### Slow Zoom In
- 别名：gradual zoom, creep zoom, Creeping zoom, Zoom progressif ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/slow-zoom-in)
- 定义：A slow zoom in is slow zoom in cinematography that tightens the frame by increasing focal length while the camera body stays locked. Perspective relations stay fixed: the world does not slide, it only enlarges as the lens compresses space.
- 叙事功能：The shot is a thought that closes without walking. Geography stays put, so the audience feels watched or analyzed rather than approached. Faces grow, walls stay in the same relation, and the pressure is optical. Use it when attention must narrow and the room must not rearrange itself. It is the wrong tool when you need to enter a mind by occupying the same air: that job belongs to a physical approach, because a zoom never changes the camera's station point.
- 怎么拍：Lock a heavy tripod. Keep height, tilt, and nodal point still. Drive focal length smoothly over several seconds and rehearse focus compensation as depth of field shallows. Compression increases: distant planes look closer to the subject even though nobody moved. Prompt a locked camera body, a gradual optical zoom in, rising compression, and an explicit ban on dolly parallax.
- 何时用：Use it to raise pressure on a still figure while the architecture stays legally the same. Concrete beat: a surveillance long-lens slowly isolating one person in a crowd. Do not use it if foreground objects must peel and prove the camera walked.
- 近似对比：Dolly In, Push In, Crash Zoom In, Push InA thought lands. Do not rush it., Dolly InEnter a mind, a room, or a threat. Geography changes because the camera walks., Crash Zoom InPunctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting.
  A Dolly In translates the whole camera, so foreground and background change speed. A Push In is a physical or virtual walk whose job is a realization landing. A Crash Zoom In uses the same optical mechanism at sting speed. Stay on slow zoom in when the station point must not move. Push InA thought lands. Do not rush it. Dolly InEnter a mind, a room, or a threat. Geography changes because the camera walks. Crash Zoom InPunctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting.
- 片中实例：The Conversation isolates figures in Union Square with a gradual long-lens close. There Will Be Blood and Phantom Thread use slow optical tightening as patience and scrutiny.；These are grammar for locked-body compression, not frames to copy.；Barry Lyndon 1975Slow widening views reveal painterly social tableaux.；The Conversation 1974The opening surveillance view gradually isolates figures in Union Square.
- Prompt 模板：`Slow optical zoom in on [Subject], camera body locked on a heavy tripod, lens gradually tightening over several seconds, background compression increasing, no physical dolly, prestige-drama patience. For motion: the lens slowly zooms in for 6 seconds while the camera body stays locked and the subject stays centered.`
- 示例 Prompt：`From a distant fixed window, slowly zoom into a solitary woman waiting at the center of a city square. Eight seconds, no camera translation, no foreground parallax, patient observational mood. She never acknowledges the camera.`
- Prompt 要点：Smooth optical zoom only.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Dolly In or a digital crop sold as a zoom. The tell is parallax: if a foreground chair slides against the wall, you translated. The fix is a locked head, a true focal-length change, and a hold on the final tight frame.

### Slow Zoom Out
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/slow-zoom-out)
- 定义：A slow zoom out widens the frame by decreasing focal length while the support stays put. More architecture and negative space enter the picture, yet the camera never travels, so true parallax does not appear.
- 叙事功能：The joke, the trap, or the social system was already around the person. The lens simply admits it. Because the station point is unchanged, the reveal feels observational: we were always this far away, we only chose to see more. It is the wrong tool when the camera must retreat through a doorway, lose a foreground, or leave someone behind in real space. Optical widening cannot walk out of a room.
- 怎么拍：Lock the tripod and reverse the zoom. Start on a composed tight frame and pre-compose the wide end so heads, signs, and negative space land. Focus will deepen as focal length shortens. Prompt a tripod-locked optical zoom out, no camera body travel, and name what architecture must appear by the last frame.
- 何时用：Use it to reveal context, isolation, or an off-screen joke that was already in the location. Concrete beat: a tight face opening onto a dinner table that has been watching. Do not use it to exit a location: that is a physical pull.
- 近似对比：Pull Out, Dolly Out, Slow Zoom In, Pull OutShow the container around a feeling., Dolly OutLeave someone behind, or show how small they are in the system., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  A Pull Out and a Dolly Out move the camera backward, so foreground objects leave the frame with parallax. A slow zoom out only changes the lens angle of view. If you also need a Slow Zoom In cousin in the same scene, keep both bodies locked so the pair stays optical. Pull OutShow the container around a feeling. Dolly OutLeave someone behind, or show how small they are in the system. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Barry Lyndon widens into painterly social tableaux without walking the camera into the party. The Social Network, Her, and Lost in Translation use slow optical opening to place a person inside a system they cannot leave.；Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Slow optical zoom out from [Subject], tripod locked, the frame breathing open to reveal surrounding architecture and negative space, no camera body travel. For motion: the lens slowly zooms out for 6 seconds from a tight frame on [Subject] into a wider environment.`
- 示例 Prompt：`The lens slowly zooms out for 6 seconds from a tight frame on [Subject] into a wider environment. Camera body stays still.`
- Prompt 要点：Camera body stays still.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Dolly Out. The tell is a sliding foreground: plants, shoulders, or door jambs changing their overlap. The fix is to freeze the support and drive only focal length, then hold the wide.

### Crash Zoom In
- 别名：whip zoom, snap zoom, zoom in, zoom out, slow zoom, Zoom coup de poing ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/crash-zoom-in)
- 定义：A crash zoom is a rapid focal-length snap from a wider frame into a detail, usually without moving the camera. The punch is optical and conspicuous: size changes faster than a body can walk.
- 叙事功能：The shot punctuates a hit, a name, a weapon, or a comic sting. Artificiality is the point. The audience is not invited to approach; they are struck by a lens. It is the wrong tool for a thought that should land over several seconds, and the wrong tool for geography. After the snap, hold. If you keep zooming or add shake, the sting becomes noise.
- 怎么拍：Keep the subject on the zoom center. Use a controlled fast zoom or, in post, a high-resolution crop that still behaves like optics, not a warp. Expect radial motion blur during the snap, then a hard hold on the tight frame. Avoid autofocus hunting. Prompt an aggressive optical punch-in under one second, zoom blur, then a locked tight hold, and ban a physical dolly.
- 何时用：Use it to punctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting. Concrete beat: a name is spoken and the face slams into close-up. Do not use it as a substitute for walking closer through a room.
- 近似对比：Slow Zoom In, Dolly In, Whip Pan, Crash Zoom OutShock-reveal scale or undercut a close moment., Whip PanTransition, punchline, or sudden attention shift., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  A Slow Zoom In is the same optical family at patience speed. A Dolly In has parallax and feels like a person stepping in. A Whip Pan blurs by rotating the head, not by changing focal length. Crash zoom in is a snap of the lens, then a hold. Crash Zoom OutShock-reveal scale or undercut a close moment. Whip PanTransition, punchline, or sudden attention shift. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Django Unchained uses abrupt zooms as Western punctuation. The Grand Budapest Hotel snaps to comic information.；Kill Bill and Hot Fuzz treat the crash zoom as genre grammar rather than invisibility. Use the speed and the hold, not the costumes.；Django Unchained 2012Abrupt zooms punctuate reactions and Western-style confrontations.；The Grand Budapest Hotel 2014Sudden reframings emphasize comic information.
- Prompt 模板：`A solemn auctioneer lifts a plain wooden box. Snap-zoom instantly from a medium shot to the tiny blinking light hidden under its lid. Fixed camera position, strong punchy zoom, immediate sharp landing, no forward dolly and no slow-motion.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Aggressive crash zoom into [Subject], snap optical punch-in under one second, radial motion blur, Shaw Brothers energy, then a hard hold on the tight frame. For motion: sudden crash zoom into [Subject] in under a second, then hold.`
- Prompt 要点：Heavy zoom blur during the snap.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a fast Dolly In or a Whip Pan. The tell is parallax or horizontal streaking instead of radial zoom blur. The fix: camera body still, subject on center, snap, then freeze the tight frame. Do not add unrelated camera shake.

### Crash Zoom Out
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/crash-zoom-out)
- 定义：A crash zoom out is a sudden, fast widening of the lens from a tight frame into a much wider one, usually without moving the camera. It dumps the subject back into the environment in a fraction of a second.
- 叙事功能：Scale, danger, or a joke appears all at once. The close moment is undercut because the world was always that large; the lens simply confessed. The snap is the comedy or the horror, not a polite reveal. It is the wrong tool when you need to walk backward through furniture, or when the newly revealed space must pass the camera in layers. Optical dump is not a retreat.
- 怎么拍：Lock the body. Center the zoom so the subject does not smear sideways. Snap from the tight composition to a pre-composed wide in under a second, then hold the wide. Radial blur during the change, not handheld bounce. Prompt a sudden crash zoom out, environment exploding into view, then a locked wide hold.
- 何时用：Use it to shock-reveal scale or undercut a close moment. Concrete beat: an intimate two-shot snaps to a parking lot full of witnesses. Do not use it when the camera must physically leave the subject.
- 近似对比：Crash Zoom In, Pull Out, Slow Zoom Out, Crash Zoom InPunctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting., Pull OutShow the container around a feeling., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  A Crash Zoom In punches the other way, into a detail. A Pull Out translates the camera backward with parallax. A Slow Zoom Out discloses the same optical widening without the sting. Crash zoom out is the dump, then the hold. Crash Zoom InPunctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting. Pull OutShow the container around a feeling. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Shaun of the Dead snaps from faces into wider comic geography. Evil Dead uses violent optical widening as shock.；Hot Fuzz works the same family in both directions. Copy the snap-and-hold, not the gag content.
- Prompt 模板：`Sudden crash zoom out from [Subject], the environment exploding into view in a fraction of a second, then a locked wide hold. For motion: snap zoom out from [Subject] in under a second, revealing the wider scene, then hold.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Snap zoom out from [Subject] in under a second, revealing the wider scene, then hold.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Dolly Out or a Crash Zoom In fired in the wrong direction. The tell is sliding foreground or a punch that gets tighter instead of wider. The fix: locked body, pre-composed wide end, snap out, hold.

### Dolly In
- 别名：truck in, dolly forward, Dolly shot, dolly out, lateral dolly, diagonal dolly ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/dolly-in)
- 定义：A dolly in shot moves the entire camera through space on a wheeled or tracked support, advancing toward the subject at a measured pace. The nodal point walks, so foreground and background shift in parallax as the surroundings are progressively excluded.
- 叙事功能：The camera enters a mind, a room, or a threat by occupying new air. Unlike a cut, the audience experiences the change of attention continuously. A small travel can make a thought feel consequential because space itself has agreed to close. It is the wrong tool when you want optical compression without new geography, or when the beat is only a sting. If the track is longer than the thought, the move tours.
- 怎么拍：Lay track or roll a wheeled dolly on a known axis. Fix focal length, usually a moderate spherical such as 40mm. Keep eye height constant unless the story changes rank. Tie the arrival at close-up to a change in the actor's thought. Foreground objects will slide. Prompt a physical dolly in on track, camera body gliding forward, parallax shifting, no optical zoom.
- 何时用：Use it to enter a mind, a room, or a threat, because geography changes when the camera walks. Concrete beat: a medium two-shot that arrives on a lie forming in one face. Do not use a digital zoom and call it a dolly.
- 近似对比：Slow Zoom In, Push In, Tracking Shot, Push InA thought lands. Do not rush it., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes., Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture.
  A Slow Zoom In keeps the station point and only changes focal length, so there is no walking parallax. A Push In is the pressure job that can be a short dolly, slider, or Steadicam; dolly in names the wheeled path and the traction. Tracking Shot matches a mover instead of closing on a still thought. Push InA thought lands. Do not rush it. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes. Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture.
- 片中实例：The Shining uses measured forward travel through the hotel so rooms become traps. Goodfellas often walks the camera as social pressure, distinct from its Copa track.；Oldboy's corridor work is mostly lateral tracking; use it as a reminder that forward dolly and side track are different axes. Grammar for translation, not a shot to duplicate.；Jaws 1975The gradual approach toward Quint during the Indianapolis monologue; shot boundaries and camera-versus-zoom mechanics require an edition check.
- Prompt 模板：`An archivist sits at a desk and notices a familiar signature on an old letter. Begin in a medium-wide shot. Over eight seconds dolly slowly forward to a close-up, fixed lens, subtle foreground parallax, no zoom. Her eyes lift only at the end. Restrained daylight, no cut.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Physical dolly in toward [Subject] on track, camera body gliding forward, parallax shifting foreground against background, 40mm spherical, buttery traction. For motion: the camera physically dollies forward toward [Subject] for 6 seconds.`
- Prompt 要点：Foreground parallax, no optical zoom.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Slow Zoom In or a crop. The tell is missing parallax: walls grow but never slide. The fix is a real translation, fixed focal length, constant eye height, and an end frame tied to a thought, not to a clock.

### Dolly Out
- 别名：truck out, pull back, Dolly shot, dolly in, lateral dolly, diagonal dolly ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/dolly-out)
- 定义：A dolly out shot withdraws the entire camera through space on a wheeled or tracked support. The world widens with true parallax, and the subject shrinks inside architecture because the station point has actually retreated.
- 叙事功能：We understand an expression first, then discover the social situation or danger that gives it meaning. Leaving someone behind is a spatial fact: the camera walks away, so the person is abandoned in a real room. It is the wrong tool when you only need a detached, flat widening, or when the famous pull-back you remember was actually a zoom. Check perspective before you name the rig.
- 怎么拍：Compose the tight and wide endpoints first. Reveal surrounding elements in a deliberate order as the dolly retreats. Keep focal length fixed so size change comes from distance. Foreground will enter from the edges. Prompt a physical dolly out on track, true parallax, subject shrinking inside architecture, no zoom-out.
- 何时用：Use it to leave someone behind, or to show how small they are in the system. Concrete beat: a confession in close coverage, then the camera retreats until the office owns them. Do not call every famous pull-back a dolly.
- 近似对比：Pull Out, Slow Zoom Out, Aerial Pullback, Pull OutShow the container around a feeling., Aerial PullbackClose a chapter. Geography wins., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  A Pull Out is the generic retreat job and may be virtual, Steadicam, or crane-backed; dolly out specifies wheeled translation at human height. A Slow Zoom Out widens without walking. An Aerial Pullback leaves the ground and hands the scene to geography from above. Pull OutShow the container around a feeling. Aerial PullbackClose a chapter. Geography wins. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：A Clockwork Orange withdraws from Alex to reveal the Korova Milk Bar. The Godfather opens by withdrawing from Bonasera until the office encounter is the room.；The Truman Show uses retreat to disclose the container around a life. Confirm each shot's parallax before treating it as track.；A Clockwork Orange 1971Opening withdrawal from Alex to reveal the Korova Milk Bar.；The Godfather 1972Opening withdrawal from Bonasera reveals the office encounter.
- Prompt 模板：`Start tightly on a calm pianist's face. Pull the camera backward in one uninterrupted shot, fixed focal length, gradually revealing that the grand piano stands alone in a flooded ballroom. Keep the face natural and delay the water reveal until the middle of the shot.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Physical dolly out from [Subject], camera retreating on track, the world widening with true parallax, subject shrinking inside architecture. For motion: the camera physically dollies backward away from [Subject], revealing more environment with parallax.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Slow Zoom Out. The tell is a flat grow of the frame with no new overlap of furniture. The fix: translate backward, keep the lens fixed, and let foreground objects arrive at the edges in order.

### Dolly Left
- 别名：truck left ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/dolly-left)
- 定义：A dolly left, also called a truck left, slides the whole camera sideways to the left on wheels or track. The lens stays aimed with the subject while background planes peel past in parallax.
- 叙事功能：The shot surveys a space or stays with a walker without yawing the head. New information enters from the left as the right side of the room exits. Because the camera translates, pillars and furniture change their overlap instead of merely sweeping. It is the wrong tool when you only need to look left from a locked tripod. A pan would rotate; this move relocates.
- 怎么拍：Lay track parallel to the action, horizon locked, height constant. Do not pan to invent the move: the body slides, the lens holds its relative aim. Subject may stay framed while the world peels, or the camera may discover a new person as it trucks. Prompt a lateral dolly left on track, background planes peeling, subject tracked in frame.
- 何时用：Use it to survey a space or stay with a walker without turning the camera. Concrete beat: sliding along a diner counter so each stool and face arrives in order. Do not pan from sticks and label it a truck.
- 近似对比：Pan Left, Dolly Right, Tracking Shot, Dolly RightOpposite of dolly left; pick the direction that reveals new information., Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  A Pan Left rotates on a fixed vertical axis with no body travel. A Dolly Right is the same translation the other way: pick the direction that reveals new information. Tracking Shot often trucks like this while matching a mover's pace; dolly left can also survey a still line of objects. Dolly RightOpposite of dolly left; pick the direction that reveals new information. Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：There Will Be Blood uses lateral travel to read rooms and landscapes as systems. In the Mood for Love slides along corridors and walls so delay and gossip live in the peeling planes.；Use the side-slip, not the color grade.
- Prompt 模板：`Lateral dolly left across [Subject], camera sliding sideways on track, background planes peeling in parallax, subject tracked in frame. For motion: the camera slides left on a dolly, keeping [Subject] in frame, background parallax visible.`
- 示例 Prompt：`The camera slides left on a dolly, keeping [Subject] in frame, background parallax visible.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Pan Left. The tell is a rotating horizon of objects with no change of station point, and no peeling of near columns against far walls. The fix is a true sideways translation, level horizon, fixed height.

### Dolly Right
- 别名：truck right ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/dolly-right)
- 定义：A dolly right, or truck right, moves the camera body sideways to the right without panning. New space enters from one side of the frame while the other side exits, and layered parallax proves the translation.
- 叙事功能：Direction is a reveal order. Trucking right can disclose a listener, a door, or a threat that was legally off-screen to camera right. The horizon stays level; only the world slides. It is the wrong tool when the camera should yaw to glance, or when a few centimeters of slider would be enough. Pick the side that produces information, not a decorative glide.
- 怎么拍：Track parallel, height and tilt constant, no compensatory pan unless you are combining moves on purpose. Keep the horizon locked. Prompt a lateral dolly right, smooth sideways travel, layered parallax, locked horizon.
- 何时用：Use the opposite of dolly left: pick the direction that reveals new information. Concrete beat: sliding right along a car's profile until a second passenger appears. Do not truck both ways in one clip without a reason.
- 近似对比：Dolly Left, Pan Right, Tracking Shot, Slider Shot, Dolly LeftSurvey a space or stay with a walker without turning the camera., Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  Dolly Left is the same physics mirrored. A Pan Right only rotates. Tracking Shot uses this lateral axis when the subject is also moving; dolly right can scan a still lineup. A Slider Shot is a short version of the same linear idea. Dolly LeftSurvey a space or stay with a walker without turning the camera. Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Children of Men often relocates the camera through real streets rather than glancing from a locked head. The Player's studio-lot sentence includes lateral travel as part of a longer choreography.；Take the side-slip as grammar, not the whole oner.
- Prompt 模板：`Lateral dolly right across [Subject], smooth sideways travel, layered parallax, locked horizon. For motion: the camera slides right on a dolly, keeping [Subject] framed, smooth lateral parallax.`
- 示例 Prompt：`The camera slides right on a dolly, keeping [Subject] framed, smooth lateral parallax.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Pan Right or an 360-Degree Orbit that starts to curve. The tell is yaw, a dipping horizon, or a changing camera-to-subject distance. The fix: straight track, rightward translation, constant radius to the subject if you are holding them.

### Pan Left
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/pan-left)
- 定义：A pan left is pan shot cinematography that rotates the camera on a fixed tripod or head around its vertical axis, sweeping the view to the left. The support does not travel; only the direction of the lens changes.
- 叙事功能：Two facts in one geography get connected by a look. A rider and a doorway, a speaker and the person they will not face. Because the sticks stay put, the audience remains in one station and is asked only to turn. It is the wrong tool when you must pass behind a column with true parallax, or when the blur of a whip is the point. If foreground does not need to slide, a pan is enough. If it does, truck.
- 怎么拍：Level the horizon on a fluid head. Rotate yaw only. Start and end on composed frames, feather the start and stop, and keep the nodal point over the tripod so the pan does not walk. No body travel. Prompt a slow pan left from a locked tripod, rotation on the vertical axis, level horizon, new architecture to the left.
- 何时用：Use it to connect two things in one geography without moving the support. Concrete beat: a look off left, then the pan finds what they see. Do not tour a whole room if a cut or a track would be cleaner.
- 近似对比：Dolly Left, Pan Right, Whip Pan, Tilt Up, Pan RightSame as pan left, other direction. End on the story beat., Whip PanTransition, punchline, or sudden attention shift., Tilt UpReveal height, awe, or a face last.
  A Dolly Left translates and peels planes. A Pan Right is the same rotation the other way. A Whip Pan is this axis past the blur threshold, often used as a join. A Tilt Up rotates on the horizontal axis instead. Pan RightSame as pan left, other direction. End on the story beat. Whip PanTransition, punchline, or sudden attention shift. Tilt UpReveal height, awe, or a face last.
- 片中实例：The Searchers connects rider, land, and doorway with turning looks from a held position. The Rules of the Game (on the sister page as a right pan) is the same Renoir law: a head turn through deep space.；Weekend is often listed beside long connecting moves; confirm whether a given beat is a pan or a lateral track before copying its mechanism.
- Prompt 模板：`Slow pan left from a locked tripod across [Subject], camera rotating on its vertical axis, horizon level, revealing new architecture to the left. For motion: the camera pans left from a fixed tripod, sweeping across [Subject] and the environment.`

### 360-Degree Orbit
- 别名：circular tracking, orbit shot, Orbit 360, 360-degree shot, partial orbit, Arc shot ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/orbit-360)
- 定义：A 360-degree orbit shot circles the subject through a full turn, usually at a constant radius, always facing them. The background becomes a continuous ribbon while the person stays the center of interest.
- 叙事功能：Time can feel as if it collapsed around one kiss, one threat, or one product. Unlike a pan, the camera reveals different sides of the subject and changes their relation to every wall. A full orbit calls attention to space itself; a partial arc can be quieter. It is the wrong tool when you only needed a quarter-turn to change a conversation axis, and the wrong tool if the subject is spinning on a turntable while the camera sits still. Separate live-speed orbiting from bullet time, which also manipulates time.
- 怎么拍：Lay a circular path, pick a center, coordinate focus as distance breathes. Keep height even unless you also boom. Do not zoom during the orbit unless you want a different technique. Prompt a full 360-degree orbit, constant radius, always facing the subject, background wrapping as a ribbon of light.
- 何时用：Use it when a moment should close around one person: kiss, threat, or product hero. Concrete beat: a couple kisses while the room becomes a ribbon. Do not also zoom, and do not let the subject rotate instead of the camera.
- 近似对比：Arc Left, Arc Right, Lazy Susan, Arc LeftChange the axis of a conversation or reveal the other half of a room., Arc RightSame as arc left, other side., Lazy SusanShow an object or costume from every side.
  Arc Left and Arc Right are partial orbits, often about 90 degrees, for axis change rather than spectacle. A Lazy Susan turns the object while the camera may stay put. A pan never relocates the support. Orbit 360 is a full inspection on an azimuth circle. Arc LeftChange the axis of a conversation or reveal the other half of a room. Arc RightSame as arc left, other side. Lazy SusanShow an object or costume from every side.
- 片中实例：The Matrix circles suspended action in the rooftop bullet-time sequence: orbit plus time manipulation, so keep the distinction. Vertigo circles Scottie and Judy as the remembered setting appears.；Carlito's Way and American Beauty use live-speed orbits as trap or rapture. Grammar of the circle, not a costume to copy.；The Matrix 1999The camera circles suspended action in the rooftop bullet-time sequence.；Vertigo 1958Scottie and Judy kiss as the camera circles and the remembered setting appears.
- Prompt 模板：`Full 360-degree orbit around [Subject], camera circling at constant radius, background becoming a continuous ribbon of light, centripetal romantic or predatory energy. For motion: the camera orbits 360 degrees around [Subject], always facing them, background wrapping as a ribbon of light.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Orbit clockwise 120 degrees around a violinist standing still in an empty circular hall. Keep her eyes near the same point in frame, natural live-speed motion, constant camera distance, no zoom. Columns reveal genuine changing perspective. One uninterrupted eight-second take.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a subject rotating on the spot, or a Pan Left from sticks. The tell is a fixed background with a spinning body, or no parallax. The fix: camera travels a circle, subject mostly still, background wrapping, constant radius.

### Arc Left

### Tracking Shot
- 别名：traveling shot, follow shot, lead shot, side-follow, chase shot, walk-and-talk ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/tracking)
- 定义：A tracking shot moves with, beside, ahead of, or behind a moving subject, typically matching pace on a parallel path. The person supplies the motion; the camera keeps distance, height, and scale while foreground, mid-ground, and deep background peel.
- 叙事功能：Accompany a walker. The picture is not a postcard of a person; it is duration spent in their path. Side-on tracking keeps cause, distance, and fatigue visible, which is why corridor fights and long walks live here. It is the wrong tool for a seated confession, and the wrong tool if you only panned from a locked tripod with a long lens. If foreground does not slide, you did not track.
- 怎么拍：Use dolly, Steadicam, gimbal, or vehicle on a path parallel to the action. Match speed. Hold a consistent distance and shoulder height unless the story changes rank. One direction. Prompt a lateral tracking shot, camera matching pace on a parallel path, shoulder height, parallax of three planes.
- 何时用：Use it to accompany a walker through space that must stay readable. Concrete beat: a side-on corridor fight in which exhaustion is as visible as the hits. Do not track a still interrogation.
- 近似对比：Follow Shot, Walk and Talk, Steadicam, Dolly Left, Follow ShotPursuit, haunting, or walking someone into a room., SteadicamLong connecting moves through architecture. Neither handheld nor dolly., Walk and TalkInformation and geography move together.
  A Follow Shot trails behind, using the back of the head as foreground. A Walk and Talk is tracking put to conversation coverage. Steadicam is a support that often executes tracks. A Dolly Left can track a still line; tracking as a job is subject-locked travel. Do not confuse it with a static telephoto pan. Follow ShotPursuit, haunting, or walking someone into a room. SteadicamLong connecting moves through architecture. Neither handheld nor dolly. Walk and TalkInformation and geography move together.
- 片中实例：Touch of Evil opens with a long traveling sentence. Children of Men and 1917 keep geography continuous while people move.；Oldboy's hammer fight is predominantly side-on tracking in a narrow corridor. The 400 Blows ends on Antoine's run toward the sea.；Grammar of matched pace, not a stunt to copy.；Oldboy 2003The hammer fight in the narrow corridor.；Oldboy 2003The corridor hammer fight seen predominantly from the side.；The 400 Blows 1959Antoine's run toward the sea near the end.
- Prompt 模板：`Side-on continuous shot of a tired security guard trying to pass three obstructing figures in a narrow service corridor. Choreographed non-graphic action, visible pauses and fatigue, full bodies readable, camera tracks only laterally. No rapid edits, no impossible acrobatics, no concealed geography.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Lateral tracking shot of [Subject], camera matching pace on a parallel path, shoulder height, parallax of foreground, mid-ground, and deep background. For motion: the camera tracks alongside [Subject] at walking pace, holding a consistent distance.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Pan Left from a locked head, or a Slow Zoom In that only changes size. The tell is no sliding foreground. The fix: a traveling support, matching pace, near objects passing.

### Follow Shot
- 别名：lead shot, side-follow, chase shot, walk-and-talk ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/follow)
- 定义：A follow shot trails a moving subject at a fixed offset, usually from behind. The back of the head becomes foreground and the world opens ahead, so pursuit, haunting, or arrival is felt as walking into space.
- 叙事功能：You are taken with them, not shown beside them. Doorways reveal themselves as they would to a stalker or a guardian. The face is withheld, which can be predatory or intimate depending on distance and height. It is the wrong tool when the audience must read both faces of a conversation, and the wrong tool if the camera is bolted to the chest looking back at the actor. Behind is a choice; body-mount is another.
- 怎么拍：Match movement through the space at a fixed offset. Steadicam, gimbal, or handheld can execute it; the grammar is the trailing station, not the vest. Keep the head as a stable foreground mass. Prompt a follow shot behind the subject, camera trailing at a fixed offset, back of the head as foreground, the world opening ahead.
- 何时用：Use it for pursuit, haunting, or walking someone into a room. Concrete beat: behind a child on a tricycle as the corridor keeps producing corners. Do not follow if the scene is a two-hander that needs eyes.
- 近似对比：Tracking Shot, Steadicam, SnorriCam, Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture., SteadicamLong connecting moves through architecture. Neither handheld nor dolly., SnorriCamTrap the audience in a body that cannot get out.
  Tracking Shot often rides beside and shows the body's full action. Steadicam is a common support for follow. A SnorriCam is mounted to the performer and faces them, so the face is pinned and the world sloshes. Follow looks at their back, not into their face from a chest rig. Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture. SteadicamLong connecting moves through architecture. Neither handheld nor dolly. SnorriCamTrap the audience in a body that cannot get out.
- 片中实例：The Shining puts us behind Danny in the hotel so corners arrive as he arrives. Enter the Void uses trailing and floating follow as afterlife grammar.；Goodfellas' Copa entrance is a follow that becomes a social descent into a room. Path grammar, not a hotel to rebuild.
- Prompt 模板：`Follow shot behind [Subject], camera trailing at a fixed offset, the back of the head as foreground, the world opening ahead. For motion: the camera follows behind [Subject], matching their movement through the space.`
- 示例 Prompt：`The camera follows behind [Subject], matching their movement through the space.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a side Tracking Shot shot or a SnorriCam. The tell is a full profile, or a pinned face with a sliding world. The fix: behind, fixed offset, head as foreground, space opening ahead.

### Steadicam
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/steadicam)
- 定义：Steadicam is a mechanical stabilizing system using a sled, arm, and vest, so an operator can walk while the camera floats. The path can connect rooms with a smoothness that is neither handheld tremor nor dolly traction.
- 叙事功能：Long connecting moves through architecture. Light temperatures shift as rooms change. The operator is walking, so the camera can turn corners, climb stairs, and arrive in a new social weather without laying track through every door. It is the wrong tool when you want documentary shake, or when a straight corridor would be cleaner and cheaper on track. It is also not a gimbal: the isolation comes from a mechanical arm and the operator's trained gait, not from motors alone.
- 怎么拍：Vest, spring arm, sled, and a balanced camera. The operator walks a rehearsed line; the camera is isolated from footfall. You can still boom slightly with the arm. Prompt Steadicam floating with the subject through connected spaces, preternatural smoothness, operator walking, no footfall shake.
- 何时用：Use it for long connecting moves through architecture, neither handheld nor dolly. Concrete beat: through a kitchen, down a stair, into a club, one path. Do not Steadicam a lock-off that only needed sticks.
- 近似对比：Gimbal Shot, Handheld, Tracking Shot, Walk and Talk, Oner, Gimbal ShotRun-and-gun smoothness without a Steadicam vest., Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture., OnerThe scene is a ride.
  A Gimbal Shot uses motorized electronic stabilization and is often run without a vest. Handheld keeps the operator's mass in the image as micro-tremor. Tracking Shot is the job; Steadicam is a support that can execute tracks, follows, and Walk and Talk coverage. A Oner may be shot on Steadicam, but length of take is not the stabilizer. Gimbal ShotRun-and-gun smoothness without a Steadicam vest. Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture. OnerThe scene is a ride.
- 片中实例：The Shining's corridor work is the textbook Steadicam walk. Goodfellas' Copa is a vest-and-arm descent through service spaces into a table.；Boogie Nights connects rooms as social circuits. Smooth path, human scale: that is the grammar.
- Prompt 模板：`Steadicam floating with [Subject] through connected spaces, preternatural smoothness, operator walking, light temperatures shifting as rooms change. For motion: smooth Steadicam move floating with [Subject] through the environment, no footfall shake.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Smooth Steadicam move floating with [Subject] through the environment, no footfall shake.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Handheld shake added as a preset, or a Gimbal Shot clip that never feels like a vest. The tell is tremor, or a weightless electronic drift with no human gait. The fix: name Steadicam, operator walking, isolated footfall, connected architecture.

### Handheld
- 别名：shaky cam, The Children of Men car ambush ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/handheld)
- 定义：A handheld camera is operated from the body without a stabilizing vest or gimbal, so breathing, micro-shake, and mass stay in the frame. The image has the nerves of a person holding weight, not a track and not a motor.

Do not describe a car ambush as simply a person with a Steadicam inside an ordinary car when the original was a designed interior path.

- 何时用：Use it for urgency, documentary truth, or a mind that cannot sit still. Concrete beat: a raid through a crowd where the operator cannot get a clean view. Do not handheld a still product on a table.

### Push In

Do not confuse it with terrain incline. Dutch AngleThe world is off its axis. Do not use as decoration. Camera RollGravity is optional. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.

- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a locked Dutch Angle or a full Camera Roll. The tell is a still tilt from frame one, or a continuous spin past 45 degrees with no stop. The fix: start level, roll on axis over time, end on a chosen cant.

### Camera Roll

Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
