### Walk and Talk
- 别名：follow shot, lead shot, side-follow, chase shot, walk-and-talk ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/walk-and-talk)
- 定义：A walk and talk shot moves with speaking people, camera leading or flanking at medium, so information and geography travel together. Architecture flows while a moving two-shot (or a moving single with interruptions) carries the dialogue.
- 叙事功能：Talk does not pause for a room, and the room does not pause for talk. Doorways, extras, and turning corners become the punctuation of the lines. The job is coverage of conversation in motion, not a silent hunt. It is the wrong tool for a chase with no words, and the wrong tool for a seated interrogation. If nobody is walking while talking, it is just a track.
- 怎么拍：Steadicam or gimbal, often leading, sometimes flanking. Hold a moving medium, shoulder height, leave headroom for doorways. Recorders and extras must be blocked as part of the path. Prompt walk-and-talk tracking, camera leading or flanking at medium, architecture flowing, corridor energy.
- 何时用：Use it when information and geography must move together. Concrete beat: two people argue policy while threading a bullpen, never sitting. Do not walk-and-talk a scene that wants a table.
- 近似对比：Tracking Shot, Follow Shot, Steadicam, Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture., SteadicamLong connecting moves through architecture. Neither handheld nor dolly., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  Tracking Shot is the broader travel job and may be silent action. A Follow Shot hides faces behind heads. Steadicam is the usual support. Walk-and-talk is specifically dialogue plus path: West Wing grammar, not a hammer fight. Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture. SteadicamLong connecting moves through architecture. Neither handheld nor dolly. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：The West Wing made corridor walk-and-talk the series' coverage engine. The Social Network uses walking conversation so status and architecture share the lines.；Birdman is a cousin in longer connecting talk. Speech in motion: that is the grammar.
- Prompt 模板：`Walk-and-talk tracking of [Subject] in conversation motion, camera leading or flanking at medium, architecture flowing, West Wing corridor energy. For motion: the camera leads [Subject] walking through a space, holding a moving medium two-shot energy even if one figure.`
- 示例 Prompt：`The camera leads [Subject] walking through a space, holding a moving medium two-shot energy even if one figure.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a silent Follow Shot or a seated two-shot with a slow Dolly In. The tell is the back of a head, or feet that do not walk. The fix: people talking while walking, camera leading or flanking, faces readable, rooms changing.

### Hyperlapse
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/hyperlapse)
- 定义：A hyperlapse combines time-lapse with significant camera movement through space. Time is compressed while the camera advances in steps that assemble into a glide, so crowds and weather race along a real path.
- 叙事功能：Duration becomes velocity. A walk that would take an afternoon becomes a few seconds, but unlike a locked time-lapse the station point travels: streets are traversed, not merely watched from one roof. It is the wrong tool for real-time tracking, and the wrong tool for a tripod time-lapse of clouds over a still city. If the camera did not move between frames, it is not a hyperlapse.
- 怎么拍：Shoot discrete frames along a surveyed path (or simulate that in 3D), then play them at time-lapse rates. Align each frame so the move reads as a glide. Crowds, traffic, and shadows should race. Prompt a hyperlapse toward or around the subject, time compressed, crowds and weather racing, camera advancing in steps that become a glide.
- 何时用：Use it to show duration as velocity along a path. Concrete beat: approaching a monument while hours of foot traffic smear. Do not hyperlapse a 6-second real-time conversation.
- 近似对比：Time-Lapse, Tracking Shot, Slider Shot, Time-LapseShow weather, construction, or a night becoming morning., Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  Time-Lapse is often a locked or slowly panned interval. Tracking Shot is real-time travel. Hyperlapse is both: interval shooting plus significant displacement. A Slider Shot interval on 100 centimeters is a tiny cousin, not a city traverse. Time-LapseShow weather, construction, or a night becoming morning. Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Koyaanisqatsi compresses traffic and weather into velocity, sometimes from moving viewpoints. Baraka and related city-interval work sit in the same family.；Music-video hyperlapse made the stepped camera path a popular grammar. Use time plus travel, not a particular skyline.
- Prompt 模板：`Hyperlapse toward or around [Subject], time compressed, crowds and weather racing, camera advancing in steps that become a glide. For motion: hyperlapse: the camera advances through the space around [Subject] while time is compressed, clouds and traffic racing.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Hyperlapse: the camera advances through the space around [Subject] while time is compressed, clouds and traffic racing.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a locked Time-Lapse or a real-time Tracking Shot shot with a speed ramp. The tell is a still station point, or real-time gait. The fix: camera position changes between frames, time compressed, path readable as a glide.

### Slider Shot
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/slider)
- 定义：A slider shot is a short, precise linear move on a compact rail, often 60 to 120 centimeters. It adds parallax to an interview, product, or lock-off without a full dolly track.
- 叙事功能：A full dolly is too much. A few centimeters of travel can prove the room has depth: a microphone in the foreground slides against a face, a bottle turns against a window. The move is small on purpose. It is the wrong tool for a city block, and the wrong tool if you needed a curve around a product. If the rail is meters long, you are dollying. If the path is a circle, you are orbiting.
- 怎么拍：Clamp a short rail, level it, choose a constant speed. Keep the move lateral or a tiny push; do not hide a zoom inside it. Prompt a short slider move, 60 to 120 centimeters of lateral travel, product or interview parallax, precise and small.
- 何时用：Use it when a full dolly is too much and a lock-off needs a little parallax. Concrete beat: an interview single with a lamp sliding in the foreground over 6 seconds. Do not slider a chase.
- 近似对比：Dolly Left, 360-Degree Orbit, Push In, Dolly LeftSurvey a space or stay with a walker without turning the camera., 360-Degree OrbitTime collapses around one person: kiss, threat, or product hero., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  A Dolly Left is the same linear idea at room or street scale. An 360-Degree Orbit is curved and long. A Push In may use a slider as the rail, but push in is the Z-axis thought; slider names the short linear tool. Slider is compact travel, not a path through architecture. Dolly LeftSurvey a space or stay with a walker without turning the camera. 360-Degree OrbitTime collapses around one person: kiss, threat, or product hero. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：The grammar is commercial and interview more than a single famous scene: tabletop product films, documentary talking heads, small table moves inside features. Use the 60-to-120-centimeter parallax, not a particular ad to clone.
- Prompt 模板：`Short slider move across [Subject], 60 to 120 centimeters of lateral travel, product or interview parallax, precise and small. For motion: a short slider move laterally across [Subject], subtle parallax, 6 seconds.`
- 示例 Prompt：`A short slider move laterally across [Subject], subtle parallax, 6 seconds.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a full Dolly Left or a tiny 360-Degree Orbit. The tell is meters of travel, or a curve. The fix: name the short rail, linear path, subtle parallax, end still in the same room.

### Lazy Susan
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/lazy-susan)
- 定义：A lazy susan shot rotates the subject on a motorized turntable while the camera stays put, or the camera circles at a fixed product-hero radius. Distance holds, so scale does not change, and the far wall barely shears if the disc is what turns.
- 叙事功能：Use it to inspect. A coat, a bottle, a weapon, a figure treated as merchandise: every azimuth is offered without a cut. Light should stay consistent so the object, not the room, is what changes. It is the wrong tool when geography matters. If walls, extras, and lamps must slide to prove a living space, you want an orbit. A conversation, a chase, a blocked room: those need the camera to travel.
- 怎么拍：The classic rig is a motorized disc under the subject; the camera is locked on sticks at eye or product height, often 50 to 85mm so the silhouette stays clean. Alternate: a circular slider at constant radius with the subject locked. Either way, nodal distance is constant. Prompt a slow turntable rotation or a camera circling at product-hero distance, one revolution or a 90-degree reveal, no zoom.
- 何时用：Show an object or costume from every side: a dress on a dummy, a car on a cyc, a relic on glass. Do not use it for a talk; faces in dialogue do not need a spin.
- 近似对比：360-Degree Orbit, 3D Rotation, Arc, 360-Degree OrbitTime collapses around one person: kiss, threat, or product hero., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes., Slow Zoom OutReveal context, isolation, or a joke that was off-screen.
  360-Degree Orbit walks the camera around a living space so walls and extras shear. A lazy susan keeps radius and usually the room still. 3D Rotation treats the figure as a virtual sculpture in computed space. An Arc is a partial circle that still faces a person in a real room. 360-Degree OrbitTime collapses around one person: kiss, threat, or product hero. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes. Slow Zoom OutReveal context, isolation, or a joke that was off-screen.
- 片中实例：Product films and music-video costume spins are the grammar: perfume turntables, album-cover rotations, a hero prop shown as a specimen. These are inspection uses, not a narrative street orbit.
- Prompt 模板：`Quote the move, not a mood. Still: Lazy-Susan rotation of [Subject] on a turntable while the camera stays put, or the camera circles a static product, commercial 360 hero.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: [Subject] rotates slowly as if on a turntable, or the camera circles at product-hero distance. Name the object, keep distance constant, forbid a zoom.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is an orbit. The tell: background sliding, a lamp shearing, the room turning. The fix: lock the camera or lock the subject to a disc, keep radius constant, let only the object rotate.

### Bolt Cam
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/bolt-cam)
- 定义：A bolt cam hurls an ultra-high-speed camera along a crash rig toward an impact, then freezes. The punch is physical translation on a rail or pneumatic throw, not a change of focal length.
- 叙事功能：The camera itself is the strike. Sports packages and music-video violence use it when contact has to be felt as a mass arriving, not as a tighter crop. Near objects smear; the last frames can lock on the hit. Do not use it for a thought. A realization wants a push or a crash zoom. A bolt cam that never hits anything is just a fast dolly with no grammar.
- 怎么拍：The body rides a crash rail, wire, or robotic throw aimed at a pad, a body, or a ball. Shutter is high; speed is tens of meters per second, then a hard stop or a programmed settle. Parallax is violent because the nodal point really moves. Prompt a bolt-cam strike toward [Subject], ultra-high-speed camera on a crash rig, the lens hurled at an impact then freezing.
- 何时用：Use it when impact is the beat: a punch, a kick, a crash test, a chorus hit. Do not use it as decoration on a wide that never meets a surface.
- 近似对比：Crash Zoom In, FPV Drone, Robo Arm, Crash Zoom InPunctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting., FPV DroneImpossible proximity and speed. Not a cinematic crane; a missile with a lens., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  A Crash Zoom In is optical: the camera stays put and focal length snaps. Bolt cam translates. An FPV Drone flies and can miss; this is a aimed throw on a rig. A Robo Arm can repeat a path without the crash energy. Crash Zoom InPunctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting. FPV DroneImpossible proximity and speed. Not a cinematic crane; a missile with a lens. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Sports impact packages and music-video crash units are the grammar. The shot is a stunt camera, not a dialogue tool.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the strike, the rig, and the freeze. Still: Bolt-cam strike toward [Subject], ultra-high-speed camera on a crash rig, the lens hurled at an impact then freezing, sports and music-video violence.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: Ultra-fast camera strike toward [Subject], then a sudden settle, impact energy. Say crash rig, not zoom.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a crash zoom. The tell: no parallax, the background simply enlarges. The fix: demand body travel on a crash rig, smear in the near plane, then a settle at contact.

### Aerial
- 别名：aerial shot, drone establishing, drone wide, helicopter shot, topographic shot, Drone-style follow ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/aerial)
- 定义：An aerial shot views a large area from a high flying camera so geography reads as a map, the figure small in land or city. Helicopter, drone, or a virtual path can carry it; altitude and a stable horizon are the facts.
- 叙事功能：Open a world. The high moving viewpoint relates a small traveler or vehicle to a broad environment. It can follow, overtake, or abandon the subject so landscape becomes a force, not a painted backdrop. It is the wrong tool for a face. If the beat is an eye-line or a whisper, come down. An aerial that never finds an anchor is weather footage.
- 怎么拍：Plan a safe helicopter, drone, or virtual path. Hold horizon stability and let foreground (trees, ridges, towers) pass to prove height. Keep a visible subject anchor and avoid implausible jumps in altitude. Do not describe older helicopter footage as drone photography. Prompt: Aerial of [Subject] from a high flying camera, geography readable as a map, scale first, the figure small in land or city.
- 何时用：Use it to make the place bigger than the person: a car on a mountain road, a rider on a ridge, a city grid. Do not use it as a default establishing shot if a street-level wide already tells the map.
- 近似对比：Aerial Pullback, Aerial Push In, FPV Drone, Aerial PullbackClose a chapter. Geography wins., Aerial Push InPick one human out of a system., FPV DroneImpossible proximity and speed. Not a cinematic crane; a missile with a lens.
  Aerial Pullback specifically retreats until geography wins. Aerial Push In descends or drives in from the air toward a target. FPV Drone flies through gaps as a subjective missile; aerial is a map, not a tunnel. Aerial PullbackClose a chapter. Geography wins. Aerial Push InPick one human out of a system. FPV DroneImpossible proximity and speed. Not a cinematic crane; a missile with a lens.
- 片中实例：The Shining opens with an aerial pursuit of a car through mountain roads. Skyfall uses large-scale landscape and travel.；Lawrence of Arabia and Sicario treat desert and border as active ground, not scenery.；The Shining 1980Opening aerial pursuit of the car through mountain roads.；Skyfall 2012Large-scale views of landscape and travel.
- Prompt 模板：`An aerial camera follows a small blue car along a winding mountain road, gradually gaining altitude as the road disappears into enormous dark forest. Smooth forward motion, stable horizon, realistic road continuity and vehicle speed, no cut.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name height, the map, and the small anchor. Still: Aerial of [Subject] from a high flying camera, geography readable as a map, scale first, the figure small in land or city.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not add a snap zoom.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is an FPV thread through a window. The tell: the camera is inside architecture, horizon tumbling. The fix: stay high, keep the subject readable as a speck or vehicle, and let the land remain a map.

### Arc
- 别名：arc shot ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/arc)
- 定义：An arc shot moves the camera around the subject along part of a circle while the lens stays aimed at them. A quarter or half orbit is enough: the axis of the scene changes without a cut, and the background slides.
- 叙事功能：Use it to reorient. A booth, a kiss, a standoff can turn from front to profile to reverse without a cut, so the relationship is rewritten by parallax. The subject can stay put; the world is what orbits. A full 360 is a different promise. If you only need a new eyeline, a quarter circle is cleaner. If nobody's position in the room matters, an arc is empty decoration.
- 怎么拍：Lay track or a circular dolly, or walk a steadicam on a curve of constant radius, camera facing inward. Height usually holds (eye or chest). Foreground posts, chairs, or extras should shear faster than the far wall. Prompt: Arc around [Subject], camera traveling a curve while facing them, background sliding, a quarter or half orbit.
- 何时用：Change the axis without cutting: a table that becomes a two-shot, a reveal of who stands behind. Do not arc 180 degrees on every line; save the curve for a real change of power.
- 近似对比：Arc Left, Arc Right, 360-Degree Orbit, Pan, Arc LeftChange the axis of a conversation or reveal the other half of a room., Arc RightSame as arc left, other side., 360-Degree OrbitTime collapses around one person: kiss, threat, or product hero.
  Arc Left and Arc Right name the direction of travel. 360-Degree Orbit completes the circle and usually inspects a body in space. A Pan only yaws from a fixed point, so the background does not parallax the same way. Arc LeftChange the axis of a conversation or reveal the other half of a room. Arc RightSame as arc left, other side. 360-Degree OrbitTime collapses around one person: kiss, threat, or product hero.
- 片中实例：Goodfellas often arcs around a booth or a table as alliances shift. Atonement uses curved travel inside longer takes to reorient a scene without a cut.；Use them as grammar for changing axis, not as frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the curve, the facing, and how much of the circle. Still: Arc around [Subject], camera traveling a curve while facing them, background sliding, a quarter or half orbit.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: The camera arcs around [Subject], always facing them, background sliding past. Say quarter or half.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid a pan from sticks.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a pan. The tell: the camera body never moves, only the head yaws, and near objects do not shear. The fix: travel a curve, keep the lens on the subject, and let the background slide.

### Choreo
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/choreo)
- 定义：A choreographed camera times bodies and lens as one phrase of movement. The blocking is scored: steps, turns, and the support share a count, then the phrase ends.
- 叙事功能：The blocking is the music. Dance floors, musicals, and some fight halls need the camera to partner, not to report. One phrase: a lift, a turn, a stop. Extra flourishes after the count read as a different shot. It is the wrong tool for coverage. If you need an over-the-shoulder for a line, shoot the line. Choreo that wanders off the dancers is a tour, not a duet.
- 怎么拍：Rehearse actors and camera as one system: steadicam, dolly, or jib, marks on the floor, a shared tempo. Height usually stays human. Parallax of partners and set pieces should land on the beat. Prompt: Choreographed camera with [Subject], bodies and lens timed together, one phrase of movement, dance-floor blocking.
- 何时用：Use it when a dance, a fight, or a walk is written as a single musical sentence. Do not use it to pretty-up a scene with no shared rhythm.
- 近似对比：Steadicam, Oner, SteadicamLong connecting moves through architecture. Neither handheld nor dolly., OnerThe scene is a ride., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  Steadicam is the vest that can carry the phrase; it is a platform, not the idea. A Oner is about duration, a long take that may or may not be danced. Choreo can be short if the count is short. SteadicamLong connecting moves through architecture. Neither handheld nor dolly. OnerThe scene is a ride. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：La La Land stages camera and dancers on one count. The Umbrellas of Cherbourg treats color, step, and lens as a shared phrase.；Use them as grammar for timed blocking.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the shared phrase and stop there. Still: Choreographed camera with [Subject], bodies and lens timed together, one phrase of movement, dance-floor blocking.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: Camera and [Subject] move as one choreography, a single phrase, no extra flourishes. Forbid a second unmotivated orbit after the stop.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a wandering steadicam. The tell: the camera keeps going after the bodies have finished the phrase. The fix: one count, a shared stop, no extra travel.

### Conveyor
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/conveyor)
- 定义：A conveyor camera treats the world as a belt: relentless lateral travel at constant speed, factory or infinite product-line geometry. The subject can stand still while the line delivers the next unit past the frame.
- 叙事功能：Industry, process, no escape from the line. The shot says labor is a machine: bodies, boxes, or faces arrive and leave at one speed. Comedy and paranoia both live here. It is the wrong tool for a walker you are meant to accompany. If the person is choosing a path, truck or track with them. A conveyor that speeds up and slows with emotion is no longer a belt.
- 怎么拍：Lateral dolly, slider, or a treadmill-like set, constant velocity, often a wide or moderate-wide so units repeat. Foreground machinery should cross faster than the far wall. Exposure can be industrial: hard practicals, green or sodium, no beauty key. Prompt: Conveyor move past [Subject], the world sliding on a belt, factory or infinite product line, relentless lateral travel.
- 何时用：Use it for a factory, an assembly of faces, a process that will not stop. Do not use it beside a casual sidewalk chat.
- 近似对比：Trucking, Tracking Shot, Dolly, Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture., TruckingStay beside a walker., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  Trucking stays beside a walker; speed is human. Tracking Shot follows a chosen path. Conveyor is the line that does not care. A Dolly can go any direction; this one is lateral and metronomic. Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture. TruckingStay beside a walker. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Modern Times turns the factory into a belt the body cannot leave. The Parallax View uses industrial process and test-film geometry as a trap.；Grammar: constant lateral speed, repeating units.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the belt and the constant speed. Still: Conveyor move past [Subject], the world sliding on a belt, factory or infinite product line, relentless lateral travel.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: The world slides past [Subject] as if on a conveyor, constant lateral speed. Forbid a halt in the middle unless the line jams on purpose.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a trucking shot with a walker. The tell: the subject is strolling and the camera is being polite. The fix: constant lateral speed, repeating units, the person as another item on the line.

### Dolly
- 别名：dolly shot, doorway dolly, Fisher dolly, Chapman dolly ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/dolly)
- 定义：A dolly shot places the camera on a wheeled platform so the body translates through space: doorway dolly, Fisher, Chapman. Because the nodal point moves, foreground, mid-ground, and background change in parallax, which a zoom cannot do.
- 叙事功能：Walk the camera. Change geography. In, out, or beside: the point is that the support rolls, so space is proven by relative motion. A face can grow because you approached, not because the glass got longer. A zoom is the wrong cousin when you need the room to be real. If you only need a tighter crop from sticks, zoom. If the floor cannot take track, say so and use a vest or a crane instead of faking wheels.
- 怎么拍：Lay level track or dance the wheels on a floor. Height is set by the column (often eye or chest). In and out ride the lens axis; a lateral truck is still a dolly. Keep the horizon honest. Prompt: Dolly toward or beside [Subject], camera body traveling on a smooth path, true parallax, not a zoom.
- 何时用：Use it when the camera must walk: approach a face, leave a room, slide a corridor. Do not call a zoom a dolly.
- 近似对比：Dolly In, Dolly Out, Tracking Shot, Zoom, Push In, Dolly InEnter a mind, a room, or a threat. Geography changes because the camera walks., Dolly OutLeave someone behind, or show how small they are in the system., Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture.
  Dolly In and Dolly Out name the axis along the lens. Tracking Shot follows a moving subject. A Zoom changes focal length with the body still, so there is no parallax. A Push In is often a vest or a looser approach; a dolly is wheels and a path. Dolly InEnter a mind, a room, or a threat. Geography changes because the camera walks. Dolly OutLeave someone behind, or show how small they are in the system. Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture.
- 片中实例：The Shining rolls the camera through hotel geometry until space feels like a trap. Goodfellas uses wheeled and vest travel as continuous geography.；Grammar: the body moves, the room shears.
- Prompt 模板：`Say the body travels. Still: Dolly toward or beside [Subject], camera body traveling on a smooth path, true parallax, not a zoom.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: The camera dollies, physically traveling, parallax shifting around [Subject]. Name in, out, or beside.`
- Prompt 要点：Ban the word zoom unless you mean a compound.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a zoom. The tell: near and far enlarge together, no shear of a lamp or a door frame. The fix: write physical travel and true parallax, and name the path.

### Falling
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/falling)
- 定义：A falling camera drops the lens through air with weight and wind, a body or viewpoint in free fall. Gravity is the path: the ground rises, air rushes, and the horizon may not stay polite.
- 叙事功能：Gravity is the plot. A jump, a slip, a body leaving a roof: the shot lasts as long as the drop, often a few seconds, and the camera either falls with the subject or is the subject. A crane down is not a fall. If the arm is supported and the speed is chosen, you have a boom, not weight. A drone that eases down is also not this shot.
- 怎么拍：The camera is dropped, thrown, or flown on a path that accelerates downward: wire, descender, or a digital fall with the same acceleration. Wide or moderate-wide helps the ground grow. Prompt: Falling camera with [Subject], the lens dropping through air, weight, and wind, a body or viewpoint in free fall. Video: six seconds of drop, rushing air, ground rising.
- 何时用：Use it when the beat is a drop: a leap, a slip, a body leaving structure. Do not use it as a stylish way to enter a lobby.
- 近似对比：FPV Drone, Ground Level, Crane Down, FPV DroneImpossible proximity and speed. Not a cinematic crane; a missile with a lens., Ground LevelStart from the dirt., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  An FPV Drone can fall, but it can also turn, climb, and thread. Falling is committed to gravity. Ground Level is a height at the end, not the drop. A Crane Down is a supported boom with chosen speed. FPV DroneImpossible proximity and speed. Not a cinematic crane; a missile with a lens. Ground LevelStart from the dirt. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：The Walk puts viewpoint and body into air above a city. Point Break uses freefall as the scene, not as a garnish.；Grammar: weight, wind, ground rising.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the drop and the ground. Still: Falling camera with [Subject], the lens dropping through air, weight, and wind, a body or viewpoint in free fall.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: The camera falls with [Subject], rushing air, ground rising, six seconds of drop. Forbid a gentle crane.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a crane down or a drone descend. The tell: constant speed, stable horizon, no sense of weight. The fix: accelerate down, let the ground rise, add wind and a short duration.

### Fixed Cam
- 别名：locked camera ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/fixed-cam)
- 定义：A fixed camera locks position and tilt so all motion belongs to the world, not the operator. The mount does not pan, tilt, or travel; blocking has to finish the shot.
- 叙事功能：Trust blocking. A kitchen, a hallway, a stage: people enter, work, leave, and the frame stays a law. Duration becomes visible because the camera refuses to help. It is the wrong tool when a look or a stand requires a reframe to keep power readable. If you start drifting to be kind, you no longer have a fixed cam. You have a timid pan.
- 怎么拍：Sticks, a wall mount, or a hidden lock-off. Pick height (often eye or a formal chest) and a lens that holds the room (often 35 to 50mm). Deep enough focus that action in more than one plane can be read. Prompt: Fixed camera on [Subject], locked position and tilt, all motion belonging to the world, not the operator.
- 何时用：Use it when the scene is blocking: chores, a ritual, a joke that happens in the wide. Do not free the head to chase a line.
- 近似对比：Static Locked-Off, Tableau, Pan, Static Locked-OffTrust blocking and duration. Movement would be noise., TableauHold the arrangement., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  Static Locked-Off is the locked-off shot as a catalog size of move (none). Tableau is a staging idea: a composed field to be read as a picture. Fixed cam is the camera-movement rule: the support does not participate. A Pan that only adjusts a little is already a different contract. Static Locked-OffTrust blocking and duration. Movement would be noise. TableauHold the arrangement. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Jeanne Dielman holds rooms until chores become the film. Rope is often cited for long takes, but those cameras travel; a true fixed cam would not.；Use Akerman as the lock-off grammar.
- Prompt 模板：`Lock it. Still: Fixed camera on [Subject], locked position and tilt, all motion belonging to the world, not the operator.`
- Prompt 要点：Video: Camera locked. Only [Subject] and the air move. / Name the height. Forbid even a small pan. / Camera locked. Only [Subject] and the air move.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a slow wander or a motivated pan. The tell: the frame eases to keep a face centered. The fix: pick a composition, lock pan and tilt, and let people leave the frame if they must.

### Omnidirectional
- 别名：360 video ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/omnidirectional)
- 定义：Omnidirectional capture uses a 360 camera to record spherical space, so the viewer can look any way and there is no behind the camera. Off-screen ceases to exist as a hiding place.
- 叙事功能：There is no behind the camera. Staging has to work in a sphere: crew, lights, and unfinished walls cannot hide at the operator's back. The rectangle of cinema is a later crop, or the piece is truly VR. It is the wrong tool for classical coverage. If you need off-screen as a threat, you need a directed frame with edges. A 360 file that is only ever viewed as a locked wide is a waste of the sphere.
- 怎么拍：A spherical rig or a pair of fisheyes stitched into an equirectangular world. Nodal point is a point in the room, not a rectangle. Hide stands above or in set dressing; light has to live in the space. Prompt: Omnidirectional capture of [Subject], a world that can look every way, spherical space, no off-screen.
- 何时用：Use it when the audience must be able to look anywhere: VR cinema, a room that is a trap in every direction. Do not use it as a fancy synonym for an orbit.
- 近似对比：360-Degree Orbit, First-Person, Pan, 360-Degree OrbitTime collapses around one person: kiss, threat, or product hero., First-PersonThe audience is the character., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  360-Degree Orbit is a directed camera walking a circle; there is still off-screen. First-Person is a character's bodily view, usually a rectangle with hands. Omnidirectional is a sphere. A Pan only yaws a limited angle from sticks. 360-Degree OrbitTime collapses around one person: kiss, threat, or product hero. First-PersonThe audience is the character. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：VR cinema is the native grammar. Hardcore Henry is first-person, a cousin in subjectivity, not a sphere.；Do not cite it as 360 capture.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the sphere and the lack of off-screen. Still: Omnidirectional capture of [Subject], a world that can look every way, spherical space, no off-screen.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: A 360-degree world around [Subject], camera able to look anywhere. Forbid a single directed pan as the whole idea.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is an orbit-360. The tell: a framed shot that travels around a person with a clear behind-camera. The fix: spherical space, look-anywhere, no hidden crew, no off-screen.

### Pan
- 别名：Pan shot, slow pan, reveal pan, anticipatory pan, reactive pan, delayed pan ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/pan)
- 定义：A pan shot rotates the camera horizontally around a fixed position, yaw on the vertical axis, feet planted. The support does not travel; the horizon should stay level as the frame sweeps the world.
- 叙事功能：Connect two facts without moving the feet. A look, a landscape, a second person: the pan can reveal, follow, anticipate, or delay. Small pans also reframe blocking so the camera stays almost invisible while power changes inside the frame. Unmotivated constant drifting weakens that change. If nothing new is being connected, the pan is fidget. A truck or a dolly is the tool when you need parallax, not a swing.
- 怎么拍：Tripod or a locked remote head. Rotate on the vertical axis; keep the bubble level unless you mean a Dutch. Speed is a choice: crawl, follow, or whip. Near objects smear at the edges on a fast pan; they do not shear as they would on a dolly. Prompt: Pan across [Subject], camera rotating on its vertical axis from a fixed point, a horizontal sweep of the world.
- 何时用：Use it to join two facts from one stance: a gun and a face, a window and a street, a speaker and a listener. Do not pan as a substitute for laying track.
- 近似对比：Pan Left, Pan Right, Whip Pan, Tilt, Dolly, Pan LeftConnect two things in one geography without moving the support., Pan RightSame as pan left, other direction. End on the story beat., Whip PanTransition, punchline, or sudden attention shift.
  Pan Left and Pan Right name direction. A Whip Pan is the same axis at a speed that blurs the join. A Tilt pitches on the other axis. A Dolly moves the body, so parallax appears. Pan LeftConnect two things in one geography without moving the support. Pan RightSame as pan left, other direction. End on the story beat. Whip PanTransition, punchline, or sudden attention shift.
- 片中实例：The Searchers and There Will Be Blood sweep land from a planted stance. Eyes Wide Shut adjusts framing as dance partners move.；12 Angry Men reframes as the jury's alliances shift. Rear Window surveys a courtyard.；The Stendhal Syndrome uses a museum pan as a survey.；Eyes Wide Shut 1999The ballroom dance adjusts framing as the partners move.；12 Angry Men 1957Group positions change as the jury's alliances shift.；Rear Window 1954The opening exploration of the courtyard and apartment.
- Prompt 模板：`Two siblings argue quietly at a kitchen table. Hold a two-shot; when one stands, gently tilt and pan to include her without cutting. As she leans back toward the seated brother, settle into a tighter shared composition. No arbitrary camera movement.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Plant the feet. Still: Pan across [Subject], camera rotating on its vertical axis from a fixed point, a horizontal sweep of the world.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid a dolly.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a trucking shot. The tell: foreground shearing as if the camera walked. The fix: lock the position, yaw only, keep the horizon level, and let the join be angular, not spatial.

### Parallax
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/parallax)
- 定义：Parallax cinematography is the relative apparent motion between near and far objects as the camera translates. Near things race, far things crawl; that speed difference is how the image proves the world has layers.
- 叙事功能：Prove the world has layers. A foreground railing, a mid-ground person, a far ridge: once the camera moves, their relative speeds cannot be faked by a zoom. The shot is less a named rig than a test you apply to any travel. A zoom that claims depth will fail this test. If you need a graphic flatten, zoom on purpose. If you need air and furniture, translate.
- 怎么拍：Any real translation works: dolly, tracking, arc, handheld, aerial. Place a near object in frame (post, glass, leaves). The near plane should slide faster than the subject, the subject faster than the horizon. Prompt: Parallax around [Subject], near things racing, far things crawling, depth proven by relative speed.
- 何时用：Use it when the room or land must feel thick: a walk past columns, a car past trees. Do not add fake 2.5D wobble to a still and call it a dolly.
- 近似对比：Dolly, Tracking Shot, Zoom, Wiggle, DollyWalk the camera. Change geography., Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  A Dolly is a wheeled translation that produces parallax. Tracking Shot produces it along a path. A Zoom changes size without relative speed between planes. A Wiggle is a tiny stereo rock, parallax as a fidget, not a path. DollyWalk the camera. Change geography. Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：The Tree of Life uses moving viewpoints so near nature shears against far sky. Gravity lets debris and faces disagree in speed as the camera translates.；Grammar: relative motion as proof of depth.
- Prompt 模板：`Name near, mid, and far, and make them disagree in speed. Still: Parallax around [Subject], near things racing, far things crawling, depth proven by relative speed.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: Camera moves so foreground around [Subject] slides faster than the background. Forbid a zoom.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a zoom. The tell: the whole picture enlarges as one card. The fix: translate the camera and keep a near object in frame so it outruns the horizon.

### Pass Through
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/pass-through)
- 定义：A camera pass through travels through a wall, a body, or a window as if matter were optional. The path is continuous: one side of the barrier, its thickness, then the next space, without a cut.
- 叙事功能：Cut the building, not the film. A house can become a mechanism, a club a sequence of rooms, a body a door. The audience is given omniscient access to geography. If you hide a cut on a passing truck, you have an invisible cut, not a pass-through. The thickness of the wall or the flesh has to occupy the lens for a moment, or the cheat will read.
- 怎么拍：Build a 3D route or a set with a removable wall, then composite so objects keep thickness and shape. Lens behavior should stay coherent (no melting plaster). Speed can ease through the barrier. Prompt: Pass-through of [Subject], the camera traveling through a wall, a body, a window as if matter were optional.
- 何时用：Use it to enter the next room without a cut, or to treat a house as a machine. Do not use it as a default transition between any two shots.
- 近似对比：Flying Cam Transition, Through Object In, Object Portal, FPV Drone, Object PortalA prop is a wormhole., FPV DroneImpossible proximity and speed. Not a cinematic crane; a missile with a lens., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  Flying Cam Transition is a flight that punches a threshold and lands in a new room as a designed join. Through Object In uses a named prop (keyhole, cup) and often changes scale. Object Portal is the object-as-door idea. FPV Drone can thread a real opening; pass-through may ignore matter. Object PortalA prop is a wormhole. FPV DroneImpossible proximity and speed. Not a cinematic crane; a missile with a lens. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Enter the Void flies through Tokyo rooms and bodies as if walls were optional. The Fight Club house tour treats a dwelling as a continuous mechanism.；Grammar: thickness, then the next space.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the barrier and the far side. Still: Pass-through of [Subject], the camera traveling through a wall, a body, a window as if matter were optional.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: The camera passes through architecture or [Subject] into the next space. Show the hole.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid a hidden wipe.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a cut on a dark frame or a passing object. The tell: a pop to a new room with no thickness. The fix: travel through the barrier and keep its shape during the passage.

### Tilt
- 别名：Tilt shot, tilt up, tilt down, reveal tilt ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/tilt)
- 定义：A tilt shot rotates the camera vertically around a fixed position, pitch on the horizontal axis, tripod planted. Height is revealed or hidden by angle, not by lifting the support.
- 叙事功能：Reveal height without traveling. A body from shoes to face, a building from door to roof, a dinosaur from ankle to skull: the facts are stacked on one vertical. The feet do not move. A crane or a jib is the wrong tool only if you wanted parallax of a rising support. If the foreground must slide as you climb, boom. If you only need to look up, tilt.
- 怎么拍：Tripod, fluid head, horizontal axis. Start and end on composed frames; do not overshoot into ceiling unless that is the gag. A wide lens exaggerates vertical stretch; a longer lens keeps the stack calmer. Prompt: Tilt on [Subject], camera rotating on its horizontal axis, climbing or descending the world from a fixed point.
- 何时用：Use it to reveal height from one stance: a statue, a tower, a person from ground to face. Do not tilt as a fake crane-up.
- 近似对比：Tilt Up, Tilt Down, Crane Up, Pedestal Up, Pan, Tilt UpReveal height, awe, or a face last., Tilt DownLand on a person or object after establishing scale above., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  Tilt Up and Tilt Down name direction. A Crane Up physically lifts the camera, so rooftops and streets change in parallax. A Pedestal Up raises the support on a column without pitching. A Pan is the horizontal cousin. Tilt UpReveal height, awe, or a face last. Tilt DownLand on a person or object after establishing scale above. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Jurassic Park tilts up bodies and gates to stack scale from a planted stance. Citizen Kane uses vertical swings and stacked compositions to turn height into power.；Grammar: rotation, not travel.
- Prompt 模板：`Plant the tripod. Still: Tilt on [Subject], camera rotating on its horizontal axis, climbing or descending the world from a fixed point.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: The camera tilts vertically across [Subject], tripod planted. Name start (shoes, door) and end (face, roof).`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid a crane.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a crane-up. The tell: foreground sliding, the support rising, the person shrinking in a map. The fix: lock the position, pitch only, and let height arrive as angle.

### Trucking
- 别名：truck ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/trucking)
- 定义：A trucking shot is a lateral dolly: the camera slides sideways with a walker, a sidewalk or corridor peeling by. Subject size holds; the world streams along the street axis.
- 叙事功能：Stay beside a walker. Talk, walk, and the city or the hallway becomes a moving set. The camera is a polite companion, not a hunter in front and not a conveyor belt. If you lead from the front, you are tracking or following. If the world is a factory that does not care, you are on a conveyor. Trucking is the side-on companion.
- 怎么拍：Track parallel to the walk, camera at eye or chest, often 35 to 50mm. Match speed to the stride. Foreground (posts, extras, doorways) should shear; the far wall crawls. Prompt: Trucking with [Subject], lateral dolly, the camera sliding sideways, a sidewalk or corridor peeling by.
- 何时用：Use it to stay beside a walker through a street or hall. Do not truck on a static portrait; then you only have a slider fidget.
- 近似对比：Dolly Left, Tracking Shot, Conveyor, Pan, Dolly LeftSurvey a space or stay with a walker without turning the camera., Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  Dolly Left names a lateral direction on wheels. Tracking Shot is the broader follow along a path, including front and behind. Conveyor is constant industrial speed with the person as cargo. A Pan from sticks will lose the walker or smear them. Dolly LeftSurvey a space or stay with a walker without turning the camera. Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：The Goodfellas Copacabana take includes lateral travel through service spaces as a companion. Touch of Evil moves with people through a town so the street peels.；Grammar: beside, matching speed, lateral parallax.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the side-on travel. Still: Trucking with [Subject], lateral dolly, the camera sliding sideways, a sidewalk or corridor peeling by.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: The camera trucks sideways with [Subject], lateral parallax. Match walking speed.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid a frontal follow unless you mean tracking.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a pan with a walking person. The tell: the subject changes size and the background only swings. The fix: translate sideways, match stride, keep size, let the sidewalk peel.

### Wandering
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/wandering)
- 定义：A wandering camera drifts near the subject as curiosity, a search without a target yet. The move is not a motivated reframe to a known fact; looking itself is the action until something is found.
- 叙事功能：Looking is the action. Openings, parties, streets: the lens behaves like a guest who has not decided what matters. Discovery is the point, not a pre-aimed hero. Once the camera knows the target and drives at it, the wandering is over. A hunt is a track. A tour that never finds anything is also empty: curiosity still needs a world worth searching.
- 怎么拍：Steadicam or handheld, human height, no locked axis. Speed is uneven on purpose. Let the frame glance off extras, corners, and unfinished business, then arrive. Prompt: Wandering camera near [Subject], unmotivated drift that becomes curiosity, a search without a target yet.
- 何时用：Use it when the scene is a search: an opening that discovers a location, a camera that has not chosen a side. Do not wander through a scene whose power geography is already known.
- 近似对比：Handheld, Steadicam, Pan, HandheldUrgency, documentary truth, or a mind that cannot sit still., SteadicamLong connecting moves through architecture. Neither handheld nor dolly., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  Handheld is a body and a shake; it can still be aimed. Steadicam is a float that can wander or can be a laser. Wandering is the motive: discovery, not targeting. A Pan from sticks surveys from one point; wandering translates. HandheldUrgency, documentary truth, or a mind that cannot sit still. SteadicamLong connecting moves through architecture. Neither handheld nor dolly. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Children of Men openings let the camera discover a street before the event lands. The Player's start wanders a lot as a search that becomes a sentence.；Grammar: looking before knowing.
- Prompt 模板：`Video: The camera wanders through the space around [Subject], discovering rather than targeting. Forbid a straight push to a close-up as the first idea.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Write discovery, not a target lock. Still: Wandering camera near [Subject], unmotivated drift that becomes curiosity, a search without a target yet.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a hero-cam walk or a clean track. The tell: the subject is already centered and inevitable. The fix: drift, miss, then find; let the space exist before the aim.

### Zoom
- 别名：zoom in, zoom out, slow zoom, snap zoom ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/zoom)
- 定义：A zoom shot changes focal length without moving the camera. Space flattens or opens with no parallax: near and far grow or shrink together because the nodal point stays put.
- 叙事功能：Change size without walking. Surveillance, emphasis, a punch: the glass does the work. The background does not shear; it merely occupies more or less of the frame. If you need the room to be real, dolly. The compound cousin is a dolly zoom, where travel and glass disagree on purpose. A zoom used as fake geography will flatten the set and give the cheat away.
- 怎么拍：Locked body, zoom lens, often on sticks. In flattens (more telephoto); out opens (more wide). No near-object shear. Prompt: Zoom on [Subject], optical magnification, camera body still, space flattening or opening without parallax.
- 何时用：Use it to change size from one stance: a watcher's glass, a snap to a face, a slow tightening. Do not label a dolly as a zoom.
- 近似对比：Slow Zoom In, Crash Zoom In, Dolly Zoom, Dolly, Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes., Crash Zoom InPunctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting., Dolly ZoomA realization that the ground is not stable. Use once.
  Slow Zoom In is the same axis at a crawl. Crash Zoom In is the punch. A Dolly Zoom pairs opposite travel and glass so perspective warps. A Dolly translates and produces parallax. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes. Crash Zoom InPunctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting. Dolly ZoomA realization that the ground is not stable. Use once.
- 片中实例：The Conversation uses optical magnification as surveillance, glass doing the watching. Jaws is famous for a dolly zoom, the other move: do not cite that beach shock as a plain zoom.
- Prompt 模板：`Keep the body still. Still: Zoom on [Subject], optical magnification, camera body still, space flattening or opening without parallax.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: The lens zooms on [Subject], no camera travel, space compressing. Say in or out.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid wheels.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a dolly-in. The tell: a lamp shears, a doorway slides, true parallax. The fix: lock the camera, change only focal length, and let planes scale together.

### Eyes In
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/eyes-in)
- 定义：An eyes in camera push travels into the gaze until the irises own the frame. It does not stop at a close-up; the portrait becomes an interior of sclera, iris, and catchlight.
- 叙事功能：The thought is in the eye. Realization, a lie, a memory: you go there by traveling, not by cutting to an ECU. The world around the face falls away until the eye is the room. A beauty close-up that never moves is not this shot. If the eyes are not the location, stay at MCU. Mouth-in is the appetite cousin; do not mix the destinations.
- 怎么拍：Start on a face, end inside the eye. Slow push, no tilt, catchlights held. Macro or a close diopter may finish the last centimeters. Identity must hold or the end face is a cut. Prompt: Eyes-in push on [Subject], the camera traveling into the gaze until the irises own the frame, a portrait that becomes an interior.
- 何时用：Use it when the scene turns inward: a decision, a lie, a memory landing in the pupil. Do not use it as a default portrait.
- 近似对比：Push In, Extreme Close-Up, Mouth In, Push InA thought lands. Do not rush it., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger., Mouth InSpeech or hunger is the scene.
  A Push In can stop at a close-up of the whole face. Extreme Close-Up is a frame size, not necessarily a move. Mouth In travels into lips and teeth. Eyes-in has one destination: the iris as architecture. Push InA thought lands. Do not rush it. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger. Mouth InSpeech or hunger is the scene.
- 片中实例：Requiem for a Dream punches into pupils until the eye is a location. The Passion of Joan of Arc already lived in the eyes as architecture, often without the travel.；Grammar: the gaze as a room.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the travel and the end state. Still: Eyes-in push on [Subject], the camera traveling into the gaze until the irises own the frame, a portrait that becomes an interior.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: The camera pushes into [Subject]'s eyes until the iris fills the frame. Keep catchlights.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid a cut to a new face.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a pretty ECU with large eyes and no travel. The tell: a still portrait, whole face, no arrival inside the iris. The fix: write the end state as iris fill, slow push, identity held.

### Mouth In
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/mouth-in)
- 定义：A mouth in camera move enters speech or appetite until lips and teeth become the set. The camera travels past the portrait into the orifice as landscape.
- 叙事功能：Speech or hunger is the scene. A threat spoken, a kiss that should feel like a location, a bite that is architecture: the mouth is not a detail in a portrait. Eating zoom is the comic, food-first version of the same aggression. A random gore insert is not this shot unless the film has already made the mouth a room. Keep the rest of the body out.
- 怎么拍：Prompt a push into the mouth, lips as foreground, interior as arrival. One move. Light the teeth like architecture. Do not also rack focus or whip-pan. Prompt: Mouth-in move on [Subject], the camera entering speech or appetite, lips as landscape.
- 何时用：Use it for appetite, a spoken threat, a kiss as a location. Avoid it as unmotivated body horror unless that is the film.
- 近似对比：Eyes In, Eating Zoom, Extreme Close-Up, Eyes InThe thought is in the eye. Go there., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger., Eating ZoomThe bite is the cut.
  Eyes In goes to the iris. Eating Zoom is an optical crash whose last foreground is food meeting mouth. Extreme Close-Up can be a locked mouth; mouth-in travels until lips and teeth are the set. Eyes InThe thought is in the eye. Go there. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger. Eating ZoomThe bite is the cut.
- 片中实例：The Cook, the Thief, His Wife & Her Lover treats orifices and appetite as rooms. Requiem for a Dream uses close oral imagery as locations of need.；Grammar: the mouth as landscape.
- Prompt 模板：`Demand the camera end past the lips. Still: Mouth-in move on [Subject], the camera entering speech or appetite, lips as landscape.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: The camera pushes into [Subject]'s mouth until lips and teeth become the set. Keep the rest of the body out.`
- Prompt 要点：One move.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a face with an open mouth. The tell: a portrait, teeth visible, camera never arriving inside. The fix: end past the lips, teeth as architecture, no leftover MCU.

### Eating Zoom
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/eating-zoom)
- 定义：An eating zoom is a crash into the bite, chopsticks or spoon as the last foreground, appetite as a punch-in. The move is optical and short; the dish should be nameable in the last frame.
- 叙事功能：The bite is the cut. Noodles, a first date, a villain who eats too well: the camera snaps to food meeting mouth. Comic or sensual depends on how kind the light is. A wide dinner master does not want this. If you still see the restaurant, you did not crash. If there is no food in the last frame, you shot a mouth-in.
- 怎么拍：Write a snap zoom, under a second, ending on the bite. Hold. Do not dolly. Show steam, gloss, or dripping as proof of the food. The face can be partial. Prompt: Eating zoom on [Subject], a crash into the bite, chopsticks or spoon as the last foreground, appetite as a punch-in.
- 何时用：Use it when the bite is the event. Do not use it on an empty plate or a whole table.

- 何时用：Use it for a sting or a joke on one optical axis. Do not use a slow hunt and call it a yoyo.
