  Crash Zoom In is one way in. Crash Zoom Out is one way out. Zoom is the parent optical change. Yoyo does both in one breath. A Rapid Zoom In snaps in and holds. Crash Zoom InPunctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting. Crash Zoom OutShock-reveal scale or undercut a close moment. ZoomChange size without walking.
- 片中实例：Shaun of the Dead uses snap zooms as comic grammar, including in-and-out breaths. Music videos treat optical breathing as percussion.；Grammar: punch then release, body still.
- Prompt 模板：`In then out, one breath. Still: Yo-yo zoom on [Subject], in and out on the same axis, a punch then a release, optical breathing.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: The lens zooms in then out on [Subject] in one breath, a yo-yo on the optical axis. No dolly.`
- Prompt 要点：Short.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a slow zoom or a one-way crash. The tell: it never comes back, or it crawls. The fix: snap both ways on a locked body, no wheels.

### Rapid Zoom In
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/rapid-zoom-in)
- 定义：A rapid zoom in snaps focal length faster than a polite crash, almost a cut, the world tightening in a few frames, then a hold. The camera body does not travel.
- 叙事功能：No time for a dolly. Emphasis as a weapon: a face, a gun, a sign. The snap is so short it can read as an axial cut with a trail of glass. A crash zoom is already fast; this is faster than a polite crash. If you can feel a leisurely enlarge, it is not rapid. If the body moved, you dollied.
- 怎么拍：Locked sticks or a locked handheld brace, zoom thrown to the end stop in a fraction of a second, then hold. Wide to tight. No parallax. Prompt: Rapid zoom in on [Subject], faster than a polite crash, almost a cut, the world snapping tight.
- 何时用：Use it when a fact must arrive as a snap, not a walk. Do not use it on every line.
- 近似对比：Crash Zoom In, YoYo Zoom, Crash Zoom InPunctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting., YoYo ZoomOne axis, two punches., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  Crash Zoom In is the punch that is still readable as a zoom. Rapid is nearer a cut. YoYo Zoom comes back out. A true cut would have no optical trail. Crash Zoom InPunctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting. YoYo ZoomOne axis, two punches. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Hot Fuzz weaponizes snap zooms as punctuation. Kill Bill uses snap zooms as comic and violent emphasis.；Grammar: almost a cut, then a hold.
- Prompt 模板：`Faster than a crash, then hold. Still: Rapid zoom in on [Subject], faster than a polite crash, almost a cut, the world snapping tight.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: Extremely fast zoom into [Subject], nearly a cut, then a hold. Body still.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid wheels.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a dolly-in or a slow crash. The tell: parallax, or a leisurely enlarge. The fix: locked body, snap to tight in a few frames, hold.

### Rapid Zoom Out
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/rapid-zoom-out)
- 定义：A rapid zoom out snaps from the subject to a wide, the environment exploding into view, then holds. Reveal as shock or joke; the camera body still does not travel.
- 叙事功能：Reveal as a joke or a shock. A close face becomes a tiny figure in a huge problem: a crowd, a desert, a mess. The snap is the gag. A pull-out walks away with parallax. A crash zoom out is the readable cousin. Rapid is the snap. If the environment does not suddenly exist, you only loosened a portrait.
- 怎么拍：Locked body, zoom thrown wide in a few frames, then hold. Tight to wide. Prompt: Rapid zoom out from [Subject], the environment exploding into view in a snap.
- 何时用：Use it to reveal scale or context as a shock. Do not use a slow zoom out and call it rapid.
- 近似对比：Crash Zoom Out, Pull Out, Crash Zoom OutShock-reveal scale or undercut a close moment., Pull OutShow the container around a feeling., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  Crash Zoom Out is the readable optical reverse. Pull Out translates the camera away. Rapid zoom out is the snap to a wide, then a hold, body still. Crash Zoom OutShock-reveal scale or undercut a close moment. Pull OutShow the container around a feeling. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Shaun of the Dead snaps out to dump a person into a problem. Scott Pilgrim uses snap outs as graphic punctuation.；Grammar: environment exploding into view.
- Prompt 模板：`Snap to wide, hold. Still: Rapid zoom out from [Subject], the environment exploding into view in a snap.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: Snap zoom out from [Subject] to a wide, then hold. Name what appears.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid a dolly reverse. / Snap zoom out from [Subject] to a wide, then hold.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a pull-out. The tell: the camera walked, lamps sheared. The fix: lock the body, snap the glass wide, hold on the new map.

### Head Tracking
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/head-tracking)
- 定义：A head tracking camera glues the lens to the skull so the face stays pinned while the background orbits. The head is the tripod; turns shear the room.
- 叙事功能：The face is the only stable point. Disorientation, intimacy, a character who cannot see the room changing: the world slides around a pinned portrait. A close-up that pans with them from far away is not glued. Snorricam is chest-mounted and sees the body; head tracking pins the face. Turns must sweep the background.
- 怎么拍：Helmet rig, face mount, or a digital lock to the skull. Face sharp, no extra zoom. When they turn, the room orbits. Prompt: Head-tracking camera on [Subject], the lens glued to the skull, background sliding as the face stays pinned.
- 何时用：Use it when the face must stay while the world becomes weather. Do not use a long-lens pan and claim a lock.
- 近似对比：SnorriCam, Locked-On, Locked-OnOne thing is the only stable point in a moving world., SnorriCamTrap the audience in a body that cannot get out., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  SnorriCam rides the chest and often sees torso and world, face at the edge or absent. Locked-On is the general glued-to-subject idea (body, car, object). Head tracking is skull-specific. Locked-OnOne thing is the only stable point in a moving world. SnorriCamTrap the audience in a body that cannot get out. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Gravity pins faces while debris and station geometry shear around the skull. Enter the Void uses head-locked subjectivity so the world orbits a consciousness.；Grammar: the skull is the tripod.
- Prompt 模板：`Glue to the skull. Still: Head-tracking camera on [Subject], the lens glued to the skull, background sliding as the face stays pinned.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: The camera stays locked to [Subject]'s head as they turn, background orbiting. No extra zoom.`
- Prompt 要点：Face sharp.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a close-up panned from a distance. The tell: the face drifts in frame, or the background does not shear on a turn. The fix: lock to the skull, pin the face, let the room orbit.

### Hero Cam
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/hero-cam)
- 定义：Hero cam is a low three-quarter tracking walk with rim light, a comic-book arrival at walking speed. The recipe is height plus travel plus a hard edge of light, not a static low angle.
- 叙事功能：They should look inevitable. Arrivals, title walks, a character who has already won in their head: the camera tracks at hip or knee, three-quarter, rim, slow walk. Glam is beauty without the walk. A low-angle still of a standing person is not this shot. They should be walking. The camera should travel. Do not crash-zoom.
- 怎么拍：Track at hip or knee height, three-quarter front, one direction. Rim or kicker separates the figure from dust or city. Pace is a walk, not a sprint unless you say so. Prompt: Hero-cam on [Subject], low three-quarter, rim light, a walk that sells myth, comic-book arrival.
- 何时用：Use it for an arrival walk that should feel inevitable. Do not use it on a seated talk.
- 近似对比：Low Angle, Tracking Shot, Glam, Low AnglePower, monument, or intimidation., Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture., GlamSell the face.
  Low Angle is a height and can be locked. Tracking Shot follows at any height without the rim-and-walk recipe. Glam is a beauty key, not a path. Hero cam is the walk plus the low three-quarter plus the rim. Low AnglePower, monument, or intimidation. Tracking ShotAccompany a walker. The shot is a journey, not a picture. GlamSell the face.
- 片中实例：The Dark Knight and Black Panther title walks are the grammar: myth at walking speed, low three-quarter, an edge of light. Use them as a recipe, not as frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Walk, low, rim. Still: Hero-cam on [Subject], low three-quarter, rim light, a walk that sells myth, comic-book arrival.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: Low heroic tracking on [Subject] walking, rim light, mythic pace. They must be walking.`
- Prompt 要点：One direction. No crash zoom.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a static low-angle portrait. The tell: standing, no travel, no walk. The fix: track at hip or knee, three-quarter, rim, walking pace.

### Robo Arm
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/robo-arm)
- 定义：A robotic camera arm runs a programmed path with inhuman precision, repeatable every take for product geometry or a stunt match. No operator shake; the spline is the performance.
- 叙事功能：The path must be identical every take. Commercials, previs stages, a bottle that must match a CGI pass, a stunt that must fit a plate: the arm does not interpret. A human dolly will drift. An orbit-360 can be walked and will breathe. Bolt cam is a throw, not a repeatable spline (unless the throw is itself robotic). If you want error and life, do not use the arm.
- 怎么拍：Motion-control arm or a six-axis robot, programmed XYZ and pan/tilt/roll. Speed can be inhumanly even or inhumanly fast. Product tables, crash pads, or a repeatable orbit. Prompt: Robotic arm move around [Subject], programmed path, inhuman precision, product or stunt geometry.
- 何时用：Use it when takes must match: VFX, product, a stunt plate. Do not use it for a scene that needs human drift.
- 近似对比：360-Degree Orbit, Bolt Cam, 360-Degree OrbitTime collapses around one person: kiss, threat, or product hero., Bolt CamThe camera itself is the punch., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  360-Degree Orbit can be a human walk or a circular dolly with breath. Bolt Cam is a crash throw aimed at impact. Robo-arm is the repeatable spline, any shape, no shake. 360-Degree OrbitTime collapses around one person: kiss, threat, or product hero. Bolt CamThe camera itself is the punch. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Commercials and previs stages are the native grammar: bottles, cars, and stunt geometry that must composite. The precision is the style.
- Prompt 模板：`Programmed, repeatable, no shake. Still: Robotic arm move around [Subject], programmed path, inhuman precision, product or stunt geometry.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: A precise robotic-arm path around [Subject], repeatable, no human shake. Name the path shape.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid handheld error.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a steadicam orbit. The tell: a little sway, a human accel. The fix: write programmed path, identical takes, no operator shake.

### Wiggle
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/wiggle)
- 定义：A wiggle camera rocks between two nearby viewpoints, a tiny stereo fidget that makes a lock-off read as a living postcard. Travel is centimeters, not a dolly.
- 叙事功能：Add life to a lock-off without a real move. Lenticular photos, stereo gifs, a still that breathes: depth as a fidget. Near objects shift a little; the far wall almost holds. If the camera walks, you have parallax as a path, not a wiggle. A full slider is already too much. The point is two nearby viewpoints, not a tour.
- 怎么拍：Nodal shift of a few centimeters, or a pair of stills played as a loop. Subject mostly still. Prompt: Wiggle cam on [Subject], tiny stereo rock, a living postcard, depth as a fidget.
- 何时用：Use it to wake a still without committing to a move. Do not use it as coverage of a walk.
- 近似对比：Wigglegram, Parallax, Slider Shot, WigglegramDepth as a twitch., ParallaxProve the world has layers., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  Wigglegram is the lenticular or stereo-gif cousin, often a pair of stills. Parallax is the optical fact; a wiggle is parallax as a tiny rock. A Slider Shot travels 60 to 120 centimeters, which is already a real move. WigglegramDepth as a twitch. ParallaxProve the world has layers. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Lenticular photos and TikTok stereo are the grammar: two nearby eyes, a postcard that lives. Not a narrative dolly.
- Prompt 模板：`Two nearby viewpoints. Still: Wiggle cam on [Subject], tiny stereo rock, a living postcard, depth as a fidget.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: The camera wiggles between two nearby viewpoints of [Subject]. Centimeters.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid a walk.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a slider or a dolly. The tell: the background really travels, the path is a meter. The fix: rock between two nearby viewpoints, stereo fidget only.

### 3D Rotation
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/3d-rotation)
- 定义：A 3d rotation camera treats the figure as a sculptural object on a virtual turntable of space. The world may be a cyc or a void; the point is every side, not a street orbit.
- 叙事功能：Show every side. Inspection, toys, a character as merchandise: even lighting or studio, the person as a model. Combine with a computed look if they should feel rendered. A chase does not want a turntable. A 360 walk around a street is an orbit: walls and extras shear in a real room. This is product-space. A slight arc is not enough; we should sense the back will arrive.
- 怎么拍：Virtual camera on a circular or spherical spline, subject locked, often studio or void. One axis unless you mean a tumble. Prompt: 3D rotation around [Subject], a turntable of space, the figure as a sculptural object in orbit.
- 何时用：Use it to inspect a figure as an object. Do not use it in a chase or a blocked room that must stay a room.
- 近似对比：360-Degree Orbit, Lazy Susan, 360-Degree OrbitTime collapses around one person: kiss, threat, or product hero., Lazy SusanShow an object or costume from every side., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  360-Degree Orbit walks a real environment. Lazy Susan often rotates the subject on a physical disc with the camera locked. 3D rotation is the virtual turntable of space, sculpture grammar, sometimes a freeze-turn. 360-Degree OrbitTime collapses around one person: kiss, threat, or product hero. Lazy SusanShow an object or costume from every side. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Product films are the native grammar. The Matrix freeze-turn is the narrative cousin: a body as a sculpture in computed space.；Use the grammar, not the frame.
- Prompt 模板：`Turntable of space, figure as object. Still: 3D rotation around [Subject], a turntable of space, the figure as a sculptural object in orbit.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: The camera rotates in 3D around [Subject] as if on a virtual turntable. Studio or void helps.`
- Prompt 要点：One axis.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a slight arc in a street. The tell: a living room shears a little and we never see the back. The fix: full turntable energy, subject as sculpture, studio or void, the back will arrive.

### Crane Over The Head
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/crane-over-the-head)
- 定义：A crane over the head rises on the arm until the camera looks nearly straight down, a person becoming a map. The end state is overhead, not a high three-quarter.
- 叙事功能：Finish by looking down. A body on a floor, a crime, a dance, a figure lost in pattern: the arm climbs and continues until the lens is almost nadir. A crane-up that eases back into a skyline is a different end: the person becomes geography from an oblique height. Overhead and bird's-eye can be locked. This shot is the travel that arrives there.
- 怎么拍：Jib or Technocrane, start at human height or a three-quarter, boom up and over until tilt is nearly 90 degrees down. A little boom-out keeps the subject from sliding off. Prompt: Crane over the head of [Subject], the arm rising until the camera looks nearly straight down, a person becoming a map.
- 何时用：Use it to end on a downward map of a person. Do not stop at a high three-quarter and call it over the head.
- 近似对比：Crane Over, Overhead Top-Down, Bird's-Eye View, Crane OverTurn a scene into a map without cutting., Overhead Top-DownTable, crime scene, or dance formation., Bird's-Eye ViewTurn life into a board game or a ritual.
  Crane Over travels the arm over an obstacle or crowd without requiring nadir. Overhead Top-Down is the locked top-down frame. Bird's-Eye View is the high downward view as a size. Crane-over-the-head is the boom that becomes those views. Crane OverTurn a scene into a map without cutting. Overhead Top-DownTable, crime scene, or dance formation. Bird's-Eye ViewTurn life into a board game or a ritual.
- 片中实例：The Untouchables uses high downward cranes (the station, the pram, the floor as a map). Birdman booms over theater space until people become pattern.；Grammar: rise until you look down.
- Prompt 模板：`End almost overhead. Still: Crane over the head of [Subject], the arm rising until the camera looks nearly straight down, a person becoming a map.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: The camera cranes up and over [Subject] until the view is almost overhead. Do not stop at a high three-quarter.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a crane-up that stays oblique, or a locked overhead with no travel. The tell: we never look down, or we were already down. The fix: boom up and over until the lens is nearly straight down.

### Earth Zoom
- 别名：Powers-of-ten journey, Micro-to-macro transition ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/earth-zoom)
- 定义：An earth zoom is a continuous or apparently continuous rush from satellite scale down to a face, continent to street to person. Nested geography collapses along one axis; a smooth zoom is not proof of real travel speed.
- 叙事功能：Start from the planet. Introduce a person as a point on Earth, or punch a joke from cosmos to porch. Landmarks should shrink in order: cloud, coast, grid, roof, face. Once per film is plenty. A conversation does not need the planet. A generic aerial that never reaches the person is not this. A crash zoom that starts on a rooftop is not this. Keep identity stable from wide to tight or the face at the end is a stranger.
- 怎么拍：Design nested environments and scale transitions in 3D or compositing. Preserve direction and visual anchors. Name the start as satellite or stratosphere, the end as eyes or feet, the path as one continuous zoom. Do not add a pan or an orbit on the way down. Prompt: Earth zoom into [Subject], satellite to street in one rush, the planet collapsing into a face.
- 何时用：Use it to place a person on Earth in one rush, or as a scale gag. Do not use it to open a dialogue scene.
- 近似对比：Aerial Push In, Crash Zoom In, Aerial Push InPick one human out of a system., Crash Zoom InPunctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  Aerial Push In approaches from the air inside one place-scale. Crash Zoom In is an optical punch from a locked camera, usually starting in a room or a street. Earth zoom starts at orbit and nested scales. Aerial Push InPick one human out of a system. Crash Zoom InPunctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Contact's opening withdraws from Earth into larger cosmic scales (the reverse direction of the same grammar). Powers of Ten runs outward and inward from a picnic.；The Simpsons couch gags punch from cosmos to porch. Reverence and joke are the same funnel.；Contact 1997The opening withdraws from Earth into progressively larger cosmic scales.；Powers of Ten 1977The outward and inward scale journey from a picnic scene.
- Prompt 模板：`Begin on a dew drop on one leaf. Pull backward continuously through the garden, neighborhood, coastline and cloud layer, ending above the planet. Keep one coherent outward axis, smooth logarithmic-feeling changes in scale and consistent daylight. Build as matched scale segments with composited handoffs; no random galaxy substitutions.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Satellite to face, one axis. Still: Earth zoom into [Subject], satellite to street in one rush, the planet collapsing into a face.`
- Prompt 要点：No pan. Identity held.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a generic aerial or a rooftop crash zoom. The tell: you cannot feel continents, or the face at the end is a new person. The fix: start at orbit, collapse nested scales in order, keep identity.

### Jib Down
- 别名：short crane down ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/jib-down)
- 定义：A jib down camera is a short descending arm, a few feet of boom, intimate arrival with nearby foreground sliding as the camera sits down. It is a small crane, not a city-scale drop.
- 叙事功能：A full crane is too much city. Sit down into the talk: a table, a face, a huddle. You drop from standing-eye or a little above into the scene like a guest sitting down. An aerial of a fortress wants a crane. A tilt down from a locked tripod has no sliding foreground. Speed is polite unless you say otherwise. Do not travel a city block.
- 怎么拍：Short jib, remote or operator on the arm, start a little high, end at the subject. Nearby foreground (glasses, a lamp, a railing) should parallax. Prompt: Jib down onto [Subject], a short descending arm, intimate arrival, nearby foreground sliding as the camera sits down.
- 何时用：Use it to arrive at a table, a secret, a song starting. Do not use it when you need a city to drop away.
- 近似对比：Crane Down, Jib Up, Tilt Down, Crane DownArrive from god-view into a person., Jib UpLeave the face, keep the architecture small., Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
  Crane Down is the big cousin, tens of feet, map becoming a person. Jib Up is the reverse small lift. A Tilt Down only pitches from sticks. Jib down translates a short arm. Crane DownArrive from god-view into a person. Jib UpLeave the face, keep the architecture small. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Music videos and small-set drama are the grammar: intimate sit-downs, a guest arriving at a table. The still is the end of the sit-down, not a skyline.
- Prompt 模板：`Short arm, sit down. Still: Jib down onto [Subject], a short descending arm, intimate arrival, nearby foreground sliding as the camera sits down.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: A short jib down into [Subject], small crane, the room arriving rather than a city-scale drop. Demand foreground slide.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid a tilt from sticks.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a tilt down. The tell: the support never moved, no foreground shear. The fix: a short descending arm, nearby objects sliding, human-scale arrival.

### Jib Up
- 别名：short crane up ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-movement/jib-up)
- 定义：A jib up camera is a short rising arm that gives a table or face back to the room, human-scale lift. Who else is present appears; a skyline does not have to.
- 叙事功能：Leave the face, keep the architecture small. Endings of talks, a stand-up, a reveal of who else is in the room. Intimate lift, not a city crane-up. If the background does not parallax, the arm did not move: you tilted. A Technocrane that finds a skyline is a different scale. One axis, a short rise, a near object shearing.
- 怎么拍：Short jib, start on the subject, end with the room. Parallax of a near object (table edge, lamp, shoulder). Prompt: Jib up from [Subject], a short rising arm, the table or face giving the room back, human-scale lift.

  Crane Up climbs toward rooftops and maps, often easing back. Jib Down sits in. A Tilt Up only pitches. Jib up is a few feet of true boom. Crane UpEnd a scene, reveal a city, or turn a person into landscape. Jib DownA full crane is too much city. Sit down into the talk. Slow Zoom InUse to raise pressure without changing geography. The world stays put; attention closes.
- 片中实例：Music videos and dialogue coverage use the polite cousin of crane-up: human-scale lift off a face or a table. Grammar: the room is given back, not a skyline.
- Prompt 模板：`Short rise, room returns. Still: Jib up from [Subject], a short rising arm, the table or face giving the room back, human-scale lift.`

## 构图与景别 / Framing and Shot Size（25 条）

**速查**：Extreme Close-Up (ECU) · Choker Shot (BCU) · Close-Up (CU) · Medium Close-Up (MCU) · Medium Shot (MS) · Cowboy Shot · Full Body (WS) · Long Shot (WS) · Extreme Long Shot (ELS) · Establishing Shot · Master Shot · Two-Shot · Three-Shot · Group Shot · Insert Shot · Cutaway · Reaction Shot · Over-the-Shoulder Coverage (OTS) · Single · Cut-ins · Gesture · Interview · Product · Video Portraits · Wide Shot (WS)

### Extreme Close-Up (ECU)
- 别名：ECU, Italian shot, choker, detail close-up, Facial detail, Très gros plan ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/extreme-close-up)
- 定义：An extreme close-up, or extreme close up shot, fills the frame with one small feature: an eye, a mouth, a fingertip, a trigger. Surrounding space disappears; the crop is tighter than a whole face.
- 叙事功能：Size is a sentence. An extreme close-up says the scene is this fragment: a pupil tightening, a lip splitting, a safety clicking off. Cutting between such fragments can turn looking into a physical confrontation, as in a standoff built from eyes instead of bodies. It is the wrong tool when the actor still needs a whole face to play the line. If you can still see hairline and chin together, you have not arrived at this size. Use it when a detail is the event, then get out before the texture becomes a poster.
- 怎么拍：Pick the anatomical landmark that hits the frame lines. Camera distance and focal length are separate from the crop: a 75mm or 100mm a few feet back keeps facial proportion; a wide lens inches from the skin balloons the nose. A macro is only required when the feature is truly small, such as an iris or a watch gear. Tight framing, macro optics, and shallow depth of field are three different choices. Light a small source if you want pore and scar; wrap if you want the fragment to stay readable. Prompt the exact feature and the crop (brow to upper cheek, mouth only), not a vague tight close-up.
- 何时用：Use it when a detail is the scene: the eye that decides to fire, the mouth that will not speak. Do not use it as a default portrait or for ordinary dialogue; the rest of the person is information you have thrown away.
- 近似对比：Choker Shot, Close-Up, Insert Shot, Choker ShotEmotion with nowhere to hide., Close-UpRead micro-expression. Default for important dialogue., Insert ShotPoint at the thing that will matter later.
  A Choker Shot still holds a whole face from hairline to chin. A Close-Up keeps head and upper shoulders. An extreme close-up is a fragment, not a portrait. An Insert Shot can be this tight, but an insert is a story object or hand fact, not a size. If the frame still includes both eyes and a mouth as a face, you are not here yet. Choker ShotEmotion with nowhere to hide. Close-UpRead micro-expression. Default for important dialogue. Insert ShotPoint at the thing that will matter later.
- 片中实例：In The Good, the Bad and the Ugly, eyes and faces dominate the final standoff montage until looking becomes the gunfight. The Passion of Joan of Arc puts interrogation pressure on facial fragments.；Persona uses faces so close that identity starts to fuse. Borrow the grammar of fragment versus whole, not a poster of an iris.；The Good, the Bad and the Ugly 1966Eyes and faces dominate the final standoff montage.；The Passion of Joan of Arc 1928Faces carry the pressure of the interrogation and trial.
- Prompt 模板：`Extreme close-up of an older watchmaker's eyes as she decides whether to open a sealed mechanism. Frame from brow to upper cheek, natural skin texture, tiny shift in gaze and controlled breathing. Restrained light, stable focus, no cosmetic smoothing or wide-angle facial distortion.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Lead with the crop, then the feature. Example: Extreme close-up of [Subject], a single feature filling the frame, pores and texture, tighter than forehead-to-chin.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Choker Shot or a Close-Up: the whole face still reads. The tell is hairline and chin both present, or shoulders sneaking in. The other tell is wide-angle distortion from parking a short lens on the nose. Fix: name the feature, crop inside the face, and pick a longer lens or a true macro only if the object is small.

### Choker Shot (BCU)
- 别名：Big Close-Up, Big Close Up, BCU ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/choker)
- 定义：A choker shot, also called a big close-up (BCU), frames the face from hairline to chin, often clipping the skull on every side. Shoulders are out; almost no background remains.
- 叙事功能：A choker traps a person in their own face. There is nowhere to gesture, no collar to hide in, no room tone in the corners. Emotion has to happen in the eyes, the mouth, and the tiny muscles around them. It is the wrong tool when you still need a swallow, a shoulder, or a hand at the chest. It is also the wrong tool if you only wanted pores on one feature: that job belongs to a tighter fragment. Hold a choker when the scene is a confession, a breakdown, or a stare with no escape, then cut out before the crop feels like a passport photo.
- 怎么拍：Put the top frame at the hairline and the bottom at the chin. Ears often clip. Headroom is nearly zero. A 75mm to 100mm from portrait distance keeps the face from ballooning; a wide lens this close will warp the skull. Camera at Eye Level unless you want a power tilt. Focus the nearer eye. Light can be hard enough to show sweat, or wrapped if the performance is the only contrast. Prompt: Choker shot of [Subject] from hairline to chin, almost no background.
- 何时用：Use it when emotion has nowhere to hide: a whispered admission, a stare across a table that has become a cell. Do not use it if you still need upper body language, or if the story is actually one feature (an eye, a mouth) rather than the whole face.
- 近似对比：Extreme Close-Up, Close-Up, Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger., Close-UpRead micro-expression. Default for important dialogue., Medium Close-UpTalk without losing body language.
  An Extreme Close-Up is tighter than the face: one feature, not hairline-to-chin. A Close-Up includes the upper shoulders and a little air around the head. A choker, also called a big close-up or BCU, is the in-between prison: a complete face with no body. Do not treat BCU and ECU as synonyms. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger. Close-UpRead micro-expression. Default for important dialogue. Medium Close-UpTalk without losing body language.
- 片中实例：Persona pushes faces until they occupy the whole rectangle and start to trade identity. Black Swan uses this proximity when the performance has no backstage left.；Use those as grammar for pressure, not as a look-alike brief.
- Prompt 模板：`Add lens only if you need undistorted proportion (75mm to 100mm). Do not write extreme close-up, and do not ask for shoulders.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Choker shot of [Subject] from hairline to chin, almost no background, claustrophobic portrait, Bergman proximity.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is an Extreme Close-Up (only an eye) or a Close-Up (shoulders still in). The tell is either a fragment with no chin, or a collar and headroom. Fix: hairline and chin are the frame lines; nothing below the jaw.

### Close-Up (CU)
- 别名：CU ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/close-up)
- 定义：A close-up, or close up shot, frames a face tightly enough to privilege detail over surroundings, usually head and upper shoulders. The room becomes secondary; the person still reads as a head, not a fragment.
- 叙事功能：A close-up is a new fact on a face. It is the default for important dialogue because micro-expression, a lie, or a decision can be read without losing the idea of a person. The shoulders keep a little body in the sentence so a swallow or a turned collar still exists. It is the wrong tool when the beat is a hand, a holster, or the door across the room. It is also the wrong tool as a beauty setting on every line: if you live here, coverage becomes a slideshow of heads. Change size when the new scale reveals a fact this crop cannot prove.
- 怎么拍：Bottom frame at the upper chest or clavicle; top just above the hair, with modest Headroom. A 65mm to 85mm at conversation distance is common; the catalog 75mm Cooke is a portrait working length, not a requirement. Shallow Focus will drop the room, but the size is the crop, not the bokeh. Match reverse size if this is dialogue. Prompt: Tight close-up of [Subject], head and upper shoulders.
- 何时用：Use it to read micro-expression on an important line: the moment a person decides not to answer. Do not use it as wallpaper on every sentence, and do not use it when the information is below the chest.
- 近似对比：Choker Shot, Medium Close-Up, Extreme Close-Up, Medium Close-UpTalk without losing body language., Choker ShotEmotion with nowhere to hide., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  A Choker Shot cuts off the shoulders and sits on hairline and chin. A Medium Close-Up starts at the chest and still shows dialogue-distance body language. An Extreme Close-Up is a fragment inside the face. Close-up is the portrait size: head plus upper shoulders, not MCU, not choker, not ECU. Medium Close-UpTalk without losing body language. Choker ShotEmotion with nowhere to hide. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：The Passion of Joan of Arc builds trial pressure from faces that still read as heads, not only fragments. The Silence of the Lambs uses close-ups in the interviews so thought is visible while a little of the body remains.；Grammar: the face as the location, with enough shoulder to stay a person.
- Prompt 模板：`Do not write choker, chest up, or a single eye. Keep a sliver of collar or shoulder so the model does not crop inside the face.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Tight close-up of [Subject], head and upper shoulders, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, 75mm Cooke, the face as landscape.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Medium Close-Up (too much chest and room) or a Choker Shot (no shoulders). The tell is either a talking-head with a lot of torso, or a face with no neck. Fix: head and upper shoulders only. Another tell is calling any tight face a close-up when you meant ECU.

### Medium Close-Up (MCU)
- 别名：MCU ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/medium-close-up)
- 定义：A medium close-up, or medium close up, usually frames a person from chest or shoulders upward. Dialogue distance remains: face, shoulders, and often a hand at chest height stay readable.
- 叙事功能：An MCU is how people talk when you still care about body language. You get the thought on the face and the small shrug, the glass raised, the cigarette, without dropping to the waist. Most interview and table coverage lives here because the room is a slice, not a map. It is the wrong tool when the holster, the gait, or the architecture is the information. It is also the wrong tool when the line needs a true close-up fact: an MCU will keep offering shoulders and wallpaper. Use it to talk; leave it when the scene stops being a conversation.
- 怎么拍：Bottom frame at mid-chest or the sternum. Hands can enter if they rise. 50mm to 75mm at sit-down distance is typical; the catalog 65 to 75mm is a working band, not a brand. You should still see a strip of set behind the shoulders. Headroom is normal, not crushed. Prompt: Medium close-up of [Subject] from chest up, shoulders and hands still readable.
- 何时用：Use it for dialogue that must keep body language: two people at a table, a phone call with a free hand. Do not use it when you need a waist-up gesture, a gunbelt, or a face with no chest left in frame.
- 近似对比：Close-Up, Medium Shot, Close-UpRead micro-expression. Default for important dialogue., Medium ShotWorkhorse coverage. Most scenes live here., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  A Close-Up is head and upper shoulders, tighter than chest-up. A Medium Shot starts at the waist and balances gesture with face. MCU is the band between them: chest up, talk without losing the shoulders. Do not write MCU when you mean CU, and do not call a waist shot a medium close-up. Close-UpRead micro-expression. Default for important dialogue. Medium ShotWorkhorse coverage. Most scenes live here. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：Heat uses this distance in the diner so two opponents can talk with shoulders and hands still in play before and between tighter singles. The Sopranos lives in MCU for talk that still needs a room sliver and a raised glass.；Grammar: conversation distance, not a beauty crop.
- Prompt 模板：`Say chest up. Example: Medium close-up of [Subject] from chest up, dialogue distance, shoulders and hands still readable, 65 to 75mm.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Do not say head and shoulders only, and do not say waist. For video, keep the chest line; a zoom into the eyes has become a close-up.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Close-Up (torso gone) or a Medium Shot (waist in). The tell is either a floating head or a belt buckle. Fix: crop at the chest, keep a hand possible, keep a slice of room.

### Medium Shot (MS)
- 别名：MS, waist shot ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/medium-shot)
- 定义：A medium shot frames a person from approximately the waist upward, so face and gesture share the rectangle. It is the workhorse size of coverage, sometimes called a waist shot.
- 叙事功能：Most scenes live in the medium shot because people talk with their hands. A glass, a phone, a cigarette, a slammed notebook all happen between waist and face. Geography is still a little present (a booth, a window, a doorway) without becoming the subject. It is the wrong tool when the story is a walk, a costume from head to toe, or a face that must be the only landscape. If you never leave this size, blocking becomes a radio play with heads and belts. Change size when the waist line no longer contains the fact.
- 怎么拍：Bottom frame at the waist or belt. Hands at rest should be in. A 40mm to 50mm at conversational standing or sitting distance keeps perspective ordinary; the catalog 50mm is a default, not a law. Camera often at chest to eye height. You should still read a bit of set, not a full room map. Prompt: Medium shot of [Subject] from the waist up, gesture and face in balance.
- 何时用：Use it as workhorse coverage: overlapping dialogue, a booth conversation, someone waiting with a suitcase handle in frame. Do not use it when the information is a holster below the hip, the feet, or a micro-expression that needs a closer crop.
- 近似对比：Medium Close-Up, Cowboy Shot, Close-Up, Cowboy ShotShow hands, weapons, or stance without going full body., Medium Close-UpTalk without losing body language., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  A Medium Close-Up starts at the chest and throws the waist away. A Cowboy Shot drops the bottom frame to mid-thigh so hands at the holster line stay in. Medium is the waist sentence, not MCU and not cowboy. A Close-Up is a different sentence entirely: the face outranks gesture. Cowboy ShotShow hands, weapons, or stance without going full body. Medium Close-UpTalk without losing body language. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：His Girl Friday runs talk and gesture in this band so overlapping dialogue still has cigarettes, phones, and desks. Lost in Translation uses waist-up hotel and bar distance where two people can exist without becoming portraits or wide maps.；Grammar: conversation with hands.
- Prompt 模板：`Do not write chest up, mid-thigh, or head and shoulders. For video, if the camera drifts down to the knees you have entered cowboy territory.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Say waist. Example: Medium shot of [Subject] from the waist up, conversational distance, 50mm, gesture and face in balance.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Cowboy Shot (knees or mid-thigh in) or a Medium Close-Up (belt gone). The tell is either a gunbelt or a floating chest. Fix: crop at the waist. Another tell is calling every talky frame a medium shot when it is an MCU.

### Cowboy Shot
- 别名：American shot, knee shot, medium long shot, three-quarter shot ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/cowboy-shot)
- 定义：A cowboy shot frames a person from mid-thigh or the knees upward so the hands stay in at the holster line. It is also called an American shot or knee shot; it is not a waist shot and not a full figure.
- 叙事功能：The cowboy exists because hands are plot. A gun, a bottle, a fist, a coat hem at the thigh: the stance is the sentence. You get face and threat or ease in one frame without spending the extra air that feet and floor demand. It is the wrong tool when gait, shoes, or the full costume silhouette is the information. It is also the wrong tool for table talk: you will be cropping a booth at mid-thigh for no reason. Use it for standing confrontation, weapons, and posture, then go tighter for the eyes or wider for the walk.
- 怎么拍：Bottom frame through mid-thigh. Holster, hanging hands, and coat edge should read. A 35mm to 50mm from a few steps back is common. Pairing with Hip Level puts the lens near the gunbelt; that height is a choice, not the size itself. You can shoot a cowboy at eye height. Prompt: Cowboy shot of [Subject] framed mid-thigh up, hands visible at the holster line.
- 何时用：Use it to show hands, weapons, or stance without going full body: a hand hovering at a belt, a bottle hanging, a ready posture. Do not use it if you need feet and walk, or if the beat is only a face.
- 近似对比：Medium Shot, Full Body, Medium ShotWorkhorse coverage. Most scenes live here., Full BodyCostume, blocking, and gait matter., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  A Medium Shot cuts at the waist, so the holster and hanging hands are gone. A Full Body includes head to toe and a strip of floor. Cowboy is the mid-thigh sentence: American shot, not MS, not full figure. Do not call it a medium long shot as if that erased the holster line. Medium ShotWorkhorse coverage. Most scenes live here. Full BodyCostume, blocking, and gait matter. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：The Good, the Bad and the Ugly uses this standing size so guns and faces share one frame before the eyes take over. Django Unchained keeps hands and weapons readable in the same band.；Grammar: stance plus face, not a landscape and not a waist-up talk shot.
- Prompt 模板：`Do not write waist up or head to toe. For video, if the feet enter you have left cowboy; if the belt is the bottom you have returned to medium.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name mid-thigh and the hands. Example: Cowboy shot of [Subject] framed mid-thigh up, hands visible at the holster line, American shot.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Medium Shot (waist) or a Full Body (feet in). The tell is a belt-only crop, or shoes. Fix: bottom frame through the thigh, hands in, feet out. Another tell is a sitting medium labeled cowboy because the genre is Western.

### Full Body (WS)
- 别名：long shot, wide on person, WS, LS ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/full-body)
- 定义：A full body shot holds a person head to toe, with the figure complete and a readable strip of environment around the silhouette. The person is still the subject; the world is a border, not the owner of the frame.
- 叙事功能：Full body is for costume, blocking, and gait. You need the shoes, the hem, the way weight sits on a hip, the path to the door. The figure occupies most of the frame height, so this is a portrait of a body in space, not a map of a valley. It is the wrong tool when land must dwarf the person, or when the beat is a face. Calling every complete figure a long shot or a wide shot erases this size. If the human is still large in the rectangle and the feet are in, you are here. If they have become a small mark in weather, you have gone longer.
- 怎么拍：Keep head and feet both in, with a little floor and a little air. The figure should own most of the vertical. A 35mm to 50mm from enough distance avoids stretching the legs; a 24mm too close will cartoon the feet. Do not confuse this with a 24mm Wide room map. Prompt: Full-body shot of [Subject], head to toe, figure complete in frame, environment readable around the silhouette.
- 何时用：Use it when costume, blocking, and gait matter: a walk in a new coat, a stand in a doorway, a body that has to be seen whole. Do not use it when the land must win, or when you only needed mid-thigh for the hands.
- 近似对比：Cowboy Shot, Long Shot, Wide Shot, Extreme Long Shot, Cowboy ShotShow hands, weapons, or stance without going full body., Extreme Long ShotScale is the emotion., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  A Cowboy Shot stops at mid-thigh; feet are out. A Long Shot shows a full figure plus so much geography that the person is small in the world. A Wide Shot lets place speak; bodies may be smaller still. Full body is the complete figure as subject, not cowboy, not long, not wide. An Extreme Long Shot makes them a speck. Cowboy ShotShow hands, weapons, or stance without going full body. Extreme Long ShotScale is the emotion. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：The Searchers uses complete figures in doorways and desert edges so costume and stance read before the land fully claims them. Drive holds night walks head to toe so gait and scorpion jacket are the sentence.；Grammar: person complete, place as margin.
- Prompt 模板：`Say head to toe. Example: Full-body shot of [Subject], head to toe, figure complete in frame, environment readable around the silhouette.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Do not write long shot, wide, or mid-thigh. For video, if the figure shrinks into architecture you have drifted into a long shot.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Long Shot (person small in land) or a Cowboy Shot (no feet). The tell is a tiny figure in weather, or a crop at the knee. Fix: feet in, head in, person still large in the frame. Do not label it WS or LS just because the body is complete.

### Long Shot (WS)
- 别名：wide shot, WS, LS ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/long-shot)
- 定义：A long shot in cinematography shows the full subject plus a substantial portion of the environment, so a person sits small in geography. The figure is still locatable as a human; the world is large enough to ignore them.
- 叙事功能：A long shot places a human in a world that could continue without them. You still recognize a body, a walk, a horse, but land, street, or weather takes most of the rectangle. The sentence is person-in-world, not person-as-portrait. It is the wrong tool when you need the face, the holster, or a complete figure that still owns the height of the frame. It is also the wrong tool when the person has become an unreadable speck: that is farther still. Use it to locate a body in a place, then go closer for the decision.
- 怎么拍：Keep a full figure readable, then add enough architecture or terrain that the person does not fill the height. Working from farther back with a 24mm to 35mm, or from a ridge with a longer lens, both can get you here; the crop is the size. Deep enough focus that the place reads. Prompt: Long shot of [Subject] small in a large environment, full figure plus geography.
- 何时用：Use it to place a human in a world that could ignore them: a rider on a ridge, a coat on a platform, a body in a square. Do not use it to read an eyelid, and do not use it when you only needed head-to-toe as a portrait.
- 近似对比：Full Body, Wide Shot, Extreme Long Shot, Establishing Shot, Extreme Long ShotScale is the emotion., Establishing ShotOpen a scene. Tell us where and when., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  A Full Body keeps the person large, head to toe, with place as a border. A Wide Shot is environment-forward coverage: place still speaks, often as the map of a scene. An Extreme Long Shot turns the figure into a speck and gives the land the subject. Long shot is full figure plus geography, not those three. An Establishing Shot is a job (where and when), which may use this size. Extreme Long ShotScale is the emotion. Establishing ShotOpen a scene. Tell us where and when. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：Lawrence of Arabia sets riders in desert so the person is still a figure and the land is already huge. Seven Samurai plants bodies in village dirt and fields the same way.；Grammar: locatable human, large world, not a postage-stamp speck and not a costume portrait.
- Prompt 模板：`Do not write head to toe as a hero portrait, and do not write speck against vast terrain. For video, keep the body identifiable; if they vanish into texture, you have gone to extreme long shot.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Say full figure plus geography. Example: Long shot of [Subject] small in a large environment, full figure plus geography.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Full Body (person fills the height) or an Extreme Long Shot (speck). The tell is either a fashion lookbook figure or a landscape with no readable human. Fix: full figure visible, world dominant, person still a person.

### Extreme Long Shot (ELS)
- 别名：ELS, extreme wide, EWS, Extreme-wide scale contrast ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/extreme-long-shot)
- 定义：An extreme long shot makes environment, scale, geography, or isolation dominant over individual detail. A person, if present, is a speck: a scale mark, not a portrait.
- 叙事功能：An ELS turns size into the emotion: awe, insignificance, loneliness, ambition. The small anchor lets the audience measure a space that would otherwise be abstract. The land, the station, the spillway, or the void is the subject. It is the wrong tool when you still need a face, a costume, or even a clearly posed full figure. It is also the wrong tool without a readable reference: huge architecture with no human, vehicle, or known object can look like a miniature. Use it when scale is the point, then come in when a person must act.
- 怎么拍：Keep the scale reference detectable through contrast, motion, or placement. Deep focus so terrain layers read; without depth cues the space flattens into a model. An Aerial Pullback can arrive here by moving; the size itself can be a lock-off from a ridge or a high vantage. Prompt: Extreme long shot of [Subject] as a speck against vast terrain, landscape as the true subject.
- 何时用：Use it when scale is the emotion: a yellow coat at the base of a spillway, a rider swallowed by desert, a craft against a planet. Do not omit a readable reference object, and do not use it to cover dialogue.
- 近似对比：Long Shot, Wide Shot, Establishing Shot, Aerial Pullback, Aerial PullbackClose a chapter. Geography wins., Establishing ShotOpen a scene. Tell us where and when., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  A Long Shot still presents a locatable full figure in large geography. A Wide Shot lets place speak inside coverage; bodies are small but not necessarily specks. An Establishing Shot is a function that often uses this size but can also be a sign or a building. ELS is speck-scale. Aerial Pullback is a move that can end on this size. Aerial PullbackClose a chapter. Geography wins. Establishing ShotOpen a scene. Tell us where and when. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：Lawrence of Arabia lets figures and riders occupy vast desert until they are marks in sand. 2001: A Space Odyssey sets small human or spacecraft elements against immense environments.；Nomadland uses wide country the same way: the van and the body as scale, the land as subject. Grammar: measure the world, do not portrait the person.；Lawrence of Arabia 1962Figures and riders occupy vast expanses of desert.；2001: A Space Odyssey 1968Small human or spacecraft elements are set against immense environments.
- Prompt 模板：`Extreme-wide static shot of a lone surveyor in a yellow coat at the base of an enormous concrete spillway. The figure is tiny but unmistakable; immense walls recede naturally. Slow drifting mist, no camera move, no giant-person scale errors.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Demand a detectable human-scale reference. For video, a tiny walk or a dust veil helps the figure read; a locked empty canyon with no marker will look like a maquette.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Long Shot (person still a clear figure) or an Establishing Shot that is really a building postcard with no scale. The tell is a readable full-body pose, or a vast space that looks like a tabletop. Fix: shrink the human to a mark, keep them findable, add depth cues.

### Establishing Shot
- 别名：opening establishing shot, re-establishing shot, aerial establishing shot, Transitional still life, Unpeopled interval ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/establishing-shot)
- 定义：An establishing shot introduces or re-establishes location, geography, time of day, or social context. It is a job in the sequence, not a synonym for wide or extreme long shot.
- 叙事功能：Before coverage begins, or when a scene has drifted, the audience needs to know where and when. An establishing shot declares the building, the street, the hour, the weather, sometimes the class of the place. A later re-establishing shot can remind us of the same geography after the scene has moved. It is the wrong tool when you actually needed the skeleton of the action: that is a master. It is also the wrong tool as empty postcard filler. Not every empty room is a pillow shot; placement and duration create the function. A clock, a sign, or a doorway can establish. A huge landscape that never connects to the next cut does not.
- 怎么拍：Choose a vantage that names spatial relations: who can reach which door, which way is the city, what the light is doing. Often a Wide Shot or Extreme Long Shot, sometimes a facade, an aerial, or an unpeopled interval. Hold long enough to read time of day. Preserve ambient sound in editorial thinking even if you are prompting a still. Prompt: Wide establishing shot of [Subject] and the location at once, time of day and spatial relations declared before coverage begins.
- 何时用：Use it to open a scene or to tell us where and when: a hotel at blue hour, a jury building in morning smog, a re-establish after a time jump. Do not fire one on every recut if geography has not changed, and do not confuse it with a master that must play the scene.
- 近似对比：Master Shot, Extreme Long Shot, Wide Shot, Long Shot, Extreme Long ShotScale is the emotion., Master ShotProtect the scene. You can always go tighter., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  A Master Shot covers the dramatic action and blocking of this scene. An establishing shot names the place and time; it does not have to contain the argument. An Extreme Long Shot is a size that often does this job. A Wide Shot is environment-forward coverage inside a scene, not automatically an establish. A Long Shot places a person in land; that may or may not be the first image of the location. Extreme Long ShotScale is the emotion. Master ShotProtect the scene. You can always go tighter. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：Blade Runner opens on a city that is already a time and a social order. The Shining uses the Overlook approach as geography before the interiors take over.；Tokyo Story and Late Spring let empty rooms and streets punctuate, which is related grammar: the world persisting between people. Peking Opera Blues reestablishes a party in broader views.；Use those as where-and-when grammar, not as frames to copy.；Tokyo Story 1953Empty rooms, streets and industrial views punctuate the family narrative.；Late Spring 1949Still-life and room imagery interrupts or outlasts the human exchange.；Peking Opera Blues 1986The opening party is introduced and later reestablished in broader views.
- Prompt 模板：`After a daughter leaves the house, hold a static shot of the empty entryway: her shoes are gone, afternoon light remains on the floor and distant street noise continues. No person enters, no camera move, no sentimental insert music. Cut to the next scene only after the room has registered as its own space.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the hour, the weather, and what building or street this is. For video, a small environmental motion (traffic, steam, a flag) is enough; do not tour if the job is only to plant geography.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Master Shot (action skeleton) or a pretty Extreme Long Shot with no relation to the next cut. The tell is a landscape postcard, or a wide that already plays the whole scene and gets labeled establish. Fix: the shot should answer where and when, then coverage can begin.

### Master Shot
- 别名：wide master, moving master, master scene ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/master-shot)
- 定义：A master shot covers the complete dramatic action and the spatial geography of a scene in one setup. It is the skeleton you can play in full, then cut into.
- 叙事功能：A master protects the scene. If every close-up dies, you still have who sat where, who could reach the door, and how the argument moved through the room. It is usually wide enough for blocking, not so wide that faces and props stop meaning anything. It is the wrong tool when you only needed to name the building from outside: that is an establish. It is also the wrong tool as a lifeless wide you never intend to use, parked for safety while all the acting happens in mismatched singles. A moving master can carry the whole beat if blocking and camera path are designed together.
- 怎么拍：Set a camera that sees all essential blocking: seats, door, table, the path out. Size is often a Wide Shot or a loose Two-Shot, but the job is coverage of the action, not a particular crop. Keep faces and key props readable enough to cut. Mark the 180. You can later cut in or go to singles. Prompt: Wide master of [Subject] with all blocking visible, the skeleton of the scene in one continuous frame, coverage can cut in later.
- 何时用：Use it to protect the scene: a jury room argument that could play in one take, a party whose crossings you must understand. Do not skip it and hope singles will invent geography, and do not treat an exterior postcard as a master.
- 近似对比：Establishing Shot, Wide Shot, Two-Shot, Group Shot, Establishing ShotOpen a scene. Tell us where and when., Two-ShotThe relationship is the shot., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  An Establishing Shot says where and when; a master says what happens in this space. A Wide Shot is a size. A Two-Shot may be the master if two people and their blocking are the whole scene. A Group Shot shows an ensemble as a unit; it is a master only if the complete action plays inside it. You can always go tighter. You cannot always invent a door that was never in the skeleton. Establishing ShotOpen a scene. Tell us where and when. Two-ShotThe relationship is the shot. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：12 Angry Men keeps returning to roomy views that clarify the changing jury arrangement so singles have a map. Nashville builds scenes whose wider coverage holds crossings and music as one geography.；Grammar: the scene could play here.
- Prompt 模板：`Demand all blocking. Example: Wide master of [Subject] with all blocking visible, the skeleton of the scene in one continuous frame.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Wide master of [Subject] with all blocking visible, the skeleton of the scene in one continuous frame, coverage can cut in later.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is an Establishing Shot (place, no action) or a Wide Shot that crops out the door you will need. The tell is a pretty exterior, or a wide so empty that the scene cannot play. Fix: every important path and body must be in, and the take must be able to run the beat.

### Two-Shot
- 别名：profile two-shot, walking two-shot, layered two-shot, Shared frame instead of isolated faces ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/two-shot)
- 定义：A two-shot, or two shot, frames two principal subjects together so their distance and posture can be compared in one composition. The space between them is part of the sentence.
- 叙事功能：When the relationship is the shot, cutting to singles too soon steals the audience's ability to watch both people at once. A two-shot lets the viewer choose which face to read, and it makes a lean, a flinch, or a widening gap visible without an edit. It is the wrong tool when one person must own the frame, or when a third body is politically in the scene. It is also the wrong tool as a timid wide that hides both performances. Keep head sizes readable. Profile, 50-50, walking, or layered (one nearer) are variants of the same job: two people, one picture.
- 怎么拍：Balance or deliberately unbalance head sizes. Set a readable axis. 40mm to 50mm at table or walking distance is common. Decide whether one face is privileged by focus or light. Small changes in distance are the acting. Prompt: Two-shot of [Subject] with a second figure, the space between them doing narrative work, 50mm, shared frame as relationship.
- 何时用：Use it when the relationship is the shot: two people at a diner table, a walk, a shared silence. Do not hide both faces in an unnecessarily empty wide, and do not use a two-shot if the scene has become a trio.
- 近似对比：Over-the-shoulder coverage, Single, Three-Shot, Three-ShotA trio has politics., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger., Choker ShotEmotion with nowhere to hide.
  Over-the-shoulder coverage puts one face in focus and the partner as a foreground shoulder; it is not a shared two-person portrait. A Single removes the partner. A Three-Shot adds a third principal and a new politics. Two-shot means both people author the frame. Shot/reverse is an editing pattern, not this size. Three-ShotA trio has politics. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger. Choker ShotEmotion with nowhere to hide.
- 片中实例：Heat plants two opponents across one diner table before and between singles, so the gap is visible. Persona juxtaposes faces inside severe shared compositions.；Before Sunrise and The Apartment keep pairs in one frame so walking and apartment air are the relation. Grammar: two bodies, one sentence.；Persona 1966Faces are juxtaposed and related within severe shared compositions.；Heat 1995The diner encounter establishes two opponents across one table before and between singles.
- Prompt 模板：`Hold a medium profile two-shot of two former business partners seated across a narrow café table. Both faces remain readable at once. One leans forward while the other slowly leans back. No cutting to singles, no focus change, tension expressed through changing distance.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Demand two people and the gap. Example: Two-shot of [Subject] with a second figure, the space between them doing narrative work, 50mm.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Over-the-Shoulder Coverage (one face plus a shoulder) or two singles cut together. The tell is one sharp face and a blur of coat, or both people so small the relation dies. Fix: two principals, comparable scale, the gap visible.

### Three-Shot
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/three-shot)
- 定义：A three-shot, or three shot, frames three principal subjects together, usually so alliances and the odd one out are readable in the blocking. It is a group sentence of three, not three singles cut together.
- 叙事功能：A trio has politics. Two against one, a hinge person in the middle, a late arrival who splits a pair: the triangle is the story. If you only cover this as ping-pong singles, the audience never sees who is left out in real space. It is the wrong tool when there are four or more as a unit, or when the scene has collapsed to a pair. It is also the wrong tool if you line three heads up with equal light and equal height and call that drama. Someone should own a peak of the triangle, or stand in the cold of it.
- 怎么拍：Arrange three bodies as a triangle in depth or across the frame, not a flat police lineup unless the story is a firing squad. Triangular Composition helps, but blocking comes first: seats, levels, who faces whom. Keep all three faces or postures readable enough to compare. Prompt: Three-shot of [Subject] in a triangular group, alliances and the odd one out readable in blocking.
- 何时用：Use it when a trio has politics: three gunmen, three people at a verdict, a couple plus the person who should not be there. Do not flatten them into equal portraits, and do not use a three-shot for a crowd.
- 近似对比：Two-Shot, Group Shot, Master Shot, Two-ShotThe relationship is the shot., Group ShotA family, a crew, a jury., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  A Two-Shot is a pair; adding a third changes the grammar. A Group Shot holds a small ensemble larger than three as a relational unit. A Master Shot may be a three-shot if the whole action is those three bodies. Do not treat three-shot as a synonym for any wide with extra extras. Two-ShotThe relationship is the shot. Group ShotA family, a crew, a jury. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：The Good, the Bad and the Ugly is the textbook trio: three men, three distances, one cemetery geometry. The standoff only works because all three remain comparable in shared frames before the eyes take over.；Grammar: three principals, readable alliance.
- Prompt 模板：`Specify who is isolated by height, light, or gap. For video, a small blocking shift (one step back) should change the politics without a cut.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name three and the triangle. Example: Three-shot of [Subject] in a triangular group, alliances and the odd one out readable in blocking.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Two-Shot that crops the third, or a Group Shot with extras filling the sides. The tell is two faces and a shoulder, or a crowd. Fix: three principals, triangular blocking, one of them slightly out.

### Group Shot
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/group-shot)
- 定义：A group shot frames a small ensemble as a relational unit, such as a family, a crew, or a jury. Position, height, and light say who belongs and who dominates.
- 叙事功能：A group shot is not a crowd still. It is a unit: people who share a table, a job, a crime, a bloodline. The audience should be able to rank them at a glance: who sits, who stands, who is brightest, who is at the edge. It is the wrong tool when the politics are only two or three principals, or when you needed a master of action rather than a portrait of the unit. Lighting everyone the same makes a yearbook. Let one face own the key, or let depth split generations.
- 怎么拍：Stage in layers: seated foreground, standing mid, a doorway back. Who is highest, central, nearest, brightest. A slightly wider lens (35mm to 50mm) holds the unit without turning them into ants; go longer if you want compression to stack them. Prompt: Group shot containing [Subject] among several figures, ensemble blocking, who owns the frame by position and light.
- 何时用：Use it for a family, a crew, a jury: the unit as the subject. Do not light every face equally if someone owns the room, and do not use a group shot when the beat has become a two-person fight.
- 近似对比：Three-Shot, Master Shot, Two-Shot, Three-ShotA trio has politics., Master ShotProtect the scene. You can always go tighter., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  A Three-Shot is specifically three principals. A Master Shot covers the complete action; a group shot may be that master, or it may be a posed unit inside a larger scene. A Two-Shot is a pair. Group means the ensemble is the relation, usually more than three, still small enough to read as people rather than a mob. Three-ShotA trio has politics. Master ShotProtect the scene. You can always go tighter. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：The Godfather stages families and crews so rank is seating, light, and who gets the center. Parasite uses household groupings the same way: who serves, who sits, who stands in a doorway.；Grammar: the unit, ranked.
- Prompt 模板：`Specify count (five at a table, a crew of six) and who is brightest or highest. For video, a small shift in who stands can re-rank the group without a cut.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the unit and the owner. Example: Group shot containing [Subject] among several figures, ensemble blocking, who owns the frame by position and light.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Three-Shot labeled group, or a Master Shot so wide the faces die. The tell is three people, or a mob with no rank. Fix: a small ensemble, readable faces, one person owning position or key.

### Insert Shot
- 别名：Pursued object, Plot-driving objective ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/insert)
- 定义：An insert shot is a close view of a story-relevant detail: an object, a hand action, a screen, or text. It points at the thing that will matter, at real scale.
- 叙事功能：An insert is not a pretty prop break. It is a fact the wider coverage cannot prove: the handwriting, the latch, the cup of water beginning to tremble, the key in a palm. Hands should be human-sized. The object should cut with the same key as the scene. It is the wrong tool when you are leaving the action for a clock on the wall or a listener in another room: that is a cutaway. It is also the wrong tool as a glowing product hero. If the object's specific mechanism never pays off, you may only have a MacGuffin in the plot, but the insert still has to be a readable picture of a thing.
- 怎么拍：Size to the object. Match the scene's key side and color so the cut belongs. Macro only if the detail is small; a letter can be a close crop on a 50mm. Keep hands at real scale, no giant fingers. Prompt: Tight close-up of an object that carries the plot near [Subject]: a glass, a letter, a latch. Hands at real scale. No glowing skin.
- 何时用：Use it to point at the thing that will matter later: a key, a letter, a latch, a trembling glass. Do not insert a decorative object that never returns, and do not light it like a catalog hero if it lives in a messy room.
- 近似对比：Cutaway, Extreme Close-Up, cut-in, Gesture, Product, CutawayHide a cut, show a clock, or let the room comment., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger., Choker ShotEmotion with nowhere to hide.
  A Cutaway leaves the primary action for context, a clock, or an observer. An Extreme Close-Up is a size; an insert is a job and may be that tight. A cut-in tightens on something already proven in the wider shot, often on the same axis. A Gesture covers a body movement rather than an object. Product lighting treats the object as a commercial portrait, which is a different job. CutawayHide a cut, show a clock, or let the room comment. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger. Choker ShotEmotion with nowhere to hide.
- 片中实例：Rear Window uses optical details as plot facts. Zodiac lives in handwriting and paper.；Notorious makes a concealed key a crucial object. Jurassic Park lets water in a cup reveal an approaching vibration.；The Maltese Falcon and North by Northwest organize pursuit around objects; those are story engines, while the insert is the picture of the thing. Grammar: show the fact.；The Maltese Falcon 1941The sought-after statuette organizes competing loyalties.；North by Northwest 1959The espionage material matters chiefly through the pursuit surrounding it.；Notorious 1946The concealed key becomes a crucial object.
- Prompt 模板：`Outline a short caper around an unopened blue envelope sought by three strangers. Never reveal its contents. Build the scenes around shifting trust, mistaken possession and one character choosing a friend over the envelope. Generate a consistent, easily trackable prop for every shot.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the object and the scale. Example: Tight close-up of an object that carries the plot near [Subject]: a glass, a letter, a latch.`
- Prompt 要点：Hands at real scale. No glowing skin.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Cutaway (leaving the action) or a Product hero (catalog glamour). The tell is a clock in another room, or black-sweep reflections on a plot letter. Fix: same scene, same light, object at real scale, story reason to look.

### Cutaway
- 别名：Plan de coupe ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/cutaway)
- 定义：A cutaway shot leaves the primary action for a related detail, observer, or part of the same world. It is used for context, reaction, compression, or continuity repair.
- 叙事功能：A cutaway is a brief exit: a clock, a kettle, a street, a person listening in a doorway. Its value is the relation it adds, not merely that it hides a bad join. It can build anticipation, let the room comment, or imply that time has passed. It is the wrong tool when the object is the plot in the actor's hands: that is an insert. It is also the wrong tool if the return to the main action restarts a gesture that should have continued. Check temporal logic. A cutaway can be a pressure release; it can also cheat geography if the new view could not exist at that moment.
- 怎么拍：Choose a detail that can plausibly be present now. Match ambient light and, in editorial thinking, room sound. Return to the main action at a later phase of the motion, not at the same frame of a handshake. Prompt: Cutaway from [Subject] to a related detail in the same world, a pressure-release or information beat that is not an insert on the actor.
- 何时用：Use it to hide a cut, show a clock, or let the room comment: a kettle trembling during an argument, a courtyard while someone looks. Do not cut away to a new geography that implies false time, and do not call an object-in-hand a cutaway.
- 近似对比：Insert Shot, Reaction Shot, cut-in, Insert ShotPoint at the thing that will matter later., Reaction ShotThe important action is watching., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  An Insert Shot stays on a plot object inside the action. A Reaction Shot is a person's response, often a face; a cutaway might be that listener, or it might be a non-human detail. A cut-in goes tighter on something already in the master, same space and often same axis, without leaving the beat. Cutaway means you left. Insert ShotPoint at the thing that will matter later. Reaction ShotThe important action is watching. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：Hot Fuzz uses cutaways as both joke and glue. The Conversation lets the world around a listener comment.；Dancer in the Dark brackets a car conversation with wider and closer views. Jurassic Park punctuates approaching threat with environmental details and observers.；Grammar: leave, add a relation, return honestly.；Dancer in the Dark 2000Wider and closer views bracket the conversation in Bill's car.；Jurassic Park 1993Environmental details and observers punctuate the approaching threat.
- Prompt 模板：`A couple argues quietly in a kitchen. Cut away to a kettle beginning to tremble on the stove while their voices continue, then return to the couple after a tense pause. Generate the insert separately with matching light and room sound. No literal symbolism captions.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the exit. Example: Cutaway from [Subject] to a related detail in the same world (a clock, a kettle, a street, a listener), not an insert on the actor.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is an Insert Shot (object in the action) or a random pretty detail. The tell is a letter in the hero's hands labeled cutaway, or a return that rewinds the action. Fix: leave the primary beat, pick a plausible now, watch time on the way back.

### Reaction Shot
- 别名：Kuleshov effect, Associative reaction construction ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/reaction-shot)
- 定义：A reaction shot shows a character's response to an event, a line, or an unseen stimulus. The important action is watching; the face (or body) is the cut.
- 叙事功能：A reaction shot is coverage of receiving. The gunshot, the insult, the courtyard window: we often learn what it meant by looking at the person who saw it. Meaning can be constructed between shots. A relatively still face reads differently depending on what came before, which is the Kuleshov lesson, not a demand that you fake a historical clip. It is the wrong tool when the speaker's line still needs to be seen, or when you over-act the response so the audience is told the emotion. It is a function, not a size: often a close-up, sometimes an MCU, occasionally a full-body flinch.
- 怎么拍：Point the eyeline at the stimulus, even if that stimulus is offscreen. Hold. Minimize explanatory mugging if you want the cut to do the work. Match Look Space and eyeline to the previous shot. Size is usually Close-Up or Medium Close-Up. Prompt: Reaction close-up of [Subject] receiving news they cannot speak yet, the face as the cut.
- 何时用：Use it when the important action is watching: the face after an offscreen shot, the listener who cannot speak yet. Do not use it as a blink after every clause, and do not perform the entire emotion so the juxtaposition has nothing to do.
- 近似对比：Close-Up, Over-the-shoulder coverage, Cutaway, Close-UpRead micro-expression. Default for important dialogue., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger., Choker ShotEmotion with nowhere to hide.
  A Close-Up is a size; a reaction is why that size is here. Over-the-shoulder coverage still includes the partner as a shoulder; a reaction single can drop them. A Cutaway may be a non-human comment; a reaction is a person's response. Keep the face fixed if you want to test Kuleshov; changing the expression changes the experiment. Close-UpRead micro-expression. Default for important dialogue. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger. Choker ShotEmotion with nowhere to hide.
- 片中实例：The Godfather often lets receiving carry the beat. Whiplash cuts to the face that has to survive the next bar.；Rear Window builds Jeff's looks so courtyard views change what the same face means. Grammar: watch the watcher.；Rear Window 1954Jeff's looks acquire different meanings through the courtyard views placed beside them.
- Prompt 模板：`Generate one neutral close-up of a woman looking slightly down and right.
