Reuse the identical clip in three short edits: after a broken heirloom, after a sleeping puppy and after an unsigned contract. Generate the inserts separately and keep the reaction genuinely unchanged. Compare the meanings created by the juxtaposition.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Specify eyeline offscreen or toward a known object. For video, hold a small physical change (a swallow, a blink) rather than a tour of expressions.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a generic Close-Up of the speaker, or an overplayed grimace. The tell is mouth moving through the line, or eyebrows explaining the plot. Fix: this person is receiving, not delivering. Point the eyes; hold.

### Over-the-Shoulder Coverage (OTS)
- 别名：OTS, Amorce épaule ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/over-the-shoulder-frame)
- 定义：Over-the-shoulder coverage, or an over the shoulder shot, puts a near shoulder or head in the foreground while the far face stays sharp. Paired reverses preserve relational space.
- 叙事功能：OTS is default dialogue coverage with spatial glue. The partner remains physically present even in a close view. Shoulder size and how much it obstructs can make the observer feel dominant, intimate, or trapped. It is the wrong tool when you need to isolate someone as if the other person had left the room: that is a clean single. It is also the wrong tool if both faces are equally sharp and complete: that is a two-shot. An over-the-shoulder shot is a framing choice. Shot/reverse shot is an editing pattern. They are not synonyms.
- 怎么拍：Place the camera beside one body, looking past a soft near shoulder at the far face. The far person looks at the near person, toward that shoulder, never into the lens. Match foreground body position, head size, and eyeline on the reverse. The 180-degree line is the axis between the two bodies. OTS coverage lives on one side of that line. If the near shoulder sits camera-right, the far face looks camera-right. The reverse OTS swaps who is near, but it stays on the same side of the axis so screen direction does not flip. Crossing the line is not a style choice in this coverage: it makes two people look like they share a bench instead of a conversation. Use focus and lighting to keep the speaking face sharp and the near cloth soft. Prompt: Over-the-shoulder framing of [Subject], near shoulder soft in foreground, the far face sharp, looking toward the near shoulder, 180-line held. Never cross the 180-degree line. Draw the axis between the two people and keep the camera on one side of it. Far face looks at the near shoulder. The reverse stays on the same side of the axis. If they look into the lens or away from each other, it is no longer OTS coverage.
- 何时用：Use it as default dialogue coverage when you want the relationship to stay in the picture: a diner, a deposition, an interview through glass. Do not mismatch shoulder size on the reverse, and do not call a clean single an OTS.
- 近似对比：Two-Shot, Single, Reaction Shot, Two-ShotThe relationship is the shot., SingleIsolate. The other person is gone even if they are in the room., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  A Two-Shot gives both faces authorship. A Single removes the foreground partner; a dirty single may chew the edge without a true shoulder anchor. A Reaction Shot may be taken as OTS or as a single. OTS means: near body fragment, far face subject. Match the pair. Two-ShotThe relationship is the shot. SingleIsolate. The other person is gone even if they are in the room. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：The Social Network runs confrontations and depositions in this geometry. Heat's diner uses shared geography and opposing coverage between the two-shot and the tighter work.；The Silence of the Lambs interviews live on whose shoulder, whose glass, whose face. The Stendhal Syndrome connects a person and a painting through alternating views, related grammar of looking past one thing at another.；Grammar: relation still in the foreground.；The Social Network 2010Confrontational conversations and deposition coverage.；Heat 1995The diner exchange uses shared geography and opposing coverage.；Heat 1995The diner conversation between Hanna and McCauley.
- Prompt 模板：`Generate two matching over-the-shoulder shots of a tense café conversation. A: the man's blurred shoulder frames the woman's face. B: her blurred shoulder frames his face. Preserve seat positions, cup placement and light direction. Edit on changing reactions, not every spoken word.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the near shoulder and the far face. Example: Over-the-shoulder framing of [Subject], near shoulder soft in foreground, the far face sharp, looking toward the near shoulder, 180-line held.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Two-Shot (both faces complete) or a Single (no shoulder). The tell is two people equally sharp, or a clean portrait. The worse tell is a broken 180: the far person looks into the lens or away from the near shoulder, so the reverse would make them appear to sit on the same side. Fix: one soft shoulder, one sharp face looking at that shoulder, matched reverse, line held.

### Single
- 别名：clean single, dirty single ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/single)
- 定义：A single, in single shot cinematography, is a coverage shot of one principal character, not a one-take scene. A clean single keeps other bodies out; a dirty single lets a shoulder or blur from the partner chew the edge without becoming a true over-the-shoulder.
- 叙事功能：A single isolates. The other person can still be in the room, but they no longer author the frame. This is how you make someone alone during a conversation, or how you give a listener a private beat. It is not a oner and not a long take; those are duration. A single is occupancy: one principal. It is the wrong tool when the relationship must stay visible as a shoulder or as a shared two-shot. Going to singles too early turns every scene into ping-pong. Going to a clean single at the right time can feel like the partner has been erased.
- 怎么拍：Frame one person. For a clean single, keep edges empty of the partner (Clean Frame). For a dirty single, allow a sliver of the other body as edge chew (Dirty Frame) without a composed foreground shoulder. Size is often Close-Up or Medium Close-Up, but a single can be a medium of one. Prompt: Clean single of [Subject], one person, no foreground shoulder, the frame belonging entirely to them.
- 何时用：Use it to isolate: the other person is gone even if they are in the room. Do not leave a stray composed shoulder if you meant clean, and do not call a continuous long take a single just because one actor walks.
- 近似对比：Over-the-shoulder coverage, Two-Shot, Close-Up, Oner, Close-UpRead micro-expression. Default for important dialogue., Over-the-Shoulder CoverageDefault dialogue coverage with spatial glue., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  Over-the-shoulder coverage uses the partner as a foreground anchor. A Two-Shot keeps both principals. A Close-Up is a size a single often uses. A Oner is a long unbroken take, a different word. Single means one occupant of the shot. Close-UpRead micro-expression. Default for important dialogue. Over-the-Shoulder CoverageDefault dialogue coverage with spatial glue. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：The Silence of the Lambs uses clean, frontal singles in the interviews so the glass and the partner can vanish and the face owns the rectangle. That isolation is the coverage choice.；Grammar: one person, the rest of the relationship offscreen.
- Prompt 模板：`Say one person and whether the edges are clean. Example: Clean single of [Subject], one person, no foreground shoulder, the frame belonging entirely to them.`
- 示例 Prompt：`If you want dirty, say a blur of the partner at the frame edge, not an OTS shoulder. For video, do not let a second face walk in unless that is the beat.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Over-the-Shoulder Coverage (composed near shoulder) or a Two-Shot. The tell is a sharp second face, or a textbook OTS. Another tell is calling a oner a single. Fix: one principal, decide clean or dirty, do not confuse occupancy with duration.

### Cut-ins
- 别名：cut in ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/cut-ins)
- 定义：A cut-in, or cut in shot, moves from a wider view to a closer detail of something already present in that space, usually along the same axis. It proves a fact the wide cannot prove: the hands, the phone, the wound.
- 叙事功能：The master already showed the table. The cut-in shows the text on the phone, the blood at the cuff, the grip on the glass. Because the object was in the wider shot, the audience does not feel teleported. They feel informed. It is the wrong tool when the detail was never in the geography (a sudden letter from nowhere) or when you leave the action for a clock on another wall. Those are insert-as-new-object and cutaway. A cut-in is tighter, same world, same beat, often the same lens axis.
- 怎么拍：From the Master Shot or a wider size, punch in on a detail that was already visible, keeping screen direction and roughly the same camera axis. An Axial Cut is the hard version of this: a jump along the lens axis. Match key side. Prompt: Cut-in on a detail of [Subject] already in the master, tighter, the same axis, a fact the wide cannot prove.
- 何时用：Use it to show the hands, the phone, the wound that the wide already contained but could not prove. Do not change axis so violently that it reads as a new setup, and do not cut in on an object that was not there.
- 近似对比：Insert Shot, Cutaway, Axial Cut, Extreme Close-Up, Insert ShotPoint at the thing that will matter later., Axial CutChange shot size without changing angle., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  An Insert Shot may introduce a plot object in close view; a cut-in tightens on what the wide already had. A Cutaway leaves the primary action. An Axial Cut is the editorial jump along the axis; cut-ins are the tighter shots you land on. An Extreme Close-Up may be the size of the cut-in, but ECU is the crop, not the coverage move. Insert ShotPoint at the thing that will matter later. Axial CutChange shot size without changing angle. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：Classical coverage is built on this grammar: master, then cut in to the business that the master only implied. You see it whenever a wide conversation yields a closer pair of hands without leaving the table.；Use that as the rule, not as a specific poster frame.
- Prompt 模板：`Say already in the master and same axis. Example: Cut-in on a detail of [Subject] already in the master, tighter, the same axis, a fact the wide cannot prove.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the detail (hands, phone, wound). For video, do not relocate the camera around the table; you are closer on the same line.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Cutaway (you left) or an Insert Shot of a new object. The tell is a different wall, a new prop, or a reverse angle pretending to be a punch-in. Fix: same space, same axis, tighter on a fact that was already there.

### Gesture
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/gesture)
- 定义：Gesture cinematography sizes and times a shot around a discrete expressive body movement: a hand, a glance, a weight shift. The plot is in the motion, not in an object sitting still.
- 叙事功能：Sometimes the scene is not the face and not the prop, but the almost-touch, the glove tightening, the look that does not land. Gesture coverage treats that small action as the beat. Duration matters: the movement has a start, a peak, and a settle. It is the wrong tool when the object is the fact (a key, a letter) rather than what the body does. It is also the wrong tool as a wide master where fingers die in the noise of a room. Get close enough that the motion reads, then let it finish.
- 怎么拍：Frame for the moving part. Hands often want a close crop without becoming a product shot; a glance may live in a Close-Up of the eyes. Keep the body connected enough that the motion has a source (wrist, shoulder). Light to separate fingers from background. Prompt: Gesture close on [Subject], the meaning in a hand, a glance, a weight shift, coverage of the small action.
- 何时用：Use it when the plot is in the fingers: an almost-touch in a corridor, a glove, a glass that does not quite rise. Do not cover it so wide the motion dies, and do not freeze it into an object insert.
- 近似对比：Insert Shot, Close-Up, Extreme Close-Up, Insert ShotPoint at the thing that will matter later., Close-UpRead micro-expression. Default for important dialogue., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  An Insert Shot is usually the object as fact. A Close-Up is a size that may hold a gesture, or may hold a still face. An Extreme Close-Up can be a fingertip as texture rather than as action. Gesture means the expressive movement is the subject. If nothing moves, you probably wanted an insert. Insert ShotPoint at the thing that will matter later. Close-UpRead micro-expression. Default for important dialogue. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：In the Mood for Love builds withheld romance out of hands, glances, and slow weight shifts more than out of speeches. Drive lets gloves, a wheel, and small body decisions carry threat.；Grammar: the small action is the line.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the movement. Example: Gesture close on [Subject], the meaning in a hand, a glance, a weight shift, coverage of the small action.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Say what the body does (fingers almost touching, a look away). For video, one motion with a settle; do not add a camera tour.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is an Insert Shot of a still object, or a Close-Up of a face that never moves. The tell is a static prop hero, or a wide where the hand is a blur. Fix: size to the moving part, let the action complete.

### Interview
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/interview)
- 定义：Interview cinematography is a talking-head setup: stable size, eyeline just off the lens, a listener implied. Someone is answering a question we often do not hear.
- 叙事功能：An interview frame is not merely an MCU. It is a social geometry: the subject speaks to a person beside the camera, look space opens toward that listener, and the audience sits in on an answered question. Direct address into the lens is a different contract (confession, host, warning). It is the wrong tool when two fictional characters are in a scene together and you needed OTS or a two-shot. It is also the wrong tool if the eyeline hits the glass and you did not mean to break the fourth wall. Keep the size stable; hunting around the face turns testimony into a music video.
- 怎么拍：Size usually Medium Close-Up or a loose Close-Up. Camera at Eye Level. Eyeline a few degrees off lens, toward an implied interviewer. Give Look Space on the look side. Motivated, simple key; catchlight in the eyes. Prompt: Interview frame of [Subject], talking-head distance, eyeline just off lens, a listener implied.
- 何时用：Use it when someone is answering a question we did not hear: documentary testimony, a fake-doc confession, a talking-head insert in a drama. Do not put the eyeline into the lens unless you mean direct address, and do not use this grammar for a two-person scene that should be OTS.
- 近似对比：Medium Close-Up, Eye level, Over-the-Shoulder, video portrait, Medium Close-UpTalk without losing body language., Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  A Medium Close-Up is only a crop; interview is the off-lens eyeline plus implied listener. Eye level is the height. Over-the-Shoulder would show the questioner. A video portrait holds a face as a study, often without the Q&A contract. Interview means testimony geometry. Medium Close-UpTalk without losing body language. Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：The Fog of War parks a speaker in this grammar so policy becomes a face answering questions. Many social-issue films borrow the same talking-head language (including The Social Dilemma's interview mode): stable size, off-lens eyeline, a listener we take on faith.；Grammar: someone is being asked.
- Prompt 模板：`Lock eyeline and size. Example: Interview frame of [Subject], talking-head distance, eyeline just off lens, a listener implied.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Specify look space toward camera-left or camera-right. For video, hold; small hand motion is fine.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not stare down the lens unless you want direct address.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a generic Medium Close-Up with eyes into the lens, or an Over-the-Shoulder Coverage of a scene. The tell is a host stare, or a second character in a fictional blocking. Fix: off-lens eyeline, implied listener, stable talking-head size.

### Product
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/product)
- 定义：Product cinematography lights and frames an object the way a portrait treats a face: hero angle, catalog clarity, controlled reflections. The thing is the subject, not a plot insert in a messy room.
- 叙事功能：A product frame sells readability: logo plane, material, edges, how metal and glass behave. Speculars are designed, not accidental. The background is often a sweep, a void, or a set built to disappear. It is the wrong tool when the object is a story fact inside a scene (a bloody letter on a kitchen table). That is an insert, and it should keep the room's key. It is also the wrong tool if the camera orbits so fast the form never settles. Show the object; let a Lazy Susan turn it if every side must read.
- 怎么拍：Choose a hero three-quarter or a true elevation. Large soft sources for wrapping highlights; flags and cards to kill ugly speculars on chrome. Macro only for texture. A turntable or a slow orbit is a separate move. Prompt: Product hero of [Subject], catalog clarity, controlled reflections, the object as the only subject.
- 何时用：Use it to sell the thing by lighting it like a face: a phone, a bottle, a watch on a sweep. Do not use drama-insert mess if you need catalog clarity, and do not use this glamour on a plot object that should look found.
- 近似对比：Insert Shot, Macro, Lazy Susan, MacroThe plot is microscopic., Lazy SusanShow an object or costume from every side., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  An Insert Shot lives in scene coverage as a plot fact, matching the room. Macro is an optic for small texture, which a product shot may use. A Lazy Susan is a rotation method. Product is the commercial portrait job: controlled reflections, hero angle, the object as subject. MacroThe plot is microscopic. Lazy SusanShow an object or costume from every side. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：Commercials and Apple keynotes are the public grammar: one object, clean plane, designed highlights, no accidental kitchen mess. Feature films sometimes steal this for a fetishized prop, which is a choice.；Grammar: catalog clarity, not found-object dirt, unless the brief is worn-in hero.
- Prompt 模板：`Specify material (brushed aluminum, glass, leather) and the background (black sweep, white cyclorama). For video, one slow turn or a locked hero; do not add a person unless they are a scale hand.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the object as hero. Example: Product hero of [Subject], catalog clarity, controlled reflections, the object as the only subject.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is an Insert Shot in dirty scene light, or a Macro texture with no hero angle. The tell is leftover room clutter, or a smear of uncontrolled speculars. Fix: isolate the object, design the highlights, pick a hero angle.

### Video Portraits
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/video-portraits)
- 定义：A video portrait is a sustained, simply covered study of one person: stable size, patient time, the face as the whole event. Duration is the intimacy; a person is enough.
- 叙事功能：A video portrait is not a close-up you cut away from after a line. You hold. Blink, breath, a swallow, the tiny life in the face becomes the content. It sits closer to a painting that is allowed to live than to dialogue coverage. It is the wrong tool when you need ping-pong coverage, a story insert, or a camera tour of the room. It is also the wrong tool if you freeze everything except one looping element: that is a cinemagraph. Here the person is alive in small ways, and time is the point.
- 怎么拍：Lock the camera. Size a Close-Up or Medium Close-Up. Light a simple, stable key. Hold long enough that duration registers (several seconds, sometimes much more). No motivated move unless a tiny push is the brief. Prompt still: Video portrait of [Subject], a held face, duration as intimacy. Motion brief: A long held portrait of [Subject], tiny life in the face, almost still.
- 何时用：Use it when a person is enough: a Screen Test, a study, an almost-still that breathes. Do not add a tour, and do not cut away the moment a thought appears; the hold is the piece.
- 近似对比：Close-Up, Cinemagraph, Single, Close-UpRead micro-expression. Default for important dialogue., CinemagraphA photograph that refuses to die., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
  A Close-Up is a size used inside coverage; it usually leaves. A Cinemagraph freezes most of the image and loops one isolated motion. A Single is occupancy of one body in scene coverage. A video portrait is duration plus stillness of a person as the entire event. Interview testimony has a questioner; this may have none. Close-UpRead micro-expression. Default for important dialogue. CinemagraphA photograph that refuses to die. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger.
- 片中实例：Warhol's Screen Tests are the plain grammar: a person, a hold, time doing the work. The Irishman uses long, patient close-ups of faces that are allowed to sit, related in duration if not in art-historical setup.；Grammar: hold the person.
- Prompt 模板：`Video: A long held portrait of [Subject], tiny life in the face, almost still. Forbid camera travel.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Allow blink, breath, a swallow. Do not write cinemagraph unless only one element should move.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a dialogue Close-Up that wants a reverse, or a Cinemagraph with a frozen body and a looping steam jet. The tell is a camera move, a cut on a line, or a dead freeze. Fix: lock off, keep the person slightly alive, hold.

### Wide Shot (WS)
- 别名：wide, WS, long shot, LS ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/framing/wide-shot)
- 定义：A wide shot shows the subject in full environment, with bodies small enough that place still speaks. It is environment-forward coverage: do not isolate yet.
- 叙事功能：Size is a sentence. A wide shot maps who can reach the door, where the street goes, what weather is doing. People are in the picture so we know the scale of the place, but the place is still talking. If you isolate too early, the scene loses its map. It is the wrong tool when the beat is a face, a holster, or a head-to-toe costume portrait. It is also the wrong tool if the human has become an unreadable speck (extreme long shot) or if you only needed to declare the building before the scene (establishing as a job). Use wide to keep geography in play, then change size when a new fact requires a tighter sentence.
- 怎么拍：Keep enough architecture, street, or weather that doors, paths, and weather remain readable. Bodies should not fill the height the way they do in a full-body portrait. A 24mm in a room or a longer lens across a square can both be wide; the crop is whether place still speaks. Prompt: Wide shot of [Subject] in full environment, bodies small enough that place still speaks.
- 何时用：Use it when you must not isolate yet: who can reach the door, how far the platform runs, whether two groups can see each other. Do not crop into a full-body fashion frame and call it wide, and do not use it as a blank postcard with no relation to the scene's paths.
- 近似对比：Full Body, Long Shot, Extreme Long Shot, Establishing Shot, Master Shot, Long ShotPlace a human in a world that could ignore them., Establishing ShotOpen a scene. Tell us where and when., Extreme Long ShotScale is the emotion.
  A Full Body makes the complete figure the subject, head to toe, place as a border. A Long Shot is the person-in-world size: full figure plus geography, still a locatable human. An Extreme Long Shot is speck-scale land. An Establishing Shot is a where-and-when job that often uses a wide. A Master Shot is the action skeleton, which may be wide if blocking needs it. Wide is the environment-forward coverage attitude, not a synonym for those four. Long ShotPlace a human in a world that could ignore them. Establishing ShotOpen a scene. Tell us where and when. Extreme Long ShotScale is the emotion.
- 片中实例：Once Upon a Time in the West lets station and desert speak while bodies remain small enough that place is the sentence. Lawrence of Arabia can sit in this band when geography is still coverage, not yet a speck-scale subject.；Grammar: keep the map; do not portrait.
- Prompt 模板：`Say full environment and small bodies. Example: Wide shot of [Subject] in full environment, bodies small enough that place still speaks.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the door, the street, the weather. Do not write head to toe hero, mid-thigh cowboy, or speck.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Full Body (person fills the height) or a Long Shot labeled wide with no coverage job. The tell is a costume portrait, or a speck landscape with no scene paths. Fix: place still speaks, bodies small enough to keep the map, geography that the next cut can use.

## 镜头角度 / Camera Angles（19 条）

**速查**：Eye Level · High Angle · Low Angle · Bird's-Eye View · Worm's-Eye View · Overhead Top-Down · Ground Level · Dutch Angle · Point of View · Profile · Three-Quarter Angle · Reverse Angle · Trunk Shot · Hip Level · Shoulder Level · First-Person · Fourth Wall · Object POV · Incline

### Eye Level
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/eye-level)
- 定义：An eye-level shot places the camera at the subject's eye height with a horizontal sightline and a level horizon. It is the default equal relationship: height and tilt assign no rank until you leave this setup.
- 叙事功能：Rank in a frame comes from where the lens sits and how it is pitched. Eye-level refuses that assignment. Two people at matching eye height read as peers; the room does not look down on them, and they do not loom. Sit when they sit. Stand when they stand. The judgment, if any, has to come from performance, costume, or light, not from geometry. It is the wrong tool when the beat is surveillance, monument, or a map. A few degrees of pitch and you have already cut to a High Angle or a Low Angle. A few inches down and you are in Shoulder Level, which is a companion, not a peer.
- 怎么拍：Match the nodal point to the subject's eyes. Keep roll at zero so verticals stay vertical. A 35mm to 50mm keeps perspective close to human vision; a wide from the same height will still stretch the room without changing rank. Height and tilt are independent: a camera at eye height that looks down is no longer an eye-level shot, it is a high angle from eye height. Prompt it as camera at their eye height, horizon level, no tilt up or down.
- 何时用：Use it for a conversation that should not take sides, or for a face you want believed without the camera lobbying. Concrete beat: two adults at a kitchen table, seated eyes matched, no ceiling grab. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
- 近似对比：High Angle, Low Angle, Shoulder Level, Point of View, Over-the-Shoulder Coverage, Single, High AngleVulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room., Low AnglePower, monument, or intimidation., Bird's-Eye ViewTurn life into a board game or a ritual.
  High Angle pitches down and shrinks the figure. Low Angle pitches up and grows it. Shoulder Level sits a few inches below the eyes, like a walking companion. Point of View is what the character sees, not a camera beside them at the same height. Over-the-Shoulder Coverage keeps a near body in the foreground; eye-level can be a clean Single. High AngleVulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room. Low AnglePower, monument, or intimidation. Bird's-Eye ViewTurn life into a board game or a ritual.
- 片中实例：Tokyo Story holds domestic talk at human height so posture, not a power tilt, does the judging. Rosetta stays with her at her own eye line as she moves, refusing a look down.；Use those as grammar: match height to the person in the scene, keep the horizon honest.
- Prompt 模板：`Lead with height and pitch. Quote: Eye-level shot of [Subject], camera at their eye height, horizontal sightline, equal relationship, no power tilt.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Eye-level shot of [Subject], camera at their eye height, horizontal sightline, equal relationship, no power tilt.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not write mood words in place of the height.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a mild Low Angle, because generators treat a portrait as a poster. Tell: ceiling in frame, chin from below, verticals converging. Fix: camera at eye height, horizon level, no tilt. If the subject is seated, sit the camera; standing eye-level on a seated person is already looking down.

### High Angle
- 别名：High angle shot, Plongée, Elevated observation ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/high-angle)
- 定义：A high-angle shot looks downward at the subject from above eye level, an oblique pitch rather than a straight drop. More floor enters the frame, the figure occupies less of the rectangle, and the viewpoint reads as observation from above.
- 叙事功能：Height plus downward tilt is what assigns the smaller rank. A high angle can be pity, surveillance, or a clinical map of who can reach the door. The face should still be a face: you see the crown and the shoulders, not only a scalp. Paths and distances that Eye Level would hide become readable because the floor is a diagram with walls still receding. It is the wrong tool when you need a true plan view. If the tabletop must be a rectangle and bodies become pieces, you wanted Overhead Top-Down or a steep Bird's-Eye View. It is also the wrong tool for a power confrontation; looking down on the boss fights the line.
- 怎么拍：Raise the camera above the subject's eyes and pitch it down. Typical working range is a step-stool to a short ladder, 20 to 45 degrees of tilt, subject still recognizable through costume and contrast. Top-light and ceiling practicals become the key more often, because you are now closer to the lights that hang. Keep roll level; a canted high angle is two techniques at once. Prompt: high-angle shot looking down, figure diminished, more floor than sky, not top-down.
- 何时用：Use it for vulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room that eye-level cannot draw. Concrete beat: a lone figure on a station platform, camera above the lamps, suitcase readable on the boards. Do not use a high oblique when the shot must be strictly top-down.
- 近似对比：Eye Level, Bird's-Eye View, Overhead Top-Down, Low Angle, Crane Over, Bird's-Eye ViewTurn life into a board game or a ritual., Low AnglePower, monument, or intimidation., Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
  Eye Level stays on the sightline and assigns no rank. Bird's-Eye View looks steeply or straight down from a great height until people are a map. Overhead Top-Down is 90 degrees, a flat-lay or room plan. Low Angle is the opposing pitch. Crane Over is the move that can arrive at a high or overhead view. Bird's-Eye ViewTurn life into a board game or a ritual. Low AnglePower, monument, or intimidation. Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
- 片中实例：Psycho uses a steep high view on the stairway so Arbogast is placed inside the house's geometry before the attack. The Shawshank Redemption uses high views of the prison so human scale sits inside the walls.；Citizen Kane and Prisoners both look down when a person should feel watched or reduced. Borrow the downward pitch and the readable floor, not a poster.；Psycho 1960The overhead view during Arbogast's stairway encounter.；The Shawshank Redemption 1994High views establish the prison and its constrained human scale.
- Prompt 模板：`High oblique view of a lone cleaner crossing a vast empty railway hall after midnight. The architecture and floor pattern dominate. The cleaner pauses at a distant sound. Fixed elevated viewpoint, no drone swoop or zoom.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Add: oblique angle, face still readable, more floor than ceiling, horizon not level to the eyes. Forbid 90-degree top-down unless you actually want Overhead Top-Down.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Bird's-Eye View or Overhead Top-Down: the model snaps to a drone plan. Tell: tops of heads only, table as a perfect rectangle, no face. Fix: looking down 30 degrees, eyes and mouth still readable, walls receding. The other failure is a raised camera that stays level, which is a high vantage, not a high angle.

### Low Angle
- 别名：Low angle shot, Tatami-level composition, Ozu-style low camera ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/low-angle)
- 定义：A low-angle shot looks upward at the subject from below eye level, so verticals converge and ceilings or sky take weight. The camera is not merely low; it is pitched up, and that pitch is what assigns monument or intimidation.
- 叙事功能：Looking up makes a body into architecture. Door frames, ceiling beams, and the underside of a chin enter the picture. A boss in a doorway, a statue, a threat: the subject occupies the top of the frame and we occupy the floor. Citizen Kane built ceilings (and sometimes dug a pit) so the look-up had a real lid. Do not confuse this with a low camera that stays level. A tatami or seated-height camera with a horizontal sightline is a height choice, close to seated Eye Level, not a low angle. Ozu's rooms sit low without turning the family into towers. If you pitch up on that setup, you have changed the sentence. It is the wrong tool for a peer conversation and for a true worm's view of a skyscraper. Moderate look-up is a portrait with rank. Extreme look-up is Worm's-Eye View.
- 怎么拍：Drop the camera below the subject's eyes (chest, waist, or a hole in the floor) and tilt up until verticals converge toward the top of the frame. A wider lens exaggerates the convergence; a longer lens from the same height still looks up but with less stretch. Practicals on the ceiling become motivated keys. Keep roll level unless you are also doing a Dutch Angle. Prompt: low-angle looking up, converging verticals, ceiling or sky in frame, not camera on the dirt looking straight up.
- 何时用：Use it for power, monument, or intimidation: someone who should fill the doorway. Concrete beat: a standing figure shot from a seated listener, ceiling beams closing over the head. Do not pitch up on every protagonist as a default poster.
- 近似对比：Eye Level, Worm's-Eye View, Ground Level, High Angle, Trunk Shot, Worm's-Eye ViewThe subject is a tower. You are dust., High AngleVulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room., Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
  Eye Level keeps the sightline horizontal. Worm's-Eye View looks sharply up from ground or below until the subject is a tower and verticals collapse inward. Ground Level is a floor-height camera; it may look along the dirt instead of up. High Angle is the opposing pitch. Trunk Shot looks up from inside a container, which is a location, not only a tilt. Worm's-Eye ViewThe subject is a tower. You are dust. High AngleVulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room. Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
- 片中实例：Citizen Kane puts ceilings and looming bodies into confrontations by looking up from a lowered camera. Touch of Evil uses the same grammar on Quinlan so bulk becomes the image.；The Dark Knight often pitches up on costume and architecture so the figure reads as a structure. Tokyo Story and Late Spring are the usual mix-up: low seated cameras, mostly level, not this tilt.；Tokyo Story 1953Domestic conversations filmed from a low, stable viewpoint.；Late Spring 1949Seated interiors and carefully arranged domestic exchanges.；Citizen Kane 1941Low-angle confrontations make ceilings and looming bodies part of the image.；Touch of Evil 1958Quinlan's imposing low-angle appearances.
- Prompt 模板：`A quiet family conversation in a modest room, filmed from a low seated height with the camera level. Two adults sit beside a low table, doorways carefully balanced, no dramatic upward angle. Locked shot, small natural gestures, patient pauses.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Add: camera below their eyes, horizon low, ceiling or sky in frame, face still a portrait. Ban from the ground looking straight up unless you want Worm's-Eye View.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Worm's-Eye View or a generic Ground Level boot shot. Tell: only nostrils and a vanishing point in the sky, or only shoes. Fix: below eye height, tilted up, eyes and mouth still readable, ceiling in. The other mix-up is Ozu: low height, level camera. If doorways and floor lines stay orthogonal, you never pitched up.

### Bird's-Eye View
- 别名：top down, overhead still ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/birds-eye)
- 定义：A bird's-eye view shot looks steeply or directly down from a great height so people and furniture become a map. Height, not just distance, is the point of view: life reads as a board game or a ritual seen from above.
- 叙事功能：From up there the body is a token. Circulation, grouping, and the shape of a courtyard or a table take over. You use it to turn a fight, a dinner, or a street into a pattern the participants cannot see. The camera is high enough that the floor is the picture, but unlike a close Overhead Top-Down you still feel drop: altitude, not a light stand over a desk. It is the wrong tool when you need a face, a line of dialogue, or a simple sense that someone is small in a room. That last job is often a High Angle from a balcony. If the model flies and tours, you have left the still viewpoint for a drone move.
- 怎么拍：Place the camera well above the action and pitch it steeply down, approaching 70 to 90 degrees. Great height is required: a ceiling corner of a lobby, a crane, a rooftop, a high grid. Anatomy foreshortens; heads and shoulders become discs. Keep extra limbs out of a seated tableau or the map grows a mutant. Light from above will flatten; a raking key throws shadows as drawing on the floor. Prompt: bird's-eye straight down from a great height, floor as a map, no extra limbs.
- 何时用：Use it to turn life into a board game or a ritual. Concrete beat: one seated person and a table seen from the ceiling so plates and hands are the story. Do not use it as a sightseeing flyover when the beat is still a person.
- 近似对比：High Angle, Overhead Top-Down, Crane Over, Aerial, FPV Drone, Overhead Top-DownTable, crime scene, or dance formation., High AngleVulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room., Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
  High Angle looks down obliquely; the face remains a face. Overhead Top-Down is a 90-degree top-down, often closer, a flat-lay or room plan whose tabletop must stay rectangular. Crane Over is the path that can arrive at a bird's-eye. Aerial and FPV Drone add flight; bird's-eye can be a locked steep look. Overhead Top-DownTable, crime scene, or dance formation. High AngleVulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room. Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
- 片中实例：The Grand Budapest Hotel uses steep downward views so hotels, desks, and ceremonies read as designed diagrams. Requiem for a Dream looks down until apartments and bodies are patterns of habit.；Use the altitude and the map, not a copied lobby.
- Prompt 模板：`Add: great height, steeply downward, people as pieces, not an oblique high angle, not a tabletop product flat-lay unless the scale is a room seen from the ceiling.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Lock height and pitch. Quote: Bird's-eye view straight down on [Subject], camera over one seated person and a table, floor as a map, no extra limbs.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a mild High Angle (too little height) or a close Overhead Top-Down (too little altitude, too much product photography). Tell: a readable standing portrait from a step-stool, or a desk filling the frame with no drop. Fix: camera high above, looking steeply down, bodies foreshortened, floor as geography. Ban extra arms in seated groups.

### Worm's-Eye View
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/worms-eye)
- 定义：A worm's-eye view looks sharply upward from ground level or below the subject, an extreme low pitch that collapses verticals inward. The subject is a tower and the camera is dust.
- 叙事功能：This is not a slightly taller portrait. The lens is on or under the floor plane and the look is nearly straight up: nostrils, cornices, the belly of a ship, a ceiling that has become the whole sky. Wonder and terror share the same geometry because scale has nowhere to go but over you. Use a Low Angle when you still need a face that can speak. Use Ground Level when the dirt, the boots, and the trailing hem are the actors and the look may travel along the ground rather than up the body. Worm's-eye is the vanishing point in the zenith.
- 怎么拍：Put the lens on the floor, in a pit, or at ground grade. Tilt up hard, often past 60 degrees, until architecture converges to a point above the frame. Ultra-wide glass increases the collapse; keep anatomy plausible (one head, two feet). Foreground may include earth, a curb, or a grating. Prompt: worm's-eye from ground level looking straight up, extreme low, verticals collapsing inward.
- 何时用：Use it when the subject should erase you: a spacecraft hull, a courthouse, a giant. Concrete beat: looking straight up the wall of a ship or a tower so the person is architecture. Do not use it for a simple power two-shot; that is a Low Angle.
- 近似对比：Low Angle, Ground Level, Trunk Shot, High Angle, Bird's-Eye View, Low AnglePower, monument, or intimidation., Ground LevelStart from the dirt., Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
  Low Angle looks up from below the eyes and still delivers a portrait. Ground Level names the height of the lens on the floor; it can look along boots instead of straight up. Trunk Shot looks up from inside a container with a rim. High Angle and Bird's-Eye View are the opposing downward family. Low AnglePower, monument, or intimidation. Ground LevelStart from the dirt. Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
- 片中实例：Citizen Kane pushes some interiors past a working low angle into a pit look, ceilings crushing the figure. Arrival stages the shell so humans look up from grass and become small against a hull.；Borrow the extreme upward pitch and the collapse of verticals.
- Prompt 模板：`Say straight up, not merely low. Quote: Worm's-eye view from ground level looking straight up at [Subject], extreme low, verticals collapsing inward, awe or terror.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Worm's-eye view from ground level looking straight up at [Subject], extreme low, verticals collapsing inward, awe or terror.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Low Angle. Tell: a readable standing portrait from belt height, a little ceiling, no collapse. Fix: camera on the ground, looking straight up, verticals rushing inward. The other cousin is Ground Level along the street: you see a row of boots and a horizon. Worm's-eye has almost no horizon; it has a zenith.

### Overhead Top-Down
- 别名：Bird’s-eye tableau, Plan zénithal ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/overhead)
- 定义：An overhead top-down shot looks nearly straight down at 90 degrees, flattening bodies and spaces into a graphic arrangement. Faces are scarce; silhouette, props, and the plan of the table or room do the talking.
- 叙事功能：This is the crime scene, the place setting, the dance formation, the town drawn as a floor plan. People become pieces in a system. Shadows draw on the surface because the camera is the ceiling. It can make an ordinary ritual strange by removing the social face. A steep High Angle still has walls in perspective. A Bird's-Eye View still has altitude and drop. Overhead wants the tabletop's geometry to match a plan: rectangles stay rectangles. If you still need the eyes, you are in the wrong viewpoint.
- 怎么拍：Mount the camera on an overhead rig, a high grid, or a virtual parent looking down the world Z-axis. Pitch at 90 degrees, roll chosen so the set's long axis sits square. Arrange performers for silhouette: heads, hands, plates, chalk outlines. Because faces are less available, costume color and contrast have to carry identity. Prompt: overhead top-down at 90 degrees, flat-lay or room plan, shadows as drawing.
- 何时用：Use it for a table, a crime scene, or a dance formation that should read as a diagram. Concrete beat: four pairs of hands setting a long table, plates passing, the rectangle of the wood filling the frame. Do not use it when the line is on a face.
- 近似对比：Bird's-Eye View, High Angle, Crane Over, Bird's-Eye ViewTurn life into a board game or a ritual., Crane OverTurn a scene into a map without cutting., Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
  Bird's-Eye View is a steep look from a great height; overhead is the 90-degree plan, often closer. High Angle is oblique and keeps a readable face. Crane Over is the move that can finish as this viewpoint. A product flat-lay is the still-life cousin; film overhead usually still includes a body as a piece in the plan. Bird's-Eye ViewTurn life into a board game or a ritual. Crane OverTurn a scene into a map without cutting. Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
- 片中实例：Dogville exposes the town as a floor-plan layout from above. The Grand Budapest Hotel uses top-down desks, pastries, and objects as graphic systems.；Oldboy's corridor coverage from above turns bodies into a moving diagram. Borrow the plan view, not the wallpaper.；Dogville 2003Overhead views expose the town's floor-plan-like layout.；The Grand Budapest Hotel 2014Top-down object and desk compositions.
- Prompt 模板：`Strict top-down locked shot of four people setting a long table, their hands passing plates in a coordinated pattern. The tabletop forms a clean rectangle, no perspective tilt, no camera rotation. One person stops and the system loses its rhythm.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Add: camera straight down, tabletop or floor as a true rectangle, tops of heads, no three-quarter face. If the model tilts, say no perspective wedge on the table.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a steep High Angle that still shows a wall and a face. Tell: trapezoid table, eyeline into camera, room in perspective. Fix: 90 degrees, plan geometry, silhouette clarity. The other failure is a bird's-eye city when you asked for a kitchen table: wrong scale. Name the surface (table, bed, street as plan) and the distance.

### Ground Level
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/ground-level)
- 定义：A ground-level shot puts the lens almost on the floor, so boots, hems, wheels, and the dirt become actors. Height is the fact: the camera starts from the ground plane, whether it looks along the street or steeply up.
- 叙事功能：From the dirt, a walk is a sequence of soles. A coat trailing, a wheel, a dropped gun, a snake's view of a street: the floor is the foreground and architecture goes large above it. Westerns and car films live here because the ground is where decisions land. Worm's-Eye View is the cousin that looks straight up until there is no street, only a zenith. Low Angle can be shot from the waist and never touch the floor. Hip Level still belongs to hands and holsters. Ground-level is the pedestal on the boards.
- 怎么拍：Set the camera on a low plate, a sandbag, or a hole so the sensor is centimeters from the ground. A wide lens exaggerates the near boots and the far horizon. You may look along the floor (track, tire, hem) or tilt up (a coat filling the sky). Keep grit, wet, or dust in the near field; that is how the height reads. Prompt: ground-level camera, lens nearly on the floor, boots and trailing coat, horizon very low.
- 何时用：Use it when the story starts from the dirt: an arrival on foot, a car, a body on the road. Concrete beat: boots stepping onto a dusty street, coat hem in the near field, town rising beyond. Do not use it as the default for a walking conversation; that is Shoulder Level or Eye Level.
- 近似对比：Worm's-Eye View, Low Angle, Hip Level, Overhead Top-Down, Worm's-Eye ViewThe subject is a tower. You are dust., Low AnglePower, monument, or intimidation., Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
  Worm's-Eye View looks sharply up from this height until verticals collapse and the horizon dies. Low Angle is a pitch from below the eyes, not a requirement that the lens kiss the floor. Hip Level sits at belt height so hands stay in the plane of focus. Overhead Top-Down is the opposite pole: the floor as a plan, not as a foreground. Worm's-Eye ViewThe subject is a tower. You are dust. Low AnglePower, monument, or intimidation. Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
- 片中实例：Once Upon a Time in the West lets the station boards, tracks, and boots own the opening; the ground is duration. Drive keeps cars, asphalt, and shoes in the near field so the street is the world.；Borrow the low pedestal and the near-ground texture.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the floor as foreground. Quote: Ground-level camera looking steeply up at [Subject], lens nearly on the floor, boots and trailing coat monumental.`
- 示例 Prompt：`If you want the along-the-dirt variant, say looking along the ground, boots in the near field, horizon low, not straight up at the sky.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Low Angle from kneeling height with a clean floor and a full face. Tell: no near-ground texture, no boots, camera clearly at knee-plus. Fix: lens nearly on the floor, grit or pavement sharp in the foreground. If the shot is only nostrils and sky, you drifted into Worm's-Eye View.

### Dutch Angle
- 别名：canted angle, oblique angle, Dutch tilt, Canted framing, Plan débullé ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/dutch-angle)
- 定义：A Dutch angle rolls the camera so verticals and the horizon appear tilted. The cant is usually static: gravity's down is no longer the bottom of the frame, which is why the world reads as off its axis.
- 叙事功能：Pitch looks up or down. Roll breaks the floor. A Dutch (canted, oblique) shot is a choice about gravity, not about power height. Use it when the moral or mental line is already bent: a sick city, a fight that will not stay fair, a mind that cannot stand up. Adjacent level shots make the cant mean something. If every setup is Dutch, nothing is. It is not a Low Angle. Looking up with a level roll is a different axis. It is not a Dutch Roll either: that is the move that rotates into a cant during the shot. A static Dutch is a frozen decision.
- 怎么拍：Rotate the camera around the lens axis. A readable working cant is about 15 to 30 degrees; past 45 the frame often just looks like a mistake. Compose diagonals on purpose: stair rails, streets, a leaning body that agrees or argues with the roll. Keep the set rigid. The sensation should come from the viewpoint, not from warped walls. Decide whether the reverse stays level for contrast. Prompt: Dutch angle, camera rolled 20 to 30 degrees, diagonal horizon.
- 何时用：Use it when the world is off its axis. Concrete beat: a stairwell confrontation, banister as a diagonal, both feet still planted on real steps. Do not use it as decoration on every villain or every night street.
- 近似对比：Eye Level, Incline, Dutch Roll, Camera Roll, Low Angle, High Angle, Dutch RollUnease that arrives in time, not as a still cant., Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it., High AngleVulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room.
  Eye Level with a level horizon is the control condition. Incline is a gentler cant, a few degrees of slope rather than a full lean. Dutch Roll and Camera Roll are motion on this axis. Low Angle pitches up; High Angle pitches down. Neither is a Dutch until you also roll. Dutch RollUnease that arrives in time, not as a still cant. Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it. High AngleVulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room.
- 片中实例：The Third Man cants Vienna's streets and encounters so the postwar city will not sit true. Do the Right Thing angles selected confrontations rather than the whole film.；Mission: Impossible uses canted Prague coverage; the later rotating vault is a different trick (the set moves). Borrow a motivated static roll, not a permanent lean.；The Third Man 1949Canted views of Vienna's streets and encounters.；Do the Right Thing 1989Angled compositions intensify selected confrontations.
- Prompt 模板：`A tenant confronts a landlord in a narrow stairwell. Static camera canted fifteen degrees, strong diagonal banister, rigid walls and natural anatomy. Both actors remain grounded. No rolling camera, fisheye distortion or vibrating image; the tension comes from the tilted composition.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the roll in degrees and keep the buildings straight. Quote: Dutch angle of [Subject], camera rolled 20 to 30 degrees, diagonal horizon, moral or mental tilt.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Low Angle (pitch) or a moving Dutch Roll. Tell: ceiling in frame but horizon level, or the camera rotating during the shot when you wanted a still lean. Fix: level pitch, roll 20 to 30 degrees, lock it. The other failure is 60-degree decoration on every setup. If the next shot is also canted, the cant has no contrast.

### Point of View
- 别名：subjective camera, Muffled perspective, Tinnitus effect ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/pov)
- 定义：A POV shot makes the camera function as a character's optical viewpoint: what they see at their eye height. The looker's head and shoulder stay out of the frame; we inhabit the look, not a seat behind it.
- 叙事功能：Classical coverage builds a POV as a sentence: a person looks, we cut to the seen, we often cut back to a reaction. Rear Window lives on that grammar. The camera sits at their eyes, aims where they aim, and refuses the back of their head. Identification is forced because the audience is briefly the character. It is not Over-the-Shoulder Coverage, which keeps the looker's shoulder as a claim of with, not as. It is not First-Person, which lets a body own the lens for a long ride: hands, breath, locomotion. A POV can be a single still insert. First-person is a body that keeps seeing. Subjective sound (a ringing ear, a mute beach) can ride with a POV or sit on an objective picture. Do not confuse a hearing filter with this optical setup.
- 怎么拍：Put the camera at the named character's eye height and point it along their eyeline. Match lens choice to their attention: a longer glass for binocular looking, a wider field for a panicked scan. No owner body in frame unless a diegetic visor or mask is the optical device (Halloween). If you include a shoulder, you have left POV for OTS. Prompt: what [Subject] sees, world at their eye height, no back of a head, no shoulder of the looker.
- 何时用：Use it to force identification: the audience is the character for the length of the look. Concrete beat: a look offscreen, then empty tracks, steam, and lamps at their eye height. Do not use it when you still need the looker's face in the same shot; shoot the look, then the POV, or use OTS.
- 近似对比：Over-the-Shoulder Coverage, First-Person, Object POV, Fourth Wall, SnorriCam, SnorriCamTrap the audience in a body that cannot get out., Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it., High AngleVulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room.
  Over-the-Shoulder Coverage shows the near shoulder and the far face; we stand with the looker. First-Person adds hands, breath, and a body that owns the lens over time. Object POV is a tool or vehicle seeing, not a person. Fourth Wall is the opposite look: eyes into our lens. SnorriCam straps the camera to the body and looks at their face. SnorriCamTrap the audience in a body that cannot get out. Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it. High AngleVulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room.
- 片中实例：Rear Window cuts from Jeff to binocular-aligned views of the courtyard. Halloween's opening adopts the observer's optical viewpoint through the mask.；Gravity moves into helmet-level seeing. Saving Private Ryan pairs optical shock with Miller's muted hearing; the sound is a cousin, not the definition of the shot.；Saving Private Ryan 1998Miller's perception becomes muted during the Omaha Beach assault.；Sound of Metal 2019The soundtrack repeatedly shifts into Ruben's changing hearing experience.；Gravity 2013Continuous-looking passages move between the astronaut, surrounding space and helmet-level subjectivity.；Halloween 1978The opening adopts the killer's optical viewpoint before revealing the observer.
- Prompt 模板：`At a crowded celebration, a character becomes overwhelmed. Keep the image continuous while voices lose clarity, room detail recedes and a small nearby glass movement becomes unusually prominent. Return gradually to the room when a friend touches her shoulder. Build the perceptual transition in sound post-production.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Describe the seen world, not the seer. Quote: What [Subject] sees: the world at their eye height, no back of a head, no shoulder of the looker in frame.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Over-the-Shoulder Coverage or a face looking toward camera. Tell: a blurry shoulder, the back of a head, or the looker staring at us. Fix: empty of the owner, eyeline into the scene, height matched to the character you just showed looking. If hands and a gun enter and stay, you drifted into First-Person.

### Profile
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/profile)
- 定义：A profile shot places the camera at 90 degrees to the head so one ear, the jaw, and the nose read as architecture, with the look offscreen. It is a true side view, not a three-quarter face and not a stamped coin if the living head still breathes.
- 叙事功能：Turn the skull until the far eye disappears. What remains is silhouette, secrecy, and a sightline that refuses us. A statue, a cameo, a don who will not grant the lens his other eye: profile withholds. The nose becomes a line against the background; the mouth can hide. It is the wrong tool for most talk. Both eyes are how we read a lie. If the beat needs charm, pain, or a clear listen, use Three-Quarter Angle. If they look into the lens, you wanted Fourth Wall, not a side.
- 怎么拍：Orbit until the camera sits on a line perpendicular to the subject's median plane. Keep height at Eye Level unless you are adding rank on purpose. Light can graze the profile so the nose and brow separate from the field, or it can swallow the face into silhouette. Leave look-space in the direction of the nose. Prompt: true profile, camera at 90 degrees to the head, one ear, nose as architecture, looking offscreen.
- 何时用：Use it for statue, secrecy, or a nose as architecture. Concrete beat: a seated power figure in side view, looking toward an offscreen petitioner, one ear and a cigar. Do not use it as default coverage of a two-person argument; you will lose the eyes.
- 近似对比：Three-Quarter Angle, Eye Level, Point of View, Fourth Wall, Three-Quarter AngleMost flattering narrative portrait., Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it., High AngleVulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room.
  Three-Quarter Angle turns the face about 45 degrees so both eyes stay visible and the cheek recedes. Eye Level is a height, not a facing; a profile is often eye-level and 90 degrees yaw. Point of View is the view they see, not the side of their head. Fourth Wall aims the eyes at us, the opposite of an offscreen profile look. Three-Quarter AngleMost flattering narrative portrait. Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it. High AngleVulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room.
- 片中实例：Barry Lyndon uses painterly side views so court faces sit like plates without becoming cartoons. The Godfather often parks Vito in profile at the desk, looking toward petitioners rather than toward us.；Borrow the 90-degree head, the offscreen look, and a human face, not a cut-out.
- Prompt 模板：`True profile of [Subject], camera at 90 degrees to the head, one ear, the nose as architecture, looking offscreen. A human face, not a stamped portrait.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Lock the yaw. Quote: True profile of [Subject], camera at 90 degrees to the head, one ear, the nose as architecture, looking offscreen.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Three-Quarter Angle: both eyes sneak back in. Tell: far iris visible, cheek still facing us. Fix: rotate until the far eye is gone and the nose breaks the cheek line. The other failure is a paper cut-out with no skull volume. Ask for a living head, skin, and one ear.

### Three-Quarter Angle
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/three-quarter)
- 定义：A three-quarter angle turns the face about 45 degrees to the camera so both eyes remain visible and the far cheek recedes. It is the standard narrative portrait angle: dimensionality without a full front or a true side.
- 叙事功能：Most coverage of a talking face lives here. You see both eyes, the bridge of the nose, and a cheek going away, which is enough skull to light and enough access to read a listen. It is useful because it models the head and still connects to an offscreen partner along a natural eyeline. It is the wrong tool when you want a coin (use Profile) or a confession into the taking lens (use Fourth Wall). It is also not a height: you can shoot three-quarter from Eye Level, Low Angle, or High Angle. The name is yaw, not tilt.
- 怎么拍：Place the camera about 30 to 50 degrees off the subject's nose. Keep both irises; hide only a sliver of the far ear if any. A 50mm to 85mm holds the head without stretching the near eye. Key from the far or near side depending on short or broad lighting; the angle is what gives the planes. Prompt: three-quarter angle, face turned about 45 degrees, both eyes, classic portrait dimensionality.
- 何时用：Use it as the default narrative portrait when a face must have volume and still belong to a scene. Concrete beat: a diner single, body open 45 degrees, eyeline to the partner off left, both eyes sharp. Do not use it when concealment is the point; rotate to Profile.
- 近似对比：Profile, Eye Level, Over-the-Shoulder Coverage, Fourth Wall, Interview, ProfileStatue, secrecy, or a nose as architecture., Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it., High AngleVulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room.
  Profile is 90 degrees, one ear, far eye gone. Eye Level is how high the camera sits; three-quarter is how the head is turned. Over-the-Shoulder Coverage often holds a three-quarter far face with a near shoulder chewing the frame. A full-front look into lens is Fourth Wall or an Interview eyeline, not three-quarter. ProfileStatue, secrecy, or a nose as architecture. Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it. High AngleVulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room.
- 片中实例：Heat's diner encounter parks two faces in three-quarter so each man remains a full head while screen direction stays clean. Classical portrait coverage from studio-era close-ups through drawing-room films uses the same 45-degree turn to model a cheek.；Borrow the yaw and the two eyes, not a copied booth.
- Prompt 模板：`Add: both eyes visible, far cheek receding, not a true profile, not looking into the lens. Specify height separately (eye-level three-quarter, and so on).`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the turn in degrees and keep both eyes. Quote: Three-quarter angle on [Subject], face turned about 45 degrees, classic portrait dimensionality.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Profile (too much turn) or a passport front (too little). Tell: far eye gone, or both ears equally seen. Fix: about 45 degrees, both irises, one ear dominant. The other failure is calling a Low Angle a three-quarter. Pitch is not yaw; say both.

### Reverse Angle
- 别名：Delayed object of the look, Restricted coverage ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/reverse-angle)
- 定义：A reverse-angle shot views the same spatial relationship from the opposing side, completing the axis of a look, a dialogue, or a standoff. Geography flips; the 180-degree line is respected so screen direction still matches.
- 叙事功能：Someone looks. The reverse is who or what occupies the other pole. In a diner, it is the other booth. In a gunfight, it is the other holster. Matching size and height keeps the cut from feeling like a new scene. The reverse can be a clean Single or an Over-the-Shoulder Coverage; the name is the axis, not the foreground shoulder. Withholding the reverse is a different editorial choice: a look, a reaction, and no answering view. The Blair Witch Project and Rosemary's Baby live on that denial. The reverse-angle shot itself is the answering camera, not the refusal of it.
- 怎么拍：Hold the 180-line. Move the camera to the opposite side of the axis, still on the same side of the line, and match lens height to the new subject (sit versus stand, adult versus child). Match shot size to the outgoing picture unless the cut is meant to punch. Eyelines must cross the same empty air. Prompt: reverse angle, opposing view of the dialogue or standoff, 180-line respected, geography flipping.
- 何时用：Use it to complete the axis: show who they were looking at. Concrete beat: after a look across a table, the matching-size single of the other person, eyeline opposing. Do not fire the reverse when the scene's power is the withheld object of the look.
- 近似对比：Over-the-Shoulder Coverage, Single, Point of View, Eye Level, Profile, Over-the-Shoulder CoverageDefault dialogue coverage with spatial glue., Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it., High AngleVulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room.
  Over-the-Shoulder Coverage is a composition often used as the reverse, with a near shoulder; a reverse can also be a clean Single. Point of View shows what they see, which may not be a face. Eye Level may match on both sides, but the reverse is the opposing camera, not a height. Profile two-shots can reverse into opposing profiles. Over-the-Shoulder CoverageDefault dialogue coverage with spatial glue. Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it. High AngleVulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room.
- 片中实例：Heat's diner keeps clear opposing screen directions on two three-quarter singles. The Good, the Bad and the Ugly builds the cemetery standoff from answering views along one axis.；The Shining's red-bathroom talk uses startling opposing spatial views. Neighbors (1920) is an early lesson in preserving orientation across reverses.；The Blair Witch Project 1999Characters' reactions and restricted recorded views withhold much of the threat.；Rosemary's Baby 1968Partial views and delayed information keep the spectator outside complete knowledge.；Heat 1995The diner encounter maintains clear opposing screen directions.；Neighbors 1920Editing preserves the action's spatial orientation.
- Prompt 模板：`Close-up of a caretaker opening a basement door just outside frame. Her expression changes as she sees something below, but hold on her face and the dark edge of the doorway. A quiet mechanical clicking comes from downstairs. Never cut to what she sees during this shot.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Describe both poles even if you generate one still. Quote: Reverse angle on [Subject], the opposing view of a dialogue or standoff, 180-line respected, geography flipping.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a new setup that crosses the line or changes size for no reason. Tell: both faces look camera-right, or a wide answering a choker. Fix: opposing eyelines, matched height and size, 180-line held. The other mix-up is Point of View: an empty doorway they were watching is a POV, not a reverse on the other person.

### Trunk Shot
- 别名：View from inside a container ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/trunk-shot)
- 定义：A trunk shot places the camera inside a car trunk or similar confined pit, looking up at the people who open it, with the lid and rim framing their downward looks. It is a located low viewpoint, not a generic look-up in a parking lot.
- 叙事功能：The audience is the object or the concealed body. Two faces appear over a bright lid; they look down at us; the dark rim eats the edges. Power and curiosity swap: the standing people have the height, the camera has the secret. Tarantino's crime grammar made the car trunk a signature, but any container (a crate, an instrument case) can host the same physics. A Low Angle on a street has no lid. A Worm's-Eye View on a tower has no one looking into the lens. If you cannot see the opening, you do not have the shot.
- 怎么拍：Put a low camera in a trunk, a box, or an open-bottom set piece. Keep the container edge in frame on several sides. Stage the lid's movement and aim the actors' eyelines at the same interior point. Daylight or a parking-lamp key from above is motivated by the open lid; the interior stays in shadow. Prompt: trunk shot looking up from inside a car trunk or confined pit, rim framing the faces.
- 何时用：Use it when someone is in the trunk, or when the reveal should come from inside a container. Concrete beat: two people pop a lid and lean in, looking down at the lens, dark rim against a bright sky. Do not use it as a decorative low-angle on standing gangsters with no car.
- 近似对比：Low Angle, Worm's-Eye View, Object POV, Point of View, Low AnglePower, monument, or intimidation., Worm's-Eye ViewThe subject is a tower. You are dust., Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
  Low Angle looks up without a container. Worm's-Eye View looks up at architecture from the dirt. Object POV can live inside a thing, but usually as the thing moving through the world, not as people opening it. Point of View of a bound captive can coincide with a trunk shot when the occupant is a character we have already met. Low AnglePower, monument, or intimidation. Worm's-Eye ViewThe subject is a tower. You are dust. Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
- 片中实例：Pulp Fiction views Jules and Vincent from inside the car trunk as they look down. Reservoir Dogs stages the same downward look into an open trunk.；Kill Bill and From Dusk Till Dawn reuse the pit-and-lid grammar. Borrow the rim, the lid, and the eyelines into the box.；Reservoir Dogs 1992Characters are seen looking down into the open trunk.；Pulp Fiction 1994Jules and Vincent are viewed from inside the car trunk.
- Prompt 模板：`From inside an old wooden instrument case, look upward as two conservators open the lid and lean over it. The dark case rim frames their faces against a bright workshop ceiling. Clear lid movement, coherent downward eyelines, no camera rise or reveal of the observer.`
- 示例 Prompt：`The rim is mandatory. Quote: Trunk shot looking up at [Subject] from inside a car trunk or similar confined pit, playful low-angle signature.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a generic Low Angle in a driveway. Tell: full standing bodies, no lid, no rim, horizon of a parking lot. Fix: inside the trunk, rim in frame, faces leaning over an opening, downward eyelines. If the camera floats up and reveals the observer, you left the container.

### Hip Level
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/hip-level)
- 定义：A hip-level shot sits the camera around belt or holster height so hands, gait, and weapons share the plane of focus. It is a height choice, usually with a level horizon: the hands will decide.
- 叙事功能：Westerns minted it because a draw happens at the belt. The face is still in the upper frame, but the story is in the fingers, the buckle, the coat hem at the wrist. Tension reads before anyone looks up. Crime films stole the height for a gun that might come out during a talk. It is not a Cowboy Shot, which is a frame size from mid-thigh up and can be taken from eye height. It is not a Low Angle unless you also pitch up. Hip-level can stay level and still make the holster the equator of the picture.
- 怎么拍：Pedestal to belt height on a standing adult (roughly 90 to 110 cm). Keep roll level. A slight look-up is optional; a true hip-level often aims through the hands toward the far figure. Depth of field should hold the holster and the facing body. A wider lens at this height will stretch legs; a longer lens compresses the standoff. Prompt: hip-level camera, gunbelt height, hands and holster in the plane of focus.
- 何时用：Use it when the hands will decide: a standoff, a pocketed weapon, a key passed at waist height. Concrete beat: two standing figures, belts in a line, fingers idle near leather. Do not use it when the face is the only event; rise to Shoulder Level or Eye Level.
- 近似对比：Cowboy Shot, Ground Level, Low Angle, Shoulder Level, Eye Level, Cowboy ShotShow hands, weapons, or stance without going full body., Ground LevelStart from the dirt., Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
  Cowboy Shot crops mid-thigh as a size; hip-level is where the lens sits. Ground Level is on the dirt and privileges boots. Low Angle pitches up for monument. Shoulder Level is a walking companion, closer to the face. Eye Level ignores the belt. Cowboy ShotShow hands, weapons, or stance without going full body. Ground LevelStart from the dirt. Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
- 片中实例：The Good, the Bad and the Ugly keeps holsters and hands alive in the line of the lens during standoffs. No Country for Old Men works at belt and pocket height so a captured bolt pistol is as present as a face.；Borrow the height of the hands, not a copied desert.
- Prompt 模板：`Add: horizon through the hands, level roll, face still in the upper frame, not a worm's-eye, not mid-thigh crop unless you also want a cowboy size.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name belt height, not low camera. Quote: Hip-level camera on [Subject], gunbelt height, Western stance, hands and holster in the plane of focus.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Low Angle power tilt or a Cowboy Shot from standing eye height. Tell: nostrils and ceiling, or a mid-thigh crop taken from above the chest. Fix: camera at belt, looking through the hands, horizon level. If only boots are sharp, you dropped to Ground Level.

### Shoulder Level
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/shoulder-level)
- 定义：A shoulder-level camera sits slightly below the eyes, at the height of a walking companion. It is less formal than true Eye Level and less monumental than a Low Angle; the face is still the target, seen from the deltoid rather than the pupil.
- 叙事功能：You stay with a mover without dropping into chaotic Handheld grammar. The lens is where another body would be: beside them on a street, a few inches low, able to take a bump. Hurt Locker bomb walks and Goodfellas nightclub approaches often live in this band because the camera can travel as a person would. It is not Over-the-Shoulder Coverage. OTS is a foreground shoulder of a different body. Shoulder-level can be a clean Single or a Follow Shot with no near shoulder at all. The name is pedestal height.
- 怎么拍：Set the camera at clavicle or deltoid height, typically 5 to 20 cm below the subject's eyes. Keep the horizon close to level; a tiny look-up is natural from this height and should not grow into a power tilt. A 35mm is a common walking companion. Stabilization (Steadicam, Gimbal Shot) keeps the height without adding shake as style. Prompt: shoulder-level camera, slightly below the eyes, walking companion's view.
- 何时用：Use it to stay with a mover as a companion, especially through rooms and streets. Concrete beat: walking a few feet off a soldier or a host, lens at their shoulder, face readable, floor not dominating. Do not use it as a substitute for messy handheld, and do not call an OTS this unless the only fact you mean is height.
- 近似对比：Eye Level, Hip Level, Low Angle, Over-the-Shoulder Coverage, Point of View, Follow Shot, Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it., High AngleVulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room., Low AnglePower, monument, or intimidation.
  Eye Level matches the pupils and reads as equal portrait. Hip Level drops to the belt. Low Angle pitches up on purpose. Over-the-Shoulder Coverage includes a near person's shoulder; shoulder-level need not. Point of View removes the companion and becomes the mover's eyes. Follow Shot is the path; shoulder-level is the height of that path. Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it. High AngleVulnerability, surveillance, or a map of a room. Low AnglePower, monument, or intimidation.
- 片中实例：The Hurt Locker often stays at soldier height through streets and rooms so the walk is shared, not observed from a balcony. Goodfellas' Copacabana approach rides at companion height through the kitchen: we arrive with Henry, not as his eyes and not as a crane.；Borrow the pedestal, not the whole tracking route.
- Prompt 模板：`Separate height from move. Quote: Shoulder-level camera on [Subject], slightly below the eyes, a walking companion's view, less formal than true eye-level.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Add: horizon nearly level, not a low-angle, no foreground shoulder unless you also want OTS. For video, one follow at that height, no tour.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is true Eye Level (too high and formal) or a Low Angle (too much pitch). Tell: matched pupils, or a ceiling grab. Fix: camera at the shoulder, slight look-up at most, companion distance. If a blurry shoulder of another actor eats the frame, you wrote OTS. If hands of the subject enter as if we were them, you wrote First-Person.

### First-Person
- 别名：FPV character, subjective camera ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/first-person)
- 定义：A first-person camera makes the lens function as a character's bodily viewpoint, with a body that owns it: hands entering the frame, breath, tools, locomotion. It is subjective seeing as continuous embodiment, not a single optical insert.
- 叙事功能：The audience is the character for a stretch of time. Lady in the Lake tries to tell a detective story this way. Hardcore Henry runs it as an action body. Enter the Void keeps the camera inside a consciousness that still has a path through rooms. Hands, a steering wheel, a gun, a door handled at the edge: those are the tells that a person, not an invisible observer, is looking. A Point of View shot can be one cut of what they see, clean of the owner. First-person keeps the owner as a felt body. Object POV parents the camera to a prop instead. SnorriCam looks at their face from their chest, which is the opposite ownership.
- 怎么拍：Parent the camera to the character's head or upper chest with a human field of view (roughly 24mm to 35mm spherical, not a tiny action-cam unless that is diegetic). Allow hands, shoulders at the extreme edge, or a tool to enter. Add breath and footfall as camera motion only as much as a body would. Do not show the owner's face except in glass.
