Prompt: first-person camera as [Subject] would see, hands entering frame, breath, a body that owns the lens.
- 何时用：Use it when the audience must be the character, not merely glance as them. Concrete beat: running a wet overpass, gloved hands hitting the rail, breath in the cold, no face of the runner. Do not use it for a two-shot argument; you will lose the listener.
- 近似对比：Point of View, Object POV, Over-the-Shoulder Coverage, Fourth Wall, SnorriCam, Point of ViewForce identification. The audience is the character., SnorriCamTrap the audience in a body that cannot get out., Object POVThe prop has eyes.
  Point of View is the optical slice of the seen world, often an insert after a look, owner body forbidden. Object POV is a ball, a bullet, a phone, a vehicle. Over-the-Shoulder Coverage keeps us behind someone we can still see. Fourth Wall has them look at us. SnorriCam bolts the camera to the torso and stares at their face while the world slides. Point of ViewForce identification. The audience is the character. SnorriCamTrap the audience in a body that cannot get out. Object POVThe prop has eyes.
- 片中实例：Hardcore Henry keeps the body in the lens: hands, weapons, impacts. Enter the Void rides a consciousness through space after the body is gone, still as a moving first-person path.；Lady in the Lake (1947) attempts extended first-person detective storytelling, other characters addressing the lens as Marlowe. Use those as embodiment grammar.
- Prompt 模板：`Video: First-person view moving as [Subject] moves, hands or tools entering the edges. Add: no owner's face except a reflection, eye height of that person, not a drone, not an OTS shoulder.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Require a body at the edges. Quote: First-person camera as [Subject] would see, hands entering frame, breath, a body that owns the lens.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a clean Point of View plate (no hands) or a Follow Shot behind the actor. Tell: a back of a head, or a perfectly disembodied lock-off of a room. Fix: hands or a tool in frame, motion as a walk or a turn of the head, owner invisible as a face. If the camera is bolted to a car hood with chrome in frame, you wanted Object POV.

### Fourth Wall
- 别名：Narration, Subjective verbal commentary ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/fourth-wall)
- 定义：A fourth-wall look aims the subject's eyes into the taking lens, so the scene admits an audience. The camera is no longer an invisible observer; it is a person in the room, or the spectator the character has decided to include.
- 叙事功能：Theatre named the fourth wall; film breaks it when a Ferris explains the day to us, when a killer in Funny Games checks whether we are still complicit, when Alvy steps out of Annie Hall to argue. The eyeline is the mechanism. Everything else in the shot can stay naturalistic. The turn is the look into glass. It is not Point of View (we see what they see). It is not a diary voiceover laid over a face that never finds the lens (Taxi Driver's narration can run without a break). It is close to Interview, except interview eyeline is usually just off-lens, to a listener, while fourth-wall treats us as the partner.
- 怎么拍：Place the camera at the subject's eye height and put their eyeline in the center of the taking lens (or a marked pupil on the matte box). Keep the rest of the blocking honest so the look is the only rupture. A slight Eye Level three-quarter that then turns into the glass can stage the break as a decision. Prompt: fourth-wall look, eyes into the lens, the scene admitting an audience.
- 何时用：Use it when they know we are here: a plan explained to us, a dare, a confession that includes the spectator. Concrete beat: a character pauses in a room, finds the lens, and continues the line to us. Do not sprinkle random winks; the break has to change the contract of the scene.
- 近似对比：Point of View, First-Person, Interview, Profile, Reverse Angle, Point of ViewForce identification. The audience is the character., InterviewSomeone is answering a question we did not hear., Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
  Point of View inhabits their look into the world. First-Person is their body seeing; other people may look at camera as if at that body, which is diegetic address, not a break. Interview aims just off-lens to an offscreen questioner. Profile looks away. Reverse Angle answers another character, not us. Point of ViewForce identification. The audience is the character. InterviewSomeone is answering a question we did not hear. Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
- 片中实例：Ferris Bueller's Day Off lets Ferris comment on his own behavior directly to viewers. Funny Games uses looks (and more) to implicate the spectator.；Annie Hall lets Alvy address the audience and step outside ordinary scene realism. The Office glances at the lens as documentary embarrassment, a softer cousin of the same eyeline.；Taxi Driver 1976Travis's diary-like narration frames his view of the city.；Badlands 1973Holly's narration creates distance from the events being shown.；Ferris Bueller's Day Off 1986Ferris explains and comments on his behavior directly to viewers.；Annie Hall 1977Alvy addresses the audience and steps outside ordinary scene realism.
- Prompt 模板：`A meticulous traveler narrates how carefully she plans every journey while the images show her repeatedly improvising: borrowing a map, following a stranger's gesture and boarding at the last moment. Write restrained original narration that reveals self-image through contradiction rather than explaining visible actions.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Add: both eyes to camera, eye-level, not a profile, not looking just off-lens as in an interview. If they were in a scene with others, say the others do not look at camera unless that is the joke.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Interview (eyeline off-lens) or a Point of View of another character (someone looking at the first-person body). Tell: they look past the camera, or we see what they see instead of their eyes. Fix: pupils on the lens, address to the audience. Voiceover without a look is narration, not this shot.

### Object POV
- 别名：Vehicle-mounted perspective, Rigid object attachment ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/object-pov)
- 定义：An object-POV shot is the viewpoint of a tool, a ball, a bullet, a phone, or a vehicle: the prop has eyes. The camera is parented to that object, so the object stays stable in the frame while the world moves relative to it.
- 叙事功能：Agency leaves the invisible observer and goes to a machine or a thing. A fork of a bicycle stays in the corner while cobbles rush. A car body is fixed and the desert tears past. A phone slides across a table toward a face. Sports broadcasts have lived here for decades (puck, stump, helmet). The motion is tactile because the mount cannot independently decide to drift. It is not First-Person, which is a human body with hands and breath. It is not a free drone that happens to start near a prop. If the anchor object wanders inside the frame, the parent is broken.
- 怎么拍：Use a professionally secured mount or a rigid virtual parent transform on the named object. Include a visible part of the anchor (barrel, rubber, chrome, glass edge). Preserve vibration that belongs to the object; do not add a second operator path. Lens choice is often wide because the mount is close. Prompt: object POV as if [Subject] were seen from a tool, a ball, a bullet, a phone: the thing looking.
- 何时用：Use it when the prop has eyes: a weapon, a vehicle, a thrown thing, a camera that is diegetic. Concrete beat: viewpoint from a phone sliding toward a face, the phone's bezel fixed at the frame edge. Do not use it as a pretty fly-around that ignores the object.
- 近似对比：First-Person, Point of View, Locked-On, Trunk Shot, FPV Drone, First-PersonThe audience is the character., Point of ViewForce identification. The audience is the character., Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
  First-Person is a human body owning the lens. Point of View is a character's optical insert, usually without a gadget rim. Locked-On glues a subject in frame while the world streams; object-POV is looking from the object, often with the object as foreground. Trunk Shot is a pit people open, not a tool in flight. FPV Drone is a flying body of its own. First-PersonThe audience is the character. Point of ViewForce identification. The audience is the character. Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
- 片中实例：Mad Max: Fury Road keeps parts of pursuing machines fixed while the desert tears past. Leviathan (2012) mounts cameras on fishing equipment and bodies at sea so the work, not an observer, sees.；Sports broadcasts use puck and vehicle mounts as the same grammar. Hardcore Henry inserts gadget viewpoints inside an otherwise human first-person film.；Mad Max: Fury Road 2015Vehicle-mounted views keep parts of the pursuing machines fixed while the desert tears past.；Leviathan 2012Cameras move with fishing equipment and bodies at sea.
- Prompt 模板：`Camera rigidly attached beside the front fork of an old bicycle, looking ahead. The fork stays fixed in the lower-left frame while cobblestones rush beneath and street corners swing with the steering. Real wheel rotation and restrained mechanical vibration; no detached drone movement.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: Viewpoint of an object moving toward or around [Subject]. Add: a visible piece of the anchor object locked in the foreground, rigid mount, world moving, no detached drone path.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is First-Person (human hands) or a free-flying camera. Tell: breath and fingers, or the phone drifting around inside the shot. Fix: parent the camera to the named prop, show the prop's edge, keep that edge locked. If people open a lid and look in, you wanted Trunk Shot.

### Incline
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/camera-angles/incline)
- 定义：An incline is a slight camera roll, a gentle cant of the floor rather than a full Dutch angle. The horizon is a few degrees off true, enough to suggest slope or unease without declaring that the world has fallen over.
- 叙事功能：A full Dutch Angle at 20 to 30 degrees is a statement: the axis is broken. Incline is the whisper. Hallways that should feel 6 to 12 degrees wrong, a street that might be hill or might be mind, a conversation that is not yet a crisis. If the viewer can measure a lean at a glance, you probably overshot into Dutch. It is still roll, not pitch. A camera looking up a real hill with a level bubble is not an incline; the floor is actually sloped and the frame is true. Incline cheats gravity in the head, not in the set.
- 怎么拍：Roll the camera a small amount, typically about 5 to 12 degrees, and lock it. Keep architecture readable and bodies upright in the world; only the frame is off. Do not combine with a wide fisheye or the small cant disappears into distortion. Contrast with a level reverse if you want the incline to be felt. Prompt: inclined camera, a gentle cant, not a full Dutch, the floor suggesting slope or unease.
- 何时用：Use it when a full Dutch is too much and the floor should only suggest slope or unease. Concrete beat: a hotel corridor, 8 degrees of roll, wallpaper still a grid, a person walking toward camera. Do not use it as a substitute for building a real ramp, and do not park at 25 degrees and call it gentle.
- 近似对比：Dutch Angle, Dutch Roll, Camera Roll, Eye Level, Low Angle, High Angle, Dutch AngleThe world is off its axis. Do not use as decoration., Dutch RollUnease that arrives in time, not as a still cant., Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
  Dutch Angle is the full cant, often 20 to 30 degrees, moral or mental tilt as a graphic. Dutch Roll and Camera Roll move on this axis over time. Eye Level with a level bubble is the control. Low Angle and High Angle are pitch, not roll. A real inclined set photographed level is production design, not this technique. Dutch AngleThe world is off its axis. Do not use as decoration. Dutch RollUnease that arrives in time, not as a still cant. Eye LevelDefault honesty. Do not look down or up unless you mean it.
- 片中实例：The Third Man contains a range of cants; the shallower ones are closer to incline, the harder leans are Dutch. Do the Right Thing similarly varies the amount of roll on confrontations rather than using one angle for every street.；Use degree of roll as a dimmer, not as a single switch.
- Prompt 模板：`Add: rolled about 8 degrees, horizon slightly off, walls not warped, static, not 25 degrees. If the model still produces a comic lean, lower the number and say almost level.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Give a small number. Quote: Inclined camera on [Subject], a gentle cant, not a full Dutch, the floor suggesting slope or unease.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a full Dutch Angle. Tell: diagonal horizon you could hang a picture on, 25-plus degrees, poster unease. Fix: 5 to 12 degrees, almost level, a hint of slope. The other failure is pitching up or down and calling it incline. Check the roll axis: left-right tilt of the horizon, not looking at the ceiling.

**速查**：Three-Point Lighting · Key Light · Fill Light · Backlight · Rim Light · Kicker · Hair Light · Eye Light · High-Key Lighting · Low-Key Lighting · Chiaroscuro · Rembrandt Lighting · Butterfly Lighting · Loop Lighting · Split Lighting · Short Lighting · Broad Lighting · Silhouette · Motivated Lighting · Practical Lighting · Available Light · Naturalistic Ambient · Bounce Light · Hard Light · Soft Light · Side Lighting · Top Light · Underlighting · Cross Lighting · Window Light · Candlelight · Neon Practicals · Golden Hour · Blue Hour · Dappled Light · Gobo Lighting · Volumetric Light · Cameo Lighting · Epiphany · Spotlight · Glam

### Three-Point Lighting
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/three-point-lighting)
- 定义：Three-point lighting, the basic three point lighting setup, places a key, a fill, and a backlight so a face is modeled from one dominant side, opened in the shadows, and separated from the background. The key is brightest and sets direction; fill and back exist only as ratios against it.
- 叙事功能：In a scene it is the default portrait grammar: the audience can read both eyes, the cheekbones have a light side and a shadow side, and the hair does not melt into the wall. Classical coverage uses it so reverse shots match, and so a close-up still feels like the same room as the master. It is the wrong tool when the room already has a single honest source, or when the story wants a face half-erased. Teaching the setup is useful. Leaving it on every night interior as three hidden movie lights is how a crime scene starts to look like a cosmetics ad.
- 怎么拍：Place the key about 45 degrees off camera axis and 30 to 45 degrees above the eyes, large enough to be slightly soft unless the scene is harsh. 5 to 3 stops down so the shadow cheek still has pores. Put backlight high and behind, often slightly opposite the key, warm or white, flagged so it rims hair and shoulders without flaring the lens. Prompt: Classic three-point lighting on [Subject]: key at 45 degrees, soft fill opening shadows, warm backlight rim, modeled volume.
- 何时用：Use it for a teachable talking-head or a studio close-up that must stay readable across a whole scene. Do not use it as the only language of a night interior that is supposed to be one lamp.
- 近似对比：Key light, Fill light, Backlight, Rembrandt lighting, loop lighting, Key LightDecide where the world is lit from. Everything else follows., Fill LightControl how much of the dark you can still read., BacklightSeparate a dark figure from a dark world.
  Key light is the dominant source inside this setup, not the setup itself. Fill light only opens the key's shadows; it has no third direction. Backlight is the rear unit that separates the figure. Rembrandt lighting and loop lighting are facial patterns you can make with the key while the other two points still exist. Key LightDecide where the world is lit from. Everything else follows. Fill LightControl how much of the dark you can still read. BacklightSeparate a dark figure from a dark world.
- 片中实例：Casablanca and Rebecca show the classical Hollywood version: key, fill, and a hair or back edge kept in ratio so stars stay modeled in every size. Use that grammar, not a poster to copy.；Later films keep the three jobs even when the units are hidden in practicals.
- Prompt 模板：`Classic three-point lighting on [Subject]: key at 45 degrees, soft fill opening shadows, warm backlight rim, sculpted dimensionality.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name all three jobs, not the word portrait. " Add key side (left or right), fill ratio, and backlight color.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not write a mood word in place of the three positions.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a single frontal soft light labeled as three-point. The tell is even cheeks, no hair edge, and a shadowless nose. Fix it by offsetting the key, dropping fill, and adding a flagged rear rim.

### Key Light
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/key-light)
- 定义：A key light in key light cinematography is the principal source that sets the subject's dominant direction, shape, and exposure. Shadows fall away from it; every other light is measured against it.
- 叙事功能：Deciding the key is deciding where the world is lit from. A window, a bare bulb, the sun, or a hidden unit standing in for those things will tell the audience what time it is and who is exposed. The rest of the plot of the lighting is contrast, color, and whether anyone else gets a face. It is the wrong tool to think of as a product. You do not add a key on top of a finished picture. If two equally bright sources fight from opposite sides, you no longer have a key. You have cross lighting or a flattened stand-off.
- 怎么拍：Pick one source and one side. Typical portrait keys sit 30 to 45 degrees off camera and above eye line; a split key sits at 90 degrees; a butterfly key sits on axis and high. Hardness follows apparent size: a small distant lamp or noon sun cuts a sharp nose shadow; a large silk or bounce wraps. Color follows the story source: daylight 5600K, tungsten around 3200K, flame nearer 1800K. Prompt: Strong directional key light on [Subject] from a single defined source, the brightest light in the frame, shadows placed as composition.
- 何时用：Use it the moment you must say which direction the scene is lit from, for example a don in an office keyed from a high practical. Do not add a second equally bright key on the other cheek.
- 近似对比：Fill light, Hard light, soft light, Three-point lighting, Motivated lighting, Fill LightControl how much of the dark you can still read., Hard LightGrit, noon sun, or interrogation., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Fill light only lifts what the key cannot reach. Hard light and soft light are qualities the key can have, not replacements for it. Three-point lighting is a system that includes a key. Motivated lighting decides whether that key could exist in the room. Fill LightControl how much of the dark you can still read. Hard LightGrit, noon sun, or interrogation. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：The Godfather often lets a high, underexposed key leave eyes in wells of shadow. Apocalypse Now uses a hard, small key on faces so the jungle night stays black.；Those films treat the key as the sentence, not as one of three equal lamps.
- Prompt 模板：`Strong directional key light on [Subject] from a single defined source, the brightest storyteller in the frame, shadows as composition.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the source and the side before any style word. " Add height (high, eye, table), hardness, and Kelvin.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is fill bright enough to become a second key. The tell is two nose highlights and no clear shadow side. Fix it by dimming or killing the fill until one direction owns exposure.

### Fill Light
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/fill-light)
- 定义：Fill light reduces contrast or adds detail in areas the key does not reach, usually from the opposite side and at a lower level. It is a ratio tool, not a second sun.
- 叙事功能：In a scene fill decides how much of the dark you can still read: the far eye, the wall, a hand in a lap. A high fill ratio (close to the key) feels open and public. A low fill ratio keeps mystery without crushing the face to a cut-out. It is the wrong tool when you want graphic black, or when bounce from the room already does the job. Adding a frontal fill because a monitor looks noisy just flattens the key you spent an hour placing.
- 怎么拍：Put fill opposite the key, larger and softer than the key so it does not cast a competing nose shadow. Control it with distance, scrim, or dimmer; common portrait ratios run from about 2:1 (gentle) to 8:1 (lean). Color is often a touch cooler or neutral versus a warm key so the shadow side does not go orange. Bounce off a wall can be the fill with no extra lamp. Prompt: Soft fill light opening the shadow side of [Subject] without flattening, a low ratio that keeps eyes alive.
- 何时用：Use it when a keyed close-up still needs the far iris and cheek pore, for example an interview after a hard window key. Do not pour fill in until both cheeks match.
- 近似对比：key light, Bounce light, High-key lighting, Eye light, Key LightDecide where the world is lit from. Everything else follows., High-Key LightingComedy, heaven, hospital, or candy., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  The key light sets direction; fill only answers it. Bounce light is a method that often becomes fill. High-key lighting uses a lot of fill across the whole frame, not a single cheek opener. Eye light is smaller still: a catchlight, not a shadow-side wash. Key LightDecide where the world is lit from. Everything else follows. High-Key LightingComedy, heaven, hospital, or candy. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Classical portrait cinematography, including close-ups in Casablanca, keeps enough fill for both eyes without erasing the key. The Age of Innocence uses soft interior fill so period rooms stay readable while lamps still feel like the source.；Borrow the ratio, not the wallpaper.
- Prompt 模板：`Soft fill light opening the shadow side of [Subject] without flattening, a low ratio that keeps eyes alive.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Say which cheek opens and how little. " Add 2:1 or 4:1 if you need a number.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not ask for bright even light if you still want a key.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a second key from camera right. The tell is a second nose shadow or a shadowless face. Fix it by making fill larger, dimmer, and shadowless, or by bouncing it.

### Backlight
- 别名：hair light when on hair, Volumetric shafts, Light beams in haze ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/backlight)
- 定义：Backlight in backlight cinematography is light coming from behind the subject toward the camera, tracing edges and lifting the figure off the background. It may stay a thin rim or, in haze, become a visible shaft.
- 叙事功能：A dark coat in a dark room disappears without an edge. Backlight draws that edge on hair, shoulders, and hat brim so the cutout reads. In rain, dust, or smoke the same rear source can turn into volume, implying a world outside the frame: a searchlight, a high window, the sun. It is the wrong tool when you need the face, not the outline. If you expose for the backlight, you get a silhouette. If you wrap it around to the cheek, you have started a kicker, not a true back.
- 怎么拍：Place the source behind and usually above, aimed toward camera, flagged so it does not flare unless you want veil. Hardness can be hard (sun, PAR, searchlight) for a sharp rim or softer for a glow in hair. Color is often warmer than the key so the edge reads as sun or tungsten. Suspended particles make the beam itself photograph; without them you only see the rim on the body. Prompt: Backlight on [Subject] from behind, rim of light tracing edges, slight veil, separation from background.
- 何时用：Use it to separate a dark figure from a dark world, as in a smoky interior with one high window behind. Do not use it as the only light on a scene that still needs a face.
- 近似对比：Rim light, Kicker, Silhouette, Volumetric light, Hair light, Rim LightGraphic silhouette with just enough flesh., SilhouetteIdentity is less important than shape., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Rim light is the thin highlight backlight can produce when tightly flagged. Kicker sits behind and to the side, kissing jaw or shoulder rather than wrapping the whole outline. Silhouette exposes for the bright ground and lets the figure go black. Volumetric light needs haze so the beam, not just the rim, is visible. Hair light is backlight aimed only at the hair. Rim LightGraphic silhouette with just enough flesh. SilhouetteIdentity is less important than shape. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Blade Runner cuts searchlights through smoky interiors so backlight becomes architecture. The Exorcist uses a powerful house light behind Merrin as he arrives.；Days of Heaven and Blade Runner 2049 keep the sun or a hard rear source as the edge that holds a figure in a bright or dusty ground.；Blade Runner 1982Searchlights and hard shafts cut through smoky interiors.；The Exorcist 1973Merrin arrives beneath the powerful light from the house.
- Prompt 模板：`A conservator enters a dark archive where one high window sends a narrow hard shaft through suspended dust. Her body briefly interrupts the beam, producing a coherent moving shadow in the haze. Deep room, restrained atmosphere, no magical glowing particles.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Put the source behind the body, not on the nose. " Name hair, coat edge, and whether haze is present.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not ask for a glowing outline sticker.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a silhouette or a neon stroke. The tell is zero facial exposure, or a cartoon ring disconnected from any lamp. Fix it by exposing a little of the key side and attaching the rim to a real rear source.

### Rim Light
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/rim-light)
- 定义：Rim lighting is a narrow edge of light, usually from a flagged backlight, that separates a subject from the background without opening the face. The highlight sits on brim, hair, and coat; flesh stays mostly dark.
- 叙事功能：The shot becomes a graphic: a profile or three-quarter figure drawn with a thread of exposure. You keep just enough flesh to know it is a person, not a paper doll. Crime, spy, and night-city work use it so a body reads against wet asphalt or a black wall. It is the wrong tool for a dialogue close-up that needs both eyes. If the rim fattens into a cheek slash, you have a kicker. If the whole figure goes empty and the sky is the subject, you have a silhouette.
- 怎么拍：Use a small hard source behind the subject, slightly off to one side, with flags or a snoot so the beam only kisses the outline. Keep it out of the lens unless you want veil. Color is often white or slightly cool against a warmer dim key, or warm against night blue. Do not wrap to the front plane of the face. Prompt: Photographic backlight on [Subject] from behind, a thin natural highlight on hat brim, hair, and coat edge, faces staying dark. Not a neon outline.
- 何时用：Use it for a graphic night figure, a spy on a roof, a coat against a black street. Do not use it when the audience must read a mouth for a line.
- 近似对比：Backlight, Kicker, Hair light, Silhouette, BacklightSeparate a dark figure from a dark world., KickerAdd a slice of glamour or menace on the far side., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Backlight is the broader rear direction; rim is the thin result. Kicker hits cheek, jaw, or shoulder as a hard side-back accent with more flesh. Hair light lights only the hair from above-behind. Silhouette removes the edge highlight and exposes for the ground instead. BacklightSeparate a dark figure from a dark world. KickerAdd a slice of glamour or menace on the far side. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Blade Runner rims figures in smoky interiors so coats and hair hold against black. Skyfall uses thin natural rims on night exteriors, faces kept dark, outlines readable.；Those are edges from sources, not stickers.
- Prompt 模板：`Forbid the cartoon stroke. Use: "Photographic backlight on [Subject] from behind, a thin natural highlight on hat brim, hair, and coat edge, faces staying dark.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Photographic backlight on [Subject] from behind, a thin natural highlight on hat brim, hair, and coat edge, faces staying dark. Not a neon outline.`
- Prompt 要点：" Name one rear lamp. Keep skin exposure low.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a neon outline or a full silhouette. The tell is a glowing closed stroke around the body, or no highlight at all. Fix it by attaching a thin highlight to hair and cloth only, from a real rear source.

### Kicker
- 别名：Kicker light ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/kicker)
- 定义：A kicker light is a relatively hard side-back accent on cheek, jaw, shoulder, or an object edge, placed behind and to one side of the subject. It is a slice, not a full wrap and not a hair-only rim.
- 叙事功能：The far plane of the face suddenly has a strip of glamour or menace. In noir it can be a streetlight kissing the jaw of someone who is otherwise in the key's shadow. In a commercial portrait it is the same physics with a kinder color: a small lamp that says the cheek has a plane. It is the wrong tool if you need an even beauty wrap, or if the accent becomes a beam shooting out of the neck. One kicker. If you add its twin on the other side you are in cross lighting.
- 怎么拍：Park a small hard source behind the subject, 30 to 60 degrees off the back axis, at about cheek height or a little above. Flag it off the camera and off the nose. Hardness should be harder than the key so the accent is a clean line. Color is often a step warmer (tungsten, amber practical) against a cooler key, or white against tungsten. Prompt: A small warm lamp behind and to the side of [Subject], a thin highlight on the far jaw and coat shoulder only. No beam shooting out of the body.
- 何时用：Use it to add a slice of glamour or menace on the far side of a keyed face, for example a jawline in a night interior. Do not fire kickers from both sides unless you want a concert edge.
- 近似对比：Rim light, Backlight, Hair light, Side lighting, Rim LightGraphic silhouette with just enough flesh., BacklightSeparate a dark figure from a dark world., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Rim light traces the whole outline and leaves the cheek darker. Backlight sits more directly behind. Hair light aims up at the hair, not the jaw. Side lighting keys the face from 90 degrees; a kicker does not become the key. Rim LightGraphic silhouette with just enough flesh. BacklightSeparate a dark figure from a dark world. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Film noir portraits, including work in the neighborhood of Double Indemnity and The Big Combo, use a hard far-side kicker on jaw and shoulder. Commercial portraiture borrowed the same accent with softer keys.；Treat those as a placement, not a costume.
- Prompt 模板：`A small warm lamp behind and to the side of [Subject], a thin highlight on the far jaw and coat shoulder only. No beam shooting out of the body.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Localize the highlight. Use: "A small warm lamp behind and to the side of [Subject], a thin highlight on the far jaw and coat shoulder only.`
- Prompt 要点：" Name left or right. Keep the key on the other side.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a rim or a light saber from the neck. The tell is a closed outline, or a shaft growing out of the shoulder. Fix it by shrinking the source, flagging it, and stopping the highlight on jaw and cloth.

### Hair Light
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/hair-light)
- 定义：A hair light is a small source behind and above the subject that lights only the top of the hair as a rim so texture separates from the background. The face stays on the key or in cooler shadow.
- 叙事功能：Black hair, black wardrobe, black set: without a hair light the head becomes a hole. The unit is a separation tool, not a beauty wash. Studio portraits and classical close-ups use it so a bun, a wave, or a wet scalp has a specular edge. It is the wrong tool when the story is a hat brim or a bald scalp you do not want to grease, or when a full backlight should wrap shoulders as well. If the lamp drops to cheek height it becomes a kicker.
- 怎么拍：Mount a small lamp high and behind, slightly opposite the key, snooted or barred so it hits hair and maybe the top of the shoulders only. Hardness is usually harder than the key so strands sparkle. Color is often a bit warmer than the face, or matching the key. Keep it out of the eyes. Prompt: A small lamp behind and above [Subject], lighting only the top of the hair as a rim. The face stays in cooler shadow.
- 何时用：Use it when dark hair would vanish into a dark wall, for example a brunette in a black interior. Do not use it as a ceiling wash that skims the forehead and noses.
- 近似对比：Backlight, Rim light, Kicker, Three-point lighting, Glam, BacklightSeparate a dark figure from a dark world., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it., Key LightDecide where the world is lit from. Everything else follows.
  Backlight can include hair but also shoulders and veil. Rim light runs the whole outline. Kicker kisses jaw, not the crown. Three-point lighting often uses a hair light as its back point. Glam may include a hair edge, but glam is a frontal beauty package. BacklightSeparate a dark figure from a dark world. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it. Key LightDecide where the world is lit from. Everything else follows.
- 片中实例：Studio portraiture and classical close-ups, including blonde and brunette work in Gentlemen Prefer Blondes and the constructed hair edges in Vertigo, keep a small rear-top unit on the hair. The face still belongs to the key.
- Prompt 模板：`Aim at the crown, not the nose. Use: "A small lamp behind and above [Subject], lighting only the top of the hair as a rim.`
- 示例 Prompt：`A small lamp behind and above [Subject], lighting only the top of the hair as a rim. The face stays in cooler shadow.`
- Prompt 要点：" Name hair color so the model does not bleach the scalp.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a full backlight or a halo. The tell is a glowing oval around the head, or forehead shine from above. Fix it by snooting the unit onto hair only and keeping the face on the key.

### Eye Light
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/eye-light)
- 定义：An eye light in eye light cinematography is a small frontal source used to put a catchlight in the irises or to lift the eyes a fraction without becoming a fill. The face can stay in shadow; the eyes remain human, not lamps.
- 叙事功能：A dark portrait dies if the sockets are empty pits with no specular. A tiny reflection of a lamp in each iris tells you there is a person looking. Crime close-ups and night interrogations use it so the audience can track thought while the room stays black. It is the wrong tool when you need to open a whole cheek (that is fill) or when the character should feel blind, dead, or monstrous. If the eyes glow, the model has turned the catchlight into an emitter.
- 怎么拍：Place a small, weak source near camera, often just above the lens, dim enough that it does not flatten the key's shadow pattern. A white card, a dim LED, or a distant practical can be enough. Color is usually white or matching the key; keep it out of the skin as much as possible. You want a pinpoint in the iris, not a beauty wash. Prompt: A dark portrait of [Subject], face mostly in shadow, a tiny white reflection of a lamp sitting in each human iris. Eyes stay brown or grey, not glowing.
- 何时用：Use it to keep a soul in a dark portrait, for example a close-up where the key leaves the eyes in wells. Do not turn the pupils into light sources.
- 近似对比：Fill light, Key light, Low-key lighting, Top light, Low-Key LightingMystery, crime, or moral night., Key LightDecide where the world is lit from. Everything else follows., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Fill light opens the whole shadow cheek. Key light shapes the face. Low-key lighting is the contrast environment that often needs an eye light. Top light without an eye light leaves sockets hollow on purpose. Low-Key LightingMystery, crime, or moral night. Key LightDecide where the world is lit from. Everything else follows. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：The Godfather sometimes withholds even this glint, which is why a tiny eye light in other Gordon Willis-adjacent close-ups feels like a choice. No Country for Old Men keeps dark rooms with human catchlights, not shining irises.；Use the physics: a reflection, not an emission.
- Prompt 模板：`Specify a reflection, not a glow. Use: "A dark portrait of [Subject], face mostly in shadow, a tiny white reflection of a lamp sitting in each human iris.`
- 示例 Prompt：`A dark portrait of [Subject], face mostly in shadow, a tiny white reflection of a lamp sitting in each human iris. Eyes stay brown or grey, not glowing.`
- Prompt 要点：" Keep the key off-axis so the rest of the face stays dark.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is fill or supernatural glowing eyes. The tell is an opened face, or irises emitting light. Fix it by dimming the frontal source to a catchlight and stating eye color as a surface.

### High-Key Lighting
- 别名：Low-contrast luminous lighting ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/high-key)
- 定义：High-key lighting, or high key lighting, uses relatively low contrast, bright exposure, and limited deep shadow so the frame stays open and readable. It is a contrast ratio, not a command to overexpose.
- 叙事功能：Comedy, heaven, hospital, and candy shops live here because the world looks safe, clean, or artificially perfect. Strong colors can still sit in a high-key frame; the shadows simply do not go to black. A sour performance inside that brightness can also prove the promise is false. It is the wrong tool for crime, night, or any beat that needs a hiding place. Bright is not the same as blown. If every surface is the same white, you lost material and face.
- 怎么拍：Use large sources, plenty of fill, and often bounce from walls and ceiling so the ratio sits near 2:1 or lower. Key can still have a side; it is just not a cliff. Protect highlight detail on skin, icing, walls. Color is often daylight-balanced or pastel-friendly, sometimes slightly cool for sterile spaces, sometimes candy-warm. Prompt: High-key lighting on [Subject], bright even illumination, minimal shadows, airy overexposure by a third, optimism or sterile future.
- 何时用：Use it for a comic interior, a showroom, a hospital, or a toy world that should feel open. Do not use it as a synonym for overexposure, and do not use it on a murder scene unless you want irony.
- 近似对比：Low-key lighting, Soft light, Glam, Cameo lighting, Soft LightBeauty, memory, or kindness., Low-Key LightingMystery, crime, or moral night., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Low-key lighting is the opposite ratio: selective light and substantial shadow. Soft light is hardness; you can have soft low-key. Glam sells a face with a large key but can still sit in a contrasty room. Cameo lighting isolates a figure in black, the reverse of an open high-key world. Soft LightBeauty, memory, or kindness. Low-Key LightingMystery, crime, or moral night. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：The Umbrellas of Cherbourg keeps brightly colored interiors openly lit so romance is artificial and clear. Barbie builds Barbieland as a carefully controlled bright world with preserved highlight detail.；2001: A Space Odyssey uses high-key Discovery spaces that stay clean rather than crushed. Marie Antoinette often lives in luminous rooms.；The Umbrellas of Cherbourg 1964Brightly colored interiors sustain an openly artificial romantic world.；Barbie 2023The bright, carefully controlled world of Barbieland.
- Prompt 模板：`A meticulously cheerful pastry shop at midday, soft broad light, luminous pastel walls and gentle shadows. The owner stands motionless while everyone else smiles. High-key image with preserved white icing texture, no blown highlights or glossy skin.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Ask for low contrast and protected whites, not a flash. " Add large sources and say highlights hold texture.`
- Prompt 要点：Avoid calling it low-key just because the genre is serious.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is overexposure or soft light in a dark room. The tell is clipped walls, or a bright face in a black void (cameo). Fix it by lowering contrast across the whole set and holding highlight detail.

### Low-Key Lighting
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/low-key)
- 定义：Low-key lighting, or low key lighting, uses high contrast, selective illumination, and substantial shadow so most of the frame can sit near black. One pool of light is often enough; the dark is designed, not an accident of underexposure.
- 叙事功能：Mystery, crime, and moral night live here because the audience cannot see the whole room. A face, a gun, a doorway gets the pool; the rest is withheld. The ratio is the story: who is visible, who is not. It is the wrong tool for comedy timing that needs both eyes, or for a location you must geography-read. Diming a fully lit office until it is muddy is not low-key. That is just a dark even room.
- 怎么拍：Place a motivated key, kill bounce with flags and black wrap, and keep fill several stops down (often 8:1 or more). Hardness is frequently hard so shadow edges stay graphic, but soft low-key exists if the source is large and still isolated. Color is often tungsten in a black room, or a single cool slash. Prompt: Low-key lighting on [Subject], most of the frame in deep shadow, one pool of light, 8:1 contrast, darkness as a designed space.
- 何时用：Use it for a crime close-up, a night office, a corridor with one practical. Do not underexpose an evenly lit room and call it low-key.
- 近似对比：Chiaroscuro, Hard light, High-key lighting, Cameo lighting, ChiaroscuroLight is moral. Darkness hides or judges., Hard LightGrit, noon sun, or interrogation., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Chiaroscuro is low-key used to model volume with a painter's moral contrast; not every low-key frame is chiaroscuro. Hard light often serves low-key but is a quality, not the ratio. High-key lighting is the opposite. Cameo lighting erases the environment entirely; low-key can still imply a room in the dark. ChiaroscuroLight is moral. Darkness hides or judges. Hard LightGrit, noon sun, or interrogation. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：The Godfather keeps offices in selective pools against the bright wedding outside. The Big Combo and Se7en use high-contrast night as a working space, not a grade slapped on a bright master.；Borrow the pool and the flags, not a grain preset.
- Prompt 模板：`Low-key lighting on [Subject], most of the frame in deep shadow, one pool of light, 8:1 contrast, noir darkness as a character.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the pool and the black. " Name the single source and forbid extra fill.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not write moody if you have not placed the lamp.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a dark high-key (everything dimmed equally) or crushed blacks with no face. The tell is no key direction. Fix it by placing one source and flagging spill, then exposing for that pool.

### Chiaroscuro
- 别名：Selective darkness, Clair-obscur ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/chiaroscuro)
- 定义：Chiaroscuro lighting uses strong light-dark contrast to model volume and to create moral, psychological, or dramatic tension. Darkness withholds; the lit plane is what the scene will admit.
- 叙事功能：A single warm source, a face turning into light, the rest of the room falling away: the audience reads character as a matter of what remains visible. Tenebrism is the hard end of this, where everything beyond arm's reach is black. Crime, period night, and religious doubt all use the same physics. It is the wrong tool for a wide that must describe architecture, or for comedy that needs a second face in the shadows. Underexposing an even room is not chiaroscuro. You have to place a key and let falloff do the cutting.
- 怎么拍：Place one motivated key (window, lamp, candle), reduce fill, and flag spill. The key is often warm, slightly high, and small enough to fall off fast. Hardness can be moderately hard so planes of the face turn quickly. Keep enough separation that eyes and hands in the pool stay legible. Prompt: Chiaroscuro lighting on [Subject], Caravaggio tenebrism, a single warm source, everything beyond arm's reach falling into black.
- 何时用：Use it when light is moral and darkness hides or judges, for example a confession across a desk lamp. Do not use it as a global grade on a daylight street.
- 近似对比：Low-key lighting, Rembrandt lighting, Cameo lighting, Hard light, Low-Key LightingMystery, crime, or moral night., Rembrandt LightingClassic dramatic portrait., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Low-key lighting is the broader contrast strategy; chiaroscuro insists on modeled volume, not just a dark frame. Rembrandt lighting is a specific cheek-triangle pattern that often lives inside chiaroscuro. Cameo lighting isolates against void and may flatten the world to a stage cutout. Hard light helps the cut but is not required if falloff is steep. Low-Key LightingMystery, crime, or moral night. Rembrandt LightingClassic dramatic portrait. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：The Godfather's dark office against the wedding outside is textbook withholding. The Third Man uses Vienna night so figures appear and vanish in designed dark.；Barry Lyndon and The Night of the Hunter both let a single source model faces while the room dies.；The Godfather 1972The Don's dark office contrasts with the wedding outside.；The Third Man 1949Vienna's night streets and hidden figures.
- Prompt 模板：`A tailor listens to an uneasy visitor in a dim back room. One high window shapes half the tailor's face; the rest falls into deep but readable shadow. Warm desk practical in the distance, no even beauty fill, no crushed featureless blacks.`
- Prompt 要点：One source, fast falloff, modeled planes. " Name the lamp. / Forbid extra fill and even ambient.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is muddy underexposure. The tell is no key direction and featureless blacks. Fix it by placing one warm source, flagging bounce, and exposing the lit planes.

### Rembrandt Lighting
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/rembrandt)
- 定义：Rembrandt lighting, in rembrandt lighting terms, is a portrait pattern in which the key sits high and about 45 degrees off axis so the nose shadow joins the shadow cheek, leaving a small triangle of light under the shadow-side eye. The rest of that cheek stays dark.
- 叙事功能：The face becomes a painting with one lit plane and a pocket of light that proves the far eye still exists. Drama likes it because the head has volume without the graphic half-and-half of a split. Period interiors and serious close-ups use it when the key could be a high window or a lamp. It is the wrong tool for a beauty close-up that should open both cheeks evenly, or for a character you want fully public. If the nose shadow does not connect to the cheek shadow, you have loop lighting, not Rembrandt.
- 怎么拍：Put a moderately hard or softly hard key high and roughly 45 degrees to one side, high enough that the nose shadow falls down and across until it meets the cheek shadow. The triangle sits below the far eye and should not spill across the whole far cheek. Fill is low or absent. Color follows the source: warm interior, cooler window. Short lighting (key on the far cheek) is the usual pairing. Prompt: Key light high and 45 degrees on [Subject], the near cheek in light, a small triangle of light on the shadow-side cheek, the rest of that cheek dark.
- 何时用：Use it for a classic dramatic portrait, a period close-up, a bargainer across a table. Do not use it when you need an even glamour wrap or a literal half-lit mask.
- 近似对比：Loop lighting, Split lighting, Butterfly lighting, Chiaroscuro, Bounce light, Motivated lighting, Loop LightingNatural portrait that is still shaped., ChiaroscuroLight is moral. Darkness hides or judges., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Loop lighting makes a small nose shadow that does not connect to the cheek shadow. Split lighting keys at 90 degrees and divides the face in half with no triangle. Butterfly lighting puts the key on axis, high, with a shadow under the nose, both cheeks open. Chiaroscuro is the larger contrast language this pattern often sits in. Bounce light would wrap the triangle away. Motivated lighting can create Rembrandt if the window sits in that high 45, but motivated is a justification, not this pattern. Loop LightingNatural portrait that is still shaped. ChiaroscuroLight is moral. Darkness hides or judges. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Fanny and Alexander uses painterly window keys that often land in this triangle. Road to Perdition, with Conrad Hall's portrait work, leans on Rembrandt-like faces in dark interiors.；Use the cheek geometry, not a still to duplicate.
- Prompt 模板：`Key light high and 45 degrees on [Subject], the near cheek in light, a small triangle of light on the shadow-side cheek, the rest of that cheek dark.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Demand the triangle by name. " Say the nose shadow connects to the cheek shadow.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid a half-and-half split.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is loop or split. The tell is a floating nose comma that never meets the cheek, or a face divided down the center with no triangle. Fix it by raising and swinging the key until the shadows join, leaving a small lit triangle under the far eye.

### Butterfly Lighting
- 别名：Paramount lighting ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/butterfly-lighting)
- 定义：Butterfly lighting, also called Paramount lighting, places the key high and on the camera axis so a small butterfly-shaped shadow falls under the nose on the philtrum. Both cheeks stay open; both eyes take light.
- 叙事功能：This is beauty lighting with a structure: cheekbones lift, the nose has a tidy shadow, and the face stays symmetrical for the lens. Classical glamour portraits used it because a star looking into camera still has modeling, not a flat flash. It is the wrong tool for a liar in half-light, a bruised antihero, or anyone whose story is asymmetry. If you swing the key off axis, the butterfly becomes a loop. If you raise it to the ceiling and kill the frontal component, you get top light sockets.
- 怎么拍：Center a large or medium source above the lens, aimed down at the face, high enough for the under-nose shadow but not so high the eye sockets collapse. A reflector under the chin is optional fill. Hardness is usually soft to medium so skin wraps. Color is often tungsten or daylight beauty-neutral, not a green overhead. Prompt: Key light high and centered on [Subject]'s face, a small shadow under the nose on the philtrum, both eyes open, glamour portrait.
- 何时用：Use it for a glamour close-up, a singer facing camera, a studio beauty still. Do not use it on a crime profile that should be short-lit.
- 近似对比：Loop lighting, Rembrandt lighting, Glam, High-key lighting, Top light, Loop LightingNatural portrait that is still shaped., High-Key LightingComedy, heaven, hospital, or candy., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Loop lighting moves the key slightly off axis so the nose shadow slides toward the mouth corner. Rembrandt lighting is further off and higher, with a cheek triangle. Glam is the broader beauty package (diffusion, catchlights) that often uses butterfly but does not have to. High-key lighting is frame contrast, not this nose-shadow pattern. Top light is overhead enough to bury the eyes. Loop LightingNatural portrait that is still shaped. High-Key LightingComedy, heaven, hospital, or candy. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Classic Hollywood glamour, including Paramount-style portraits and films such as Gilda and Shanghai Express, parks the key high and frontal so the butterfly sits under the nose. The face stays a product the camera can sell.
- Prompt 模板：`Key light high and centered on [Subject]'s face, a small shadow under the nose on the philtrum, both eyes open, glamour portrait.`
- Prompt 要点：Keep the key on center and high. " Forbid a shadow cheek. / Mention both eyes taking light.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is loop or top light. The tell is a nose shadow that leans to one side, or hollow eyes. Fix it by centering the key and lowering it until sockets open and the butterfly sits on the philtrum.

### Loop Lighting
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/loop-lighting)
- 定义：Loop lighting creates a small nose shadow that loops toward the corner of the mouth and does not connect to the cheek shadow. The key sits slightly off axis and a little high, a middle step between butterfly and Rembrandt.
- 叙事功能：The face is shaped but still friendly: interviews, earnest close-ups, people we are supposed to trust. You get a hint of cheek shadow and a definite nose, without the painterly triangle or the glamour butterfly. It is the wrong tool when you need a mask of light and dark, or a fashion-symmetric face. If that loop grows until it joins the cheek, you have crossed into Rembrandt. If you center the key, you are back at butterfly.
- 怎么拍：Offset the key about 30 to 45 degrees from the nose, slightly above eye line, softness medium so the loop is a clean comma, not a smear. Fill can sit opposite at a gentle ratio (2:1 to 4:1). Color is usually the room: window daylight or soft tungsten. The shadow-side cheek still receives some light; that is the difference from Rembrandt. Prompt: Loop lighting on [Subject], key slightly off-axis, a small loop shadow from the nose toward the corner of the mouth.
- 何时用：Use it for a natural portrait that is still shaped, an interview, a two-shot that should not look lit. Do not use it when you want a cheek triangle or a half-face cut.
- 近似对比：Rembrandt lighting, Butterfly lighting, Split lighting, Bounce, Motivated lighting, Rembrandt LightingClassic dramatic portrait., Butterfly LightingBeauty lighting with structure., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Rembrandt lighting connects nose shadow to cheek shadow and leaves a triangle. Butterfly lighting is on axis with a philtrum butterfly. Split lighting goes to 90 degrees and drops the far cheek. Bounce will wrap the loop away if the source gets too large. Motivated lighting may produce a loop from a slightly off window, but the pattern is the geometry, not the justification. Rembrandt LightingClassic dramatic portrait. Butterfly LightingBeauty lighting with structure. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Interview cinematography and news-adjacent films such as Frost/Nixon live on loop because both eyes stay open and the face still has a side. The Social Network's talking-head grammar often sits here: slightly off keys, not painterly triangles.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the loop and forbid the triangle. Use: "Loop lighting on [Subject], key slightly off-axis, a small loop shadow from the nose toward the corner of the mouth." Add that the loop does not touch the cheek shadow.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Loop lighting on [Subject], key slightly off-axis, a small loop shadow from the nose toward the corner of the mouth.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Rembrandt or butterfly. The tell is a connected cheek triangle, or a perfectly centered under-nose butterfly. Fix it by offsetting the key a little and stopping before the shadows merge.

### Split Lighting
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/split-lighting)
- 定义：Split lighting divides the face into a lit half and a shadow half by placing the key at about 90 degrees to the nose, a vertical cut down the center line. There is no Rembrandt triangle and no loop; the far plane is largely gone.
- 叙事功能：Duality made as geometry: hero and liar, cop and crook, the same person cut in two. The audience gets one eye in light and one in almost nothing. Music, crime, and moral argument use it because the cut is literal. It is the wrong tool for charm, romance, or any beat that needs both cheeks. If you sneak fill across the center line, the split collapses into side lighting with wrap. If you raise the key and pull it forward, you may accidentally make Rembrandt.
- 怎么拍：Put a relatively hard key at 90 degrees to the face, at about eye height, so the shadow edge runs down forehead, nose, and chin. Fill is near zero. Color can be a hard white or a theatrical gel; the point is the cut, not prettiness. A true split is more severe than generic side light because the wrap over the nose is killed with flags if needed. Prompt: Split lighting on [Subject], one half of the face in light, the other in shadow, a vertical moral cut.
- 何时用：Use it when a character is two things at once, a drummer under a side spot, a don in profile thought. Do not use it on a first-date close-up unless you want threat.
- 近似对比：Side lighting, Rembrandt lighting, Loop lighting, Short lighting, Butterfly, Side LightingCarve a face like sculpture., Short LightingSculpt a face; add mystery on the camera side., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Side lighting is the broader 90-degree direction and can still wrap a body or a room. Split is the facial pattern with a hard center line. Rembrandt lighting keeps a triangle on the dark cheek; split does not. Loop lighting is much more frontal. Short lighting can include a split if the dark cheek faces camera, but short is about which cheek the camera sees, not the 90-degree cut. Butterfly is the opposite: both cheeks open. Side LightingCarve a face like sculpture. Short LightingSculpt a face; add mystery on the camera side. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：The Godfather uses half-lit faces in the office so thought reads as a cut. Whiplash slashes players with hard side spots that often split the face on stage.；The pattern is the center line, not a mood word.
- Prompt 模板：`Demand the vertical cut. Use: "Split lighting on [Subject], one half of the face in light, the other in shadow, a vertical moral cut." Add key at 90 degrees, almost no fill, no triangle on the dark cheek.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Split lighting on [Subject], one half of the face in light, the other in shadow, a vertical moral cut.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Rembrandt or wrapped side lighting. The tell is a pocket of light on the dark cheek, or a soft wrap over the nose. Fix it by moving the key to 90 degrees and killing fill until the center line is clean.

### Short Lighting
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/short-lighting)
- 定义：Short lighting in short lighting terms keys the side of the face turned away from camera, so the camera sees more shadow than light. The head looks slimmer and more dimensional because the near cheek falls off.
- 叙事功能：Mystery sits on the camera side. We look at the dark plane and infer the person from the far, lit cheek. Noir portraits and serious close-ups use it so a face is sculpted instead of presented like a passport photo. It is the wrong tool when a comic or public figure should feel open to us. Short is not a shadow pattern by itself: you can light short as Rembrandt, loop, or even a soft wrap. The definition is which cheek faces the lens, not the nose shadow.
- 怎么拍：Turn the face so the far cheek takes the key (often 45 to 90 degrees from camera). The near cheek, the one occupying more of the frame, goes toward shadow. Hardness can be hard for noir or medium for drama. Color follows the key source. Combine with a low fill so the near eye does not die unless you want it to. Prompt: Short lighting on [Subject], the side turned away from camera is keyed, the near side falls toward shadow, slimming and dramatic.
- 何时用：Use it to sculpt a face and put mystery on the camera side, a close-up in an office or a night bar. Do not use it when the character is presenting themselves to the public in a broad, open way.
- 近似对比：Broad lighting, Rembrandt lighting, Split lighting, Side lighting, Broad LightingOpen, readable, less mystery., Rembrandt LightingClassic dramatic portrait., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Broad lighting keys the camera-facing cheek, the reverse. Rembrandt lighting is a triangle pattern often shot short, but Rembrandt can be broad if the triangle is on the near cheek. Split lighting is a 90-degree cut that is usually short if the dark half faces us. Side lighting describes direction, not which cheek is near camera. Broad LightingOpen, readable, less mystery. Rembrandt LightingClassic dramatic portrait. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Portrait noir and Godfather-adjacent close-ups often key the far cheek so the camera sits with the shadow. Road to Perdition does the same sculpting in dark interiors.；Read the near cheek: if it is the dark one, you are short.
- Prompt 模板：`Name which cheek is near. Use: "Short lighting on [Subject], the side turned away from camera is keyed, the near side falls toward shadow, slimming and dramatic." Add that the camera-facing cheek is the darker one.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Short lighting on [Subject], the side turned away from camera is keyed, the near side falls toward shadow, slimming and dramatic.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is broad lighting or a frontal butterfly. The tell is a bright near cheek filling the frame. Fix it by turning the face or swinging the key onto the far side.

### Broad Lighting
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/broad-lighting)
- 定义：Broad lighting keys the side of the face turned toward camera, so the near cheek is the bright one and the shadow sits on the far side. The face reads open, public, and less mysterious.
- 叙事功能：Someone is presenting themselves: a speech, a studio comic, a star who must be fully available to the lens. The camera-facing plane carries the exposure, so pores and expression on that cheek are easy to read. It is the wrong tool for menace, secrecy, or a slimming portrait on a wide face. Broad is not high-key; you can still have a dark room. The definition is only which cheek is near and lit.
- 怎么拍：Turn the face or swing the key so the camera-facing cheek takes the key, often 30 to 45 degrees off a near-frontal axis. Fill can be generous. Hardness is often softer than noir short lighting. Color is whatever the public space is: daylight, studio tungsten, a bright practical. Prompt: Broad lighting on [Subject], the camera-facing side keyed, open and public, less shadow on the near cheek.
- 何时用：Use it for an open, readable portrait, a public figure, a comic close-up. Do not use it when the near cheek should be the secret.
- 近似对比：Short lighting, High-key lighting, Butterfly lighting, Loop lighting, Short LightingSculpt a face; add mystery on the camera side., High-Key LightingComedy, heaven, hospital, or candy., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Short lighting is the reverse: far cheek keyed, near cheek dark. High-key lighting is overall contrast, which often pairs with broad but is not the same job. Butterfly lighting is on-axis, so neither cheek is favored. Loop lighting can be executed broad or short depending on head turn. Short LightingSculpt a face; add mystery on the camera side. High-Key LightingComedy, heaven, hospital, or candy. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Classical portraiture and studio comedy close-ups, including open faces in Roman Holiday and Singin' in the Rain, key the near cheek so the public can have the person. The shadow, if any, lives on the far side.
- Prompt 模板：`Light the near cheek. Use: "Broad lighting on [Subject], the camera-facing side keyed, open and public, less shadow on the near cheek." Say the bright plane is the one occupying most of the frame.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Broad lighting on [Subject], the camera-facing side keyed, open and public, less shadow on the near cheek.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is short lighting. The tell is a dark near cheek and a bright far sliver. Fix it by turning the key onto the camera-facing side or turning the face toward the key.

### Silhouette
- 别名：Shape-led composition, Ombre chinoise ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/silhouette)
- 定义：A silhouette shot places the subject dark against a brighter background so the figure reads as shape, not as a modeled face. Gesture and contour do the work; surface detail is gone.
- 叙事功能：Identity is less important than emblem: a rider on a ridge, a bicycle against a moon, a man in a doorway. The audience recognizes an action from outline alone. If two shapes merge, the sentence is lost. It is the wrong tool when a line of dialogue needs a mouth, or when you still want pores and color in the coat. A little rim is not a silhouette. If you can name the eye color, you overexposed the figure.
- 怎么拍：Expose for the bright ground (sky, doorway, fire, sun disk). Keep the key off the subject, or far below the background. Backlight may exist as a sky, not as a facial key. Separate limbs, hats, and props so the outline parses. Hardness of the background source can be hard sun or a bright overcast; the subject is simply underexposed. Prompt: Silhouette of [Subject] as a dark shape against a bright ground, surface detail gone, mythic outline only.
- 何时用：Use it when identity matters less than shape, a departure through a door, a figure against dusk. Do not use it if the action cannot be read from the outline.
- 近似对比：Backlight, Rim light, Cameo lighting, Low-key lighting, BacklightSeparate a dark figure from a dark world., Rim LightGraphic silhouette with just enough flesh., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Backlight can create a silhouette if you expose for it, or a rim if you hold the face a little. Rim light keeps a thread of flesh highlight; silhouette usually does not. Cameo lighting is the inverse: a lit figure on a black ground. Low-key lighting still models something in the pool. BacklightSeparate a dark figure from a dark world. Rim LightGraphic silhouette with just enough flesh. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：T. the Extra-Terrestrial puts bicycle and riders in silhouette across the moon.；The Searchers isolates a figure against a bright doorway and landscape. Lawrence of Arabia and Skyfall use desert and sun as the bright field that turns bodies into emblems.；E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial 1982The bicycle and riders pass in silhouette across the moon.；The Searchers 1956The figure is isolated against the bright doorway and landscape.
- Prompt 模板：`A parent and child carry a small telescope up a ridge at dusk, rendered as clean dark silhouettes against a luminous pale sky. Keep their limbs and the telescope distinct. Locked wide view, gentle wind, no visible facial detail or artificial rim halo.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Expose the ground, starve the body. " Name a readable outline (limbs separated).`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid facial detail and neon rims.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a rim portrait or a muddy underexposure on a dark ground. The tell is visible eyes, or a black figure on a black field. Fix it by brightening the background, killing keys on the body, and separating the limbs.

### Motivated Lighting
- 别名：Music source reveal, Source-score play ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/motivated-lighting)
- 定义：Motivated lighting is designed to appear consistent with a visible or plausible story-world source: a window, a lamp, a sign, the sky. Hidden units may exist, but they match that source in direction, hardness, and color.
- 叙事功能：The room feels like a world rather than a studio. A hotel sconce, a kitchen window, a sodium street, an overcast sky: the key could have come from there even if a silk outside the window is doing the real work. Control stays; theatricality hides. It is the wrong tool when the point is frankly theatrical (a follow spot, a beauty butterfly that no lamp in the room could throw). Motivated is not the same as using only what is already there. That is available light. It is also not the same as showing the bulb. That is a practical.
- 怎么拍：Choose the story source first. Match camera-side direction to that window or fixture. Match hardness: a distant sun stays hard; a sheer curtain becomes a large soft key; a bare bulb stays small. Match color: tungsten practicals around 2800 to 3200K, daylight windows nearer 5600K, sodium and neon as they are. Hide extra units along the same axis, flagged to the same throw. Prompt: Motivated lighting on [Subject], every source justified by a window, lamp, or sign that could exist in the room.
- 何时用：Use it for realism with control, a hotel corridor, a kitchen at 4 p.m., a car at night that should feel streetlit. Do not use it as an excuse to keep a frontal beauty key that no source in the space could explain.
- 近似对比：Practical lighting, Available light, Naturalistic ambient, Bounce light, Rembrandt, window light, Practical LightingLet the set light the face., Available LightCommit to the hour you have., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Practical lighting is the visible fixture in frame; motivated lighting can boost or replace it from hiding. Available light uses what exists without adding units. Naturalistic ambient is the overall wrap that hides craft. Bounce light is a method you may use to imitate a wall or ceiling the story already has. Rembrandt and window light are patterns or sources that motivated work often chooses, not synonyms. Practical LightingLet the set light the face. Available LightCommit to the hour you have. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：The Shining lets lamps and hotel fixtures justify interior direction. Children of Men keeps windows, fixtures, and available sky as the logic of the frame.；Blade Runner 2049 and In the Mood for Love build rooms whose keys could be the signs, blinds, and lamps we see, even when film lights help.；Blazing Saddles 1974A seemingly conventional musical accompaniment is revealed as a band in the desert.；Birdman 2014Visible percussion performance plays with the status of the drum soundtrack.；Yi Yi 2000The image eventually identifies the source of previously heard piano music.；The Shining 1980Lamps and hotel fixtures motivate much of the interior look.
- Prompt 模板：`A solemn traveler crosses an empty plaza accompanied by an original elegant string theme. Pan slowly to reveal a small string quartet following him on a wheeled platform, still playing the exact phrase. Their presence is treated matter-of-factly. Generate the visual reveal and synchronize an original performance in the edit.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Justify every beam. " Name the story source, its side, hardness, and Kelvin.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid an unexplained frontal beauty key.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is unmotivated studio three-point or claiming available light while describing movie lamps. The tell is a key from a wall with no window or fixture. Fix it by naming the story source and aligning hidden units to it.

### Practical Lighting
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/practical-lighting)
- 定义：Practical lighting uses a visible or logically present light source within the set as a real contributor: lamps, neon, candles, screens. You see the fixture, and it (or a unit matching it) actually lights the face.
- 叙事功能：The set becomes the lighting department. A table lamp in the foreground, a TV, a diner sign: the audience believes the room because the source is in the shot. Mixed color temperatures are a feature, not a mistake. It is the wrong tool when the fixture is only set dressing and a frontal key from nowhere does the work. A dark lamp in frame with a face lit from camera is a lie. If the lamp is off-screen but implied, you have shifted toward motivated lighting.
- 怎么拍：Put working fixtures in frame, often brighter than a real living room so they expose on camera. Control them with bulbs, dimmers, and flags. Hardness is whatever the shade allows: a bare bulb is hard; a cloth shade is softer. Color is mixed on purpose: tungsten 2700 to 3200K, neon magenta or cyan, screens cooler. You may hide a small unit in the same shade. Prompt: Practical lighting on [Subject] from visible lamps, neon, candles, or screens in frame, mixed color temperatures, no hidden movie lights.
- 何时用：Use it when the set should light the face, a night apartment, a bar, a car dash. Do not leave dead props in frame while a beauty key does the real job.
- 近似对比：Motivated lighting, Candlelight, Neon practicals, Available light, Window light, Motivated LightingRealism with control. Light like a world, not a studio., CandlelightPeriod night or ritual., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Motivated lighting can hide units that match a source; practicals are the sources you see. Candlelight is a specific small warm practical with fast falloff. Neon practicals are a color-and-sign subset. Available light might include existing fixtures but forbids adding them. Window light is often a practical architecture plus sky. Motivated LightingRealism with control. Light like a world, not a studio. CandlelightPeriod night or ritual. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Barry Lyndon puts flame in frame as the logic of night. In the Mood for Love and Blade Runner 2049 let lamps, neon, and screens in the set do visible work on faces.；The fixture is part of the composition, not only the plot.
- Prompt 模板：`Show the lamp and let it work. Use: "Practical lighting on [Subject] from visible lamps, neon, candles, or screens in frame, mixed color temperatures, no hidden movie lights." Name which fixture is the key and its color.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Practical lighting on [Subject] from visible lamps, neon, candles, or screens in frame, mixed color temperatures, no hidden movie lights.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a dummy lamp plus an off-screen key. The tell is a dark shade and a face lit from the camera. Fix it by turning the practical up (or matching a hidden unit inside it) and killing the orphan frontal.

### Available Light
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/available-light)
- 定义：Available light in available light cinematography is the illumination already at the location before the crew adds or changes units: sun, sky, or existing interior fixtures. You commit to the hour and the existing contrast.
- 叙事功能：The day is the gaffer. , a kitchen with one overhead, a station with sodium: you expose for what is there and block actors into it. Documentary and certain features treat that limitation as the look. It is the wrong tool when you need night-for-night control, a cheek triangle that the sun will not hold, or matching a scene across three hours. If you add a bounce board you have already left pure available and entered a small bounce or naturalistic cheat.
- 怎么拍：Do not add lights. Choose sun angle, weather, and existing fixtures. Hardness is the sun's (hard when clear, soft when overcast). Color is the real Kelvin of that hour: high sun near 5600K, late sun warmer, interiors whatever the building installed. Expose for faces or for sky, not both if the ratio is huge. Prompt: Available light only on [Subject], sun, sky, or existing interior fixtures, documentary humility, no added units.
- 何时用：Use it when you will commit to the hour you have, a ridge, a real kitchen, a street at the time the story needs. Do not use it if you plan to sneak in an HMI and still call it available.
- 近似对比：Motivated lighting, Naturalistic ambient, Golden hour, blue hour, Practical lighting, Naturalistic AmbientInvisible craft., Motivated LightingRealism with control. Light like a world, not a studio., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Motivated lighting adds hidden units that imitate the world. Naturalistic ambient is crafted to look unstyled and may include lights. Golden hour and blue hour are specific available conditions. Practical lighting can be available if the fixtures already exist and you do not enhance them. Naturalistic AmbientInvisible craft. Motivated LightingRealism with control. Light like a world, not a studio. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Days of Heaven waited on natural edges of the day. The Revenant committed to location sun, overcast, and fire already in the space.；The grammar is patience and geography, not a gel called natural.
- Prompt 模板：`Available light only on [Subject], sun, sky, or existing interior fixtures, documentary humility, no added units.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Forbid added units. " Name the hour and the existing source.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not list movie lamps.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is motivated lighting sold as available. The tell is a perfect fill on the shadow cheek at noon in open sun. Fix it by removing extra units, or by renaming the setup motivated.

### Naturalistic Ambient
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/naturalistic-ambient)
- 定义：Naturalistic ambient lighting wraps the subject in soft, directionally plausible room or sky tone so the craft reads as unstyled even when units are added. Shadows stay believable; nothing announces a movie lamp.
- 叙事功能：Invisible craft. A kitchen, a car, a holiday apartment: the light feels like the space, and the audience stops thinking about lighting. Independent drama uses it so emotion is not underlined by a slash of hard key. It is the wrong tool when the story wants a theatrical cut, a butterfly, or a concert edge. If the wrap is so complete that direction dies, you have flattened the room. Naturalistic still has a window side.
- 怎么拍：Start from the real window or overhead, then add large soft sources or bounce along that same axis. Keep ratios gentle (often under 4:1). Hardness is soft; color matches the space (daylight through glass, warm tungsten mix at dusk). Avoid hair lights that cannot be a ceiling and kickers that cannot be a lamp. Prompt: Naturalistic ambient wrap on [Subject], soft room tone, believable shadow, window-motivated without theatricality.
- 何时用：Use it for quiet contemporary drama, a memory that should not look lit. Do not use it for noir graphic or a glamour package.
- 近似对比：Available light, Soft light, Motivated lighting, Bounce light, High-key, Soft LightBeauty, memory, or kindness., Available LightCommit to the hour you have., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Available light forbids adding units; this look may add them. Soft light is the hardness you will use. Motivated lighting is the justification; naturalistic ambient is the overall unstyled wrap.
