Bounce light is a common method. High-key is brighter and more even than most lived-in rooms. Soft LightBeauty, memory, or kindness. Available LightCommit to the hour you have. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Aftersun lets holiday rooms and sky feel found. Manchester by the Sea keeps New England interiors and winter daylight in a believable wrap.；Neither film advertises a key position even when units are surely there.
- Prompt 模板：`Naturalistic ambient wrap on [Subject], soft room tone, believable shadow, window-motivated without theatricality.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Ask for room tone, not a named portrait pattern. " Name a window side.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid hair lights and hard kickers.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is three-point or frankly available noon sun. The tell is a rim that no ceiling could throw, or harsh unshaped sun while you asked for quiet. Fix it by aligning every unit to the window and softening until direction remains only as a gentle side.

### Bounce Light
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/bounce-light)
- 定义：Bounce lighting reflects light from a surface (wall, ceiling, poly, card) before it reaches the subject, so the apparent source becomes that large surface. Direction remains, but shadow edges soften and wrap.
- 叙事功能：You keep a window side or a lamp side without the brutality of the bare source. Faces wrap, rooms feel inhabited, and the key still has a direction because the bounce surface occupies a place in the world. Period interiors and daylight rooms use it so skin does not speckle. It is the wrong tool when you need razor shadows, a gobo pattern, or a hard split. Bounce is a method, not a facial pattern: it is not Rembrandt, not split, not butterfly. Those patterns die if you bounce too much.
- 怎么拍：Aim a lamp or the sun at a white or neutral surface, then let that surface light the subject. Larger and closer bounce means softer light. Color picks up the bounce surface: white stays honest, a cream wall warms, a green wall will tint. The key side is the side of the bounce, not the lamp behind it. Prompt: Bounce light on [Subject], key ricocheted off a white wall or poly, wrapping, gentle, large-source softness.
- 何时用：Use it to soften without losing direction, a face by a white wall, a ceiling bounce in a low room. Do not bounce when you need a crisp nose shadow or projected blinds.
- 近似对比：Soft light, Window light, Fill light, Motivated lighting, Hard light, Soft LightBeauty, memory, or kindness., Window LightDay interiors without looking lit., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Soft light can also come from a large silk in line with the lamp; bounce specifically reflects first. Window light is often bounced by walls after entering. Fill light is a job bounce often performs. Motivated lighting may use bounce to imitate a wall the story has. Hard light is the quality bounce destroys. Soft LightBeauty, memory, or kindness. Window LightDay interiors without looking lit. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Cries and Whispers uses wrap from walls and rooms so faces glow without a hard edge. The Tree of Life often lets sun hit interiors and bounce into skin.；The method is the ricochet, not a filter named soft.
- Prompt 模板：`Bounce light on [Subject], key ricocheted off a white wall or poly, wrapping, gentle, large-source softness.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the reflecting surface. " State the wall's side and color.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid a small bare bulb as the apparent source.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a bare hard key or a frontal silk that is not a bounce. The tell is razor nose shadows, or a source that still looks small. Fix it by making the last surface before the face a large wall or board, and by naming that surface.

### Hard Light
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/hard-light)
- 定义：Hard light in hard light cinematography comes from a small apparent source and produces crisp shadow edges and specular definition on skin, metal, and walls. Texture is amplified; falloff can still be steep or long depending on distance.
- 叙事功能：Noon sun, a bare bulb, an interrogation lamp: pores, sweat, and brick become graphic. Noir and westerns use it so a hat brim cuts a clean triangle on the face and a body throws a readable double on the wall. It is the wrong tool for kindness, memory, or a beauty close-up that should wrap. Hard is not the same as bright, and not the same as low-key. You can have a dim hard source in a black room, or a blazing hard sun in a high-key desert.
- 怎么拍：Use a small source relative to the subject: distant sun, bare tungsten, a focused Fresnel, a snooted LED. Distance makes it harder (smaller apparent size). Color is often white daylight or tungsten; gels stay saturated because the source is specular. Pair with flags for gobo patterns. Prompt: Hard light on [Subject] from a small distant source, razor shadow edges, texture amplified, noir graphic.
- 何时用：Use it for grit, noon sun, or interrogation, a street at midday, a bulb over a table. Do not use it as default beauty on a romantic close-up.
- 近似对比：Soft light, Gobo lighting, Low-key lighting, Split lighting, Bounce, Soft LightBeauty, memory, or kindness., Gobo LightingThe room writes on the person., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Soft light is the opposite quality: large source, gradual edges. Gobo lighting needs hard light to throw a sharp pattern. Low-key lighting often uses hard sources but is a ratio. Split lighting often wants a hard 90-degree key. Bounce is how you destroy hardness. Soft LightBeauty, memory, or kindness. Gobo LightingThe room writes on the person. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：The Big Combo and Se7en cut faces and rooms with small, hard sources. Once Upon a Time in the West lets hard sun define hats, dust, and wood.；The edge of the shadow is the grammar.
- Prompt 模板：`Name a small distant source and razor edges. Use: "Hard light on [Subject] from a small distant source, razor shadow edges, texture amplified, noir graphic." Forbid silks, wrap, and cloudy softness unless weather is the point.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Hard light on [Subject] from a small distant source, razor shadow edges, texture amplified, noir graphic.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is soft light with high contrast. The tell is fuzzy shadow edges on the nose and table. Fix it by shrinking the apparent source (remove diffusion, move it farther, or switch to sun and a clear sky).

### Soft Light
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/soft-light)
- 定义：Soft light in soft light cinematography comes from a large apparent source and produces gradual shadow transitions and wrap around the face or body. Speculars get larger and dimmer; texture is reduced.
- 叙事功能：Kindness, memory, overcast, a north window: the key still has a side, but the nose shadow is a gradient. Skin holds, rooms feel breathable. You can still have contrast if the fill is low; softness is not high-key. It is the wrong tool for a gobo of blinds, a noon duel, or a split that needs a knife edge. If the source becomes so large it surrounds the subject, direction dies and you have ambient soup.
- 怎么拍：Make the last surface before the subject large: silk, book light, overcast sky, big window, bounce wall. Closer and larger is softer. Color is often daylight 5600K through diffusion, or tungsten through a large shade. Keep a key side. Prompt: Soft wrapping light on [Subject] from a large source, gentle shadow transitions, luminous skin, north-window daylight.
- 何时用：Use it for beauty, memory, or kindness, a daylight interior, a close-up that should not cut pores into craters. Do not use it when you need projected pattern or interrogation.
- 近似对比：Hard light, Bounce light, Window light, Glam, High-key lighting, Bounce LightSoften without losing direction., Window LightDay interiors without looking lit., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Hard light is the opposite quality. Bounce light is a method of getting soft. Window light is often large and soft by architecture. Glam uses soft keys plus diffusion and catchlights. High-key lighting uses soft sources and a lot of fill; you can have soft low-key if the wrap is large but isolated. Bounce LightSoften without losing direction. Window LightDay interiors without looking lit. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：The Tree of Life and Call Me by Your Name let large daylight sources wrap skin and rooms. The softness is the size of sky and window, not a beauty filter named glow.
- Prompt 模板：`Soft wrapping light on [Subject] from a large source, gentle shadow transitions, luminous skin, Vermeer daylight.`
- Prompt 要点：Name a large source and gentle edges. " Keep a key side. / Forbid razor nose shadows.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is hard light or directionless ambient. The tell is razor edges, or no key side at all. Fix it by enlarging the source and keeping it on one side of the face.

### Side Lighting
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/side-lighting)
- 定义：Side lighting keys primarily from one side, around 90 degrees to the camera-subject line, so shape and texture are emphasized. Half the form goes toward light, half toward shadow.
- 叙事功能：A face or a landscape becomes sculpture. Sweat, wood grain, and cheekbones show because the light rakes. Action and crime use it so bodies have planes; portraits use it when character should look carved. It is the wrong tool for a passport-readable hero or a beauty wrap. Side lighting a room is not automatically split lighting. Split is the facial center-line cut with almost no wrap. Side can still graze a shoulder, a horse, a wall.
- 怎么拍：Place the key at about 90 degrees, at a height that fits the story (eye height for a face, raking low sun for ground texture). Hardness is often hard so texture reads; soft side light exists as a large window in a side wall. Color follows that source. Control wrap with flags if you need a truer split. Prompt: Pure side light at 90 degrees on [Subject], half the face brilliant, half gone, texture and duality.
- 何时用：Use it to carve a face or a body like sculpture, a raking desert, a sweat-lit fight. Do not use it as default coverage on a two-shot that needs both people open.
- 近似对比：Split lighting, Cross lighting, Kicker, Short lighting, broad lighting, Split LightingDuality made literal., Cross LightingStage, sweat, or two moral sources., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Split lighting is the hard facial version of this direction. Cross lighting uses two opposing side keys. Kicker is a side-back accent, not a key. Short lighting and broad lighting depend on head turn relative to camera, not on 90 degrees as such. Split LightingDuality made literal. Cross LightingStage, sweat, or two moral sources. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Apocalypse Now rakes faces with hard side sources in the dark. Sicario uses raking sun and side keys so landscape and faces have grain.；The job is the 90-degree rake, not a mood.
- Prompt 模板：`Pure side light at 90 degrees on [Subject], half the face brilliant, half gone, texture and duality.`
- Prompt 要点：Put the lamp at 90 degrees. " Name hardness. / Say whether the body or only the face is raked.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Rembrandt (too frontal) or cross lighting (a second key). The tell is a cheek triangle, or rims on both sides. Fix it by parking one key at 90 and killing the opposite unit.

### Top Light
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/top-light)
- 定义：Top lighting is illumination from directly above the subject, falling on forehead, nose bridge, and shoulders while the eye sockets and the underside of the chin go into shadow. The source is a ceiling, a rig, or a high practical, not a frontal beauty key.
- 叙事功能：Power sitting in a chair, or guilt: the head is a skull with a lid of light. Crime bosses, interrogations, and some night exteriors use overhead so the eyes recede. The person is still human; the pupils must not emit. It is the wrong tool for glamour. If you bring the source forward of the head you get butterfly. If you need a catchlight, add a tiny eye light rather than lowering the overhead until it becomes a frontal key.
- 怎么拍：Hang a lamp or use a ceiling practical directly above, flagged so it does not rake the nose as a frontal. Hardness can be hard (bare bulb) for a skull, or a bit softer (shaded pendant) for a diner. Color is often tungsten, sometimes cool industrial. Keep exposure on the forehead, not in the sockets, unless you add a separate eye glint. Prompt: A lamp directly above [Subject], light falling on forehead and shoulders, eye sockets in shadow, human eyes, no light emitting from the pupils.
- 何时用：Use it for a figure of power in a chair, a diner pendant, a guilty face under a garage bulb. Do not use it as beauty lighting.
- 近似对比：Underlighting, Butterfly lighting, Low-key lighting, Hair light, Cameo, Low-Key LightingMystery, crime, or moral night., UnderlightingThe source is fire, a screen on the floor, or a monster., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Underlighting is the opposite direction, from below. Butterfly lighting is high but still in front of the face. Low-key lighting is the ratio that often houses top light. Hair light is behind and above, not a downward key on the forehead. Cameo may use a top pool but is about isolating the figure in void. Low-Key LightingMystery, crime, or moral night. UnderlightingThe source is fire, a screen on the floor, or a monster. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：The Godfather is the famous overhead office: forehead and hands, eyes in wells. The Batman (2022) uses overhead rain and practicals so faces sit under lids of light.；The sockets stay dark on purpose.
- Prompt 模板：`Put the lamp on the ceiling axis. Use: "A lamp directly above [Subject], light falling on forehead and shoulders, eye sockets in shadow, human eyes, no light emitting from the pupils." Forbid frontal beauty fill.`
- 示例 Prompt：`A lamp directly above [Subject], light falling on forehead and shoulders, eye sockets in shadow, human eyes, no light emitting from the pupils.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is butterfly or glowing eyes. The tell is an under-nose butterfly with open sockets, or pupils that shine like LEDs. Fix it by moving the source truly overhead and keeping eyes as dark human surfaces with at most a tiny catch.

### Underlighting
- 别名：uplighting ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/under-light)
- 定义：Underlighting, also called uplighting, lights from below the face so shadows climb the cheekbones and the tops of the eye sockets. The modeling is the reverse of daylight and often reads as uncanny.
- 叙事功能：The source is fire, a screen on the floor, a flashlight under a chin, or a monster. Faces invert: the brow ridge goes dark, the nostrils and chin light up. Horror and campfire talk use the same physics; only the object changes. It is the wrong tool for ordinary conversation under a ceiling. A candle on a table can underlight if it sits below the chin, but candlelight is a source type that can also sit beside a face. Underlighting is the direction.
- 怎么拍：Place a lamp, flame, or panel below the chin, pointing up. Keep it close so inverse-square falloff hits the face and dies on the ceiling. Hardness is often hard or small-soft (a phone screen is a smallish source). Color is flame-warm, screen-cool, or theatrical green; the climb of the shadows is the tell. Prompt: A lamp on the table below [Subject]'s chin, pointing up. Shadows climb the cheekbones and eye sockets. The source is under the face, not beside it.
- 何时用：Use it when the source is fire, a floor screen, or a threat under the chin. Do not use it as a default beauty fill from a white card unless you want unease.
- 近似对比：Top light, Candlelight, Practical lighting, Glam, Top LightPower sitting in a chair, or guilt., CandlelightPeriod night or ritual., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Top light is the opposite. Candlelight may underlight if the flame is low, but a candelabra at face height is more of a small frontal or side key. Practical lighting is the visible object; underlighting is where it sits. Glam sometimes uses a weak under fill (a reflector) that must stay far below key so it does not invert the face. Top LightPower sitting in a chair, or guilt. CandlelightPeriod night or ritual. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：James Whale's Frankenstein (1931) underlights the creature so the brow and sockets invert. Hereditary uses low sources and ritual light to the same uncanny effect.；The shadows must climb, not slide sideways.
- Prompt 模板：`A lamp on the table below [Subject]'s chin, pointing up. Shadows climb the cheekbones and eye sockets. The source is under the face, not beside it.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Put the source under the chin. Use: "A lamp on the table below [Subject]'s chin, pointing up.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is side lighting or a candle off to the side. The tell is a left-right split instead of shadows that climb. Fix it by lowering the source below the jaw and aiming up.

### Cross Lighting
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/cross-lighting)
- 定义：Cross lighting keys subjects from opposite side directions, so each person or each side of a body gets a key and a far rim. It is common in dialogue coverage, stage, and concert work.
- 叙事功能：Two moral sources, or just two people who both need a face. Sweat on a drummer, a duet, a fight: edges appear on both sides because each lamp is someone else's key. Theatrical energy comes from the dual rims, not from smoke alone. It is the wrong tool for a single-source room, a motivated night interior with one lamp, or a true split on one face. If both keys are equally frontal you have flattened the pair. If only one side is keyed, you are back to side lighting.
- 怎么拍：Place two keys roughly opposite, each about 70 to 110 degrees off the camera-subject axis, often slightly back so they rim as well as key. Hardness is often hard for concerts, softer for dialogue. Color may match, or each side can carry a different gel (warm versus cool) as two worlds. Flag them off the lens. Prompt: Cross lighting on [Subject] from two opposing keys, dual rims, theatrical or concert edges on both sides.
- 何时用：Use it for stage, sweat, or two people who each need a key from the other's side. Do not use it in a one-lamp apartment unless you want that apartment to feel like a concert.
- 近似对比：Side lighting, Rim light, Kicker, Three-point lighting, Split, Rim LightGraphic silhouette with just enough flesh., Side LightingCarve a face like sculpture., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Side lighting is one direction. Rim light is a thin rear edge, not a second key. Kicker is a single far-side accent. Three-point lighting uses key, fill, and back, not two opposing keys. Split is one face cut by one key. Rim LightGraphic silhouette with just enough flesh. Side LightingCarve a face like sculpture. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Whiplash cross-lights the band so rims and sweat read from both sides. Concert films and stage sequences in A Star Is Born use opposing keys as the grammar of performance.；Two sources, two edges.
- Prompt 模板：`Cross lighting on [Subject] from two opposing keys, dual rims, theatrical or concert energy, edges on both sides.`
- Prompt 要点：Name two opposing keys. " Specify colors if they differ. / Forbid a single-side split.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is one side key or a frontal pair of fills. The tell is one rim only, or two flat cheeks. Fix it by parking hard or medium keys opposite each other, slightly back, and letting each throw a far edge.

### Window Light
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/window-light)
- 定义：Window light in window light cinematography is illumination shaped to appear as light entering through a window: a large, directional source with falloff into the room. The architecture is the modifier.
- 叙事功能：Day interiors without looking lit. A figure sits in the falloff, one side toward glass, the far wall dying. Painterly rooms, period houses, and quiet dramas use the window as the only key so the hour is readable. It is the wrong tool at night (unless moonlight through glass is the story), or when you need a hard bulb. A window is not automatically bounce; bounce happens after the light hits a wall. A window can be hard if the sun is direct and small in the frame of the glass.
- 怎么拍：Use real sky or a large source outside the glass, plus sheers if you want wrap. Direction is the window's side. Hardness: overcast or north light is soft; direct sun through dirty glass is harder and may throw a patch. Color is daylight, cooler if north sky, warmer late. Let inverse-square and flags create falloff toward the room. Prompt: Window light as the only key on [Subject], large soft directional source, falloff into the room, painterly interior.
- 何时用：Use it for a day interior that should not look studio-lit, a sitting room, a workshop. Do not use a frontal silk that ignores the window's actual wall.
- 近似对比：Soft light, Motivated lighting, Bounce, Available light, Golden hour, Soft LightBeauty, memory, or kindness., Motivated LightingRealism with control. Light like a world, not a studio., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Soft light is the usual quality of north windows. Motivated lighting is the logic that lets you hide a source outside that window. Bounce is the wall ricochet after entry. Available light uses the real window without adding. Golden hour through a window is a specific color and angle of this source. Soft LightBeauty, memory, or kindness. Motivated LightingRealism with control. Light like a world, not a studio. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Girl with a Pearl Earring (2003) builds interiors as if Vermeer's window were the key. The Danish Girl uses large directional day interiors with falloff.；The grammar is glass, falloff, and one side, not a painting to clone.
- Prompt 模板：`Make the window the only key. Use: "Window light as the only key on [Subject], large soft directional source, falloff into the room, painterly interior." Name which wall holds the glass and whether the sky is overcast or late sun.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Window light as the only key on [Subject], large soft directional source, falloff into the room, painterly interior.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a frontal soft key that does not match the window wall, or a hard gobo of blinds when you asked for wrap. The tell is a key from a blank wall. Fix it by putting the bright side on the glass and letting the room fall off.

### Candlelight
- 别名：Low-light period interior ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/candlelight)
- 定义：Candlelight in candlelight cinematography is a small warm practical or a simulated flame with rapid falloff, often around 1800K, that carves faces near the flame and lets the rest of the room die. Flicker is part of the source, not a grade.
- 叙事功能：Period night and ritual live on this physics: people lean in because the light does not travel. A card table, a vigil, a cabin: faces emerge from the room instead of being separately lit for the viewer. Darkness stays as lived space. It is the wrong tool for a wide court that must stay evenly readable, or for a modern kitchen. Not every period film used only candles; Barry Lyndon's approach is specifically documented, often with fast lenses and sometimes hidden augmentation matched to the flame.
- 怎么拍：Cluster real or LED candles close to faces. The apparent source is small, so shadows are fairly hard, but multiple flames wrap a little. Falloff is steep (inverse square from a tiny source). Color is deep warm, well below tungsten. If the cluster sits below the chin you will also get some underlighting; if it sits at eye height it is a small frontal or three-quarter key. Prompt: Candlelight on [Subject], warm 1800K flicker, faces carved by flame, deep falloff.
- 何时用：Use it for period night or ritual, a table of cards, a prayer. Do not claim a huge hall is only candles if you have even, modern fill.
- 近似对比：Practical lighting, Underlighting, Motivated lighting, Chiaroscuro, Glam, Practical LightingLet the set light the face., UnderlightingThe source is fire, a screen on the floor, or a monster., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Practical lighting is the broader class; candle is the small flame subset. Underlighting is direction, which a low candle can cause. Motivated lighting may hide units that match 1800K along the same throw. Chiaroscuro is the contrast language this falloff often creates. Glam will fight the falloff. Practical LightingLet the set light the face. UnderlightingThe source is fire, a screen on the floor, or a monster. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Barry Lyndon is the documented candlelit card-table and evening interior, with fast optics and credible falloff. The Witch keeps flame as the logic of night in a dark New England.；Faces fade with distance from the cluster.；Barry Lyndon 1975Candlelit card-table and evening interiors.
- Prompt 模板：`An eighteenth-century card game lit as if only by clustered candles on the table. Faces fade quickly into darkness with distance from the flames, warm uneven illumination, believable flame detail and subdued room corners. A slow restrained gesture, no bright modern fill or electric orange wash.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Keep the flame small and close. " Cluster the candles, kill electric fill, and let corners go dark.`
- Prompt 要点：No orange wash on a bright room.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a tungsten wash or underlighting from a big movie lamp. The tell is even exposure ten feet from the candle, or a single huge orange gel. Fix it by making falloff rapid and keeping color at flame Kelvin.

### Neon Practicals
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/neon-practical)
- 定义：Neon practicals are visible neon or similar sign tubes used as actual keys or strong accents, coloring the subject with magenta, cyan, or other tube hues instead of a hidden white source. The city fixture is the lamp.
- 叙事功能：Night streets, hotels, and rain: the sign is not decoration. Wet pavement bounces the same hue back up. Mixed gels are honest because different signs disagree. Faces pick up the nearest tube as a key and the next one as a kicker. It is the wrong tool for a daylight office, or for a teal-and-orange grade with no tubes in frame. If the neon is only in the background and a white key lights the face, you have set dressing, not neon practicals.
- 怎么拍：Put working tubes in frame close enough to expose. Hardness is that of a long, thin source: relatively soft along the tube, harder across it, with specular lines in eyes and on wet cloth. Color is the gas and the gel: magenta, cyan, red, green, often mixed. Wet-down helps bounce. Prompt: Neon practicals coloring [Subject], magenta and cyan signs as real keys, wet bounce, mixed gels, night-city chromatics.
- 何时用：Use it when the city is the lighting department, a wet street, a motel sign, a night market. Do not use a white key and a neon wallpaper.
- 近似对比：Practical lighting, Motivated lighting, Blue hour, Cool blue, warm amber, Cross lighting, Practical LightingLet the set light the face., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it., Key LightDecide where the world is lit from. Everything else follows.
  Practical lighting is the parent class. Motivated lighting can hide units that match a sign's hue. Blue hour often mixes with neon as warm and cool together. Cool blue and warm amber are grades; neon is a physical tube. Cross lighting happens when two signs oppose. Practical LightingLet the set light the face. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it. Key LightDecide where the world is lit from. Everything else follows.
- 片中实例：Blade Runner uses signage and tubes as interior and street keys. Chungking Express lets Hong Kong neon hit faces at mixed hues.；Drive keeps magenta and cyan signs as real contributors on wet night streets.
- Prompt 模板：`Neon practicals coloring [Subject], magenta and cyan signs as real keys, wet bounce, mixed gels, night-city chromatics.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Make the signs the keys. " Name which tube hits which cheek.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid a white beauty key.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a white key plus neon bokeh. The tell is neutral skin in front of colored circles. Fix it by letting the nearest tube be the key and allowing mixed color on the face.

### Golden Hour
- 别名：Twilight photography, Golden-hour window ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/golden-hour)
- 定义：Golden hour in golden hour cinematography is low-angle warm sunlight shortly after sunrise or before sunset, when the sun is near the horizon. Shadows go long; the light is directional, warm, and brief.
- 叙事功能：You have a short window in which ordinary action looks transient because the sun is leaving or arriving. Faces rake, dust shows, and the sky still has brightness. Farms, roads, and childhood exteriors wait on this hour because it will not hold. It is the wrong tool if you need three hours of matching coverage, or if you mean the cool time after the sun is down. An orange grade on midday sun is not golden hour. Direct late sun is still a hard-ish source; post-sunset wrap is blue hour or dusk ambient.
- 怎么拍：Point the scene at the low sun. Backlight is common (warm rim, long ground shadows toward camera); front or side rake also works. Hardness is softer than noon because of atmosphere, but shadows remain defined. Color is warm amber, well below midday 5600K. Rehearse before the window. Prompt: Golden hour backlight on [Subject], warm amber raking sun, long shadows, horizontal flare.
- 何时用：Use it when the day is ending or beginning and the sun is still up, a last walk, a field, a ridge. Do not use an orange LUT on noon and call it this hour.
- 近似对比：Blue hour, Available light, Backlight, Warm amber, Blue HourDay is gone but the sky still works., Available LightCommit to the hour you have., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Blue hour is after sunset or before sunrise, cool ambient, no hard sun disk lighting the subject. Available light is the method; golden hour is a specific available condition. Backlight is a common placement of this sun. Warm amber is a grade that can fake the hue without the long shadows. Blue HourDay is gone but the sky still works. Available LightCommit to the hour you have. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Days of Heaven waited on farm and prairie edges of the day. The Tree of Life uses low-sun childhood passages.；The Revenant and Call Me by Your Name both treat late or early sun as a scheduled source, not a preset.；Days of Heaven 1978Farm and prairie scenes in the low-light edges of the day.；The Tree of Life 2011Natural-light childhood passages, including low-sun imagery.
- Prompt 模板：`Two farm workers walk beside a wheat field just after sunset. Soft luminous sky, low contrast on their faces, warm remnants on the horizon, no direct overhead sun. Gentle wind and patient lateral movement, natural exposure, no exaggerated orange filter.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Keep the sun low and real. " Say the sun is just above the horizon.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid midday height and a full blue sky with no rake.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is blue hour or an orange midday grade. The tell is a high sun, or a cool sky with no long shadows. Fix it by lowering the sun, warming the key, and throwing long shadows.

### Blue Hour
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/blue-hour)
- 定义：Blue hour in blue hour cinematography is cool ambient twilight before sunrise or after sunset, when the sun is below the horizon but the sky still glows. There is no hard sunlight; the sky is a large cool source, and warm practicals often kick in.
- 叙事功能：Day is gone but the sky still works as a wrap. Cities mix cobalt air with sodium, tungsten, and neon. Crime and melancholy exteriors use this mix because faces can be cool while windows go warm. It is the wrong tool if you still want a sun disk raking the ground. That is golden hour or late sun. A blue grade on night black is not blue hour. You need residual sky luminance.
- 怎么拍：Expose for the glowing sky as a large, soft, overhead-to-side source, Kelvin high and cool. Add warm practicals (streetlights, windows, signs) as small hard or semi-hard accents. Hardness of the wrap is soft; hardness of the lamps is whatever they are. Color contrast is the point: cool ambient versus warm fixtures. Prompt: Blue hour wrap on [Subject], deep cobalt sky still glowing, warm practicals kicking in.
- 何时用：Use it when the sun is down but the sky still holds, a city street, a platform, a rooftop. Do not use it for a hard sunset backlight.
- 近似对比：Golden hour, Neon practicals, Available light, Cool blue, Motivated lighting, Golden HourYou have twenty minutes of truth., Neon PracticalsThe city is the lighting department., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Golden hour still has directional warm sun. Neon practicals often appear inside blue hour as the warm or magenta notes. Available light at this time is exactly this mix if you add nothing. Cool blue is a grade; blue hour is a real sky condition. Motivated lighting can fake it with large cool overheads plus warm lamps. Golden HourYou have twenty minutes of truth. Neon PracticalsThe city is the lighting department. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Heat and Collateral are built on Los Angeles twilight, digital-friendly cobalt air with sodium and tungsten. Drive uses the same urban mix of residual sky and signs.；The sky has to still be there.
- Prompt 模板：`Keep the sky luminous and cool. Use: "Blue hour wrap on [Subject], deep cobalt sky still glowing, warm practicals kicking in." Forbid a visible sun disk and a black night sky with no residual light.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Blue hour wrap on [Subject], deep cobalt sky still glowing, warm practicals kicking in, Mann twilight melancholy.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is golden hour or night-for-night black. The tell is long warm sun shadows, or a sky with no glow. Fix it by killing the sun, cooling the wrap, and turning practicals on against a still-bright sky.

### Dappled Light
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/dappled-light)
- 定义：Dappled light is broken patches of brightness and shadow caused by foliage, water, blinds, or another irregular obstruction in a hard beam. The pattern is organic and often moving.
- 叙事功能：A tree writes on a coat. Jungle, orchard, and bedroom blinds turn a person into a field of spots. Nature or architecture becomes the gobo without looking designed as a logo. It is the wrong tool for a clean beauty close-up or a graphic prison-bar statement. If the pattern is a crisp logo or perfectly parallel slats, you have shifted toward gobo lighting. Dappled wants irregular leaf-shaped or caustic patches.
- 怎么拍：You need a relatively hard sun or lamp, plus an obstructing layer (leaves, a tree, water surface, dirty glass) between source and subject. Distance from gobo to subject controls softness of the patches. Color is usually daylight. Wind or water makes the patches crawl. Prompt: Sun through leaves on [Subject], irregular patches of brightness and leaf-shaped shadows on coat and horse, a real tree overhead.
- 何时用：Use it when nature or blinds should break the key, a forest walk, a siesta under a tree. Do not use a clean unobstructed key and then paint spots in post as stickers.
- 近似对比：Gobo lighting, Hard light, Window light, Volumetric light, Gobo LightingThe room writes on the person., Hard LightGrit, noon sun, or interrogation., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Gobo lighting is the designed version: a cucoloris, bars, or blinds placed to write a graphic. Dappled is irregular and usually natural. Hard light is required for sharp patches. Window light through trees outside can be dappled. Volumetric light shows beams in air; dappled shows patches on surfaces. Gobo LightingThe room writes on the person. Hard LightGrit, noon sun, or interrogation. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：The Thin Red Line lets jungle canopy break sun on soldiers. Moonlight uses broken daylight and night sources so bodies carry irregular patches.；The obstruction is real, not a texture overlay.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the obstruction. Use: "Sun through leaves on [Subject], irregular patches of brightness and leaf-shaped shadows on coat and horse, a real tree overhead." Forbid a clean unpatterned key and a venetian-bar prison graphic unless blinds are the story.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Sun through leaves on [Subject], irregular patches of brightness and leaf-shaped shadows on coat and horse, a real tree overhead.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a clean key or a designed gobo of bars. The tell is even skin, or perfectly parallel slats. Fix it by putting a real tree, water, or irregular foliage in a hard beam.

### Gobo Lighting
- 别名：cucoloris ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/gobo-lighting)
- 定义：Gobo lighting places a pattern or object in a light beam (a gobo or cucoloris) so the source throws graphic shadows across face, body, and wall. The room writes on the person.
- 叙事功能：Venetian blinds, bars, branches cut as a design, a fan, a grille: the character wears the architecture. Noir and political interiors use it so a man is already in a cage before anyone speaks. It is the wrong tool for invisible naturalism, or for random leaf scatter you do not want to look designed. If the pattern is irregular canopy, prefer dappled light. Gobos need a hard enough source to stay readable.
- 怎么拍：Put a hard, small source through slats, a cut cucoloris, or a metal gobo in a fixture. Distance from pattern to subject sets how sharp the shadows are. Key side is wherever that lamp sits, often high and off axis. Color is often white moonlight gel or hard tungsten. Flag spill so the pattern is not washed out. Prompt: Gobo-patterned light on [Subject], venetian blinds, bars, or branches throwing graphic shadows across face and wall.
- 何时用：Use it when the room should write on the person, blinds on a liar, bars on a prisoner. Do not use it as default texture on every close-up.
- 近似对比：Dappled light, Hard light, Window light, Split lighting, Film noir, Hard LightGrit, noon sun, or interrogation., Dappled LightNature or blinds as gobo., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Dappled light is irregular and natural. Hard light is the quality a gobo needs. Window light through blinds is a motivated gobo. Split lighting is a half-face cut without a pattern. Film noir is a genre look that often employs this tool. Hard LightGrit, noon sun, or interrogation. Dappled LightNature or blinds as gobo. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：The Conformist (Storaro) throws architectural slats and graphic shadows across faces and walls. Classic film noir uses blinds and bars as cages.；The pattern is placed, not accidental leaf scatter.
- Prompt 模板：`Gobo-patterned light on [Subject], venetian blinds, bars, or branches throwing graphic shadows across face and wall.`
- Prompt 要点：Name the object in the beam. " Specify a hard source. / Keep the pattern sharp enough to read.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is dappled leaf scatter or soft wrap that eats the slats. The tell is fuzzy blobs, or no pattern at all. Fix it by hardening the source and putting a real slat or cucoloris in the beam.

### Volumetric Light
- 别名：god rays, crepuscular rays ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/volumetric-light)
- 定义：Volumetric lighting makes beams visible through haze, fog, dust, smoke, or other particles, so the air photographs as well as the subject. Also called god rays or crepuscular rays when the shafts are distinct.
- 叙事功能：Air has to be photographed. A cathedral, a forest, a smoky archive: the beam is architecture. The source implies a world outside the frame. Without particles you only see where the light lands, not the path it took. It is the wrong tool in clean air if you still want shafts, or when haze is so thick that every depth plane flattens. Disconnected glowing stripes with no lamp are not volumetric light. They are stickers.
- 怎么拍：You need a directional source (often hard, slightly back or high) and a scattering medium: haze, dust, rain, smoke. The camera usually sees some of the beam angle, which is why backlight helps. Color follows the source: warm sun, cool window, searchlight white. Limit haze so foreground and background still separate. Prompt: Volumetric rays through haze around [Subject], visible beams, dust in the shaft, cathedral or forest light as architecture.
- 何时用：Use it when the air is part of the picture, a smoky interior, a forest morning, a searchlight. Do not add floating stripes with no source and no medium.
- 近似对比：Backlight, Atmospheric haze, Dappled light, Epiphany, Silhouette, Atmospheric HazeShow kilometers, not just meters., BacklightSeparate a dark figure from a dark world., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Backlight is the direction that often reveals volume. Atmospheric haze is the medium. Dappled light patterns surfaces; volume patterns the air. Epiphany may use a sudden shaft, but epiphany is a change timed to understanding. Silhouette can sit inside a bright shaft if the figure stays dark. Atmospheric HazeShow kilometers, not just meters. BacklightSeparate a dark figure from a dark world. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Blade Runner 2049 builds interiors where dust and haze make shafts physical. The Tree of Life lets forest and interior sun become visible architecture.；Blade Runner (1982) searchlights through smoke are the same physics.
- Prompt 模板：`Volumetric god rays through haze around [Subject], visible beams, dust in the shaft, cathedral or forest light as architecture.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name source plus medium. " Attach every beam to a window, sun, or searchlight.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid disconnected glowing stripes.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a backlight rim with no air, or painted god-ray stickers. The tell is stripes that ignore the lamp and the body. Fix it by adding a scattering medium and a real rear or high source, then letting the body interrupt the beam.

### Cameo Lighting
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/cameo-lighting)
- 定义：Cameo lighting isolates a lit subject against a predominantly dark environment, so the figure sits in a pool and the world falls to black. The person remains modeled; the set is withheld.
- 叙事功能：Erase the world, keep the person. Theatre-to-screen work, interrogation, and some comic-book night use a pool that does not describe architecture. The audience gets a bust or a full figure as if cut from a void. It is the wrong tool when geography is the plot, or when you still want rain, furniture, and city in the frame. If the figure is also unmodeled and the ground is bright, you have a silhouette, the inverse. If a hard circle with a visible edge is the point, prefer spotlight.
- 怎么拍：Key the subject (any portrait pattern) and kill all ambient and bounce with black wrap, distance, and flags. The background goes underexposed to black, not to a dimly readable room (low-key can still imply walls). Hardness and color are free; isolation is the job. Prompt: Cameo lighting on [Subject], figure isolated in a pool against a black void, theatrical isolation, no environment.
- 何时用：Use it when the world should vanish and the person remain, a confession, a stage aside. Do not use it for a chase that needs corridors.
- 近似对比：Spotlight, Low-key lighting, High-key lighting, Epiphany, Silhouette, Low-Key LightingMystery, crime, or moral night., High-Key LightingComedy, heaven, hospital, or candy., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Spotlight is a hard-edged theatrical pool from a focused instrument. Cameo is the isolation result, which can use a softer key. Low-key lighting still allows a dark room to exist. High-key lighting is the opposite field. Epiphany is a change of light timed to thought, not a static void. Silhouette puts a dark figure on a bright field. Low-Key LightingMystery, crime, or moral night. High-Key LightingComedy, heaven, hospital, or candy. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：The Batman isolates figures in pools against withheld environments. Stage-to-screen work, including dark-stage passages in Birdman, treats the actor as a cutout in black.；The Elephant Man also parks bodies in isolated pools. The set is missing on purpose.
- Prompt 模板：`Cameo lighting on [Subject], figure isolated in a pool against a black void, theatrical spotlight, no environment.`
- Prompt 要点：Kill the room. " Keep the face modeled. / Forbid a readable set and a bright sky.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is low-key with a still-visible room, or silhouette. The tell is furniture in the dark, or an unlit figure on a bright ground. Fix it by exposing the person and letting the background go truly black.

### Epiphany
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/epiphany)
- 定义：Epiphany lighting is a change of illumination that makes a face or figure suddenly the brightest readable fact in the room as a realization lands. The light finds the person; it is timed to understanding, not left as a static setup.
- 叙事功能：Thought becomes visible. A dim interior, a forest, a chapel: something shifts (a cloud, a door, a hidden unit, a match) and the face takes the key as if the idea switched a lamp. Spiritual and interior films use the change; the audience reads insight as exposure. It is the wrong tool for a whole scene that is merely pretty, or for a jump scare flash. If the pool never changes, you have cameo or a static shaft. If the beam is only atmosphere, you have volumetric light without a thought.
- 怎么拍：Start under, then raise a motivated source on the face: sun through cloud, a door opening, a practical turned up, a flagged unit revealed. Direction often comes from above or behind so it can feel given rather than a frontal beauty key. Hardness can be soft wrap or a sudden shaft; color often goes warmer or clearer than the preceding gloom. In video, the change is the shot. Prompt: Epiphany light on [Subject], a sudden intelligible brightness, as if the thought itself switched a lamp. Motion: Light finds [Subject] as a realization lands, the face becoming the brightest fact in the room.
- 何时用：Use it when understanding should be visible, a decision, a grace, a confession that lands. Do not use a random brightness bump with no story cause.
- 近似对比：Cameo lighting, Volumetric light, Spotlight, High-key, Cameo LightingErase the world. Keep the person., Volumetric LightAir has to be photographed, not just the subject., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Cameo lighting isolates a figure in a static pool. Volumetric light shows beams in air; epiphany may use that, but the job is the timed change on a face. Spotlight is a theatrical instrument, not necessarily a thought. High-key is a whole-frame ratio, not a reveal. Cameo LightingErase the world. Keep the person. Volumetric LightAir has to be photographed, not just the subject. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：The Tree of Life lets sun and interior light arrive as if attention itself brightened. Silence uses sudden or given light on faces at moments of spiritual crisis.；The grammar is the change, not a lens flare sticker.
- Prompt 模板：`Write the before and after. Still: "Epiphany light on [Subject], a sudden intelligible brightness, as if the thought itself switched a lamp." Video: "Light finds [Subject] as a realization lands, the face becoming the brightest fact in the room." Name what caused the change (sun, door, lamp).`
- 示例 Prompt：`Light finds [Subject] as a realization lands, the face becoming the brightest fact in the room.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a static cameo or a decorative volumetric shaft. The tell is no change, or brightness with no cause. Fix it by starting darker and letting a motivated source find the face at the thought.

### Spotlight
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/spotlight)
- 定义：A spotlight in spotlight cinematography is a focused, hard-edged pool from a theatrical or similar instrument, with darkness around the circle. The person is treated as an act inside that pool.
- 叙事功能：The stage is a circle of light. A drummer, a speaker, a dancer: the instrument has a beam you can see the edge of, and stepping out of it is stepping out of the scene. Theatre and concert coverage use it because the world really is that lamp. It is the wrong tool for a motivated apartment, or for a soft cameo with no circle. If the pool has no edge, you have a general key in a dark room. If the figure is isolated but the source is a large silk, that is cameo, not a spot.
- 怎么拍：Use a focused fixture (ellipsoidal, follow spot, PAR with a tight lens) with shutters or an iris so the pool has a hard edge. Place it high and frontal or high and slightly front-side, the theatrical default. Hardness is hard; falloff at the circle is sudden. Color is often white or a theatrical gel. The surround is unlit. Prompt: Spotlight on [Subject], a hard pool, theater darkness around, the person as an act.
- 何时用：Use it when the stage is a circle of light, a solo, a speech, a club act. Do not use it as the key in a kitchen that has no such instrument.
- 近似对比：Cameo lighting, Hard light, Top light, Cross lighting, Epiphany, Cameo LightingErase the world. Keep the person., Hard LightGrit, noon sun, or interrogation., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Cameo lighting is isolation; a spotlight is one hard instrument that can create that isolation with a visible circle. Hard light is the quality. Top light may come from above without a circular shuttered pool. Cross lighting is two concert keys, not necessarily irised spots. Epiphany is a story-timed change, which a spotlight snap can serve. Cameo LightingErase the world. Keep the person. Hard LightGrit, noon sun, or interrogation. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：Whiplash puts players in hard stage pools. Birdman's theatre scenes treat follow spots and stage lamps as the world of the act.；The edge of the circle is the set line.
- Prompt 模板：`Demand a hard pool and a dark surround. " Mention a visible circle or shuttered edge.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Spotlight on [Subject], a hard pool, theater darkness around, the person as an act.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid a large soft wrap.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a soft cameo or a general hard key. The tell is no circle, or wrap that lights the floor evenly. Fix it by irising a focused fixture and letting the edge of the pool be visible.

### Glam
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lighting/glam)
- 定义：Glam lighting, in glam lighting terms, is a large beauty key with catchlights in the eyes and a little diffusion on skin, built to sell the face. It is a package of size, frontal or near-frontal placement, and skin treatment, not a single nose-shadow pattern.
- 叙事功能：Fashion, stardom, a singer at a mirror: pores calm down, eyes live, the face is a product the camera can love. The key is large, often slightly high, and fill is generous enough that neither cheek dies. It is the wrong tool for grit, illness, or a liar in a dark bar. Glam is not butterfly by default (butterfly is the Paramount nose shadow; glam can be loop or almost frontal). It is not high-key unless the whole set is also bright. It is not generic soft light; a large side key can be soft and still un-glamorous.
- 怎么拍：Use a large source near camera, slightly above the lens, with optional bounce below so sockets do not hole. Hardness is soft. Color is beauty-neutral or slightly warm (tungsten or daylight, not sick green). Add a weak hair edge if the set is dark. Diffusion on the lens or source keeps speculars kind. Catchlights should sit in the irises as lamps, not grids projected on the face. Prompt: Soft beauty key on [Subject], large source, catchlights inside the eyes, a little diffusion on skin. No projected squares or grids on the face.
- 何时用：Use it to sell the face, a star close-up, a beauty still, a romantic hero the story wants us to want. Do not use it on a corpse, a boxing cut, or a documentary interview that should look found.
- 近似对比：Butterfly lighting, Soft light, High-key lighting, Eye light, Three-point lighting, Naturalistic ambient, Butterfly LightingBeauty lighting with structure., Soft LightBeauty, memory, or kindness., Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
  Butterfly lighting is a specific high on-axis nose shadow often used inside glam. Soft light is only hardness. High-key lighting is frame contrast. Eye light is the catchlight subset. Three-point lighting can be glamorous if the key is large and frontal enough, but three-point includes a back that glam may skip. Naturalistic ambient hides this package on purpose. Butterfly LightingBeauty lighting with structure. Soft LightBeauty, memory, or kindness. Three-Point LightingTeachable portrait. Start here, then break it.
- 片中实例：A Star Is Born (both the concert close-ups and the makeover grammar) uses large beauty keys when stardom is the product. Fashion films and work in the neighborhood of Carol or Phantom Thread sell faces with size, catchlights, and controlled skin, then withdraw the package when the story turns ugly.
- Prompt 模板：`Sell the face with physics, not a mood word. Use: "Soft beauty key on [Subject], large source, catchlights inside the eyes, a little diffusion on skin.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Soft beauty key on [Subject], large source, catchlights inside the eyes, a little diffusion on skin. No projected squares or grids on the face.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is butterfly with a small hard source, or a grid of catchlights printed on the skin. The tell is a razor nose shadow, hollow sockets, or square projections on the cheeks. Fix it by enlarging the key, moving it near the lens, and keeping catchlights inside the irises only.

### Rule of Thirds
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/rule-of-thirds)
- 定义：The rule of thirds in rule of thirds cinematography divides the frame into nine equal cells and parks important masses on those lines or at their four intersections. The horizon usually sits on an upper or lower third so land and sky are not equal partners, and the subject usually sits off-center with look-space in the larger remaining field.
- 叙事功能：Treat the frame as a diagram of who owns space. Thirds is a default, not a law. A face on a power intersection hands the bigger rectangle to the look, the weather, or the threat. The strip behind the head is leftover, not decoration. It is the wrong tool when the beat needs a formal altar, a trap, or a joke about order. Dead-center ritual, short-sided panic, and poster symmetry all break the grid on purpose. If you apply thirds to every close-up, the diagram stops meaning anything. A model that hears only balanced composition will center the face and split the sky in half. Name which intersection holds the eyes and which third holds the horizon.
- 怎么拍：Turn on the 3x3 overlay on the monitor. Place eyes, a head, or a landmark on an intersection, not in the dead middle of a cell. Keep the camera level unless a roll is the point. A 35mm to 50mm keeps the grid honest. Ultra-wide glass stretches the outer thirds into cartoon corners. Telephoto compresses them into stacked bands. Prompt: Rule-of-thirds placement of [Subject] on a power intersection, horizon on a third, breathing room in the look direction.
- 何时用：Use it on a landscape walk, a single looking off, or an establishing wide that must feel occupied without becoming an altar. Do not treat it as a religion on every close-up, title card, or ritual tableau.
- 近似对比：Lead Room, Centered Composition, Short Siding, Golden RatioA more secret order than thirds., Lead RoomThey are going somewhere, even if standing., Central FramingPut them on the crosshairs.
  618 instead of one-third. Lead Room is the horizontal air that thirds usually create for a look or a walk. Centered Composition refuses the offset and puts the subject on the axis. Short Siding is the opposite diagram: the look is crushed against the edge it faces. Golden RatioA more secret order than thirds. Lead RoomThey are going somewhere, even if standing. Central FramingPut them on the crosshairs.
- 片中实例：Classical coverage treats thirds as the default diagram for singles and landscapes. Lawrence of Arabia parks horizons on a third so desert owns the rest of the frame.；Days of Heaven does the same with prairie and sky. There Will Be Blood often offsets a figure so land outweighs the person.；These are grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Write the grid, not a mood. Rule-of-thirds placement of [Subject] on a power intersection, horizon on a third, breathing room in the look direction.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Rule-of-thirds placement of [Subject] on a power intersection, horizon on a third, breathing room in the look direction.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is dead-center portrait posing as thirds. The tell is a face on the optical axis with equal sky and equal leftover on both ears. The fix is to slide the eyes to an intersection and give the look the larger field, or admit you wanted Central Framing and shoot that instead.

### Golden Ratio
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/golden-ratio)
- 定义：Golden ratio composition organizes the frame with proportional relationships near phi, about eight to five, as a phi grid or a logarithmic spiral rather than a 3x3. The main mass sits closer to center than a third, and the eye is asked to travel a curve through secondary masses instead of jumping cell to cell.
- 叙事功能：Phi is a more secret order than thirds. The diagram still asks who owns space, but the large field is not a blunt two-thirds slab. A spiral from a corner through a face, then through a doorway, then into empty weather, can feel inevitable without announcing a grid. It is the wrong tool when the audience needs the diagram in one glance. Action geography, comedy blocking, and most coverage live on simpler axes. If you cannot point to a curve the eye actually rides, you are decorating with math. Painters used these proportions because canvases hold still. In a moving shot the spiral has to survive a pan, a walk, and a focus change. Design the still first, then see if the move keeps the curve.
- 怎么拍：A phi grid places lines at about 38 percent and 62 percent, inward of a thirds overlay. A golden spiral is a path, not a stamp: start at a quiet corner and coil toward the face or the object of the look. Keep the camera level. Moderate glass (40mm to 65mm) preserves the proportions. Ultra-wide will fake a spiral by bending the room. Prompt: Golden-ratio spiral composition around [Subject], the eye traveling a harmonic curve rather than a grid.
- 何时用：Use it on a painterly hold: a portrait in a designed room, a landscape where a path, a tree, and a figure actually coil. Do not overlay a spiral on a shot whose masses do not sit on that curve.
- 近似对比：Rule of Thirds, Centered Composition, Leading Lines, Central Framing, Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose., Centered CompositionControl, ritual, comedy, or fate., Central FramingPut them on the crosshairs.
  Rule of Thirds is the coarser default, lines at one-third, faster to set. Centered Composition plants the subject on the axis and ignores the spiral. Leading Lines can trace the same curve if the architecture supplies it, but leading lines do not require phi. If the picture is a bullseye, you wanted Central Framing. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose. Centered CompositionControl, ritual, comedy, or fate. Central FramingPut them on the crosshairs.
- 片中实例：Painterly cinema often organizes near these proportions without announcing them. Barry Lyndon holds figures and furniture in quiet harmonic rooms.；The Tree of Life lets landscape, light, and a small body share a coil rather than a grid. Portrait of a Lady on Fire stages faces and firelight as a slow curve of attention.；Grammar, not overlays to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the curve and the destination. Golden-ratio spiral composition around [Subject], the eye traveling a harmonic curve rather than a grid.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Say where the coil starts (corner, doorway, shoreline) and where it lands (eyes, hands, a window). Do not write Fibonacci as a sticker.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is thirds with a spiral graphic imagined on top. The tell is a face on a 33 percent line and a prompt that only says golden. The fix is to move the mass inward toward 62 percent, or to build an actual path of secondary objects the eye can ride.

### Central Framing
- 别名：dead center, center punch ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/central-framing)
- 定义：Central framing, also called dead center or center punch, places the figure on the optical axis so the body sits on the crosshairs of the frame. Bilateral weight may gather around that body, but the first fact is placement: the person is the altar, not a guest in a third.
- 叙事功能：Put them on the crosshairs and the diagram changes. Off-center space no longer belongs to the look. Both leftover fields become equal attendants. The subject owns the axis. Everyone else owns the wings. It is the wrong tool when the character should be hunting, fleeing, or eavesdropping. A center punch on a spy in a crowd makes them a poster. A center punch on a god, a child in costume, a dictator, or a comic stiff makes the formality legible. You can center-punch a face in a messy room. That is still central framing. The architecture does not have to salute. If the whole room salutes, you have walked into centered composition and maybe into symmetry.
- 怎么拍：Align the lens axis with the sternum or the bridge of the nose. Keep verticals upright unless you want a joke or a threat. A longer lens (65mm to 85mm) isolates the bullseye. A wider lens will show whether the room is also axial. Check both ears have similar leftover, then decide if that equality is the point. Prompt: Central framing of [Subject], the figure on the optical axis, bilateral weight, a formal altar in the frame.
- 何时用：Use it when a character must be presented, judged, or worshipped: an arrival through doors, a formal portrait, a comic stare into lens. Do not use it on a look-off that needs air in front of the eyes.
- 近似对比：Centered Composition, Symmetry, Rule of Thirds, One-Point Perspective, Centered CompositionControl, ritual, comedy, or fate., SymmetryThe world is designed. Or pretending to be., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Centered Composition organizes the entire field around the axis, often as a frontal tableau. Central framing can be just the body on the crosshairs. Symmetry mirrors masses. You can punch a face dead center in an asymmetric street. Rule of Thirds is the default you are breaking. One-Point Perspective adds a vanishing point on that same axis. Centered CompositionControl, ritual, comedy, or fate. SymmetryThe world is designed. Or pretending to be. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：The Grand Budapest Hotel center-punches concierges and guests as if they were stamps. Moonrise Kingdom does the same with children in uniform, frontal and unembarrassed.；The formality is the joke and the tenderness. Grammar, not a Wes Anderson costume kit.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the axis. Central framing of [Subject], the figure on the optical axis, bilateral weight, a formal altar in the frame.`
- 示例 Prompt：`If the room must also salute, add frontal architecture. If it must not, say messy sides, figure still dead center.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is thirds with a slightly lazy offset. The tell is more air on the look side than behind the head. The fix is to slide the figure until both leftover fields match, or to admit you wanted Lead Room and keep the offset.

### Centered Composition
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/centered-composition)
- 定义：Centered composition places the dominant subject on or near the central vertical axis and organizes the rest of the picture around that axis. The frame reads as a frontal tableau: walls, furniture, and attendants arranged so the subject is an altar, not an accident of blocking.
- 叙事功能：Control, ritual, comedy, and fate all like this diagram. The person does not borrow space from a third. The room reports to them, or pretends to. Who owns space is settled in advance by the architecture. It is the wrong tool for eavesdropping, pursuit, and most dialogue that needs a look-off. If the sides are busy with unequal life, you have an offset picture with a centered head, which is a different sentence. Wes Anderson made the grammar famous, which is a reason to be precise. Formality is the instrument. Pastel luggage is not.
- 怎么拍：Square the camera to the back wall. Match left and right masses, or let a planned mismatch be the only joke. Keep the lens on the centerline of the set, not a casual handheld approximation. A 27mm to 40mm will show the room's obedience. Longer glass will crop the salute and leave you with mere central framing. Prompt: Dead-center composition of [Subject], bilateral symmetry or frontal tableau, Wes Anderson formality, the subject as altar.
- 何时用：Use it for a ritual entrance, a desk of power, a dollhouse comedy, or a fate that feels designed. Do not use it on a chase or a whispered aside that should feel stolen.
- 近似对比：Central Framing, Symmetry, One-Point Perspective, Tableau, SymmetryThe world is designed. Or pretending to be., One-Point PerspectiveDestiny has a vanishing point., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Central Framing only demands the body on the crosshairs. Centered composition demands the field. Symmetry is the stronger claim that left mirrors right. You can center a subject in a room that is not a mirror. One-Point Perspective adds a vanishing point on the same axis, a tunnel instead of a flat altar. Tableau holds the arrangement in time. SymmetryThe world is designed. Or pretending to be. One-Point PerspectiveDestiny has a vanishing point. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：The Grand Budapest Hotel builds hotel interiors as frontal altars. Moonrise Kingdom presents tents, churches, and children as arranged diagrams.；Both films let a small human deviation read loudly because the axis was so clean. Grammar, not a production-design costume.
- Prompt 模板：`Ask for the whole altar. Dead-center composition of [Subject], bilateral symmetry or frontal tableau, Wes Anderson formality, the subject as altar.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Dead-center composition of [Subject], bilateral symmetry or frontal tableau, Wes Anderson formality, the subject as altar.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a centered head in an uncomposed room. The tell is a bullseye face with a plant on one side and a door on the other. The fix is to square the camera, match the masses, or switch to Central Framing and let the mess be honest.

### Symmetry
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/symmetry)
- 定义：Symmetry in a symmetrical composition balances visual masses around an axis, usually the vertical centerline, so left answers right. The world looks designed, or it is pretending to be, whether or not a person occupies the middle.
- 叙事功能：When left mirrors right, nobody owns a secret side of the frame. Space is ceremonial. A small break (a crooked tie, a missing lamp, a person one step off axis) becomes the whole event. It is the wrong tool when life should feel unarranged. A kitchen argument, a chase, a documentary street: forcing a mirror there is a lie unless the lie is the point (a showroom, a regime, a dream). Symmetry is not the same as centering a face. A mirrored corridor can swallow a figure who is slightly late to their mark. The architecture still owns the diagram.
- 怎么拍：Place the camera on the centerline of the set. Match practicals, furniture, and verticals. Use a level. One-point architecture helps but is not required: a flat elevation of a facade can be a mirror without a vanishing tunnel. Stop down if both wings must stay sharp. Prompt: Perfect symmetry around [Subject], mirrored architecture, a central axis, obsessive order.
- 何时用：Use it when the location is a machine of order: hotel, chapel, spaceship, courtroom, dollhouse. Do not use it as wallpaper on a location that has no axis.
- 近似对比：Centered Composition, One-Point Perspective, Repetition and Pattern, Asymmetry, Centered CompositionControl, ritual, comedy, or fate., One-Point PerspectiveDestiny has a vanishing point., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Centered Composition plants a subject on the axis. Symmetry mirrors the field, with or without that subject. One-Point Perspective is a perspective construction that often produces symmetry, but two wings can match in a flat, shallow picture with no tunnel. Repetition and Pattern repeats units without requiring a mirror. Asymmetry is the refusal. Centered CompositionControl, ritual, comedy, or fate. One-Point PerspectiveDestiny has a vanishing point. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：The Grand Budapest Hotel treats hotels as mirrored diagrams of service. 2001: A Space Odyssey uses axial, bilateral order as a claim that the future is designed.；A fingerprint on that order reads as error or omen. Grammar, not a filter.
- Prompt 模板：`Demand the mirror. Perfect symmetry around [Subject], mirrored architecture, a central axis, obsessive order.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Perfect symmetry around [Subject], mirrored architecture, a central axis, obsessive order.`
- Prompt 要点：If a break matters, name the one unmatched object.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a centered actor in an unmatched room. The tell is a bullseye face and a window only on the left. The fix is to move the camera onto the architectural axis, or to drop the claim and shoot Asymmetry with real counterweight.

### Asymmetry
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/asymmetry)
- 定义：Asymmetry, or asymmetrical composition, offsets the dominant mass and answers it with a different kind of weight: color, light, a small face, a dark void, or a distant doorway. The frame does not mirror, so leftover space is a counterweight rather than a matching wing.
- 叙事功能：Who owns space is unsettled. A woman in a corridor may occupy a sliver while red wallpaper and a lamp own the rest. A driver may sit in a third of night while neon and road own the surplus. The counterweight is the point, not the empty accident of a bad mark. It is the wrong tool when the scene is a ceremony of order. If both sides should salute, shoot the mirror. If the character should be presented as an altar, do not hide them in a wing. Asymmetry is not automatically thirds. Thirds is one recipe for offset. You can hang a figure in a far corner and balance them with a bright speck, which is visual weight, not a student grid.
- 怎么拍：Place the main body off the centerline. Find a counterweight: a practical, a second figure, a block of color, a window. Check the frame on a monitor without overlay first. If it tips over, add weight or crop. A slightly wide lens (32mm to 40mm) lets the unused field stay a real place. Prompt: Asymmetrical balance with [Subject] offset, counterweights of color or mass, tension instead of mirror.
- 何时用：Use it for desire, class, loneliness, and any conversation where the room is not fair. Do not use it as a default mess: unmotivated clutter is not balance.
- 近似对比：Rule of Thirds, Visual Weight, Symmetry, Short Siding, Negative Space, Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose., Visual WeightThe eye should land where the story is., Golden RatioA more secret order than thirds.
  Rule of Thirds is a specific offset grid. Asymmetry is the larger family. Visual Weight is the currency that makes an unequal picture hold. Symmetry is the opposite claim. Short Siding is a harsh asymmetric trap that denies look-space rather than composing a counterweight. Negative Space lets emptiness itself be the other mass. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose. Visual WeightThe eye should land where the story is. Golden RatioA more secret order than thirds.
- 片中实例：In the Mood for Love parks bodies in corridors and door gaps so wallpaper, lamps, and rain own as much as faces. Drive lets night, steel, and neon outweigh a still driver.；The pictures hold because something answers the offset. Grammar, not mood boards.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the offset and the answer. Asymmetrical balance with [Subject] offset, counterweights of color or mass, tension instead of mirror.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Say which side holds the body and what holds the other side (lamp, doorway, red wall, dark road). Do not write unbalanced as a mood.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a failed centered shot. The tell is a person who missed their mark and nothing answering them. The fix is to add a real counterweight, move them to a thirds intersection, or recenter and own Symmetry.

### Leading Lines
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/leading-lines)
- 定义：Leading lines in leading lines cinematography are edges, rails, roads, corridors, shadows, or gestures that steer the eye toward or through the image. The lines are vectors in the diagram, not decoration around a centered face.
- 叙事功能：If a corridor, a rail, or a carpet chevron aims at a person, that person owns the destination and the building owns the path. If the lines aim past them, the person is a gate and infinity owns the rest. It is the wrong tool when the location has no honest vector. Drawing implied arrows in a bland room is a graphic lie. A close-up that needs only a face does not need a railroad. Lines can be one-point, two-point, or even a curve. The job is the same: decide where the eye is forced to land, and whether that landing is a face, a door, or a vanishing field.
- 怎么拍：Find real edges in the set: baseboards, rails, a road, a shadow from a hard source. Place the camera so those edges converge on the intended mass. A wider lens (24mm to 35mm) strengthens convergence. A long lens flattens lines into stacks, which is compression, not pointing. Keep the horizon level unless the line itself is a dutch. Prompt: Leading lines driving the eye to [Subject], rails, corridors, roads, or shadows converging on the figure.
- 何时用：Use it when a location can aim: station, hotel hall, highway, trench, church nave. Do not invent converging furniture in a set that is actually a box of leftovers.
- 近似对比：Vanishing Point, One-Point Perspective, Diagonal Composition, Architexture, Vanishing PointThere is a long way still to go., One-Point PerspectiveDestiny has a vanishing point., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Vanishing Point is where parallel lines appear to meet. Leading lines may never meet in frame. One-Point Perspective is a full axial construction with one dominant vanishing point. Leading lines can be a single railing cutting a messy room. Diagonal Composition uses bias energy even when nothing converges. Architexture fills the frame with material until pointing is secondary. Vanishing PointThere is a long way still to go. One-Point PerspectiveDestiny has a vanishing point. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：The Shining aims carpets, halls, and a tricycle path at whatever waits. The Deer Hunter uses steel, roads, and industrial edges to shove attention through working space.；The lines are geography, not stickers. Grammar, not a maze to clone.
- Prompt 模板：`Say what the lines are made of. If they should miss the person and continue, say the figure is a gate, lines continuing to a distant point.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the vector and the landing. Leading lines driving the eye to [Subject], rails, corridors, roads, or shadows converging on the figure.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a centered portrait with random architecture. The tell is a face in the middle and walls that do not aim. The fix is to move the camera until an edge actually hits the subject, or to drop the claim and shoot a clean portrait.

### Frame within Frame
- 别名：Doorway framing, Surcadrage ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/frame-in-frame)
- 定义：A frame within a frame (doorway framing, surcadrage) puts a second rectangle inside the screen, a door, window, arch, mirror, or gap that encloses the subject. The inner aperture is a second boundary, and crossing it is a beat, not a decoration.
- 叙事功能：Someone is watched, trapped, or pictured. The inner frame decides who is allowed in the picture of the picture. A man in a doorway is either coming home or locked out, depending on which side of the jamb we stand. It is the wrong tool when the second rectangle is only a pretty arch behind a centered face. If nobody could enter or leave that aperture, you added a sticker. Dirty edges chew. A frame-in-frame cuts a clean inner border. You can have both: a dirty outer view through a clean door. Decide which border owns the subject.
- 怎么拍：Compose two rectangles. Place the camera so the inner opening has readable sides, top, and (often) threshold. Control exposure between the two spaces: interior warm, exterior cold, or the reverse. A moderate wide (32mm to 40mm) shows both borders. If the inner frame swallows the outer, you have simply recropped. Prompt: Frame-within-frame around [Subject], doorway, window, mirror, or arch as a second rectangle, nested attention.
- 何时用：Use it for arrivals, farewells, affairs in corridors, and anyone pictured by a house. Do not drop a random arch behind a portrait and call it nested attention.
- 近似对比：Dirty Frame, Windows, Screen in Screen, Negative Space, Voyeur, Dirty FrameWe are not supposed to have this view., Negative SpaceLoneliness needs room., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Dirty Frame occupies the outer edges with out-of-focus matter. Frame-in-frame is a graphic inner border, often sharp. Windows stacks many apertures until the building is a grid of shots. Screen in Screen is a picture that is itself a display. Negative Space can surround a small inner frame with emptiness. Voyeur is the ethical position of watching through that aperture from concealment. Dirty FrameWe are not supposed to have this view. Negative SpaceLoneliness needs room. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：The Searchers opens and closes on doorway compositions: desert and home as two countries split by a jamb.
