In the Mood for Love uses doorframes and corridor gaps to contain encounters that cannot be public.；Entering or leaving the inner rectangle is the cut you do not have to make.；The Searchers 1956The opening and closing doorway compositions.；In the Mood for Love 2000Doorframes and corridors contain the encounters.
- Prompt 模板：`From inside a dim farmhouse, hold on a bright rectangular doorway framing a lone traveler outside. The family passes into the room while the traveler remains beyond the threshold. Locked wide shot, no push-in, natural exposure contrast.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name both rectangles. Frame-within-frame around [Subject], doorway, window, mirror, or arch as a second rectangle, nested attention.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a decorative arch. The tell is an ornamental curve that nobody could walk through, with the subject already filling the screen. The fix is to show the inner border on at least three sides and to give the threshold a job.

### Negative Space
- 别名：Unbalanced framing, Short-sided composition ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/negative-space)
- 定义：Negative space in negative space cinematography leaves a large, relatively empty area around or beside the subject so absence becomes a mass. The unoccupied field is still a world (sky, wall, snow, sea), and the subject occupies a small or unusual portion of the diagram.
- 叙事功能：Loneliness needs room. So does dread, and so does waiting. A face low under a slab of architecture, a man tiny in a desert, a woman with a blank wall as her partner: the empty area is the other character. It is the wrong tool when the scene is crowded with story. If the blank wall is just an unlit set, you underexposed a failure. Empty is not automatically meaningful. Unbalanced framing and short-sided composition are cousins, not synonyms. Negative space can sit above a head (headroom as weather), beside a look (air as future), or all around a speck (the world as indifference).
- 怎么拍：Decide what the unoccupied area means before you widen. Control eyeline, headroom, and background detail. A longer lens can isolate a small figure against a simple field. A wide lens can make the field truly large. Do not automatically rebalance. Stop down if the empty weather must stay a texture, or open up if it should melt to tone. Prompt: Vast negative space around [Subject], the figure small, absence as weight, Antonioni emptiness.
- 何时用：Use it when isolation, waiting, or land must outweigh a person: a figure under sky, a face under ceiling, a body at the edge of a pale wall. Do not confuse a blank backdrop with a designed void, and do not auto-balance if the imbalance is the beat.
- 近似对比：Extreme Long Shot, Short Siding, Void, Clean Frame, Headroom, Extreme Long ShotScale is the emotion., Short SidingDeny the character air., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Extreme Long Shot is a size that often produces this space. Negative space can also crush a close face under ceiling. Short Siding specifically denies look-space. Negative space may sit in any direction. Void erases the set into nothing. Negative space still belongs to a world. Clean Frame tidies edges without requiring a small subject. Headroom is the vertical slice of this idea. Extreme Long ShotScale is the emotion. Short SidingDeny the character air. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：Ida parks faces low under large fields of architecture and sky. L'Avventura lets islands and empty coasts outweigh the searchers.；Her uses pale interiors and city air as partners for a small body. Mr.；Turner subordinates figures to weather. No Country for Old Men lets landscape refuse comfort.；Grammar of absence, not a desert kit.；Ida 2013Low-positioned faces beneath large areas of architecture and sky.；Mr. Turner 2014Figures can be subordinated to large spaces and atmosphere.
- Prompt 模板：`A young woman sits in the bottom-right corner of a tall, nearly empty waiting room. Most of the frame is pale wall and high windows. She looks toward the near edge rather than into the empty space. Static shot, restrained performance, no decorative camera movement.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the field (wall, sky, snow, sea) and the placement (low in frame, far right, a speck). Do not write lonely as a substitute for geometry.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is an Extreme Long Shot with a busy horizon. The tell is a small figure against cluttered detail that competes. The fix is to simplify the field, or to own the clutter as Architexture instead of claiming emptiness.

### Foreground Interest
- 别名：foreground anchor, foreground element, Dirty frame, Occluded observation ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/foreground-interest)
- 定义：Foreground interest (a foreground anchor or occluded observation) puts a salient near object between the lens and the subject: flowers, a fence, glass, a table, or a body. The near layer creates depth, scale, a visual entry, or partial concealment, so air and obstacle sit between us and them.
- 叙事功能：The diagram now has a landlord in front of the camera. A bedpost, a shoulder, a glass of whisky can own the near third while the scene happens beyond. We feel physically situated. Sometimes we feel we should not be there. It is the wrong tool when the near object covers the decisive face or when it is random clutter. A plant in focus in front of an important mouth is not depth. It is a mistake. Foreground interest can be sharp (a gun on a table, Kane's objects) or soft (flowers as a veil). Sharp near matter stages power. Soft near matter stages eavesdropping.
- 怎么拍：Place a real object close to the lens, on a plane that reads as obstacle. Coordinate its edge with eyes and hands so it conceals by design. A wide or moderate wide (24mm to 40mm) exaggerates the near mass. Open the aperture if the layer should melt. Stop down if the near object is information. Prompt: Strong foreground object between lens and [Subject], dirty aperture of flowers, fence, or glass, layered depth.
- 何时用：Use it to put the camera in a room that already has stuff, to spy, or to show a power object in front of a distant person. Do not let the foreground eat the expression you came for.
- 近似对比：Dirty Frame, Layered Depth, Frame within Frame, Voyeur, Dirty FrameWe are not supposed to have this view., Layered DepthA shot should be walkable., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Dirty Frame specifically chews the outer edges, often all around, as voyeur layers. Foreground interest can be a designed object in the lower frame without dirty corners. Layered Depth asks midground and background to carry action too, not just a pretty veil. Frame within Frame uses a hard inner rectangle rather than an object. Voyeur is the concealment ethic that often uses this layer. Dirty FrameWe are not supposed to have this view. Layered DepthA shot should be walkable. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：Citizen Kane loads tables and objects in the near plane while deals happen beyond. The Graduate frames Benjamin through Mrs.；Robinson's bent leg, a joke of obstruction and power. In the Mood for Love watches through walls and gaps.；The Revenant uses brush, breath, and near nature as obstacles, not stickers.；In the Mood for Love 2000Characters are seen through doorways, walls and narrow architectural gaps.；The Graduate 1967Benjamin is framed through Mrs. Robinson's bent leg.
- Prompt 模板：`Observe two neighbors speaking softly in a stairwell through a narrow gap between a door and its frame. A dark blurred door edge occupies one third of the image. The camera remains hidden and still; both faces remain readable when they lean toward the light.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the near object and whether it is sharp. Strong foreground object between lens and [Subject], dirty aperture of flowers, fence, or glass, layered depth.`
- Prompt 要点：If it is a veil, say out of focus foreground.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is accidental clutter. The tell is a menu board or a head slicing a mouth with no relationship to the beat. The fix is to choose the object, place its edge, and pick focus on purpose. Random foreground is not occluded observation.

### Layered Depth
- 别名：Foreground-midground-background action ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/layered-depth)
- 定义：Layered depth, or layered composition, stages important action on at least two distances, typically foreground, midground, and background in one picture. Depth staging is that arrangement, while deep focus is a separate optical choice about how much of it is sharp.
- 叙事功能：Social geometry becomes visible at once. Adults sign a boy's future in a near room while the boy plays in a distant window. A phone booth and a piano split a bar. Who owns space is a matter of which plane can still act. It is the wrong tool when only one plane has story. Three pretty layers of wallpaper are not layered depth. If you cannot imagine walking from the near object to the far door, the diagram is a collage. Do not assume every deep stage must be uniformly sharp. You can hold two actions and still rack. The arrangement is the composition. The iris is the optics.
- 怎么拍：Place meaningful bodies or objects on separate planes with readable gaps. Keep sightlines and entrances clear. Choose a wider lens and more distance if you want natural deep space. Stop down (and add light) if several planes must be sharp. A split diopter is a different cheat. Prompt: Three-plane composition around [Subject], foreground, mid, and deep background all carrying information, deep staging.
- 何时用：Use it when two relationships must be true in one hold: a deal and a child, a dance and a call, a guard and a prisoner. Do not stack bric-a-brac in three zones and call it staging.
- 近似对比：Deep Focus, Foreground Interest, Tableau, One-Point Perspective, Deep FocusLet the audience find the story in the whole room., Foreground InterestPut air and obstacle between us and them., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Deep Focus is the optical result of small aperture and sufficient light, or a digital imitation. Layered depth can exist with selective focus. Foreground Interest only guarantees a near layer. Layered depth requires the far planes to work. Tableau may be deep or flat, but it privileges a fixed arrangement over cutting. One-Point Perspective can organize the walkable space as a tunnel. Deep FocusLet the audience find the story in the whole room. Foreground InterestPut air and obstacle between us and them. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：Citizen Kane stages Kane's future indoors while the boy plays outside the window, planes in one sentence. The Best Years of Our Lives splits a bar between piano and telephone booth so attention has to choose.；The Conformist uses fascist architecture as deep, walkable politics. Grammar of staging, not a focus preset.；Citizen Kane 1941The adults arrange Kane's future while the boy plays outside the window.；The Best Years of Our Lives 1946The bar scene distributes attention between the piano area and the telephone booth.
- Prompt 模板：`A landlord signs a document in the near foreground while, through an open doorway, a family quietly packs in the distant room. Hold both actions in one wide composition. The foreground gesture must not obscure the family. No cut or explanatory insert.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Assign jobs to planes. Three-plane composition around [Subject], foreground, mid, and deep background all carrying information, deep staging.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not write 3D as a slogan.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Deep Focus wallpaper. The tell is everything sharp and only one action. The fix is to put a second story on another plane, or to admit you wanted a single-plane portrait and simplify.

### Diagonal Composition
- 别名：Diagonal lines ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/diagonal-composition)
- 定义：Diagonal composition uses diagonal lines and masses (stairs, rifles, rain, a body on the bias, a street receding on a corner) to raise energy, instability, or depth. The camera can stay level, because the set supplies the tilt of the diagram.
- 叙事功能：Stillness would be a lie if the scene is a riot, a chase down stairs, or a city that will not sit square. Diagonals shove the eye and refuse a calm horizon of furniture. It is the wrong tool for a formal treaty, a joke about order, or a face that needs to be an altar. If you roll the camera to fake a diagonal that the set does not have, you have made a dutch angle, which is a different sentence. A single strong bias line can be enough: a banister, a shadow, a gun. Filling the frame with accidental slants is not composition. It is a crooked set.
- 怎么拍：Keep the head level unless you truly want a dutch. Find a bias vector in blocking or architecture and place the subject on it or against it. A wider lens increases the thrust of a receding diagonal. Hard light can throw a diagonal shadow as a second line. Prompt: Diagonal composition through [Subject], energy on the bias, unstable, rain or stairs as the line.
- 何时用：Use it for stairs, street corners, rain, battles, and any beat where a level diagram would calm the scene down. Do not roll the camera to counterfeit a line the location does not offer.
- 近似对比：Dutch Angle, Leading Lines, One-Point Perspective, Asymmetry, Dutch AngleThe world is off its axis. Do not use as decoration., Leading LinesArchitecture should point., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Dutch Angle rolls the camera so the horizon itself tilts. Diagonal composition can keep a true horizon while stairs and bodies cut across. Leading Lines may be diagonal, but they can also be straight corridors on axis. One-Point Perspective is usually a square, ceremonial tunnel. Asymmetry offsets mass without requiring a bias line. Dutch AngleThe world is off its axis. Do not use as decoration. Leading LinesArchitecture should point. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：Battleship Potemkin drives rifles, stairs, and crowds on the bias so the massacre cannot sit still. The Third Man turns Vienna's streets, stairs, and wet shadows into diagonal traps while the camera is often simply in the right place.；Grammar of instability, not a tilt preset.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the bias line and keep the horizon honest unless you also want a dutch. Diagonal composition through [Subject], energy on the bias, unstable, rain or stairs as the line.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Diagonal composition through [Subject], energy on the bias, unstable, dynamic, rain or stairs as the line.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Dutch Angle. The tell is a tilted horizon and no architectural diagonal. The fix is to level the camera and find stairs, a corner, or a gesture that actually cuts the frame.

### Triangular Composition
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/triangular-composition)
- 定义：Triangular composition arranges subjects or visual masses into a triangle so three points lock the frame. A group gets a hierarchy: the apex is usually power, witness, or the object of desire, and the base is support, threat, or the audience inside the picture.
- 叙事功能：Two people and a desk, a family and a doorway, three men and a gun: the triangle tells you who sits at the top of the diagram. Renaissance blocking taught this before cinema. The camera inherited the altar. It is the wrong tool for a true two-hander that should be a flat axis, or for a crowd that has no hierarchy. Forcing a triangle onto two people plus a plant is a fake court. The apex can be low (a child, a corpse, a briefcase) and still run the picture. Height is not automatically rank. Placement in the triangle is.
- 怎么拍：Block three masses with clear vertices. Check the silhouette on a wide enough lens that all three read (often 27mm to 40mm, or a longer lens at a distance). Keep depth of field sufficient for the intended points. A Three-Shot is a size. The triangle is the geometry inside it. Prompt: Triangular arrangement with [Subject] at an apex, three masses locking the frame, Renaissance blocking.
- 何时用：Use it when a group has a hierarchy: a don and two captains, a family portrait with a secret, a bargaining table. Do not invent a third mass to complete a shape nobody in the scene would form.
- 近似对比：Three-Shot, Visual Weight, Centered Composition, Tableau, Symmetry, Three-ShotA trio has politics., Visual WeightThe eye should land where the story is., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Three-Shot is coverage of three bodies, which may sit in a line. Triangular composition is the pyramid, even if one mass is a doorway or a lamp. Visual Weight decides which vertex wins the eye. Centered Composition may plant the apex on the axis. Tableau can freeze the triangle for duration. Symmetry may split a triangle into a formal court. Three-ShotA trio has politics. Visual WeightThe eye should land where the story is. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：The Godfather uses office blocking as a pyramid of power: who sits, who stands, who waits at the door. Painters' Last Supper language (a central apex, flanking groups) is the ancestor of that court.；Cinema borrowed the altar long before it borrowed the name. Grammar of rank, not a painting to clone.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the three masses and the apex. Triangular arrangement with [Subject] at an apex, three masses locking the frame, Renaissance blocking.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Triangular arrangement with [Subject] at an apex, three masses locking the frame, Renaissance blocking.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a flat Three-Shot in a line. The tell is three heads at one height, no pyramid. The fix is to sit one figure, stand another, and give the third a doorway or a chair so the triangle actually locks.

### Headroom
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/headroom)
- 定义：Headroom in headroom cinematography is the space between the crown of the head and the top frame edge. Tight headroom applies pressure, while generous headroom hands the upper field to air, architecture, or sky.
- 叙事功能：The vertical diagram is easy to ignore until it is wrong. Too much accidental headroom makes a person sink, a student error. Too little clips thought. Deliberate surplus (a nun under a pale wall, a man under oil derricks) makes emptiness a partner. It is the wrong tool to 'fix' by always parking the eyes on a thirds line. Some faces need to be crushed under a ceiling. Some need to float. The rule of thirds is a default for the eyes, not a law for the top edge. Headroom talks to costume and architecture. A tall hat, a halo lamp, a beam: the top edge is a character.
- 怎么拍：Measure from hair to the frame line, not from eyes. For a standard close-up, leave a modest band, enough that a nod will not clip. For pressure, shave it to a hair. For weather or faith, drop the face in the lower third and let ceiling or sky own the rest. Tilt and pedestal change headroom without changing lens. Prompt: Deliberate headroom on [Subject], either tight to the hair (pressure) or generously open (air, God, sky).
- 何时用：Use tight headroom when the room is a trap or the thought has no ceiling. Use open headroom when land, church, or sky must outweigh the skull. Do not leave extra sky because you failed to tilt down.
- 近似对比：Lead Room, Close-Up, Negative Space, Short Siding, Void, Lead RoomThey are going somewhere, even if standing., Close-UpRead micro-expression. Default for important dialogue., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Lead Room is horizontal air in the direction of motion. Headroom is vertical. Close-Up is a size that makes headroom mistakes loud. Negative Space often lives in surplus headroom. Short Siding crushes the look horizontally. Void can eat everything above a face until there is no ceiling, only nothing. Lead RoomThey are going somewhere, even if standing. Close-UpRead micro-expression. Default for important dialogue. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：Classical coverage keeps modest headroom so a nod survives. Ida uses large upper fields of wall and sky as designed surplus, faces low in the diagram.；There Will Be Blood lets derricks and air dwarf a skull. Grammar of the top edge, not a crop preset.
- Prompt 模板：`State tight or open, and what lives in the gap. Deliberate headroom on [Subject], either tight to the hair (pressure) or generously open (air, God, sky).`
- 示例 Prompt：`If open, name the upper field (ceiling, sky, concrete). If tight, say hair almost touching the top frame edge.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is accidental sink, a figure dropped because the operator did not tilt. The tell is leftover ceiling with no job and eyes nowhere near a decision. The fix is to tilt down for a standard portrait, or to own the surplus as Negative Space and compose the face low on purpose.

### Lead Room
- 别名：nose room, looking room ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/lead-room)
- 定义：Lead room in lead room cinematography (nose room, looking room) is space in the direction a subject looks or moves. More frame sits ahead of the walk or the gaze than behind the head, so the surplus is the path rather than leftover wallpaper.
- 叙事功能：The horizontal diagram assigns the future. Air in front of the nose is the path, the other person, the door. Air behind the skull is the past or a trap. Classical coverage buys this air by default. It is the wrong tool when the character has nowhere to go. A prisoner, a liar pinned by a question, a car about to hit a wall: giving them lead room is politeness the scene does not want. Lead room is not automatically thirds. You can give a walker a huge field (almost a landscape) or a modest band in a close-up. The direction of the surplus is the definition.
- 怎么拍：Put the look or the motion toward the empty side. If they walk screen-left, leave more frame on the left. Pan with a walker to keep that surplus, or let them eat it if arrival is the point. A profile needs more lead than a three-quarter. Prompt: Lead room in front of [Subject]'s look or walk, more space in the direction of attention than behind, forward narrative.
- 何时用：Use it for walks, looks that will be answered, and any coverage that should feel like forward grammar. Do not give lead room to a character you mean to trap. That is Short Siding's job.
- 近似对比：Short Siding, Rule of Thirds, Look Space, Headroom, Short SidingDeny the character air., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose., Golden RatioA more secret order than thirds.
  Short Siding crushes the look against the edge they face and parks dead air behind them. Rule of Thirds often creates lead room as a side effect of an offset face. Look Space is the field a gaze owns, especially when the object is off-screen. Lead room includes motion. A still look can be either, but a sprint is lead room first. Headroom is the vertical cousin. Short SidingDeny the character air. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose. Golden RatioA more secret order than thirds.
- 片中实例：Classical coverage puts looking room in front of singles as default grammar, from studio talkies onward. Westerns and road films extend that air into landscape so a rider has a country to enter.；When a film withholds it, you feel the withheld future immediately.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the direction of the surplus. Lead room in front of [Subject]'s look or walk, more space in the direction of attention than behind, forward narrative.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Lead room in front of [Subject]'s look or walk, more space in the direction of attention than behind, forward narrative.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Short Siding by accident. The tell is a profile kissing the edge they look toward, with a warehouse of wallpaper behind the hair. The fix is to pan toward the look until the surplus sits ahead, unless the trap was intended.

### Short Siding
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/short-siding)
- 定义：Short siding places the face near the frame edge the character looks toward, crushing look-space and leaving surplus air behind the head. The edge they face becomes a wall, so the diagram denies them a future in the picture.
- 叙事功能：Deny the character air and the scene tightens without a closer lens. An interrogator, a liar, a person who has just seen the worst thing: they look into almost nothing. The leftover field behind them is wasted country they cannot use. It is the wrong tool for ordinary coverage. Do it by accident and the shot feels like a student pan. Do it on every close-up and the trap stops meaning. Short siding is not the same as a big empty wall. If they look into a vast field, you have negative space in the look. Short siding specifically starves the look.
- 怎么拍：Put the eyes close to the edge they face. Leave the larger field behind the skull. A profile or strong three-quarter makes the crush obvious. You can still use a 50mm or 75mm. The crop does the violence, not a wider lens. Do not correct it in the pan. Prompt: Short-sided framing of [Subject], look space crushed, the face near the frame edge they look toward, trapped or urgent.
- 何时用：Use it for interrogation, guilt, panic, and any beat where the next thing should feel unreachable. Do not use it as default portrait grammar.
- 近似对比：Lead Room, Negative Space, Look Space, Close-Up, Lead RoomThey are going somewhere, even if standing., Negative SpaceLoneliness needs room., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Lead Room is the polite reverse: air ahead of the look. Negative Space may surround a small figure without starving the gaze. Short siding can coexist with a large empty field behind the head, which is negative space used as a trap. Look Space is what you are withholding. Close-Up size makes the crush louder but is not required. Lead RoomThey are going somewhere, even if standing. Negative SpaceLoneliness needs room. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：The Silence of the Lambs uses short-sided faces so conversations feel like cages even in a medium. Prisoners presses heads toward the edge they look into, air wasted behind them.；The grammar is denial, not a filter. Use as pressure, not as a default crop.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the crush. Short-sided framing of [Subject], look space crushed, the face near the frame edge they look toward, trapped or urgent.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Short-sided framing of [Subject], look space crushed, the face near the frame edge they look toward, trapped or urgent.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is accidental bad coverage. The tell is a talking head kissing the look-edge in a scene that is not a trap, often from a rushed pan. The fix is to give Lead Room unless the beat is confinement, in which case hold the crush and stop trying to rebalance.

### Visual Weight
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/visual-weight)
- 定义：Visual weight in visual weight composition is the attention an element attracts through size, contrast, color, position, focus, faces, or motion. A small bright thing can equal a large dark mass, because scale of attention is not scale of object.
- 叙事功能：The diagram is a set of weights, not a ruler. A cigarette in a pool of light can outweigh a sofa. A face, even tiny, will beat a mountain unless you starve the face of contrast. Who owns space is who wins the glance in the first half second, then the second glance you designed. It is the wrong tool as a slogan. Saying visual weight without choosing a winner is a wish. If two masses fight to a draw, the beat is confused unless the fight is the point. Motion and faces cheat. A still landscape that was balanced becomes a different picture when a figure turns. Recheck weight when action starts.
- 怎么拍：List the masses and their currencies: size, tone, chroma, sharpness, position (center and upper field weigh more), faces, movement. Dim or desaturate the losers, or throw them out of focus. A hard key on a small object is a common way to mint weight. Prompt: Composition balancing visual weight around [Subject], a bright small thing equal to a large dark mass, scale of attention.
- 何时用：Use it whenever more than one mass could steal the shot: a deal on a table, a child in a window, a red coat in a grey street. Do not light every surface equally and hope the script will point.
- 近似对比：Asymmetry, Tonal Contrast, Figure-Ground, Triangular Composition, AsymmetryLife is not a diagram., Tonal ContrastMake a poster out of a frame., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Asymmetry is often how unequal weights still hold as a picture. Tonal Contrast is specifically tonal punch, lightest versus darkest. Visual weight includes color, faces, and motion. Figure-Ground is the first-read separation of person from field. Triangular Composition assigns rank by geometry. Weight can override the apex if you light the wrong vertex. AsymmetryLife is not a diagram. Tonal ContrastMake a poster out of a frame. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：Painterly cinema is a school of weight: a lit hand, a dark coat, a window. Barry Lyndon and other candlelit pictures let a small warm mass equal a room.；Westerns and desert films let a tiny rider equal a butte by placing them on a line and isolating tone. Grammar of attention, not a painting to duplicate.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the winner and the equalizer. Composition balancing visual weight around [Subject], a bright small thing equal to a large dark mass, scale of attention.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Say what is small and bright, what is large and dark, and where the eye should land first. Forbid equal lighting on all masses.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is even, polite illumination. The tell is every object at the same brightness and sharpness, a catalogue page. The fix is to pick a winner and tax the rest: darker, softer, smaller, or less chromatic.

### Repetition and Pattern
- 别名：Repeated staging, Structural echo ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/repetition-pattern)
- 定义：Repetition and pattern composition repeats shapes, colors, lines, positions, or actions so the eye reads a system of columns, windows, soldiers, or hotel doors. A break in that pattern is often the story, because the grid had already set the expectation.
- 叙事功能：Systems, armies, hotels, and factories love this diagram. Who owns space is the grid. A person is a unit until they fail to match. That failure (an empty desk, a red coat, a late soldier) becomes the subject without a closer lens. It is the wrong tool when the location is unique and irregular. Forcing a pattern onto a messy apartment is a graphic lie unless the character is trying to impose one. Pattern can also return in time: the same blocking on a different day. That is structural echo. Compositionally it still needs a recognizable spatial rhyme so the audience can measure change.
- 怎么拍：Find a repeating unit and put the camera where the unit tiles: elevation of a facade, a long lens compressing a row, an overhead of desks. Align so the repeat is countable. Place the break on a power position (a missing unit, a different color, a still figure in a marching line). Prompt: Repeating pattern around [Subject], columns, windows, soldiers, a break in the pattern as the story.
- 何时用：Use it for institutions and copies: hotels, offices, armies, data centers, choruses. Do not use it as wallpaper if nothing can break.
- 近似对比：Symmetry, Bird's-Eye View, Architexture, One-Point Perspective, SymmetryThe world is designed. Or pretending to be., Bird's-Eye ViewTurn life into a board game or a ritual., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Symmetry is a mirror, which is one kind of repeat. Pattern can run in a line or a field without mirroring. Bird's-Eye View often reveals pattern by removing horizon. Architexture treats material and facade as texture until the person is a detail. Pattern is the countable grid inside that texture. One-Point Perspective can aim the repeat into a tunnel. SymmetryThe world is designed. Or pretending to be. Bird's-Eye ViewTurn life into a board game or a ritual. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：The Grand Budapest Hotel tiles uniforms, doors, and pastry boxes so a scuff reads. The Matrix uses copies as a philosophical pattern.；Shaun of the Dead rhymes a trip to the shop across a changed world. Jaws and The Empire Strikes Back also teach recurrence in sound, a cousin of visual echo: a figure that returns until it is a system.；Shaun of the Dead 2004The repeated trip to the local shop changes meaning as the world changes.；Jaws 1975A recurring musical figure becomes associated with the shark threat.；The Empire Strikes Back 1980The Imperial March gives the Empire a recurring musical identity.
- Prompt 模板：`Create two versions of a woman's morning walk through the same apartment courtyard. First, she ignores three neighbors while checking her phone. Later, repeat the camera positions and route, but she greets each neighbor and notices a repaired fountain. Keep the environment consistent so changed attention, not a new location, carries the meaning.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the unit and the break. Repeating pattern around [Subject], columns, windows, soldiers, a break in the pattern as the story.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is busy production design. The tell is lots of stuff and no countable unit. The fix is to pick one motif, align the camera to tile it, and isolate the one mismatch.

### Figure-Ground
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/figure-ground)
- 定义：Figure-ground composition separates the subject from the field so the person or object reads in under a second. Contrast of tone, color, or focus does the split, and if figure and ground share the same value the diagram fails even if the acting is good.
- 叙事功能：First read is survival. A face against a matching wall disappears. A dark coat against a dark street disappears. The audience should not have to hunt the subject unless hunting is the beat (camouflage, a sniper, a ghost). It is the wrong tool to solve with a fake halo on every shot. Sometimes the story is that they do not separate: a clerk eaten by an office, a dancer eaten by a crowd. Then you are composing fusion on purpose. Clean edges help. Dirty edges and busy wallpaper fight figure-ground unless the figure has a stronger currency: backlight rim, color, or a pool of focus.
- 怎么拍：Park the subject against a simpler or opposite field. A rim or backlight traces the outline. A shallow plane of focus melts the ground. A costume change (dark on light, light on dark, a single saturated piece) is cheaper than a new set. Check a squint test: if the silhouette dies when you defocus your eyes, the split is weak. Prompt: Clear figure-ground separation of [Subject] from background, contrast of tone, color, or focus so the person reads instantly.
- 何时用：Use it as default whenever a person must be found immediately: coverage, posters, any beat that is not hide-and-seek. Do not separate a character who is meant to be eaten by the room.
- 近似对比：Silhouette, Shallow Focus, Tonal Contrast, Cameo Lighting, Architexture, SilhouetteIdentity is less important than shape., Shallow FocusNothing else is invited., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Silhouette is a hard version: figure as outline against a brighter field, interior detail sacrificed. Shallow Focus buys separation with optics. Figure-ground can also be a sharp, deep picture with tonal contrast. Tonal Contrast is the graphic extreme of lightest versus darkest mass. Cameo Lighting isolates with a pool against dark. Architexture may intentionally lose the person in the building. SilhouetteIdentity is less important than shape. Shallow FocusNothing else is invited. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：Classical cinematography treats instant separation as manners: rim, backlight, and costume contrast so a face reads in a theater. Westerns park figures against sky.；Noir parks them against wet highlights. When a film withholds the split, it is usually a hide, not a mistake.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the split method. Clear figure-ground separation of [Subject] from background, contrast of tone, color, or focus so the person reads instantly.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Clear figure-ground separation of [Subject] from background, contrast of tone, color, or focus so the person reads instantly.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a matching suit on a matching wall. The tell is a hunt for the head. The fix is a rim, a different backdrop value, a costume change, or Shallow Focus. If they should vanish, own it and stop claiming a portrait.

### Tonal Contrast
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/contrast-composition)
- 定义：Tonal contrast, the contrast composition of lightest against darkest mass, organizes the frame as a fight of value with the subject as one of those poles. Graphic punch replaces mid-grey mush, so the diagram reads as a poster of value rather than a gentle range of detail.
- 叙事功能：Make a poster out of a frame and the eye cannot miss the subject. A white face in a black room, a black coat on a white street, a lighthouse beam cutting tar: value owns space more loudly than furniture. It is the wrong tool for a scene that lives in complexion, food, or mixed daylight conversation. If you crush the mids, you lose the sweat. Not every picture should be a woodcut. Tonal contrast is composition, not automatically Low-Key Lighting lighting. You can shoot high contrast at noon with hard sun and deep shade. Low-key is a lighting ratio. Contrast composition is where the masses sit.
- 怎么拍：Meter for the winner. Let the other mass fall off or blow, on purpose. Hard light and a dark flag help. A backlight rim can keep a dark figure readable on dark. Expose for highlights if the subject is the bright mass. Kill fill if the subject is the dark mass on a bright field. Prompt: High tonal contrast composition with [Subject] as the lightest or darkest mass, graphic punch, no mid-gray mush.
- 何时用：Use it for night hunts, moral binaries, graphic titles, and any beat that should read at a distance. Do not crush a scene whose information lives in the midtones.
- 近似对比：Low-Key Lighting, Silhouette, Figure-Ground, Chiaroscuro, Void, Low-Key LightingMystery, crime, or moral night., SilhouetteIdentity is less important than shape., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Low-Key Lighting is a lighting style with dominant shadow. Tonal contrast can also be a bright graphic (white wall, black figure). Silhouette gives up interior detail. Contrast composition may still keep an eye. Figure-Ground is the broader first-read split, including color and focus. Chiaroscuro is the painterly modeling of form with light and dark, which may be less poster-flat. Void deletes the field. Contrast still has two masses. Low-Key LightingMystery, crime, or moral night. SilhouetteIdentity is less important than shape. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：Sin City language turns faces and streets into ink and paper. The Lighthouse grinds value until salt, beam, and body are almost woodcut.；Both make composition out of value first. Grammar, not a comic-panel kit to steal.
- Prompt 模板：`Declare which pole the subject occupies. High tonal contrast composition with [Subject] as the lightest or darkest mass, graphic punch, no mid-gray mush.`
- 示例 Prompt：`High tonal contrast composition with [Subject] as the lightest or darkest mass, graphic punch, no mid-gray mush.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is muddy mid-grey. The tell is a face, a wall, and a coat all sitting in the same value band. The fix is to pick the lightest or darkest mass and send the rest away with flags, exposure, or costume.

### One-Point Perspective
- 别名：Central vanishing point, Axial composition ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/one-point-perspective)
- 定义：One-point perspective in one point perspective cinematography squares the camera to a plane so receding parallels meet at a single vanishing point, often on the central axis. The result is tunnel depth or ceremonial order: a corridor, a nave, a hotel hall aimed at infinity or at a person.
- 叙事功能：Destiny has a vanishing point when the architecture agrees. Walk toward it and the world funnels. Stand in the middle and the world presents. A small step off axis becomes a scandal because the construction was so true. It is the wrong tool in a room with no parallel receding edges, or when the scene should feel found rather than designed. Forcing a tunnel onto a forest is a lie unless the trees were planted as a nave. Centering a face is not enough. If the walls do not recede to one point, you have central framing in a box.
- 怎么拍：Align the lens with the centerline of the architecture. Keep verticals vertical (shift, a level, or a longer lens farther back). Place the vanishing point on a face, on a door, or on empty infinity. A moderate wide (24mm to 35mm) shows the funnel. Too wide bows the walls. Prompt: One-point perspective corridor toward [Subject] or through them, vanishing point on axis, Kubrick infinity.
- 何时用：Use it for hotels, spaceships, naves, bunkers, and any fate that should feel designed. Do not square up a messy street and call it one-point because a face is in the middle.
- 近似对比：Leading Lines, Centered Composition, Vanishing Point, Symmetry, Architexture, Leading LinesArchitecture should point., Centered CompositionControl, ritual, comedy, or fate., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Leading Lines may converge without a full axial construction. Centered Composition plants the subject on the axis but may be a flat altar with no tunnel. Vanishing Point is the meeting place itself and can sit off-axis in two-point perspective. Symmetry often arrives with one-point, but a tunnel can hide an unmatched object as the break. Architexture may flatten facade as texture instead of aiming it. Leading LinesArchitecture should point. Centered CompositionControl, ritual, comedy, or fate. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：The Shining aims Overlook corridors at a point that feels like destiny. 2001: A Space Odyssey uses axial interiors as designed future.；Leon and The Grand Budapest Hotel also square halls and lobbies so order is the air you breathe. Grammar of construction, not a carpet to copy.；The Shining 1980The Overlook's corridors and architectural interiors.；The Grand Budapest Hotel 2014Frontal hotel interiors and concierge compositions.
- Prompt 模板：`A lone night porter stands centered at the end of a perfectly symmetrical hotel corridor. Locked axial camera, central vanishing point, balanced lamps and doorways. Hold still as one door on the far left opens slightly, breaking the order. No camera move.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Demand a single vanishing point and a square camera. One-point perspective corridor toward [Subject] or through them, vanishing point on axis, Kubrick infinity.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a centered portrait in a hall shot from a corner. The tell is two vanishing points, a wall receding on one side only. The fix is to move onto the axis until left and right converge together, or to own Vanishing Point as a two-point street.

### Vanishing Point
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/vanishing-point)
- 定义：A vanishing point in vanishing point composition is the apparent meeting place of parallel lines in perspective, a destination for rails, a road, or a colonnade. The person often stands as a gate in front of that meeting, or occupies it as the target of the architecture.
- 叙事功能：There is a long way still to go when the point sits beyond the figure. Space owns the future. The body is a threshold, not the altar. If the point sits on the face, the architecture aims at them like a weapon or a blessing. It is the wrong tool in a flat elevation with no receding parallels. A painted backdrop that does not converge cannot offer a vanishing point. You would be naming a ghost. One-point, two-point, and three-point perspective all have vanishing points. The compositional choice is where you put them, and whether the subject blocks, occupies, or is ignored by that meeting.
- 怎么拍：Stand where real parallels recede: tracks, a highway, a colonnade. Choose height (eye-level keeps the point near the horizon; a low camera lifts it). Place the subject on the point, in front of it, or off it. A wider lens makes the suck toward infinity more violent. Prompt: Deep vanishing point beyond [Subject], rails or road sucking the eye to infinity, the person as a gate.
- 何时用：Use it when distance is the meaning: a road, a station, a landing site, a life still unwalked. Do not claim a vanishing point in a flat, shallow room.
- 近似对比：One-Point Perspective, Leading Lines, Extreme Long Shot, One-Point PerspectiveDestiny has a vanishing point., Leading LinesArchitecture should point., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  One-Point Perspective is the special case of a single, often axial, vanishing point with the camera squared. Vanishing-point composition can be a two-point street corner with the meeting off to the side. Leading Lines steer the eye but may never meet in frame. Extreme Long Shot often includes a distant point. The point is a location in the diagram, not a shot size. One-Point PerspectiveDestiny has a vanishing point. Leading LinesArchitecture should point. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：Paris, Texas aims roads and rails at a horizon that keeps going after the man stops. Close Encounters builds landing-site perspective as a meeting with something that arrives from the point.；Stations, docks, and desert highways are the same grammar: infinity as a character.
- Prompt 模板：`Place the point and the person. Deep vanishing point beyond [Subject], rails or road sucking the eye to infinity, the person as a gate.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the parallels (rails, highway, colonnade). Say the point is on the horizon beyond them, or on their chest if they are the target.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a centered figure with no converging lines. The tell is a person in the middle of a flat field and a prompt that only says vanishing. The fix is to include actual receding parallels, or to switch to Centered Composition and stop claiming perspective.

### Dirty Frame
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/dirty-frame)
- 定义：A dirty frame in dirty frame cinematography lets out-of-focus shoulders, glass, foliage, or crowd chew the edges of the picture so the aperture is occupied. The camera sits inside a populated space, not on a seamless studio axis.
- 叙事功能：Dirty versus clean edges is a moral diagram. Clean edges say the picture was granted. Dirty edges say it was stolen, crowded, or survived. A shoulder in the foreground, a plant slicing a corner, rain on a window: someone else owns the near space. It is the wrong tool for a product, a formal portrait, or a ritual altar. If the edges are dirty because the set was not cleared, you have clutter, not voyeur layers. A dirty frame can still be composed. The chew should be intentional shapes, not a boom or a coffee cup.
- 怎么拍：Put matter close to the four edges or to the ones that should feel occupied. Open the aperture so that matter melts, unless a sharp shoulder is the eavesdropper. A longer lens compresses crowd into the edges. A wider lens needs objects truly near the glass. Check that faces still clear a hole in the middle. Prompt: Dirty frame around [Subject], out-of-focus shoulders, glass, foliage, or crowd chewing the edges, voyeur layers.
- 何时用：Use it for surveillance, parties, streets, and any view that should feel unauthorized or crowded. Do not dirty a ceremonial single or a product hold.
- 近似对比：Foreground Interest, Frame within Frame, Voyeur, Clean Frame, Layered Depth, Foreground InterestPut air and obstacle between us and them., Frame within FrameSomeone is watched, trapped, or pictured., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Foreground Interest is a salient near object that may sit in one region. Dirty frame is specifically about edges being occupied, often all around. Frame within Frame cuts a hard inner rectangle. Dirty matter is usually soft and irregular. Voyeur is the concealment position that often produces dirty edges. Clean Frame is the opposite ethic: empty edges, isolation by tidiness. Layered Depth may keep those edge layers sharp if they carry action. Foreground InterestPut air and obstacle between us and them. Frame within FrameSomeone is watched, trapped, or pictured. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：The Conversation watches through crowds, glass, and occupied space so privacy is already compromised. Children of Men keeps debris, bodies, and near matter in the aperture so the future never grants a poster.；Grammar of occupancy, not a blur sticker.
- Prompt 模板：`Occupy the edges and name the matter. Dirty frame around [Subject], out-of-focus shoulders, glass, foliage, or crowd chewing the edges, voyeur layers.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Dirty frame around [Subject], out-of-focus shoulders, glass, foliage, or crowd chewing the edges, voyeur layers.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid clean margins.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is accidental clutter, or a Clean Frame with a fake vignette. The tell is a boom, a logo, or a blurry oval that is not an object. The fix is to choose the occluders, place them on the edges, and open the lens so they melt without covering the mouth.

### Clean Frame
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/clean-frame)
- 定义：A clean frame in clean frame cinematography keeps the edges empty of accidental objects so isolation arrives by tidiness, not by blur. The diagram has no landlord in the corners, which is studio-poster clarity even on a real street.
- 叙事功能：Nothing extra. Who owns space is whoever you left in the rectangle. A driver against night, a bottle on seamless, a dancer in a cleared hall: the edges do not argue. It is the wrong tool for eavesdropping and for documentary crowding. , a clean frame may be a lie unless someone in the story has already tidied for an inspection. Clean is not the same as empty. A fully dressed set can still be clean if no lamp, plant, or shoulder nicks the four sides. Negative space is extra emptiness. Clean is extra discipline.
- 怎么拍：Clear the near field. Watch all four edges on the monitor. Use flags and art department, not only a long lens. A longer lens helps by excluding, but a wide clean frame is a stronger claim: you composed the whole room and still kept the borders empty. Stop down if you need the empty walls sharp. Prompt: Clean frame of [Subject], edges empty, no accidental objects, studio-poster clarity, isolation by tidiness.
- 何时用：Use it for product, ritual, poster portraits, and any character who lives in control. Do not clean a view that should feel stolen.
- 近似对比：Dirty Frame, Negative Space, Centered Composition, Void, Negative SpaceLoneliness needs room., Centered CompositionControl, ritual, comedy, or fate., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Dirty Frame occupies the edges. That is the opposite ethic. Negative Space makes emptiness a mass, which a clean frame may also do, but a clean frame can be full of designed set as long as the borders are tidy. Centered Composition often wants clean edges so the altar is not nibbled. Void deletes the world. Clean still allows a world, just a disciplined one. Negative SpaceLoneliness needs room. Centered CompositionControl, ritual, comedy, or fate. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：Drive isolates night figures and cars with poster discipline: edges held, little accident. Product cinema clears tables until an object is a monument.；The grammar is control. A scuff on that control should be intended.
- Prompt 模板：`Forbid the corners. Clean frame of [Subject], edges empty, no accidental objects, studio-poster clarity, isolation by tidiness.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Say no foreground occluders, margins clear. If the set is dressed, add fully dressed room, edges still empty of accident.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a dirty street pretending to be a poster, or a Void you got by turning off the lights. The tell is a stray shoulder, a plant in the corner, or a black field with no place. The fix is to clear the edges or to admit you wanted occupied edges and shoot Dirty Frame.

### Look Space
- 别名：Look-object relationship, Raccord regard ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/look-space)
- 定义：Look space framing is the field in front of a gaze, the air a look owns, often because the important object is off-screen. In cutting, that look may be joined to what is seen (raccord regard, the look-object relationship).
- 叙事功能：A face and a rectangle of unused air can be a whole scene. We wait for the object: a person entering, a painting, a courtyard window. The subject does not own the surplus. The unseen does. It is the wrong tool when there is no look. Empty space beside a face that stares into lens is not look-space. It is leftover. If you need the object on-screen, put it there and stop pretending the air is a mystery. Look-space is the composition. The POV cut is the completion. You can hold the look and never pay off, which is a different cruelty.
- 怎么拍：Place more frame in the gaze direction than behind the head, unless you are short-siding. Match the height and direction of the look if the next shot is the object. A profile or three-quarter makes the owned field obvious. Do not fill that field with competing faces unless the competition is the point. Prompt: Generous look space for [Subject], the off-screen gaze owning a field of air, tension in what we cannot see.
- 何时用：Use it when the object of attention is off-screen or about to enter: a watcher, a painter, a sniper, a lover at a door. Do not leave dead air beside a to-camera interview and call it a look.
- 近似对比：Lead Room, Point of View, Short Siding, Reaction Shot, Frame within Frame, Lead RoomThey are going somewhere, even if standing., Point of ViewForce identification. The audience is the character., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Lead Room includes motion and classical manners for a walk. Look-space is specifically the gaze, especially toward an off-screen object. Point of View is the shot of what they see. Look-space is the shot of them seeing. Short Siding withholds this field. Reaction Shot may be a look with almost no space if the face is the whole event. Frame within Frame can put the object in a window inside the look-space. Lead RoomThey are going somewhere, even if standing. Point of ViewForce identification. The audience is the character. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：Rear Window builds Jeff's looks and then pays them with courtyard activity. Portrait of a Lady on Fire makes looking the subject, space between painter and model as the true field.；The Stendhal Syndrome matches Anna's looks to museum paintings. Grammar of eyeline, not a tourist view to copy.；Rear Window 1954Jeff looks out, followed by views of courtyard activity.；The Stendhal Syndrome 1996Anna's looks are matched to museum paintings.
- Prompt 模板：`Generate A: a seated woman looks upward and to her left toward a sound. Generate B: a slightly elevated wall clock seen from her seated side of the room. Generate C: return to her face as she understands she is late. Preserve look direction and plausible clock height.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Give the gaze a field and keep the object off unless you want it. Generous look space for [Subject], the off-screen gaze owning a field of air, tension in what we cannot see.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is leftover wallpaper, or a false eyeline cut. The tell is empty space on the wrong side of the face, or a next shot the look could not geometrically reach. The fix is to put the surplus in the gaze direction and to match height and angle if you complete the look.

### Architexture
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/architexture)
- 定义：Architexture, a nickname for architectural cinematography that treats the set as subject, fills the frame with facades, grids, and materials until a person is a detail of the building. Texture, module, and mass own space, and the body is an ornament or a scale figure.
- 叙事功能：When the set is the subject, human plot becomes a visitor. Concrete, glass, carpet, and window bands do the talking. A figure gives scale, then disappears into the pattern. It is the wrong tool when a close-up of a lie is the scene. Architecture cannot deliver an eye twitch. If you drown a dialogue in facade, you will photograph a building and call it a conversation. This is not automatically one-point ceremony. A flat elevation, a brutalist soffit, a repeating office ceiling can be architexture without a vanishing tunnel.
- 怎么拍：Expose for the material: raking light for relief, or flat light for graphic grids. Use a longer lens to compress floors into texture, or a wide lens close to a wall so the body is tiny against a single plane. Stop down so brick and joint stay sharp if texture is the point. Prompt: Architecture as texture around [Subject], facades, grids, and materials filling the frame until the person is a detail of the building.
- 何时用：Use it when place outweighs person: first arrival in a city, a worker in a machine, a critic of a monument. Do not use it as the only coverage of an intimate scene.
- 近似对比：One-Point Perspective, Repetition and Pattern, Extreme Long Shot, Windows, One-Point PerspectiveDestiny has a vanishing point., Repetition and PatternSystems, armies, hotels, factories., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  One-Point Perspective aims space as a tunnel. Architexture may be a flat, tactile wall. Repetition and Pattern counts units. Architexture can be irregular material, poured and stained. Extreme Long Shot shrinks a person in land. This shrinks them in built matter. Windows makes apertures the subject. Architexture may have almost no people in those apertures. One-Point PerspectiveDestiny has a vanishing point. Repetition and PatternSystems, armies, hotels, factories. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：Playtime (PlayTime) lets modern Paris eat its visitors: glass, grid, and waiting room as comedy of texture. The Brutalist language puts poured mass and material ahead of comfort.；The person remains, as scale. Grammar of buildings, not a tourist postcard.
- Prompt 模板：`Let the building win. Architecture as texture around [Subject], facades, grids, and materials filling the frame until the person is a detail of the building.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Architecture as texture around [Subject], façades, grids, and materials filling the frame until the person is a detail of the building.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not crop as a portrait.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a human portrait with a famous building behind. The tell is a large face and a postcard sliver of facade. The fix is to step back or go longer until the body is a module among modules, or to admit you wanted a portrait and drop the claim.

### Reflections
- 别名：Mirror dialogue, One-way-glass staging ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/reflections)
- 定义：Reflections in reflection cinematography put observer and observed in one plane by using glass, water, chrome, or a mirror. Mirror dialogue and one-way-glass staging let two spaces occupy a single composition, because optics, not a filter, do the doubling.
- 叙事功能：Show looking and the looked-at together and you skip a cut. A man and a woman speak through a booth. A face and a street stack in a shop window. Identity splits without a dissolve. It is the wrong tool when the reflection is an unreadable smear, or when it cheats physics (a mirror that does not answer a head turn). If you cannot map the sightline, the audience will feel the fake even if they cannot name it. Reflections can dirty a frame or frame-in-frame a second world. Decide which space is brighter. The brighter side writes itself onto the darker glass.
- 怎么拍：Map optics before you light. Control which side is hotter: the reflection needs a brighter source to read on glass. Hide the camera, or let it appear if that is the joke. Keep gaze and reflection geometrically honest. Polarizers kill or manage bounce. Water needs an angle and a still or living surface. Prompt: Reflections of [Subject] in glass, water, or chrome, observer and observed in one plane.
- 何时用：Use it for split identity, conversations that cannot be face to face, cities on windows, a child seeing a parent in a cabinet. Do not add a random mirror because the set has one.
- 近似对比：Frame within Frame, Silhouette, Screen in Screen, Dirty Frame, Windows, Frame within FrameSomeone is watched, trapped, or pictured., SilhouetteIdentity is less important than shape., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Frame within Frame uses a hard inner rectangle. A reflection may be a smear, a stack, or a perfect copy. Silhouette can appear in glass as outline. Screen in Screen is an electronic or projected picture, not a bounce. Dirty Frame often uses glass as an edge chew. Here the glass is the sentence. Windows may include reflections, but windows as a technique are stacked apertures of lives. Frame within FrameSomeone is watched, trapped, or pictured. SilhouetteIdentity is less important than shape. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：The Lady from Shanghai multiplies positions in a mirror maze until aiming becomes impossible. Paris, Texas stages Travis and Jane across a one-way-glass booth so seeing is not symmetrical.；In the Mood for Love catches bodies in glass and rain. Contact uses a cabinet mirror in a child's race down a hall: reflection as geography.；Paris, Texas 1984Travis and Jane speak across the one-way-glass booth.；The Lady from Shanghai 1947The mirror-maze climax multiplies possible positions.；Contact 1997Young Ellie races for the bathroom medicine cabinet after discovering her father collapsed.
- Prompt 模板：`A man and woman speak across a one-way-glass booth. Her illuminated face is visible while his dim reflection gradually overlays the glass as the light balance changes. Keep their positions consistent and the reflection optically plausible. Slow, restrained performance; no supernatural double.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the surface and both occupants. Reflections of [Subject] in glass, water, or chrome, observer and observed in one plane.`
- Prompt 要点：Add camera hidden if the camera must not appear.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a pasted-on double, or a mirror that ignores head movement. The tell is a reflection that does not match angle, brightness, or motion. The fix is to build a real optic: brighter observed side, correct eyeline, and a surface that could actually see both.

### Screen in Screen
- 别名：Desktop film, Interface as the camera ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/screen-in-screen)
- 定义：Screen in screen (desktop film, interface as the camera) nests a monitor, phone, television, or cinema inside the cinema so someone is watching a picture of someone. The inner image has its own crop, delay, and artifacts, and nested looking is the diagram.
- 叙事功能：A picture of a picture changes ownership. The person on the inner screen is already framed by someone else: a director, a hacker, a parent, a god. We watch the watcher, or we become them if the interface takes over the outer frame. It is the wrong tool when the inner screen is an unreadable glow. If text, faces, or timing cannot be parsed, you have set dressing. Desktop films live or die on exact writing and cursor behavior. This is not split screen. Split screen is a graphic of two presents. Screen-in-screen is a nested world with a power relation.
- 怎么拍：Design a real timeline and a legible inner frame. Photograph or generate the inner picture as an asset, then place it in a monitor with correct perspective, refresh, and reflections. Do not ask a generator to invent stable UI and accurate text in one pass if the words matter. Prompt: Screen-in-screen of [Subject], a monitor, phone, or cinema inside the cinema, nested looking.
- 何时用：Use it when looking is already mediated: security, live TV, a search on a laptop, a projectionist, a god's control room. Do not add a TV that plays nothing relevant.
- 近似对比：Frame within Frame, Split Screen, Windows, Voyeur, Reflections, Frame within FrameSomeone is watched, trapped, or pictured., Split ScreenTwo rooms, one moment., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Frame within Frame is usually architecture. Screen-in-screen is a display with its own image. Split Screen tiles simultaneous presents without one being a device in the other. Windows stacks architectural panes of lives. Voyeur may watch a screen, but voyeur is the concealment ethic. Reflections can stack a face on a dark monitor, a hybrid. Frame within FrameSomeone is watched, trapped, or pictured. Split ScreenTwo rooms, one moment. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：The Truman Show makes the world a production watched on screens. Videodrome infects the watcher through the tube.；Searching and Unfriended run investigation and terror through interfaces whose text and timing are the coverage. Sherlock Jr.；lets a projectionist enter the inner picture. Grammar of nested looking, not a wallpaper of monitors.；Searching 2018The investigation is presented through screens, calls and digital activity.；Unfriended 2014The action unfolds through a computer interface and group call.；Sherlock Jr. 1924The projectionist enters the world of the cinema screen.
- Prompt 模板：`Create a desktop-screen short: a woman starts writing an apology email, deletes it, receives an old photo and opens a video call she hesitates to answer. Generate the photo and call footage separately. Build the interface, readable text, cursor path and notification timing with code or compositing. No unreadable AI-generated UI text.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Specify the outer view and the inner picture. Screen-in-screen of [Subject], a monitor, phone, or cinema inside the cinema, nested looking.`
- Prompt 要点：Keep the inner image stable.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a blurry TV set, or a fake Split Screen. The tell is unreadable text, melting UI, or two images tiled with no device. The fix is to treat the inner picture as a designed insert with real words and a physically plausible monitor.

### Tableau
- 别名：tableau vivant, Frontal ensemble, Cinematic frieze ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/tableau)
- 定义：A tableau (tableau vivant, frontal ensemble, or frieze) is a staged composition whose meaning develops inside a relatively fixed frame. Arranged bodies and objects form a living picture, so duration replaces coverage while the camera stays locked or nearly locked.
- 叙事功能：Hold the arrangement and the audience reads at their own speed: who stands where, who fails to move, who sneaks a gesture. Stillness makes a tiny action loud. Comedy, ceremony, and dread all use that delay. It is the wrong tool when the scene needs chase geography or a close-up of a lie. If you cut the tableau to pieces immediately, you shot a master and threw it away. If the arrangement has no readable relationships, you shot decoration. Tableau is not automatically centered, but it likes a designed field. Dirty edges can still apply if the living picture is glimpsed from a door.
- 怎么拍：Block silhouettes, spacing, and sightlines before adding motion. Rehearse separate timings inside the shared frame. Use enough depth of field that the intended points stay readable. A locked tripod is the default. A slow creep is a different sentence. Prompt: Tableau of [Subject], arranged bodies, a living painting, duration instead of coverage.
- 何时用：Use it for ritual, comic ensembles, processions, and any beat that should be discovered rather than prescribed by cutting. Do not hold a well-dressed but empty arrangement.
- 近似对比：Static Locked-Off, Centered Composition, Group Shot, Triangular Composition, Long Take, Centered CompositionControl, ritual, comedy, or fate., Static Locked-OffTrust blocking and duration. Movement would be noise., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Static Locked-Off is the camera lock. Tableau is the staged picture that uses that lock. Centered Composition is a common altar for it, not a requirement. Group Shot is a size. Tableau is duration plus arrangement. Triangular Composition may be the geometry inside the hold. Long Take may travel. A tableau usually stays and lets time do the move. Centered CompositionControl, ritual, comedy, or fate. Static Locked-OffTrust blocking and duration. Movement would be noise. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：Barry Lyndon holds painterly courts until a glance is an event. Roy Andersson's films park ensembles in still rooms so a small failure is comic and awful.；PlayTime distributes gags across broad, held compositions. The Color of Pomegranates arranges people and objects as ritual friezes.；Grammar of duration, not a freeze.；PlayTime 1967Office and restaurant scenes distribute comedy across broad compositions.；The Color of Pomegranates 1969Frontal, ritualized arrangements of people and objects.
- Prompt 模板：`Locked wide frontal shot of five museum attendants preparing a display. Each performs a different small task; one repeatedly moves an object that another immediately returns. Clear spacing, readable full-body gestures, dry visual humor, no close-ups or camera motion.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name positions (left standing, center seated, right in a doorway) and say camera locked off. For video, add little motion except a planned gesture, no coverage cuts.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Master Shot you plan to chop, or a pretty still with no relationships. The tell is a posed group that exists to be pretty, then a cut to close-ups that do all the work. The fix is to give each body a job and to let the hold be the coverage.

### Void
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/void)
- 定义：A void in void cinematography erases the set: darkness, white, or a blank field eating the world until a figure stands against nothing. Negative space still belongs to a place, while a void deletes place, leaving almost no landlord but the body or the darkness that might eat it.
- 叙事功能：Erase the set and the social world goes with it. A woman in a black room, a man in white nowhere, a beam with no walls: there is no furniture to own space, only the figure and the absence. It is the wrong tool when geography matters. A void cannot show a door, a class, or a weather. If you still need the kitchen, you wanted negative space or cameo light in a real room. Cameo lighting can create a void by refusing to fill. The void is the compositional result: no readable world, not merely a moody key.
- 怎么拍：Kill the surround. Black velvet, an unlit stage, fogged white, a clipped sky. Light only the figure, or let them fall to Silhouette on nothing. Watch for stray stand legs and floor bounce. A longer lens helps exclude leftover set. Prompt: Void around [Subject], darkness or blank field eating the world, a figure against nothing.
- 何时用：Use it for existential isolation, alien rooms, interrogation nowhere, a mind. Do not use it as a cheap way to hide a location you did not dress.
- 近似对比：Negative Space, Cameo Lighting, Clean Frame, Silhouette, Low-Key Lighting, Negative SpaceLoneliness needs room., Cameo LightingErase the world. Keep the person., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Negative Space keeps a world (sky, wall, sea) as the empty mass. Void removes the world. Cameo Lighting is the lighting method that often produces a dark void: a pool on a figure, no environment. Clean Frame still allows a tidy place. Silhouette is outline against a brighter field, which can be a void if that field is featureless. Low-Key Lighting may still show a room in the shadows. Negative SpaceLoneliness needs room. Cameo LightingErase the world. Keep the person. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：Under the Skin uses black, featureless space as a place that is not a place, bodies without social furniture. The Lighthouse isolates men in weather and dark until the world feels eaten, more void than village.；Grammar of deletion, not a crushed exposure accident.
- Prompt 模板：`Delete the place. Void around [Subject], darkness or blank field eating the world, a figure against nothing.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Say black void, no set, no floor detail, or white featureless field. Light only the figure.`
- Prompt 要点：Forbid furniture and windows.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is an underexposed room, or Negative Space with a visible wall. The tell is a baseboard, a plant, or grainy wallpaper in the dark. The fix is to actually kill the surround (velvet, distance, flags), or to own the wall as designed emptiness.

### Voyeur
- 别名：Unseen sound source, Sound beyond the frame ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/voyeur)
- 定义：Voyeur cinematography places the camera in concealment so the audience is trespassing: a view through foliage, glass, a grate, or a distant window, often with dirty edges. The diagram is a peephole, not coverage, and the owner of that hide does not want us there.
- 叙事功能：The audience is trespassing. That is the beat. A couple through blinds, a conversation across a square, a tent at night: we occupy a hiding place. The subject does not present. They are caught, or they would be if they turned. It is the wrong tool for granted intimacy. A close-up the character knows about is not voyeur. An over-the-shoulder in a dialogue scene is coverage, even if a shoulder dirties the edge. Offscreen sound often rides with this view (a whistle, a courtyard, a tent wall) because the hide limits what we can see. The technique itself is the concealed camera, not the soundtrack.
- 怎么拍：Put a real occluder between lens and subject and stand where a watcher could stand. Keep enough aperture to melt the hide (leaves, fabric, a slit) while holding the distant face. A longer lens is the usual cheat for distance. Do not center the peephole like a pretty wreath unless the hide is a designed iris. Prompt: Voyeur frame of [Subject], watching from concealment, dirty edges, a view we should not have.
- 何时用：Use it when watching is transgression: affairs, surveillance, a neighbor, a hunter. Do not slap dirty leaves on a scene the character is performing for us.
- 近似对比：Dirty Frame, Over-the-Shoulder Coverage, Frame within Frame, Windows, Point of View, Dirty FrameWe are not supposed to have this view., Over-the-Shoulder CoverageDefault dialogue coverage with spatial glue., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Dirty Frame is the edge grammar voyeur often uses. Voyeur is the ethical position: concealment. You can dirty a party from inside the crowd without hiding. Over-the-Shoulder Coverage is dialogue coverage with a known listener in the foreground. Frame within Frame may be a window we are invited to look through. Windows stacks many lives. Voyeur picks one hide. Point of View claims we are the character. Voyeur often claims we are not supposed to be anyone. Dirty FrameWe are not supposed to have this view. Over-the-Shoulder CoverageDefault dialogue coverage with spatial glue. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：Rear Window makes looking across a courtyard the plot. The Conversation records and watches until privacy is a myth.；Cache (Hidden) holds distant, unauthorized views until the camera itself is an aggressor. M and The Blair Witch Project let presence arrive from beyond the visible, often as sound around a limited hide.；Grammar of trespass, not a leaf kit.；M 1931The murderer's whistling identifies a presence beyond what is visible.；The Blair Witch Project 1999Night sounds suggest activity outside the tent and camera view.；The Usual Suspects 1995The final details destabilize the story that has been narrated.
- Prompt 模板：`Locked shot inside a dim railway waiting room. An unseen suitcase rolls across the platform outside; its wheels move audibly from left to right, pause, then return. The lone passenger reacts without the camera revealing the source. Design spatially coherent audio separately, with no visible creature or arbitrary musical sting.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the hide and the forbidden view. Voyeur frame of [Subject], watching from concealment, dirty edges, a view we should not have.`
- Prompt 要点：Occupy the edges with the hide.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a pretty Dirty Frame the subject could see, or an Over-the-Shoulder Coverage from a scene partner. The tell is eye contact with lens, or a hide that is only a vignette. The fix is a real occluder, a plausible hiding place, and a subject who does not present.

### Windows
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/composition/windows)
- 定义：Windows cinematography treats panes as the true subject: stacked apertures, lives in rectangles, a building of frames. The diagram is a grid of possible pictures, not one doorway around one face.
- 叙事功能：A facade at night is a contact sheet of other people's rooms. A courtyard is a theater of windows. Who owns space changes per rectangle: a cook, a sleeper, a fighter, an empty kitchen. The building is a montage that does not cut. It is the wrong tool when you only need one inner frame around one encounter. That is a single frame-within-frame. If the other panes do no work, you photographed a house. Windows can be looked through from inside (rain on glass, a face and a street) or looked at from outside (Rear Window grammar). Decide which side of the glass we occupy, and whether reflections will stack a second world.
- 怎么拍：Find a true grid: a courtyard, a block of apartments, an office elevation. Use a longer lens to flatten panes into a sheet of rectangles, or a wider lens if we are inside one room looking at many across a court. Expose so more than one interior reads, or so most go dark except the one that matters. Prompt: Windows as the true subject around [Subject], stacked apertures, lives in rectangles, a building of frames.
- 何时用：Use it when many lives share a building, or when a single life is one pane among others. Do not use it as a pretty rain window on a portrait that never acknowledges other rooms.
- 近似对比：Frame within Frame, Screen in Screen, Voyeur, Repetition and Pattern, Reflections, Frame within FrameSomeone is watched, trapped, or pictured., Screen in ScreenSomeone is watching a picture of someone., Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
  Frame within Frame is usually one inner rectangle. Windows multiplies them. Screen in Screen nests electronic pictures. These are architectural pictures. Voyeur may watch one pane from concealment. Windows can also be a public elevation, a city showing itself. Repetition and Pattern counts the grid. Here the content of each cell matters. Reflections may write the street onto the same glass.
