Frame within FrameSomeone is watched, trapped, or pictured. Screen in ScreenSomeone is watching a picture of someone. Rule of ThirdsDefault dynamic balance. Break it later on purpose.
- 片中实例：Rear Window turns a courtyard of windows into a set of simultaneous shorts. The Hours uses windows as thresholds between interior lives and the weather of a city.；A building becomes an editing machine you can hold. Grammar of panes, not a single pretty rain glass.
- Prompt 模板：`Make the panes the subject. Windows as the true subject around [Subject], stacked apertures, lives in rectangles, a building of frames.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Say courtyard facade at night, multiple lit interiors, or a wall of office panes. Place the subject in one rectangle among others.`
- Prompt 要点：Name at least two other lives or empty rooms.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a single rain-streaked portrait, or a Frame within Frame doorway. The tell is one face and one glass with no other cells. The fix is to show a grid of apertures and to give at least one other pane a life, even if it is only a lamp and an empty chair.

## 镜头与光学 / Lenses and Optics（17 条）

**速查**：14mm Ultra-Wide · 24mm Wide · 35mm Moderate Wide · 50mm Normal · 85mm Portrait · 135mm Telephoto · 200mm Long Telephoto · Anamorphic · Spherical · Fisheye · Tilt-Shift · Macro · Probe Lens · Split Diopter · Vintage Cine Glass · Telephoto Compression · Magnification

### 14mm Ultra-Wide
- 别名：Intimate wide lens, Exaggerated near perspective ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lenses/ultra-wide-14mm)
- 定义：A 14mm ultra-wide in 14mm cinematography is a very short focal length that, from a close stand, takes in a huge field and exaggerates near-to-far size. The close camera position, not the millimeter stamp alone, is what balloons a foreground face or object against a receding room.
- 叙事功能：Stand an arm's length from a person and a 14mm still holds the ceiling, the corridor, and the street behind them. Near masses swell. Far walls drop away. The figure is inside a space that will not stay polite, which is why the same glass can feel intimate and confrontational at once. It is the wrong tool for a flattering head-and-shoulders. Edge stretch cartoons ears and cheeks unless the face stays near the optical axis. If you only wanted a body plus a readable room without heroic geometry, step back and use 24mm Wide. If the walls must bow, that is Fisheye, not a rectilinear 14mm.
- 怎么拍：Stand first, then choose glass. Park the nodal point close enough that a hand, a table, or a face owns scale, then let 14mm include the rest. Rectilinear 14mm keeps straight lines straighter than a fisheye; remaining stretch is perspective from that close viewpoint. Keep faces off the extreme frame edges unless further stretching is intended. Architecture will fan from the lens axis. Prompt: 14mm ultra-wide on [Subject], exaggerated perspective, looming foreground, stretched architecture, slight heroic distortion.
- 何时用：Use it when the audience must sit inside a space that is too big or too close: a face in a hotel lobby that still owns the ceiling. Do not use 14mm as a default portrait lens, or as a sticker that means wide.
- 近似对比：24mm Wide, Fisheye, 50mm Normal, Forced Perspective, 24mm WidePerson plus place, neither winning., FisheyeThe mind is warped, or the space is a dome., 35mm Moderate WideMost narrative coverage. Human but not telephoto.
  24mm Wide is the next stop: person plus place without this much ballooning. Fisheye bends those straight lines on purpose. 50mm Normal from the same close stand still crops the room out; 14mm is inclusion plus exaggeration. Forced Perspective is a staging trick along the axis; 14mm is an optical field from a close stand. 24mm WidePerson plus place, neither winning. FisheyeThe mind is warped, or the space is a dome. 35mm Moderate WideMost narrative coverage. Human but not telephoto.
- 片中实例：The Revenant often works this close in weather so bodies and trees share one aggressive space. Birdman keeps wide glass in tight interiors so rooms never let the actors go.；Fallen Angels films faces against expanded urban night. Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas uses close wide proximity as subjective unease.；Borrow the stand and the field, not a still.；Fallen Angels 1995Faces and bodies are filmed very close against strongly expanded urban space.；Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas 1998Distorted close proximity intensifies subjective unease.
- Prompt 模板：`Very close wide-angle portrait of a tired night cook leaning toward the camera in a tiny kitchen. His near hand appears larger, the room stretches strongly behind him, walls remain rigid. Expressive perspective, natural facial anatomy, no fisheye circle.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Say how close the camera is (arm's length, over the table, in the doorway) and keep the face near center unless edge stretch is the point. Do not write distorted as a sticker, and do not ask for oval bokeh.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Fisheye (bowed walls) or a distant 24mm Wide labeled 14mm. The tell is either curvilinear bowing or a calm environmental portrait with no looming foreground. Fix: move close, keep lines mostly straight, let the near object own scale. Wide angle does not automatically distort a face from every distance; viewpoint is the dominant variable.

### 24mm Wide
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lenses/24mm-wide)
- 定义：A 24mm wide in 24mm lens cinematography is a moderately wide prime that holds a person and a usable amount of place without extreme stretch. Body and architecture share the rectangle; neither fully wins.
- 叙事功能：This is the environmental portrait length. You can see the hands, the floor, and the doorway, and the face still belongs to a human rather than a mural. Reportage interiors, street coverage, and walking masters live here because the room is a partner, not a special effect. It is the wrong tool when the space should attack the face, or when the face should erase the space. A closer 14mm will balloon the near ground. An 85mm Portrait will melt the room into stacked color. If the beat is most narrative talk with a little extra world, 35mm Moderate Wide is the quieter default.
- 怎么拍：Stand first: usually a few feet back, not on the nose. 24mm then includes a generous field with only moderate perspective stretch on a full-frame or Super 35 sensor. Keep the camera closer to eye height unless rank is the point; a low 24mm will still heroic the figure because of the field, not because of a power slogan. Hands and foreground furniture will read large, so place them on purpose. Prompt: 24mm wide on [Subject], environmental portrait, body in space, moderate stretch, reportage coverage.
- 何时用：Use it when a person plus their place must share the frame, neither winning: a soldier in a kitchen, a walker in a street. Do not use it to fake 14mm intrusion or 85mm isolation.
- 近似对比：14mm Ultra-Wide, 35mm Moderate Wide, 50mm Normal, Anamorphic, 35mm Moderate WideMost narrative coverage. Human but not telephoto., 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close., 50mm NormalYou do not want the glass to editorialize.
  14mm Ultra-Wide from close exaggerates near-to-far size until the room attacks. 35mm Moderate Wide shows less world and less stretch, the usual storyteller step inward. 50mm Normal from the same stand crops the environment. Anamorphic is a squeeze system, not a wider 24mm. 35mm Moderate WideMost narrative coverage. Human but not telephoto. 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close. 50mm NormalYou do not want the glass to editorialize.
- 片中实例：Children of Men often covers bodies in threatened rooms at a wide-normal that still lets geography read. The Hurt Locker does similar work in streets and interiors: person plus place, neither a poster.；Use that grammar of shared space, not a matching still.
- Prompt 模板：`Lead with body in space, not with a mood. 24mm wide on [Subject], environmental portrait, body in space, moderate stretch, reportage coverage.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name what architecture must remain (door, street, kitchen). Do not ask for extreme distortion, oval bokeh, or a melted background.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is 14mm Ultra-Wide or 35mm Moderate Wide. The 14mm tell is a looming foreground and cartoon edges. The 35mm tell is a tighter room with the environment demoted. Fix: stand a few feet back, hold full body or three-quarter plus readable architecture, keep stretch moderate.

### 35mm Moderate Wide
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lenses/35mm-moderate)
- 定义：A 35mm moderate wide in 35mm cinematography is the common narrative wide-normal: natural perspective with a little more world than a 50mm. It is default coverage for scenes that need both face and room.
- 叙事功能：Most talking scenes want this field. You see the listener's shoulder, a lamp, a slice of wall, and a face that does not balloon. The glass does a little editorial work (more place than a 50) without turning the room into a character the way 24mm and 14mm do. It is the wrong tool when the location must dominate, or when the person must become the only landscape. Street masters and kitchen two-shots often belong at 24mm. Isolation close-ups belong at 85mm. If you shoot every size on 35mm, the coverage matches, but you never change how space feels.
- 怎么拍：Stand at a conversational distance, roughly the same as a person talking across a table or a small room. On Super 35, 35mm sits near format-normal; on full frame it is a mild wide. Either way the perspective is gentle if you do not crowd the nose. Keep verticals honest unless a tilt is the sentence. Prompt: 35mm on [Subject], storyteller focal length, natural perspective with a little more world than 50.
- 何时用：Use it for most narrative coverage that should feel human but not telephoto: a two-shot at a table, a walk through a doorway. Do not use it as the only length in a film that needs space to change meaning.
- 近似对比：24mm Wide, 50mm Normal, 85mm Portrait, 50mm NormalYou do not want the glass to editorialize., 24mm WidePerson plus place, neither winning., 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
  24mm Wide shows more architecture and more stretch. 50mm Normal crops toward the conversation and editorialize less. 85mm Portrait from farther back isolates the face and stacks the background. 35mm is the middle storyteller, not a look. 50mm NormalYou do not want the glass to editorialize. 24mm WidePerson plus place, neither winning. 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
- 片中实例：Moonlight often covers faces in rooms at a moderate wide-normal so Miami stays present without becoming a postcard. Manchester by the Sea does the same with New England interiors: people in places, neither squeezed nor stretched.；Grammar for default coverage, not a frame to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the storyteller length and the extra world. 35mm on [Subject], storyteller focal length, natural perspective with a little more world than 50.`
- 示例 Prompt：`35mm on [Subject], the classic storyteller focal length, natural perspective with a little more world than 50.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is 50mm Normal (too little room) or 24mm Wide (too much stretch). The tell is either a tight conversational crop with a melted wall, or a reportage wide with looming furniture. Fix: conversational stand, face plus a true slice of place, mild perspective.

### 50mm Normal
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lenses/50mm-normal)
- 定义：A 50mm normal in 50mm cinematography is the conventional normal prime: from a typical stand it neither stretches near space nor stacks distant planes. The glass refuses to editorialize perspective; camera position still does all of that work.
- 叙事功能：A 50mm is the length you pick when the sentence should sound like looking, not like a lens. Faces keep proportion. Rooms neither rush forward nor crowd in. Conversations, over-the-shoulders, and plain singles live here because the audience is not asked to notice the optic. It is the wrong tool when space itself must argue. A 24mm will make the room a partner. An 85mm will make the person a landscape. From the same tripod, switching to 50mm only crops; if you wanted compression you still have to walk back, then use longer glass.
- 怎么拍：Stand first at a human talking distance. On a roughly 35mm-wide sensor, 50mm is a mild tele-normal; on full frame it is the classic still-camera normal. Either way, keep the nodal point where a person would stand, and let the field fall out. Depth of field at 50mm is moderate unless you open very wide or get close. Prompt: 50mm normal lens on [Subject], human-scale perspective, neither compressed nor stretched, conversational truth.
- 何时用：Use it when you do not want the glass to editorialize: a talk across a table, a single that should feel observed rather than styled. Do not use it to fake telephoto isolation or wide environmental stretch from a fixed stand.
- 近似对比：35mm Moderate Wide, 85mm Portrait, Spherical, 24mm Wide, 35mm Moderate WideMost narrative coverage. Human but not telephoto., 85mm PortraitA person is the landscape., 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
  35mm Moderate Wide shows a little more world from the same stand. 85mm Portrait requires a farther stand and starts to compress the background. Spherical is the lens construction; a 50mm is usually spherical, but spherical is not a focal length. 24mm Wide from close is a different sentence about space. 35mm Moderate WideMost narrative coverage. Human but not telephoto. 85mm PortraitA person is the landscape. 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
- 片中实例：Classical coverage often parks the 50mm on singles and over-the-shoulders so the optic disappears and performance plus blocking carry the scene. Use that as grammar: conversational distance, honest proportion, no stacked city and no looming furniture.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the refusal to stretch or stack. 50mm normal lens on [Subject], human-scale perspective, neither compressed nor stretched, conversational truth.`
- 示例 Prompt：`State camera distance (across a table, a few paces). Do not add oval bokeh, barrel distortion, or heat-haze compression.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is 35mm Moderate Wide labeled as normal, or 85mm Portrait because generators treat every face as a portrait length. The tell is extra room (35) or a washed, stacked background (85). Fix: talking-distance stand, full-face proportion, background present but not crowding.

### 85mm Portrait
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lenses/85mm-portrait)
- 定义：An 85mm portrait in 85mm cinematography is a short telephoto used from a farther stand so a head-and-shoulders stays large while the background enlarges and recedes in importance. The person becomes the landscape; the room becomes stacked color and shape behind them.
- 叙事功能：Walk back until an 85mm fills the frame with a face. Noses stop dominating. Ears sit in proportion. The wall behind them comes forward as a soft plane rather than a readable room. Isolation is the job: a person is the country, and everyone else is weather. It is the wrong tool for geography. You cannot hold a kitchen two-shot honestly at 85mm in a small room because you cannot get far enough, and if you could, the space would flatten into wallpaper. If the beat is person plus place, go to 35mm Moderate Wide or 24mm Wide. If the beat is surveillance from across a street, you wanted 135mm Telephoto.
- 怎么拍：Stand first, farther than conversation. Restore subject size with 85mm. That distant viewpoint is what compresses facial features and enlarges background objects; the 85mm only chooses the crop. Open the aperture if you want rapid falloff, but shallow focus is a separate choice from the length. Keep the camera at eye height unless you mean a power tilt. Prompt: 85mm portrait of [Subject], compressed background, rapid falloff, isolation, the face as the only country.
- 何时用：Use it when a person is the landscape: a close-up of thought, a romantic single, a face that should not share billing with the room. Do not use it for masters, group geography, or any beat that still needs architecture as a partner.
- 近似对比：50mm Normal, 135mm Telephoto, Shallow Focus, Macro, 135mm TelephotoSurveillance, sports, or stacked city., Shallow FocusNothing else is invited., 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
  50mm Normal from closer keeps the room honest. 135mm Telephoto stacks even harder and feels like eavesdropping. Shallow Focus can happen on many lengths; 85mm is a stand plus a crop, not a synonym for blur. Macro is close-focusing on a tiny object, not a portrait length. 135mm TelephotoSurveillance, sports, or stacked city. Shallow FocusNothing else is invited. 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
- 片中实例：Her often isolates faces against a soft city so the person is the only country in the frame. Portrait cinema in general uses short telephotos this way: farther stand, larger face, background as a plane.；Borrow the distance and the isolation, not a still of Joaquin Phoenix.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the farther stand and the isolation. 85mm portrait of [Subject], compressed background, rapid falloff, isolation, the face as the only country.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Say head-and-shoulders, background as a soft plane, not a readable room. Do not write 24mm, and do not ask for environmental architecture in focus.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is 50mm Normal or a wide close-up that balloons the nose. The tell is a large room still readable behind a close face, or a stretched forehead from standing too close with short glass. Fix: walk back, 85mm, face large, background stacked and secondary.

### 135mm Telephoto
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lenses/135mm-telephoto)
- 定义：A 135mm telephoto in 135mm cinematography is a long lens used from a distant stand so planes stack and the background crowds the figure. The image feels like eavesdropping: you are far away, yet the world presses in.
- 叙事功能：From across a street, a parking lot, or a sports field, 135mm restores a person to usable size and collapses the air between them and whatever sits behind. Cars, crowds, and buildings become a wall. Approaches take forever. Isolation here is not portrait softness; it is surveillance distance. It is the wrong tool inside a small room. You cannot get far enough, and if you force it the blocking dies. It is also the wrong tool for a tender head-and-shoulders that should still feel like a conversation: that is 85mm Portrait. If the stack must be extreme, with heat shimmer and sniper intimacy, you wanted 200mm Long Telephoto.
- 怎么拍：Walk far away first. 135mm then crops that distant view tightly. Compression is the distant viewpoint; the long lens only chooses how much of it to keep. Expect a thin depth of field even at moderate apertures, and expect atmospheric haze or heat if the throw is long enough. A stick or beanbag beats handheld at this length. Prompt: 135mm telephoto on [Subject], stacked planes, eavesdropping compression, background crowding the figure.
- 何时用：Use it for surveillance, sports, or a stacked city: a figure watched from a rooftop, a runner against a wall of spectators. Do not use it for table coverage or any scene whose geography needs deep, receding space.
- 近似对比：85mm Portrait, 200mm Long Telephoto, Telephoto Compression, Macro, 200mm Long TelephotoFar away and still in their pores., 85mm PortraitA person is the landscape., 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
  85mm Portrait is the nearer telephoto: isolation without the eavesdrop. 200mm Long Telephoto is farther and harder, with more shimmer and less escape in depth. Telephoto Compression is the perspective effect itself, which 135mm often frames. Macro is close-up scale, the opposite throw. 200mm Long TelephotoFar away and still in their pores. 85mm PortraitA person is the landscape. 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
- 片中实例：The Conversation uses long glass as listening: Harry is in the crowd and apart from it. Heat stacks Los Angeles so bodies and city occupy the same plane.；Those films treat distance as a moral fact. Borrow the throw and the stack, not a matching still.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the distant stand and the crowded background. 135mm telephoto on [Subject], stacked planes, eavesdropping compression, background crowding the figure.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Add across-the-street or parking-lot throw. Do not write 85mm portrait, and do not ask for wide environmental stretch.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is 85mm Portrait (too near, too kind) or a wide shot labeled telephoto. The tell is a readable receding street, or a close conversational background. Fix: put the camera far away, stack the background against the body, keep the throw obvious.

### 200mm Long Telephoto
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lenses/200mm-long)
- 定义：A 200mm long telephoto in 200mm cinematography is an extreme long lens used from a very distant stand so size differences between planes almost vanish. Heat shimmer, stacked terrain, and sniper intimacy are the physical leftovers of that throw.
- 叙事功能：At 200mm you are often so far that the air itself becomes part of the optic: heat, dust, and haze sit in layers. A walker seems not to approach. A face can be in their pores while the desert, the compound, or the crowd is a flat wall glued to their shoulders. It is the wrong tool for any scene that must explain left and right in a room. It is also the wrong tool if you only wanted portrait isolation; 85mm already does that without the shimmer and the unreachable camera. If the stack is a city street rather than a desert or a sniper line, 135mm Telephoto is usually enough.
- 怎么拍：Stand very far first, then restore size with 200mm. Support the camera; angular shake is huge at this length. Focus is unforgiving. Expect a thin slice of sharpness and, outdoors, visible atmospheric disturbance along the path. Do not confuse this with digital zoom from a 50mm stand: that crop has no compression because you never moved. Prompt: 200mm long lens on [Subject], extreme compression, heat shimmer, isolated from a distance, sniper intimacy.
- 何时用：Use it when you must be far away and still in their pores: a desert rider, a compound watch, a face across a canyon of air. Do not use it for dialogue coverage or for a portrait you could have made at 85mm.
- 近似对比：135mm Telephoto, Telephoto Compression, 85mm Portrait, Macro, 135mm TelephotoSurveillance, sports, or stacked city., Telephoto CompressionThe city or army is right on their back., 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
  135mm Telephoto is the nearer long lens, stacked but less extreme. Telephoto Compression names the viewpoint effect 200mm often shows. 85mm Portrait is intimacy from a portrait stand, not this throw. Macro is the opposite: inches, not hundreds of meters. 135mm TelephotoSurveillance, sports, or stacked city. Telephoto CompressionThe city or army is right on their back. 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
- 片中实例：Lawrence of Arabia uses heat telephotos so distant riders take an age to arrive through shimmer. Zero Dark Thirty uses long glass as watcher's distance on compounds and streets.；Grammar of throw and air, not a poster of a silhouette.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the extreme throw and the air. 200mm long lens on [Subject], extreme compression, heat shimmer, isolated from a distance, sniper intimacy.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Say the camera is hundreds of feet away. Do not write portrait 85mm, and do not ask for a wide establishing field.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is 135mm Telephoto or a cropped 50mm labeled 200mm. The tell is too much remaining depth, or no atmospheric stack. Fix: put real distance between camera and subject, let planes glue together, allow haze or heat if outdoors.

### Anamorphic
- 别名：Oval bokeh, Anamorphic lens signature ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lenses/anamorphic)
- 定义：Anamorphic cinematography squeezes one image dimension during capture, usually horizontally by 2x, then expands it for presentation. Depending on the lens, that cylindrical squeeze can produce oval bokeh, directional flares, and distinctive edge behavior; a wide aspect ratio alone is not anamorphic photography.
- 叙事功能：The frame can hold a face and a landscape in the same breath because the desqueezed field is wide while the taking lens may still be a moderate focal length. Highlights streak sideways. Out-of-focus lamps become ovals. The optic announces a movie without needing black bars glued onto a spherical image. 39:1. Cropping a Spherical 50mm and adding letterbox is an aspect ratio, not this glass. It is also the wrong tool if you need clinical edges and round bokeh. Not every anamorphic lens flares the same way; do not treat Anamorphic Flare as automatic.
- 怎么拍：8x) or recreate specific optical traits with restraint. Keep desqueezed geometry correct: circles in the world must not stay squeezed in the final image. Focus breathing and a thinner vertical taking field are common. Oval bokeh comes from the cylindrical elements, not from a filter sticker. Prompt: Anamorphic 2x on [Subject], oval bokeh, horizontal flares, widescreen squeeze character.
- 何时用：Use it when the frame should announce itself as widescreen glass: a night interior with oval lamps, a face in a wide city. Do not use it as a synonym for letterbox, and do not sprinkle blue streaks on every spherical shot.
- 近似对比：Spherical, Anamorphic Flare, Vintage Cine Glass, Anamorphic FlareNight lights and headlights should write on the lens., SphericalControl and sharpness over romance., 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
  Spherical has round bokeh and rectilinear edges with no squeeze. Anamorphic Flare is one artifact some anamorphic lenses produce, not the whole system. Vintage Cine Glass can be spherical or anamorphic; vintage is coatings and contrast, not the squeeze. Black bars on a 16:9 file are not this technique. Anamorphic FlareNight lights and headlights should write on the lens. SphericalControl and sharpness over romance. 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
- 片中实例：Blade Runner uses anamorphic night interiors and city imagery as a widescreen optical fact. Inception's live-action photography is largely anamorphic widescreen.；La La Land and The Batman lean on oval highlights and directional flares as part of that glass. Borrow the squeeze behavior, not a copyrighted still.；Blade Runner 1982Widescreen night interiors and city imagery.；Inception 2010Much of the live-action photography uses an anamorphic widescreen approach.
- Prompt 模板：`Night exterior of a woman beneath station lights, widescreen anamorphic-style optics, subtle oval defocused highlights and restrained horizontal flare from one practical light. Natural face width, coherent architecture, no excessive streaks and no letterbox bars baked into the image.`
- 示例 Prompt：`39:1 if the delivery is widescreen. Do not write letterbox on a spherical lens, and do not add random blue streaks without oval bokeh and correct geometry.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Spherical footage with black bars, or a flare overlay without oval highlights. The tell is round lamps, no squeeze character, and a 16:9 image with mats. Fix: oval bokeh, horizontal highlight streaks, desqueezed widescreen geometry. A wide aspect ratio alone is not anamorphic.

### Spherical
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lenses/spherical)
- 定义：A spherical lens in spherical lens cinematography uses rotationally symmetric elements with no anamorphic squeeze, so the image is captured already in its display proportions. Bokeh from a round iris is round, and edges stay rectilinear aside from ordinary wide-angle stretch.
- 叙事功能：This is default modern capture. You pick a focal length, you stand somewhere, and the optic does not ovalize lamps or streak headlights into bars. Sharpness and control are easier to specify because you are not also managing squeeze, desqueeze, and cylindrical artifacts. It is the wrong tool only when those artifacts are the point. If the beat needs oval highlights and horizontal flares, you wanted Anamorphic. 39:1 still exists: you crop or use a large sensor. That is an aspect ratio on spherical glass, not a conversion.
- 怎么拍：Choose a spherical prime or zoom and a stand. Perspective still comes from camera position; 24mm spherical is not 85mm spherical. Keep the iris in mind if bokeh shape matters: a round iris yields round highlights; a many-bladed iris yields a polygon. No desqueeze in post. Prompt: Spherical prime on [Subject], round bokeh, rectilinear edges, clean modern capture, no anamorphic streak.
- 何时用：Use it when you want control and sharpness over squeeze romance: most coverage, VFX plates, anything that must stitch or track cleanly. Do not label spherical footage anamorphic because you added black bars.
- 近似对比：Anamorphic, 50mm Normal, Vintage Cine Glass, Fisheye, AnamorphicYou want the frame to announce it is a movie., 50mm NormalYou do not want the glass to editorialize., 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
  Anamorphic squeezes and often ovalizes. 50mm Normal is a focal length you will often shoot spherical. Vintage Cine Glass may be spherical glass with older coatings; vintage is not a squeeze. Fisheye is curvilinear spherical or a dedicated projection, still not anamorphic. AnamorphicYou want the frame to announce it is a movie. 50mm NormalYou do not want the glass to editorialize. 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
- 片中实例：Most modern digital cinema is spherical unless the production states otherwise. Use that as a reminder: round lamps, no horizontal streak from the taking lens, geometry that matches a prime's field.；The look is the stand and the length, not a flare pack.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the lack of squeeze. Spherical prime on [Subject], round bokeh, rectilinear edges, clean modern capture, no anamorphic streak.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Then name the actual focal length (35mm, 50mm, 85mm). Do not add oval highlights or blue horizontal flares.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Anamorphic stickers on a round-bokeh image. The tell is letterbox plus circular lamps plus random streaks. Fix: round bokeh, no squeeze, rectilinear edges, and a named spherical focal length.

### Fisheye
- 别名：Curvilinear ultra-wide view ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lenses/fisheye)
- 定义：A fisheye in fisheye cinematography is a very wide curvilinear projection that bends straight lines, especially away from the center. The world wraps around the lens; architecture becomes a bowl rather than a rectilinear box.
- 叙事功能：Put a face in the middle and the room circles them. Put them off-center and their skull stretches along the barrel. The mapping can be circular (a round image in a black frame) or diagonal (the circle fills the rectangle). Either way, the mind of the shot is warped, or the space is a dome. It is the wrong tool when you wanted extreme width with straight walls. That is a rectilinear 14mm Ultra-Wide. Random wobbly architecture is a model failure, not fisheye projection. If the beat is only a mildly wide room, 24mm Wide already does it without the wrap.
- 怎么拍：Choose circular or full-frame fisheye and stage faces near the center unless edge stretching is deliberate. Keep the distortion systematic: lines bow around a stable center, they do not ripple. A zenith or dome shot will map the room as a globe. Prompt: Fisheye on [Subject], circular or extreme barrel distortion, a world wrapping around a face, subjective unreality.
- 何时用：Use it when the mind is warped, or the space is a dome: a palace that should feel wrong, a subjective spiral, a helmet-cam joke. Do not use it as a synonym for 14mm, and do not apply random warping.
- 近似对比：14mm Ultra-Wide, 24mm Wide, Kaleidoscope, 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close., 24mm WidePerson plus place, neither winning., 35mm Moderate WideMost narrative coverage. Human but not telephoto.
  14mm Ultra-Wide is rectilinear: huge field, straight-ish lines, stretch from a close stand. Fisheye is curvilinear by design. 24mm Wide is moderate and polite. Kaleidoscope multiplies fragments; fisheye is one continuous wrap. 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close. 24mm WidePerson plus place, neither winning. 35mm Moderate WideMost narrative coverage. Human but not telephoto.
- 片中实例：The Favourite bends palace interiors under conspicuously wide, curvilinear views. Poor Things uses highly distorted wide-angle views so the world stays unfamiliar.；A Clockwork Orange and Being John Malkovich have used extreme wide wrap as subjective pressure. Grammar of bowing space, not a filter preset.；The Favourite 2018Palace interiors bend under conspicuously wide, curvilinear views.；Poor Things 2023Highly distorted wide-angle views contribute to an unfamiliar world.
- Prompt 模板：`A palace official stands small at the center of an enormous ornate chamber, filmed with a frame-filling fisheye look. Walls bow smoothly toward the edges, ceiling and floor remain structurally coherent. Slow restrained action, locked camera, no circular black border.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Say whether the image is a circle or fills the frame, and keep the face near center unless stretch is the point. Do not write 14mm rectilinear, and do not ask for random wobble.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is 14mm Ultra-Wide with extra warp, or a wavy hallucination. The tell is straight walls that should bow, or unstable rippling. Fix: systematic barrel around a clear center, horizon curved, face protected unless you mean the stretch.

### Tilt-Shift
- 别名：Tilt-shift look, Diorama illusion ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lenses/tilt-shift)
- 定义：Tilt-shift cinematography tilts the lens relative to the sensor so the plane of focus rotates, and may also shift the lens to slide perspective. A narrow band or shaped region of sharpness, often from a high viewpoint, can make a real-scale scene resemble a small model.
- 叙事功能：Tilt is not a blur sticker. The Scheimpflug relation puts a slice of the world in focus along a plane that is no longer parallel to the sensor: a street of rowers, a crowd, a tabletop of people who suddenly read as toys. Shift is a different job: it slides the image to keep verticals parallel or to look around a corner without rotating the camera. It is the wrong tool when you only wanted a face isolated from a wall. That is Shallow Focus on a normal plane. It is also the wrong tool if the miniature effect has no high viewpoint and no consistent focus band. A horizontal blur strip that ignores perspective is a post fake, not this optic.
- 怎么拍：Tilt the lens so the focus plane cuts through the subject as a thin band or a wedge. A high angle helps the diorama reading because we look down on models. Match blur to depth; as perspective changes, the band should follow the plane, not a 2D stripe. Shift independently if you need to correct converging buildings. Prompt: A real-scale city or citadel with [Subject] human-sized. A thin band of focus across the subject, foreground and far ground softly blurred, no hard seam across the frame.
- 何时用：Use it to make a city a model, or to slice focus through a crowd on a tilted plane. Do not use it as a synonym for shallow portrait focus, and do not lay a blur bar across a flat image.
- 近似对比：Shallow Focus, Macro, Bird's-Eye View, Shallow FocusNothing else is invited., 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close., 24mm WidePerson plus place, neither winning.
  Shallow Focus keeps the focus plane parallel to the sensor and isolates by distance. Tilt rotates that plane. Macro is close-up scale, not a diorama of a city. Bird's-Eye View can supply the high viewpoint the miniature reading often needs, but a bird's-eye without a tilted focus plane is just a map. Shallow FocusNothing else is invited. 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close. 24mm WidePerson plus place, neither winning.
- 片中实例：The Social Network's Henley rowing sequence gives real-scale action a miniature-like appearance through a thin, high, diorama focus. Miniature-city treatments in other films follow the same grammar: high view, shallow band, motion that reads like a toy.；Borrow the plane, not a still of the race.；The Social Network 2010The Henley rowing sequence gives real-scale action a miniature-like appearance.
- Prompt 模板：`High oblique view of two rowing teams moving along a river, with a narrow depth-aware focus region around the boats and smoothly increasing blur nearer and farther away. Slightly brisk motion and crisp miniature-like detail. No actual toy proportions, no arbitrary blurry stripe across faces.`
- 示例 Prompt：`A thin horizontal band of focus across the subject, foreground and far ground softly blurred, no hard seam across the frame. Add a high viewpoint if you want the diorama.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Shallow Focus on a face, or a post miniature with a 2D blur strip. The tell is a portrait with creamy background, or a seam that ignores buildings' depth. Fix: high view, human-sized figures, focus as a plane through the scene, blur that follows depth.

### Macro
- 别名：Extreme-detail photography, Plan macro ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lenses/macro)
- 定义：Macro cinematography is close-focusing optics that let a small object or surface occupy the image at high reproduction scale, often near 1:1. An unusually close view turns texture, insects, eyes, or mechanisms into the entire shot.
- 叙事功能：The plot becomes a centimeter. A pill, a watch gear, a drop, a pupil: the object is no longer an insert in a room, it is the room. Depth of field collapses to a millimeter, so a breath or a rack is a traverse across a landscape of pores. It is the wrong tool when you only wanted a tight face. An Extreme Close-Up of an eye can be a long lens from a foot away; that is a crop, not macro scale. A normal close-up enlarged in post does not automatically have convincing macro texture or depth of field. If you need to travel through a glass or a machine, that is a Probe Lens.
- 怎么拍：Use a macro lens or close-focus setup, stabilize the object, and light for surface texture (small hard sources show relief; wrap shows translucency). Anticipate shallow depth of field and tiny focus changes. Working distance is short; watch your own shadow. Magnification is image size over object size, not the shot-size name. Prompt: Macro lens on a detail of [Subject], insects of texture, an eye, a watch, a drop of rain, a world in a centimeter.
- 何时用：Use it when the plot is microscopic: a ritual of pills, a bug, a lock mechanism. Do not use it as a synonym for close-up, and do not blow up a normal portrait and call it macro.
- 近似对比：Extreme Close-Up, Insert Shot, Probe Lens, Magnification, Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger., Insert ShotPoint at the thing that will matter later., 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
  Extreme Close-Up is a framing size; it may or may not use macro optics. Insert Shot is a story object in the cut, any size. Probe Lens is a long barrel that can enter tiny spaces with a wide-ish view. Magnification is the scale number; macro is one optical way to get it. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger. Insert ShotPoint at the thing that will matter later. 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
- 片中实例：Requiem for a Dream repeats extreme-detail images so rituals compress into sensory fragments. Amélie turns ordinary objects into tactile small pleasures.；Microcosmos treats insects as full-scale drama. Grammar of close-focus scale, not a copied frame of a pupil.；Requiem for a Dream 2000Repeated extreme-detail images compress rituals into sensory fragments.；Amélie 2001Tactile details turn ordinary objects and actions into small pleasures.
- Prompt 模板：`Extreme macro shot of a watchmaker lowering one tiny screw into an old brass mechanism. The screw head and adjacent gear teeth are crisp; focus falls away rapidly. One slow precise movement, realistic metal scale, no oversized fingers or morphing gears.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the optic and the centimeter. Macro lens on a detail of [Subject], insects of texture, an eye, a watch, a drop of rain, a world in a centimeter.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is an Extreme Close-Up made with a portrait lens, or a zoomed crop. The tell is normal skin-pore size with deep-ish focus, or a whole face labeled macro. Fix: small object filling the sensor, true close-focus falloff, texture lit as terrain.

### Probe Lens
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lenses/probe-lens)
- 定义：A probe lens is a long, narrow macro optic that can pass through small spaces and create extreme close moving shots from inside the subject. The front element is tiny and far from the camera body, so the viewpoint can enter a glass, a wound of machinery, food, or a miniature set.
- 叙事功能：The camera body stays outside. The tube goes where a camera cannot: through ice in a drink, between gears, across a tabletop forest, into a bottle. The view is often wide at the tip, so a drop of liquid becomes a lake and a crumb becomes a boulder, while the move can travel through that world. It is the wrong tool when a standard Macro from outside already sees the surface you need. It is also the wrong tool for a face portrait; the look is proximity through a hole, not an 85mm single. If you only wanted a 14mm in a normal room, you wanted 14mm Ultra-Wide, not a probe.
- 怎么拍：Mount the probe, protect the barrel, and plan a path the tip can physically travel. Light from outside the tiny space or fiber the interior; the front element is close to the subject and will see your flags if you are careless. Depth of field is still small despite the typical slow stop, because you are close. Stabilize the move; inches are miles. Prompt: Probe-lens view of [Subject], tiny wide lens on a stick, impossible proximity through glass, food, or machinery, miniature world.
- 何时用：Use it to go where a camera body cannot: through a drink, into a watch, across a plated meal as if it were terrain. Do not use it as a synonym for macro on a tabletop you could shoot from above.
- 近似对比：Macro, 14mm Ultra-Wide, Magnification, MacroThe plot is microscopic., 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close., 24mm WidePerson plus place, neither winning.
  Macro photographs a small object from outside at high scale. A probe enters the space. 14mm Ultra-Wide is a wide field from a normal camera body. Magnification is the scale; the probe is a delivery system that also tends to be wide at the tip. MacroThe plot is microscopic. 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close. 24mm WidePerson plus place, neither winning.
- 片中实例：Commercial food and product work uses probes constantly so a camera can travel through bubbles and garnish. The Hobbit's miniature-language cousins (and similar tabletop/miniature photography) rely on tiny viewpoints inside constructed worlds.；Treat those as grammar for impossible proximity, not as a still to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the tube and the interior path. Probe-lens view of [Subject], tiny wide lens on a stick, impossible proximity through glass, food, or machinery, miniature world.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Probe-lens view of [Subject], tiny wide lens on a stick, impossible proximity through glass, food, or machinery, miniature world.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Macro from outside, or a 14mm in a full-size room. The tell is a tabletop still with the camera clearly outside, or a normal interior wide. Fix: viewpoint from inside a small space, barrel-path move, wide-at-the-tip scale.

### Split Diopter
- 别名：Split-field diopter, Double plan de netteté ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lenses/split-diopter)
- 定义：A split diopter is a partial close-focus element that keeps different distance zones sharp in one frame. One region focuses very near while another remains focused farther away; it is not two focal lengths, and it is not ordinary deep focus.
- 叙事功能：A telephone in the foreground and a doorway across the room can both be tack-sharp, with a narrow blur band where the half-lens ends. The construction is often hidden on a door edge, a lamp, or a dark seam. The coexistence is the sentence: a face and a distant threat are equally true at once. It is the wrong tool when a small aperture and careful staging would hold both planes without a seam. That is Deep Focus. It is also the wrong tool if you meant to throw attention from one plane to the other over time: that is Rack Focus. Do not describe this as a split-screen or a ghost overlay.
- 怎么拍：Mount a split-field diopter in front of the taking lens so half the field is a close-up filter. Focus the naked side on the far subject; the diopter side will bring a near object into focus. Hide the boundary against a vertical edge or a soft region. A two-focus composite can recreate the look with more control. Prompt: One continuous room: a near object on the left tack-sharp and [Subject] far on the right also tack-sharp, a narrow blur band between them. Not a split-screen, not a ghost overlay.
- 何时用：Use it when two distances must both be true at once: a listener and a far figure, a glass and a door. Do not use it as a substitute for deep focus, and do not split the frame into two movies.
- 近似对比：Deep Focus, Rack Focus, Split Screen, Deep FocusLet the audience find the story in the whole room., Rack FocusChange who owns the shot without cutting., 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
  Deep Focus holds near and far by stopping down and staging, with no diopter seam. Rack Focus changes which plane is sharp over time. Split Screen cuts the frame into separate images. A split diopter is one take, two focus regions, a possible tell at the join. Deep FocusLet the audience find the story in the whole room. Rack FocusChange who owns the shot without cutting. 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
- 片中实例：Blow Out holds near listening equipment or faces with distant action in the same composition. Jaws keeps near and far figures simultaneously sharp in selected setups.；The Conversation and Mission: Impossible have used the same charged coexistence. Grammar of two distances at once, not a copied still.；Blow Out 1981Near listening equipment or faces share the frame with distant action.；Jaws 1975Near and far figures are held simultaneously in focus in selected compositions.
- Prompt 模板：`A listening device fills the near-left foreground; a suspicious figure stands far back on the right. Both are tack sharp, with a narrow soft transition aligned to a dark door jamb between them. Locked camera, deliberate split-diopter look, not uniformly sharp depth throughout the room.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name one room and two sharp zones. One continuous room: a near object on the left tack-sharp and [Subject] far on the right also tack-sharp, a narrow blur band between them.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not write deep focus or two shots side by side.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Deep Focus (no seam, everything held by aperture) or Split Screen (two images). The tell is a hard vertical cut, a double-exposed ghost, or uniform focus with no join. Fix: two distance zones, both sharp, a narrow optical blur band, one continuous space.

### Vintage Cine Glass
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lenses/vintage-cine)
- 定义：Vintage cine glass is older motion-picture optics whose coatings, contrast, and aberrations differ from modern clinical primes. Lower contrast, gentle halation, and sometimes swirling or rolling edges are properties of the lens, not a grade slapped on sharp digital.
- 叙事功能：Put a face on Cooke, K35, or similar older glass and the image rolls off instead of biting. Highlights bloom a little. Contrast sits down. Backgrounds can swirl or breathe at the edges. Memory, period, or beauty over resolution is the job of the optic, before anyone touches the timeline. It is the wrong tool when you need hard edges for VFX or a documentary fact. It is also the wrong tool if you only wanted a faded grade on modern glass: that is Filmic Faded or a Vintage treatment, not this lens. Halation can be stock or a filter; vintage cine may contribute similar bloom, but the swirl and the contrast live in the glass.
- 怎么拍：Choose actual vintage or vintage-inspired cine primes and shoot them wide enough to show the aberrations. Do not stop down until they behave like modern glass if those aberrations are the point. Keep skin highlights just hot enough to halate. Separate this from anamorphic squeeze: many vintage cine lenses are Spherical. Prompt: Vintage cine glass on [Subject], lower contrast, gentle halation, swirling edges, Cooke or K35 character, not clinical sharpness.
- 何时用：Use it for memory, period, or a face that should not look like a catalog. Do not use it as a synonym for a faded LUT on a modern zoom.
- 近似对比：Anamorphic, Halation, Filmic Faded, Vintage, HalationHighlights should bleed like film, not clip like video., AnamorphicYou want the frame to announce it is a movie., 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
  Anamorphic is a squeeze system; some vintage glass is anamorphic, most of this entry is about spherical old coatings. Halation is highlight bloom, one trait. Filmic Faded is a print-emulation grade. Vintage is a whole period treatment. Vintage cine is the taking lens. HalationHighlights should bleed like film, not clip like video. AnamorphicYou want the frame to announce it is a movie. 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
- 片中实例：The Master and Phantom Thread are often cited for older or character glass on faces: lower bite, gentle bloom, a refusal of clinical digital edges. Use that as grammar for optic character, not as a still to match pixel for pixel.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the glass, not a sticker. Vintage cine glass on [Subject], lower contrast, gentle halation, swirling edges, Cooke or K35 character, not clinical sharpness.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Add spherical unless you also want anamorphic ovals. Do not write faded LUT only, and do not add heavy grain as a substitute for the lens.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Filmic Faded grade or a Vintage dye fade on sharp modern glass. The tell is crunchy edges with a brown LUT, or grain with no optical swirl or halation. Fix: lower contrast in the taking image, gentle highlight bloom, edge character from the lens.

### Telephoto Compression
- 别名：Distant viewpoint, Compressed perspective ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lenses/compression)
- 定义：Telephoto compression in lens compression cinematography is the perspective effect of a distant viewpoint: size differences between separated depth planes shrink, so a crowd or a city appears to press against a person. A long lens then frames that distant view tightly; a long lens from a close stand does not create the effect.
- 叙事功能：Walk away until a far building and a near figure occupy similar size, then crop with 135mm or 200mm. Escape routes in depth disappear. An approaching rider takes an age. A fallen body and a car can look glued together. The air gets crowded even when the location is huge. It is the wrong tool when space should recede. From close with wide glass, near objects balloon and far walls drop away, the opposite sentence. Do not zoom in from a fixed tripod and call it compression: that is only a crop. Stand first, then glass.
- 怎么拍：Move farther away until the relative sizes of planes collapse, then choose a long focal length to restore the subject's size in the frame. Keep atmospheric haze, foreground overlaps, and focus consistent with that distance. A 200mm from 50 meters compresses; a 200mm crop of a 35mm file shot from 3 meters does not. Prompt: Telephoto compression stacking [Subject] against a wall of background, distances collapsed, crowded air, no escape in depth.
- 何时用：Use it when the city, army, or terrain should sit right on their back: a walker who cannot outrun the buildings. Do not use it as a synonym for any long lens, and do not claim compression from a close stand.
- 近似对比：200mm Long Telephoto, 135mm Telephoto, 85mm Portrait, 14mm Ultra-Wide, 200mm Long TelephotoFar away and still in their pores., 135mm TelephotoSurveillance, sports, or stacked city., 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
  200mm Long Telephoto and 135mm Telephoto are lengths that often frame this viewpoint. Compression is the standpoint, not the millimeter number. 85mm Portrait starts the stack but still feels like a portrait distance. 14mm Ultra-Wide from close is the anti-compression: exaggerated size differences. 200mm Long TelephotoFar away and still in their pores. 135mm TelephotoSurveillance, sports, or stacked city. 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
- 片中实例：Lawrence of Arabia lets Sherif Ali approach through desert shimmer as a study in collapsed distance. Payback glues a fallen figure and a car in depth.；Heat and Chungking Express stack cities so people have no air behind them. Grammar of viewpoint, not a copied composition.；Lawrence of Arabia 1962Sherif Ali's distant approach through the desert shimmer.；Payback 1999A fallen figure and a car appear tightly related in depth.
- Prompt 模板：`From far away with a long lens, frame one cyclist approaching along a straight road. Successive streetlights appear densely stacked behind him and his approach seems slow despite steady pedaling. Heat shimmer, fixed camera, no wide-angle expansion or zoom.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the collapsed distances, not only the lens. Telephoto compression stacking [Subject] against a wall of background, distances collapsed, crowded air, no escape in depth.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a long-lens label on a close-stand shot, or a wide that still shows receding space. The tell is large size differences between near and far, or a cropped 35mm perspective. Fix: walk away, long glass, planes of similar apparent size, crowded air.

### Magnification
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/lenses/magnification)
- 定义：Magnification in magnification cinematography is the ratio of the subject's image size on the sensor to its real size. High magnification makes a centimeter of the world fill the frame; it is a scale number, not a shot-size name and not automatically a macro lens.
- 叙事功能：Scale is lost on purpose. A tick, a spark, a cell of fabric becomes geography. Powers of Ten is a ladder of magnification: each step changes what counts as a place. Going closer than a close-up is the beat, but closer optically, not only by cropping a 4K face. It is the wrong tool when you meant a Close-Up of an actor from a meter away. That face may fill the frame at low magnification. It is also the wrong tool if the path through a tiny space is the point: Probe Lens delivers that path. Macro is the usual optic that reaches 1:1; magnification is the measurement you are after.
- 怎么拍：Decide the reproduction ratio (1:2, 1:1, 2:1) and pick optics that can hold it: macro, bellows, probe, or microscope. Light for the new scale; apparent motion and camera shake scale up with magnification. Depth of field collapses. Do not confuse digital punch-in with optical magnification: extra pixels are not extra scale. Prompt: Extreme magnification of [Subject], a world inside a centimeter, scale lost on purpose.
- 何时用：Use it when you must go closer than a close-up in true scale: a world inside a centimeter. Do not use it as a synonym for a tight portrait or a cropped still.
- 近似对比：Macro, Probe Lens, Extreme Close-Up, Insert Shot, MacroThe plot is microscopic., Probe LensGo where a camera body cannot., 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
  Macro is close-focusing optics that commonly reach these ratios. Probe Lens adds a barrel that can enter the small world. Extreme Close-Up is a framing of a feature, which may be low magnification. Magnification is the scale, not the cutaway name Insert Shot. MacroThe plot is microscopic. Probe LensGo where a camera body cannot. 14mm Ultra-WidePut the audience inside a space that is too big or too close.
- 片中实例：Microcosmos treats insect scale as full drama, true high magnification. Powers of Ten makes magnification itself the structure, stepping in and out of orders of size.；Use those as grammar for scale, not as frames to duplicate.
- Prompt 模板：`State a ratio if you can (1:1). Forbid ordinary close-up of a face, and forbid a simple crop of a wider shot.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the lost scale. Extreme magnification of [Subject], a world inside a centimeter, scale lost on purpose.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is an Extreme Close-Up or a punched-in Close-Up. The tell is a whole eye from portrait distance with moderate depth of field. Fix: object scale on the sensor near life-size or greater, razor focus, centimeter geography.

## 色彩与胶片质感 / Color and Film Look（19 条）

**速查**：Teal and Orange · Bleach Bypass · Monochrome · Sepia · Desaturation · Hyper-Saturation · Cool Blue · Warm Amber · Filmic Faded · Cross Process · Day for Night · Tungsten Balance · Moonlight Gel · Split Toning · Natural Grade · Color Shift · Vintage · Palette · Overexposed

### Teal and Orange
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/teal-orange)
- 定义：A teal and orange color grade pushes shadows and often skies toward cyan-teal while keeping skin and warm sources in the orange half of the wheel. It is a complementary split with faces protected, not a silver-retention process and not a general cool wash.
- 叙事功能：Skin stays peach or tan. Asphalt, night air, and foliage slide toward teal. Explosions, practicals, and desert sand sit on the orange side. The split is why contemporary studio action reads as punchy: complementary colors vibrate, and the audience still finds a face. It is the wrong tool when the world should be drained, metallic, and merciless. That is Bleach Bypass, which crushes chroma and raises contrast instead of parking hues on a complementary axis. It is also the wrong tool if you wanted an overall honey interior (Warm Amber) or a steel institution (Cool Blue). Taste is the limiter; the split becomes a cliche when every exterior night is the same teal wall.
- 怎么拍：Grade shadows and non-skin midtones toward cyan-teal. Isolate skin so it remains warm; push highlights and practicals toward amber or orange if the scene supports it. Do not paint half a face teal and half orange unless two sources actually do that. Contrast can be healthy, but this is hue geometry, not silver. Prompt: Teal-and-orange grade on [Subject], skin staying warm, shadows and skies pushed cyan, complementary split.
- 何时用：Use it when you want contemporary studio punch: a night street with warm skin against cyan air. Do not use it on a war or crime world that should feel silver and exhausted, and do not teal every shadow by default.
- 近似对比：Bleach Bypass, Split Toning, Warm Amber, Blockbuster Gloss, Blockbuster GlossThe shot must play on a billboard., Warm AmberHome, memory, or invitation., Bleach BypassWar, crime, or a world without mercy.
  Bleach Bypass desaturates and densifies; it does not park skin on orange against teal air. Split Toning is the general tool (any highlight hue versus any shadow hue). Teal-orange is one popular complementary instance, usually with skin isolation. Warm Amber is an overall warm world. Blockbuster Gloss is a broader finish that often includes this split. Blockbuster GlossThe shot must play on a billboard. Warm AmberHome, memory, or invitation. Bleach BypassWar, crime, or a world without mercy.
- 片中实例：Transformers-era Hollywood made the complementary split a default for studio action. Mad Max: Fury Road runs a harsher cousin: fire and chrome-orange against cyan-teal desert air.；Use the hue geometry, not a copied still of a truck.
- Prompt 模板：`Protect skin, then split the rest. Teal-and-orange grade on [Subject], skin staying warm, shadows and skies pushed cyan, complementary split.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Teal-and-orange grade on [Subject], skin staying warm, shadows and skies pushed cyan, blockbuster complementary split.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Bleach Bypass (drained, contrasty, metallic) or a full Cool Blue wash that turns faces cyan. The tell is grey-green skin, or no orange left in highlights. Fix: warm skin, cyan shadows and skies, complementary split, faces readable.

### Bleach Bypass
- 别名：Silver-retention look, Desaturated high-density image ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/bleach-bypass)
- 定义：Bleach bypass retains silver during processing, or simulates that retention, so the dye image sits on leftover metallic density. Contrast rises, grain shows, saturation falls, and highlights turn harsh rather than candy-colored.
- 叙事功能：The world looks abrasive, contaminated, or exhausted. Combat, crime, and unforgiving cities live here because color has been punished, not tastefully split. Skin can go towards brass or grey. Blacks pack down. It is a coordinated tonal system, not just the removal of hue. It is the wrong tool when you wanted complementary studio punch. Teal and Orange keeps faces warm and skies cyan; bleach-bypass does not throw a party on the color wheel. It is also the wrong tool if you need full Monochrome: there is still some chroma, just crushed. A simple Desaturation without the silver contrast is a paler, softer cousin.
- 怎么拍：For a digital recreation, grade contrast, saturation, and highlight roll-off separately and test skin. Lift nothing in the blacks that should stay packed. Keep a little hue so it does not collapse into black and white unless that is the intent. Original films may use different negative, intermediate, or print treatments; do not assume one lab recipe. Prompt: Bleach-bypass look on [Subject], retained silver, crushed color, harsh contrast, metallic midtones.
- 何时用：Use it for war, crime, or a world without mercy: a landing, a hunt through rain, a fluorescent interrogation. Do not use it as a synonym for teal-orange action gloss, and do not call every desaturated image bleach-bypass.
- 近似对比：Desaturation, Monochrome, Teal and Orange, Tonal Contrast, DesaturationDrain the world without going fully mono., Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste., MonochromeStrip to drawing.
  Desaturation only pulls chroma; contrast and silver behavior may stay gentle. Monochrome removes hue entirely. Teal and Orange is a complementary grade with warm skin. Tonal Contrast is how you place dark against light in the rectangle, not a lab process. DesaturationDrain the world without going fully mono. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste. MonochromeStrip to drawing.
- 片中实例：Saving Private Ryan's combat imagery has a harsh, desaturated, high-contrast character associated with silver retention. Se7en packs interiors and city scenes with dense shadows and restrained color.；Minority Report is often cited for a related cold, dense, drained finish. Grammar of density, not a still to clone.；Saving Private Ryan 1998Combat imagery has a harsh, desaturated, high-contrast character.；Se7en 1995Dark interiors and city scenes use dense shadows and restrained color.
- Prompt 模板：`Rain-soaked industrial street with restrained color, dense but separated blacks, pale stressed skin and hard wet highlights. Bleach-bypass-inspired tonal treatment, visible fine texture, no crushed black voids or monochrome conversion. Slow observational camera.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name silver, crush, and metal. Bleach-bypass look on [Subject], retained silver, crushed color, harsh contrast, metallic midtones.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Teal and Orange or mild Desaturation. The tell is warm peach skin against cyan night, or a flat grey wash with no extra density. Fix: packed blacks, harsh highlights, drained but not absent color, metallic mids. A look label does not verify the exact photochemical stage of a particular release.

### Monochrome
- 别名：black and white ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/monochrome)
- 定义：Monochrome, including black and white cinematography, removes or does not record chromatic information so the image is value, texture, and shape. Hue is gone; contrast, grain, and outline do the talking.
- 叙事功能：Strip to drawing. A lighthouse, a boxing ring, a list of names: without hue, costume and light have to carry rank. Skin becomes a grey. Blood becomes a density. The audience reads edges and tones the way they read a print. It is the wrong tool when leftover color is the point. Desaturation still lets a red coat or a yellow lamp speak. Bleach Bypass keeps a little chroma under silver. Sepia is not black and white; it is a brown-gold world. If a single object must arrive in hue inside a grey film, that is a Color Shift or a selective hold-out, not this technique used honestly.
- 怎么拍：Capture in color or in a panchromatic/orthochromatic black-and-white workflow, then discard chroma or never record it. Expose for a full grey scale: hats, skies, and faces need separation that hue is no longer providing. Orthochromatic stocks darken lips and skies differently than panchromatic; if you specify a stock era, keep that physics. Prompt: Monochrome treatment of [Subject], silver highlights, deep blacks, no chroma, shape and light only.
- 何时用：Use it when the scene should be a drawing: a confession in a tower, a fight, a historical record. Do not use it if a leftover color accent is doing the emotional work, and do not confuse it with a brown memory tone.
- 近似对比：Desaturation, Bleach Bypass, Sepia, Tonal Contrast, Bleach BypassWar, crime, or a world without mercy., Tonal ContrastMake a poster out of a frame., Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
  Desaturation keeps hue at a lower intensity. Bleach Bypass drains and densifies but is not fully grey. Sepia tints the whole scale brown-gold. Tonal Contrast is how blacks and whites are placed; monochrome is the missing chroma. Bleach BypassWar, crime, or a world without mercy. Tonal ContrastMake a poster out of a frame. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
- 片中实例：The Lighthouse commits to a hard black-and-white world of texture and rank. Raging Bull uses monochrome so boxing becomes tone and impact.；Schindler's List is largely black and white, with controlled exceptions that are a different technique. Grammar of value, not a poster.
- Prompt 模板：`Ban hue explicitly. Monochrome treatment of [Subject], silver highlights, deep blacks, no chroma, shape and light only.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the grey scale (deep blacks, silver highlights). Do not write sepia, and do not leave a teal wash.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Desaturation or Sepia. The tell is leftover blue in shadows, or a brown wash calling itself black and white. Fix: zero chroma, a real grey scale, texture carrying the image.

### Sepia
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/sepia)
- 定义：Sepia tone in sepia tone film maps the grey scale onto brown-gold instead of neutral silver, so whites go toward faded paper and blacks toward umber. It is a color of the past as chemistry, not a warm grade on a full-hue world.
- 叙事功能：A story that already happened often arrives in this brown. Photographs, memory inserts, and period chapters use it because the audience has been trained by albumen and toned prints. Faded whites, tobacco mids, no true cyan sky. It is the wrong tool when the present should still have a full palette that happens to be warm. That is Warm Amber or a Filmic Faded print with hues intact. It is also the wrong tool for true Monochrome silver. If the whole movie is a dusty yellow-brown but still has distinct reds and greens, you are in a restricted Palette or a period DI, not sepia toning.
- 怎么拍：Start from a monochrome or low-chroma image and tone highlights toward paper-gold, mids toward brown, shadows toward umber. Keep cyan and clean white out. Grain can sit in the mids as in a print. Do not overlay a brown sticker on a saturated modern grade and call it sepia. Prompt: Sepia tonality on [Subject], brown-gold memory, faded whites, the past as a color, not a filter sticker.
- 何时用：Use it for a chapter that already happened: a memory, a found photograph, a prologue. Do not use it as a synonym for any warm movie, and do not leave full modern chroma under the brown.
- 近似对比：Monochrome, Warm Amber, Filmic Faded, Vintage, Halation, Filmic FadedNot HDR. A print., Warm AmberHome, memory, or invitation., Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
  Monochrome is neutral silver. Warm Amber keeps full color in a honey world. Filmic Faded lifts blacks and rolls highlights while usually retaining hues. Vintage is a broader period chemistry look that may include sepia but also dye fade and Halation. Filmic FadedNot HDR. A print. Warm AmberHome, memory, or invitation. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
- 片中实例：The Godfather Part II uses warmer, aged memory color for earlier time. O Brother, Where Art Thou?；is a digital period finish in dusty yellow-brown, a cousin often cited when people say sepia. Treat those as grammar for past-as-tone, not as frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Map the scale to brown-gold. Sepia tonality on [Subject], brown-gold memory, faded whites, the past as a color, not a filter sticker.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Sepia tonality on [Subject], brown-gold memory, faded whites, the past as a color, not a filter sticker.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Warm Amber (full hue, honey mids) or a Instagram brown on a color image. The tell is green trees and blue jeans still speaking as themselves under a wash. Fix: brown-gold scale, faded whites, almost no leftover modern hue.

### Desaturation
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/desaturation)
- 定义：Desaturation in desaturated cinematography reduces color intensity while leaving hue present. The world is wintered or dusted; leftover accents still speak, but chroma is no longer loud.
- 叙事功能：Drain the world without going fully mono. A grey-green England, a dusty border, a road the color of ash: emotion sits in whatever hue remains, a red taillight or a pale face. The audience feels the withholding. It is the wrong tool when you needed silver density and harsh highlights. That is Bleach Bypass. It is the wrong tool when hue should be gone entirely (Monochrome) or when feeling should be louder than fact (Hyper-Saturation). A teal-orange split can coexist with moderate saturation; do not confuse a complementary grade with a drain.
- 怎么拍：Pull global chroma down, then decide which accents survive (a practical, a costume, blood). Keep contrast independent: desaturation is not automatically high contrast. Skin should stay identifiable as skin, just quieter. Prompt: Desaturated palette on [Subject], chroma pulled back, dusty, wintered, emotion in leftover color accents.
- 何时用：Use it to drain the world without going fully mono: a refugee road, a winter city, a moral hangover. Do not use it as bleach-bypass, and do not desaturate until nothing but grey remains unless you meant monochrome.
- 近似对比：Bleach Bypass, Monochrome, Cool Blue, Hyper-Saturation, Bleach BypassWar, crime, or a world without mercy., Cool BlueCold institutions, night, or alienation., Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
  Bleach Bypass adds silver contrast and metallic mids on top of a drain. Monochrome is zero chroma. Cool Blue is a hue family, which may still be saturated. Hyper-Saturation is the opposite lever. Bleach BypassWar, crime, or a world without mercy. Cool BlueCold institutions, night, or alienation. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
- 片中实例：Children of Men winters a near-future England so leftover color hurts. Sicario dusts the border until chroma is a ration.；The Road goes further, almost ash. Grammar of withheld hue, not a copied sky.
- Prompt 模板：`Pull chroma, keep accents. Desaturated palette on [Subject], chroma pulled back, dusty, wintered, emotion in leftover color accents.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the one leftover hue if there is one. Do not write bleach-bypass silver, and do not go fully black and white.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Bleach Bypass or Monochrome. The tell is metallic packed blacks with harsh grain, or zero hue. Fix: quieter chroma, identifiable leftover color, contrast set independently of the drain.

### Hyper-Saturation
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/hyper-saturation)
- 定义：Hyper-saturation in saturated cinematography raises color intensity past ordinary record, so hues read as lacquer, fever, or dream. Feeling is louder than fact; the palette is not documentary.
- 叙事功能：Reds become wet enamel. Greens look poisonous or operatic. A dance academy, a wuxia desert, a Hong Kong corridor: the world is painted, and the paint is the emotion. Accents do not hide; they shout. It is the wrong tool when the location's real color science should be believed. That is Natural Grade. It is the wrong tool for a complementary studio split that still wants plausible skin (Teal and Orange), and it is not a chemical accident (Cross Process), which skews primaries off their true identities. Giallo often uses this lever, but giallo is a genre system, not the saturation knob.
- 怎么拍：Push chroma, especially in chosen primaries, while watching skin. You may isolate skin to protect it or let it go with the fever. Contrast can be high or candy-flat; saturation is independent. Production design should already supply the hues you will amplify, or the grade will invent plastic color. Prompt: Hyper-saturated color on [Subject], Velvia intensity, reds like lacquer, a dream or a fever, not documentary.
- 何时用：Use it when feeling is louder than fact: a nightmare corridor, a told-and-retold battle, a romance that is all dye. Do not use it on a documentary claim, and do not confuse it with teal-orange punch.
- 近似对比：Teal and Orange, Cross Process, Giallo, Desaturation, GialloHorror that is also fashion., Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste., Bleach BypassWar, crime, or a world without mercy.
  Teal and Orange is a complementary split, often at moderate-to-high but controlled chroma. Cross Process misplaces hues (cyan shadows, magenta skin). Giallo is a genre package that frequently includes this intensity. Desaturation is the opposite lever. GialloHorror that is also fashion. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste. Bleach BypassWar, crime, or a world without mercy.
- 片中实例：Suspiria (1977) treats color as a physical force, reds and blues at full scream. Hero organizes versions of a story as saturated fields of cloth and desert.；In the Mood for Love lets corridor and cheongsam dyes run hotter than life. Grammar of intensity, not a still of a lamp.
- Prompt 模板：`Name intensity, not a mood word. Hyper-saturated color on [Subject], Velvia intensity, reds like lacquer, a dream or a fever, not documentary.`
- 示例 Prompt：`List the loud hues. Do not write teal-orange split, and do not ask for naturalistic skin if the fever should include the face.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Teal and Orange (controlled complementary) or Cross Process (wrong primaries). The tell is cyan shadows with peach skin, or hues that have slipped to the wrong neighbors. Fix: true hues, louder than life, design that already holds those colors.

### Cool Blue
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/cool-blue)
- 定义：A cool blue grade in cool color grade work shifts the image toward steel, cyan, or moonlight blues across shadows and often midtones. Warmth, if it survives, is reserved for a practical or a face that the story wants to save.
- 叙事功能：Cold institutions, night, or alienation live in this family. A hospital, a CIA office, a pre-dawn street: the air has no honey. Skin goes toward porcelain or grey-pink. One tungsten desk lamp, if you allow it, becomes the only hearth. It is the wrong tool when you are faking night with underexposed sun. That is Day for Night, a capture trick, not only a blue LUT. It is the wrong tool for sculpted moon as a key on a dark set: Moonlight Gel is a lighting decision. It is also the wrong tool if the complementary split of Teal and Orange is what you actually wanted (warm skin, teal air, not an overall steel wash).
- 怎么拍：Bias white balance or the grade toward high Kelvin in the mids and shadows. Hold or isolate a warm practical if the scene needs one hearth. Keep skin just readable; full cyan faces look sick unless that is the line. Night windows and fluorescent rooms already help. Prompt: Cool blue grade on [Subject], steel shadows, hospital or moonlight, warmth reserved for one practical if any.
- 何时用：Use it for cold institutions, night, or alienation: a lawyer in a glass tower at 5 a.m., a clinic corridor. Do not use it as a synonym for day-for-night, and do not steel every romance interior.
- 近似对比：Blue Hour, Day for Night, Moonlight Gel, Warm Amber, Teal and Orange, Blue HourDay is gone but the sky still works., Day for NightYou cannot wait for night, or night must still show terrain., Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
  Blue Hour is actual dusk light, a capture window. Day for Night turns daylight into a night reading. Moonlight Gel is a cool key on set. Warm Amber is the opposing overall grade. Teal and Orange keeps skin warm on purpose. Blue HourDay is gone but the sky still works. Day for NightYou cannot wait for night, or night must still show terrain. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
- 片中实例：The Bourne Ultimatum runs steel-green-blue through offices, streets, and stations so the institution never thaws. Michael Clayton uses cold corporate and night hues against the few warmer domestic scraps.；Grammar of withheld warmth, not a copied still.
- Prompt 模板：`Specify whether skin goes cool or stays slightly protected. Do not write day-for-night sun, and do not add orange complementary punch unless you mean teal-orange.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the steel and the reserved hearth. Cool blue grade on [Subject], steel shadows, hospital or moonlight, warmth reserved for one practical if any.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Teal and Orange (skin stays warm) or Day for Night (hard shadows from a high sun). The tell is peach faces against cyan, or daytime sky structure. Fix: overall cool bias, maybe one warm practical, no high-sun day cues.

### Warm Amber
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/warm-amber)
- 定义：A warm amber grade in warm color grade work biases mids and highlights toward tungsten honey, candle, and practical glow. Safety, home, or nostalgia sits in the mids; the world is invited rather than chilled.
- 叙事功能：Interiors go honey. Skin picks up lamp color. Windows, if they stay, can go relatively cooler, but the room itself is an invitation. Memory dinners, fairy-tale hotels, and domestic hearths live here because the grade says stay. It is the wrong tool for a past that should look like a toned print. That is Sepia, brown-gold with chroma mostly gone.
