It is the wrong tool for mixed-source truth where 3200K rooms meet 5600K windows as a relationship: that is Tungsten Balance, a white-balance fact, not only a honey LUT. Golden Hour is actual low sun, a capture window you can grade warm, not a synonym.
- 怎么拍：Bias the grade toward 2800K to 4000K in the mids. Let practicals and candles carry the key when you can (Candlelight, Practical Lighting). Keep whites from clipping to paper unless overexposure is the point. Skin should look blooded, not jaundiced; pull green if tungsten goes sick. Prompt: Warm amber grade on [Subject], tungsten honey, candle and practical glow, safety or nostalgia in the mids.
- 何时用：Use it for home, memory, or invitation: a kitchen at night, a hotel corridor that wants you. Do not use it as sepia, and do not honey a crime scene that should stay merciless.
- 近似对比：Sepia, Golden Hour, Tungsten Balance, Teal and Orange, Candlelight, Golden HourYou have twenty minutes of truth., CandlelightPeriod night or ritual., Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
  Sepia is a brown-gold toned scale, not full color. Golden Hour is a time of day. Tungsten Balance is the camera's white balance at about 3200K, which can make windows blue. Teal and Orange warms skin while cooling the world. Candlelight is the source; warm-amber is the overall grade. Golden HourYou have twenty minutes of truth. CandlelightPeriod night or ritual. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
- 片中实例：Amélie keeps interiors in inviting warm practical color so Paris is a hearth. The Grand Budapest Hotel paints hotel spaces with designed warm (and pastel) invitation.；Grammar of hospitality in the mids, not a copied lobby.
- Prompt 模板：`Name honey mids and practical glow. Warm amber grade on [Subject], tungsten honey, candle and practical glow, safety or nostalgia in the mids.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Keep full color, not sepia. Do not write bleach-bypass, and do not add a teal complementary wall unless you mean that split.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Sepia or Teal and Orange. The tell is no true hue left, or cyan streets with only the face warm. Fix: overall amber bias, lamps as hearths, color still present in costumes and walls.

### Filmic Faded
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/filmic-faded)
- 定义：A filmic faded grade in filmic color grade work imitates a print: blacks are lifted off true zero, highlights roll off instead of clipping like video, and contrast sits like photochemical display. It is not HDR punch, and it is not automatically period costume.
- 叙事功能：The image looks like it could have gone through a projector. Shadows have air. Bright windows go creamy instead of digital-clipped. Romance and memory often live here because the display already forgives, but the hues can still be present and modern. It is the wrong tool when you need packed, merciless blacks (Bleach Bypass or a hard digital contrast). It is the wrong tool if the fade is meant as expired dyes and period chemistry as a whole costume: that is Vintage. Vintage Cine Glass is the taking lens; you can shoot modern glass and still fade the print. Film Grain is texture you may add, not the fade itself.
- 怎么拍：Lift the toe (blacks sit at a low grey, not 0). Roll the shoulder so highlights compress instead of hard-clipping. Keep saturation moderate unless the story is candy. A print-emulation LUT is a starting point; still check skin and that blacks are lifted, not milky-brown by accident. Prompt: Filmic faded grade on [Subject], lifted blacks, rolled-off highlights, print-emulation, slightly expired romance.
- 何时用：Use it when the display should feel like a print rather than HDR: a summer memory, a period-adjacent present. Do not use it on a look that needs crushed blacks, and do not treat fade as a substitute for vintage glass.
- 近似对比：Vintage, Vintage Cine Glass, Film Grain, Bleach Bypass, Natural Grade, Film GrainThe image should feel developed, not rendered., Vintage Cine GlassMemory, period, or beauty over resolution., Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
  Vintage is a broader past-as-chemistry treatment (dye fade, period). Vintage Cine Glass is the lens. Film Grain is grain. Bleach Bypass packs density instead of lifting the toe. Natural Grade can be print-like or not; natural is about hue honesty, not the toe and shoulder. Film GrainThe image should feel developed, not rendered. Vintage Cine GlassMemory, period, or beauty over resolution. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
- 片中实例：The Master often sits in a print-like contrast with air in the blacks. Call Me by Your Name lets summer highlights roll instead of biting like video.；Grammar of toe and shoulder, not a still of a peach.
- Prompt 模板：`Say blacks are not crushed and highlights are not HDR-clipped. Do not write bleach-bypass, and do not add a sepia sticker unless you mean sepia.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the print curve. Filmic faded grade on [Subject], lifted blacks, rolled-off highlights, print-emulation, slightly expired romance.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Bleach Bypass (packed, harsh) or a milky brown wash. The tell is crushed blacks, or a foggy image with no rolled shoulder. Fix: lifted toe, compressed highlights, hues still present, contrast like a print.

### Cross Process
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/cross-process)
- 定义：A cross process look imitates developing a film in the wrong chemistry, such as slide stock in color-negative developer, so primaries skew off their true identities. Contrast often climbs; cyan shadows, magenta or yellow skin shifts, and other chemical accidents become the palette.
- 叙事功能：Wrong chemistry on purpose. Fashion films and music videos of the 1990s used the accident as style: skies go odd, shadows pick up cyan or green, skin slides toward magenta or jaundice. The world looks like a lab error you kept. It is the wrong tool when you wanted true hues only louder. That is Hyper-Saturation. It is the wrong tool for a designed complementary split with protected skin (Teal and Orange). Vaporwave may borrow skewed primaries as a genre costume; cross-process is the chemical alibi, not the nostalgia package.
- 怎么拍：Offset primary relationships: push shadows toward cyan or green, let highlights go yellow, magenta, or red depending on the stock story, and raise contrast. Skin will not grade like a commercial unless you isolate it, which fights the look. Do not randomly assign hues shot to shot; pick one accident and keep it. Prompt: Cross-processed look on [Subject], skewed primaries, cyan shadows, magenta skin shift, music-video chemical accident.
- 何时用：Use it when the image should look like a kept lab error: a 1990s fashion clip, a music video, an unreliable night. Do not use it as loud-but-true color, and do not confuse it with teal-orange.
- 近似对比：Hyper-Saturation, Teal and Orange, Vaporwave, Color Shift, Hyper-SaturationFeeling is louder than fact., VaporwaveNostalgia for a future that never shipped., Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
  Hyper-Saturation intensifies correct hues. Teal and Orange is a controlled complementary grade. Vaporwave is a genre palette. Color Shift is a change of color state over time or across a threshold. Cross-process is a skewed primary relationship from the start. Hyper-SaturationFeeling is louder than fact. VaporwaveNostalgia for a future that never shipped. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
- 片中实例：1990s fashion films and music videos are the grammar: chemical accident as style, not a single canonical feature. When a narrative film borrows it, the tell is displaced primaries rather than simple loud red.；Treat those clips as the reference class.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the wrong primaries. Cross-processed look on [Subject], skewed primaries, cyan shadows, magenta skin shift, music-video chemical accident.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Cross-processed look on [Subject], skewed primaries, cyan shadows, magenta skin shift, music-video chemical accident.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Hyper-Saturation or Teal and Orange. The tell is correct reds that are only louder, or peach faces on cyan streets in a studio-split pattern. Fix: hues that have slipped to the wrong neighbors, contrasty accident, skin not commercially protected.

### Day for Night
- 别名：Nuit américaine, Daylight transformed into night ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/day-for-night)
- 定义：Day for night cinematography photographs daylight so it will read as nighttime while still showing terrain that true night might hide. Exposure, sky, and highlight control do the lying; a blue wash alone is not the technique.
- 叙事功能：You cannot wait for night, or night must still show a desert, a ranch, a ridge. The sun is skipped, flagged, or placed as a hard moon. Underexposure and a cool bias sell darkness, but headlights, windows, and eyes must still find something to see. It is the wrong tool when you can light a real night with a sculpted moon (Moonlight Gel) and do not need miles of terrain. It is the wrong tool if you only grade a day interior steel (Cool Blue) without hiding day cues: blue sky, short hard shadows from high sun, warm unlit windows. Ordinary day-for-night and a special high-sensitivity or infrared capture system are not the same production method.
- 怎么拍：Control daylight direction, often shooting when the sun is lower or back, and underexpose. Avoid obvious daytime cues (pale blue zenith, visible sun disc, lit-looking clouds). Reshape color toward moonlight. More advanced approaches combine differently sensitive captures. Do not equate the technique with simply making footage blue. Prompt: Day-for-night treatment of [Subject], underexposed daylight, blue wash, skipped-over sun, moonlight as a lie that reads.
- 何时用：Use it when you cannot wait for night, or night must still show terrain: a desert chase, a ranch under a false moon. Do not use it as a blue LUT on a sunny street with the sun in frame.
- 近似对比：Cool Blue, Moonlight Gel, Blue Hour, Tungsten Balance, Cool BlueCold institutions, night, or alienation., Moonlight GelNight that is still sculpted., Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
  Cool Blue is a grade, including on true night or interiors. Moonlight Gel is a cool key you hang. Blue Hour is real twilight. Tungsten Balance can turn daylight windows blue as mixed color, which is not the same as selling a whole landscape as night. Cool BlueCold institutions, night, or alienation. Moonlight GelNight that is still sculpted. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
- 片中实例：Classic Westerns often sold day as night to keep horses and mesas readable. Mad Max: Fury Road has stylized blue night passages in the desert.；Nope's ranch-at-night work uses a specific capture approach that should not be flattened into ordinary day-for-night. Grammar of terrain-at-night, not a copied sky.；Nope 2022The ranch and surrounding landscape at apparent night.；Mad Max: Fury Road 2015The stylized blue night passages in the desert.
- Prompt 模板：`A wide horse ranch under apparent moonlight: deep dark sky, subtly readable distant hills, muted color and believable cool low-level illumination. One rider crosses the field. No bright daytime clouds, no obvious noon shadows, no uniform blue overlay. Generate a controlled base and grade sky and terrain separately.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Hide the day, keep the land. Day-for-night treatment of [Subject], underexposed daylight, blue wash, skipped-over sun, moonlight as a lie that reads.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Cool Blue LUT on obvious day, or underexposed day that still shows a white sky and short noon shadows. The tell is blue-tinted sunlight with the sun in shot. Fix: skip the sun, underexpose, cool the key, keep terrain, kill daytime sky cues.

### Tungsten Balance
- 别名：Warm interior versus cool exterior ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/tungsten-balance)
- 定义：Tungsten balance in tungsten color temperature work sets the camera or stock for about 3200K so tungsten practicals render near-neutral or gently warm while daylight and cooler sources go blue. Different source colors remain visibly distinct rather than being normalized to one white.
- 叙事功能：The room is warm; the world is not. A hotel corridor, a Christmas party, a snowed-in hotel: 3200K lamps own the interior, and the windows go cold. Mixed sources tell inside versus out without a caption. Safety and exposure can split across a pane of glass. It is the wrong tool when the whole image should be honey with no cold leftover. That is Warm Amber as a grade. It is the wrong tool if you paint opposite halves of a face teal and orange without sources to justify it. Do not treat this as a LUT named mixed lighting; it is a white-balance relationship among real lamps.
- 怎么拍：Set white balance near 3200K, or use tungsten stock. Let 5600K windows, moonlight, or cool LEDs go blue. Keep 3200K practicals as the interior key (Practical Lighting). Gels exist to convert sources toward or away from that balance. Colored light should hit nearby surfaces consistently. Prompt: Tungsten-balanced interior on [Subject], 3200K warmth, windows going cold blue, mixed sources telling inside versus out.
- 何时用：Use it when the room is warm and the world is not: a night interior with cold windows, a party against snow. Do not use it to fake a complementary grade without sources, and do not neutralize every lamp to the same white.
- 近似对比：Warm Amber, Cool Blue, Practical Lighting, Moonlight Gel, Split Toning, Practical LightingLet the set light the face., Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste., Bleach BypassWar, crime, or a world without mercy.
  Warm Amber is an overall honey grade, not necessarily mixed. Cool Blue chills the whole frame. Practical Lighting supplies the lamps this balance photographs. Moonlight Gel is a cool key you hang, which will go even colder if the camera is tungsten-balanced. Split Toning paints highlights and shadows in grade; this is source color at capture. Practical LightingLet the set light the face. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste. Bleach BypassWar, crime, or a world without mercy.
- 片中实例：The Shining lets warm interior sources contrast with cold blue window light. Eyes Wide Shut keeps warm practicals and cool night illumination in the same rooms.；Heat and Her also live in mixed-temperature interiors. Grammar of 3200K versus daylight, not a copied wallpaper.；The Shining 1980Warm interior sources contrast with cold blue window light.；Eyes Wide Shut 1999Warm practicals and cool night illumination coexist.
- Prompt 模板：`A woman sits at a kitchen table lit by a warm tungsten pendant while cold blue predawn light enters from a window behind her. Both colors stay distinct, natural skin transitions, readable shadows. She turns toward the window and moves from warmth into cooler light.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name 3200K and the cold window. Tungsten-balanced interior on [Subject], 3200K warmth, windows going cold blue, mixed sources telling inside versus out.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Warm Amber (no cold leftover) or Teal and Orange painted on a face. The tell is a uniformly honey room, or a split face with no window or lamp to cause it. Fix: 3200K balance, visible warm practicals, daylight or night windows going blue, consistent spill.

### Moonlight Gel
- 别名：Gel-color world, Unmotivated expressive color ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/moonlight-gel)
- 定义：Moonlight gel in moonlight lighting gel work is a cool, often cyan or steel-green key standing in for the moon, usually a large source from above or through trees. Night stays sculpted: there is a direction, a rim, and deep underexposure, not only a blue grade.
- 叙事功能：A single cool key as the moon, silver edges, ground barely held. Fire, a cabin window, or a lantern can oppose it as a warm hearth. The audience should feel a source in the sky even when the moon disc is out of frame. It is the wrong tool when you are faking night with underexposed noon (Day for Night). It is the wrong tool when the whole file is merely cooled in the timeline (Cool Blue) with no sculpted key. Strongly colored, unmotivated gels (academy reds and greens in Suspiria, nightmare color in Mandy) are cousins in expressive gel work; if the beat is psychological color rather than a moon, say so, and do not call every gelled nightmare moonlight.
- 怎么拍：Hang a large cool source high, gel toward cyan, steel blue, or pale green, and underexpose the fill so night remains night. Edge the figure with that key; keep faces just inside readability. A warm practical can sit in the frame as opposition. Control spill so the moon stays one direction. Prompt: Moonlight gel on [Subject], cyan-green night, a single cool key as the moon, deep underexposure, silver edges.
- 何时用：Use it for night that is still sculpted: a forest approach, a snow field, a cabin under a false moon. Do not use it as a blue LUT on day, and do not flatten night into even cool fill.
- 近似对比：Cool Blue, Day for Night, Blue Hour, Tungsten Balance, Hyper-Saturation, Blue HourDay is gone but the sky still works., Cool BlueCold institutions, night, or alienation., Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
  Cool Blue is a grade. Day for Night is daylight sold as night. Blue Hour is real dusk. Tungsten Balance will make a cool gel even colder if the camera is set to 3200K. Hyper-Saturation plus gels becomes expressive color (Suspiria, Mandy), which is related gel language but not a moon key. Blue HourDay is gone but the sky still works. Cool BlueCold institutions, night, or alienation. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
- 片中实例：The Revenant uses cool night against fire so moon and hearth compete. The Witch sculpts dark-forest night as a directional cool.；Suspiria and Mandy show how far gel color can leave natural moon; use them as grammar for expressive gels, not as default moonlight. Borrow direction and underexposure.；Suspiria 1977The dance academy's saturated red, blue and green interiors.；Mandy 2018Extreme colored light supports a subjective nightmare atmosphere.
- Prompt 模板：`A dancer crosses an empty rehearsal room divided between deep crimson side light and cold cobalt light from the opposite side. Colors remain spatially separate and shift across her body as she moves. Rich blacks, deliberate theatrical unreality, no rainbow lighting or pulsing nightclub effects.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the cool key and the underexposure. Moonlight gel on [Subject], cyan-green night, a single cool key as the moon, deep underexposure, silver edges.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Cool Blue fill or Day for Night sun. The tell is no key direction, or hard noon shadows tinted blue. Fix: one high cool source, silver rims, packed night, maybe one warm opposing practical.

### Split Toning
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/split-tone)
- 定义：Split toning in split toning cinematography assigns one hue to highlights and another to shadows, so the tone curve becomes a two-color world. Any pair is legal; teal-and-orange is only one famous instance.
- 叙事功能：Shadows and lights belong to different gods. Gold over teal, magenta over green, steel over amber: the split is a law for the whole image, not a pair of gels in the room. Drive's night can feel like candy highlights over cool dark. A future city can put warm sun on one side of the curve and cyan smog on the other. It is the wrong tool when the split should come from real lamps (a 3200K room and a cold window). That is Tungsten Balance or mixed Practical Lighting, including Neon Practicals. It is the wrong tool if you only wanted overall steel or overall honey. And it is not bleach-bypass, which is density, not a two-hue curve.
- 怎么拍：In the grade, map the toe to hue A and the shoulder to hue B, with a crossover in the mids you actually like on skin. Keep the pair limited; more hues are not a stronger split. Test faces at the crossover. Prompt: Split-toned grade on [Subject], highlights one hue, shadows another, for example gold over teal, a two-color world.
- 何时用：Use it when highlights and shadows should belong to different hues as a law: a night drive, a future city. Do not use it as a substitute for mixed practicals, and do not assume the pair must be teal and orange.
- 近似对比：Teal and Orange, Neon Practicals, Cross Process, Palette, Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste., Neon PracticalsThe city is the lighting department., Bleach BypassWar, crime, or a world without mercy.
  Teal and Orange is a specific complementary split that also isolates skin. Split-tone is the general method and can be gold/teal, magenta/green, or something else. Neon Practicals is colored light in the room. Cross Process skews primaries chemically rather than splitting the curve cleanly. Palette restricts production design hues; split-tone paints the tone curve. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste. Neon PracticalsThe city is the lighting department. Bleach BypassWar, crime, or a world without mercy.
- 片中实例：Drive often lets night highlights and shadows sit in different hue families. Blade Runner 2049 grades future light so sun, smog, and interior color occupy different parts of the curve.；Grammar of two-hue curves, not a still of a car.
- Prompt 模板：`Name both hues and which owns shadows. Split-toned grade on [Subject], highlights one hue, shadows another, for example gold over teal, a two-color world.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Split-toned grade on [Subject], highlights one hue, shadows another, for example gold over teal, a two-color world.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Teal and Orange used as the only imaginable split, or mixed lamps called split tone. The tell is peach skin plus cyan streets with no other pair allowed, or colored neon in the set with a neutral grade. Fix: declare highlight hue and shadow hue, apply them on the curve, keep the law consistent.

### Natural Grade
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/natural-grade)
- 定义：A natural color grade keeps skin faithful and saturation restrained so the location's real color science remains the authority. No stylized split, no silver punishment, no fever: the grade mostly refuses to editorialize hue.
- 叙事功能：Style would be a lie. A holiday video that is actually grief, a village in true sun, a fluorescent shop that should stay ugly: the audience is asked to believe the place, not a lookbook. Fidelity is the point, which is harder than a LUT because every mistake shows as fakery. It is the wrong tool when color must carry a version of the story (Palette, Color Shift) or when the world is merciless silver (Bleach Bypass). Filmic Faded can still be fairly natural in hue while lifting the toe; natural-grade is about hue honesty first. Available Light is how you captured it; you can still ruin that capture with a stylized grade.
- 怎么拍：Balance to a plausible white for the location and time of day. Hold skin in a real range (blood, melanin, no teal faces, no plastic orange). Restrain saturation; do not invent complementary walls. Contrast should match the light you shot, not a trailer. Prompt: Natural grade on [Subject], faithful skin, restrained saturation, no stylized split, the location's real color science.
- 何时用：Use it when style would be a lie: a documentary-adjacent drama, a sunlit memory that must stay ordinary. Do not use it if the beat is a designed palette, a fever, or a complementary poster.
- 近似对比：Available Light, Filmic Faded, Teal and Orange, Split Toning, Warm Amber, Cool Blue, Available LightCommit to the hour you have., Filmic FadedNot HDR. A print., Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
  Available Light is the capture sources. Filmic Faded is a print curve that may still be honest in hue. Teal and Orange and Split Toning editorialize the wheel. Warm Amber and Cool Blue are overall biases. Natural-grade refuses those biases except what the location already had. Available LightCommit to the hour you have. Filmic FadedNot HDR. A print. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
- 片中实例：Aftersun lets holiday light stay plausible so the grief is not costumed in a look. Timbuktu holds desert and village color as themselves.；Grammar of restraint, not a still to match.
- Prompt 模板：`Forbid the splits by name. Natural grade on [Subject], faithful skin, restrained saturation, no stylized split, the location's real color science.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Natural grade on [Subject], faithful skin, restrained saturation, no stylized split, the location's real color science.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a mild Teal and Orange or a Filmic Faded LUT that still splits hues. The tell is cyan shadows under 'natural', or plastic skin. Fix: faithful skin, location-true walls and sky, no complementary law, restrained chroma.

### Color Shift
- 别名：Color threshold, B&W/color transition ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/color-shift)
- 定义：A color shift effect is a change of color state that the audience is meant to notice: monochrome to hue, one world to another, or a slide of temperature during the shot. Color is the event, not a hidden LUT.
- 叙事功能：Dorothy opens a door and the world gains hue. A zone, a lie, a memory: the threshold can be a cut, a doorway, or a grade that travels inside the take. The audience crosses with the character. A global saturation ramp is different from a color world revealed through a door. It is the wrong tool when the film simply has more than one static Palette across chapters. Palettes can sit still; a shift is a change you watch. It is also the wrong tool for Cross Process or Split Toning that never move. If the beat is one loud world from the first frame, you wanted Hyper-Saturation or a locked palette, not a shift.
- 怎么拍：Choose whether the change occurs across a cut, through an opening, or gradually inside the image. Match production design and exposure so the arrival of color (or of a new temperature) feels intended. If you go from grey to hue, expose the grey chapter so the later color has somewhere to live. Prompt: Color shift across [Subject], hues sliding mid-shot or mid-grade, a world that changes temperature in front of us. For video: The grade around [Subject] shifts hue during the shot, warmth turning cold or the reverse.
- 何时用：Use it when color is the event: a door onto a new world, a lie that changes temperature, a zone. Do not use it as a random hue drift, and do not call two static chapter palettes a shift unless we watch the change.
- 近似对比：Palette, Split Toning, Cross Process, Monochrome, Split ToningShadows and lights belong to different gods., Cross ProcessWrong chemistry on purpose., Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
  Palette assigns stable hue systems to strands or places. Split Toning is a static two-hue curve. Cross Process is a skewed primary look. Monochrome is a state you might leave. Color-shift is the transition. Split ToningShadows and lights belong to different gods. Cross ProcessWrong chemistry on purpose. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
- 片中实例：The Wizard of Oz makes the farmhouse door a threshold into hue. Stalker changes visual treatment between the outside world and the Zone.；Hero retells events in different dominant colors; some transitions are chapter cuts, which is palette as much as shift. Suspiria (2018) lets color states mutate with the story.；Grammar of a threshold, not a still of a ruby shoe.；The Wizard of Oz 1939Dorothy opens the farmhouse door onto the colorful world of Oz.；Stalker 1979The visual treatment changes between the outside world and the Zone.
- Prompt 模板：`Inside a muted sepia workshop, a child opens a large door onto a richly colored greenhouse. Keep the interior sepia while the exterior already exists in color beyond the threshold. As the camera crosses the doorway, enter the full-color world. No dissolve or global color wash.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the before and after. Color shift across [Subject], hues sliding mid-shot or mid-grade, a world that changes temperature in front of us.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a static Palette or a Split Toning that never moves. The tell is two looks in two scenes with no threshold, or a random hue drift. Fix: a defined before-state, a defined after-state, and a visible crossing (door, cut, or traveling grade).

### Vintage
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/vintage)
- 定义：A vintage film look treats the image as past chemistry: faded dyes, possible Halation, softened contrast, and period color that has drifted. It is a whole-file costume of time, not only old glass and not only a lifted print curve.
- 叙事功能：It already happened. Dyes have wandered. Whites are not video-white. The past is chemistry, not a sticker of scratches. A 1970s still, a memory sitcom, a period film that wants the stock to confess its age: the treatment says archive even when the camera is new. It is the wrong tool when the only thing you wanted was Cooke swirl on a contemporary story (Vintage Cine Glass). It is the wrong tool when you only wanted toe and shoulder of a print (Filmic Faded) with modern dyes intact. Sepia is one brown-gold path through the past; vintage can stay in faded color. Do not add random specks and call it time.
- 怎么拍：Fade dyes (cyan often goes first in some stocks, or reds go brick), add gentle Halation on practicals, keep contrast modest, and optionally add period-accurate Film Grain. Separate dirt and weave: they are extra claims. Prompt: Vintage treatment of [Subject], faded dyes, halation, the past as chemistry, not a sticker.
- 何时用：Use it when the image should already have happened as an artifact of time. Do not use it as a substitute for vintage glass on a present-tense scene, and do not reduce it to a scratch overlay.
- 近似对比：Vintage Cine Glass, Filmic Faded, Sepia, Halation, Filmic FadedNot HDR. A print., HalationHighlights should bleed like film, not clip like video., SepiaA story that already happened.
  Vintage Cine Glass is the taking lens. Filmic Faded is print curve. Sepia is brown-gold tone. Halation is bloom on highlights, one ingredient. Vintage is the combined period chemistry claim. Filmic FadedNot HDR. A print. HalationHighlights should bleed like film, not clip like video. SepiaA story that already happened.
- 片中实例：The Master can sit in period-adjacent chemistry as well as character glass; the vintage claim is the whole file looking of an age. Memory-television language (The Wonder Years and similar) treats the past as a softer, drifted color world.；Grammar of faded dyes, not a still to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Keep it color unless you also want sepia. Do not write scratch overlay as the whole look, and do not confuse it with Cooke swirl alone.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name dyes and bloom, not stickers. Vintage treatment of [Subject], faded dyes, halation, the past as chemistry, not a sticker.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Vintage Cine Glass (glass only) or a dirty overlay on a modern grade. The tell is sharp modern contrast with specks, or swirl bokeh with contemporary dyes. Fix: drifted dyes, modest contrast, halation on lamps, time as chemistry.

### Palette
- 别名：Palette as location or story state ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/palette)
- 定义：A color palette in color palette cinematography is a restricted set of hues used as law across set, costume, light, and grade. Too many colors would be noise; a few chosen hues do all the work and can mark location, timeline, or story state.
- 叙事功能：Design as law. A yellow desert chapter, a red-cloth lie, a mint hotel: the audience learns the rule and then feels the break. Traffic can tint strands so you know which plot you are in. A hotel can live in pinks and purples until a new room breaks the set. It is the wrong tool when the location must keep its un-designed color science (Natural Grade). It is the wrong tool if the only restriction is no chroma (Monochrome). A Split Toning paints the curve; a palette paints the world, including walls and clothes. Palette changes should distinguish meaningful states, not create arbitrary variety.
- 怎么拍：Define a palette rule for each strand across set design, costume, lighting, and grading. Keep the rule stable enough to be learned before breaking it deliberately. Remove extra hues from frame (a stray neon, a blue plastic bag). Prompt: Restricted palette on [Subject], a few chosen hues doing all the work, design as law.
- 何时用：Use it when too many colors would be noise, or when strands of a story must be recognizable by hue. Do not use it as random look-variety, and do not confuse it with a grade-only split on a messy set.
- 近似对比：Monochrome, Split Toning, Color Shift, Hyper-Saturation, Split ToningShadows and lights belong to different gods., MonochromeStrip to drawing., Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
  Monochrome is one scale, no hue. Split Toning is highlight versus shadow in the grade. Color Shift is a change you watch. Hyper-Saturation can live inside a palette (Hero) but saturation is not the restriction. Palette is the designed set of allowed hues. Split ToningShadows and lights belong to different gods. MonochromeStrip to drawing. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
- 片中实例：Hero organizes successive versions of events around changing dominant colors. The Grand Budapest Hotel runs hotel spaces as a learned set of pastels and purples.；Traffic uses distinct visual color treatments for different story strands. Grammar of rules, not a still of a desert army.；Traffic 2000Different story strands use distinct visual color treatments.；Hero 2002Successive versions of events are organized around changing dominant colors.
- Prompt 模板：`Generate three matched views of one train-station meeting as alternate recollections: warm amber, cool blue-gray and restrained white-green. Keep blocking and character identities identical while wardrobe accents, environment and light follow each version's palette. Assemble as distinct narrative strands rather than cycling hues within one shot.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the allowed hues and ban the rest. Restricted palette on [Subject], a few chosen hues doing all the work, design as law.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Split Toning on an uncontrolled set, or a Natural Grade with a LUT. The tell is extra hues leaking from wardrobe and extras, or a grade fighting the furniture. Fix: control walls, clothes, and lights first, then grade inside that law.

### Overexposed
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/color/overexposed)
- 定义：Overexposed cinematography lets values clip or bloom toward white on purpose so information in the highlights is burned. It is a choice to lose the top of the scale, not the same as high-key lighting, which can stay bright while still holding detail.
- 叙事功能：Blow the whites as a choice. A window becomes heaven or fluorescent hell. Faces can go toward erasure. The image says there is more light than the medium will hold: revelation, amnesia, a club, a death, a childhood sun that cannot be looked at. It is the wrong tool when the scene is simply bright and even with detail in the shirts (High-Key Lighting). It is the wrong tool for a white flash as an edit event (Light Flash) if the shot itself is normally exposed. Do not underexpose and crush, then call it the opposite. Clipping is directional: you are throwing away the top, not the bottom.
- 怎么拍：Expose until the shoulder clips or the highlights bloom beyond recovery. Decide what must survive (eyes, a silhouette) and let the rest go. A blooming lens and Halation can soften the burn; a digital clip is harder-edged unless you diffuse. Prompt: Overexposed [Subject], values clipping toward heaven or fluorescent hell, information burned on purpose.
- 何时用：Use it when blowing the whites is the sentence: a door onto blinding sun, a memory that erases, a club strobe that stays. Do not use it as a synonym for high-key beauty, and do not clip by accident and keep the take.
- 近似对比：High-Key Lighting, Light Flash, Filmic Faded, Halation, High-Key LightingComedy, heaven, hospital, or candy., Light FlashA cut that is also a wound of light., Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
  High-Key Lighting is low-contrast bright lighting that usually still holds detail. Light Flash is a transient white event, often an edit. Filmic Faded rolls highlights instead of clipping them. Halation blooms bright points without necessarily destroying the whole shoulder. High-Key LightingComedy, heaven, hospital, or candy. Light FlashA cut that is also a wound of light. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
- 片中实例：The Tree of Life lets sun and windows blow so childhood light exceeds the medium. Enter the Void uses overbright interiors and flashes as sensory overload.；Grammar of burned information, not a copied still of a child.
- Prompt 模板：`Say what still holds (eyes, a doorway silhouette). Do not write high-key with detail in the whites, and do not crush the blacks as a substitute.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the burn. Overexposed [Subject], values clipping toward heaven or fluorescent hell, information burned on purpose.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is High-Key Lighting (bright, detailed, low contrast) or a Light Flash cut. The tell is a bright image with texture in the shirts, or a single frame of white in an otherwise normal shot. Fix: clipped or blooming highlights, lost highlight information, the burn as the point.

## 时间与运动 / Time and Motion（21 条）

**速查**：Slow Motion · Fast Motion · Speed Ramp · Freeze Frame · Time-Lapse · Step Printing · Reverse Motion · Bullet Time · Long Take · Oner · Motion Blur · Stutter / Stop-Stutter · Boomerang · Infinite Loop · Stop Motion · Low Shutter · Timelapse Glam · Timelapse Human · Timelapse Landscape · Frozen in Motion · Moonwalk

### Slow Motion
- 别名：Overcranking, Ralenti ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/slow-motion)
- 定义：Slow motion cinematography plays action over more screen time than the event occupied during capture, usually by overcranking (recording 120 to 240 fps and playing at 24). The extra samples reveal fabric delay, particle hang, and impact mechanics that a 24 fps shutter would compress into a few smeared frames.
- 叙事功能：Use it when a second already contains a scene: a fall, a look that decides, a hit whose mechanics matter. Stretching the instant can turn it into dread, grief, or inspection. Sound is half the meaning. Stretched diegetic noise makes the world heavy. Real-time audio against slow picture can feel like a memory or a lie. It is the wrong tool when the beat needs speed, comic timing, or spatial inspection of a frozen pose. If the camera orbits a nearly stopped body, you wanted bullet time. If frames are duplicated and smeared, you wanted step printing. Do not slow every punch or the rate stops meaning anything.
- 怎么拍：Capture at a higher frame rate than playback and keep a planned shutter (often 180 degrees, so 120 fps is about 1/240 s per frame). You need more light because each exposure is shorter. Keep gravity, contacts, and anatomy continuous through the extra samples. For generated footage, ask for real intermediate motion, not interpolated mush. Prompt: Slow motion of [Subject] at 120 to 240 fps playback, dust hanging, fabric delayed, continuous gravity.
- 何时用：Use it on a decisive instant a normal rate would hide, such as a glass leaving a waiter's hand. Do not use it as a default look for an entire fight.
- 近似对比：Speed Ramp, Step Printing, Bullet Time, Freeze Frame, Fast Motion, Time-Lapse, Speed RampMark one instant inside a fight or a look., Step PrintingLonging that cannot move at normal speed., Fast MotionToo much life for real time.
  Constant slow motion is not a Speed Ramp, which changes rate inside the shot and then recovers. It is not Step Printing, which duplicates low-rate, long-exposure frames into a stuttered lyric smear. It is not Bullet Time, which decouples a traveling viewpoint from near-frozen action. Freeze Frame stops sampling altogether. Fast Motion and Time-Lapse crush duration instead of stretching it. Speed RampMark one instant inside a fight or a look. Step PrintingLonging that cannot move at normal speed. Fast MotionToo much life for real time.
- 片中实例：Seven Samurai stretches the kidnapper's fall so the death occupies more than its wall-clock instant. The Wild Bunch fragments gunfights through varied slow-motion views so violence becomes duration.；The Matrix is often filed here, but the rooftop lean is closer to bullet time. In the Mood for Love belongs with step printing more than with clean overcranked silk.；Seven Samurai 1954The rescued child's kidnapper falls in slowed motion.；The Wild Bunch 1969Violence is fragmented and expanded through varied slow-motion views.
- Prompt 模板：`A glass slips from a waiter's hand and falls in elegant slow motion. Fingers release naturally, the glass rotates coherently and fabric moves with plausible inertia. Locked close shot, smooth temporal detail, no frozen background or bullet-time orbit.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the fps feel and what the extra time reveals. Still: a physically plausible mid-action pose with hanging dust, delayed fabric, and readable contacts, not a statue.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Bullet Time or a freeze. The tell is a stopped body with a moving camera, or a still with no new frames of motion. Fix: keep the subject traveling through the action, keep anatomy and gravity continuous, and specify 120 to 240 fps playback rather than an orbit around a sculpture.

### Fast Motion
- 别名：undercranking ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/fast-motion)
- 定义：Fast motion cinematography compresses screen duration so action plays faster than it occurred, by undercranking the camera or by retiming a normal-rate take. Crowds smear, clouds race, and labor can look absurdly efficient because too many events occupy too little time.
- 叙事功能：Use it when real time cannot hold the life in front of the lens: a factory that never stops, a city that should feel over-efficient, a chase whose danger is relentlessness rather than one punch. Subtle acceleration can be funnier or more oppressive than a cartoon speed-up. Keep sound on its own clock. Pitch-shifted footsteps often betray the trick. It is the wrong tool for weather, construction, or a night becoming morning. Those need interval sampling, not sped-up continuous action. If the camera itself steps through space while hours collapse, you wanted a hyperlapse. Do not accelerate a performance whose contacts and gravity must stay honest.
- 怎么拍：Undercrank (shoot fewer frames per second than playback) or retime in the cut with a planned speed ratio. Longer exposure per frame, if the shutter stays open, increases motion blur. Check hands, object contacts, and foot cadence after the speed change. Prompt: Undercranked fast motion of [Subject], crowds smearing, clouds racing, planned speed ratio, coherent contacts.
- 何时用：Use it when a mailroom, assembly line, or crowd must feel over-efficient, as in a comic or cosmic crush of ordinary work. Do not use it to stand in for a day-to-night sky.
- 近似对比：Time-Lapse, Hyperlapse, Slow Motion, Speed Ramp, Time-LapseShow weather, construction, or a night becoming morning., HyperlapseShow duration as velocity., Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
  Fast motion speeds continuous action. Time-Lapse samples the world at long intervals so slow change (shadows, crowds as systems) plays quickly. Hyperlapse is time-lapse plus a camera that advances through space. Slow Motion is the inverse stretch. A Speed Ramp changes rate inside one shot rather than holding a constant acceleration. Time-LapseShow weather, construction, or a night becoming morning. HyperlapseShow duration as velocity. Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
- 片中实例：Modern Times uses factory rhythm so mechanized work feels like a speeded machine wearing a man. A Clockwork Orange undercranks selected passages so appetite and violence become brisk, grotesque efficiency.；Mad Max: Fury Road alters cadence on chosen action beats rather than running the whole film as a cartoon. Koyaanisqatsi is often grouped here, but its urban crush is mostly interval time-lapse.；Modern Times 1936Factory rhythms exaggerate the pressure of mechanized work.；Mad Max: Fury Road 2015Selected action beats use altered motion cadence and speed.
- Prompt 模板：`A harried mailroom worker sorts envelopes in slightly accelerated motion while maintaining physically coherent hand actions. Fixed medium-wide view, increasingly comic efficiency, no teleporting objects or time-lapse crowd trails. Retime a clean base shot if exact cadence is required.`
- 示例 Prompt：`State that time is compressed and what races. Still: a pose that implies acceleration (smeared extras, streaked traffic) while the subject, if they must stay readable, holds.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Time-Lapse. The tell is a racing crowd under a sun and shadows that never move, or people who teleport instead of stepping. Fix: keep continuous action and a planned speed ratio, then check contacts. If hours must collapse, change to interval photography.

### Speed Ramp
- 别名：Variable-speed action, Ralenti accéléré ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/speed-ramp)
- 定义：Speed ramping changes playback or capture speed inside a single shot rather than holding one retiming ratio. Approach and recovery stay energetic while one motivated instant (impact, glance, turn) stretches, then the clock returns.
- 叙事功能：Treat it as temporal close-up. The shot walks up in real time, lands on the fact that matters, and releases. A fight, a catch, a look across a room can all take the ramp if the event is readable. The audience should feel one continuous action, not a new clip glued on. It is the wrong tool when the whole beat should stay slow, or when you only need a smash of magnification. If rate never returns, you shot slow motion and called it a ramp. If the picture punches in by focal length, you wanted a crash zoom. Do not ramp to hide unreadable choreography.
- 怎么拍：Capture enough temporal detail (high frame rate) that both the fast and slow portions have samples. Identify the motivated event, then shape the acceleration curve and matching motion blur. The body must stay mechanically continuous through the change. Prompt: Speed ramp on [Subject], real time slamming into slow motion at the impact or glance, then releasing.
- 何时用：Use it to mark one instant inside a fight or a look, such as a board leaving the ramp at the peak of a jump. Do not use it on every cut or the emphasis dies.
- 近似对比：Slow Motion, Crash Zoom In, Freeze Frame, Bullet Time, Slow MotionA second contains a scene., Crash Zoom InPunctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting., Fast MotionToo much life for real time.
  A ramp is not constant Slow Motion, which never returns to real time. It is not a Crash Zoom In, which changes focal length rather than the clock. Freeze Frame holds one image. Bullet Time lets the camera orbit a nearly stopped instant instead of stretching and releasing the same viewpoint's action. Slow MotionA second contains a scene. Crash Zoom InPunctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting. Fast MotionToo much life for real time.
- 片中实例：300 moves combat between fast and extended slow-motion beats so selected blows become readable. Sherlock Holmes (2009) isolates anticipated fight details, then snaps back to the hit as performed.；The Matrix mixes rates around chosen impacts, though its array orbits are a different machine.；300 2006Combat moves between fast and extended slow-motion beats.；Sherlock Holmes 2009Anticipated combat details are isolated before action resumes.
- Prompt 模板：`A skateboarder approaches a small ramp at normal speed, slows smoothly to reveal the board rotating beneath their feet, then returns to normal speed on landing. One coherent action, readable foot placement, natural gravity, no impossible extra spin. Specify and refine the ramp in editing.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: Speed ramp: real-time movement of [Subject] suddenly stretches into slow motion at the key beat, then recovers. One coherent action, readable contacts, natural gravity.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is wall-to-wall Slow Motion. The tell is a shot that never returns to real time, or a jump in pose at the speed change. Fix: write approach, hold, and release, and keep the body continuous through the curve.

### Freeze Frame
- 别名：Pre-existing song placement, Featured song cue ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/freeze-frame)
- 定义：A freeze frame holds one image so narrative time stops while camera, subject, and world all cease to generate new samples. The hold can end a story, land a joke, or present a face as evidence.
- 叙事功能：Use it when the fact is the picture itself: a boy at the edge of the sea, a narrator labeling a life, a triumph that should not continue into the next second. Grain, dust, and expression stay. Sound may keep running (voiceover, a song, a crowd) so the freeze feels like a caption, not a crash. It is the wrong tool when you still need motion around a stopped body, or a camera that walks around an instant. Those are frozen-in-motion and bullet time. A posed tableau with living extras is not a freeze. Do not freeze a line of dialogue whose meaning is in the next word.
- 怎么拍：Select one frame and reprint or hold it for the required duration. An optical zoom into that still (as at the end of The 400 Blows) is a move on a photograph, not new live action. The shutter is no longer sampling. Prompt: Freeze frame on [Subject], the world stopping on a decisive pose, grain holding, a still torn out of time.
- 何时用：Use it to end, to joke, or to offer evidence, such as a final still of a runaway on a beach. Do not use it when particles should hang while the camera still travels.
- 近似对比：Slow Motion, Frozen in Motion, Bullet Time, Tableau, Slow MotionA second contains a scene., TableauHold the arrangement., Fast MotionToo much life for real time.
  A freeze is not Slow Motion, which continues to sample the action, only slower. It is not Frozen in Motion, where a chosen person or the camera may still move while the world holds. It is not Bullet Time, an orbit around a sculpture of speed. A Tableau is staged stillness inside living time, extras breathing, not a held frame. Slow MotionA second contains a scene. TableauHold the arrangement. Fast MotionToo much life for real time.
- 片中实例：The 400 Blows ends on Antoine at the water, the image arrested so the boy cannot run farther. Goodfellas freezes Henry so voiceover can label a life mid-gesture.；Rocky is often cited for punctuation energy around a still of triumph. Trainspotting is listed beside freeze grammar more for its opening jolt than for a single copied hold.；Goodfellas 1990The Layla piano passage accompanies the discovery montage.；Trainspotting 1996The opening running sequence uses a prominent song cue.
- Prompt 模板：`Edit a group of exhausted friends leaving an all-night diner at sunrise to an original energetic rock cue. Let the first strong beat land on the door opening, then allow the song to continue over several distinct street moments. Use a newly composed track, not a replica of an existing film song.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Write a hold, not a slow pose. Still: the chosen frame as a photograph with grain, a decisive expression or body shape, no implied smear.`
- Prompt 要点：No orbit, no hanging debris that later falls.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Frozen in Motion or Bullet Time. The tell is rain or coat tails hanging while the viewpoint keeps traveling, or a mid-air sculpture with parallax. Fix: stop the camera and the world on one frame. If you need a walk around the instant, change technique.

### Time-Lapse
- 别名：Interval photography, Time compression ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/time-lapse)
- 定义：Time-lapse cinematography captures frames at long intervals so slow change plays as continuous motion, hours becoming seconds as shadows sweep and crowds become flow. It is interval photography, not a sped-up ordinary take.
- 叙事功能：Use it to reveal a pattern no one can stand still long enough to see. Weather, construction, traffic, a plant, a city emptying and filling. People often stop being protagonists and become a system. The camera is usually locked so the only motion is time. It is the wrong tool for a comic undercrank of a performance, or for a still hero in a racing crowd (that is a different recipe). If the camera must walk the street while hours collapse, you wanted a hyperlapse. Do not call a fast crowd under a stuck sun a full day-to-night lapse.
- 怎么拍：Plan interval, total duration, exposure, and stability. A locked head is the default. For day-to-night, ramp exposure so windows light as the sky dies. The sun and shadows must travel if the claim is a full day. Prompt: Time-lapse of [Subject] or the world around them, hours in seconds, shadows sweeping, crowds as smoke.
- 何时用：Use it to show weather, construction, or a night becoming morning from a stable viewpoint. Do not use it to make an actor's performance merely faster.
- 近似对比：Fast Motion, Hyperlapse, Timelapse Landscape, Timelapse Human, Timelapse Glam, HyperlapseShow duration as velocity., Fast MotionToo much life for real time., Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
  Time-lapse is not Fast Motion, which accelerates a continuous take. Hyperlapse adds significant camera travel through space on top of the interval. Timelapse Landscape is the weather-and-shadow specialty. Timelapse Human freezes one will inside a racing crowd. Timelapse Glam interval-samples wardrobe on a held face. HyperlapseShow duration as velocity. Fast MotionToo much life for real time. Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
- 片中实例：Koyaanisqatsi turns traffic, crowds, and urban cycles into large-scale patterns. Baraka organizes cities and ritual through altered temporal scales.；Both are grammar for interval sampling, not frames to copy.；Koyaanisqatsi 1982Traffic, crowds and urban cycles become large-scale patterns.；Baraka 1992Cities and human activity are organized through altered temporal scales.
- Prompt 模板：`Locked high view of a public square from early morning to night, compressed into ten seconds. Shadows move continuously, crowds form and dissolve, windows light up gradually. Stable buildings and weather logic, no morphing architecture. Generate controlled day-phase keyframes and assemble a time-lapse progression.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the interval collapse and what must move. Still: matched architecture at one implied phase, or a composite of sun angles only if you label it a study.`
- Prompt 要点：Buildings stay solid.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Fast Motion. The tell is smeared pedestrians under a sun that never moves, or architecture that morphs. Fix: write hours in seconds, a stable camera, and continuous shadow travel. If only people race, you have not shown a day.

### Step Printing
- 别名：Repeated-frame motion, Wong Kar-wai motion texture ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/step-printing)
- 定义：Step printing repeats or omits frames optically or digitally so motion advances in visible temporal steps. Combined with low-rate capture and long exposures, each frame smears internally while the sequence stutters forward, a texture of delay rather than clean high-frame-rate slow motion.
- 叙事功能：Use it for longing that cannot move at normal speed: a walk through rain, a pursuit that feels remembered, a figure isolated from a city's rush. The smear belongs inside the frame. The step belongs between frames. Together they make memory feel unstable without a digital glitch overlay. It is the wrong tool for a readable impact study, a fight that must stay mechanical, or anxiety that should skip like a damaged mind. Those are slow motion and stutter. Do not interpolate the cadence away. If the walk becomes silk, you left the technique.
- 怎么拍：Shoot or generate a low temporal sample (often well below 24 fps) with enough shutter time for motion blur, then duplicate frames to the delivery rate. Test the cadence. Keep practical lights saturated and the lonely figure more readable than the crowd. Prompt: Step-printed motion of [Subject], frames duplicated, stuttering lyric delay, long-exposure smear inside each frame.
- 何时用：Use it on a rain walk or a night counter where one person should separate from the city's rush. Do not use it when you need clean 120 fps anatomy of a hit.
- 近似对比：Slow Motion, Stutter / Stop-Stutter, Motion Blur, Stop Motion, Slow MotionA second contains a scene., Stutter / Stop-StutterThe mind skips., Fast MotionToo much life for real time.
  Step printing is not silk Slow Motion, which samples densely and interpolates smoothly. It is not Stutter / Stop-Stutter, which drops or repeats frames as anxious rhythm without requiring long-exposure smear. Motion Blur can exist at normal cadence. Stop Motion builds poses by hand between exposures rather than reprinting live action. Slow MotionA second contains a scene. Stutter / Stop-StutterThe mind skips. Fast MotionToo much life for real time.
- 片中实例：Chungking Express gives crowded street movement a blurred, stuttering temporal texture. Fallen Angels uses irregular urban motion and smear as a lonely gait.；In the Mood for Love is often remembered as slow romance. Much of that delay is step-printed texture rather than overcranked silk.；Chungking Express 1994Crowded street movement and pursuit have a blurred, stuttering temporal texture.；Fallen Angels 1995Urban passages use expressive irregular motion and blur.
- Prompt 模板：`A lonely man stands at a night food counter while pedestrians stream past as smeared, stuttering shapes. His small movements remain readable. Long-exposure motion texture with deliberate repeated-frame cadence, saturated practical lights, no clean high-frame-rate slow motion. Apply the cadence in post from a controlled base clip.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: Step-printed slow motion of [Subject], stuttering duplicated frames, lyrical delay rather than smooth slow-mo. No generic glitch, no interpolated in-betweens.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Slow Motion. The tell is clean high-frame-rate motion with no step and no smear, or a datamosh overlay. Fix: specify low-rate capture, long shutter, duplicated frames, and a cadence you can count.

### Reverse Motion
- 别名：Consequences before causes ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/reverse-motion)
- 定义：Reverse motion plays recorded action backward so causes arrive after their effects inside the shot: rain rises, smoke inhales, a shattered object reassembles. This is reversed playback, not a story told in reverse scene order.
- 叙事功能：Use it for trick photography, grief that wants an undo, or a world whose physics run the other way. The audience reads inverted inertia: water, cloth, sparks, and footsteps all lie. A single reversed gesture can feel like a spell. A whole reversed fight can feel like entropy running downhill in the wrong direction. It is the wrong tool when you only need a toy loop, or when the plot itself is told from consequence to cause without reversing the footage. A boomerang goes forward then back on the same path. Memento-style chronology reorders scenes at normal playback. Do not mix those machines in one prompt.
- 怎么拍：Shoot the action forward with readable contacts, then reverse the clip. Gravity, fluids, and cloth are the proof. A person putting on a coat forward will look like an impossible undressing in reverse only if the fabric was honest on the way in. Prompt: Reverse motion of [Subject], time running backward, rain rising, a broken thing assembling.
- 何时用：Use it when a broken object should reassemble, or rain should rise, as a visible undo. Do not use it to mean reverse story order with ordinary-speed scenes.
- 近似对比：Boomerang, Slow Motion, Infinite Loop, Slow MotionA second contains a scene., Fast MotionToo much life for real time., Speed RampMark one instant inside a fight or a look.
  Reverse playback is not reverse chronology. Boomerang runs the same action forward then back as a loop. Slow Motion only changes rate, not direction. An Infinite Loop sews last frame to first and may stay forward. Tenet mixes inverted world-lines with true reversed footage. Memento and Irréversible mostly reorder scenes. Slow MotionA second contains a scene. Fast MotionToo much life for real time. Speed RampMark one instant inside a fight or a look.
- 片中实例：Tenet lets objects and people move through events against the local clock, including true reversed photography. Cocteau's Orphée and related trick shots reverse ordinary gestures so they read as rites.；Memento opens with a Polaroid and a violent action running backward, then tells much of the rest by reverse scene order. Irréversible presents major sections from later to earlier without reversing every shot.；Memento 2000The color sequences move backward in story order, interwoven with forward-moving monochrome material.；Irréversible 2002The story's major sections are presented in reverse order.；Memento 2000The opening Polaroid and violent action run backward.；Tenet 2020Objects and people can move through events in reverse temporal direction.
- Prompt 模板：`Create four ordinary-speed scenes about a broken friendship: an unopened apology, a public argument, a misunderstood message and an earlier act of trust. Present them in reverse chronological order. At each transition, reveal a cause that changes the previous scene's meaning. Do not run the footage backward.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: The action around [Subject] plays in reverse: rain rising, smoke inhaling, motion undone. Ordinary-speed scenes in reverse order is a different brief.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is reverse chronology or a Boomerang. The tell is a normal-speed scene shuffle, or a clip that goes forward then snaps back. Fix: reverse one recorded action and show fluids, cloth, or debris traveling the wrong way along a single path.

### Bullet Time
- 别名：Time-slice orbit, The Matrix effect ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/bullet-time)
- 定义：Bullet time freezes or radically slows action while the viewpoint travels around it, decoupling camera speed from subject time. The instant becomes inspectable space: a time-slice orbit around a sculpture of speed, not ordinary slow motion with a handheld camera.
- 叙事功能：Use it when a split-second decision should become architecture. The audience seems to occupy a viewpoint no observer inside the event could have. Debris, rain, and coat tails hang so we can walk around them. The path is one move, usually an arc. It is the wrong tool for a dinner scene, a lyric walk, or a simple impact study from a locked camera. If the camera is locked, you wanted frozen in motion or a freeze. If the fighter keeps moving at stretched rate and the camera stays put, you wanted slow motion. Do not add a zoom on top of the orbit unless you are making a different shot.
- 怎么拍：Use a synchronized or time-offset multi-camera array with interpolation, or a fully controlled 3D scene. Enforce frozen or near-frozen subject geometry while changing viewpoint. Particles should be countable and rigid enough to survive the arc. Prompt: Bullet time around [Subject], the moment frozen while the camera orbits, a slice of time as a sculpture.
- 何时用：Use it to inspect an impact, a leap, or a dodge that already happened, as on a rooftop lean under gunfire. Do not use it as slow motion with a shaky camera.
- 近似对比：Slow Motion, 360-Degree Orbit, Freeze Frame, Frozen in Motion, 360-Degree OrbitTime collapses around one person: kiss, threat, or product hero., Slow MotionA second contains a scene., Fast MotionToo much life for real time.
  Bullet time is not Slow Motion, which stretches action without requiring a traveling viewpoint around a hold. It is not a normal 360-Degree Orbit, which circles living time. It is not Freeze Frame, which stops the camera too. Frozen in Motion may let a chosen person move through a stopped world. Bullet time stops or crushes the event while the camera walks around it. 360-Degree OrbitTime collapses around one person: kiss, threat, or product hero. Slow MotionA second contains a scene. Fast MotionToo much life for real time.
- 片中实例：The Matrix rooftop, Neo leaning under gunfire, is the textbook array move. Wanted curves bullets as inspectable paths through space.；Later action films borrow the split between body-time and camera-time. Prompt the physics, not a trademark.；The Matrix 1999Neo leans backward under gunfire on the rooftop.
- Prompt 模板：`A dancer is suspended at the peak of a leap while loose paper hangs around her. The camera moves smoothly through a 90-degree arc at normal viewing speed while the leap advances only slightly. Consistent anatomy, rigid paper shapes, coherent shadows, no repeated body limbs. Build with multi-view keyframes or 3D for control.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Write two clocks: action stopped or crushed, camera continuing on a path. Still: one instant seen as if from a step along an orbit, hanging debris, consistent anatomy.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is handheld Slow Motion. The tell is a moving fighter and a camera that does not orbit, or a freeze with no parallax. Fix: subject frozen or nearly frozen, camera orbits a named arc, debris hanging, consistent shadows.

### Long Take
- 别名：plan sequence, extended take, long-duration shot, true long take, simulated long take, The Atonement beach tableau ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/long-take)
- 定义：Long take cinematography is an unusually extended shot that preserves continuous performance, space, action, or duration without an overt cut. Blocking and camera share one sentence so the audience cannot leave the room.
- 叙事功能：Use it when incompatible facts must coexist in one geography: boredom beside danger, a joke beside a wound, a bomb in a trunk while people chat. The eye scans a functioning world instead of consuming an insert. Duration is the tension. A dense crowd is not enough. Each zone needs an intelligible action timed to the camera. It is the wrong tool when the scene is a virtuoso ride that may hide joins, or when coverage should isolate a face. A oner is designed to play as one take and may be stitched. A long take's claim is continuous time. Do not hold a static close-up for two minutes and call the endurance a panorama.
- 怎么拍：Block foreground, midground, and background on a shared timeline. Give the camera a clear route (Steadicam, crane, handheld, or studio dolly) and vary its attention without losing the human anchor. Rehearse contacts, eyelines, and extra business so the take can survive. Prompt: Long take covering [Subject] without a cut, duration as tension, blocking and camera choreographed as one sentence.
- 何时用：Use it when the audience must stay in the room, such as a car that cannot cut away from incoming gunfire. Do not use it to show off a corridor walk with nothing happening in depth.
- 近似对比：Oner, Steadicam, Invisible Cut, Master Shot, OnerThe scene is a ride., SteadicamLong connecting moves through architecture. Neither handheld nor dolly., Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
  A long take emphasizes continuous duration. A Oner is designed to play without visible edits and may hide stitches. Steadicam is a support, not a duration claim. An Invisible Cut is how some oners cheat. A Master Shot covers the action so the scene can be cut. A long take often is the scene. OnerThe scene is a ride. SteadicamLong connecting moves through architecture. Neither handheld nor dolly. Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
- 片中实例：Children of Men keeps car and birth passages inside continuous danger. The Player opens by walking conversations across a studio lot in one moving sentence.；Touch of Evil follows a bomb car while nearby people remain unaware. Atonement's Dunkirk beach moves among soldiers, wreckage, and stranded activity.；Russian Ark and Victoria extend the wager to feature length.；Atonement 2007The Dunkirk beach passage moves among soldiers, wreckage and stranded activity.；The Player 1992The opening moves between conversations across the studio lot.；Touch of Evil 1958The opening follows a car after a bomb is placed in its trunk, while nearby people remain unaware.
- Prompt 模板：`Follow a harbor nurse through an improvised waiting area after a storm. In one flowing shot, pass people playing cards, repairing a radio, tending injuries and staring silently at the sea. No disaster spectacle; distinct actions continue independently in depth. Keep the nurse as a loose visual anchor.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: An unbroken long take following [Subject] through the space with no cut. Name foreground, midground, and background actions on one timeline.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a stitched Oner sold as uncut truth, or a crowded wide with no timed business. The tell is a whip into darkness, a crossing truck, or extras who only occupy space. Fix: one overt take, distinct actions in depth, a camera route, and a human anchor.

### Oner
- 别名：true oner, stitched oner ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/one-er)
- 定义：A oner shot is designed to play as if the scene were one take, with no visible edits. It may be a true single take or a stitched oner whose joins hide in whips, darkness, or crossing bodies.
- 叙事功能：Use it when geography, breath, and choreography should feel like one continuous push: a backstage spiral, a trench, an extraction through apartments. Hidden cuts are allowed only if they are invisible. The audience should not be able to point to the splice. The camera and the blocking are one machine. It is the wrong tool when the ethical claim is uncut duration, or when the scene is a quiet two-person talk that only needs a master. A true long take refuses the stitch. A oner may use it. Do not call three coverage angles a oner because the editor was smooth.
- 怎么拍：Choreograph a path that can be performed, then decide where a join could hide if the take cannot be true. Steadicam, crane, and handheld all work if the breath stays consistent. Match lighting and eyelines across stitches. Prompt: Apparent oner of [Subject], a whole scene as one take, hidden cuts allowed only if invisible.
- 何时用：Use it when the scene is a ride through connected actions, such as a backstage spiral or a trench crossing. Do not use it for a static conversation that only needs coverage.
- 近似对比：Long Take, Steadicam, Invisible Cut, Tracking Shot, Follow Shot, Long TakeDo not let the audience leave the room., SteadicamLong connecting moves through architecture. Neither handheld nor dolly., Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
  A Long Take emphasizes uncut duration as a fact. A oner emphasizes the ride and may be stitched. Steadicam is often the support. An Invisible Cut is the join. Tracking Shot and Follow Shot can exist inside a oner without making every track a oner. Long TakeDo not let the audience leave the room. SteadicamLong connecting moves through architecture. Neither handheld nor dolly. Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
- 片中实例：Birdman plays backstage panic as one apparent breath, stitches hidden. 1917 connects trench and field into a continuous war path, also stitched.；Extraction runs apartment and vehicle action as a designed single-take sequence. Compare those with Russian Ark, a true feature-length take, if the claim is uncut fact rather than ride.
- Prompt 模板：`Video: A continuous oner following [Subject] through connected actions without a visible cut. Name rooms, turns, and the human anchor.`
- 示例 Prompt：`A continuous oner following [Subject] through connected actions without a visible cut.`
- Prompt 要点：Hidden cuts only if they would not read.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is ordinary coverage, or a Long Take you secretly cut. The tell is a change of breath, a jump in extra positions, or a whip that does not match. Fix: one visible path, matched energy across any hidden join, and no insert that admits the splice.

### Motion Blur
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/motion-blur)
- 定义：Motion blur cinematography is the streaking or softness caused by subject or camera movement during exposure. The longer the gate stays open relative to the motion, the more the image paints, so edges fail on purpose.
- 叙事功能：Use it when speed or trauma should smear: headlights as ribbons, a body that cannot be counted, a whip that erases geography for a frame. Normal 180-degree film already has some blur. This look commits further, so edges fail on purpose. It is the wrong tool for staccato combat that should feel like discrete fragments. That is short shutter, often misfiled under the same war films. Slow motion with dense samples can look sharper, not smearier. Do not add a blur overlay on a sharp take and call it shutter.
- 怎么拍：Expose long enough, or move fast enough, that edges streak within the frame. A Whip Pan is a burst of this. A locked camera with a racing subject is the other axis. Night lamps help because they write ribbons. Prompt: Long-shutter motion blur on [Subject] or the world, streaks of light, bodies smearing.
- 何时用：Use it when a night street or a panicked camera move should smear, such as lamps dragging during a run. Do not use it when you want Saving Private Ryan's crisp, segmented droplets.
- 近似对比：Low Shutter, Whip Pan, Slow Motion, Step Printing, Whip PanTransition, punchline, or sudden attention shift., Slow MotionA second contains a scene., Fast MotionToo much life for real time.
  Motion blur is smear from exposure. Low Shutter in this library is short shutter: reduced blur, staccato edges. A Whip Pan is camera rotation fast enough to erase the middle. Slow Motion often looks sharper because each high-fps frame is a shorter exposure. Step Printing smears and steps. Do not confuse photography's 'low shutter speed' with film's low shutter angle. Whip PanTransition, punchline, or sudden attention shift. Slow MotionA second contains a scene. Fast MotionToo much life for real time.
- 片中实例：Cloverfield lets handheld panic smear the monster and the street. Whip-heavy action (the Bourne films among them) uses bursts of blur as geography fails.；Saving Private Ryan is often listed here, but Omaha Beach is largely short-shutter staccato, the cousin, not the smear.
- Prompt 模板：`Video: Heavy motion blur as [Subject] or the camera moves, light streaking, shutter dragged. If every raindrop is crisp, the shutter was too short.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Commit to streaks. Still: lamps as ribbons, bodies smearing, a subject sharp only if they held still.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Low Shutter (short shutter angle). The tell is crispy rain and chopped limbs with no ribbons. Fix: drag the shutter or increase motion until lights streak. If you wanted SPR cadence, change technique rather than adding a blur filter.

### Stutter / Stop-Stutter
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/stutter)
- 定义：Stutter editing drops or repeats frames so playback skips and the world's clock hitches. It is an anxious rhythm, not the lyric smear of step printing and not a jump cut's spatial jump.
- 叙事功能：Use it when thought itself is damaged: obsession, panic, a headache that cuts time into chips. The picture may stay in the same setup while frames go missing or repeat. Cadence is the meaning. A little is a twitch. A lot is a seizure. It is the wrong tool for Wong Kar-wai rain, for Godard-style discontinuous geography, or for stop-motion craft. If the smear is romantic, you wanted step printing. If the camera angle or body position jumps, you wanted a jump cut. Do not add a codec glitch unless the story is a broken file.
- 怎么拍：Start from a clean take, then remove or duplicate frames on a planned irregular grid. You can also skip in camera by lowering sample rate without long-exposure smear. Keep identity and space continuous so the hitch reads as time, not as a cut. Prompt: Stuttered motion of [Subject], frames dropping or repeating, a glitch in time, anxiety as rhythm.
- 何时用：Use it when a thought or a panic attack should skip, such as a close face whose blinks do not land on a steady clock. Do not use it as lyric street texture.
- 近似对比：Step Printing, Jump Cut, Stop Motion, Datamosh, Step PrintingLonging that cannot move at normal speed., Jump CutDo not soothe. Show the skip., Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
  Stutter is not Step Printing, which reprints long-exposure frames into a smeared delay. It is not a Jump Cut, which discards time and often shows a spatial jump in the same setup. Stop Motion is pose-to-pose craft. Datamosh is compression damage. Keep them separate in the prompt. Step PrintingLonging that cannot move at normal speed. Jump CutDo not soothe. Show the skip. Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
- 片中实例：Pi uses staccato, high-contrast skipping so numbers and pain share a rhythm. Music videos often stutter a gesture as a beat.；Aronofsky's later montage grammar (Requiem among them) neighbors this hitch without being identical to skip-frame stutter.
- Prompt 模板：`Write frames dropping or repeating, not smear and not a jump in angle. Still: a face or gesture that looks temporally sampled, slight after-images only if they come from repeats.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: Stuttering playback of [Subject], frames repeating and skipping, anxious rhythm. Same setup, no lyric blur, no datamosh.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Step Printing or Jump Cut. The tell is romantic long-exposure crowds, or a sudden change of body position that reads as an edit. Fix: keep space continuous and make the cadence irregular. Count the missing frames.

### Boomerang
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/boomerang)
- 定义：A boomerang video effect plays a short action forward, then snaps it backward along the same samples, often looping. The gesture comes and goes on one path: reversed playback used as a round trip rather than a one-way undo.
- 叙事功能：Use it to weaponize a small motion: hair toss, splash, a jump's peak, a door that never finishes closing. Both directions must read. If the forward pass is ugly, the reverse will not save it. Loops work when the end of the reverse meets the start of the forward without a bump. It is the wrong tool for grief, inverted physics as story, or a seamless forward-only cycle (a pendulum designed to sew). Reverse motion one way is a spell. An infinite loop may never reverse. Do not boomerang a line of dialogue whose words cannot run backward.
- 怎么拍：Record a short, readable gesture with clean contacts, play it forward, then reverse the same frames. Trim so the join is at a still-ish peak or a matched pose. Camera usually locked. Prompt: Boomerang of [Subject], action running forward then snapping backward on the same path, a loop of coming and going.
- 何时用：Use it to turn a splash, a jump, or a hair toss into a toy loop. Do not use it for a one-way undo of a crash.
- 近似对比：Reverse Motion, Infinite Loop, Moonwalk, Cinemagraph, Infinite LoopDuration without progress., Reverse MotionMagic, grief, or a world with inverted physics., Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
  A boomerang is not one-way Reverse Motion. It is not an Infinite Loop that sews last frame to first while staying forward. A Moonwalk is a body's lie in living time. A Cinemagraph freezes most of a still and loops one element. Infinite LoopDuration without progress. Reverse MotionMagic, grief, or a world with inverted physics.
