Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
- 片中实例：Instagram and Vine made the round-trip native. Music videos use it as a hook on a single gesture.；Feature grammar rarely needs it except as a quoted phone-screen or a title-card gag.
- Prompt 模板：`Video: [Subject] plays forward then reverses along the same motion, a seamless boomerang loop. Same path, no new action on the way back, no one-way reverse.`
- 示例 Prompt：`[Subject] plays forward then reverses along the same motion, a seamless boomerang loop.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Reverse Motion or a forward Infinite Loop. The tell is rain that only rises, or a loop that never rewinds. Fix: specify forward then back on the same samples, and a join that matches.

### Infinite Loop
- 别名：Repeated day, Iterative narrative ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/infinite-loop)
- 定义：An infinite loop video sews the last frame to the first so motion never arrives at an ending. The cycle can be a seamless visual join, or, in narrative use, a repeated day whose variables change.
- 叙事功能：As a picture machine, design a motion whose end state matches its start: position, light, pose. The cut should vanish. As a story machine, repeat an event sequence while knowledge or one decision changes. Those are cousins that share a name. Do not prompt them as one blob. It is the wrong tool for a forward-back toy (boomerang) or a mostly still image with one living detail (cinemagraph). A loop that changes everything at once has no baseline. A join that flashes is just a cut.
- 怎么拍：For a visual loop, match the first and last frames and keep the action forward. For a narrative loop, establish a reset cue and a stable baseline, then vary a small number of actions per cycle. Prompt: Infinite loop of [Subject], the last frame sewing to the first, a motion that never arrives.
- 何时用：Use it when a motion or a day should fail to conclude, such as a walk cycle that sews or a morning that resets. Do not use it when you want a boomerang snap.
- 近似对比：Boomerang, Cinemagraph, Reverse Motion, BoomerangTurn a gesture into a toy., CinemagraphA photograph that refuses to die., Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
  An infinite loop is not a Boomerang, which rewinds the same samples. A Cinemagraph holds a still and loops one island of motion. Reverse Motion is direction, not a sew. Narrative loops (Groundhog Day) change behavior inside a repeated event. Visual loops must match ends. BoomerangTurn a gesture into a toy. CinemagraphA photograph that refuses to die. Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
- 片中实例：GIF culture and installation video are the visual grammar: a motion that can play forever. Groundhog Day returns the same morning while Phil's behavior changes.；Run Lola Run repeats attempts with varied actions and outcomes. Edge of Tomorrow turns repetition into training.；Groundhog Day 1993The same morning returns while Phil's behavior changes.；Run Lola Run 1998Repeated attempts vary actions and outcomes.；Edge of Tomorrow 2014Repeated experience produces learned adaptations.
- Prompt 模板：`Design three repetitions of a commuter's morning: the same alarm, dropped coin and departing bus. In each cycle she changes one decision, producing a different encounter. Reuse matched camera positions and reset sounds. Generate the baseline once, then controlled variations with stable people and geography.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: A seamless loop of [Subject], end matching start, no cut visible. Forward motion unless you explicitly want a boomerang.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Boomerang. The tell is a visible rewind, or a reset with no matching frames. Fix: match last frame to first, keep direction consistent, and change only the variables you mean to change.

### Stop Motion
- 别名：Frame-by-frame object animation, Replacement animation ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/stop-motion)
- 定义：Stop motion cinematography photographs physical objects incrementally, adjusting them between exposures so successive poses create apparent movement. The cadence is pose to pose and slightly staccato, with tactile materials in the light.
- 叙事功能：Use it when motion should feel made: puppets, replacement faces, dinosaurs that are sculptures, a fox whose fur is fabric. Weight, texture, and small irregularities are the performance. Live-action smoothness would be the wrong world. It is the wrong tool for a choppy filter on a real actor, or for step-printed streets. If the fox's fur flows like photographed animal hair, you left the craft. A generated 'stop-motion look' is an aesthetic. Frame-by-frame production is a method. Say which one you want.
- 怎么拍：Lock the camera. Repeat the lighting. Plan pose spacing. Secure the model so it does not drift. Replacement animation swaps parts (mouths, lids) between frames. For generated approximations, specify consistent materials, visible joints, and deliberate increments. Prompt: Stop-motion of [Subject], stepped poses, tactile increment, time built by hand.
- 何时用：Use it when a puppet or object should perform as a photographed sculpture, such as a fox folding paper on a miniature desk. Do not use it as a jitter preset on live action.
- 近似对比：Step Printing, Animation, Stutter / Stop-Stutter, Low Shutter, Step PrintingLonging that cannot move at normal speed., AnimationThe world is constructed, not captured., Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
  Stop motion is not Step Printing of live footage. It is a branch of Animation, specifically frame-by-frame object animation, including replacement animation. Stutter / Stop-Stutter skip-frames living time. Low Shutter makes live action staccato without posing a model. Step PrintingLonging that cannot move at normal speed. AnimationThe world is constructed, not captured. Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
- 片中实例：King Kong (1933) animates Kong and prehistoric creatures as physical models. Jason and the Argonauts combines Harryhausen figures with live action in the skeleton fight.；The Nightmare Before Christmas and Coraline perform with puppets and miniatures. Fantastic Mr.；Fox keeps tactile fur and handmade increment as the world's law.；King Kong 1933Kong and prehistoric creatures are animated as physical models.；Jason and the Argonauts 1963The skeleton fight combines animated figures and live action.；Coraline 2009Puppet performances and miniature environments.
- Prompt 模板：`An articulated paper-and-wire fox carefully folds a paper boat on a miniature desk. Tactile materials, consistent joint construction, deliberate frame-by-frame posing and small controlled increments. Stable lighting and set, readable hand-object contact, no fluid live-action fur or continuously melting paper.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: Stop-motion cadence of [Subject], pose to pose, slightly staccato. Stable lights and set, readable hand-object contact, no fluid live-action fur.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a live-action jitter or Step Printing. The tell is morphing materials, melting paper, or continuously flowing hair. Fix: consistent model, deliberate pose changes, locked camera, repeatable light.

### Low Shutter
- 别名：Crisp motion cadence, Reduced motion blur ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/low-shutter)
- 定义：Low shutter cinematography uses a short shutter angle or short exposure so moving edges stay sharp inside each frame. Normal-rate action then feels abrupt and staccato because this is reduced motion blur, not a long-exposure smear.
- 叙事功能：Use it when impact and sensory stress should feel exposed: rain as beads, limbs as chopped positions, a landing that does not silk over. You are not speeding the scene. You are removing the blur that usually glues fragments together. Combat and panic live here. It is the wrong tool for night-traffic ribbons, lyric smear, or silk slow motion. Photography says 'low shutter speed' for long exposure. Film says low shutter angle for the opposite. If every lamp paints a ribbon, you shot motion blur. Do not skip frames and call that short shutter.
- 怎么拍：At 24 fps, a 180-degree shutter is about 1/48 s. A 45-degree shutter is about 1/192 s: less blur, more light required. Compensate exposure. In generated footage, request low motion blur and crisp droplets, not missing frames. Prompt: Low-shutter (short shutter angle) of [Subject], reduced motion blur, crisp rain and limb edges, staccato cadence.
- 何时用：Use it on a landing, a rescue run, or a fight that should feel like discrete fragments, such as Omaha-style rain and bodies. Do not use it when lamps should drag as ribbons.
- 近似对比：Motion Blur, Whip Pan, Slow Motion, Stutter / Stop-Stutter, Motion BlurSpeed or trauma. Clarity would be false., Whip PanTransition, punchline, or sudden attention shift., Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
  Low shutter here is the inverse of Motion Blur. A Whip Pan smears by rotating fast, usually with a normal or long shutter. Slow Motion can look sharp because high fps shortens each exposure, but the clock is stretched. Stutter / Stop-Stutter drops frames. Short shutter, low frame rate, skipped frames, and speed changes are separate controls. Motion BlurSpeed or trauma. Clarity would be false. Whip PanTransition, punchline, or sudden attention shift. Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
- 片中实例：Saving Private Ryan's Omaha Beach landing is the grammar: sharp, harshly segmented movement. Gladiator uses aggressive, discontinuous-looking motion on selected battle images.；Cloverfield is listed nearby for chaos, but much of that chaos is handheld smear, the cousin.；Saving Private Ryan 1998The Omaha Beach landing has sharp, harshly segmented movement.；Gladiator 2000Selected battle imagery uses aggressive, discontinuous-looking motion treatment.
- Prompt 模板：`Handheld close action of a rescue crew running through heavy rain, normal playback speed but crisp short-exposure droplets and sharply segmented body movement. Readable geography, restrained shake, no smooth slow motion, no artificial frame skipping.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: Handheld close action of [Subject], normal playback speed, short-exposure droplets, sharply segmented body movement, no smooth slow motion, no artificial frame skipping.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Motion Blur (and the phrase 'low shutter speed'). The tell is ribbons of light and unreadable rain. Fix: specify short shutter angle or 1/200 s class exposure, reduced motion blur, staccato edges. If you wanted paint, go to motion blur.

### Timelapse Glam
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/timelapse-glam)
- 定义：Timelapse glam is interval photography of a styling process in which clothes, hair, and makeup change at high speed while the face holds. The person is a still axis and wardrobe is the changing weather.
- 叙事功能：Use it to show transformation as labor rather than as a cut to a new costume. Stylists swarm. Hangers fly. Identity must survive the swarm or the face becomes a morph. The camera is usually locked. The clock is the dressing room's, not the street's. It is the wrong tool for landscape days, racing crowds, or a freeze of the world. If the city is the process, you wanted time-lapse or timelapse landscape. If only the person is a statue in traffic, you wanted timelapse human. Do not let the skull drift.
- 怎么拍：Lock identity, eyeline, and camera. Interval-sample while wardrobe and hair change in discrete, readable steps. Hands of stylists may smear. The face should not. Prompt: Timelapse glam of [Subject], styling swarm, clothes and hair changing while the face holds.
- 何时用：Use it when a look is assembled in public, such as a held face while stylists swap dresses at interval speed. Do not use it to time-lapse a skyline.
- 近似对比：Time-Lapse, Glam, Timelapse Human, Timelapse Landscape, Time-LapseShow weather, construction, or a night becoming morning., GlamSell the face., Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
  This is a specialty of Time-Lapse, not a Glam lighting pattern alone. Timelapse Human holds a person while a crowd races. Timelapse Landscape holds geography while weather races. A montage of costume changes with cuts is editing, not interval sampling. Time-LapseShow weather, construction, or a night becoming morning. GlamSell the face. Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
- 片中实例：Vogue transformation films and fashion-week process pieces are the native grammar. Music videos use interval wardrobe bursts on a held star.；Feature films more often cut montages. If you need a narrative cousin, think process, not a copied title sequence.
- Prompt 模板：`Video: Time-lapse around a still [Subject] as stylists and wardrobe change at high speed. Same skull, same eyeline, clothes as weather, no identity morph.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Lock the face, accelerate the styling. Still: one held identity with evidence of process (hands, garments in mid-swap).`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a costume Montage or a face morph. The tell is a changing skull, or a city time-lapse with no styling work. Fix: hold identity and camera, interval the wardrobe, keep stylist hands as the swarm.

### Timelapse Human
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/timelapse-human)
- 定义：Timelapse human holds one person in living time while the crowd is interval-sampled into smoke, so one still will stands in a rushing system. It is the opposite clock of a frozen world with a moving hero.
- 叙事功能：Use it when isolation is a rate difference: the subject decides, waits, or grieves at 24 fps while the city is hours. Commuters become flow. The camera is usually locked so the contrast stays readable. A tiny sway in the hero is allowed. Walking at full speed through a lapse crowd breaks the contract. It is the wrong tool when the world should freeze and the hero should walk (frozen in motion), or when weather is the subject (timelapse landscape). The Matrix lobby is often misfiled here. That lobby is bullet time: an orbit around a crushed instant, not interval crowds around a statue.
- 怎么拍：Lock the hero's mark and the camera. Sample passersby at long intervals, or composite a held performance over a crowd lapse. Shadows on the hero should not travel like a full day unless that is the story. Prompt: Timelapse human of [Subject] frozen in a rushing crowd, people as smoke, one still will.
- 何时用：Use it when one person should hold a station or a square while the crowd becomes smoke. Do not use it when that person must walk through a stopped city.
- 近似对比：Time-Lapse, Frozen in Motion, Bullet Time, Timelapse Landscape, Fast Motion, Time-LapseShow weather, construction, or a night becoming morning., Frozen in MotionStop the world, keep the pose., Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
  This is Time-Lapse applied to extras around a held lead. Frozen in Motion freezes the crowd and lets the lead (or camera) move. Bullet Time orbits a near-frozen event. Timelapse Landscape races weather, not pedestrians. Fast Motion would accelerate the hero too. Time-LapseShow weather, construction, or a night becoming morning. Frozen in MotionStop the world, keep the pose. Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
- 片中实例：Koyaanisqatsi turns crowds into systems. The still-person-in-racing-crowd recipe is a commercial and music-video cousin of that grammar.；The Matrix lobby stills are a frequent false reference. They belong with bullet time.
- Prompt 模板：`Video: Crowds time-lapse around a still [Subject], the city racing, the person holding. No frozen pigeons, no orbit, no hero sprinting through stopped extras.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Hold the person, lapse the crowd. Still: one sharp figure, pedestrians as flow, stable sun unless you want a day.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Frozen in Motion or Bullet Time. The tell is stopped extras and a walking hero, or a camera orbit around hanging brass. Fix: subject holds, crowd races, camera locked, people as smoke.

### Timelapse Landscape
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/timelapse-landscape)
- 定义：Timelapse landscape interval-samples light and weather over a place so hours play in seconds as clouds and shadows sweep. Geography is the actor, and a person, if present, is a scale mark rather than a racing extra.
- 叙事功能：Use it when the story is a sky, a desert, a city grid as climate, a ridge that must survive several suns. The camera is locked or on a slow, even move that does not fight the sun's path. Buildings and rock stay solid. Clouds are the motion. It is the wrong tool for wardrobe process, a still hero in a smoking crowd, or undercranked acting. If the camera walks the avenue in steps, you wanted a hyperlapse. If only headlights streak under a stuck sun, you have not shown a landscape day.
- 怎么拍：Choose interval from the process (clouds faster than a shadow-day, stars slower). Lock off or use a motion-control pan. Ramp exposure for day-to-night. Keep the sun's arc continuous. Prompt: Timelapse landscape around [Subject] or their place, clouds and shadows sweeping, hours in seconds.
- 何时用：Use it to show the day turning over a ridge, a square, or a citadel. Do not use it as a crowd recipe with a motionless sky.
- 近似对比：Time-Lapse, Aerial, Hyperlapse, Timelapse Human, Fast Motion, Time-LapseShow weather, construction, or a night becoming morning., AerialOpen a world. Make the place bigger than the person., Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
  This is Time-Lapse aimed at weather and terrain. Aerial may carry it if the viewpoint is high, but height is not the interval. Hyperlapse moves the camera through space in steps. Timelapse Human races people. Fast Motion speeds a continuous take. Time-LapseShow weather, construction, or a night becoming morning. AerialOpen a world. Make the place bigger than the person. Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
- 片中实例：Baraka and Koyaanisqatsi are the landscape-and-city interval grammar: clouds, shadows, and human systems at non-human rates. Later nature films inherit the same sun-and-cloud contract.；The still should imply a phase of day, not a morphing mountain.
- Prompt 模板：`Video: Time-lapse of light and weather over the landscape of [Subject]. Shadows sweep, clouds race, architecture holds.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Write light and weather as the motion. Still: one honest sun angle on stable geology.`
- Prompt 要点：No morphing cliffs, no crowd-only acceleration.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Fast Motion or Timelapse Human. The tell is racing people under a stuck sun, or mountains that melt. Fix: hours in seconds, traveling shadows, solid ground, camera stable or slowly authored.

### Frozen in Motion
- 别名：Time-stop environment ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/frozen-in-motion)
- 定义：Frozen in motion stops the environment and most people while a chosen character, the viewpoint, or both continue to move. Particles, extras, and pigeons hang, and the rule of who may move is the entire effect.
- 叙事功能：Use it to separate a mind from consequence: superhuman perception, a wish to step outside a square, a kitchen instant stretched into a walk. Julie can run through a stopped Oslo. Quicksilver can work a room the rest of the world cannot occupy. Hair, weather, shadows, and loose objects must obey the same freeze or the illusion dies. It is the wrong tool when the whole picture should hold (freeze-frame), when the camera should orbit a crushed event (bullet time), or when crowds should race around a statue (timelapse human). Do not freeze the hero and the street together unless you mean a still.
- 怎么拍：Decide the rule: extras hold, fluids and debris are suspended, the subject and/or camera may travel. Use held extras and practical supports for simple beats, VFX or 3D for complex hangs. Prompt: Frozen-in-motion of [Subject], the world stopped mid-gesture, particles hanging, [Subject] or the camera still allowed to move.
- 何时用：Use it when one person should walk a stopped street, or work a stopped kitchen, while pigeons and extras hang. Do not use it as a freeze of the entire frame, and do not race the crowd.
- 近似对比：Freeze Frame, Bullet Time, Timelapse Human, Slow Motion, Bullet TimeA moment is so important it becomes architecture., Freeze FrameEnd, joke, or evidence., Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
  Frozen in motion is not Freeze Frame (camera and world both stop). It is not Bullet Time (event crushed, camera orbits a sculpture). It is not Timelapse Human (crowd races, hero holds). Slow Motion still advances everyone, only slower. Keep the permission list explicit. Bullet TimeA moment is so important it becomes architecture. Freeze FrameEnd, joke, or evidence. Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
- 片中实例：X-Men: Days of Future Past expands Quicksilver's Pentagon kitchen into a subjective instant the others cannot share. The Worst Person in the World lets Julie run through an Oslo whose other inhabitants are suspended.；The Matrix rooftop is the orbiting cousin, bullet time, not this split of who may walk.；X-Men: Days of Future Past 2014The Pentagon kitchen sequence expands Quicksilver's subjective instant.；The Worst Person in the World 2021Julie runs through an Oslo whose other inhabitants are suspended.
- Prompt 模板：`A woman walks through a city square where all other people are motionless mid-gesture and pigeons hang in the air. Only she, her clothing and the following camera move. Coherent suspended poses, no breathing crowds, no melting birds, quiet suspended mood.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: Action around [Subject] freezes mid-move while [Subject] and/or the camera may still travel. Coherent suspended poses, no breathing crowds, no racing extras, no array orbit unless you actually want bullet time.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Freeze Frame, Bullet Time, or Timelapse Human. The tell is a fully still picture, an orbit around a statue, or people as smoke. Fix: write the freeze rule, hang the extras, and let only the chosen body or camera continue.

### Moonwalk
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/time-and-motion/moonwalk)
- 定义：A moonwalk effect is a backward glide that reads as a forward myth: the torso stays upright, one foot slides, the other pushes, and the heel does not lift like a walk. It is a locomotion lie in living time, not reversed footage.
- 叙事功能：Use it when gait itself is the spectacle: dance, a villain who does not obey floors, a sidewalk that should feel like ice. Wet asphalt or a stage helps the read. Coat tails should trail the slide, not bounce like steps. It is the wrong tool for a chase on gravel, a grief undo, or a toy loop. Reverse motion would rewind the whole world. A boomerang would come and go. A double dolly puts subject and camera on one platform so the world slides while the walk may be ordinary. Moonwalk is the body's lie. Do not also spin or levitate.
- 怎么拍：Write a backward slide, upright torso, one foot gliding, the other pushing. Camera can lock or track laterally. Keep contact with the floor. Prompt: Moonwalk of [Subject], backward glide that reads as forward myth, slide as dance grammar.
- 何时用：Use it when the walk is the trick, such as a backward glide on wet night asphalt. Do not use it as reversed footage of an ordinary walk.
- 近似对比：Reverse Motion, Boomerang, Double Dolly, Infinite Loop, Double DollyInterior state made external: the person is carried by an idea., BoomerangTurn a gesture into a toy., Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
  A moonwalk is not Reverse Motion of a forward walk (that inverts the whole street). It is not a Boomerang loop. A Double Dolly can fake a similar float by moving person and camera together, world sliding, feet possibly still walking. Moonwalk deletes the heel-lift. Infinite Loop may sew a glide but is a join, not a gait. Double DollyInterior state made external: the person is carried by an idea. BoomerangTurn a gesture into a toy. Slow MotionA second contains a scene.
- 片中实例：Moonwalker and Jackson's music videos are the grammar: the still is the middle of the glide, not a pose at rest. Later videos quote the slide.；Spike Lee's double-dolly is the camera-platform cousin, a different physical cause for a similar dream of locomotion.
- Prompt 模板：`Video: [Subject] glides backward as if the floor were ice, a moonwalk path. Heel does not lift like a walk.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Write the slide, not a reverse clip. Still: mid-glide, one foot flat, torso upright, coat trailing.`
- Prompt 要点：No spin, no float off the ground, no world rewind.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is walking backward normally, or Reverse Motion. The tell is a heel lift, swinging arms of a walk, or rain rising. Fix: flat glide, upright torso, floor contact, world still running forward.

### Lens Flare
- 别名：veiling flare, ghost flare, anamorphic streak, rainbow flare, Veiling glare, Light striking the lens ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/lens-flare)
- 定义：Lens flare in lens flare cinematography is stray light scattered by glass, coatings, and barrel walls, producing ghosts, streaks, or veiling glare instead of a clean image. The artifacts live in the taking optic, so they track the source angle and dim when a body occludes the lamp.
- 叙事功能：When a hard source sits near or inside the frame, the camera admits it cannot contain the light. Contrast falls. A ghost of the iris repeats across the field. The sun, a hangar opening, or a bare practical becomes a force the glass is failing to image. Use it when the observer is overwhelmed: encounter lights, headlights, a door onto daylight. The audience should feel the camera struggling to see, not a sticker riding the grade. It is the wrong tool when no source can explain the artifact. If blocking the lamp does not change the flare, you have an overlay, not an optic.
- 怎么拍：Place a small, hard source (sun, HMI, bare bulb) just off axis or in frame. Uncoated or vintage glass scatters more. A dirty or filtered front element veils the whole field. Spherical lenses print circular ghosts that take the iris shape when you stop down. For composites, parent flare position and intensity to the source and cut it when something crosses the beam. Prompt the source, its angle to the glass, and whether the result is veiling, ghosts, or both.
- 何时用：A rescue worker opens a hangar onto daylight. The frame whites and veils, then clears as her body blocks the sun. Do not drop a rainbow streak on a night interior with no lamp in the lens.
- 近似对比：Anamorphic Flare, Halation, Light Leak, Anamorphic FlareNight lights and headlights should write on the lens., HalationHighlights should bleed like film, not clip like video., Film GrainThe image should feel developed, not rendered.
  Anamorphic Flare is a horizontal streak from cylindrical anamorphic elements, not general scatter. Halation is a warm bloom on the emulsion around a highlight, not light bouncing inside the lens. Light Leak is unfiltered light hitting film or sensor from a body gap, usually from the frame edge, not from a pictured source. Anamorphic FlareNight lights and headlights should write on the lens. HalationHighlights should bleed like film, not clip like video. Film GrainThe image should feel developed, not rendered.
- 片中实例：Close Encounters of the Third Kind lets encounter lights overwhelm the viewing system. Star Trek (2009) lets bright practicals streak and veil the frame.；Alien lets industrial sources dirty the glass. The Revenant lets the sun strike the lens as weather, not as a logo.；Close Encounters of the Third Kind 1977Powerful encounter lights overwhelm the viewing system.；Star Trek 2009Bright practical sources create conspicuous streaks and veiling light.
- Prompt 模板：`A rescue worker opens a hangar door onto dazzling daylight. As the source enters the lens angle, a restrained flare and brief veiling glare wash across the image, then clear as she blocks it. Realistic source-linked behavior, no floating decorative rainbow effects.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the source and the glass, not a pack. Example: Lens flare across [Subject], the sun or a hard practical striking the front element, veiling contrast, ghost orbs tracking the source, source-linked not floating.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: a grade overlay or an anamorphic streak pack with no lamp. Tell: the flare does not move or dim when the source is blocked, and it ignores occlusions. Fix: put a real source in or near frame and parent the artifact to it.

### Anamorphic Flare
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/anamorphic-flare)
- 定义：An anamorphic flare is a horizontal streak produced when a bright point hits the cylindrical elements of an anamorphic lens. It is a subset of lens flare, not a general haze, and it usually arrives with oval bokeh from the same squeeze.
- 叙事功能：Night lamps and headlights write a bar across the frame because the front optic stretches one axis. The streak is cyan, blue, or magenta depending on coatings, and it stays level with the squeezed world. Oval highlights in the background confirm the same glass. Use it when the night should be written on the taking lens: wet streets, neon, a car coming toward camera. The streak is evidence of scope optics, not of brightness alone. It is the wrong tool in spherical coverage, or when you want a circular ghost of the iris. If the bokeh is round and the streak is a random rainbow, you have mixed two lens families.
- 怎么拍：Shoot anamorphic (typically 2x squeeze). Put a hard point source in or near frame: headlight, practical, sun. Keep the cylindrical axis consistent so streaks stay horizontal. Coatings and the front element decide color and length. Stop down and ovals become more polygonal. In a prompt, say horizontal anamorphic streak, name the hue, and demand oval bokeh, not round discs.
- 何时用：A car cresting a wet overpass at night, headlights drawing cyan bars through a figure in a raincoat. Do not add horizontal streaks to a spherical 50mm close-up with round bokeh.
- 近似对比：Lens Flare, Anamorphic, Bokeh, AnamorphicYou want the frame to announce it is a movie., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite., HalationHighlights should bleed like film, not clip like video.
  Lens Flare covers ghosts, veiling, and spherical scatter. Anamorphic flare is the horizontal bar from cylindrical glass. Anamorphic is the lens format itself: squeeze, oval bokeh, and the flare are consequences. Bokeh is the out-of-focus disc shape. Oval discs support the claim. Round discs contradict it. AnamorphicYou want the frame to announce it is a movie. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite. HalationHighlights should bleed like film, not clip like video.
- 片中实例：Blade Runner lets neon and headlights write on anamorphic glass. J.；Abrams films push the horizontal streak until it becomes a signature. Super 8 (2011) uses the same family of bars as period scope language.
- Prompt 模板：`State squeeze and streak axis. Example: Horizontal anamorphic flares streaking through [Subject], cyan or magenta bars from headlights or neon, oval bokeh, 2x squeeze, not round spherical ghosts.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Horizontal anamorphic flares streaking through [Subject], cyan or magenta bars, oval bokeh, scope cinema signature.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: generic lens flare or a spherical rainbow. Tell: round bokeh with a pasted horizontal bar that ignores source position. Fix: match oval highlights, keep streaks horizontal, and lock them to a pictured point source.

### Halation
- 别名：Soft filtration, Highlight bloom ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/halation)
- 定义：Halation in film is a reddish or warm glow around bright highlights caused by light passing through the emulsion, reflecting off the base, and scattering back into the image. It is a stock behavior, not a diffusion filter and not flare inside the lens.
- 叙事功能：A lamp, a window, or a candle does not clip to a hard video edge. The highlight breathes. A thin red or amber ring forms where the bright tone meets darker density. Fine contrast softens while faces and rooms stay readable. Use it when the picture should feel developed on film: tungsten practicals, Super 8 lamps, a window in a small apartment. Tie the bloom to a point of view, not to every specular in the grade. It is the wrong tool when you blur the whole frame equally and call it analog. If eyes go milky and there is no extra glow at highlight edges, you applied diffusion or defocus, not halation.
- 怎么拍：On film, skip or weaken the anti-halation layer, or use stocks and formats that show base scatter (some Super 8 and 16mm). In camera, keep highlights luminous but not clipped, and do not confuse this with a Promist on the lens. Digital recreation should bloom only the brightest edges, often with a warm or red fringe, while preserving grain structure and eye texture. Prompt red-edge bloom around lamps, not a fog filter over the set.
- 何时用：A woman beside a rain window, amber practicals breathing, the neon sign outside gaining a warm halo while her eyes stay sharp. Do not frost the entire frame and destroy highlight information.
- 近似对比：Lens Flare, Film Grain, Vintage Cine Glass, Film GrainThe image should feel developed, not rendered., Vintage Cine GlassMemory, period, or beauty over resolution., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Lens Flare is scatter inside the glass, ghosts and veils that track a source into the optic. Halation is scatter in the film layers around a highlight already in the image. Film Grain is the random silver or dye texture, not the glow. Vintage Cine Glass can add both bloom and falloff, but the physical cause of halation is the emulsion, not old coatings alone. Film GrainThe image should feel developed, not rendered. Vintage Cine GlassMemory, period, or beauty over resolution. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：The Master lets 65mm highlights bloom without turning faces to vapor. Barry Lyndon is grammar for candlelit tones that stay luminous instead of clipping.；Atonement uses soft summer windows around the country house. Those are highlight behaviors, not frames to copy.；Barry Lyndon 1975Soft pictorial light and luminous candlelit interiors.；Atonement 2007Soft, luminous summer imagery around the country house.
- Prompt 模板：`A woman reads beside a bright summer window. Fine facial detail stays readable while window highlights bloom gently into the surrounding air. Subtle soft filtration, luminous skin without smoothing away texture, no fog overlay or global defocus.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Bloom the highlight edge, not the whole room. Example: Halation glow around highlights on [Subject], red-edge bloom of film stock, lamps breathing, eyes and fabric texture preserved, not a global fog.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: Promist, bloom filter, or shallow-focus mush. Tell: even blur, no red-edge, highlights crushed to white with no density. Fix: confine the glow to bright edges, keep a warm fringe, and hold texture in faces.

### Film Grain
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/film-grain)
- 定义：Film grain in film grain cinematography is the random texture of silver halide crystals or color dye clouds in the emulsion, or a digital simulation of that structure. It is a developed surface, not a PNG overlay sitting on top of a clean render.
- 叙事功能：The image is made of particles that change every frame. Shadows crawl. Midtones have a living grain. Highlights are not a separate smooth plate. Format and stock speed set the size: 16mm reads coarser in the frame than 35mm or 65mm. Use it when the picture should feel exposed and processed, not drawn. A rooftop at blue hour, a winter platform, a handheld interior. Grain should scale with density, not stamp the same speckle on sky and coat alike. It is the wrong tool as a default film look on a sharp digital plate. If the grain is identical on every frame, or floats above motion blur, it is a layer, not an emulsion.
- 怎么拍：On film, choose stock and format: faster stocks and smaller negatives show more grain. Push processing increases it. Digitally, generate monochromatic grain that is denser in midtones and shadows, temporally unstable, and finer on larger implied formats. Do not sharpen after. Prompt 16mm or 35mm texture, living grain, no overlay.
- 何时用：A charcoal coat on wet slate at blue hour, 35mm grain in the dusk, chimney smoke breaking into particles. Do not paste coarse grain on an already sharp product still and call it developed.
- 近似对比：Halation, Filmic Faded, Light Leak, HalationHighlights should bleed like film, not clip like video., Filmic FadedNot HDR. A print., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Halation is highlight bloom in the layers, not the particle field. Filmic Faded is a contrast and color decision (lifted blacks, reduced saturation), which can sit with grain but is not grain. Light Leak fogs from the edge with unfiltered light. Grain is the stock's texture everywhere the image has density. HalationHighlights should bleed like film, not clip like video. Filmic FadedNot HDR. A print. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：The Revenant lets natural-light textures read as a developed image rather than a clean sensor. Roma is large-format stillness with a photochemical finish, not a grain storm.；Saving Private Ryan uses a harsher, tighter grain as combat stock language.
- Prompt 模板：`Specify format and that the grain is in the image, not on it. Example: Visible film grain over [Subject], 35mm or 16mm dye-cloud texture, temporally unstable, denser in shadows, not a cheap overlay.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Visible film grain over [Subject], 35mm or 16mm texture, living silver, not a cheap overlay.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: a repeating overlay, digital noise, or halation bloom. Tell: identical grain on every frame, speckle in clipped whites, or a wallpaper that ignores motion. Fix: per-frame grain, format-sized particles, density-weighted, no overlay.

### Bokeh
- 别名：round bokeh, oval bokeh, cat-eye bokeh, swirly bokeh, onion-ring bokeh ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/bokeh)
- 定义：Bokeh in bokeh cinematography is the aesthetic character of out-of-focus rendering: the disc shape, edge, and smoothness of blurred points, not the mere fact of a thin depth of field. The glass, not a blur slider, decides whether those discs are round, oval, outlined, or swirling.
- 叙事功能：A city, a string of practicals, or a wet street becomes a field of discs. Circular blades make circles. Anamorphic squeeze makes ovals. Mechanical vignetting cats-eyes the discs at the frame edge. Nervous, outlined, or onion-ring discs are also bokeh. They are just unkind bokeh. Use it when the world behind or in front of a face should become light rather than information. One plane stays true. The rest is the optic's handwriting. It is the wrong tool when you need the room. If background signs, eyelines, or geography still have to read, creamy discs are hiding the scene. It is also the wrong word for a masked cutout with no optical discs at all.
- 怎么拍：Open the aperture, separate subject from background, and choose glass: spherical circles, anamorphic ovals, Petzval swirl, cat-eye at the edges. Point sources (practicals, speculars, rain catches) make the discs visible. Distance and focal length set disc size. Prompt the disc shape and the source of the highlights, not blurry background alone.
- 何时用：A close portrait in a cramped apartment, amber lamps and a magenta neon turning into circular or oval discs while the near eye stays sharp. Do not melt a wide master that still has blocking to read.
- 近似对比：Shallow Focus, Anamorphic, Rack Focus, Shallow FocusNothing else is invited., AnamorphicYou want the frame to announce it is a movie., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Shallow Focus is the thin sharp plane. Bokeh is the look of whatever is off that plane. Anamorphic turns those discs into ovals and often adds streaks. Rack Focus moves the sharp plane during the shot. Bokeh can change as focus moves, but the pull is a different verb. Shallow FocusNothing else is invited. AnamorphicYou want the frame to announce it is a movie. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：In the Mood for Love turns crowded Hong Kong lamps into soft discs around faces. Her isolates Theodore against city lights whose character is the glass, not a painted smear.
- Prompt 模板：`Name disc shape and highlight sources. Example: Creamy bokeh field behind [Subject], circular or oval highlight discs from practicals, subject sharp, background as light not as a masked blur.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Creamy bokeh field behind [Subject], circular or oval highlights, the world melted to light, subject isolated by glass.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: a cutout mask or generic shallow focus with no disc structure. Tell: hair cut out like a sticker, no specular discs, background replaced rather than optically soft. Fix: keep optical discs, cat-eye at edges if wide open, and a real distance between planes.

### Double Exposure
- 别名：Cloning, Split matte, Superimposition ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/double-exposure)
- 定义：Double exposure in double exposure film combines two or more image records on one frame, in camera by winding back, optically in a printer, or digitally as an additive composite. Both pictures occupy the same emulsion or file unless a matte fully holds one off.
- 叙事功能：A face in a city. A ghost in rain. Fireplace flames laid over a locked interior. Two times share density. The result can be lyrical (memory, a second self) or purely practical (an element you could not shoot with the first pass). Use it when two records should coexist: a thought over a room, a spirit over a landscape, fire added later. Superimposition is the family. Actor doubling with a split matte is one application, not the whole technique. It is the wrong tool when you need two solid bodies that occlude each other, cast contact shadows, and pass objects. That is duplication or a split-matte composite, not a ghosted overlay. It is also the wrong tool when a dissolve would carry you from one time to the next instead of stacking them.
- 怎么拍：In camera: expose, matte off part of the gate or shoot a full overlay, rewind, expose again with matched lighting. Optically: bi-pack or printer pass. Digitally: additive mix or screened layers, or a hard split matte for twins. Lock the camera unless both passes share motion control. Prompt two named images sharing one frame, optical overlay, not a hard cut and not a morph.
- 何时用：A face superimposed over rain-soaked rooftops so memory and place occupy one still. Do not use a translucent overlay when two twins must sit at one table and pour tea.
- 近似对比：Dissolve, Duplication, Morph, Match Cut, DissolveMemory, passage, or a gentle death of a scene., Match CutTwo images are the same idea., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Dissolve is a temporal crossfade from shot A to shot B. Double exposure holds both at once. Duplication makes two solid performances of the same body in one space, usually with mattes, not ghosts. Morph interpolates geometry from one form into another. Overlay is not transformation. Match Cut joins two shots. Double exposure never cuts. DissolveMemory, passage, or a gentle death of a scene. Match CutTwo images are the same idea. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Persona stacks faces until identity is a density problem. The Tree of Life lays memory over photographed nature.；The Shining adds fireplace flames with a separate exposure. The Parent Trap and Adaptation use related splitting and doubling when two bodies must coexist, which is the cousin, not the same overlay.；The Parent Trap 1961The same performer appears as both twins in shared compositions.；Adaptation 2002Charlie and Donald occupy the same scenes.；The Shining 1980Fireplace flames were added with a separate exposure.
- Prompt 模板：`A woman argues with an identical version of herself across a kitchen table. Generate each performance as a separate plate from the same locked camera and clean kitchen reference. Match eyelines and timing; keep their silhouettes separate. Composite them together with consistent shadows and no identity blending.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name both records and the mix. Example: Double exposure of [Subject] overlaid with a second named image, faces in cities, a ghost in rain, optical composite in camera, both exposures visible, not a morph and not a split-screen join.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: dissolve, morph, or twin duplication. Tell: one image simply fades into the next, or two solid people with no shared density, or a face melting into a building. Fix: keep both images present, set opacity or a matte on purpose, and decide whether the second pass is ghost or solid.

### Rack Focus
- 别名：focus pull, slow rack, snap rack, multiple rack, Bascule de point ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/rack-focus)
- 定义：A rack focus moves the sharp plane from one subject or distance to another during a continuous shot, while the composition stays largely the same. Attention changes because the helical turns, not because the camera cuts or dollies.
- 叙事功能：A brass key is sharp on a desk. The woman in the doorway is soft. Over about two seconds the key goes, her face arrives. Nobody moved. The audience felt a handoff inside one space. Use it to change who owns the shot without cutting: pursuer and pursued, a clue and a face, a listener and the person who just entered. A slow rack is a sentence. A snap rack is a jab. It is the wrong tool when both planes must stay sharp (that is deep focus or a split diopter) or when the camera should physically travel. If details morph instead of going in and out of focus, the model invented a dissolve.
- 怎么拍：Mark two distances. Rehearse timing with the first AC. Keep the head still for a clean demonstration, or coordinate the pull with a small move. Wide-open glass makes the rack readable. Lens breathing may change field of view slightly. Decide if that is wanted. Prompt: locked camera, named near and far subjects, a two-second pull, shallow depth of field, no zoom.
- 何时用：Focus holds on a foreground key, then pulls to the figure in the doorway over about two seconds. Do not rack when the scene needs both faces sharp at once, or when a cut would be cleaner.
- 近似对比：Shallow Focus, Split Diopter, Deep Focus, Push In, Shallow FocusNothing else is invited., Split DiopterTwo distances must both be true at once., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Shallow Focus is a static thin plane. A rack is that plane moving. Split Diopter keeps two distances sharp at once with a seam. Deep Focus keeps a continuous range sharp so no pull is required. Push In travels the camera. The rack does not change the map, only the focus mark. Shallow FocusNothing else is invited. Split DiopterTwo distances must both be true at once. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Peking Opera Blues shifts focus from the pursued figure to the pursuing policeman inside one composition. The Graduate uses selective focus to organize Benjamin against the people around him.；The Player treats the pull as a long sentence of attention.；Peking Opera Blues 1986Focus shifts from the pursued figure to the pursuing policeman.；The Graduate 1967Selective focus organizes attention between Benjamin and surrounding figures.
- Prompt 模板：`Locked composition: a brass key in sharp foreground on a desk, a woman blurred in the doorway behind it. Hold the key, then slowly rack focus to her expression as the key becomes soft. No camera move, no zoom, neither object changes position.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name both planes and the duration. Still: Rack focus between planes around [Subject], a two-second pull from foreground to the figure or the reverse.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: a cut, a morph, or both planes staying sharp. Tell: no defocus, details melting, or a zoom pretending to be a pull. Fix: hold framing, send one plane soft while the other comes true, and keep identities stable.

### Shallow Focus
- 别名：Selective focus, Faible profondeur de champ ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/shallow-focus)
- 定义：Shallow focus keeps a narrow depth range sharp while foreground or background falls off. It is a depth-of-field choice made with distance, focal length, and aperture together, not a button labeled blur.
- 叙事功能：The near eye is true. Ears, wallpaper, and the street outside go. Isolation is optical: the world is still there, the glass has declined to report it. Intimacy is a byproduct of exclusion. Use it when nothing else is invited: a ticket seller behind glass, a close-up in a crowded station, a face in an apartment. The blur should clarify who we are with. It is the wrong tool for blocking that lives in depth, for geography, or for any beat where a background reaction still has to read. If hair is cut out like a mask and the backdrop is a smear without discs, you left photography.
- 怎么拍：8), longer glass or closer camera, and real subject-to-background distance. Keep the important eye as the mark, especially if the actor moves. Bokeh character follows the lens. Do not treat aperture as the only control. Prompt the stop, the sharp plane (near eye), and that the background is optically soft, not replaced.
- 何时用：An elderly ticket seller, near eye sharp, station crowd reduced to unreadable shapes. Do not use it on a wide that still has to show who entered the far door.
- 近似对比：Bokeh, Deep Focus, Rack Focus, 85mm Portrait, BokehOnly one plane may be true., Deep FocusLet the audience find the story in the whole room., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Bokeh is how the blur looks. Shallow focus is that the blur exists. Deep Focus is the opposite: near and far both legible. Rack Focus starts from shallow focus and moves the mark. 85mm Portrait often produces this look because of distance and length, but any focal length can go shallow if you get close and open up. BokehOnly one plane may be true. Deep FocusLet the audience find the story in the whole room. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Central Station isolates portraits from busy surroundings. Her keeps Theodore in a thin plane against a soft city.；In the Mood for Love uses selective focus as crowding and privacy at once. The Master often holds faces in a narrow range against rooms that fall away.；Central Station 1998Portraits isolate individuals from busy surroundings.；Her 2013Intimate close-ups separate Theodore from his environment.
- Prompt 模板：`An elderly ticket seller sits behind glass in a busy station. Tight portrait with the near eye sharp and the crowd reduced to soft, unrecognizable shapes. Tiny natural movements, stable eye focus, no plastic skin, no abrupt background replacement.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the mark and the stop. Example: Very shallow focus on [Subject], T1.4, near eye sharp, background dissolved into optical discs, intimacy by exclusion, not a cutout mask.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: a subject cutout, or deep-focus staging with a fake blur. Tell: sticker edges on hair, both ears as sharp as the eye, no disc highlights. Fix: a real distance gap, one eye as the plane, optical falloff, readable bokeh discs.

### Deep Focus
- 别名：Extended depth of field, Grande profondeur de champ ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/deep-focus)
- 定义：Deep focus in deep focus cinematography keeps multiple near and far planes legibly sharp in one image. It is a continuous depth of field, not merely action arranged in depth while the glass stays selective.
- 叙事功能：A hand stamps a form near the lens. A visitor waits in a distant doorway. Both are readable. The audience may look at either without a pull or a cut dictating the choice. Cause and effect share the room. Use it when the story is the whole space: a child outside a window while adults sign papers, a street and a face, two rooms through a doorway. Staging does the directing. The lens declines to choose. It is the wrong tool for intimacy that should exclude the world, or when light cannot support a small aperture. Two sharp planes with a blur belt between them are a split diopter or a composite, not deep focus.
- 怎么拍：Balance shorter focal length, smaller aperture, enough illumination, and subject distances that the stop can cover. Some famous deep-focus-looking shots also used in-camera composites. The screen result does not prove a single-pass method. Prompt: everything sharp from a named near object to the far plane, no rack, no seam, continuous space.
- 何时用：A clerk's hand in the near field and an anxious visitor in a far doorway, both sharp, locked wide. Do not claim deep focus if a blur boundary splits the frame in two.
- 近似对比：Shallow Focus, Split Diopter, Layered Depth, Rack Focus, Forced Perspective, Layered DepthA shot should be walkable., Split DiopterTwo distances must both be true at once., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Shallow Focus isolates one plane. Deep focus refuses that isolation. Split Diopter cheats two sharp distances with a visible or hidden seam and a soft belt. Layered Depth is compositional stacking. It can be shot shallow or deep. Rack Focus would choose for the audience. Deep focus leaves the choice open. Forced Perspective may need deep focus so the scale lie is not exposed by blur. Layered DepthA shot should be walkable. Split DiopterTwo distances must both be true at once. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Citizen Kane keeps young Kane readable outside the window behind the adults. Touch of Evil holds near and distant figures in the same legible compositions.；The Best Years of Our Lives uses deep space so a whole room can act at once.；Citizen Kane 1941The young Kane outside the window remains legible behind the adults.；Touch of Evil 1958Near and distant figures share strongly legible compositions.
- Prompt 模板：`Locked wide shot of a courthouse office: a clerk's hand stamps a form near the lens while an anxious visitor stands in a distant doorway. Both near and far action remain sharply readable, natural perspective, no rack focus, no artificial split-screen seam.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Demand continuous sharpness, not two cut planes. Example: Deep focus on [Subject] and the far plane, near action and distant doorway both sharp, no rack focus, no split-diopter seam, the eye may wander.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: split diopter or a composite of two sharp layers with mush in the middle. Tell: a vertical blur stripe, mismatched grain between planes, or a rack hiding in the still. Fix: one continuous volume, matched perspective, both distances sharp without a join.

### Forced Perspective
- 别名：Apparent size manipulation, Perspective trick ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/forced-perspective)
- 定义：Forced perspective uses camera position, subject distance, and set geometry to alter apparent size or distance, and the lie exists only from the taking viewpoint. Bodies, furniture, and eyelines must agree or the scale collapses.
- 叙事功能：A small adult sits at a table with a full-sized host. The table is built in two scales. From one locked lens they share a meal. Move off the axis and the join shows. The photograph looks ordinary. The measurements are not. Use it to change size without a digital shrink: a hobbit beside a man, a grown actor in a giant childhood kitchen, a miniature city aligned with a live foreground. Fantasy stays inside a photograph. It is the wrong tool for a free-moving camera unless the geometry is motion-controlled to match. It is also the wrong tool when you actually built a miniature of the whole world (that is diorama) or when you faked miniature scale with a tilted plane of focus (that is tilt-shift).
- 怎么拍：Choose the viewing position first. Place the small performer farther from camera, or the large one nearer, and scale the set pieces they touch. Match eyelines and ground contact. Light both distances as one space. Lock the camera, or move only on a path that preserves alignment. Prompt: in-camera scale by placement, shared table or floor, coherent eyelines, not a digital resize.
- 何时用：A tiny adult guest and a normal host at one rustic table, locked camera, feet and hands sharing scaled furniture. Do not orbit the pair. A new angle will break the alignment.
- 近似对比：Diorama, Tilt-Shift, Deep Focus, Duplication, Tilt-ShiftMake a city a model, or slice focus through a crowd., Deep FocusLet the audience find the story in the whole room., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Diorama photographs a physical model standing in for a large world. Forced perspective usually uses real people at different distances. Tilt-Shift fakes toy scale with a thin focus plane on a real landscape. Deep Focus often supports forced perspective so both scales stay sharp. Duplication copies a person. Forced perspective copies a size relationship. Tilt-ShiftMake a city a model, or slice focus through a crowd. Deep FocusLet the audience find the story in the whole room. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring seats humans and hobbits in shared compositions by distance and scaled props. Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind puts Joel child-sized inside enlarged rooms.；Those are viewpoint constructions, not frames to duplicate.；The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring 2001Human and hobbit scale relationships in shared compositions.；Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind 2004Joel appears child-sized inside enlarged childhood environments.
- Prompt 模板：`From one locked camera, a tiny adult guest sits beside a normal-sized host at a rustic table. Design the table and seating in separate scaled sections so their eyelines meet correctly. Stable hands, feet and contact shadows; no shrinking animation or distorted anatomy.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Describe the viewpoint lie, not a shrink filter. Example: Forced perspective with [Subject], scale altered by camera placement and scaled furniture, giant or miniature in camera, locked viewpoint, matching eyelines, not a digital resize.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: tilt-shift miniature look, or a person digitally scaled with wrong contact shadows. Tell: feet hover, eyelines miss, blur betrays true distance, or the camera freely orbits. Fix: one axis, scaled contact, matched light, deep enough focus to sell both sizes.

### Light Leak
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/light-leak)
- 定义：A light leak in light leak film is unfiltered light that reaches the emulsion or sensor without passing through the taking lens, usually through a gap in the body, magazine, or gate. It fogs from the edge or along a scratch in the film path, often orange or red on color negative because it hits the base side.
- 叙事功能：The frame is wounded at the border. A wash of orange, red, or white eats density that the lens never saw. It feels like damaged time: a Super 8 cartridge, a clock not seated, a magazine door. The pictured lamps are innocent. Use it for memory, accident, or analog failure, when the camera body is part of the story. A leak can punctuate a cut or stain a whole take. It is the wrong tool as a default nostalgia grade on a clean digital interior. If the wash sits in the middle of the frame and tracks a pictured sun, you are describing flare, not a leak. If only highlight edges glow, that is halation.
- 怎么拍：Physically: open a gap at the magazine, leave a clock loose, or flash the film in loading. The fog often blooms from one edge and may shift as the film advances. Recreating it: edge-based, warm, additive fog that can clip, unrelated to sources in the set. Prompt: analog leak from the frame edge, orange or red, emulsion wound, not a lens flare from a lamp.
- 何时用：An apartment portrait with an orange bite coming in from the left, as if the cartridge failed, while the window practicals remain ordinary. Do not center a golden wash on the sun in frame and call it a leak.
- 近似对比：Lens Flare, Halation, Film Grain, Light Flash, HalationHighlights should bleed like film, not clip like video., Film GrainThe image should feel developed, not rendered., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Lens Flare enters through the glass and ghosts the source. A leak bypasses the glass. Halation is a halo around highlights already imaged. Film Grain is texture, not fog. Light Flash is a temporal blowout of the whole frame, often as a cut. A leak is a spatial stain, usually from the edge. HalationHighlights should bleed like film, not clip like video. Film GrainThe image should feel developed, not rendered. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Spring Breakers uses analog damage, including leaks and blown edges, as party-memory texture. Super 8 (2011) treats cartridge wounds as period accident.；Home-movie Super 8 diaries are the grammar: edge fog, not a pictured lamp.
- Prompt 模板：`Put the wound on the edge, not on the sun. Example: Analog light leak washing [Subject], orange or red fog eating the frame edge, unfiltered light on the emulsion, not a source-linked lens flare.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Analog light leak washing [Subject], orange or red flare eating the frame edge, a wound in the emulsion.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: lens flare or halation. Tell: the colored wash tracks a lamp in shot, or a red ring around a bulb with a clean frame edge. Fix: originate the fog from a body gap at the border, independent of pictured sources.

### Vignette
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/vignette)
- 定义：A vignette in vignette cinematography darkens, desaturates, or lowers contrast toward the frame edges because of optical falloff, mechanical vignetting in the barrel, a filter, or a later grade. Optical vignette follows the lens, while a post oval is a drawing.
- 叙事功能：The corners lose stop. Attention pools in the center without a spotlight on the actor. Vintage wide glass and some anamorphics do this unasked. Cameo lighting can look similar, but that is a lighting plot, not falloff in the optic. Use it to hold the eye in, to mimic old glass, or to admit that the field is darker off axis. Keep it gentle enough that the sides still exist. It is the wrong tool as a heavy post oval crushed onto every wide. If the edges go to black like a spotlight and the falloff is a perfect geometric shape unrelated to the lens, you have a filter, not an optic.
- 怎么拍：Wide-open vintage glass, a wide angle on a small coverage circle, or an ND or grad at the edges. Cosine-fourth falloff is natural. Mechanical vignetting is the barrel cutting the bundle. In a grade, darken corners with a soft, lens-shaped roll, not a hard oval. Prompt: natural optical vignette, edges falling off, vintage falloff, not a post oval.
- 何时用：A rooftop figure at blue hour, corners a stop down, center holding the coat and the city. Do not crush the sides of a group shot until the people at the edge disappear.
- 近似对比：Cameo Lighting, Vintage Cine Glass, Central Framing, Halation, Vintage Cine GlassMemory, period, or beauty over resolution., Cameo LightingErase the world. Keep the person., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Cameo Lighting lights a figure against a dark field. The darkness is in the set, not in the glass. Vintage Cine Glass often includes natural vignette plus aberrations. Central Framing is a compositional choice that vignette can support. Halation glows highlights. Vignette darkens edges. Vintage Cine GlassMemory, period, or beauty over resolution. Cameo LightingErase the world. Keep the person. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Barry Lyndon shows fast vintage glass with natural corner falloff in candlelit rooms. The Witch uses older optics whose edges go quietly, holding the eye in the clearing or the kitchen.
- Prompt 模板：`Ask for lens falloff, not a baked oval. Example: Natural optical vignette around [Subject], corners a stop down, attention pooled in the center, vintage falloff not a post oval.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Natural optical vignette around [Subject], edges falling off, attention pooled in the center, vintage falloff not a post oval.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: a circular crop, cameo spotlight, or a heavy social-media oval. Tell: perfect ellipse of black, subjects at the edge crushed, no relation to the lens. Fix: soft, stop-based roll, keep edge information, match the glass.

### Chromatic Aberration
- 别名：lateral chromatic aberration, longitudinal chromatic aberration ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/chromatic-aberration)
- 定义：Chromatic aberration in chromatic aberration cinematography is color fringing from different wavelengths focusing at different distances or magnifications. Lateral CA puts red-cyan (or similar) fringes on high-contrast edges, worse toward the frame edge, while longitudinal CA puts different colors in front of and behind the focus plane.
- 叙事功能：Cheap, wide, or vintage glass fails to put all colors on the same plane. A branch, a shoulder, a neon sign grows a red or cyan beard. The optic is imperfect on purpose, or it is simply old. Use it when the glass should confess: lo-fi night, a dream that is optical rather than a grade, a wide at full aperture. Tie fringes to contrast edges, stronger in the corners. It is the wrong tool as a full-frame RGB split, which is a channel offset, not aberration. If the whole image is three layers of the same picture, you have a digital treatment, not CA.
- 怎么拍：Wide angle, wide open, simple or vintage designs. Lateral CA scales with distance from center. Longitudinal CA shows as color bokeh (magenta in front, green behind, or the reverse). Recreate by fringing high-contrast edges, not by sliding entire channels. Prompt: red-cyan fringing at high-contrast edges, stronger at the frame edge, cheap or vintage glass.
- 何时用：A night overpass, raincoat against neon, red-cyan fringes on the brightest sign edges and the silhouette. Do not RGB-split the entire figure as if it were a channel offset.
- 近似对比：Lens Flare, Fisheye, Vintage Cine Glass, Distortions, FisheyeThe mind is warped, or the space is a dome., Vintage Cine GlassMemory, period, or beauty over resolution., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Lens Flare is scatter and ghosts, not edge fringes. Fisheye is extreme barrel distortion. It can carry CA but is a geometry, not a color error. Vintage Cine Glass often includes CA plus haze and vignette. Distortions are spatial warps. CA is a color-focus error on top of, or instead of, those warps. FisheyeThe mind is warped, or the space is a dome. Vintage Cine GlassMemory, period, or beauty over resolution. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Spring Breakers lets cheap-looking fringing and analog error sit on party lights. Music videos often push lateral CA as a wide-open night look.；Enter the Void uses optical error as subjective night, which is grammar, not a template.
- Prompt 模板：`Fringe the edges, do not split the body. Example: Chromatic aberration on [Subject], red-cyan fringing at high-contrast edges, stronger toward the corners, vintage or simple glass, not a full RGB channel offset.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Chromatic aberration on [Subject], red-cyan fringing at high-contrast edges, cheap glass or dream distortion.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: RGB split, lens flare, or fisheye stretch. Tell: the whole subject is three colored copies, or only a rainbow streak with no edge fringe. Fix: confine color to high-contrast edges, increase it off center, keep the core image registered.

### Infrared
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/infrared)
- 定义：Infrared cinematography photographs near-infrared reflectance (roughly 700 to 900 nm), not heat, so foliage often goes pale, skies go dark, and skin can look waxy. It is a different slice of reflected light, still a photograph of the location.
- 叙事功能：The woods are white. The sky is near black. Faces are wrong in a quiet way: veins, powder, fabric dyes all rewrite. The place is still Earth. The spectrum is not the one the eye owns. Use it when a landscape should feel like another planet without leaving the location: a forbidden forest, a concert IR look, a surveillance still that is not green-tube night vision. It is the wrong tool for hunting in total dark (that is image intensification) or for seeing body heat (that is thermal). If the image is green and noisy with blooming lamps, you have night vision. If faces are ironbow masks, you have thermal.
- 怎么拍：Use an IR-pass filter and a sensor or stock sensitive to near-IR, or remove a camera's IR-cut filter. Light is still reflected sunlight or IR-rich tungsten, not emitted heat. Expose for the Wood effect on leaves. Prompt: pale foliage, dark sky, waxy skin, near-infrared photograph, not green phosphor, not a thermal palette.
- 何时用：A rider on a ridge, trees gone chalky, sky black, skin slightly unearthly, still clearly a daylight landscape. Do not render it as predator heat colors or as a green goggle feed.
- 近似对比：Night Vision, Thermal, Monochrome, Night VisionSomeone is hunting in the dark., MonochromeStrip to drawing., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Night Vision intensifies residual photons onto a phosphor, usually green and grainy, as a hunting or surveillance eye. Thermal maps emitted long-wave radiation to a false-color palette. Monochrome is visible-light black and white. Infrared can be printed mono, but its tonalities (white leaves, black sky) come from IR reflectance. Night VisionSomeone is hunting in the dark. MonochromeStrip to drawing. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：The Village used infrared film in the woods so the forest would read as another world while remaining a photographed place. Concert IR photography is the live-music cousin: pale skin, dark clothing dyes, no green tube.
- Prompt 模板：`Specify near-IR reflectance, not heat. Example: Infrared look on [Subject], foliage going pale, skies black, skin waxy, near-infrared photograph, not night-vision green, not a thermal palette.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Infrared look on [Subject], foliage going pale, skies black, skin otherworldly, a spectrum humans do not own.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: night vision or thermal. Tell: green phosphor grain, or ironbow heat masks, or ordinary black and white with normal dark trees. Fix: invert the foliage and sky relationship, keep it a reflected-light still, no goggle HUD.

### Night Vision
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/night-vision)
- 定义：Night vision in night vision cinematography is image intensification: residual photons, and often a near-IR illuminator, amplified through a photocathode and microchannel plate onto a phosphor. The picture is typically green, grainy, blooming around lamps, with the framing of goggles, a weapon sight, or a camera in the dark.
- 叙事功能：Someone is hunting or hiding. The world is a tube. Speculars bloom. Resolution is poor. Grain is the gain. You are not looking at a graded night exterior. You are looking through a device that makes the dark usable. Use it as a point of view: a raid, a found camera, a basement with goggles on. The green (or white phosphor) is the display, not a color grade on a normal sensor. It is the wrong tool for a moonlit scene, for pale IR woods, or for heat outlines. If trees go white and skies black in clean daylight contrast, that is infrared photography. If bodies are warm masks against cold walls, that is thermal.
- 怎么拍：Motivate the device: goggles, rifle sight, security cam. High gain, scintillation, blooming highlights, limited dynamic range, maybe a circular or binocular mask, maybe an IR illuminator hot-spot. Prompt: green phosphor, grainy intensification, surveillance or military eye, blooming lamps, not a teal grade, not thermal.
- 何时用：A figure on a snow platform seen through goggles, green, noisy, lamps blooming, as a hunter's feed. Do not paint a normal night master green.
- 近似对比：Thermal, Infrared, Found Footage, ThermalSee temperature, not light., Found FootageThe operator is in danger too., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Thermal sees emitted heat, not intensified light. Faces become temperature. Infrared is a near-IR photograph of reflectance, often in daylight woods. Found Footage is the amateur or diegetic-camera wrapper that night vision often sits inside. Night vision is the tube. Found footage is the alibi. ThermalSee temperature, not light. Found FootageThe operator is in danger too. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：The Hurt Locker uses intensification as a combat eye. Zero Dark Thirty uses goggle and raid imagery as the operation's seeing.；The Silence of the Lambs puts the audience in night-vision goggles in the dark.
- Prompt 模板：`Make it a device, not a grade. Example: Night-vision green phosphor of [Subject], grainy image intensification, blooming lamps, goggle or sight framing, surveillance or military eye, not a thermal palette.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Night-vision green phosphor of [Subject], grainy, surveillance, found-footage military eye.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: a green color grade, thermal ironbow, or infrared woods. Tell: normal contrast with a hue shift, or heat-colored people, or no grain and no bloom. Fix: high gain noise, phosphor color, highlight bloom, diegetic device framing.

### Thermal
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/thermal)
- 定义：Thermal imaging cinematography maps emitted long-wave infrared (heat), not reflected light. A microbolometer or similar sensor assigns a palette (white-hot, black-hot, ironbow) to temperature, so faces, engines, and blood read warm while cold metal and night air do not.
- 叙事功能：You are not lighting the scene. You are reading temperature. A body is a mask. A recently used gun is a bright shape. Walls may be dark. Visible lamps do not necessarily dominate. The camera is forensic or predatory. Use it when the story is heat: a hunter's vision, search and rescue, a border raid, an alien targeting system. The palette is a legend, not a grade. It is the wrong tool for green goggle work or for pale-leaf IR photography. If lamps bloom and the room is grainy green, that is night vision. If foliage is white under a black sky, that is near-IR stills.
- 怎么拍：No key light in the usual sense. Contrast is delta-T. Choose a palette and keep it consistent. Warm cores, cooler edges, possible bloom on the hottest spots. Glass windows can block LWIR, so a face behind glass may fail. Prompt: thermal palette, heat as color, faces as warm masks, not green phosphor, not near-IR foliage.
- 何时用：A rider and horse as warm shapes on a cold ridge, ironbow or white-hot, breath as a plume, stone dark. Do not render it as a green night-vision feed or as daylight IR woods.
- 近似对比：Night Vision, Infrared, Monochrome, Night VisionSomeone is hunting in the dark., InfraredThe world should look like another planet that is still Earth., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Night Vision intensifies residual light on a phosphor. Infrared photographs near-IR reflectance (white leaves, dark sky). Thermal is emitted LWIR. Monochrome is visible-light grey. A thermal image can look mono in white-hot, but its tones follow heat, not albedo. Night VisionSomeone is hunting in the dark. InfraredThe world should look like another planet that is still Earth. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Predator makes heat the alien's sight: bodies as warm figures in a cool jungle. Sicario uses thermal and related electro-optical views as raid and border seeing.；Those are device palettes, not looks to photocopy.
- Prompt 模板：`Map temperature, not lamps. Example: Thermal palette of [Subject], heat as color, faces as warm masks, ironbow or white-hot, search-and-rescue or predator vision, not night-vision green, not pale infrared foliage.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Thermal palette of [Subject], heat as color, faces as warm masks, Predator vision or search-and-rescue.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: night vision or near-IR photography. Tell: green grain with blooming streetlights, or white trees and black sky, or normal modeling from a key light. Fix: temperature-based tones, warm bodies, cold surroundings, a named palette.

### Slit-Scan
- 别名：Star Gate effect, Temporal slit photography ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/slit-scan)
- 定义：Slit-scan exposes moving artwork or a moving camera through a narrow slit over time, stretching space into streaks and corridors with time laid along one axis. The result is structured geometry, not a random particle tunnel.
- 叙事功能：A slit is the only open part of the gate. Artwork or a light source moves relative to that slit. Each frame or pass accumulates a thin slice. The stack becomes a corridor of color with a vanishing point. Travel is not through a photographed street. It is through exposure. Use it for passage that is not ordinary space: a stargate, a mind unspooling, a title that is time smeared into architecture. It is the wrong tool if you mean a kaleidoscope of mirrors, a time-lapse of a real street, or a nebula of sparks. Random neon particles do not reproduce slit-scan geometry.
- 怎么拍：Classic optical method: slit mask, illuminated artwork on a track, camera or art in controlled relative motion, long accumulation. Digital: procedural streaks with a stable vanishing point, ordered planes, long-exposure character along one axis. Prompt: slit-scan streaking, time smeared along one axis, a corridor of light, ordered perspective, no random sparks.
- 何时用：A sustained passage through layered luminous planes that converge on a center, like the Star Gate. Do not fill the frame with unstructured particles and call it slit-scan.
- 近似对比：Time-Lapse, Kaleidoscope, Motion Blur, Time-LapseShow weather, construction, or a night becoming morning., KaleidoscopeOrnament, drugs, or chorus girls., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Time-Lapse samples a real scene at intervals. The world stays a world. Slit-scan rebuilds space from a slit. Kaleidoscope repeats a fragment with mirrors. That is spatial symmetry, not temporal smear. Motion Blur streaks moving objects inside a normal photograph. Slit-scan is the photograph of the slit. Time-LapseShow weather, construction, or a night becoming morning. KaleidoscopeOrnament, drugs, or chorus girls. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：2001: A Space Odyssey is the grammar: Douglas Trumbull's Star Gate, slit-scan corridors of light. Later films quote that structured tunnel.；They are not a license to generate fireworks.；2001: A Space Odyssey 1968The Star Gate passage.
- Prompt 模板：`A sustained voyage through abstract planes of luminous geometry. Long parallel light streaks converge toward a stable central vanishing point, evolving through layered spatial corridors. Procedural slit-scan character, controlled acceleration, no literal starfield, random sparks or kaleidoscope cuts.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Ask for ordered temporal geometry. Example: Slit-scan streaking around [Subject], time smeared along one axis, structured corridor of light with a stable vanishing point, Star Gate language, no random neon particles.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: kaleidoscope, starfield, or generic long-exposure sparks. Tell: chaotic particles, no slit axis, no vanishing point, or a mirrored flower. Fix: one smear axis, repeating planes, controlled convergence.

### Kaleidoscope
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/kaleidoscope)
- 定义：Kaleidoscope cinematography fragments the image with mirrors or radial repetition so one subject becomes a symmetric pattern. The camera looks into angled glass, or the staging itself is a kaleidoscope: bodies arranged around an axis, often from above.
- 叙事功能：A shard repeats. A face, a limb, a lamp becomes an ornament. Busby Berkeley built this with dancers and an overhead camera. A kaleidoscope adapter builds it with mirrors in front of the lens. Chorus girls, jewels, a subjective break: the picture is multiplication, not smear. Use it when pattern is the point: a musical number, a jewel-box interior, a decorative fracture of a face.
