It is the wrong tool for a stargate of streaks, for a simple birds-eye that does not repeat, or for a collage of torn edges. If there is no mirror logic and no radial repeat, it is just a busy frame.
- 怎么拍：Physical: kaleidoscope prism or three-mirror tube on the lens, or a mirrored set. Staging: radial choreography shot from Bird's-Eye View. Keep a clear axis of symmetry and repeating shards. Prompt: kaleidoscopic fragmentation, mirrored shards, radial repeat of [Subject], not slit-scan streaks.
- 何时用：A figure in a red dress multiplied into mirrored shards, jewel symmetry, like looking into a toy kaleidoscope. Do not stretch her along a vanishing-point tunnel and call it kaleidoscope.
- 近似对比：Slit-Scan, Repetition and Pattern, Bird's-Eye View, Repetition and PatternSystems, armies, hotels, factories., Bird's-Eye ViewTurn life into a board game or a ritual., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Slit-Scan smears time into a corridor. Kaleidoscope repeats space with mirrors. Repetition and Pattern is compositional repeat in a normal photograph (windows, soldiers). Kaleidoscope is optical or staged radial multiplication. Bird's-Eye View is the overhead angle Berkeley used. Without mirroring or radial design it is only a top view. Repetition and PatternSystems, armies, hotels, factories. Bird's-Eye ViewTurn life into a board game or a ritual. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Busby Berkeley numbers (42nd Street, Gold Diggers of 1933) turn chorus girls into kaleidoscopic geometry from above. 2001: A Space Odyssey also uses radial, jewel-like fragmentation in passages of the Star Gate, which is a cousin of the mirror, not the slit alone.
- Prompt 模板：`Demand mirrors or radial shards. Example: Kaleidoscopic fragmentation of [Subject], mirrored shards, radial symmetry, Busby Berkeley from inside a jewel, not a slit-scan tunnel.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Kaleidoscopic fragmentation of [Subject], mirrored shards, Busby Berkeley from inside a jewel.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: slit-scan, birds-eye without repeat, or collage. Tell: streaks to a vanishing point, a plain overhead, or torn paper layers. Fix: clear mirror axes, repeating fragments of the same subject, jewel symmetry.

### Light Flash
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/light-flash)
- 定义：A light flash transition is a brief blowout of the frame to white or near-white, then a return, as if a bulb, explosion, or memory dump hit the emulsion. It is a temporal event, often a cut hidden in the peak, not a standing lens flare.
- 叙事功能：The picture goes. For a few frames there is only density failure: a bulb, a muzzle, a Polaroid, a trauma. Then the next image, or the same room, settles back. The flash is both a wound and a splice. Use it when the cut should hurt: memory stings, explosions, still cameras in a crowd, a mind skipping. The white is the edit. It is the wrong tool for a sun ghost that stays in shot, or for a smash cut that is only a hard join of two dark images. If the flare hangs and tracks a lamp, that is flare. If you simply jump scenes with no blowout, that is a smash cut.
- 怎么拍：Overexpose a practical, a strobe, or a muzzle until clipping, or animate a white frame at the cut. Recovery can carry a lingering veil. In camera, a still photographer's flash or a door onto daylight can do it live. Prompt: frame going to white then returning, bulb or explosion or memory sting, not a persistent source-linked flare.
- 何时用：A hard flash blows out a face, then settles into the next memory, as in a sting cut. Do not leave a decorative streak parked on the lens after the white is gone.
- 近似对比：Smash Cut, Lens Flare, Fade In / Fade Out, Iris, Smash CutThe next image should hurt., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite., Anamorphic FlareNight lights and headlights should write on the lens.
  Smash Cut is an abrupt edit without a required white-out. A light flash is the white that can carry that cut. Lens Flare is scatter that remains while a source is in the optic. Fade In / Fade Out goes slowly to black or white as a chapter mark. A flash is fast. Iris closes a circle. It does not blow the whole field. Smash CutThe next image should hurt. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite. Anamorphic FlareNight lights and headlights should write on the lens.
- 片中实例：Memento uses white flashes as memory dumps between Polaroids and the present. Saving Private Ryan lets muzzle flashes and overload wipe the frame as combat sting.；Raging Bull's camera flashes in the ring are the still-photographer version of the same blowout.
- Prompt 模板：`Make it an event with a recovery. Still: Blinding light flash over [Subject], a bulb, explosion, or memory cut, the frame going to white then returning.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: A hard light flash blows out [Subject] then settles back, as a memory or explosion sting.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: persistent lens flare or a smash cut with no exposure event. Tell: a rainbow streak that never whites the frame, or a hard cut in full detail. Fix: clip to white (or near-white) for frames, then recover. Hide the splice in the peak if it is a transition.

### Projections
- 别名：Reflective-screen projection ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/projection-mapping)
- 定义：Projections in projection mapping film put a pictured image onto a surface that the taking camera then photographs: front projection onto a retroreflective screen, rear projection behind a window or windshield, or video mapped onto architecture. The projector is a light source, and the set is also a screen.
- 叙事功能：Actors stand on a rocky foreground. Behind them a desert plate is thrown, coaxial with the lens, onto Scotchlite. Or a car process shot: performers in a cockpit, a plate on a screen beyond the glass. Or a city that wears moving faces. Media is the set. Use it when a large environment must coexist with live foreground, or when architecture itself is the display. Front projection and rear projection are in-camera composites. Mapping is the same family with a three-dimensional screen. It is the wrong tool when you mean a double exposure (two records in the emulsion, no projector) or a digital backdrop that never hits a surface. A generated image can imitate the look. It cannot prove a projector was used.
- 怎么拍：Front projection: camera and projector aligned through a beam splitter, retroreflective screen, foreground lit so it does not wash the plate. Rear projection: a translucent screen behind the action, plate brightness matched to the foreground key. Mapping: projectors registered to architecture, then recaptured. Prompt: projected imagery on walls or a screen behind [Subject], shared viewpoint, foreground lit to match, not a ghost overlay.
- 何时用：A rocky foreground merging into a still desert panorama, performers lit to the horizon plate, locked wide. Do not drift the mountain independently of the camera, and do not stack a translucent face over the room unless you mean double exposure.
- 近似对比：Double Exposure, Practical Lighting, Double ExposureTwo times or two selves occupy one frame., Practical LightingLet the set light the face., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Double Exposure combines two photographic records without a projector writing on a set. Practical Lighting is lamps in the scene. A projector can be a practical, but projection is imagery, not just illumination. Rear-projection driving in Hitchcock is the same family as 2001's Dawn of Man front projection: a plate on a surface, recaptured. Double ExposureTwo times or two selves occupy one frame. Practical LightingLet the set light the face. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：2001: A Space Odyssey uses front projection for Dawn of Man landscapes. To Catch a Thief and Vertigo use process projection for driving conversations.；Blade Runner 2049 and Ghost in the Shell treat building-scale imagery as architecture.；2001: A Space Odyssey 1968Dawn of Man environments combine foreground staging with projected landscape imagery.；To Catch a Thief 1955Driving conversations combine foreground performers with moving scenery.；Vertigo 1958Driving scenes use a controlled foreground against photographed surroundings.
- Prompt 模板：`A small practical-looking rocky foreground merges into an immense still desert panorama. Locked wide camera, performers lit to match the horizon photograph, subtle boundary between physical foreground and distant projected landscape. No drifting mountain geometry or independently moving horizon.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Put the image on a surface. Example: Projected imagery crawling over [Subject] and architecture, a plate on a screen or faces on walls, foreground lit to match the projection, in-camera process not a double-exposure ghost.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: double exposure, or a floating hologram with no surface. Tell: a translucent overlay that ignores walls, mismatched vanishing points, or a background that parallax-slides against the foreground. Fix: shared viewpoint, projection on a named surface, matched key, restrained plate motion.

### Morph
- 别名：Morphing / Dissolve Effect ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/match-morph)
- 定义：A morphing effect transforms one image, face, shape, or object into another by interpolating corresponding geometry over time. It is a continuous becoming, not a crossfade of opacities and not two exposures stacked.
- 叙事功能：A face does not cut to another face. Vertices travel. The nose, the jaw, the silhouette pass through illegal in-between states. Identity is unstable for a measured number of seconds, then a new form is solid. Use it when the story is transformation: a liquid metal man, a mask that is anatomy, a person becoming another person. The audience should watch the change, not infer it across a dissolve. It is the wrong tool when two images should merely trade dominance (dissolve), coexist (double exposure), or rhyme across a cut (match cut). If you still see both complete faces as ghosts, you dissolved. If the cut is hard and only the outline matches, you graphic-matched.
- 怎么拍：Establish correspondence: eyes to eyes, contour to contour. Interpolate, often with a cross-dissolve of textures on top of the warp. Duration is part of the grammar (a six-second become is a sentence). Prompt: [Subject] morphs into a named second form over N seconds, continuous transformation, not a dissolve, not a cut.
- 何时用：A face becomes another face over about six seconds, features traveling, one identity at the end. Do not crossfade two full portraits and call it a morph.
- 近似对比：Dissolve, Double Exposure, Match Cut, Duplication, DissolveMemory, passage, or a gentle death of a scene., Double ExposureTwo times or two selves occupy one frame., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Dissolve changes opacity from shot A to shot B. Forms do not have to correspond. Double Exposure holds both images. Match Cut joins two shots at a similar shape without interpolating the in-between. Duplication places two solid versions of one person in a space. Morph turns one into the other. DissolveMemory, passage, or a gentle death of a scene. Double ExposureTwo times or two selves occupy one frame. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Terminator 2 interpolates the T-1000 through chrome and human geometry. The Mask treats anatomy as a morph target.；Willow (1988) and Michael Jackson's Black or White are early digital morph grammar: correspondence plus time.
- Prompt 模板：`Name both states and the duration. Still: Morph between [Subject] and another named state, face or body becoming, in-between geometry visible.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: [Subject] morphs into another form or face over 6 seconds, a continuous transformation, not a dissolve.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: dissolve, double exposure, or match cut. Tell: two ghosts, a hard cut on similar shapes, or a texture fade with no warp. Fix: require corresponding features to travel, show illegal in-betweens, land on one solid form.

### Altered State
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/altered-state)
- 定义：Altered state cinematography makes the mind the location: smear, afterimage, wrong color, unstable time, optics and cutting that no sober observer would report. It is a bundle of techniques motivated by consciousness, not a single filter name.
- 叙事功能：Edges trail. Hue unhooks from the room. A face leaves a stain. Focus and speed refuse to sit still. The set may be an apartment. The picture is a nervous system. Use it when perception is the plot: drugs, vertigo, dying, revelation. Pick a few physical tells and repeat them so the state has rules. A smear plus a color unhook is a language. Everything at once is noise. It is the wrong tool for a single clean optic (one fisheye, one flare) that the character would still recognize as the room. If the codec collapses, that is datamosh. If two times overlay as density, that is double exposure. Altered state may borrow those, but it has to be motivated as seeing.
- 怎么拍：Combine a short list: long shutter smear, step-printed time, wrong white balance, afterimages, a diopter or a distorting optic, occasional overlay. Keep the body of the subject readable enough to stay in the scene. Prompt: perception bent, edges trailing, color unhooked from the room, as if consciousness is slipping, not a random glitch pack.
- 何时用：A close interior where the frame warps as a character slips, trailing edges, hue wrong, time sticky. Do not apply it to a wide establishing shot that still has to map the street.
- 近似对比：Dreamcore, Datamosh, Double Exposure, Distortions, DreamcoreNostalgia with the safety removed., DatamoshBreak the file on purpose., Double ExposureTwo times or two selves occupy one frame.
  Dreamcore is a genre look of liminal rooms and childhood lighting gone wrong. Altered state is the perceptual event, often in an ordinary set. Datamosh is codec collapse. Double Exposure is a stacked record. Distortions are geometric lies in the glass. Altered state may include distortion, plus time and color that will not sit. DreamcoreNostalgia with the safety removed. DatamoshBreak the file on purpose. Double ExposureTwo times or two selves occupy one frame.
- 片中实例：Enter the Void binds camera, smear, and color to a consciousness that will not stay in a body. Requiem for a Dream uses speed, close optics, and cutting as intoxication and crash.；Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas is the wide-angle, wrong-color cousin.
- Prompt 模板：`List the perceptual tells. Still: Altered-state image of [Subject], smear, afterimage, wrong color, time that will not sit still.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: The frame around [Subject] warps as if consciousness is slipping, edges trailing, color unhooked from the room.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: a single fisheye, a datamosh, or a dreamcore bedroom with no perceptual event. Tell: a clean room with one sticker effect, or total illegibility. Fix: motivate two or three repeating tells, keep the subject locatable, let the room remain a room that is failing.

### Anthropo
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/anthropo)
- 定义：Anthropomorphic cinematography stages an object or animal as a performer: human scale in the frame, a gesture, an eyeline, reaction shots, as if the inanimate had a will. The camera does not need a face so much as an actor's grammar.
- 叙事功能：A red balloon waits, follows, sulks. A robot tilts its head at a trash cube. The object is not a prop in a still life. It is covered like a person: singles, looks, pauses. Will is implied by blocking and eyeline, not by a drawn smile unless the story needs one. Use it to give a thing agency: a balloon, a machine, a relic, an animal shot as a colleague. The rest of the scene should treat it as a presence. It is the wrong tool when you simply shoot an object from its own optical position (that is object POV) or when a tableau arranges bodies as a picture. Anthropo is performance coverage of a nonhuman. Object POV is a camera mount.
- 怎么拍：Assign an eyeline height. Cover the object with the same sizes you would give an actor: wide for entrance, medium for dialogue, close for reaction. Let humans look at it as a partner. Puppet, wire, or animation can supply gesture. Prompt: an object or animal given human scale, gesture, or eyeline, the inanimate performing, not a POV from inside the object.
- 何时用：A balloon at head height, held in a single, a child looking to it as if it might answer. Do not bolt the camera to the balloon and call that anthropo. That is object POV.
- 近似对比：Object POV, Tableau, Macro, Object POVThe prop has eyes., TableauHold the arrangement., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Object POV puts the camera in the object's position. Anthropo looks at the object as an actor. Tableau freezes people into a composed picture. Anthropo keeps a will in motion. Macro can isolate an object as texture without giving it an eyeline. Object POVThe prop has eyes. TableauHold the arrangement. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：The Red Balloon covers a balloon as a companion, with waits and follows that belong to a performer. WALL-E plays a machine with human gesture and eyeline without needing a human face.；Those are coverage choices, not mascots to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Cover the thing like a person. Example: Anthropomorphic frame of [Subject], an object or animal given human scale, gesture, or eyeline, singles and looks as if it had a will, not a camera inside the object.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Anthropomorphic frame of [Subject], an object or animal given human scale, gesture, or eyeline, the inanimate performing.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: object POV, a cute sticker face, or a still-life insert. Tell: the camera is mounted in the object, or the object sits as a prop with no eyeline. Fix: assign a look, a height, and reaction coverage. Let others treat it as a partner.

### Cinemagraph
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/cinemagraph)
- 定义：A cinemagraph is a still photograph in which one isolated element continues to move on a loop (steam, rain on glass, hair, a blink) while the rest of the frame is frozen. It is not a freeze-frame of a whole shot, and it is not a full clip that happens to loop.
- 叙事功能：The picture looks dead, then a kettle breathes. A coat is still. Only the rain tracks the window. Time is allowed in one masked region. The rest is a still. Use it when a photograph should refuse to fully stop: fashion, a poster that lives, a memory with one leak of motion. The moving part must be plausible as a cycle. It is the wrong tool when the whole scene moves, or when all motion stops (freeze-frame). If every element loops, that is an infinite loop of a shot, not a cinemagraph. If the loop is a boomerang of the entire take, that is a different toy.
- 怎么拍：Shoot a locked camera. Choose one motion that can cycle (steam, rain, flicker). Mask that region in post, freeze the rest from a single frame, loop the live patch so the join is invisible. Prompt: almost a still, only one named element loops, locked camera, no other motion.
- 何时用：A woman at a rain window, body frozen, only the rain and a thread of steam looping. Do not let her blink, the curtains blow, and the neon flicker all at once.
- 近似对比：Freeze Frame, Infinite Loop, Boomerang, Time-Lapse, Infinite LoopDuration without progress., Freeze FrameEnd, joke, or evidence., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Freeze Frame stops everything. Infinite Loop repeats the entire shot. Boomerang plays a whole action forward and back. A cinemagraph freezes the majority and loops a patch. Time-Lapse advances the whole world in steps. Infinite LoopDuration without progress. Freeze FrameEnd, joke, or evidence. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：The form comes from fashion stills (Jamie Beck and Kevin Burg) and advertising, not from a single feature grammar. Fashion films and window displays are the well-known uses: one living detail in a still.；La Jetee is a cousin of stills and motion, not a cinemagraph loop.
- Prompt 模板：`Freeze the frame, license one cycle. Still: Cinemagraph of [Subject], almost a still, one isolated motion looping: steam, hair, a blink, rain in a window.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: Almost still on [Subject], only one named element loops, locked camera, seamless cycle.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: freeze-frame, full-shot loop, or a normal live take. Tell: several motions alive, a visible loop bump, or a frozen frame with no live patch. Fix: one masked element, invisible join, everything else from a single still.

### Collage
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/collage)
- 定义：Collage cinematography builds a frame from torn, cut, or mixed pieces: different stocks, paper, print, and live action sharing one plane with visible joins. Edges are graphic, and the stack is a construction, not an optical blend.
- 叙事功能：A head from one still, a building from another, newsprint, a painted sky. You can see the scissors. Mixed grain, mixed contrast, maybe a bit of tape. One image was not enough, so the frame was assembled. Use it when sources should remain sources: titles, satire, memory as scrapbook, a graphic sequence that refuses photographic unity. It is the wrong tool when two photographs should fuse as density (double exposure) or when live action and animation share a photographed space without torn edges. Mixed media can do either. Collage insists on the cut.
- 怎么拍：Shoot or collect plates. Cut them. Leave borders, torn fiber, misregistered printing, different grain structures. Composite with hard or torn masks, not a screen blend. Prompt: torn layers, mixed stocks, cut paper and live action sharing one plane, visible joins, not a smooth double exposure.
- 何时用：A portrait built from a live face, a city fragment, and newsprint, joins visible. Do not dissolve the same elements into a ghosted overlay and call it collage.
- 近似对比：Double Exposure, Mixed Media, Split Screen, Mixed MediaNo single medium owns the truth., Double ExposureTwo times or two selves occupy one frame., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Double Exposure is an optical or additive stack without scissors. Mixed Media is the broader family (animation plus live, print plus plate). Collage is the cut-and-paste grammar inside that family. Split Screen divides the frame into simultaneous pictures with a designed border, usually live. Collage can ignore a shared timebase. Mixed MediaNo single medium owns the truth. Double ExposureTwo times or two selves occupy one frame. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Terry Gilliam's Monty Python work is cut-out collage in motion. The Jinx titles treat documents and images as a stacked graphic plane.；Bruce Conner's A Movie is found-footage collage as a film, which is grammar for the cut, not a look to clone.
- Prompt 模板：`Show the joins. Example: Collage frame of [Subject], torn layers, mixed stocks, cut paper and live action sharing one plane, visible edges, not a smooth optical overlay.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Collage frame of [Subject], torn layers, mixed stocks, cut paper and live action sharing one plane.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: double exposure or a clean split-screen. Tell: translucent blend, matching grain across pieces, or a hard live divider without paper or tear. Fix: mismatched stocks, torn or cut borders, graphic stacking.

### Datamosh
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/datamosh)
- 定义：Datamosh is intentional codec failure: inter-frame prediction continues after keyframes are removed or broken, so motion vectors smear the previous picture into the next GOP and faces bleed into the following shot. The image is file wreckage, not a lens error.
- 叙事功能：The I-frame never arrives. P-frames keep describing motion that no longer has a valid picture. A mouth stretches into a wall. A cut happens in time but not in pixels. Digital ruin is the style. Use it when the file should break on purpose: a music video, a corrupted memory, a broadcast that fails. The smear should follow motion vectors, not a random RGB offset. It is the wrong tool for a stutter of whole frames (that is stop-stutter), for chromatic fringing, or for an altered-state smear from a long shutter. If the image trails because the shutter was open, that is photography. If it trails because the codec predicted the wrong future, that is datamosh.
- 怎么拍：Encode with inter-frame compression, drop or repeat I-frames, let P-frames or B-frames run. The artifact is temporal and blocky, often with residual macroblocks. Prompt: inter-frame collapse, faces smearing into the next GOP, codec wreckage, not RGB split, not film smear.
- 何时用：A cut from a face to a city in which the face's pixels are dragged across the skyline by leftover motion vectors. Do not step-print the same clip or add red-cyan edge fringe and call it datamosh.
- 近似对比：Stutter / Stop-Stutter, Altered State, Chromatic Aberration, Stutter / Stop-StutterThe mind skips., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite., Anamorphic FlareNight lights and headlights should write on the lens.
  Stutter / Stop-Stutter repeats or steps whole frames as a temporal rhythm. Datamosh destroys the picture between frames. Altered State is perceptual and photographic. Chromatic Aberration is optical color fringing. Datamosh is codec wreckage, not a general noise overlay. Stutter / Stop-StutterThe mind skips. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite. Anamorphic FlareNight lights and headlights should write on the lens.
- 片中实例：Chairlift's Evident Utensil is a well-known datamosh music video: GOP collapse as the picture. Other music videos adopted the same inter-frame smear.；Features rarely hold it long because it destroys coverage.
- Prompt 模板：`Break prediction, not the lens. Still: Datamosh of [Subject], inter-frame collapse, faces smearing into the next GOP, digital ruin as style.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video: Datamosh corruption around [Subject], frames bleeding into the next, codec wreckage as image, not a shutter smear.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: stutter, long-shutter smear, or RGB split. Tell: clean frame repeats, photochemical motion blur, or three colored copies of the subject. Fix: blocky temporal bleed across a cut, leftover pixels from the previous picture, no new I-frame.

### Diorama
- 别名：Scale-model effects, Model photography ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/diorama)
- 定义：Diorama cinematography photographs a physical scale model so that it stands in for a much larger object or environment, with real light hitting real miniature surfaces. Scale is sold by texture, camera speed, depth of field, and movement, not by a toy-like tilt of focus.
- 叙事功能：A city, a ship, a hotel wing sits on a table or a stage, built at an inch to the foot or another ratio. The camera treats it as full size: enough stop for deep focus, a slow pass, fine windows, hard distant key. Water, fire, and smoke are the hard parts, because fluids do not scale. Use it when a world should be tactile and built: a spacecraft, an industrial skyline, a storybook hotel. The pleasure is that light is true on small surfaces. It is the wrong tool when you point a tilt-shift lens at a real city to make it look like a model, or when you align two live actors at different distances to lie about size. Those are cousins. If depth of field is a thin band, the miniature will look like a miniature.
- 怎么拍：Build surface scale (panel lines, dirt, tiny lights). Light with a hard, distant key as if the sun were far. Stop down. Move slowly. For water and fire, high-speed capture can help scale. Prompt: miniature world photographed as full size, deep enough focus, tactile model surfaces, not tilt-shift toy blur.
- 何时用：An orbital freighter as a detailed model, slow camera pass, tiny windows, deep focus against a black field. Do not add a thin horizontal band of focus that announces tabletop scale.
- 近似对比：Tilt-Shift, Forced Perspective, Macro, Tilt-ShiftMake a city a model, or slice focus through a crowd., Forced PerspectiveChange size without VFX., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Tilt-Shift tilts the plane of focus to make a real landscape look like a toy. Diorama is an actual model, usually shot deep to hide scale. Forced Perspective uses live people and scaled set pieces from one viewpoint. Macro is close focus on small things as small things. Diorama wants the small thing to read as large. Tilt-ShiftMake a city a model, or slice focus through a crowd. Forced PerspectiveChange size without VFX. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Blade Runner uses industrial miniatures for city and architecture. 2001: A Space Odyssey photographs spacecraft and stations as models.；The Grand Budapest Hotel uses storybook miniatures as a designed world. Those are model stages, not tilt-shift streets.；Blade Runner 1982The industrial cityscape and large architectural exteriors.；2001: A Space Odyssey 1968Spacecraft and space-station imagery.
- Prompt 模板：`Photograph a practical-looking miniature orbital freighter as if it were enormous. Slow precise camera pass, deep enough focus for convincing scale, hard distant key light, tiny windows and layered surface detail. No shallow tabletop focus or fast toy-like acceleration.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Photograph a model as a world. Example: Diorama view of [Subject], physical miniature, tactile surfaces, deep enough focus for full-size scale, slow camera, not tilt-shift toy blur.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: tilt-shift, or a digital city with shallow tabletop focus. Tell: a thin focus band, fast toy-like motion, coarse textures, fluids that look like pouring on a desk. Fix: finer detail, deeper stop, slower move, scale-aware effects.

### Distortions
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/distortions)
- 定义：Lens distortion cinematography warps space so straight lines bow, stretch, or melt: barrel, pincushion, mustache, extreme wide stretch, or a physical distorting optic such as a diopter, a bottle, or rain on glass. The lens is lying about geometry, not adding flare.
- 叙事功能：Walls lean. Faces balloon as they near the glass. A hallway breathes. Space is not trustworthy. The cause can be a very wide spherical, a fisheye, anamorphic mumps, heat shimmer, or a shot through a glass of water. Use it when the location should feel unsafe or subjective: a droogs' wide, a binge, a peephole, a fever. Pick a distortion family and keep it consistent with the glass. It is the wrong tool for a clean normal-lens master, for flare without warp, or for a kaleidoscope of mirrors. If color fringes without bent lines, that is chromatic aberration. If the whole mind is unhooked, consider altered state, of which distortion may be one part.
- 怎么拍：Choose the glass: 14 mm or fisheye for barrel, long glass for pincushion, anamorphic for mumps and wave, a close diopter for melt at the edge. Get too close to faces on a wide and perspective distortion adds to optical distortion. Prompt: optical distortion around [Subject], stretched edges, melted geometry, named wide or fisheye, not a flare overlay.
- 何时用：A close wide on a face in a tense interior, edges stretching, the room bowing, space untrustworthy. Do not keep a 50 mm rectilinear room and paste melted corners as a sticker.
- 近似对比：Fisheye, Lens Flare, Chromatic Aberration, 14mm Ultra-Wide, Altered State, FisheyeThe mind is warped, or the space is a dome., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite., Anamorphic FlareNight lights and headlights should write on the lens.
  Fisheye is the extreme barrel member of this family, with a circular or strongly bowed field. Lens Flare is scatter, not geometry. Chromatic Aberration fringes color on edges. 14mm Ultra-Wide distorts through field of view and proximity even when the designer corrects barrel. Altered State may include distortion plus time and color. FisheyeThe mind is warped, or the space is a dome. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite. Anamorphic FlareNight lights and headlights should write on the lens.
- 片中实例：A Clockwork Orange uses extreme wides so rooms and faces are geometrically hostile. Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas melts space as intoxication.；Those are glass and proximity, not a warp filter parked on a normal lens.
- Prompt 模板：`Bend the space with glass. Example: Optical distortion around [Subject], stretched edges, barrel or melted geometry from ultra-wide or fisheye glass close to the face, the lens lying about space, not a flare pack.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Optical distortion around [Subject], stretched edges, melted geometry, the lens lying about space.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: lens flare, fisheye circular crop without the scene, or altered-state color smear with straight walls. Tell: rainbow streaks, a round porthole sticker, or a clean rectilinear room with a melted overlay. Fix: choose a lens family, bow lines, let near faces balloon, keep the warp attached to the optic.

### Duplication
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/duplication)
- 定义：A duplicate subject effect puts the same performer in a frame more than once as solid bodies: twins, a self across a table, copies in one room. It is usually a split matte, motion control, or a locked-camera composite, not a translucent double exposure.
- 叙事功能：One person is not a single self. Two performances share a kitchen. They argue, pass a look, fail to occupy the same chair. Contact shadows, eyelines, and any exchanged object are the hard problems. Two similar-looking people are not automatically this effect. Use it when identity splits in space: twins, a writer and his brother, a man meeting himself. The encounter should feel physically ordinary. It is the wrong tool when the second self is a ghost (double exposure), when the frame is simply divided (split-screen as the visible device), or when one body melts into another (morph). If they cannot sit in depth and occlude, you have the wrong cousin.
- 怎么拍：Lock the camera or repeat the move with motion control. Record a clean plate. Shoot each performance with matched light. Use a split matte where bodies stay apart, or tracked masks where they overlap. Plan contact and handed objects as separate shots or as later help. Prompt: the same figure twice in one frame, solid bodies, matched lighting, not a ghost overlay, not a visible split line unless you want split-screen.
- 何时用：Two versions of one woman across a kitchen table, distinct posture and clothing, shared shadows, locked camera. Do not stack them as translucent densities, and do not leave a vertical join down the table.
- 近似对比：Double Exposure, Split Screen, Morph, Double ExposureTwo times or two selves occupy one frame., Split ScreenTwo rooms, one moment., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Double Exposure is additive overlay. Ghosts, not two sitters. Split Screen shows two pictures with a designed border, which can be how duplication is done if the join is visible. Seamless duplication hides the join. Morph turns one form into another over time. Duplication keeps both. Double ExposureTwo times or two selves occupy one frame. Split ScreenTwo rooms, one moment. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：The Parent Trap seats one performer as both twins in shared compositions. Adaptation puts Charlie and Donald in the same scenes.；Enemy multiplies a man as encounter. The Social Network uses similar motion-control doubling for the Winklevoss pair.
- Prompt 模板：`Two solid performances, one space. Example: Duplication of [Subject], the same figure twice in one frame, twins of identity, solid bodies with matched light and contact shadows, not a double-exposure ghost, not a visible split-screen line.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Duplication of [Subject], the same figure twice or more in one frame, twins of time or identity.`
- 常见错误：Wrong cousin: double exposure, split-screen with a hard line, or two lookalikes who are not the same face. Tell: translucent stack, a seam down the set, mismatched grain or key, hovering hands. Fix: locked or motion-controlled plates, identical identity, shared shadows, planned occlusion.

### Echo Print
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/echo-print)
- 定义：An echo print is an echo print effect that leaves a ghosted afterimage offset in time or register, so the last pose is still printed on this frame. The ghost is a stain of a previous exposure, not a second complete picture sharing the same plane.
- 叙事功能：Use it when a gesture has already happened and the present cannot shake it. A head turns and the old profile hangs a few pixels away. A step leaves a faint body where the foot was. Time reads as a registration error. It is the wrong tool for a clean double of two living people in conversation. If both images are fully exposed and equally sharp, you shot a superimposition, not a stain.
- 怎么拍：Keep the camera locked or on a short path. Copy the previous frame, offset it along the motion vector by a few pixels or a few milliseconds, and print it at lower opacity. Optical printers did this with a slight mis-register. Video echo does it with delay. One key still lights the live body. The ghost has no second key. Prompt an afterimage offset in time or register, and say that the last frame is still printed on this one.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat after a look, a blow, or a departure, when the last pose should remain as a stain. Do not use it to introduce a twin who must occupy the room as a solid person.
- 近似对比：Double Exposure, Step Printing, Double ExposureTwo times or two selves occupy one frame., Step PrintingLonging that cannot move at normal speed., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Double Exposure combines two complete pictures. An echo print is a faded offset of the same action. Step Printing repeats discrete frames to slow or stutter a take. The echo is a smear of register, not a held frame. Double ExposureTwo times or two selves occupy one frame. Step PrintingLonging that cannot move at normal speed. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Experimental optical printing and title-design ghosts are the grammar: a credit or a figure that leaves a trail of itself. Video-echo music videos do the same with delay.；These are uses of the stain, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Write the still as a photochemical hold, then name the ghost. Quote: Echo print of [Subject], a ghosted afterimage offset in time or register, the last frame still printed on this one.`
- 示例 Prompt：`For video: Afterimages of [Subject] trail the present, an echo print of the previous moment. Name the offset direction.`
- Prompt 要点：Ban a second full scene.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Double Exposure. The tell is two equally solid bodies, both keyed, both sharp. The fix is one live subject and a fainter, offset copy of the same pose, no second lamp.

### Feedback
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/feedback)
- 定义：Video feedback is made by pointing a camera at its own live output so the picture nests into a recursive corridor of the same face. Each generation is a rephotograph of the monitor, with bloom, lag, and a tunnel of shrinking frames.
- 叙事功能：The medium stares at itself. A face on a tube is recaptured, recaptured again, and the room becomes a hallway of the same look. Use it when the story is about watching, broadcast, or a mind that cannot get out of the signal. It is the wrong tool for a simple loop of action. If the last frame merely sews to the first, you have a cycle in time, not a camera eating its monitor.
- 怎么拍：Aim the taking lens at a playback screen that shows the live feed. A slight off-axis angle builds a corridor. Dead-on nesting builds rectangles inside rectangles. Gain, lag, and the phosphor or pixel bloom set how fast the tunnel eats itself. The subject is usually close to the screen so the first generation is readable. Prompt video feedback around the subject: camera looking into its own output, infinite corridor of the same face.
- 何时用：Use it when a person is trapped in a transmission, a title, or a night of monitors. Do not use it as wallpaper behind a dialogue scene that still needs geography.
- 近似对比：Kaleidoscope, Infinite Loop, KaleidoscopeOrnament, drugs, or chorus girls., Infinite LoopDuration without progress., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Kaleidoscope mirrors facets of one image into symmetry. Feedback nests generations of the same capture. Infinite Loop sews the last frame to the first in time. Feedback is optical recursion, not a cycle of action. KaleidoscopeOrnament, drugs, or chorus girls. Infinite LoopDuration without progress. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：1960s tape experiments pointed cameras at monitors until the image tunnelled. The Doctor Who howlaround titles are the famous broadcast version.；Music videos still use the same recursive corridor. Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Video feedback around [Subject], camera looking into its own output, infinite corridor of the same face. For video: Recursive video feedback of [Subject], the image eating itself into a tunnel.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Recursive video feedback of [Subject], the image eating itself into a tunnel.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Kaleidoscope or a simple video loop. The tell is mirrored wedges or a repeating walk with no nested screen. The fix is a camera aimed at its own output, generations shrinking down a tunnel.

### Floating UI
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/floating-ui)
- 定义：Floating UI, or HUD overlay cinematography, places readable interface, callouts, and data planes in the air of the scene so information lives in space, not only on a physical screen. The cockpit is the room.
- 叙事功能：A hand reaches into a diagram. Callouts hang beside a face. The camera can dolly and the panels should parallax against the walls. Use it when the character is working with data as if it were furniture. It is the wrong tool when type is glued to the frame like a broadcast bug. If the graphics do not occupy 3D space, you made a lower-third, not a HUD in the air.
- 怎么拍：Photograph the subject with a real key in the room. Composite interface planes with their own vanishing points, a few centimeters to a few meters in front of the face. If the camera moves, the panels must parallax. Type stays sharp enough to read. A faint self-illumination on the planes is allowed. It should not replace the key on the skin. Prompt floating UI over the subject: HUD, callouts, and interface planes in 3D space, the screen as a cockpit.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat when a pilot, surgeon, or detective is reading the air. Do not use it as decorative chrome on a portrait that has no data to parse.
- 近似对比：Projections, Video Game, Video GameThe world is playable., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite., Anamorphic FlareNight lights and headlights should write on the lens.
  Projections throw pictures onto walls and bodies. Floating UI hangs panels in space. Video Game borrows playable camera grammar and HUD as game UI. Floating UI can live in live-action space without becoming a navigable engine. Video GameThe world is playable. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite. Anamorphic FlareNight lights and headlights should write on the lens.
- 片中实例：Minority Report treats data as planes a body can shove. Iron Man puts callouts in the helmet's air.；Both are grammar for readable interface in 3D, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Floating UI over [Subject], HUD, callouts, and interface planes in 3D space, the screen as a cockpit. Name what the panels say in plain language, keep type sharp, and say the planes parallax if the camera moves.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Floating UI over [Subject], HUD, callouts, and interface planes in 3D space, the screen as a cockpit.`
- Prompt 要点：Ban unreadable scribble.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a 2D overlay or projections on a wall. The tell is type stuck to the frame edge, or light crawling on brick with no hanging planes. The fix is interface with depth and parallax, still keyed like a room.

### Focal Shift
- 别名：focus pull, slow rack, snap rack, multiple rack ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/focal-shift)
- 定义：A focal shift moves the plane of sharpness from one subject or distance to another during the shot, so attention travels as a pull. The camera body can stay put, and only the focus mechanism walks the depth.
- 叙事功能：Someone in the foreground owns the frame, then the helix turns and a face in the room takes over. No cut. The blur itself is the sentence. Use it when who matters changes while geography stays. It is the wrong tool if both planes must stay readable at once, or if you only need a static shallow portrait. If nothing is sharp at either end, you did not shift focus. You lost it.
- 怎么拍：Mark two distances. Keep depth of field shallow enough that only one plane is crisp, often a 50mm to 85mm near T2. A follow-focus or remote motor walks the helical from A to B. The camera is usually locked or slow so the pull is the only event. Lens breathing may thicken the image slightly as glass moves. Prompt a focal shift: the plane of sharpness traveling from one fact to another. For video, pull from a foreground object onto the subject, or the reverse.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat when a glass, a gun, or a listener in the foreground yields to the person who must answer. Do not use it as decoration on a single face with no second plane.
- 近似对比：Rack Focus, Shallow Focus, Rack FocusChange who owns the shot without cutting., Shallow FocusNothing else is invited., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Rack Focus is the standard two-mark transfer, often about two seconds, composition held. Focal shift is the traveling plane as the event, including a slow rack, a snap rack, or several racks in a row. Shallow Focus is a state: one plane already sharp. A shift is the move between states. Rack FocusChange who owns the shot without cutting. Shallow FocusNothing else is invited. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：The Graduate organizes attention between Benjamin and the figures around him by selective focus. There Will Be Blood uses the same grammar in hard interiors: who is true in the room changes without a cut.；Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Focal shift on [Subject], the plane of sharpness traveling from one fact to another, attention as a pull. Video: Focus pulls from a foreground object onto [Subject], or the reverse.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Focus pulls from a foreground object onto [Subject], or the reverse.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a cut, or a morph of detail during the pull. The tell is both planes sharp, or the face warping as focus moves. The fix is two marked distances, shallow field, and a clean travel of the plane.

### Generative
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/generative)
- 定义：Generative visuals show process: forms grown by rule, particles, and iteration, so cinema is made by a system rather than only by a finished photograph. Making is visible.
- 叙事功能：A body, a city, or a cloud is not posed. It is grown. Cells, grains, or agents iterate until a figure appears. Use it when the point is how the image becomes, not only what it depicts. It is the wrong tool for a codec wound or a person turning into a beast. If the look is smashed motion vectors, you want datamosh. If a body becomes another body in continuous view, you want a transformation.
- 怎么拍：Treat the forming matter as something you can light. Name the rule (particles, iteration, grown geometry), the scale of the bits, and a hard or soft source that rakes them. The camera can be locked so the growth is the move. Keep a readable subject so the system has an object. Prompt a generative image of the subject: forms grown by rule, particles, and iteration, cinema made by a system.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat when a world or a face is still assembling. Do not use it as a style wash on a finished portrait that never needed a rule.
- 近似对比：Datamosh, Transformation, DatamoshBreak the file on purpose., TransformationThe change is the scene., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Datamosh is deliberate compression failure: I-frames gone, motion vectors smeared. Generative growth is a rule, not a wound in the file. Transformation changes a body or room in continuous view. Generative imagery shows the system that builds the picture. DatamoshBreak the file on purpose. TransformationThe change is the scene. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Koyaanisqatsi-adjacent process films let systems and time grow the image. Music-video generative sequences make iteration the event on screen.；Grammar for process, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Generative image of [Subject], forms grown by rule, particles, and iteration, cinema made by a system. Name the rule and the light on the bits.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Generative image of [Subject], forms grown by rule, particles, and iteration, cinema made by a system.`
- Prompt 要点：Keep the subject recognizable at the end of the growth.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousins are Datamosh and a generic melt. The tell is blocky codec smear, or a face liquefying with no rule. The fix is named iteration, countable bits, and a subject the system is growing toward.

### Levitation
- 别名：Wire work, Wire removal ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/levitation)
- 定义：A levitation shot holds a body or object in a quiet impossible hover, refusing ordinary gravity while support is hidden or removed. Hair and cloth still hang, and the gap under the feet is the proof.
- 叙事功能：Someone leaves the floor and stays. The room does not drop away. The camera often holds so we can read the air under the shoes. Use it when weight is optional and the performance should still look human: a takeoff, an apex, a landing. It is the wrong tool for a fall. If the body is going down, even slowly, you want a floating fall. If the camera itself is dropping, you want falling.
- 怎么拍：Support the performer on wires, a crane, or a hidden platform, then remove the rig in a clean plate. Keep a hard side-key so the gap under the feet is visible. Cloth and hair hang downward because gravity still acts on fabric. Specify launch, trajectory, apex, and landing rather than a vague request to fly. Prompt levitation of the subject: body or object refusing gravity, a quiet impossible hover, no visible support.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat when a person hangs in a room, on a rooftop, or over a street and the hover is the fact. Do not use it for a drop that must still feel like disaster.
- 近似对比：Falling, Bullet Time, Floating Fall, FallingGravity is the plot., Bullet TimeA moment is so important it becomes architecture., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Falling drops the camera or the body with real weight, ground rising. Bullet Time orbits a pose that is frozen in time. Levitation is a sustained hover with a living performance. Floating Fall still goes down. This does not. FallingGravity is the plot. Bullet TimeA moment is so important it becomes architecture. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon keeps human effort inside rooftop and bamboo flight. The Matrix suspends combat so a body can hang and strike.；Mary Poppins arrives by an impossible hold in the air. Grammar for hover, not frames to copy.；Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon 2000Rooftop movement and the bamboo-forest duel.；The Matrix 1999Suspended and extended movements during combat.
- Prompt 模板：`A fictional acrobat crosses between two low rooftops in one graceful extended leap. Clear push-off, smooth rising arc, brief suspension and weighted landing with knees absorbing impact. Loose fabric follows the body with delay. Fixed wide camera, consistent architecture, no teleportation or rubber limbs.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Levitation of [Subject], body or object refusing gravity, a quiet impossible hover. Video: [Subject] hangs in air, slow drift, no visible support.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a balloon hover or a fall shot in slow motion. The tell is missing takeoff and landing, rubber limbs, or cloth that floats as if underwater. The fix is a readable gap, downward hang of fabric, and a human push-off or settle.

### Masking
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/masking)
- 定义：Masking cinematography uses a matte, a viewfinder object, or a graphic window so looking is visible as a shape cutting the picture. We see through binoculars, a keyhole, or a hard-edged hole.
- 叙事功能：The audience is made to look as a character looks. A circle of night, a door slot, a camera's own frame-lines. The surround is black or graphic. The photograph lives only in the hole. It is the wrong tool when you merely want a tighter shot, or when the container itself should widen. If the outer bounds of the movie change ratio, that is a ratio switch. If a doorway is simply in the set, that is a frame within a frame.
- 怎么拍：Put a physical mask in front of the lens (binoculars, a cutout, an iris board) or add a hard matte in optical printing. The interior of the hole is the exposure. The surround stays opaque. Keep the subject composed for that shape, not for the full sensor. Light the interior as a real scene. The mask does not need its own key. Prompt a masked frame around the subject: a shape cutting the picture, binoculars, a keyhole, a graphic window.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat of spying, peeping, or a title that looks through an object. Do not use it as a fancy crop on a scene that is not about looking.
- 近似对比：Frame within Frame, Iris, Frame within FrameSomeone is watched, trapped, or pictured., IrisPoint with the mask itself., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Frame within Frame uses architecture already in the room: a window, a door, a mirror. Masking cuts the picture with a shape that is the act of looking. Iris opens or closes a circle as a transition. A masked binocular hole can sit for the whole shot. Frame within FrameSomeone is watched, trapped, or pictured. IrisPoint with the mask itself. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Kill Bill looks through coffin slots and tight graphic holes. The Grand Budapest Hotel boxes looking as a designed window.；Grammar for seeing-as-object, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Masked frame around [Subject], a shape cutting the picture, binoculars, a keyhole, a graphic window. Name the shape, keep the interior photographed, and keep the surround opaque.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Masked frame around [Subject], a shape cutting the picture, binoculars, a keyhole, a graphic window.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not stretch the image to fill the hole.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousins are a Wide Shot with a vignette, or a Ratio Switch. The tell is a soft dark edge, or the whole frame widening. The fix is a hard shape, a hole, and a scene composed for that hole.

### Mixed Media
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/mixed-media)
- 定义：Mixed media film combines live action with type, illustration, and stock in one plane so no single capture method owns the truth of the frame. Media collide rather than dissolve into one photograph.
- 叙事功能：A face is a photograph. The wall is a drawing. A headline sits on the glass. Use it when the story is already a pile of documents, broadcasts, and drawings, and the cut would lie by smoothing them. It is the wrong tool for a single elegant composite that should feel like one camera. If every layer is the same still torn into pieces, you are closer to collage. If the only extra layer is words as objects, you are closer to typography.
- 怎么拍：Shoot or generate a live-action plate with a real key. Add illustration, type, and stock as separate layers with visible edges: torn, keyed, or butted. Lighting does not have to match across media. The mismatch is evidence of different sources. Keep one subject readable so the collision has a center. Prompt mixed media around the subject: live action, type, illustration, and stock colliding in one plane.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat when news, memory, and the body cannot agree on one medium. Do not use it as a sticker pack on a scene that still wants photochemical unity.
- 近似对比：Collage, Typography, CollageOne image is not enough; stack them., TypographyThe sentence is in the shot., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Collage layers stills and textures into one picture. Mixed media insists on different capture modes in the same plane. Typography puts words in the world as objects. Mixed media can include type, but type is only one of the colliding sources. CollageOne image is not enough; stack them. TypographyThe sentence is in the shot. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Natural Born Killers collides broadcast, film, and graphic interruption. Everything Everywhere All at Once lets illustration, stock, and live action share a plane when the universe will not stay one medium.；Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Mixed media around [Subject], live action, type, illustration, and stock colliding in one plane. Name each medium.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Mixed media around [Subject], live action, type, illustration, and stock colliding in one plane.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a graded live-action still with a font on top, or a pure Collage of one photo. The tell is one texture, one grain, one key. The fix is at least two capture modes, edges showing, one readable subject.

### Morphing
- 别名：Geometric image transformation ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/morphing)
- 定义：Morphing cinematography transforms one shape or image continuously into another by interpolating geometry, rather than merely fading between pictures. Identity is a dissolve you can watch as contour.
- 叙事功能：A face becomes another face while the eyes stay aligned. A body interpolates toward a new contour. Use it when becoming should be visible as a correspondence of landmarks, not as a cut or a fade. It is the wrong tool when the person stays the same and the room should change, or when makeup and performance can do the work in stages. If only opacity changes, you shot a dissolve.
- 怎么拍：Lock pose, eyeline, and key on two endpoints. Set landmark matches (eyes to eyes, mouth to mouth, silhouette to silhouette). Separate foreground from background so the warp does not drag the room. Control which features change first. The midpoint should be an intentional in-between, not a melt. Prompt a morph of the subject into another state: continuous transformation, identity as a dissolve you can watch. For video, morph into another form over the shot.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat when one form must become another in a few seconds of continuous view. Do not use it as a fancy cut between two unrelated shots with no shared landmarks.
- 近似对比：Morph, Transformation, MorphIdentity is unstable., TransformationThe change is the scene., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Morph as an edit uses the warp as the join between two shots. Morphing here is the geometric interpolation itself. Transformation can be practical makeup, a set change, or a world swap around a stable body. Morphing is landmark geometry, not a new room. MorphIdentity is unstable. TransformationThe change is the scene. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Terminator 2 interpolates chrome and flesh as correspondence. Michael Jackson's Black or White walks faces through aligned landmarks.；Willow interpolates between creature forms. Grammar, not frames to copy.；Willow 1988Transformation passages visibly interpolate between forms.
- Prompt 模板：`Transform a close-up of a young fictional woman's face into her older self over four seconds. Keep eyes aligned, head pose, expression and light direction fixed. Age changes occur gradually and coherently. Use matched endpoint portraits and controlled landmark-based compositing, no identity swap or liquefying face.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Morph of [Subject] into another state, continuous transformation, identity as a dissolve you can watch. Video: [Subject] morphs into another form over the shot.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Dissolve. The tell is two images fading with no shared contour, or a liquefying face with no midpoint design. The fix is matched pose, matched light, and landmarks that travel.

### Object Portal
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/object-portal)
- 定义：An object portal effect treats a prop as a wormhole: a bag, a screen, or a doorway that should not lead there, opening onto another space. The thing is the cut.
- 叙事功能：A filing cabinet leads to a tunnel. A mirror becomes a corridor. A phone swallows a body. Use it when geography must jump through an object we already believe in as a prop. It is the wrong tool when the camera itself punches through a wall with no special object, or when a wall is only a screen of light. If matter is optional for the lens, that is a pass-through. If pictures crawl on architecture, that is a projection.
- 怎么拍：Photograph the prop as a real object with thickness, rim, and a key. Composite or project the far space inside its opening. Parallax the rim against the interior so the hole has depth. The room around the prop stays this world. Hands, edges, and contact shadows sell the aperture. Prompt an object portal through the subject: a thing opening onto another space, a bag, a screen, a doorway that should not lead there.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat when a character climbs into a prop and arrives somewhere the room cannot contain. Do not use it as a generic glow around a door that is just a door.
- 近似对比：Pass Through, Projections, Pass ThroughCut the building, not the film., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite., Anamorphic FlareNight lights and headlights should write on the lens.
  Pass Through travels the camera through architecture as if matter were optional. An object portal needs a prop as the aperture. Projections put pictures on surfaces. A portal opens onto another space inside the object. Pass ThroughCut the building, not the film. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite. Anamorphic FlareNight lights and headlights should write on the lens.
- 片中实例：Being John Malkovich sends a body through a small door into a head. The Matrix uses a mirror and other props as passages between worlds.；Grammar for the object as wormhole, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Object portal through [Subject], a thing opening onto another space, a bag, a screen, a doorway that should not lead there. Name the prop, the rim, and the far geography inside it.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Object portal through [Subject], a thing opening onto another space, a bag, a screen, a doorway that should not lead there.`
- Prompt 要点：Keep the surrounding room in this world.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a glowing doorway or a Pass Through through a wall. The tell is no prop with thickness, or the whole set melting. The fix is a readable object, a hole with parallax, and two geographies meeting at the rim.

### Photogrammetry
- 别名：Gravitational lensing, Simulation-led imagery ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/photogrammetry)
- 定义：The photogrammetry look reconstructs 3D geometry and texture from overlapping photographs, so a real place is turned into a scanned mesh. Slightly wrong normals, stretched texture, and holes are the evidence of capture.
- 叙事功能：The camera can orbit a courtyard that was photographed, not built. Faces of stone look photographed because they were, then wrapped onto geometry. Use it when the scene should feel surveyed: a real site captured as a model. It is the wrong tool for a handmade miniature, and it is not proof of a physics simulation. A black-hole visualization is simulation-led imagery, a cousin name in the catalog, not a scan.
- 怎么拍：Shoot many overlapping stills around the subject, triangulate a mesh, project the photographs as texture. The look: texture stretching at grazing angles, missing undersides, a seam where coverage failed. Light can be the captured light, or a new CG key on the mesh. The camera path is free because the space is geometry. Prompt a photogrammetry look: scanned space, slightly wrong mesh, a real place turned into a model.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat when a real location should be inspectable as a model, slightly too virtual. Do not use it to claim a scientific render is a scan.
- 近似对比：Diorama, Video Game, DioramaShrink the epic until it fits a shelf., Video GameThe world is playable., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Diorama is a built miniature with model lighting. Photogrammetry is photographed reality wrapped on a mesh. Video Game uses engine lighting and authored assets. The photogrammetry look keeps photo texture and scan error. DioramaShrink the epic until it fits a shelf. Video GameThe world is playable. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Experimental documentaries and game cutscenes orbit scanned spaces. Interstellar is listed beside them as simulation-led imagery (Gargantua's computed disk), a cousin of modeled pictures, not a photogrammetric mesh.；Use the scan look for places. Use simulation when the phenomenon was computed.；Interstellar 2014Gargantua and its gravitationally lensed accretion-disk imagery.
- Prompt 模板：`Create a visualization concept for a spinning black hole with an accretion disk appearing lensed around the dark central region. Use a validated ray-traced simulation as the geometric reference and preserve its major contours. Label this as a cinematic visualization, not a newly computed scientific result.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Photogrammetry look of [Subject], scanned space, slightly wrong mesh, a real place turned into a model. Name overlapping-photo texture, a hole or stretch, and an orbit or inspection camera.`
- Prompt 要点：Ban a toy diorama and ban a perfect game render.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousins are a Diorama and a clean engine render. The tell is painted miniature charm, or PBR plastic with no photo texture. The fix is photographic skin on imperfect geometry, seams included.

### Ratio Switch
- 别名：Expanding frame, Narrative frame boundary ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/ratio-switch)
- 定义：An aspect ratio switch changes the image's visible boundaries so the container itself widens or closes as the story changes register. The picture is not stretched: previously unseen area is revealed, or the crop tightens.
- 叙事功能：A square world learns it can become a wide one. A scope picture suddenly sits in a taller box. The frame is a character. Use it when a period, a freedom, or a constraint should be felt as the edge of the movie. It is the wrong tool for a zoom, and it is not a mask inside the picture. If the lens merely tightens, the container never changed. If a keyhole sits inside a stable 16:9, that is masking.
- 怎么拍：Compose protected areas for both ratios. Animate the crop or the side mattes. Preserve subject geometry. Bodies must not squash to fill the new frame. The camera may be locked. The event is the bounds. Prompt an aspect-ratio switch on the subject: the frame itself widening or closing. For video, a visible crop or reveal during the sequence.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat when a character pushes the world open, or when a new time period deserves a different box. Do not use it as a zoom-out that only changes shot size.
- 近似对比：Masking, Wide Shot, MaskingShow looking as an object., Wide ShotDo not isolate yet., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Masking cuts a shape inside a stable container. A ratio switch changes the container. Wide Shot is a shot size inside whatever ratio you already have. Switching ratio is not going wider with the lens. MaskingShow looking as an object. Wide ShotDo not isolate yet. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Mommy lets Steve appear to open a constrained frame outward. The Grand Budapest Hotel assigns different narrative periods different frame shapes.；Ozark and other Xavier Dolan films use the same container-as-event grammar. Not frames to copy.；Mommy 2014Steve appears to open the constrained frame outward.；The Grand Budapest Hotel 2014Different narrative periods use different frame shapes.
- Prompt 模板：`Begin with a young cyclist confined within a square image. As she reaches an open seaside road and takes a deep breath, widen the frame smoothly to a broad rectangle, revealing the ocean on both sides. Reveal previously unseen image area; never stretch her body or bicycle. Animate the framing in post.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Aspect-ratio switch on [Subject], the frame itself widening or closing as the story changes register. Video: The frame around [Subject] changes aspect ratio during the sequence, a visible crop or reveal.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousins are a zoom and a stretch. The tell is the body fattening to fill the new box, or the lens punching in with no matte move. The fix is a crop or reveal of extra picture, geometry preserved.

### Scale Shift
- 别名：Dunkirk temporal convergence ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/scale-shift)
- 定义：Scale shift cinematography changes a body's size against the same room so the figure is suddenly giant or tiny: Alice physics as an optical event. Furniture, shadows, and contact have to match the new ratio.
- 叙事功能：A person stands in a kitchen and the table is a landscape. Or a hand is a building. The geography did not cut. The scale did. Use it when relative size is the plot of the shot. The same name is sometimes used for unequal story-time strands, as in Dunkirk's land, sea, and air clocks. That is editorial scale, not optical size. Do not mix the two tools in one prompt.
- 怎么拍：Lock the room plate. Resize the figure with oversized furniture, miniatures, split-scale composites, or a cut that reprints the body at a new height in the same architecture. Shadows and contact must match the new size: a giant throws a larger shadow from the same key. Forced perspective can help as a static alignment of two real sizes. Prompt a scale shift of the subject: the body suddenly giant or tiny against the same room.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat when a person becomes a toy in their own hallway, or a monster in a dollhouse. Do not use it as a simple close-up that only magnifies a detail without changing the body-to-room ratio.
- 近似对比：Forced Perspective, Magnification, Forced PerspectiveChange size without VFX., MagnificationGo closer than a close-up., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Forced Perspective aligns two real sizes on one focal plane so they look like one scale. Scale shift is the change of that relationship. Magnification goes closer than a close-up, a world inside a centimeter. It does not make the whole body tiny in the room. Forced PerspectiveChange size without VFX. MagnificationGo closer than a close-up. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Honey, I Shrunk the Kids and Ant-Man stage bodies against furniture and grass at the wrong size. Dunkirk and Inception appear in the catalog as temporal-scale cousins: unequal clocks, not Alice rooms.；Use the first pair for optical size. Keep the second pair for editorial time.；Dunkirk 2017Land, sea and air strands span different durations before converging.；Inception 2010Different dream levels unfold at different apparent rates.
- Prompt 模板：`Design an intercut rescue story: a mountain team's six-hour ascent, a driver's thirty-minute approach and a climber's final two-minute wait. Build a timeline showing exactly where they converge. Generate separate location strands and edit them toward one shared radio call, not as falsely equal real-time durations.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Scale shift of [Subject], the body suddenly giant or tiny against the same room, Alice physics. Name the room, the new size, and matching shadows.`
- Prompt 要点：Ban a mere close-up and ban stretching the architecture.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousins are a Close-Up and a zoom. The tell is a big face with a normal room, or a lens punch with no furniture scale change. The fix is the same architecture, a new body-to-room ratio, and contact that fits.

### Shadow Box
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/shadow-box)
- 定义：Shadow-box cinematography tells the story in layered cut-outs, depth as stacked silhouettes, a diorama of darkness. Figures are unfilled, and distance is paper stacked in front of a hard backlight.
- 叙事功能：A procession of blacks: a rider, a tree, a palace, each on its own plane. Use it when the scene should be read as theatre cut from card, not as a modeled room with fill. It is the wrong tool for a single backlit person in a real location, and for a miniature that still has painted faces. If there is only one plane of black, you shot a silhouette. If the model is fully dressed and scaled, you shot a diorama.
- 怎么拍：Cut figures and architecture as separate layers. Space them in depth in front of a hard source. No fill on the faces. Edges stay graphic. Parallax between layers if the camera creeps. The source is behind. The camera is in front. Color, if any, is in the backlight or in a few tinted planes, not in modeled skin. Prompt a shadow-box of the subject: layered cut-outs, depth as stacked silhouettes, a diorama of darkness.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat that should feel like a night play made of paper. Do not use it when the face must carry skin and eye light.
- 近似对比：Silhouette, Diorama, SilhouetteIdentity is less important than shape., DioramaShrink the epic until it fits a shelf., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Silhouette is one backlit figure, usually in real space. A shadow box stacks many cut-outs. Diorama is a miniature world with modeled volume. A shadow box is layers of black, not a tiny set with fill. SilhouetteIdentity is less important than shape. DioramaShrink the epic until it fits a shelf. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：The Adventures of Prince Achmed is silhouette animation as stacked theatre. Kara Walker's language of cut-out processions is the still and installation cousin.；Grammar of layered black, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Shadow-box of [Subject], layered cut-outs, depth as stacked silhouettes, a diorama of darkness. Name several planes, a hard backlight, and no fill on the figures.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Shadow-box of [Subject], layered cut-outs, depth as stacked silhouettes, a diorama of darkness.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousins are a lone Silhouette and a lit Diorama. The tell is skin texture, or only one black plane. The fix is stacked cut-outs, hard source behind, unfilled figures.

### Transformation
- 别名：Psychological background transformation, Subject-stable world change ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/transformation)
- 定义：Transformation cinematography makes a body, room, or object become something else in continuous view. The camera keeps watching while the state changes, with a stable anchor so the becoming can be read.
- 叙事功能：A kiss turns the restaurant into a memory. A man becomes an animal in stages. A liquid takes a face. Use it when the audience should not be allowed a cut to skip the becoming. It is the wrong tool when you only need a landmark warp of one contour into another, or when a new scene should simply start. If the job is matched geometry between two portraits, morphing is cleaner. If both body and world melt at random, the anchor is gone.
- 怎么拍：Decide what stays. A subject-stable world change matches pose, contact, and key while the background is exchanged by a move, an occlusion, a projection, a set change, or a tracked composite. A body transformation stages makeup, puppet, or digital change in order, with weight and effort. Light the new state with a source that still makes sense on the skin. Prompt a transformation of the subject: a body, room, or object becoming something else in continuous view.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat when becoming is the action: a memory room, a creature, a substance taking form. Do not use it as a morph between two unmatched stills.
- 近似对比：Morphing, Morph, MorphingBecoming is visible., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite., Anamorphic FlareNight lights and headlights should write on the lens.
  Morphing interpolates landmarks from one contour to another. Transformation can be practical, architectural, or a world swap around a stable person. Morph uses the warp as an edit join. Creature stages (werewolf cinema) are performance and makeup, not only a warp. MorphingBecoming is visible. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite. Anamorphic FlareNight lights and headlights should write on the lens.
- 片中实例：Vertigo's revolving kiss shifts the surrounding setting toward memory. Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind lets memory spaces change around the couple.；An American Werewolf in London and The Fly stage the body as a visible change of state. Terminator 2 and The Abyss sit nearby as shape that reforms.；Grammar, not frames to copy.；Vertigo 1958The revolving kiss shifts the surrounding setting toward Scottie's memory.；Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind 2004Memory spaces change or lose continuity around the characters.；Terminator 2: Judgment Day 1991The T-1000 changes shape and reforms within scenes.
- Prompt 模板：`Orbit slowly around two fictional former friends embracing in a modern station. Keep their bodies and contact continuous while the architecture behind them gradually becomes the childhood railway platform they remember. Change only the surrounding world, with coherent light and perspective. Plan matched environment plates and composite the transition; no melting faces.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Transformation of [Subject], a body, room, or object becoming something else in continuous view. Video: [Subject] transforms across the shot, a visible change of state.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a generic morph of everything. The tell is melting faces and melting walls at once, no anchor. The fix is a stable perceptual center and a designed change of state.

### Typography
- 别名：Narrative main titles, Graphic opening sequence ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/typography)
- 定义：Kinetic typography puts words in the world of the shot as objects: titles that occupy space, letters with scale, parallax, and a surface. The sentence is in the picture, not parked as a caption.
- 叙事功能：A name walks the street. A credit is scratched into a notebook. Type pursues a figure. Use it when the film should teach its pattern before or during the action, and when letters are part of the blocking. It is the wrong tool for a lower-third, and a single handsome card is not yet a title sequence. If live action, drawing, and stock collide as equal media, you are in mixed media. If paper layers tear without readable words as objects, you are in collage.
- 怎么拍：Choose one visual rule: ink that becomes a map, letters that stand in the set, type that tracks a body. Light in-world letters as surfaces (a key, an edge). Reserve space for exact spelling. Animate progression before dropping credits. The camera can dolly so type parallax against walls. Prompt typography in the world of the subject: words as objects, titles that occupy space, kinetic type.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat when a word must share space with a person, or when an opening must tell a miniature story in letters. Do not use it as unreadable scribble over a portrait.
- 近似对比：Mixed Media, Collage, Mixed MediaNo single medium owns the truth., CollageOne image is not enough; stack them., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Mixed Media collides several capture modes. Typography can live inside a single photographed world. Collage layers images. Type may appear there, but collage does not require words as blocking. Mixed MediaNo single medium owns the truth. CollageOne image is not enough; stack them. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Vertigo's spiral opening sets a pattern of obsession in letter and shape. Se7en builds credits from hands, notebooks, and material type.；Catch Me If You Can condenses pursuit into animated letterforms. Annie Hall and Scott Pilgrim vs.；the World put sentences into the scene.
