Grammar, not frames to copy.；Vertigo 1958The spiral-based opening establishes a pattern of obsession and instability.；Se7en 1995Hands, notebooks and material fragments construct a disturbing preparatory ritual.；Catch Me If You Can 2002Animated pursuit imagery condenses the film's identity game.
- Prompt 模板：`Design a forty-second title sequence for a film about a missing cartographer. A single ink line becomes a street, a fingerprint ridge and a coastline before vanishing at the edge of a map. Generate visual elements separately; animate the transformations and add exact credits in a motion-graphics timeline. No arbitrary stock-footage montage.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Typography in the world of [Subject], words as objects, titles that occupy space, kinetic type. Name the words, the surface they sit on, and the light.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a title card or a caption. The tell is unreadable AI lettering, or type glued to the frame with no space in the set. The fix is exact words, a surface, and a rule that progresses.

### Wigglegram
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/wigglegram)
- 定义：A wigglegram is a short stereo shiver: two or three frames rocking so depth reads as a fidget. The viewpoints are a few centimeters apart, so depth is a twitch, not a dolly.
- 叙事功能：A postcard comes alive as a cheap lenticular. The subject stays almost still. The room jumps between two eyes. Use it when you want stereo without a move, a GIF of depth. It is the wrong tool for a real tracking shot, and it is not camera shake. If planes peel continuously, you have parallax from travel. If the same viewpoint chatters, you have a wiggle or a stutter.
- 怎么拍：Lock two (or three) stills on a stereo baseline of a few centimeters, same height, same lens. Flicker A-B-A. Foreground shifts more than the back, which is the disparity. No motion blur from a pan. Light both frames with the same key so only position changes. Prompt a wigglegram of the subject: two or three frames rocking, a cheap stereo shiver. For video, a short wiggle between two viewpoints.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat that should feel like a lenticular or a stereo GIF: a portrait, a product, a joke of depth. Do not use it in place of a dolly through a room.
- 近似对比：Parallax, Stutter / Stop-Stutter, Wiggle, ParallaxProve the world has layers., Stutter / Stop-StutterThe mind skips., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Parallax comes from the camera traveling so planes peel at different speeds. A wigglegram only rocks between two locked viewpoints. Stutter / Stop-Stutter is a temporal step of one take. Wiggle is a tiny tremor of the support, not a stereo pair. ParallaxProve the world has layers. Stutter / Stop-StutterThe mind skips. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Lenticular photos and GIF stereo are the well-known uses: postcards, early web 3D fidgets, social stereo stills. Cinema borrows that twitch.；Grammar of two eyes, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Wigglegram of [Subject], two or three frames rocking, a cheap stereo shiver, depth as a fidget. Video: A short wiggle between two viewpoints of [Subject], stereoscopic shiver.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name a small baseline and a locked subject. Ban a dolly and ban handheld shake.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousins are Wiggle shake and a mini Dolly In. The tell is blur from motion, or a continuous path. The fix is two sharp stills a few centimeters apart, flickering.

### X-Ray
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/x-ray)
- 定义：X-ray cinematography images through a surface as if denser structure were visible: bones, wiring, a body as diagram. Transmission, not reflectance, is the physics.
- 叙事功能：Skin becomes a veil. The interior is the subject. Use it when the story needs to see through: a medical look, a machine's vision, a suitcase, a chest. It is the wrong tool for heat, and for foliage that glows in near-infrared. If warmth is false color, you want thermal. If leaves go pale and skies go dark, you want infrared.
- 怎么拍：Render or photograph as transmission: denser parts (bone, metal) hold more of the beam and read as structure. Invert or not, but keep a graphic interior with little surface makeup. A hard, even backlight through the subject helps. Keep one body readable as a diagram, not a smear of glow. Prompt an x-ray view of the subject: interior structure, bones or wiring, a body as diagram.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat of seeing through a person, a wall, or a device. Do not use it as a teal grade on ordinary skin.
- 近似对比：Thermal, Infrared, ThermalSee temperature, not light., InfraredThe world should look like another planet that is still Earth., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Thermal maps heat as false color. Infrared is near-IR reflectance, often odd foliage and skin, not a skeleton. X-ray is transmission through the object, structure as diagram. ThermalSee temperature, not light. InfraredThe world should look like another planet that is still Earth. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：The Abyss HUD and science films treat seeing-through as a device overlay or a laboratory plate. Superhero x-ray vision is the pop grammar of the same diagram.；Uses of interior structure, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`X-ray view of [Subject], interior structure, bones or wiring, a body as diagram. Demand transmission, a readable skeleton or circuit, and no thermal palette.`
- 示例 Prompt：`X-ray view of [Subject], interior structure, bones or wiring, a body as diagram.`
- Prompt 要点：Ban glowing skin that is only a grade.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousins are Thermal and a ghostly double exposure. The tell is heat colors, or a transparent person with a normal room and no structure. The fix is bones or wiring as the picture, graphic, transmitted.

### Zoetrope
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/zoetrope)
- 定义：Zoetrope cinematography shows the frames inside a movement: stroboscopic slices of a spinning action, motion as a drum of poses. You see the sampling, not a smooth blur.
- 叙事功能：A horse's legs become a ring of stills. A spinning body is a drum of slices. Use it when the point is that motion is made of frames, a toy of persistence of vision on screen. It is the wrong tool for ordinary slow motion, and for stop-motion of a puppet that never spins. If you repeat frames of a continuous take to stutter time, that is step-printing. If an object is posed per frame on a table, that is stop-motion.
- 怎么拍：Strobe the action, or present discrete poses around a rotation, like slits in a drum. Each slice is sharp. The gaps are the point. A hard, brief source (strobe, shuttered light) freezes each pose. The camera can be locked on the drum or on a repeating run. Prompt a zoetrope of the subject: stroboscopic slices of a spinning action, motion as a drum of frames. For video, stroboscopic zoetrope slices in repeating action.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat that should look like a Victorian motion toy, or a spin sampled into poses. Do not use it as a generic choppy grade on a walk that is not a drum of frames.
- 近似对比：Stop Motion, Step Printing, Stop MotionMotion should feel made., Step PrintingLonging that cannot move at normal speed., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Stop Motion poses an object once per frame. A zoetrope samples a spin or a repeating action as a ring of slices. Step Printing repeats frames of a photographed take to slow or stutter it. The zoetrope shows the drum. Stop MotionMotion should feel made. Step PrintingLonging that cannot move at normal speed. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：The Horse in Motion is the scientific ancestor: sampled gait as a sequence of stills. Batman Begins uses zoetrope imagery as a motion toy inside the story.；Grammar of sampled spin, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Zoetrope of [Subject], stroboscopic slices of a spinning action, motion as a drum of frames. Video: Stroboscopic zoetrope slices of [Subject] in repeating action.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Demand discrete sharp poses, a spin or cycle, and visible sampling. Ban smooth blur.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousins are Slow Motion and Stutter / Stop-Stutter. The tell is a fluid overcrank, or a walk that hitch-steps without a drum of slices. The fix is strobe-sharp poses around a repeating spin.

### Focus Change
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/focus-change)
- 定义：Focus change cinematography jumps or slides the plane of sharpness to a new fact, a rack without apology. The mid-blur is short, and the new plane owns the shot as soon as it lands.
- 叙事功能：A glass goes soft. A face snaps true. Attention relocates. Use it when the point is the new owner of the frame, not the poetry of traveling blur. It is the wrong tool if you need to watch the plane walk slowly through a room, or if both planes must stay sharp. A lyric travel is a focal shift. A two-mark textbook pull is a rack focus. This is the discrete change.
- 怎么拍：Keep the camera locked or nearly so. Depth of field is shallow. The follow-focus snaps or hard-slides from distance A to B. Do not linger in the mush. End sharp on the new subject. A 75mm to 100mm makes the jump brutal. A wider lens makes it weaker. Prompt a focus change on the subject: the plane of sharpness jumping or sliding to a new fact. For video, focus changes from one plane onto the subject or away.
- 何时用：Use it for the beat when a clue, a gun, or an eavesdropper must steal the shot at once. Do not use it as a slow search through several planes.
- 近似对比：Focal Shift, Rack Focus, Focal ShiftChange who owns the shot without cutting., Rack FocusChange who owns the shot without cutting., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Focal Shift is the traveling plane as the event, including slow and multiple racks. Focus change is the relocate, jump or hard slide. Rack Focus is the measured two-mark procedure. This one does not apologize for the snap. Focal ShiftChange who owns the shot without cutting. Rack FocusChange who owns the shot without cutting. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：The Graduate still supplies the grammar of attention changing by focus, here read as a harder hand-off. There Will Be Blood's interiors let sharpness relocate inside a held composition.；Same films as the cousin pulls, different timing. Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Focus change on [Subject], the plane of sharpness jumping or sliding to a new fact, a rack without apology. Video: Focus changes from one plane onto [Subject] or away from them.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Focus changes from one plane onto [Subject] or away from them.`
- Prompt 要点：Name both planes and that the mid-blur is brief.

### Sticker Peel
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/effects/sticker-peel)
- 定义：A sticker peel effect lifts the image from a backing: adhesive shine, a die-cut layer coming off the world. Thickness, curl, and glue are the physics, not a still collage of torn paper.

It is the wrong tool for a fight, and for a collage that only layers stills without a peel event. If media collide as equal sources, that is mixed media. If torn paper sits still, that is collage. This one has a curl and a specular of adhesive.
- 怎么拍：Build a die-cut layer with paper tooth or vinyl gloss. Animate one peel direction. Show the adhesive shine on the underside and the backing that is revealed. A hand is optional. Keep the face or object on the sticker readable. Light the curl with a small hard source so the edge has a tick. Prompt a sticker peel on the subject: the image lifting from a backing, adhesive shine. For video, a sticker layer peels off, revealing another layer.
- 何时用：Use it for titles, identity jokes, a reveal of what was under the poster. Do not use it as a transition in a chase that still needs geography.
- 近似对比：Collage, Mixed Media, CollageOne image is not enough; stack them., Mixed MediaNo single medium owns the truth., Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
  Collage layers images without a peel. Mixed Media collides capture modes. Sticker peel is a single graphic layer with thickness, curl, and glue, coming off a backing. CollageOne image is not enough; stack them. Mixed MediaNo single medium owns the truth. Lens FlareLight is too strong to be polite.
- 片中实例：Title design and motion graphics are the well-known uses: a credit that is a label, a street-art rip, a vinyl coming off a wall. Grammar of paper as matter, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Sticker peel on [Subject], the image lifting from a backing, adhesive shine, a graphic coming off the world. Video: A sticker layer peels off [Subject] or the frame, revealing another layer.`

## 剪辑与转场 / Editing and Transitions（23 条）

**速查**：Match Cut · Graphic Match · Match on Action · Jump Cut · Smash Cut · Dissolve · Fade In / Fade Out · Wipe · Iris · Cross-Cutting · Split Screen · Montage · Axial Cut · Invisible Cut · J-Cut / L-Cut (Visual Setup) · Crash Cut · Flash Cut · Match Motion · Match Split · Quick Cuts · Set Transition · Transitions · Fragments

### Match Cut
- 别名：Plant and payoff, Chekhov’s gun ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/match-cut)
- 定义：A match cut joins two shots through a visual, spatial, sonic, or conceptual correspondence the viewer can read at the splice. The outgoing frame and the incoming frame share a shape, motion, object class, or idea, so the cut argues a relationship instead of only changing the view.
- 叙事功能：One side of the join is complete. The other side is complete. What they share is the point: a bone leaving a hand, then a craft in the same screen path; a match blown out, then a sun the same size in the frame. The splice is the sentence. Use it when two images are the same idea and you want that idea to land in one frame of time. It is the wrong tool when you only need a new camera position on the same gesture: that job belongs to match on action, and forcing a rhyme will feel like decoration. If the second image does not change what the first one meant, skip the trick. A contour rhyme with no conceptual load is a graphic match wearing a bigger name.
- 怎么拍：Design both frames as a pair before either is shot. Match the dominant contour, screen position, motion vector, or sonic envelope, then cut hard. There is no optical mix: A is 100 percent, then B is 100 percent, and the correspondence is what the viewer supplies in the gap. Keep the shared property honest. A door that sticks in the first shot must stick for the same mechanical reason later. Prompt both sides: name the outgoing object, the incoming object, the shared geometry or motion, and a hard cut, not a morph.
- 何时用：Use it at the leap: tool to tool, flame to sun, a planted object returning with a new meaning. Do not use it as a pretty way to leave a room. If the next shot is only the next room, a straight cut or a Dissolve is cleaner.
- 近似对比：graphic match, Match on action, Match Motion, Morph, Graphic MatchForm carries you across time., Match on ActionHide the cut in a movement., Jump CutDo not soothe. Show the skip.
  A graphic match rhymes form (shape, line, color, placement) even when the idea is thin. A match cut can use that rhyme, but it needs a correspondence of meaning, space, or sound as well. Match on action stays inside one continuous gesture and hides the camera change. Match Motion rides a vector into another place or time. Morph interpolates pixels; a match cut does not. Graphic MatchForm carries you across time. Match on ActionHide the cut in a movement. Jump CutDo not soothe. Show the skip.
- 片中实例：In 2001: A Space Odyssey the thrown bone is followed by an orbiting craft on a related path, tool to tool across eras. In Lawrence of Arabia a blown match is followed by the desert sun at matching scale.；Apocalypse Now binds ceiling fan and helicopter so the two rotors share a thought. Use those joins as grammar, not as frames to copy.；Back to the Future 1985The clock-tower information becomes crucial to the climax.；Shaun of the Dead 2004Ordinary objects and earlier remarks become survival tools and jokes.；Parasite 2019Objects and architectural details accumulate later significance.；Lawrence of Arabia 1962A match being extinguished is followed by the desert sunrise.
- Prompt 模板：`In an early workshop scene, casually show a door that sticks unless lifted slightly. Later, during an urgent evacuation, a visitor fails to open it until the apprentice remembers the trick. Generate the same door hardware and motion in both scenes. Avoid a conspicuous explanatory close-up in the setup.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name the shared contour or vector, name what changes (place, era, scale), and forbid a morph or dissolve. For video, generate A and B as separate shots with matched screen position, then cut; do not ask the model to blend them.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a morph or a graphic match with nothing to say. The tell is identical subject identity with no shared geometry, or a liquid melt from A into B. The fix: lock the shared contour, placement, or motion; keep the two objects distinct; cut hard.

### Graphic Match
- 别名：Shape match, Raccord graphique ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/graphic-match)
- 定义：A graphic match cut joins two images that share a dominant shape, line, color, placement, or motion pattern, even when location and time change. The outgoing contour and the incoming contour occupy the same part of the screen, so form carries you across the splice.
- 叙事功能：You leave a drain, circular, centered. You arrive on an eye, circular, centered. Nothing has been explained, but the cut has already made a bridge. The viewer feels the leap before anyone names it. Use it when form should carry you across time or place. It is the wrong tool when the two frames do not share a contour you can point at. Matching wardrobe or actor identity is not a graphic match. A graphic match is not a morph. Similarity across a hard cut is enough. If the image melts, you have left editing and entered morph.
- 怎么拍：Design the outgoing and incoming frames together. Match the important contour and screen position rather than every part of the image: circle size, horizon height, the diagonal of a body. Use a hard cut when the instant connection is the point. A short Dissolve can soften the rhyme, but it also hides how precise the match was. Prompt the silhouette or the echoed shape on both sides, same placement, no morph.
- 何时用：Use it when a silhouette, a circle, or a line should survive a jump in time: a watch face to a dome, a scream-mouth to a tunnel. Do not use it as wallpaper between unrelated wides. If the contour does not match, the cut is just a cut.
- 近似对比：Match Cut, Match on Action, Dissolve, Morph, Match CutTwo images are the same idea., Match on ActionHide the cut in a movement., Jump CutDo not soothe. Show the skip.
  A Match Cut may include a graphic rhyme, but it also claims an idea. Graphic match can be purely formal. Match on Action continues one gesture in one scene. Dissolve overlaps two images in time instead of snapping form to form. Morph interpolates; graphic match does not. Match CutTwo images are the same idea. Match on ActionHide the cut in a movement. Jump CutDo not soothe. Show the skip.
- 片中实例：2001: A Space Odyssey throws a bone and finds a craft of similar attitude and screen path. Psycho leaves the shower drain and arrives on Marion's eye, two circles in one place.；Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown uses compositional rhymes to connect successive images. Borrow the geometry, not the posters.；2001: A Space Odyssey 1968The thrown bone is followed by an orbiting spacecraft.；Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown 1988Compositional similarities connect successive images.
- Prompt 模板：`Generate A: close-up of a circular watch face centered in frame. Generate B: a circular observatory dome seen from above at exactly the same size and position. Hard-cut on the shared circle, with no morph or dissolve. Keep the two objects distinct and the visual connection immediate.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Graphic match on the silhouette of [Subject], shape echoing shape, circle to circle, a visual rhyme. Specify the shared contour, its screen position, and that the objects stay distinct.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is morph or a lazy Match Cut that only repeats the actor. The tell: the model blends A into B, or the second frame does not occupy the same contour. The fix: lock one shape and one placement, keep two different objects, cut hard.

### Match on Action
- 别名：Cut on movement, Raccord mouvement ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/match-action)
- 定义：Match on action cuts during one continuous action so the movement itself bridges two camera positions. The outgoing shot starts the gesture; the incoming shot finishes it, which is why the edit can change size or angle without feeling interrupted.
- 叙事功能：A hand reaches for a handle in a wide. In the close shot the same hand, same speed, same sleeve, finishes the turn. The viewer follows the reach instead of inspecting the splice. That is the job: hide the cut in a movement. It is the wrong tool when the action is not continuous, or when you want the skip to be seen. Skipping time inside a similar frame is a Jump Cut. Jumping closer on the same axis without a bridging gesture is an Axial Cut. If hands swap, travel reverses, or too much of the motion is repeated on both sides, the glue fails and the cut becomes visible for the wrong reason.
- 怎么拍：Repeat the action with matching speed, hand, object position, and body orientation. Cut at a readable phase of motion, usually the acceleration or the midpoint, not after the gesture has already landed. Check screen direction and sound continuity across the join. The two sides are the same event, different views. Prompt: the motion started in one shot and finished in the next, same hand, same object, two framings.
- 何时用：Use it to change shot size or angle on a door, a punch, a sit-down, a pour. Do not use it to leap to another day or another room. If the world changes while the vector continues, that is Match Motion, not match on action.
- 近似对比：Match Cut, Axial Cut, Match Motion, Invisible Cut, Match CutTwo images are the same idea., Axial CutChange shot size without changing angle., Graphic MatchForm carries you across time.
  A Match Cut rhymes two different images. Match on action is one action, two views. An Axial Cut jumps distance on the same axis and does not need a bridging gesture. Match Motion can carry a body into another location or reality if direction and speed match. Invisible Cut hides the splice in occlusion or blur, not in a readable gesture. Match CutTwo images are the same idea. Axial CutChange shot size without changing angle. Graphic MatchForm carries you across time.
- 片中实例：Buster Keaton's Neighbors connects courtyard movement across changing views so the body remains the through-line. The Matrix links action across changing shot sizes and viewpoints while the gesture continues.；Classical continuity comedy and action both depend on this glue. Use the principle, not a copied punch.；Neighbors 1920Keaton's courtyard movement is connected across shots.；The Matrix 1999Action is linked across changing shot sizes and viewpoints.
- Prompt 模板：`Generate A: wide view of a courier reaching for a door handle with the right hand. Generate B: close view from the same side of the action axis, continuing that exact reach and turning the handle. Cut during the reach, preserving hand, speed, sleeve and handle position.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Match on action through [Subject]'s gesture, the motion started in one shot and finished in the next. Name the wide and the close, the hand, the object, the direction of travel, and that the cut happens during the move.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Jump Cut (time skipped, similar frame) or an Axial Cut (scale jump, no bridging move). The tell: the close shot uses the other hand, the walk flips screen direction, or the gesture completes twice. The fix: match hand, speed, object, orientation; cut during the move, not after.

### Jump Cut
- 别名：Visible temporal discontinuity, Faux raccord temporel ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/jump-cut)
- 定义：A jump cut removes time or slightly shifts framing inside a similar setup, so the discontinuity is conspicuous. The outgoing frame and the incoming frame are close enough that the missing interval reads as a skip, not as a new shot.
- 叙事功能：The car is the same. The road is the same. The speaker has jumped three sentences and a mile. You are not soothed. The film has shown the skip. Use it for impatience, instability, comic abbreviation, or an openly constructed voice. It is the wrong tool when you want invisible continuity. If the two frames are very different in size or angle, the skip hides and you have ordinary coverage, not a jump cut. A jump cut is not simply any fast cut. The visible break within a similar setup is the whole point.
- 怎么拍：Remove intervals from one setup, or join closely related views of the same subject. Keep enough of the composition (lens, angle, body size) that the jump is obvious. Decide whether sound smooths the skip (a continuous line) or emphasizes it (hard in and out). Prompt: time skipped inside a similar framing, same seat, missing frames, no morph.
- 何时用：Use it in a wait, a rambling talk, a comedown, a drive that should feel too long and too short at once. Do not use it as a substitute for coverage you did not shoot. If the audience should not notice the edit, use Match on Action or an Invisible Cut.
- 近似对比：Smash Cut, Montage, Axial Cut, Quick Cuts, Smash CutThe next image should hurt., MontageYou need months in a minute., Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
  A Smash Cut slams into a violently different image. A jump cut stays inside a similar frame and skips time. Montage juxtaposes many shots to compress or argue; jump cut is usually one setup with holes. An Axial Cut jumps distance on the same axis as emphasis, not as missing time. Quick Cuts are short shots from changing setups, a rhythm, not a skip inside one frame. Smash CutThe next image should hurt. MontageYou need months in a minute. Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
- 片中实例：Breathless lets car rides and talks skip forward inside similar framings, which is the modern template. Dancer in the Dark uses discontinuous cutting to disrupt smooth observation.；Requiem for a Dream turns repeated rituals into jumps that feel like appetite. Grammar, not a look to clone.；Breathless 1960Car rides and conversations skip forward within similar framings.；Dancer in the Dark 2000Discontinuous cutting disrupts smooth observation.
- Prompt 模板：`Locked medium shot of a woman waiting at a station bench. Make six jump cuts in the same framing as she changes posture, checks the clock and shifts her bag. Other passengers change between cuts. Clear elapsed waiting time, no morphing transitions or camera repositioning.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Jump cut on [Subject], time skipped inside a similar framing, interruption, anxiety or comedy of missing frames. Specify a locked or near-locked setup, what changes (posture, clock, crowd), and that the camera does not morph.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Quick Cuts or random coverage labeled as a jump. The tell: every shot is a new angle, so nothing jumps. Or the model morphs the sitter from pose to pose. The fix: keep the framing nearly constant, remove time, let the discontinuity show.

### Smash Cut
- 别名：Apparent closure, Last-beat reversal ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/smash-cut)
- 定义：A smash cut makes an abrupt, high-contrast transition in image, sound, tone, scale, or time. The outgoing side has earned a state (quiet, prayer, resolution); the incoming side contradicts it without a polite blend.
- 叙事功能：A night walk tightens. A bus door hisses into the frame. The scare was a vehicle, not a monster, and the cut is the joke and the slap at once. Or: a grave visit settles, then a hand breaks the earth. The next image should hurt. Use it when contrast is the meaning. It is the wrong tool when the two sides are similar, or when you still need the audience inside one continuous action. Similar frames with missing time are a Jump Cut. A few stolen frames of another image are a Flash Cut. Earn the first state. A smash from nowhere, with no quiet or no prayer, is only loud.
- 怎么拍：Hold A long enough to establish tone, scale, or apparent closure. Cut to B with a large change in brightness, loudness, shot size, or subject class: silence to noise, interior to blast, hymn to murder. No dissolve, no fade, no matched contour unless the match is itself the insult. Coordinate picture and sound so they smash together, or delay the sound for a second smash (the blast seen, then heard). Prompt: from [Subject] to a violently different image, no polite dissolve.
- 何时用：Use it at the false ending, the bus in the dark, the cut from a kiss to a siren. Do not use it on every scene change. If nothing in A was quiet, sacred, or resolved, B has nothing to smash.
- 近似对比：Jump Cut, Crash Cut, Match Cut, Cross-Cutting, Jump CutDo not soothe. Show the skip., Match CutTwo images are the same idea., Graphic MatchForm carries you across time.
  A Jump Cut stays in a similar frame and skips time. A Crash Cut is a hard collision used as percussion or as a start inside an event; smash cut is contrast after a state has been earned. A Match Cut rhymes; smash cut usually refuses the rhyme. Cross-Cutting alternates lines over time; smash is one brutal join. Jump CutDo not soothe. Show the skip. Match CutTwo images are the same idea. Graphic MatchForm carries you across time.
- 片中实例：Cat People uses the bus to interrupt a tense walk: the cut is the scare and its release. Carrie lets the aftermath settle, then destabilizes the coda.；Whiplash smashes quiet into the kit. Oppenheimer lets the Trinity flash arrive before the blast sound.；Contrast as grammar, not a shot to duplicate.；Carrie 1976The apparent aftermath and grave visit lead to a final destabilizing event.；Oppenheimer 2023The Trinity explosion is experienced visually before the full blast sound arrives.；Cat People 1942The bus interrupts the tense nighttime walk.
- Prompt 模板：`After a conservator returns a stolen painting, show a calm closing sequence: gallery reopened, lights dimmed, doors locked. In one final locked shot, reveal a tiny fresh brushstroke appearing on the otherwise restored canvas. Keep the event subtle and consistent with earlier clues, not an unrelated shock.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Smash cut from [Subject] to a violently different image, silence to noise, prayer to explosion, no polite dissolve. Name the outgoing state (quiet, dark, small, resolved) and the incoming opposite (loud, bright, huge, ruptured).`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Dissolve (polite) or a Jump Cut (same setup). The tell: A and B have similar brightness, scale, and tone, so nothing smashes. The fix: earn a state on A, change at least two axes (sound and scale, or tone and time) on B, cut hard.

### Dissolve
- 别名：cross-dissolve, Audio match transition, Sonic metamorphosis ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/dissolve)
- 定义：A dissolve gradually overlaps the outgoing shot with the incoming shot so both images occupy the frame for a measurable duration. Opacity of A falls as opacity of B rises; at the midpoint you are looking at two ghosts.
- 叙事功能：A face thins. A landscape thickens through it. Time has passed, or memory has, and the cut did not want to be a door slam. Dissolves are for passage, recollection, or the gentle death of a scene. It is the wrong tool when the next image should hurt, or when the correspondence should snap. Hurt is a Smash Cut. Snap-rhyme is a Match Cut or Graphic Match. If you hold the overlap as a meaning in itself, you are in Double Exposure territory, not a transition. A dissolve does not automatically mean years have passed. Duration, sound, and context do that work. A two-frame dissolve is just a soft cut.
- 怎么拍：Mix A and B over time: typically a dozen frames to a few seconds. Keep a shared compositional hook if you want the overlap to read (a fan through a rotor, a face through a ceiling). Decide whether sound dissolves with picture or bridges first. This is an optical or digital mix, not a camera move. Prompt: dissolve from [Subject] into another time or place, overlapping ghosts, longer than a cut admits.
- 何时用：Use it for memory, montage-like passage, or a scene that should die instead of stop. Do not use it to hide a bad match on action. If the two sides should collide, cut hard.
- 近似对比：Fade In / Fade Out, Double Exposure, Morph, Wipe, Fade In / Fade OutA scene is a book chapter., Double ExposureTwo times or two selves occupy one frame., Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
  A Fade In / Fade Out goes to a uniform field (black or color) so there is a moment with no scene. A dissolve never empties the frame; B is already there. Double Exposure holds two images as a stacked meaning, not as a handoff. Morph warps contours; dissolve only changes opacity. Wipe uses a traveling boundary instead of a mix. Fade In / Fade OutA scene is a book chapter. Double ExposureTwo times or two selves occupy one frame. Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
- 片中实例：Citizen Kane uses dissolves as time's grammar through a life. The Godfather lets faces and rooms bleed across turns of power.；Apocalypse Now layers hotel fan, jungle, and helicopter so picture and sound dissolve together. The 39 Steps bridges a scream into a train whistle, a sonic cousin of the mix.；Grammar of overlap, not a look to steal.；Apocalypse Now 1979Helicopter imagery and hotel-fan perception are linked through sound and image.；The 39 Steps 1935A scream is bridged into a train whistle.；The Stendhal Syndrome 1996The painting and subjective immersion are linked through overlapping images.
- Prompt 模板：`End on an old projector turning in a dark room. Let its rhythmic mechanical chatter continue across a cut to a sewing workshop, then resolve naturally into the sewing machine now on screen. Generate both pictures separately and match the two sound rhythms without a decorative visual dissolve.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Dissolve from [Subject] into another time or place, overlapping ghosts, a longer time than a cut admits. Name both images, a shared hook if any (shape, motion, sound), and the mix duration.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Fade In / Fade Out (empty field in the middle) or a morph. The tell: the frame goes to black, or A warps into B. The fix: keep both pictures intact, change only opacity, let the midpoint show two readable images.

### Fade In / Fade Out
- 别名：Fade-out, Punctuation through absence ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/fade)
- 定义：A fade in or fade out takes the picture to or from a uniform field of black or color, rather than handing the frame straight to another visible scene. One side of the join is a world; the other side is absence, sleep, death, or a chapter break.
- 叙事功能：The room goes. Red remains, or black does, long enough to feel like a closed book. Then another room is born from the same field. A fade is punctuation, not a mix of two stories. Use it when a scene is a chapter, when consciousness drops, or when you want a pause the audience can rest in. It is the wrong tool for a gentle bleed between two images that should both stay present: that is a Dissolve. It is also the wrong tool if you only want to point at a face inside a shrinking circle: that is an Iris. A fade does not automatically mean a long period has passed. Sound that continues over black can mean a second of unconsciousness. Sound that dies with the picture can mean an ending.
- 怎么拍：Reduce the picture to a field (or raise a picture out of one). Choose black for neutral chaptering, or a color (deep red, white) when the field itself should feel like a mood. Coordinate whether sound survives the empty picture. Do not fill the room with fog or smoke to fake a fade; the image must leave, not get weather. Prompt: fade to or from black around [Subject], chapter punctuation, sleep, death, or the start of a world.
- 何时用：Use it to open a film, close an act, or mark a blackout of awareness. Do not use it between every scene in a contemporary dialogue piece unless you want a period cadence. If two pictures should overlap, dissolve.
- 近似对比：Dissolve, Iris, Wipe, Vignette, DissolveMemory, passage, or a gentle death of a scene., IrisPoint with the mask itself., Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
  A Dissolve overlaps two scenes; a fade empties the frame first. An Iris is a moving mask that points at a detail while the rest goes black, not a full-field fade. A Wipe keeps both pictures alive, divided by a traveling edge. Vignette is optical falloff on a living image, not a transition. DissolveMemory, passage, or a gentle death of a scene. IrisPoint with the mask itself. Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
- 片中实例：Cries and Whispers uses red fields as emotional punctuation between rooms and crises. 1917 uses a blackout to separate lapse and return of consciousness.；Classical studio films chapter with fades to black as a default. Borrow the pause, not a tint as a trademark.；Cries and Whispers 1972Red transitions give the film a distinctive emotional punctuation.；1917 2019A blackout separates the protagonist's lapse and return of consciousness.
- Prompt 模板：`A woman closes her eyes in a quiet room. Fade the image slowly into deep dark red while the room's ticking continues for one second, then stops. Hold the empty color field before the next scene. Produce the fade and sound timing in post, not as red smoke filling the room.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Fade to or from black around [Subject], chapter punctuation, sleep, death, or the start of a world. Name the field color if it is not black.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Dissolve (two pictures mixed) or fog as a fake fade. ' The fix: go to a uniform field, hold it, then let the next scene emerge. No overlap, no weather.

### Wipe
- 别名：horizontal wipe, vertical wipe, diagonal wipe, clock wipe, radial wipe, barn-door wipe ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/wipe)
- 定义：A wipe replaces one image with another through a moving boundary that travels across the frame. One side of the join is still A; the other side is already B; the edge between them is the edit, and it is meant to be seen.
- 叙事功能：A vertical line walks left to right and a village becomes a mountain pass. Geography has changed as a page turn, not as an invisible cut. Adventure, serials, and playful maps like that honesty. Use it when the change of scene should feel brisk, storybook, or openly constructed. It is the wrong tool when you need the audience not to feel an edit: that is Invisible Cut or Match on Action. A wipe is not a person walking in front of the lens (occlusion). Occlusion can hide a cut; a wipe displays one. Direction and speed should agree with the next action. A wipe against the traveler's walk fights the grammar.
- 怎么拍：Choose a boundary: vertical, horizontal, diagonal, clock hand, barn-door, shape. Animate it across a clean pair of shots. Soft-edged or hard-edged is a taste choice; the edge must remain a graphic, not a morph of the scenery. A motivated object edge (a passing wall, a cloak) can justify a wipe, but then you are close to an invisible occlusion cut. Prompt: wipe replacing [Subject] with the next image, a line traveling across the frame, a clock hand or a hard vertical.
- 何时用：Use it to leap from planet to planet, village to road, chapter to chapter in a serial cadence. Do not use it to hide a continuity error. If the join should vanish, do not wipe.
- 近似对比：Iris, Match Cut, Dissolve, Invisible Cut, IrisPoint with the mask itself., Match CutTwo images are the same idea., Graphic MatchForm carries you across time.
  An Iris is a radial mask from a center, not a traveling edge. A Match Cut rhymes two full frames with a hard cut and no boundary. A Dissolve mixes opacities. An Invisible Cut uses a real object or blur to conceal the splice; the wipe's graphic boundary is intentional and visible. IrisPoint with the mask itself. Match CutTwo images are the same idea. Graphic MatchForm carries you across time.
- 片中实例：Star Wars uses directional wipes as adventure punctuation between locations. Seven Samurai uses wipes to mark narrative progression with a visible page-turn.；Those are grammar samples for an honest scene change, not compositions to clone.；Star Wars 1977Directional wipes connect adventure scenes and locations.；Seven Samurai 1954Wipes punctuate narrative progression.
- Prompt 模板：`Generate A: a traveler leaves a dusty village at dawn. Generate B: the traveler approaches a distant mountain pass later that day. Replace A with B using a clean left-to-right vertical wipe. Consistent travel direction, no blending or morphing scenery.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Wipe replacing [Subject] with the next image, a line traveling across the frame, Star Wars grammar or a clock hand. Name direction, edge hardness, and both scenes.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is an Invisible Cut (hidden occlusion) or a Dissolve. The tell: the edge is gooey, or a passing extra is doing the work while you call it a wipe. The fix: a clean traveling mask, two intact pictures, direction matched to the story's travel.

### Iris
- 别名：Iris-in, Iris-out ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/iris)
- 定义：An iris transition reveals or conceals the picture with a moving circular or shaped mask. The mask's center is a pointer: one side of the join is the full world, the other is a hole closing on a face, a detail, or black.
- 叙事功能：The hall is there. The circle tightens on a satisfied face, then opens a little to include the yawning cat on the piano, then shuts. Silent comedy pointed with the mask itself. The iris is a wink and a chapter ending at once. Use it to isolate a comic detail, imitate a viewing device, or close in an openly theatrical way. It is the wrong tool if you only want the image to die evenly: that is a Fade In / Fade Out. It is also not a zoom into a dark tunnel. The camera can sit still while the mask moves. An iris is a mask over the image, not a Vignette. Vignette is optical falloff on a living frame. Iris is a boundary that travels until the picture is gone or born.
- 怎么拍：Build the mask in post (or in-camera with an iris gimmick). Control center, shape, and timing. Decide whether the circle follows a subject or stays fixed while action continues underneath. Iris-in opens from black; iris-out closes to black (or to a tiny remaining image). Prompt: iris in or out on [Subject], a circular mask closing on a face or detail, silent-era pointing, or a wink.
- 何时用：Use it to point at a ring, a glance, a gag, or to end a scene as theatre. Do not use it as a substitute for a push-in. If the camera must physically approach, move the camera. If the world should fade as a whole, fade.
- 近似对比：Fade In / Fade Out, Wipe, Vignette, Match Cut, VignetteHold the eye in. Do not crush the sides as a filter., Fade In / Fade OutA scene is a book chapter., Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
  A Fade In / Fade Out empties the whole field evenly. A Wipe uses a traveling straight or clock edge, not a hole from a center. Vignette darkens corners without being a transition. A zoom changes focal length; the iris does not. Match Cut joins two full frames; iris withholds the frame on purpose. VignetteHold the eye in. Do not crush the sides as a filter. Fade In / Fade OutA scene is a book chapter. Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
- 片中实例：Neighbors uses a circular reveal to change the apparent scale and circumstances of a wedding. The Artist borrows silent-era punctuation, including iris-like framing, as a period grammar.；Silent comedy at large treated the iris as a pointing finger. Use the mask logic, not a pastiche overlay on every close-up.；Neighbors 1920A circular reveal changes the apparent scale and circumstances of the wedding.；The Artist 2011Silent-film-derived visual punctuation includes iris-like framing.
- Prompt 模板：`A violinist finishes a performance in an otherwise empty hall. Close a circular iris around her satisfied face, then let the circle reveal a tiny yawning cat on the piano before closing to black. Generate the clean scene and animate the mask separately.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Iris in or out on [Subject], a circular mask closing on a face or detail, silent-era pointing, or a wink. Name the center (an eye, a ring, a cat), whether the mask follows, and whether it opens or closes.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a zoom, a Fade In / Fade Out, or a heavy Vignette. The tell: the camera pushes in, or the whole frame dims evenly, or corners are just dark. The fix: keep the camera still, animate a circular mask with a chosen center, let the unmasked picture stay at full exposure.

### Cross-Cutting
- 别名：Misleading cross-cut, Wrong-door suspense ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/cross-cut)
- 定义：Cross-cutting alternates two or more locations or action lines, often implying they are happening at the same time. Each side of the join is a complete strand; the engine is meanwhile, two clocks racing.
- 叙事功能：A baptism in one room. Killings in others. The film does not wait for one to finish. It braids them so ritual and murder share a tense. Or: a team at a door, a listener at another door, and the cut teaches you they are about to meet until a reverse proves they are not. Use it when simultaneity, comparison, or false geography is the engine. It is the wrong tool when you need one compressed idea from unlike images: that is Montage. It is also the wrong tool when two rooms must be visible at once: that is Split Screen. Fair misdirection relies on inference. Do not show matching house numbers and then pretend the doors were different.
- 怎么拍：Shoot each line so it can be interrupted: clear geography, readable time of day or clock, compatible but not identical details if you plan a wrong-door surprise. Alternate with tightening duration if you want the clocks to race. Sound can bleed across (a bell, a vow) to bind the lines. Prompt: cross-cutting between [Subject] and a simultaneous other line, suspense by alternation, two clocks racing.
- 何时用：Use it for a raid versus a doorbell, a ritual versus a crime, dream levels that must tick together. Do not use it to dump unused coverage of one scene. If there is no second clock, you are just cutting.
- 近似对比：Montage, Smash Cut, Split Screen, L-cut, MontageYou need months in a minute., Smash CutThe next image should hurt., Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
  Montage collides images to make an argument or to compress months; cross-cutting keeps parallel actions alive. A Smash Cut is one contrast join, not a braid. Split Screen shows both lines at once instead of alternating. An L-cut lets sound from one line sit on the picture of the other without changing the picture's location. MontageYou need months in a minute. Smash CutThe next image should hurt. Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
- 片中实例：The Godfather baptizes Michael while the rival killings land in other rooms. The Silence of the Lambs intercuts an FBI raid with a doorbell, then reveals the geography was wrong.；Inception alternates dream levels so one clock pressures another. Use the braid, not the blocking.；The Silence of the Lambs 1991The FBI raid is intercut with the killer's doorbell before the geography is revealed.；The Godfather 1972The baptism is intercut with the killings of Michael's rivals.；Inception 2010The climax alternates between dream levels.
- Prompt 模板：`Generate A: a team approaches a building and presses a doorbell. Generate B: someone in a similar interior hears a bell and walks toward a door. Intercut as though they connect. Reveal in a wide reverse that B opens to a lone courier at a different address. Keep the earlier shots ambiguous rather than contradictory.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Cross-cutting between [Subject] and a simultaneous other line, suspense by alternation, two clocks racing. Name both geographies, what the viewer is invited to assume, and whether that assumption is true.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Montage (idea by collision) or Split Screen (both at once). The tell: the second line has no clock, or both lines are clearly the same hallway. The fix: two geographies, implied simultaneity, a reveal if you are lying about the door.

### Split Screen
- 别名：Rashomon structure, Replayed encounter ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/split-screen)
- 定义：Split screen shows two or more image fields at once, so separate spaces share a single moment on the same frame. Both sides of the join are visible together; there is no waiting for the next cut.
- 叙事功能：A phone call places two apartments in one picture. A party splits into the night you wanted and the night you got. Dual identity, dual time, or dual witness: the pane is the grammar. Use it when two rooms must be one moment, or when comparison is the joke. It is the wrong tool when the audience should assume contact and then be wrong: that surprise is often better as Cross-Cutting. It is also not a window, doorway, or mirror inside the set. That is Frame within Frame, a diegetic frame, not a panel. Replaying an event from another angle does not automatically make the accounts unreliable. Split screen can show agreement as easily as a lie.
- 怎么拍：Shoot or generate each pane with matched eye-lines, horizon, or motion if you want the split to feel like one organism (a Match Split). Or keep the panes frankly separate for a phone call. Decide the boundary: hard vertical, architectural, torn. Keep identity stable unless the point is two versions of one person. Prompt: split screen with [Subject] in one pane and another life in the other, simultaneous spaces, phone-call cinema or dual identity.
- 何时用：Use it for simultaneous phone calls, twins, expectation versus reality, four quadrants of one hour. Do not use it as wallpaper on a single conversation that wants ordinary coverage. If you need the second room later, cut later.
- 近似对比：Cross-Cutting, Frame within Frame, Match Split, Montage, Frame within FrameSomeone is watched, trapped, or pictured., Cross-CuttingMeanwhile is the engine., Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
  Cross-Cutting alternates; split screen co-presents. Frame within Frame is a picture found in the world (a window, a phone, a doorway). Match Split is a split whose dividing line or contour continues from one world into the other. Montage sequences images; split screen stacks them now. Frame within FrameSomeone is watched, trapped, or pictured. Cross-CuttingMeanwhile is the engine. Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
- 片中实例：Pillow Talk and other studio comedies park two ends of a phone call in one frame. Timecode runs four continuous views in quadrants.；Kill Bill and Sisters use panels as simultaneous action. (500) Days of Summer splits expectation and reality at a party.；Use the pane logic, not a copied poster.；Rashomon 1950Testimonies offer incompatible versions of the central encounter.；Elephant 2003Paths and encounters are revisited from different students' viewpoints.；Jackie Brown 1997The money exchange is replayed through different participants' perspectives.
- Prompt 模板：`Show one lost-wallet incident three times: from the owner's view, a cleaner's view and a distant passenger's view. Preserve the same station clock, movements and wallet position, but reveal different occluded actions each time. The third version resolves the apparent theft without inventing a new event.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Split screen with [Subject] in one pane and another life in the other, simultaneous spaces, phone-call cinema or dual identity. Name the boundary, whether eyelines match, and what each pane contains.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Frame within Frame (a real window) or Cross-Cutting (sequential). The tell: a doorway in the set, or the model giving you one wide with a scratch down the middle. The fix: two fully directed spaces, a graphic divide, simultaneous time.

### Montage
- 别名：Associative juxtaposition, Idea generated by the cut ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/montage)
- 定义：Film montage creates meaning or compression through the ordered juxtaposition of shots. Each side of a join is a complete image; the claim lives in the order, the collision, or the months squeezed into a minute.
- 叙事功能：Workers, then a slaughterhouse. The cut is an argument. Or: sweat, rope, steps, a breath, the same stairs later, a body that can now climb. Time has collapsed, and the sequence did the climbing. Use it when you need months in a minute, or an idea neither image holds alone. It is the wrong tool when two ongoing actions must remain simultaneously alive: that is Cross-Cutting. It is the wrong tool when you only want to skip a few seconds in one setup: that is a Jump Cut. An evocative analogy is not factual proof. Do not let the sequence imply unsupported real-world causation.
- 怎么拍：State the intended inference or the time curve first. Choose images whose relation is legible: matching geometry for analogy, progressive sizes or sweat for training, repeated rituals for addiction. Control duration as a metric (shortening toward a peak, or a held pause as payoff). Prompt: montage sequence built around [Subject], time collapsed by images, training, travel, or a life in twenty shots.
- 何时用：Use it for training, a marriage dying over breakfasts, a city arriving, an essay of images. Do not use it to cover a scene you could have played in continuity. If the audience must follow one fight blow by blow, shoot the fight.
- 近似对比：Cross-Cutting, Jump Cut, Fragments, Quick Cuts, Cross-CuttingMeanwhile is the engine., Jump CutDo not soothe. Show the skip., Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
  Cross-Cutting braids parallel actions that continue. Montage often finishes each shot as a unit in an argument or a time-lapse of life. Jump Cut holes out one setup. Fragments withhold a complete view of one event; montage may show complete views whose collision is the event. Quick Cuts are a duration pattern; they become montage when the order makes a claim. Cross-CuttingMeanwhile is the engine. Jump CutDo not soothe. Show the skip. Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
- 片中实例：Rocky and The Karate Kid compress training into progressive labor. Strike and October collide images into political argument.；Citizen Kane breakfasts a marriage down to silence. Up condenses a life into selected moments.；Steal the function (compress, argue), not the needle-drops.；Strike 1925The repression of workers is juxtaposed with slaughterhouse imagery.；October 1927Religious images are combined into an overt visual argument.；Yi Yi 2000The father's and daughter's dates are linked across different places and experiences.
- Prompt 模板：`Create an essay montage alternating an automated sorting line with commuters moving through identical ticket gates. Match recurring barriers and mechanical rhythms to suggest institutional organization, while keeping humans visibly individual. No captions asserting the analogy as an objective fact.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Montage sequence built around [Subject], time collapsed by images, training, travel, or a life in twenty shots. List the ordered images, what the collision claims, and whether time or idea is the engine.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Quick Cuts with no claim, or a single moving camera. The tell: twenty angles of the same five seconds, or a morphing collage. The fix: pick an inference or a time span, choose distinct images, cut on order, let the join do the work.

### Axial Cut
- 别名：Jump along the camera axis, Cut-in emphasis ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/axial-cut)
- 定义：An axial cut jumps closer or farther along approximately the same camera axis, changing shot size without changing angle. The outgoing frame and the incoming frame share a viewpoint; only distance snaps.
- 叙事功能：A farmhouse kitchen, then the same kitchen larger, then an eye socket you were not ready to occupy. Recognition arrives as a series of shocks, not as a walk. Change shot size without changing angle. Use it for stepwise emphasis: a date in a book, a wound, a face that must suddenly fill the world. It is the wrong tool when you want a continuous approach. A Crash Zoom In is an optical move in time. A dolly-in is a walk. An axial cut is an edit. If the angle changes more than a few degrees, you have ordinary coverage, not an axial cut. If time is what you skipped inside one size, you have a Jump Cut.
- 怎么拍：Capture or generate matched wide, medium, and close compositions on the same axis. Preserve pose, eyeline, and background alignment enough that the jump is only scale. Choose deliberate steps (for example 50mm at 3 meters, then 50mm at 1 meter, or a punch-in crop that matches a true closer camera). Do not animate a zoom between the frames if the point is the snap. Prompt: axial cut jumping toward or away from [Subject] along the lens axis, punch-in without a zoom.
- 何时用：Use it when a detail must land as a blow: the date stamp, the empty eye, the gun on the table. Do not use it as a substitute for a motivated push-in during a long take. If the camera should walk, walk.
- 近似对比：Crash Zoom In, Jump Cut, Match on Action, Crash Zoom InPunctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting., Jump CutDo not soothe. Show the skip., Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
  A Crash Zoom In is a continuous, fast focal-length change. An axial cut is a splice. A Jump Cut skips time in a similar size; axial cut skips distance on one axis. Match on Action needs a bridging gesture; axial cut can hit a still figure. A push-in has parallax; a punch-in crop of one take has none, and is a cheaper cousin of a true closer camera on the same axis. Crash Zoom InPunctuate a hit, a realization, or a comic sting. Jump CutDo not soothe. Show the skip. Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
- 片中实例：The Birds sends Lydia through successive closer views of the dead farmer, the axis held, the scale jumping. The Shining uses hard axial emphasis on rooms and faces so space feels like a trap.；Goodfellas punches in for recognition rather than a polite zoom. Use the snap, not a copied kitchen.；The Birds 1963Lydia's discovery of the dead farmer is emphasized through successive closer views.
- Prompt 模板：`A librarian notices an impossible new date stamped inside an old book. Make three hard cuts on the same axis: desk-wide, book close-up, extreme close-up of the date. Keep the page and hands fixed, with no zoom animation, morph or lateral angle change. Add exact date text in compositing.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Axial cut jumping toward or away from [Subject] along the lens axis, punch-in without a zoom, a snap of scale. Name two or three matched framings, same angle, same pose, hard cuts.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a Crash Zoom In or a digital crop sold as a camera move. The tell: the lens breathes, or the angle walks off axis, or the subject morphs larger. The fix: two (or three) still-matched compositions, same axis, hard cuts, pose locked.

### Invisible Cut
- 别名：Substitution splice, Stop trick ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/invisible-cut)
- 定义：An invisible cut hides an edit through motion, darkness, occlusion, blur, matching geometry, or digital stitching. One side of the join and the other are meant to feel like a single take; the splice is a seam the audience should not find.
- 叙事功能：A coat fills the lens. When it leaves, the room is later, or the body is gone, or the street has changed. You needed a cut the audience must not feel. Stop-trick cinema did this with a locked camera and a substitution. Contemporary oners do it with whips, walls, and stitches. Use it to simulate a long take, to vanish a person, or to change time inside an apparently continuous walk. It is the wrong tool when the cut should be a sentence: a Match Cut, a Smash Cut, a Wipe. If you want the join seen, do not hide it. The trick depends on spatial continuity around the substitution. A wandering unmatched camera exposes an unintended jump.
- 怎么拍：Plan a hiding place: a passing body, a dark wall, a whip-pan blur, a matched doorway, a digital stitch on a texture. Lock exposure and lighting across plates if you are substituting. For a stop trick, lock the camera, hold actors, change the object, splice on the occlusion. For an oner illusion, match motion blur and grain at the whip. Prompt: invisible cut hidden in [Subject]'s whip, a dark wall, or a passing body, the oner illusion.
- 何时用：Use it to extend a take through a theatre, a trench, a street, or to make a woman vanish from a chair. Do not use it to avoid writing a scene change. If the geography actually transforms as you watch, that may be a Set Transition instead of a hidden splice.
- 近似对比：Oner, Whip Pan, Match on Action, Set Transition, Morph, OnerThe scene is a ride., Whip PanTransition, punchline, or sudden attention shift., Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
  A Oner is the long take you are faking or actually shooting. A Whip Pan can be the bandage over the splice. Match on Action hides a cut in a readable gesture but still changes the view on purpose. Set Transition lets the location rewrite itself. Morph is a visible interpolation, the opposite of invisible. OnerThe scene is a ride. Whip PanTransition, punchline, or sudden attention shift. Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
- 片中实例：The Vanishing Lady substitutes a seated woman between frames. A Trip to the Moon pops Selenites out of existence.；Rope hides joins in dark foregrounds. 1917 and Birdman stitch walks so trenches and theatres feel continuous.；Spectre's opening presents multiple spaces as one shot. Grammar of concealment, not a take to clone.；The Vanishing Lady 1896A seated woman apparently disappears and is replaced.；A Trip to the Moon 1902Selenites disappear in bursts when struck.；1917 2019Long continuous-looking stretches through trenches, ruins and open ground.
- Prompt 模板：`A stage magician drops a cloth over an empty chair. At the instant the cloth fills the chair silhouette, cut to an identically framed plate with a bouquet beneath it. The magician lifts the cloth. Locked camera, matching hands and shadows, no liquid morph or camera move. Generate two plates and join them at the occlusion.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Invisible cut hidden in [Subject]'s whip, a dark wall, or a passing body, the oner illusion. Name the hiding action, the before plate, the after plate, and that the camera path should appear continuous.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a visible Whip Pan that never hides a join, or a morph. The tell: a pop in grain, a jump in crowd, a morphing wall. The fix: a true occluder or blur that fills the frame, matched lighting, a hard splice inside that fill, continuous motion on both sides.

### J-Cut / L-Cut (Visual Setup)
- 别名：Contrapuntal sound, Ironic music ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/l-cut-visual)
- 定义：A J-cut or L-cut visual setup is a picture designed so sound can lead or lag across the splice. One side of the join is a face, a room, or a listener that can hold; the other side is a space already speaking, or still speaking after we have left it.
- 叙事功能：We hear the next room before we see it (J-cut): the picture stays on the walker, the voice has already arrived. Or we see the listener while the speaker's words continue (L-cut): the face is the bridge. Sound will lead or lag. The face is the bridge. Use it when picture and track should not cut on the same frame, so thought can cross a doorway. It is the wrong tool when you need both rooms visible at once (Split Screen) or when you only need a mute reaction insert with no overlapping track. Randomly mismatched music is not automatically meaningful counterpoint. Define what the lag reveals: dread, irony, a voice that will not let the face go.
- 怎么拍：On the timeline, a J-cut lets incoming audio start under the outgoing picture. An L-cut lets outgoing audio continue under the incoming picture. The visual setup is a shot that can bear that overlap: a Reaction Shot, a walk toward a door, an empty office. Keep the sound's source clear enough that the overlap is information, not muddle. Prompt: a frame of [Subject] designed as the picture half of an L-cut or J-cut, reaction holding while another space is already speaking.
- 何时用：Use it to enter a conversation before the room, to stay on a listener after a confession, to let a song continue over a packing scene it does not belong to. Do not use it as default dialogue cutting if both faces should share the same on-camera words. If you need meanwhile geography, Cross-Cutting.
- 近似对比：Reaction Shot, Cross-Cutting, Smash Cut, Reaction ShotThe important action is watching., Cross-CuttingMeanwhile is the engine., Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
  A Reaction Shot is the picture; J-cut and L-cut are how that picture meets sound. Cross-Cutting alternates whole lines. A smash in sound on a picture cut is closer to Smash Cut. Counterpoint (cheerful music on a cruel image) can ride an L-cut, but the technique here is the staggered splice, not the playlist. Reaction ShotThe important action is watching. Cross-CuttingMeanwhile is the engine. Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
- 片中实例：The Social Network and Heat keep speech living over listeners' faces so thought continues across the join. The Conversation makes incoming sound a threat before the picture explains it.；Yi Yi lets piano arrive before its source is located. A Clockwork Orange and Reservoir Dogs place cheerful tracks against behavior the picture will not bless.；Use the stagger, not the needle-drop.；A Clockwork Orange 1971Cheerful performance is placed against disturbing behavior.；Reservoir Dogs 1992The radio song contrasts with the warehouse torture scene.；Yi Yi 2000Piano music is heard before its source is fully located visually.
- Prompt 模板：`A cheerful original corporate jingle plays over a spotless office being emptied after a sudden closure. Workers quietly pack plants and family photographs while the tune maintains its bright tempo. Generate restrained visual coverage and compose an original cue; do not imitate an existing recording or melody.`
- 示例 Prompt：`A frame of [Subject] designed as the picture half of an L-cut or J-cut, reaction holding while another space is already speaking. For stills, describe a listening face or a doorway that can hold offscreen voice.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a mute Reaction Shot with picture and sound cutting together, or a Cross-Cutting that never overlaps track. The tell: lips in the new room are already talking in sync at the picture cut, with no pre-lap. The fix: hold the first picture while the second track starts, or hold the first track after the picture has moved.

### Crash Cut
- 别名：Start inside the event, Flash-forward opening ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/crash-cut)
- 定义：A crash cut slams two images together with no blend, so the join itself stings. One side of the splice and the other collide; unlike a smash that breaks an earned quiet, a crash cut often starts inside the event or hits like a drum from the first frame.
- 叙事功能：A trunk, a man, a knife already in play, then the story will explain how we got here. Or a cymbal, a face, a rehearsal that never had a polite establishing wide. The next image must hurt, and it must hurt immediately. Use it as percussion, as in medias res, as a refusal of the soft open. It is the wrong tool when you have just built a hush that should be betrayed: that betrayal is a Smash Cut. It is the wrong tool when you only skip time in one seat: that is a Jump Cut. A few frames of interrupt are a Flash Cut, not a committed new scene. Do not open on a sensation the rest of the story cannot causally earn.
- 怎么拍：Cut A to B with maximum difference in scale, brightness, or violence of content, and with no mix. Often B is already mid-action (a trunk, a gun, a kit). Mark any later temporal reset clearly (a title, a younger haircut) so the crash is a structure, not an accident. Prompt: crash cut on [Subject], two images colliding with no polite blend, a hard join that should sting.
- 何时用：Use it to open on the consequence, to hit a downbeat, to refuse an establishing courtesy. Do not use it between two similar wides. If A was a long prayer, consider smash. If B lasts three frames, consider flash.
- 近似对比：Smash Cut, Jump Cut, Flash Cut, Quick Cuts, Smash CutThe next image should hurt., Jump CutDo not soothe. Show the skip., Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
  A Smash Cut breaks an earned state (quiet, closure, prayer). A crash cut is the collision as a blow, often before a state was offered. A Jump Cut stays similar. A Flash Cut is too short to become the new scene. Quick Cuts are a run of short shots; a crash is one brutal splice. Smash CutThe next image should hurt. Jump CutDo not soothe. Show the skip. Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
- 片中实例：Goodfellas opens in the trunk, then later supplies the life that led there. Fight Club starts inside a crisis and then rewinds the path.；Whiplash and Requiem for a Dream use hard joins as rhythmic blows. Use the sting and the delayed explanation, not a copied trunk.；Goodfellas 1990The trunk scene precedes the account of Henry's earlier life.；Fight Club 1999The opening crisis is followed by the path that led there.
- Prompt 模板：`Design three sequences: begin with a violinist standing alone on a flooded stage holding an unopened letter; cut to a calm morning before the concert; later return to the stage with the meaning of the letter now clear. Generate each sequence separately and edit the order deliberately. No unrelated mystery props.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Crash cut on [Subject], two images colliding with no polite blend, a hard join that should sting. Name A and B, the scale or sound collision, and that B may already be mid-event.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Smash Cut (after a hush) or Flash Cut (a few frames). The tell: a long quiet setup before the hit (that is smash), or B vanishing before it can be a scene (that is flash). The fix: collide two committed images, start inside the event if that is the structure, cut hard.

### Flash Cut
- 别名：Future presented as memory ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/flash-cut)
- 定义：A flash cut interrupts the present image with a few frames of another picture, then returns or races on before the insert can be studied. One side of the join is the ongoing scene; the other is lightning: a thought, a future, a wound, lasting a blink.
- 叙事功能：A face in a room. Three frames of a well, a tape, a child. The room again. You cannot inventory what you saw, but it has already happened to you. A thought that lasts three frames. Use it for intrusion: prophecy wearing the clothes of memory, a trauma tic, a subliminal threat. It is the wrong tool when the other image should become the scene. That committed landing is a Crash Cut or Smash Cut. A white frame that is only exposure is a Light Flash, not another picture. Keep the insert temporally honest enough that a later anchor can fix it. Mystery is not the same as no clue.
- 怎么拍：Hold the present shot. Insert 1 to 8 frames of a different image (often high contrast, closer, or from another time). Return to the present, or chain flashes. Do not dissolve; the brevity is the grammar. Picture may be silent or carry a tick of sound. Prompt: flash cut through [Subject], a few frames of another image interrupting, lightning in the edit.
- 何时用：Use it when a mind is leaking another time, or when a threat should be unreadable but present. Do not use it as decoration on a trailer. If the audience must read the insert, give it a shot, not a flash.
- 近似对比：Crash Cut, Light Flash, Jump Cut, Smash Cut, Crash CutThe next image must hurt., Light FlashA cut that is also a wound of light., Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
  A Crash Cut stays with the new image. A Light Flash is a burst of light, not a second diegesis. A Jump Cut skips time in a similar frame without inserting a foreign picture. Smash Cut commits to contrast as the new present. Flash cut is an interrupt. Crash CutThe next image must hurt. Light FlashA cut that is also a wound of light. Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
- 片中实例：The Ring uses stolen frames as contamination. Natural Born Killers sprays interruptive images as a nervous system.；Arrival presents images that first read as memory and are later re-placed in time. Use the brevity and the later anchor, not a copied well.；Arrival 2016Images initially read as memories are later understood in a different temporal relation.
- Prompt 模板：`Show brief intimate images of a woman teaching a child to repair a radio, initially without dates or age labels. In the present, she has never met the child. A later encounter reveals these are future moments. Generate stable radio and room details that make the temporal recognition precise.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Flash cut through [Subject], a few frames of another image interrupting, lightning in the edit. Name the present scene, the insert (and its duration in frames), and the return.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Light Flash (no second image) or Crash Cut (the insert stays). The tell: a white blink, or a new scene that never returns to the present. The fix: a countable handful of frames of a different picture, then the original scene, hard cuts.

### Match Motion
- 别名：Motion bridge, Seamless spatial jump ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/match-motion)
- 定义：A match-motion cut continues direction and speed across the splice so the cut rides a vector even when location, time, or reality changes. One side of the join starts a movement; the other side keeps that movement, and the world around the body may be new.
- 叙事功能：A fall toward a mattress becomes a fall toward grass. A dive into a pool completes as a lunge onto a bed. Hide the cut inside a vector. The body is the continuity; the room is allowed to lie. Use it to carry someone through an impossible transition: dream to street, train to meadow, one chase into another. It is the wrong tool when you are still in the same room and only changing cameras on one gesture: that is Match on Action. Matching only the actor's face, with no shared phase of motion, will not hide the leap. A whip can supply the blur that sells the vector (Whip Pan), but the match is the body's direction and speed, not the smear alone.
- 怎么拍：Match pose, screen position, camera angle, motion direction, and speed at the cut. Plan the two shots as a pair (or a shared rig). Cut at a readable phase: mid-fall, mid-turn, mid-stride. The outgoing world and the incoming world can disagree; the vector must not. Prompt: match-motion cut on [Subject], direction and speed continuing across the join so the cut rides the movement.
- 何时用：Use it to leave a dream, to stitch a chase across towns, to let a dance continue in another decade. Do not use it as ordinary coverage inside one hallway. If the action is the same event, match on action. If only the contour matches and the body is still, use a Graphic Match or Match Cut.
- 近似对比：Match on Action, Whip Pan, Match Cut, Invisible Cut, Match on ActionHide the cut in a movement., Whip PanTransition, punchline, or sudden attention shift., Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
  Match on Action is one continuous event, two views, same world. Match-motion can change the world if the vector holds. A Whip Pan hides a cut in camera blur; match-motion hides it in subject motion (they can combine). A Match Cut may be still. Invisible Cut conceals a splice in occlusion; the motion match is a visible, readable continuation. Match on ActionHide the cut in a movement. Whip PanTransition, punchline, or sudden attention shift. Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
- 片中实例：The Graduate connects pool and bedroom through Benjamin's movement so the body finishes what the water started. Paprika carries gestures between incompatible dream spaces.；Baby Driver rides motion from music and cars across joins. Lawrence of Arabia's match-to-sun is more a still match cut; use it only if you are matching a rising gesture, not just a circle.；Borrow the vector, not the wardrobe.；The Graduate 1967Benjamin's movement connects the swimming pool and bedroom imagery.；Paprika 2006Dream transitions carry gestures and movement between incompatible spaces.
- Prompt 模板：`Generate A: a woman falls backward onto a train berth. Generate B: the same woman completes the identical backward movement onto grass in a sunlit field. Match body pose, clothing, framing and velocity at the cut. Hard transition between worlds, no dissolving mattress or body morph.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Match-motion cut on [Subject], direction and speed continuing across the join so the cut rides the movement. Name the outgoing path, the incoming path, matched pose and velocity, and what world changes.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Match on Action (same room) or a Match Cut of two stills. The tell: the walk resets, speed changes, or the subject is static on both sides. The fix: match phase, direction, and speed; let geography jump; cut during the move.

### Match Split
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/match-split)
- 定义：A match split continues a graphic line or motion across a divide, so one contour belongs to two worlds at once. One side of the join is a pane or half-frame; the other is its partner; the shared edge, horizon, or gesture is the match.
- 叙事功能：A table edge runs from a 1960s kitchen into a present-day diner. A face is halved: left is the party you imagined, right is the party you got. One line, two worlds. Use it when a split should feel like one organism rather than two televisions. It is the wrong tool when the panes have no shared contour and are only simultaneous: that is ordinary Split Screen. It is also the wrong tool when you cut from one full frame to another rhyming full frame: that is a Match Cut or Graphic Match. The divide is not a scratch. It is a designed seam that the eye can follow.
- 怎么拍：Compose both halves so a line, eyeline, horizon, or motion vector continues across the boundary. Match scale of heads if two versions of one person share a couch. Keep lighting motivated per world unless the gag is that light also matches. Prompt: match split of [Subject], a graphic divide that continues a line or motion into another space.
- 何时用：Use it for twins, double lives, expectation versus reality, a road that is two times of day. Do not use it if the two spaces should not touch graphically. If you need a phone call with frankly separate rooms, a clean split is enough.
- 近似对比：Split Screen, Match Cut, Frame within Frame, Graphic Match, Match CutTwo images are the same idea., Split ScreenTwo rooms, one moment., Graphic MatchForm carries you across time.
  Split Screen co-presents; match split is a split whose form rhymes or continues. A Match Cut replaces one full image with another. Frame within Frame is a window in the set. Graphic Match happens across a hard cut in time, not across a simultaneous seam. Match CutTwo images are the same idea. Split ScreenTwo rooms, one moment. Graphic MatchForm carries you across time.
- 片中实例：The Parent Trap seats two versions of one girl in a shared graphic so the split is a relationship. (500) Days of Summer divides a party into expectation and reality along a readable seam.；Use the continued line, not the plot.
- Prompt 模板：`Match split of [Subject], a graphic divide that continues a line or motion into another space. Name the shared contour (horizon, table, eyeline), what each half contains, and that both are simultaneous.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Match split of [Subject], a graphic divide that continues a line or motion into another space.`
