- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a generic Split Screen with unmatched eyelines, or a Match Cut in sequence. The tell: two stacked clips with no shared line, or a cut instead of a co-present seam. The fix: design the divide, continue one contour, hold both worlds at once.

### Quick Cuts
- 别名：Accelerating cut pattern, Metric tension ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/quick-cuts)
- 定义：Quick cuts editing strings shots shorter than a breath, so duration itself becomes rhythm, pressure, or music. Each side of a join is a full view from a changing setup; the meaning is the rate, not a skip inside one frame.
- 叙事功能：Eyes, hands, a kit, a face, the room, the stick, faster. You feel a release coming before the last hit lands. Pace is the meaning. A sudden hold in that pattern can be the climax. Use it when acceleration or a metric pulse should do narrative work: a showdown tightening from bodies to eyes, a raid, a practice that becomes punishment. It is the wrong tool when the similar frame is losing time: that is a Jump Cut. It is the wrong tool when you are withholding the complete event in shards: that is Fragments. Faster is not always more tense. Contrast between acceleration and a held pause often carries the payoff.
- 怎么拍：Design a duration curve and a progression of shot sizes. Alternate angles enough that each cut is a new view, not a hole in one view. Use musical or physical accents selectively; not every splice must land on a beat. Prompt: quick cuts around [Subject], shots shorter than a breath, rhythm as violence or music.
- 何时用：Use it to tighten a duel, a performance, a chase through hands and gauges. Do not use it on a conversation that needs air. If the pattern never rests, the last hit has nowhere to land.
- 近似对比：Jump Cut, Crash Cut, Montage, Fragments, Jump CutDo not soothe. Show the skip., Crash CutThe next image must hurt., Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
  A Jump Cut is a skip inside a similar setup. A Crash Cut is one brutal join. Montage may use short shots, but montage's job is collision of meaning or collapsed months; quick cuts' job is rate. Fragments hide the whole action; quick cuts often show the action in many complete, brief views. Jump CutDo not soothe. Show the skip. Crash CutThe next image must hurt. Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
- 片中实例：The Good, the Bad and the Ugly tightens the three-way showdown from bodies and positions toward faces and eyes. Whiplash binds image duration to pressure and rhythm.；Mad Max: Fury Road and Requiem for a Dream use short shots as pulse. Steal the curve, not the coverage plan.；The Good, the Bad and the Ugly 1966The three-way showdown tightens from bodies and positions toward faces and eyes.；Whiplash 2014Performance passages bind image duration to pressure and rhythm.
- Prompt 模板：`Create a tense three-person card-game ending. Begin with wide spatial views, then progressively shorter shots of faces, hands and one face-down card. Accelerate the cutting while preserving who sits where, then hold a long silent close-up before the card turns. Assemble rhythm in the edit.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Quick cuts around [Subject], shots shorter than a breath, rhythm as violence or music. List a progression of sizes (wide to eyes, or hands to kit) and a duration curve.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Jump Cut (same frame, missing time) or chaos with no curve. The tell: every shot is the same length and size, or the camera never changes axis. The fix: new views, shortening (or a designed break), a last image that can resolve the pulse.

### Set Transition
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/set-transition)
- 定义：A set transition lets the location change in camera: walls walk, architecture rewrites, one space becomes another without a hard cut. Both sides of the join are geographies that share a continuous camera path; the set itself is the editor.
- 叙事功能：A dressing room wall slides and you are in a nightclub. A theatre door is a street. Geography itself edits. The subject may not have cut; the world did. Use it when the story's spaces are porous: backstage as mind, city as stage, a lobby that rewrites under fire. It is the wrong tool when you only need to hide a splice in a whip: that is an Invisible Cut. It is the wrong tool when A melts into B as a picture: that is Morphing. If the camera passes through a wall into another place as a portal gag, you are next to Pass Through. Set transition is the room changing around the body.
- 怎么拍：Build two (or more) complete spaces that can physically or digitally replace each other on a continuous move: sliding flats, revolving walls, a stitch on a doorway, a digital set extension that rewrites. Keep lighting motivated as the space changes, or let the lights change as part of the trick. Prompt: set transition around [Subject], the location transforming in camera, walls walking, one space becoming another. Motion brief: the set around [Subject] transforms into a new location without a hard cut.
- 何时用：Use it to walk from rehearsal into performance, from memory into a street, from one building into another without admitting an edit. Do not use it if a hard cut or a wipe would tell the truth faster. Virtuosity with nothing new in the second space is empty.
- 近似对比：Invisible Cut, Pass Through, Morphing, Match Motion, Pass ThroughCut the building, not the film., MorphingBecoming is visible., Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
  An Invisible Cut conceals a splice; the set may stay the same. A Pass Through drives the camera through a surface into another space. Morphing interpolates the image. A set transition rewrites architecture along a continuous path, theatrical or digital. Match Motion can change worlds on a body vector without the walls walking. Pass ThroughCut the building, not the film. MorphingBecoming is visible. Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
- 片中实例：Birdman lets theatre and city feel like one porous set. 1917 hides joins so trenches, ruins, and fields play as continuous geography.；The Matrix lobby rewrites a space through action and spatial continuity. Use the porous building, not a copied tracking path.
- Prompt 模板：`Set transition around [Subject], the location transforming in camera, walls walking, one space becoming another. Name the starting architecture, the ending architecture, and that the camera does not hard-cut.`
- 示例 Prompt：`For video: the set around [Subject] transforms into a new location without a hard cut. No morphing faces; the room is what changes.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Morphing the actor, or a visible cut in a doorway. The tell: the person melts, or there is a pop at the threshold. The fix: keep the body continuous, let walls or set extension rewrite, hide or omit the splice, match lighting across the change.

### Transitions
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/transitions)
- 定义：Film transitions are designed joins: the splice treated as a visible gesture rather than as continuity glue. One side of the join and the other are planned as a pair, and the audience is meant to notice how we left A and entered B.
- 叙事功能：A wipe turns a page. A match claims an idea. A dissolve remembers. A whip throws you. The cut should be seen. This is the parent of those gestures, not a substitute for choosing one. Use it when invisible continuity would lie, or when the join is the joke, the thesis, or the chapter mark. It is the wrong tool when the scene should feel found and unedited. Then hide the cut, or do not cut. Pick a species. 'A cool transition' is not a shot list. Name wipe, match, mix, light, or whip.
- 怎么拍：Decide what the join must do: rhyme (Match Cut), mix (Dissolve), empty (Fade In / Fade Out), travel an edge (Wipe), point (Iris), blur (Whip Pan), or rewrite space (Set Transition). Design A and B together so the chosen gesture has material to work with. Prompt: a designed transition around [Subject], the join as a gesture: wipe, morph, match, or light.
- 何时用：Use it at act breaks, world leaps, jokes about cinema, or any time the how of leaving matters. Do not use a designed transition on every reverse in a talk scene. If nothing in the story changes at the splice except the camera, a straight cut is the design.
- 近似对比：Match Cut, Dissolve, Whip Pan, Wipe, Invisible Cut, Match CutTwo images are the same idea., Whip PanTransition, punchline, or sudden attention shift., DissolveMemory, passage, or a gentle death of a scene.
  A Match Cut is a correspondence across a hard cut. A Dissolve is a mix. A Whip Pan can hide or announce a join through blur. A Wipe shows a traveling edge. This page is the choice to make the join a gesture; those pages are the species. Invisible Cut is the opposing doctrine. Match CutTwo images are the same idea. Whip PanTransition, punchline, or sudden attention shift. DissolveMemory, passage, or a gentle death of a scene.
- 片中实例：Star Wars makes scene changes into directional wipes, a serial grammar. 2001: A Space Odyssey makes a hard match the largest leap in the film.；Use them as proof that a visible join can carry story, not as a kit to paste on every cut.
- Prompt 模板：`For video, generate A and B as complete shots, then specify the gesture (hard match, mix, traveling edge, whip). Do not write 'cool transition' or 'seamless' if you want the join seen.`
- 示例 Prompt：`A designed transition around [Subject], the join as a gesture: wipe, morph, match, or light. Name both sides and the species of join.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is an Invisible Cut you accidentally made visible, or a morph used because no join was chosen. The tell: A and B have no designed relationship, and a filter slurries them. The fix: pick a species, give both sides a job, execute that physics only.

### Fragments
- 别名：Constructed action, Montage implication ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/editing/fragments)
- 定义：Fragments, or fragmented editing, build an event from partial views, so the audience infers an action more complete than anything shown in one shot. Each side of a join is a shard: a blade, a mouth, a drain, a hand too late; the whole lives in the gaps.
- 叙事功能：You never get the master. You get a sleeve, a missed catch, a face, ceramic already on the floor, and one offscreen crash. Do not give the whole. The viewer assembles the blow. Use it to make an impact intense while withholding explicit depiction, or to show a night that will not assemble. It is the wrong tool when the audience must see a legal, continuous action. It is also not just speed: Quick Cuts can show complete blows rapidly. Fragments hide the complete blow. Fast shards alone do not guarantee clarity. Direction, causal order, and sound have to let the viewer reconstruct the event.
- 怎么拍：Break the event into distinct visual elements that can be shot safely: the approaching object, a body part, a reaction, the aftermath. Preserve screen direction and order. Bind with timing and sound; do not require the dangerous contact on camera. Prompt: fragments of [Subject], shattered coverage, pieces of a moment, the scene as shards. Name what is missing.
- 何时用：Use it for a shower, a staircase massacre built from details, a panic, a memory. Do not use it for a demonstration that must be readable as one take. If the pieces cannot be ordered into a cause, you have a Collage, not an event.
- 近似对比：Quick Cuts, Montage, Collage, Jump Cut, Quick CutsPace is the meaning., CollageOne image is not enough; stack them., Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
  Quick Cuts are a rate pattern and may show complete actions. Montage collides complete images for an idea or a month. Collage is a paper or composite of pieces as a surface. Jump Cut holes one setup. Fragments are incomplete views of one action whose whole is inferred. Quick CutsPace is the meaning. CollageOne image is not enough; stack them. Match CutTwo images are the same idea.
- 片中实例：Psycho constructs the shower from brief fragments, reactions, and sound rather than one continuous explicit view. Battleship Potemkin builds the Odessa Steps from details and reactions.；Requiem for a Dream and Memento use shards as a nervous or backward structure. Use inference, not a copied stab.；Psycho 1960The shower murder is constructed from brief fragments, reactions and sound rather than one continuous explicit view.；Battleship Potemkin 1925The Odessa Steps sequence builds violence through details and reactions.
- Prompt 模板：`Imply a valuable vase being accidentally knocked over without showing the full break. Generate separate shots of a sleeve brushing its base, a hand reaching too late, a startled face and ceramic pieces already on the floor. Join with one offscreen crash. No real hazardous stunt or incoherent object duplication.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Fragments of [Subject], shattered coverage, pieces of a moment, the scene as shards. List the shards in causal order and name the missing master.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Quick Cuts of the same complete wide, or a Collage texture. The tell: a master already shows the whole, or the pieces have no direction. The fix: withhold the complete contact, keep a causal line, let sound and order finish the blow in the viewer's head.

## 氛围与天气 / Atmosphere and Weather（13 条）

**速查**：Rain · Fog · Mist · Atmospheric Haze · Smoke · Dust Motes · Steam · Snow · Wet-Down · Sparks and Embers · Dust and Sand · Underwater · Ocean

### Rain
- 别名：haze, fog, smoke, dust, snow, steam ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/atmosphere/rain)
- 定义：Rain in film is falling water that makes air visible as streaks and turns the ground into a mirror. Drops are matter in the optical path; without backlight they vanish, and without a wet-down the street stays dry under a fake storm.
- 叙事功能：Silver needles between a lamp and the lens. Shoulders darken. Puddles double the neon. Weather is percussion you can see. Make the air visible and the ground reflective. Use it when the scene must be wet in depth, not only on a window pane. It is the wrong tool when you only need specular streets at night with no falling drops: that is a Wet-Down. It is also the wrong tool when you want a still veil that hides geography: that is Fog. Rain against a bright overcast sky reads as nothing. Put a light behind the drops, toward camera, or lose the storm.
- 怎么拍：Put water in the air (rain bars, towers, or a real front) and light it from behind or the side so droplets scatter toward the lens. Keep a darkish background so streaks separate. Wet the ground even if the rain is light. Shutter angle controls streak length versus beads. Prompt: heavy rain around [Subject], backlit drops, wet-down pavement, umbrellas, silver streaks, weather as percussion.
- 何时用：Use it for a night street, a rooftop, a prison yard, any beat that needs falling water as a layer. Do not use it as a grade or as window tracks only. If the air is empty and the asphalt is merely shiny, you shot a wet-down.
- 近似对比：Wet-Down, Atmospheric Haze, Snow, Fog, Wet-DownNight exteriors that must sparkle., Atmospheric HazeShow kilometers, not just meters., FogHide geography. Delay the reveal.
  A Wet-Down soaks surfaces so lights double; it need not rain. Atmospheric Haze is a distant scatter, not falling drops. Snow is ice that settles and accumulates. Fog is a local veil that hides figures. Rain falls, streaks when backlit, and leaves the ground wet. Wet-DownNight exteriors that must sparkle. Atmospheric HazeShow kilometers, not just meters. FogHide geography. Delay the reveal.
- 片中实例：Blade Runner builds night as backlit rain and reflective streets. Seven uses rain as a constant layer over investigation.；The Shawshank Redemption lets a yard storm become a body-length release. Use drop, backlight, and wet ground, not a copied coat.
- Prompt 模板：`Heavy rain around [Subject], backlit drops, wet-down pavement, umbrellas, silver streaks, weather as percussion. Name the backlight (a streetlamp, a sign, a HMI behind the rain), the wet ground, and drop size.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Heavy cinematic rain around [Subject], backlit drops, wet-down pavement, umbrellas, silver streaks, weather as percussion.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Wet-Down (shiny street, empty air) or a blue LUT called rain. The tell: no streaks against lamps, dry shoulders, no puddles. The fix: put drops in the air, backlight them, wet the ground.

### Fog
- 别名：haze, smoke, dust, rain, snow, steam ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/atmosphere/fog)
- 定义：Fog is a dense local suspension of water droplets that collapses depth, turns lamps into globes, and delays the reveal of figures. The air is matter close to camera; geography hides until someone walks into the last few meters.
- 叙事功能：A sodium lamp becomes a ball. A platform ends in nothing. A coat arrives late, as if the world were only as large as a flashlight. Hide geography. Delay the reveal. Use it for horror, docks, London streets, any beat that should withhold the next plane. It is the wrong tool when you still want kilometers of readable landscape: that is Atmospheric Haze. It is the wrong tool when the veil is thin and lyrical: that is Mist. Combustion with a source is Smoke. If faces at three meters are crisp and only the grade is grey, you do not have fog. You have a LUT.
- 怎么拍：Fill a volume with dense droplets (machines or weather) so contrast falls with distance on a short scale. Backlight or sidelight the fog to make globes around practicals; front light flattens it to milk. Keep practicals inside the soup, not only a filter on the lens. Prompt: dense fog around [Subject], depth collapsing, lamps becoming globes, figures appearing late, horror or London grammar.
- 何时用：Use it when a figure should appear late, a road should end in white, a house should have no yard. Do not use it on a vista you still need to read. If the far ridge must stay a ridge, use haze or mist.
- 近似对比：Mist, Atmospheric Haze, Smoke, Steam, MistSofter mystery than fog. Lyric, not monster., Atmospheric HazeShow kilometers, not just meters., RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
  Mist is thinner: layered, see-through, lyric. Atmospheric Haze stacks paler planes over kilometers, not a wall at ten meters. Smoke has a source and a direction and is not weather. Steam rises from heat and thins as it cools. Fog is a local, dense water veil. MistSofter mystery than fog. Lyric, not monster. Atmospheric HazeShow kilometers, not just meters. RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
- 片中实例：The Exorcist and The Others use fog to withhold houses, lamps, and bodies. Sicario lets dust and fog-like veils erase desert edges (a cousin in opacity).；Use delayed reveal and globes around lamps, not a copied graveyard.
- Prompt 模板：`Dense fog around [Subject], depth collapsing, lamps becoming globes, figures appearing late. Name density (visibility in meters), the practicals blooming, and what is hidden.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Dense fog around [Subject], depth collapsing, lamps becoming globes, figures appearing late, horror or London grammar.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Atmospheric Haze (distance) or a desaturated grade. The tell: sharp buildings a block away, lamps with no globes, faces fully lit at thirty meters. The fix: short visibility, backlit bloom on lights, late arrivals.

### Mist
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/atmosphere/mist)
- 定义：Mist is a thinner water suspension than fog: pale layered air that still lets you read the next plane. Droplets are matter, but the veil is lyric, a morning or mountain breath rather than a wall.
- 叙事功能：Ridges stack as paler copies of themselves. A horse is readable, then a second ridge, then a paler third. Softer mystery than fog. Lyric, not monster. Use it for dawn, river valleys, high cold air, a courtyard that should glow rather than vanish. It is the wrong tool when a killer should appear at two meters with no yard behind them: that is Fog. It is the wrong tool when the paleness is only far, far away over desert: that is Atmospheric Haze. If you cannot see the subject at all, you overshot into fog. If every plane is equally sharp, you have no mist.
- 怎么拍：Use a light density of droplets or a real inversion layer. Backlight the layers so each plane separates (aerial perspective at short-to-medium range). Keep contrast on the near subject; let receding planes lift in value and lose saturation. Prompt: light mist around [Subject], softer than fog, morning or mountain breath, layers of pale air.
- 何时用：Use it for a hunt at dawn, a mountain pass, a wet garden. Do not use it as horror soup, and do not fill an interior with it unless the windows are open on a cold morning. Interiors with volume are often Smoke or haze juice, not mist.
- 近似对比：Fog, Atmospheric Haze, Smoke, Rain, FogHide geography. Delay the reveal., Atmospheric HazeShow kilometers, not just meters., RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
  Fog hides. Atmospheric Haze is scattering over long distance, often without local wetness on skin. Smoke has a source. Rain falls. Mist hangs, layers, and remains see-through at working distance. FogHide geography. Delay the reveal. Atmospheric HazeShow kilometers, not just meters. RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
- 片中实例：The Revenant uses morning and mountain moisture as stacked pale planes around bodies. Raise the Red Lantern lets courtyard air go milky without erasing architecture.；Use layered breath, not a white-out.
- Prompt 模板：`Light mist around [Subject], softer than fog, morning or mountain breath, layers of pale air. Name near-subject readability, paler far planes, and a backlight or low sun.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Light mist around [Subject], softer than fog, morning or mountain breath, layers of pale air.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Fog (too dense) or Atmospheric Haze (only the horizon pales). The tell: the hero vanishes, or only the skyline is pale while mid-ground is hard. The fix: keep the subject readable, stack two or three paler planes, backlight the moisture.

### Atmospheric Haze
- 别名：haze, fog, smoke, dust, rain, snow ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/atmosphere/haze)
- 定义：Atmospheric haze is scattering over distance: far planes go paler and often cooler, so kilometers of air become the depth cue. The particles are too small to read as drops; the air is matter you measure in ridges, not in globes around a near lamp.
- 叙事功能：A citadel sits in a paler key than the rider. The next cliff is paler still. Show kilometers, not just meters. Depth is weather, not a second fog machine at the actor's feet. Use it for desert, city, sea, any wide that must recede. It is the wrong tool when the next person should vanish at five meters (Fog) or when you want a shaft you can cut with a hand (Volumetric Light in a smoky room). Haze is aerial perspective, not a local veil. If the foreground is milky, you hazed the lens, not the distance.
- 怎么拍：Keep the near ground relatively clean. Let successive planes lift in value, lose contrast, and often shift toward the sky color. Dust, humidity, or pollution can be real; a graded aerial perspective can stand in if the physics hold. Hard sun through haze becomes a disk. Prompt: atmospheric haze stacking distance around [Subject], aerial perspective, far planes paler, depth as weather.
- 何时用：Use it on a ridge, a skyline, a valley, a megacity grid. Do not use it to hide a monster in a corridor. If the scare is in the room, use fog, smoke, or darkness.
- 近似对比：Mist, Fog, Volumetric Light, Dust and Sand, Volumetric LightAir has to be photographed, not just the subject., MistSofter mystery than fog. Lyric, not monster., RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
  Mist is local layered moisture at human distances. Fog is dense and near. Volumetric Light is a beam made visible by particles, often indoors. Dust and Sand is wind-driven grit that attacks the near ground too. Haze leaves the subject sharp and sends the world backward. Volumetric LightAir has to be photographed, not just the subject. MistSofter mystery than fog. Lyric, not monster. RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
- 片中实例：Lawrence of Arabia lets desert distance go paler until armies are weather. Blade Runner 2049 stacks orange and pale planes so the city has kilometers.；Use successive paler ridges, not a fogged close-up.
- Prompt 模板：`Atmospheric haze stacking distance around [Subject], aerial perspective, far planes paler, depth as weather. Keep the near subject contrasty; name two or three receding planes.`
- 示例 Prompt：`For video, stable long-distance paleness, not swirling soup around the lens. No globes on a foreground practical unless you also have local fog.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Fog on the actor, or a low-contrast grade on every plane. The tell: the face is milky, or the far citadel is as sharp as the horse. The fix: sharp near, paler far, several stacked distances, particles too small to resolve.

### Smoke
- 别名：haze, fog, dust, rain, snow, steam ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/atmosphere/smoke)
- 定义：Smoke is combustion particles with a source, a direction, and enough density to turn a room's air into a volume the light can strike. Unlike weather fog, it has a chimney, a cigarette, a tire, or a battlefield; backlight carves it into shafts and swirls.
- 叙事功能：A practical lamp becomes a wedge through grey air. A drag on a cigarette writes a ribbon. Photograph the air of a room. The walls were always there; now the air is too. Use it when volume should be visible indoors or when a battle, a chimney, or a club must have a source. It is the wrong tool when the veil is weather with no fire (Fog, Mist). It is the wrong tool when the white stuff rises off a manhole because water met cold air: that is Steam. Without a key or backlight, smoke is only a smell. Front-filling a room with unlit smoke turns faces to mud.
- 怎么拍：Pick a source and a particle (cigarette, incense, oil, battlefield pot). Control air currents so ribbons have direction. Light from the side or behind so the volume renders; use a hard beam if you want shafts (Volumetric Light). Keep some clean path to the face. Prompt: smoke around [Subject], cigarette, chimney, or battle, shafts of light catching it, volume in the room.
- 何时用：Use it for apartments, temples, engine rooms, aftermath. Do not use it as a default 'atmosphere' pass on a sunny kitchen. If the beat is stillness in a closed parlor, Dust Motes in a shaft may be enough.
- 近似对比：Atmospheric Haze, Fog, Steam, Dust Motes, Atmospheric HazeShow kilometers, not just meters., Volumetric LightAir has to be photographed, not just the subject., RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
  Atmospheric Haze in the distance is aerial perspective. A hazer used to fill a stage is a cousin of smoke but without a story source; still light it as volume. Fog is wet weather. Steam is water vapor from heat, white, rising, condensing. Dust Motes are discrete specks in a beam, not a ribbon. Atmospheric HazeShow kilometers, not just meters. Volumetric LightAir has to be photographed, not just the subject. RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
- 片中实例：In the Mood for Love lets cigarette ribbons occupy cramped rooms. Blade Runner fills interiors so shafts and practicals have air to hit.；Apocalypse Now makes battle and jungle air into volume. Give smoke a source and a light, not a generic grey.
- Prompt 模板：`Smoke around [Subject], cigarette, chimney, or battle, shafts of light catching it, volume in the room. Name the source, the backlight or side key, and the direction of the ribbon.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Smoke around [Subject], cigarette, chimney, or battle, shafts of light catching it, volume in the room.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Fog (no source) or unlit fill that dirties skin. The tell: no chimney or cigarette, lamps without shafts, a muddy key. The fix: a visible source, side or back light, a clean path to the eyes.

### Dust Motes
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/atmosphere/dust-motes)
- 定义：Dust motes are discrete particles hanging in a shaft of light, slow enough to read as time in still air. They are matter you can almost count; they live in the beam, not as a veil across the whole room.
- 叙事功能：A window cuts a wedge through a closed parlor. Specks drift, rise, fall. Stillness that is still alive. The room has been shut; time is visible because the air has a population. Use it when quiet should not be empty: a church, a bedroom, a barn in late sun. It is the wrong tool when the air is a ribbon from a cigarette (Smoke) or a soup that hides the far wall (Fog). It is the wrong tool when the particles are on fire (Sparks and Embers). If the whole room is milky, you filled it. Motes need a dark surround and a hard beam.
- 怎么拍：Create a shaft (window, slats, a cut HMI) and keep off-beam air darker. Introduce fine particles (real dust, atmosphere in small amounts). Backlight or sidelight the beam; motes are seen by scatter toward camera. Slow movement: convection, not wind. Prompt: dust motes hanging in a shaft of light around [Subject], slow particles, a room that has been closed, time made visible.
- 何时用：Use it for a pause, a prayer, a house that remembers. Do not use it in a gale or a nightclub wash. If the camera is racing, motes become streaks or noise. Pair with Slow Motion only if you want to inventory the specks.
- 近似对比：Volumetric Light, Smoke, Sparks and Embers, Atmospheric Haze, Volumetric LightAir has to be photographed, not just the subject., Slow MotionA second contains a scene., RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
  Volumetric Light is the shaft; dust motes are the countable inhabitants of that shaft. Smoke is a continuous volume. Sparks and Embers are incandescent and short-lived. Atmospheric Haze pales the far plane. Motes are slow, discrete, and local to the beam. Volumetric LightAir has to be photographed, not just the subject. Slow MotionA second contains a scene. RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
- 片中实例：The Assassination of Jesse James by the Coward Robert Ford lets window light populate air so interiors feel timed. The Tree of Life hangs specks in domestic and cosmic shafts.；Use beam plus specks, not a dusty grade on a flatly lit room.
- Prompt 模板：`Dust motes hanging in a shaft of light around [Subject], slow particles, a room that has been closed, time made visible. Name the window or slat, the dark surround, and that particles are discrete, not a fog fill.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Dust motes hanging in a shaft of light around [Subject], slow particles, a room that has been closed, time made visible.`
- Prompt 要点：For video, slow drift inside the beam only.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Smoke fill or Volumetric Light with no specks. The tell: milky room, no shaft, or sparks. The fix: a hard beam, dark off-beam, countable slow particles, backlight.

### Steam
- 别名：haze, fog, smoke, dust, rain, snow ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/atmosphere/steam)
- 定义：Steam is water vapor released where heat meets colder air: trains, manholes, showers, a white veil that rises and thins. It is wet matter, not combustion; it billows, condenses on lens and wool, and has a thermal source.
- 叙事功能：A locomotive writes a column that the platform wind tears. A manhole breathes. A shower erases a body in white. Heat meeting cold air. Industrial or intimate, the physics are the same. Use it when the source is hot water or hot metal in cold space. It is the wrong tool when the cloud is burning (Smoke) or hanging as weather (Fog). Smoke can sink and stain; steam wants to rise and vanish. If the white cloud has no grate, kettle, train, or shower, you have fog in a trench coat.
- 怎么拍：Show the source (stack, manhole, shower head, kettle). Let the vapor rise and shear in wind. Backlight for a white, translucent volume; it should feel wetter and brighter than smoke. Condensation on glass and wool helps. Prompt: steam billowing around [Subject], trains, manholes, showers, a white veil, industrial or intimate heat.
- 何时用：Use it on a winter platform, a night street grate, a bathroom, a factory press. Do not use it as generic alley 'atmosphere' with no heat. If the alley is burning, use smoke. If the alley is only wet and cold, use fog or rain.
- 近似对比：Smoke, Fog, Atmospheric Haze, SmokePhotograph the air of a room., FogHide geography. Delay the reveal., RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
  Smoke is combustion, often grey or colored, with a fire source. Fog is ambient water droplets without a hot origin. Atmospheric Haze is distant scatter. Steam is a thermal event: white, rising, local to a grate, stack, or shower. SmokePhotograph the air of a room. FogHide geography. Delay the reveal. RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
- 片中实例：Winter station grammar in thrillers leans on locomotive steam as moving architecture. The Untouchables uses train steam as a white, violent veil.；Drive lets night streets breathe from grates. Spirited Away treats bathhouse steam as a wet interior weather.；Show the heat, not a smoke bomb.
- Prompt 模板：`Steam billowing around [Subject], trains, manholes, showers, a white veil, industrial or intimate heat. Name the hot source, the cold air, backlight, and rise.`
- 示例 Prompt：`For video, billows that shear and thin, condensation, no grey cigarette ribbons unless you also have smoke.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Smoke (wrong color, wrong source) or Fog (no rise from heat). The tell: a grey cloud sitting still with no grate or stack. The fix: a thermal source, white translucent rise, backlight, wind shear.

### Snow
- 别名：haze, fog, smoke, dust, rain, steam ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/atmosphere/snow)
- 定义：Snow is ice falling and settling: large flakes in backlight, a muffled world, tracks that record who passed. The air holds crystals you can size; the ground accumulates; contrast goes soft because the world has been covered.
- 叙事功能：Flakes cross a sodium lamp like slow sparks that do not burn. Shoulders collect white. Footsteps write the path. Hush the world. Silence becomes visible as reduced contrast and falling matter. Use it when winter must occupy both air and ground. It is the wrong tool when you only need pale air without accumulation (Mist). It is the wrong tool when the falling matter is liquid (Rain). Rain wets and mirrors; snow blankets and records tracks. Tiny fast specks against a day sky read as video noise. Size the flakes and backlight them.
- 怎么拍：Put flakes in the air (practical or digital) large enough to read, and light them from behind or the side. Let accumulation sit on wool, hair, rails, and ground. Keep a dark background for flakes to separate, or accept a white-on-white hush. Wind decides drift versus fall. Prompt: falling snow around [Subject], large flakes in backlight, muffled world, tracks, winter silence you can see.
- 何时用：Use it for a platform wait, a hunt, a small-town crime, a night street that should go quiet. Do not use it as white rain that never settles. If shoulders stay dry and the pavement is only wet, you shot rain.
- 近似对比：Rain, Mist, Blue Hour, Dust Motes, MistSofter mystery than fog. Lyric, not monster., Blue HourDay is gone but the sky still works., RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
  Rain streaks and mirrors. Mist hangs and does not accumulate as a blanket. Blue Hour is a sky condition that often pairs with snow but is not weather. Dust Motes are indoor specks in a shaft. Snow falls, lands, and stays. MistSofter mystery than fog. Lyric, not monster. Blue HourDay is gone but the sky still works. RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
- 片中实例：Fargo lets snow be ground, air, and isolation. Let the Right One In uses falling flakes and muffled suburbs.；The Revenant puts bodies into falling and settled winter. Use accumulation and backlight, not a noise overlay.
- Prompt 模板：`Falling snow around [Subject], large flakes in backlight, muffled world, tracks, winter silence you can see. Name flake size, a lamp or sun behind them, accumulation on shoulders and ground, and tracks if anyone has walked.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Falling snow around [Subject], large flakes in backlight, muffled world, tracks, winter silence you can see.`
- Prompt 要点：For video, fall plus settle; no dry coats, no rain streaks.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Rain tinted white, or grain called snow. The tell: wet mirrors, no accumulation, specks too small to size. The fix: large backlit flakes, settled white on surfaces, tracks, a hush in contrast.

### Wet-Down
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/atmosphere/wet-down)
- 定义：A wet-down sprays pavement, asphalt, and cars so night lights double themselves in reflection, often with no rain in the air. The street is the effect; water is a surface treatment, not weather.
- 叙事功能：Sodium, neon, a traffic headlamp: each finds a second copy on blacktop. Night exteriors that must sparkle. Studio crews invented this because dry asphalt eats light. The trick is the shine, not the storm. Use it when a night street, alley, or overpass must specularize practicals. It is the wrong tool when you need falling streaks and umbrellas as percussion: add Rain. It is the wrong tool when the color should come only from tubes on walls with a dry floor: that is Neon Practicals without a mirror. If the air is full of drops, you have rain (usually on top of a wet-down). If the air is empty and the ground is a black mirror, you have the wet-down alone.
- 怎么拍：Hose or rain-bar the travel path until it sheets. Place practicals (sodium, neon, shop windows) so their reflections fall in frame. Keep the camera low enough to catch the mirror, or lose it. No need for backlight in the air unless rain is also falling. Prompt: wet-down streets around [Subject], pavement sprayed for night, double the lights by reflection.
- 何时用：Use it for night driving, a sidewalk wait, a neon block. Do not soak a dusty noon street unless the story has just rained. A wet-down in hard sun can look like a spill, not night grammar.
- 近似对比：Rain, Neon Practicals, Fog, Atmospheric Haze, RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective., Neon PracticalsThe city is the lighting department., FogHide geography. Delay the reveal.
  Rain puts drops in the optical path. Neon Practicals is the source color; wet-down is how that color doubles on the ground. Fog blooms lamps in air. Wet-down blooms them on the floor. Atmospheric Haze does not spec the asphalt. RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective. Neon PracticalsThe city is the lighting department. FogHide geography. Delay the reveal.
- 片中实例：Drive and Collateral make Los Angeles nights out of wet asphalt and practicals. Who Framed Roger Rabbit's night streets use the same studio-wet logic so lamps have copies.；Use the mirror, not a copied car.
- Prompt 模板：`Wet-down streets around [Subject], pavement sprayed for night, double the lights by reflection. Name the practicals, the sheeting water on asphalt, and empty air unless rain is also requested.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Wet-down streets around [Subject], pavement sprayed for night, double the lights by reflection, studio-night trick made beautiful.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Rain (streaks in air) or a glossy grade on dry pavement. The tell: drops around lamps, or no reflections despite 'wet streets.' The fix: sheet the ground, place lights that can reflect, keep air empty if rain is not the job.

### Sparks and Embers
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/atmosphere/sparks)
- 定义：Sparks and embers are incandescent particles thrown by welding, fire, grinding, or a cigarette: orange weather with short trajectories. They are burning matter; backlight is optional because they are their own small keys.
- 叙事功能：A welder writes a fountain. A collapsing floor throws embers that hang, then die. Industry or apocalypse in the air. Unlike dust, these specks have temperature and a brief life. Use it when the air should be dangerous or industrial: a foundry, a burning street, a cigarette in a dark booth (embers, not a fountain). It is the wrong tool when the specks are cold (Dust Motes, Snow). It is the wrong tool when the glow is only a warm key on a face with no particles: that is Candlelight or firelight without weather. If the particles are large, slow, and white, you probably asked for snow. If they never fall, you asked for hanging dust.
- 怎么拍：Give them a source (welder, angle grinder, timber, cigarette). Let gravity and heat dictate: sparks drop and bounce; embers can loft and drift. Expose for the particle without losing the face entirely, or accept silhouettes. A dark surround makes them read. Prompt: sparks or embers around [Subject], welding, fire, cigarettes, orange particles as weather.
- 何时用：Use it for a night burn, a factory, a ruined city, a match. Do not sprinkle orange specks on a pastoral wide with no fire. Particles need a reason.
- 近似对比：Candlelight, Volumetric Light, Dust Motes, Snow, CandlelightPeriod night or ritual., Volumetric LightAir has to be photographed, not just the subject., RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
  Candlelight is a warm, flickering key. Sparks are the particles. Volumetric Light is a shaft; sparks can cross it but are not the shaft. Dust Motes are cold and slow in a beam. Snow is cold and accumulates. Sparks die in the air. CandlelightPeriod night or ritual. Volumetric LightAir has to be photographed, not just the subject. RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
- 片中实例：Blade Runner 2049 throws orange particles as industrial weather. The Dark Knight Rises uses fire and debris as airborne specks in night action.；Use source plus trajectory, not a spark overlay on a clean street.
- Prompt 模板：`Sparks or embers around [Subject], welding, fire, cigarettes, orange particles as weather. Name the source, color (white-orange to dull red), trajectory (fountain versus lofted drift), and a dark surround.`
- 示例 Prompt：`For video, short-lived particles with gravity; no snow, no cigarette smoke unless you also want smoke.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Dust Motes tinted orange, or Snow. The tell: specks hang forever, accumulate on the ground as white, or have no welder or fire. The fix: a hot source, brief trajectories, self-luminous particles, dark air.

### Dust and Sand
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/atmosphere/dust-storm)
- 定义：Dust and sand as weather is mineral grit driven by wind until the sun is a dull coin and figures become silhouettes. The land attacks: particles occupy near air, sting highlights, and erase the horizon that Atmospheric Haze would only pale.
- 叙事功能：A rider is a cutout. The sun is a disk you can look at. Grit crawls across metal and teeth. This is not a poetic far ridge. This is the ground in the lungs. Use it when the environment is an antagonist: border desert, convoy, siege. It is the wrong tool when you only need paler mountains behind a sharp hero (Atmospheric Haze). It is the wrong tool when the particles hang in a quiet indoor shaft (Dust Motes). Hard Light through a storm becomes a brown disk; do not keep a crisp white sun and a clean face unless the storm is still on the way.
- 怎么拍：Fill near and mid air with wind-driven particulates (fuller's earth, practical sand, or digital grit) so contrast collapses at working distance. Keep a strong directional wind. Backlight or sun-through-dust to silhouette. Let highlights on skin and vehicles pick up specks. Prompt: dust or sandstorm wrapping [Subject], sun as a dull coin, silhouettes, grit in the highlights.
- 何时用：Use it for an ambush, a crossing, a road that should be unsurvivable. Do not use it as a warm grade on a calm dune. If flags hang limp and pores are clean, there is no storm.
- 近似对比：Atmospheric Haze, Fog, Smoke, Hard Light, Atmospheric HazeShow kilometers, not just meters., Hard LightGrit, noon sun, or interrogation., RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
  Atmospheric Haze is calm aerial perspective over kilometers, subject still sharp. Fog is water, grey-white, little wind required. Smoke has a fire source. Hard Light is the sun's character; in a storm that sun is filtered. Dust-storm is mineral, windy, and near. Atmospheric HazeShow kilometers, not just meters. Hard LightGrit, noon sun, or interrogation. RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
- 片中实例：Sicario lets desert particulate erase edges and turn daylight hostile. Mad Max: Fury Road drives through walls of grit and sun as a coin.；Lawrence of Arabia also uses blowing sand as an attack, not only distant haze. Use wind and near opacity, not a tan LUT.
- Prompt 模板：`Dust or sandstorm wrapping [Subject], sun as a dull coin, silhouettes, grit in the highlights. Name wind direction, reduced visibility, and dirty speculars on skin and metal.`
- 示例 Prompt：`For video, horizontal grit, flapping cloth, no calm air, no sharp far town unless it is a brief hole in the storm.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Atmospheric Haze (sharp rider, paler citadel) or a brown grade. The tell: clean pores, limp flags, a white sun, crisp horizon. The fix: wind, near-air grit, silhouettes, a dull solar disk, specks on highlights.

### Underwater
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/atmosphere/underwater)
- 定义：Underwater cinematography leaves air: the camera is in water, so caustics, buoyancy, and a missing horizon rewrite every edge. The medium is the matter; particles are silt and bubbles, and bodies move as if the world had gone slow without a slow-motion shutter.
- 叙事功能：Hair and cloth delay. Light arrives as moving lattice from a surface that is now a ceiling. There is no standing horizon, only up toward silver and down toward dark. Leave air. Use it when the scene is actually submerged: a pool, a sea, a tank, a flood. It is the wrong tool when you only want grace: dry Slow Motion with a blue grade is a lie, and it shows in hair that still falls at air speed. It is the wrong tool when the story is on the swell with a sky: that is Ocean. Color dies with depth (reds first). If the red dress is still loud at ten meters, you stayed in air.
- 怎么拍：Put the lens in a housing in water (or a convincing tank). Expose for caustics from the real sun or a hard source through the surface. Let bubbles and silt backlight. Wardrobe and hair must float. Camera moves fight drag; they read slower. Prompt: underwater of [Subject], caustics, muffled space, hair and cloth in slow water, a world without horizon.
- 何时用：Use it for a dive, a drowning, a creature, a flooded corridor. Do not use it as a look for a dry bedroom. If you need the surface and the sky, shoot ocean, then go under for a beat if the story dives.
- 近似对比：Ocean, Atmospheric Haze, Slow Motion, Atmospheric HazeShow kilometers, not just meters., Slow MotionA second contains a scene., RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
  Ocean is the surface world: swell, horizon, salt light. Atmospheric Haze is air scatter. Slow Motion is a frame-rate choice that often accompanies underwater but is not the medium. Underwater is a different optical path: refraction, caustics, buoyancy, no air horizon. Atmospheric HazeShow kilometers, not just meters. Slow MotionA second contains a scene. RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
- 片中实例：The Big Blue lives in the medium, not in a tint. The Shape of Water makes tanks and canals a second gravity.；Thunderball proved action can be staged as true submerged geography. Use caustics and float, not a teal LUT on a dry actor.
- Prompt 模板：`Underwater of [Subject], caustics, muffled space, hair and cloth in slow water, a world without horizon. Name depth, the surface as ceiling or absence, floating wardrobe, silt or bubbles in backlight.`
- 示例 Prompt：`For video, buoyancy and drag; no air-speed hair, no standing horizon unless looking up at the underside of the surface.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a blue grade in air, or Ocean from a boat. The tell: cloth hangs, hair falls, a skyline, no caustics. The fix: submerge the camera, float the fabrics, add caustics and backlit silt, kill the air horizon.

### Ocean
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/atmosphere/ocean)
- 定义：Ocean cinematography treats the sea as the other actor: swell, a horizon, salt light, a person against water that does not care. The atmosphere is spray, haze over distance, and a moving floor; the camera is in air, on a hull, or on rocks, not yet in the lung of the sea.
- 叙事功能：A mole, a boat, a body: small. The horizon is a line that can kill you. Swell has a period. Salt in backlight is weather. The sea is the other actor. Use it for exile, work, awe, war at the rail. It is the wrong tool when you have left the surface (Underwater). It is the wrong tool when the water is a still lake used as silk behind a posed figure. If there is no swell and no scale, it is not ocean. A bathtub, a pool, a harbor with no fetch: different jobs. Name the swell.
- 怎么拍：Shoot wide enough for scale. Put real swell in the frame (period, whitecaps or long rollers). Backlight spray. Let far water go paler with Atmospheric Haze. Keep the human or boat small unless the story is a face against a rail. Practical water on lens is allowed; fake silk water is not. Prompt: ocean world of [Subject], swell, horizon, salt light, a person against water that does not care.
- 何时用：Use it when the sea must act: a crossing, a lighthouse rock, a mole under fire, a diver's surface world. Do not use it as a backdrop for fashion on calm glass. If the camera goes under, switch techniques.
- 近似对比：Underwater, Atmospheric Haze, Rain, UnderwaterLeave air., Atmospheric HazeShow kilometers, not just meters., RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
  Underwater submerges the lens. Atmospheric Haze is the aerial perspective over the water, a modifier, not the whole job. Rain can lash a surface but is not swell. Ocean is surface gravity, horizon, and scale. A wet street is not an ocean. UnderwaterLeave air. Atmospheric HazeShow kilometers, not just meters. RainMake the air visible and the ground reflective.
- 片中实例：The Big Blue treats the surface as a workplace and a temptation. The Lighthouse puts two men against water and rock with no kindness in the horizon.；Dunkirk uses mole, hull, and swell as hostile architecture. Show weight and weather, not a stock seascape.
- Prompt 模板：`Ocean world of [Subject], swell, horizon, salt light, a person against water that does not care. Name sea state, scale (small figure or small boat), backlight on spray, and a hard horizon.`
- 示例 Prompt：`For video, real period in the swell, not a looping texture. Do not make the water a silk backdrop.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a calm stock seascape or Underwater caustics on a dry beach. The tell: no swell, a posed model large in frame, glass-smooth water, no spray. The fix: scale the human down, give the sea a period, backlight salt, keep the horizon honest.

## 类型片风格 / Genre Looks（27 条）

**速查**：Film Noir · Neo-Noir · German Expressionism · Giallo · Spaghetti Western · Found Footage · Cinéma Vérité · French New Wave · Wuxia · Tech Noir · Southern Gothic · Cosmic Horror · Vaporwave · Documentary · Blockbuster Gloss · Arthouse · Animation · BTS · Dreamcore · Dystopian · Magical Realism · Maximalism · Photography · Pixel Art · Stylistic Suck · Video Game · Weirdcore

### Film Noir
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/film-noir)
- 定义：Film noir lighting is a low-key, high-contrast setup: a hard key, often cut by a venetian gobo or a streetlamp cookie, leaves one cheek in true black while wet pavement returns silver. The camera sits at eye height on a 35mm or 50mm spherical lens, tungsten practicals as motivated sources, and blocking that isolates a figure in a doorway, an alley, or a pool of light.
- 叙事功能：The shot withholds the room. A face is half a mask. Guilt has to live in the sliver that remains, which is why voice-over can sit on this image without explaining the picture. Streets are wet so the night has a specular path back to the lens. It is the wrong tool when the crime is colorful, fashionable, or futuristic. If the threat is a gelled primary, use Giallo. If the night is neon and the year is now, use Neo-Noir. If the architecture itself is bent, use German Expressionism, not a wet street.
- 怎么拍：Key with a hard Fresnel or open-face through slats, 45 to 90 degrees off camera, fill killed so the ratio sits near 8:1. Wet-down the street so the same key returns as bounce. Practicals (desk lamp, cafe sign, streetlamp) must match the direction even if they are not the exposure. Lens: 35mm for a street, 50mm for a face, moderate stop so walls fall off. Camera locked or a short dolly, eye level or a touch below. Prompt the gobo, the unfilled cheek, the wet asphalt, and 1940s crime blocking.
- 何时用：Use it when a character steps under a streetlamp and the shadow has to accuse them. Do not use it as a generic dark-crime grade on a color-saturated fashion interior.
- 近似对比：Film noir, Neo-noir, Tech noir, Giallo, German Expressionism, Low-Key Lighting, Gobo Lighting, Wet-Down, Chiaroscuro, Low-Key LightingMystery, crime, or moral night., Gobo LightingThe room writes on the person., Wet-DownNight exteriors that must sparkle.
  Film noir is silver, hard, and unfilled. Neo-noir keeps the guilty geometry but paints it with color practicals. Tech noir adds future screens as keys. Giallo is the opposite palette: hyper-saturated primaries, not black-and-white pools. German Expressionism distorts the set; noir usually keeps real streets and lets light do the distortion. Kit cousins: Low-Key Lighting, Gobo Lighting, Wet-Down, Chiaroscuro. Low-Key LightingMystery, crime, or moral night. Gobo LightingThe room writes on the person. Wet-DownNight exteriors that must sparkle.
- 片中实例：The Third Man (wet Vienna, hard raking keys, a face in a doorway). Double Indemnity (venetian gobos, a confession in a dark living room).；The Big Combo (a fogged spotlight as the only map of a killing ground). Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Lead with the treatment, then lock physics. Film-noir treatment of [Subject], hard venetian gobos, unfilled far cheek, wet-down street bounce, 50mm spherical, 1940s crime blocking.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Name who stands where and which practical is the motivated key. Do not replace the gobo, the ratio, and the wet pavement with mood adjectives.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Neo-Noir or generic Low-Key Lighting: color neon rain, or a softly underexposed room with no hard edge. The tell is a filled shadow, dry pavement, and no slat texture on the wall. Fix: kill the fill, add a venetian or tree cookie, wet the ground, and keep the palette silver.

### Neo-Noir
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/neo-noir)
- 定义：Neo-noir cinematography keeps noir's hard keys and isolated blocking but replaces silver night with color: sodium vapor, neon practicals, and tungsten that stain rain and skin. The camera still hunts faces in shadow, yet the palette is contemporary, often cyan signage against warm flesh, not black-and-white contrast alone.
- 叙事功能：The city is still a trap, but the trap has a hue. Rain carries magenta and cyan. A sodium streetlamp turns a raincoat mustard. The moral geometry (half a face, a wet street, a figure stranded in a pool of light) survives. Only the stock is color. It is the wrong tool when you need period silver, future screens as the only keys, or candy primaries as threat. Classic Film Noir has no neon to name. Tech Noir puts crime inside a digital city. Vaporwave uses pink-cyan without guilt or investigation.
- 怎么拍：Keep a hard key 45 to 90 degrees off, but let practical color do the fill: neon in rain, sodium overhead, a tungsten interior leaking onto wet asphalt. Contrast stays high. Skin may go teal-shadow, orange-highlight, or stay mixed on purpose. Lens: 35mm or 40mm anamorphic, or spherical 35mm, often at night with rain as the volume. Camera: locked wides, slow tracking, occasional push-in on a face. Prompt color where classic noir was silver, name the neon practicals, and keep the rain.
- 何时用：Use it when a present-day or period-color crime scene needs melancholy and rain, not a 1940s silver print. Do not use it as a teal-and-orange grade on a scene with no hard key and no guilty blocking.
- 近似对比：Neo-Noir, Film Noir, Tech Noir, Teal and Orange, Neon Practicals, Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps., Neon PracticalsThe city is the lighting department., Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
  Neo-Noir is color noir: same isolation, new practicals. Film Noir is the silver original. Tech Noir adds science-fiction production design and screens as sources. Teal and Orange is a grade, not a genre look; you can grade a comedy teal-orange and still have no noir blocking. Neon Practicals is the lamp. Neo-noir is the lamp plus the crime geometry. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps. Neon PracticalsThe city is the lighting department. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste.
- 片中实例：Chinatown (period color, hard sun and venetian interiors, investigation as a trap). Blade Runner (rain, smoke, neon as key, still a detective picture).；Drive (night exteriors, pink-cyan practicals, locked-off melancholy). Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Neo-noir look on [Subject], color where classic noir was silver, neon practicals, rain, contemporary crime blocking, hard key, unfilled far cheek. Name the hue of the signage and whether the camera is locked or tracking.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Neo-noir look on [Subject], color where classic noir was silver, neon practicals, rain, contemporary crime melancholy.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not write only teal and orange.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Film Noir (you asked for color and got a black-and-white fedora) or a Teal and Orange grade with no key. The tell is a filled, even night or a palette with no motivated practical. Fix: add a named neon or sodium source, keep the hard ratio, and wet the ground.

### German Expressionism
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/german-expressionism)
- 定义：German Expressionism cinematography treats the set as a mind: forced-perspective corridors, painted shadows, and jagged hard light replace natural architecture. The camera is often locked and slightly dutch, so the actor walks a geometry that already looks illegal.
- 叙事功能：Psychology is built, not implied. A staircase leans. A shadow is bigger than the body that casts it, and sometimes the shadow is paint. The face is lit like a mask because the room is already a diagnosis. It is the wrong tool for a real wet street or a fashion interior. Noir keeps plausible cities and lets Hard Light do the violence. Giallo bends color, not carpentry. If the walls are square and only the grade is moody, you do not have expressionism.
- 怎么拍：Build or paint impossible architecture: converging walls, oversized windows, stairs that refuse the horizon. Light with hard, unfilled sources so shadows are graphic edges, not soft falloff. Dutch the camera a few degrees as a default, not a sting. Orthochromatic or high-contrast black-and-white, 35mm spherical, theatrical blocking, often locked-off. Prompt painted shadows, impossible architecture, jagged light, and Caligari psychology as set.
- 何时用：Use it when the location must be a mental state, not a real address. Do not use it as a dutch-angle garnish on a square contemporary room.
- 近似对比：German Expressionism, Film Noir, Dutch Angle, Hard Light, Chiaroscuro, Dutch AngleThe world is off its axis. Do not use as decoration., Hard LightGrit, noon sun, or interrogation., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  German Expressionism distorts carpentry. Film Noir distorts with light on real streets. Dutch Angle is one tilted horizon; expressionism is the whole set. Hard Light is the source quality. Chiaroscuro is the ratio. You need the bent architecture, not only the contrast. Dutch AngleThe world is off its axis. Do not use as decoration. Hard LightGrit, noon sun, or interrogation. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari (painted shadows, canted town as a mind).；Metropolis (shafts, scale, and machine geometry as social diagram). Nosferatu (a body that is also a shadow on a wall).；Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`German expressionist treatment of [Subject], painted shadows, impossible architecture, jagged hard light, dutch horizon, theatrical blocking. Name which wall or stair is illegally angled.`
- 示例 Prompt：`German expressionist treatment of [Subject], painted shadows, impossible architecture, jagged light, Caligari psychology as set.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not ask for a normal street with a moody grade.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Film Noir or a lone Dutch Angle: a wet alley, or a tilted camera in an ordinary room. The tell is square architecture with only contrast added. Fix: cant the set or the perspective, paint or project graphic shadows, and lock the camera on that geometry.

### Giallo
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/giallo-look)
- 定义：Giallo cinematography is Italian thriller grammar: hyper-saturated primaries from gelled windows and glass, fashion interiors, and a camera that often zooms rather than dollies toward threat. Beauty lighting sits on the victim. The violence is styled, not silver.
- 叙事功能：Horror here is also wardrobe. A cobalt window, a red hallway, black leather in the foreground. The frame is chic until the glove enters. Subjective threat is a color, a zoom, and a Dutch Angle, not a wet black alley. It is the wrong tool for low-key crime or for density-as-ornament. Film Noir withholds with black. Maximalism fills every zone with pattern for pleasure. Giallo uses primaries as a weapon inside relatively designed, often sparse, interiors.
- 怎么拍：Gel the keys: red, green, cobalt through windows or colored glass, so the palette is primary, not pastel. Keep contrast high but chroma higher. 35 Techniscope wides for interiors. Dutch a few degrees on the kill or the stare. Foreground a black glove, a blade, or a fashion object. Prompt hyper-saturated primaries, implied black leather, Argento color crime, and beauty as the lighting on the face, not a slogan.
- 何时用：Use it when a stylish interior has to turn hostile through color, a zoom, and a gloved hand. Do not use it as generic saturated horror or as noir with a red grade.
- 近似对比：Giallo, Film Noir, Hyper-Saturation, Maximalism, Dutch Angle, Hyper-SaturationFeeling is louder than fact., Dutch AngleThe world is off its axis. Do not use as decoration., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Giallo is gelled primaries and fashion-threat. Film Noir is unfilled silver. Hyper-Saturation is a grade; giallo is that grade plus zoom, dutch, and leather-glove blocking. Maximalism packs ornament; giallo often leaves chic negative space and stains it with one violent hue. Dutch Angle is a tilt. Giallo uses the tilt as one tool among gels and zooms. Hyper-SaturationFeeling is louder than fact. Dutch AngleThe world is off its axis. Do not use as decoration. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：Suspiria (1977): colored glass as motivated key, dance-school architecture as a trap. Deep Red: zoomed inserts, primary interiors, investigation as fashion-horror.；Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Giallo look on [Subject], hyper-saturated primaries, gelled window key, black leather implied in the foreground, 35mm zoom threat, Argento color crime. Name the red, green, or cobalt source.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Giallo look on [Subject], hyper-saturated primaries, black leather gloves implied, Argento color crime, beauty as threat.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not prompt a black-and-white alley.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Film Noir or plain Hyper-Saturation: a fedora night, or a loud grade with no glove, no gelled window, and no zoom. The tell is teal-orange rain or even, pretty color with no threat axis. Fix: pick one primary as the key, dutch or zoom toward the threat, and put a dark fashion object in the foreground.

### Spaghetti Western
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/spaghetti-western)
- 定义：Spaghetti western cinematography restages western iconography on Techniscope 2.35: dusty ochre landscapes, hard sun as the only key, and cuts from a 24mm plaza wide to a telephoto extreme close-up of eyes. Moral ambiguity sits in the hold on a face before anyone draws.
- 叙事功能：Myth is dirt, sweat, and a horizon that refuses shade. The sun is a weapon. A Cowboy Shot shows the holster. An Extreme Close-Up of the eyes shows the decision. The land is wide. The soul is a few millimeters of iris. It is the wrong tool for a clean studio western or a misted martial landscape. American A-westerns often fill the faces and keep the sky polite. Wuxia uses silk, mist, and wire, not ochre and hard noon.
- 怎么拍：35 spherical. Pair a 24mm or 28mm for the town and ridge with a 75mm to 135mm (historically much longer) for the eye. Hard sun as key, little or no fill, dust as diffusion. Grade: burnt umber, bleached sky, dry highlights. Blocking: hip-level cowboy size for guns, then the operatic hold on the face. Prompt Techniscope grit, dusty ochre, extreme close-ups of eyes, sun as a weapon.
- 何时用：Use it when a standoff needs dirt, a hard sun, and a cut from landscape to iris. Do not use it for a polished sunset ride or for martial-arts mist.
- 近似对比：Spaghetti Western, Cowboy Shot, Extreme Close-Up, Hard Light, Wuxia, Cowboy ShotShow hands, weapons, or stance without going full body., Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger., Hard LightGrit, noon sun, or interrogation.
  Spaghetti Western is hard sun, ochre, Techniscope, and eye ECUs. Cowboy Shot is only the size (mid-thigh). Extreme Close-Up is only the size of the eye. Hard Light is the source. The look is those tools in a dusty, morally dirty western, not a filled Hollywood campfire. Wuxia is the cousin in landscape myth with the opposite weather. Cowboy ShotShow hands, weapons, or stance without going full body. Extreme Close-UpA detail is the scene: an eye, a mouth, a trigger. Hard LightGrit, noon sun, or interrogation.
- 片中实例：The Good, the Bad and the Ugly (plaza wides against eye close-ups, bleached sun). Once Upon a Time in the West (operatic holds, Harmonica's face as a landscape).；Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`35, dusty ochre, hard noon sun, no fill, extreme close-up of eyes cut against a 24mm ridge. Name the dust and the holster height.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Spaghetti-western frame of [Subject], Techniscope grit, dusty ochre, extreme close-ups of eyes, sun as a weapon.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not prompt a clean golden-hour poster western.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a glossy adventure western or Wuxia: rim-lit horses, polite skies, or bamboo mist. The tell is filled faces, teal-orange grade, and no eye ECU. Fix: kill the fill, bleach the sky, add dust, and jump from a wide plaza to the eyes.

### Found Footage
- 别名：Recovered recording, Camera as a story object ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/found-footage-look)
- 定义：The found footage look presents images as a recording made by someone inside the events, often later discovered or assembled, so the camera is a story object with a timestamp, a battery, and a reason to keep rolling. Consumer digital, Hi8, or MiniDV optics, autofocus hunt, and amateur framing are constraints, not decoration.
- 叙事功能：Knowledge is limited to what the operator can point at. What the camera misses is part of the beat. Autofocus hunts a doorway. A timestamp sits in the corner. The person holding the camera is in danger too, which is why the frame is late, dirty, and incomplete. Handheld footage alone is not found footage. If there is no fictional origin for the tape, you have Handheld or stylistic suck. If a documentary crew is interviewing, you have documentary rhetoric, not a recovered camcorder.
- 怎么拍：Choose the device: Hi8, MiniDV, early digital, or a phone. Match its wide-ish zoom, auto exposure pumping, rolling shutter, and focus hunt. Keep a plausible operator position and a reason the camera stays on. Night-vision is a mode of that device, not a grade. Do not add a crane or a pretty close-up the operator could not have taken. Prompt consumer digital or Hi8, timestamp, autofocus hunt, amateur framing, and documentary panic as the operator's, not the film's.
- 何时用：Use it when the operator is inside the event and the tape could later be found. Do not use shake as the entire premise, and do not use it for an omniscient amateur look with no diegetic camera.
- 近似对比：Found footage, Handheld, Stylistic Suck, Cinéma vérité, Night Vision, Documentary, HandheldUrgency, documentary truth, or a mind that cannot sit still., Night VisionSomeone is hunting in the dark., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Found footage needs a diegetic recorder. Handheld is a body-mounted tool in an otherwise omniscient film. Stylistic Suck can look cheap without a recovered-tape story. Cinéma vérité puts a filmmaker in real life as a catalyst, not a character's camcorder. Night Vision is one mode the found camera may switch into. Documentary uses interview and observation, not a lost tape. HandheldUrgency, documentary truth, or a mind that cannot sit still. Night VisionSomeone is hunting in the dark. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：The Blair Witch Project (recordings presented as the missing filmmakers' tapes). REC (a television crew's camera as the constrained record).；Cloverfield (a personal camcorder framing a disaster). Grammar, not frames to copy.；The Blair Witch Project 1999The narrative is presented as recordings made by the missing filmmakers.；REC 2007A television crew's camera becomes the constrained record of events.；Cloverfield 2008Personal recording frames the disaster experience.；Zelig 1983New material is integrated into an archival-looking documentary world.
- Prompt 模板：`A volunteer records the final inventory of a closing observatory on a handheld camcorder. Every shot must have a plausible recording reason. When an unexplained door opens, the operator first documents the room number, then hesitates before following. Maintain limited battery, imperfect framing and consistent microphone perspective.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Found-footage camera on [Subject], consumer digital or Hi8, timestamp, autofocus hunt, amateur framing, operator-height, documentary panic. Name who holds the camera and why it stays on.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not add a second, prettier angle.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Handheld shake or Stylistic Suck ugliness with no operator. The tell is a perfect close-up, a crane, or coverage the character could not have shot. Fix: pick the device, keep one operator position, let focus hunt, and let the frame miss the action.

### Cinéma Vérité
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/cinema-verite)
- 定义：Cinéma vérité uses available light, zoom-to-find framing, and the filmmaker's presence as a catalyst, so the camera is admitted into the room rather than hidden. Unpretty 16mm or digital frames, mixed color temperature, and a zoom hunting the moment are the physical signature, not a recovered amateur tape.
- 叙事功能：Life is not staged for a key light. Someone talks, the zoom finds them, a window or a practical is the source, and the filmmaker's question or proximity changes what happens. The frame can be late, centered wrong, or blown at the window. That is the contract. It is the wrong tool when polish is the point, or when a fictional camcorder is the story. Blockbuster Gloss would be propaganda here. Found footage needs a diegetic operator in danger. Documentary is broader: interviews, archive, and observation that may sit back.
- 怎么拍：Available light only, or a small on-camera bounce that still reads as room light. 16mm or a long ENG zoom (the 12-120 class), hunting focus and size. Handheld or a monopod, eye height, reacting. Leave mixed tungsten and daylight. Do not add a rim or a pretty backlight. Prompt available light, unpretty frames, zooming to find, life unstaged.
- 何时用：Use it when style would feel like a lie and the filmmaker's presence is part of the event. Do not use it as a shake filter on a scripted scene that still has three-point lighting.
- 近似对比：Cinéma vérité, Documentary, French New Wave, Handheld, Available Light, Found Footage, HandheldUrgency, documentary truth, or a mind that cannot sit still., Available LightCommit to the hour you have., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Cinéma vérité is intervention and available light in documentary reality. Documentary includes sit-down interviews and archive. French New Wave borrows the tools for fiction, then adds jump cuts and cinephile blocking. Handheld is only the body. Available Light is only the source. Found Footage invents a tape inside the story. HandheldUrgency, documentary truth, or a mind that cannot sit still. Available LightCommit to the hour you have. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：Don't Look Back (zoom-to-find, dressing rooms, a public figure not styled for film). Primary (campaign interiors, available light, the camera in the room).；The Battle of Algiers (newsreel immediacy as a staged cousin of this grammar). Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Cinéma vérité treatment of [Subject], available light, unpretty frames, zooming to find, mixed color temperature, life unstaged. Name the window or practical.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Cinéma vérité treatment of [Subject], available light, unpretty frames, zooming to find, life unstaged.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not add a rim, a crane, or a recovered-tape timestamp.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Found Footage or pretty Documentary: a timestamp and panic, or a keyed interview with a clean backlight. The tell is three-point light, a rim, or a device story. Fix: kill the film lights, let the zoom hunt, and keep the filmmaker in the room as a presence, not a horror operator.

### French New Wave
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/french-new-wave)
- 定义：French New Wave cinematography shoots fiction on locations with street light, handheld 16mm or 35mm, and an edit that will jump-cut rather than cover. The frame jumps into walking life: cafes, sidewalks, apartments with mixed practicals, and a camera that admits it is a camera.
- 叙事功能：Youth and impatience with studio polish. A character talks to the lens. A walk is a burst of handheld, then a jump cut skips the boring meters. Paris oxygen, or any city's equivalent, is the lighting plot: windows, cafes, overcast streets. It is not cinéma vérité. Vérité is documentary presence. New Wave is authored fiction using documentary tools plus cinephile grammar (Jump Cut, freeze, iris, a look at the camera). It is also not found footage: there is no recovered tape, only a director in the street.
- 怎么拍：Location interiors, available or small practicals, 35mm or 50mm on a Cameflex-class body, handheld or a light tripod. Shoot the walk, then jump-cut in the edit. Reflexive beats: eyeline to camera, a sudden insert. Street daylight, cafe tungsten, no matching backlight. Prompt jump cuts implied, street light, jump-into-life framing, handheld Paris oxygen as location air, not as a mood word.
- 何时用：Use it when a young, restless fiction needs streets, jump cuts, and impatience with coverage. Do not use it for studio three-point polish or for a camcorder-horror premise.
- 近似对比：French New Wave, Jump Cut, Cinéma Vérité, Handheld, Documentary, Arthouse, Jump CutDo not soothe. Show the skip., HandheldUrgency, documentary truth, or a mind that cannot sit still., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  French New Wave is fiction plus location plus Jump Cut. Cinéma Vérité is documentary catalysis. Handheld is the body only. Documentary may interview. New Wave characters still act a story. Arthouse may be slower, emptier, and less cinephile-playful. The New Wave camera is in a hurry. Jump CutDo not soothe. Show the skip. HandheldUrgency, documentary truth, or a mind that cannot sit still. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：Breathless (jump cuts on the street and in the room, a look to camera). The 400 Blows (location childhood, available light, a final run).；Cléo from 5 to 7 (real-time Paris, streets and interiors as a clock). Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`French New Wave energy on [Subject], location street light, handheld 35mm, jump cuts implied, jump-into-life framing, mixed cafe practicals. Name the sidewalk or apartment.`
- 示例 Prompt：`French New Wave energy on [Subject], jump cuts implied, street light, jump-into-life framing, handheld Paris oxygen.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not add a rim, a timestamp, or studio flags.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Cinéma Vérité or Found Footage: a documentary claim, or a tape. The tell is a news timestamp, a horror shake, or glossy three-point. Fix: keep it fiction, keep it location, handheld or light tripod, and let the edit jump.

### Wuxia
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/wuxia-look)
- 定义：Wuxia cinematography stages martial chivalry in landscape: misted bamboo or desert silk, long-shot geography, and wire-assisted paths that read as weightless rather than as street punching. Color is costume and fog, not a gelled murder window.
- 叙事功能：The fight is a poem in a real (or studio-built) landscape. A body travels a wire path through Mist. A Long Shot keeps honor readable as choreography, not as a blur of impacts. Silk and banners carry hue. The camera cranes or holds wide so the land remains the other actor. It is the wrong tool for a grit street fight or a dusty gun standoff. Hong Kong urban kung fu wants handheld wides and hits. Spaghetti Western wants hard sun and eyes. Wuxia wants weather, fabric, and a path through air.
- 怎么拍：35 spherical or anamorphic. 24mm to 40mm for wire wides, 50mm to 75mm to compress bamboo. Mist or smoke as diffusion, not as a night-club haze. Crane, jib, or wire-rig the performer so the path has a rise and a float. Slow the strike, not the walk. Palette: silk dyes, forest green, desert gold, color-coded armies if the story needs them. Prompt misted bamboo, wire-fu weightlessness implied, silk color, heroic wides, Crouching Tiger air as weather, not as a slogan.
- 何时用：Use it when martial myth needs landscape and a weightless path. Do not use it for a bar brawl, a gun standoff, or a handheld hit sequence.
- 近似对比：Wuxia, Long Shot, Spaghetti Western, Mist, MistSofter mystery than fog. Lyric, not monster., Long ShotPlace a human in a world that could ignore them., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Wuxia is mist, silk, wire, and Long Shot geography. Spaghetti Western is ochre, hard sun, and eye close-ups. Mist is the atmosphere only. Long Shot is the size only. A street kung-fu look is the opposite: wide, close, dirty, and weighted. Do not swap them. MistSofter mystery than fog. Lyric, not monster. Long ShotPlace a human in a world that could ignore them. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon (bamboo canopy, rooftop paths, wire as flight). Hero (color-coded armies, desert and lake as moral spaces).；House of Flying Daggers (forest, silk, and a fight that is also a dance). Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Wuxia look on [Subject], misted bamboo or silk banners, wire-fu weightlessness implied, long-shot landscape, designed costume color, crane or wide hold. Name the weather and the path through air.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Wuxia look on [Subject], misted bamboo, wire-fu weightlessness implied, silk color, heroic wides, Crouching Tiger air.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not prompt a dusty gunfight or a handheld alley brawl.
