- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a grit martial film or Spaghetti Western: sweat, ochre, and punches, or a noon standoff. The tell is no mist, no wire path, and a camera in the fighters' faces. Fix: widen up, add mist, show the path through air, and let costume carry color.

### Tech Noir
- 别名：future noir, cyber-noir, cyber noir ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/tech-noir)
- 定义：Tech noir (also called future noir or cyber-noir) fuses noir's hard keys, rain, and guilty blocking with science-fiction production design: screens, LEDs, and corporate towers as practical sources. Analog crime grammar sits inside a digital city.
- 叙事功能：The future is wet and guilty. A detective, a fugitive, or a machine walks rain that is lit by advertisements and monitors. The face is still half in shadow. The key is no longer only a streetlamp. It is a billboard, a terminal, a police scanner. It is not all dystopia and not all neo-noir. Dystopian can be daylight bureaucracy and civic scale with no crime plot. Neo-Noir can be a present-day parking garage with sodium lamps and no future tech. Tech noir needs both the investigation geometry and the machine city.
- 怎么拍：Keep noir ratios: hard key, unfilled cheek, wet ground. Replace tungsten with screens and LEDs as motivated keys, plus residual sodium or neon. Smoke or rain for volume. 35mm or 40mm anamorphic, night exteriors, occasional long-lens compression of towers. Blocking: figures small under signage, then a close-up keyed by a display. Prompt future crime, screens as practicals, rain, corporate night, analog noir in a digital city.
- 何时用：Use it when a future city is also a crime scene and the screens light the guilt. Do not use it for a clean utopian interface, or for present-day noir with no speculative design.
- 近似对比：Tech Noir, Neo-Noir, Dystopian, Neon Practicals, Film Noir, Neo-NoirNoir after color was invented., Neon PracticalsThe city is the lighting department., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Tech Noir is noir plus science-fiction sources. Neo-Noir is color noir without requiring future tech. Dystopian is the used civic system, often in daylight, with the state as antagonist. Neon Practicals is the lamp. Film Noir is the silver ancestor. If there is no screen, tower, or machine as light, you are still in neo-noir. Neo-NoirNoir after color was invented. Neon PracticalsThe city is the lighting department. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：Blade Runner (rain, neon, and a detective plot inside a machine city). The Terminator (1984 night, tech-noir club and streets, analog crime against a future machine).；Ghost in the Shell (1995) (screens, rain, and investigation as identity). Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Tech-noir on [Subject], future crime, screens as practicals, rain, corporate night, hard unfilled key, analog noir in a digital city. Name the display that lights the face.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Tech-noir on [Subject], future crime, screens as practicals, rain, corporate night, analog noir in a digital city.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Neo-Noir or generic Dystopian: contemporary neon crime, or a grey megacity with no investigation geometry. The tell is no screen as a source, or daylight civic haze with no wet guilty night. Fix: add a display key, rain, towers, and a crime blocking of isolation.

### Southern Gothic
- 别名：Southern Gothic cinema ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/southern-gothic)
- 定义：Southern gothic cinematography uses the American South as a humid optical problem: late-afternoon gold gone sickly, Spanish-moss Dappled Light, porch tungsten, and Atmospheric Haze that keeps heat in the air. Decay is on the walls. The threat is family, history, and something under the porch, not a city streetlamp.
- 叙事功能：Beauty is rotting. A house peels. Sweat holds on skin. Sun through moss becomes a moving gobo. The palette is gold-green and tobacco, not cyan neon. Blocking is slow: a porch, a church, a river, a dinner table that will not end. It is the wrong tool for urban night crime or for cosmic scale. Film Noir is a wet city. Cosmic horror makes the human irrelevant against illegal geometry. Southern gothic keeps the human too close: kin, pulpit, swamp.
- 怎么拍：Late sun as key, often raking, through trees or moss so the pattern crawls. Add atmospheric haze or real humidity so blacks go milky. Porch bulbs and interior practicals go warm and a little dirty. 35mm or 50mm spherical, sometimes 24mm for a house against sky. Avoid clean rims. Let paint peel in the highlight. Prompt humid decay, moss, late-afternoon gold gone sickly, beauty rotting as production design, not as a slogan.
- 何时用：Use it when heat, family, and decay have to be visible in the air. Do not use it as generic gothic fog on a Victorian stone castle, or as noir in a Southern town with the humidity removed.
- 近似对比：Southern Gothic, Dappled Light, Atmospheric Haze, Cosmic Horror, Film Noir, Dappled LightNature or blinds as gobo., Atmospheric HazeShow kilometers, not just meters., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Southern Gothic is humid gold-green decay. Dappled Light is the moss gobo only. Atmospheric Haze is the air only. Cosmic Horror is scale and illegal geometry. Film Noir is urban night silver. A British gothic look is stone, grey, and cold. Keep the heat. Dappled LightNature or blinds as gobo. Atmospheric HazeShow kilometers, not just meters. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：The Night of the Hunter (river, moonlight, and a Southern fable's hard shadows). Beasts of the Southern Wild (humid daylight, water, a community at the edge of weather).；True Detective S1 (sickly gold, industrial coast, family rot). Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Southern gothic air around [Subject], humid decay, Spanish moss dappled sun, late-afternoon gold gone sickly, porch tungsten, peeling paint. Name the heat and the house.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Southern gothic air around [Subject], humid decay, moss, late-afternoon gold gone sickly, beauty rotting.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not prompt a dry noir alley or a cosmic void.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Film Noir or generic gothic fog: wet city silver, or a cold castle. The tell is no humidity, no moss pattern, and a teal night grade. Fix: add late sickly sun, haze, peeling surfaces, and slow porch blocking.

### Cosmic Horror
- 别名：Lovecraftian horror, cosmic dread ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/cosmic-horror-look)
- 定义：Cosmic horror cinematography builds dread from human insignificance: extreme long shots, slightly illegal geometry, under-light on faces, and a brightness that reveals too much. The threat is not a man. Scale, entity, and knowledge that will not fit a face are the optical problem.
- 叙事功能：The frame makes the person a mistake. A horizon does not match. A structure has too many vanishing points. Light may be too hard, too colored, or too revealing, so looking is the harm. Underlighting turns a familiar face into a specimen. It is the wrong tool for a slasher in a cabin or for family rot on a porch. Giallo is a gloved human. Southern Gothic is kin and heat. Cosmic horror needs the universe, a lab, an ice, a shimmer, or a ship that is also a geometry error.
- 怎么拍：Start too wide: Extreme Long Shot of land, ice, or a structure that is the wrong size. Cheat perspective (forced, dutch, non-matching vanishing points) a little, not as cartoon expressionism. Light faces from below or from a source that has no sun logic. Overexpose the revelation. Palette: Antarctic bounce, alien shimmer, or red that is not a gel gag. Prompt scale wrong, geometry slightly illegal, a brightness that reveals too much, human irrelevance.
- 何时用：Use it when the threat cannot be a person and the image must make knowledge dangerous. Do not use it for a masked killer in a hallway, or for a foggy swamp that is still a family story.
- 近似对比：Cosmic horror, Extreme Long Shot, Underlighting, German Expressionism, Southern Gothic, Dreamcore, Extreme Long ShotScale is the emotion., UnderlightingThe source is fire, a screen on the floor, or a monster., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Cosmic horror is scale, illegal geometry, and revealing light. Extreme Long Shot is only size. Underlighting is only the angle. German Expressionism bends sets as a mind; cosmic horror bends them as an alien fact. Southern Gothic keeps humans too near. Dreamcore is a soft liminal room, not a cosmos. Extreme Long ShotScale is the emotion. UnderlightingThe source is fire, a screen on the floor, or a monster. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：The Thing (1982): Antarctic bounce, isolation wides, a body that will not stay a body. Annihilation: shimmer, wrong color in daylight, landscape as mutation.；Event Horizon: a ship interior whose lighting and geometry refuse comfort. Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Cosmic horror framing of [Subject], scale wrong, geometry slightly illegal, under-lit face or a brightness that reveals too much, human irrelevance, extreme long shot or a corridor that does not vanish correctly. Do not prompt a gloved killer.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Cosmic horror framing of [Subject], scale wrong, geometry slightly illegal, a brightness that reveals too much, human irrelevance.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is a slasher, Southern Gothic, or generic fog. The tell is a human antagonist filling the frame, or a porch. Fix: widen until the person is small, break one vanishing point, and let the source be too bright or from below.

### Vaporwave
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/vaporwave-look)
- 定义：The vaporwave aesthetic is a pastel, low-contrast look: pink-cyan gradients, marble and palms, mall fluorescents, and VHS chroma bleed, as if a 1980s future never shipped. The camera is often centered and still. There is no crime geometry unless you add it.
- 叙事功能：Nostalgia for a catalog that closed. A bust, a grid floor, Japanese retail signage, a sunset that is a gradient more than a sun. Highlights bloom like consumer tape. The mood is mall-at-closing, not investigation. It is easy to confuse with Neo-Noir because both like cyan and magenta. Noir still wants a hard key, rain guilt, and a face in shadow. Vaporwave wants even pastel fill, sculpture, and tape artifacts. Cross Process can supply the hue shift. It is not the whole look.
- 怎么拍：Soft, even sources: fluorescent mall, plus a pink or cyan gel as a wash, not a hard key. Center the subject. 35mm spherical, moderate depth. Add VHS: chroma bleed, slight tracking error, soft resolution. Set dressing: marble, palms, Greek busts, grid, sunset gradient. Prompt pink-cyan gradient, marble and palms, VHS bleed, mall-at-closing melancholy as empty retail air, not as a slogan.
- 何时用：Use it when the image should feel like a unused future on worn tape. Do not use it as a crime night or as a hard neon-noir alley.
- 近似对比：Vaporwave, Neo-Noir, Neon Practicals, Cross Process, Tech Noir, Cross ProcessWrong chemistry on purpose., Neon PracticalsThe city is the lighting department., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Vaporwave is pastel, centered, and tape-soft. Neo-Noir is hard, rainy, and guilty. Neon Practicals is the tube. Cross Process is a chemical hue shift. Tech Noir still investigates. If the face is unfilled and the street is wet, you have left the mall. Cross ProcessWrong chemistry on purpose. Neon PracticalsThe city is the lighting department. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：Drive supplies adjacent night grammar (pink-cyan practicals) but remains neo-noir in blocking. The look itself is more native to music video and internet stills than to a single film cycle.；Use Drive only as a cousin for hue, not as a crime template.
- Prompt 模板：`Vaporwave treatment of [Subject], pink-cyan gradient, marble and palms, VHS bleed, centered 35mm, mall fluorescent fill, no hard unfilled cheek. Name the bust or the grid.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Vaporwave treatment of [Subject], pink-cyan gradient, marble and palms, VHS bleed, mall-at-closing melancholy.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not prompt a wet detective alley.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Neo-Noir: rain, hard key, raincoat. The tell is an unfilled cheek and wet asphalt. Fix: flatten the contrast, center the frame, add marble or palms, and let VHS chroma bleed the edges.

### Documentary
- 别名：Fictional documentary, Documentary parody ｜ [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/documentary-look)
- 定义：Documentary cinematography mixes observational coverage with interview and archive rhetoric: unstyled wardrobe light, mixed color temperatures, a zoom finding focus, and respect without a glamour rim. Fictional films may borrow the same grammar as mockumentary. That is still documentary rhetoric, not a recovered camcorder tape.
- 叙事功能：The camera claims evidence. A sit-down by a window. A wide of work being done. A cutaway that pretends to prove the sentence. Comedy and unease both live in the gap between what people say and what the camera appears to witness. It is broader than Cinéma Vérité. Vérité hunts with a zoom and admits the filmmaker as catalyst. Documentary may also plant a stable interview, use archive, or build a fictional crew (Interview style, observational B-roll). It is not Found Footage: there is usually an implied production, not a lost tape.
- 怎么拍：Leave mixed color. Window key for interviews, 35mm to 50mm, eye level, interviewer often offscreen. Observational wides on a zoom, focus hunting is allowed if the implied crew would hunt. No hair light unless the real room has one. Imperfect coverage only when it fits that production. Prompt mixed color, unstyled wardrobe light, zoom finding focus, respect without glamour.
- 何时用：Use it when pretty would be a lie, or when a fiction wants interview-versus-observation irony. Do not use it as random shake, and do not swap it for a recovered-camera story.
- 近似对比：Documentary, Cinéma Vérité, Found Footage, Available Light, BTS, Cinéma VéritéStyle would be propaganda., Available LightCommit to the hour you have., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Documentary is a rhetoric (interview, observation, archive). Cinéma Vérité is a method (available light, presence, zoom-to-find). Found Footage is a diegetic recorder. Available Light is the source only. BTS shows a film set's crew. Mockumentary uses documentary rhetoric on invented people. Quality check: those are not interchangeable. Cinéma VéritéStyle would be propaganda. Available LightCommit to the hour you have. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：The Act of Killing (reenactment and interview as evidence). Honeyland (observational patience, mixed natural light).；Won't You Be My Neighbor? (archive plus sit-down).；This Is Spinal Tap and Best in Show (fictional crews using interview and observation). Grammar, not frames to copy.；This Is Spinal Tap 1984Interviews, backstage observation and performance footage construct the fictional band's story.；Best in Show 2000Interviews and observational scenes build the dog-show ensemble.
- Prompt 模板：`Create a short mockumentary about a municipal committee preparing the world's smallest parade. Intercut confident seated interviews with observational footage of tiny practical setbacks. Keep interview framing consistent, interviewer mostly offscreen and comedy grounded in sincere behavior rather than broad reaction faces.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Documentary look on [Subject], mixed color, unstyled wardrobe light, zoom finding focus, interview or observational coverage, respect without glamour. Name whether this is a sit-down or a follow.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not add a timestamp or a rim.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Found Footage or glossy interview: a horror camcorder, or a keyed talk show. The tell is a timestamp, or a Hollywood hair light on a 'documentary' subject. Fix: pick a crew style, mix the color, and let the zoom or the window be the only flattery.

### Blockbuster Gloss
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/blockbuster-gloss)
- 定义：Blockbuster cinematography is high-contrast, billboard-readable coverage: clean skies or designed weather, a heroic rim on hair and shoulder, volumetric shafts, and a grade that often splits teal shadow from warm skin. The shot must still parse at poster size.
- 叙事功能：Adventure as a still that could sell the film. Faces are shaped. Horizons are clean. Dust and haze exist to carry god-rays, not to hide information. 39 anamorphic, but the finish is expensive contrast, not empty duration. It is the wrong tool when thought needs space or when cheapness is the truth. Arthouse leaves headroom and waits. Stylistic Suck would be dishonest here in reverse: polish is the contract. Teal and Orange is a grade you can apply to anything. Gloss is the whole package: rim, scale, cleanliness.
- 怎么拍：Key plus a strong backlight rim. Add haze for Volumetric Light shafts. Keep skies clean or dramatically designed, not stained by accident. 24mm to 40mm for scale, longer glass for faces if the format is large. Grade: expensive contrast, often teal-orange, highlights rolled but still bright. Prompt expensive contrast, clean skies, heroic rim, IMAX-scale finish, adventure poster in motion.
- 何时用：Use it when the shot must play on a billboard and the world should look funded. Do not use it for a quiet empty interior, a vérité interview, or a decaying porch.
- 近似对比：Blockbuster Gloss, Teal and Orange, Volumetric Light, Arthouse, Maximalism, Dystopian, Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste., Volumetric LightAir has to be photographed, not just the subject., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Blockbuster Gloss is rim, scale, and clean contrast. Teal and Orange is only the grade. Volumetric Light is only the shaft. Arthouse is the opposite contract: patience and empty frame. Maximalism packs pattern. Gloss can be relatively simple, just expensive. Dystopian dirties the civic future. Gloss polishes the adventure. Teal and OrangeYou want contemporary studio punch. Use with taste. Volumetric LightAir has to be photographed, not just the subject. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：Mad Max: Fury Road (hard sun, rims, desert contrast built for large screens). Dune (2021) (volumetric shafts, monumental wides, controlled haze).；Skyfall (poster-clear action geography, expensive night and landscape). Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Blockbuster gloss on [Subject], expensive contrast, clean skies, heroic rim, volumetric haze, IMAX-scale finish, adventure poster in motion. Name the rim and the horizon.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Blockbuster gloss on [Subject], expensive contrast, clean skies, heroic rim, IMAX-scale finish, adventure poster in motion.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not prompt odd headroom or mixed unstyled color.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Arthouse emptiness or a Teal and Orange grade on a poorly lit face. The tell is no rim, stained accidental skies, and a frame that would not read as a poster. Fix: add a backlight rim, clean the sky, and raise the contrast until the silhouette holds at small size.

### Arthouse
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/arthouse)
- 定义：Arthouse cinematography leaves space for thought: a Static Locked-Off camera, odd Headroom, natural or window light, and a frame willing to be empty. Duration is implied even in a still. The picture does not sell itself as a poster.
- 叙事功能：Someone sits. The room keeps being a room. Headroom is a little wrong. The light is a window, not a rim. You are allowed to get bored, which is how thought enters. Negative space is not a mistake. It is the wrong tool when the shot must play on a billboard or when the camera should hunt. Blockbuster Gloss shapes every edge. French New Wave is impatient and jump-cut. Photography may also hold still, but as a print: posed, decisive, often centered. Arthouse can be off-center, slightly ugly, and long.
- 怎么拍：Lock the tripod. 35mm or 50mm spherical, modest stop, available or window key, little or no fill. Allow odd headroom and Negative Space. Do not add a backlight rim unless the room has one. Color stays mixed or quietly naturalistic. Prompt patience, odd headroom, natural light, the frame willing to be empty, duration implied.
- 何时用：Use it when a beat needs time and air more than emphasis. Do not use it on an action geography pass, and do not confuse it with a centered stills-like tableau.
- 近似对比：Arthouse, Blockbuster Gloss, Negative Space, Static Locked-Off, Photography, Negative SpaceLoneliness needs room., Static Locked-OffTrust blocking and duration. Movement would be noise., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Arthouse is empty, patient, and often slightly mis-framed. Blockbuster Gloss is the opposite finish. Negative Space is a composition tool. Static Locked-Off is the locked camera. Photography pretends to be a print: posed light, decisive moment. Arthouse may refuse the decisive moment and keep running. Negative SpaceLoneliness needs room. Static Locked-OffTrust blocking and duration. Movement would be noise. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：Toni Erdmann (plain light, social duration, frames that do not flatter). Roma (65mm black-and-white patience, even when the set is full).；Drive My Car (holds on cars, rooms, and grief). Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Arthouse still of [Subject], patience, odd headroom, natural window light, the frame willing to be empty, static camera, duration implied. Name the unused air in the frame.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Arthouse still of [Subject], patience, odd headroom, natural light, the frame willing to be empty, duration implied.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not add a heroic rim or clean poster skies.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Blockbuster Gloss or Photography: a rim-lit poster, or a perfectly posed print. The tell is a hair light, centered beauty, and no empty duration. Fix: lock off, raise the headroom, kill the rim, and let the room stay a room.

### Animation
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/animation)
- 定义：Animation cinematography constructs light and motion instead of capturing them: graphic volume, designed keys, and movement as drawing, paint, or stepped CG, not as a photographed exposure. The world is built. Lens physics appear only if you choose them.
- 叙事功能：A drawing can hold a smear. A painted film can ignore a 180-degree shutter. Spider-Verse can step the action and print halftone. Kaguya can let charcoal dissolve. The 'camera' is a viewpoint in a constructed space. It is not Pixel Art (discrete sampling and a locked palette) and not Stop Motion (physical puppets moved a frame at a time). Those are specific construction methods. Animation as a look means designed light and graphic motion, in 2D, 3D, or hybrid.
- 怎么拍：Decide the construction: 2D volumes, CG with graphic shaders, or mixed. Light is keyed in the design, not motivated only by a set practical unless you invent one. Motion: smears, holds, stepped frame rates, or full 24fps. Do not default to photoreal ray-traced blur unless that is the film. Prompt graphic volume, designed light, motion as drawing rather than photography.
- 何时用：Use it when the world must be constructed, not captured. Do not use it as a filter on live action that still wants real lens physics, and do not collapse it into pixel tiles or puppet stop-motion unless that is the method.
- 近似对比：Animation, Pixel Art, Stop Motion, Video Game, Pixel ArtThe world is tiles., Stop MotionMotion should feel made., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Animation is constructed motion and light. Pixel Art is tiled, paletted sampling. Stop Motion is physical increment. Video Game is playable camera logic (follow cam, HUD, collision), which may be animated or live-action dressed as a game. A photoreal CG shot that imitates a 50mm still is animation as production, not this graphic look. Pixel ArtThe world is tiles. Stop MotionMotion should feel made. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse (stepped motion, graphic halftone, designed light). The Tale of the Princess Kaguya (charcoal and watercolor as cinematography).；Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Animated treatment of [Subject], graphic volume, designed light, motion as drawing rather than photography. Name the medium (halftone, charcoal, cel, graphic CG).`
- 示例 Prompt：`Animated cinematic treatment of [Subject], graphic volume, designed light, motion as drawing rather than photography.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is photoreal live action, Pixel Art, or Stop Motion. The tell is a 50mm bokeh plate, chunky sprites, or puppet seams you did not want. Fix: specify the graphic medium, design the key as paint or shader, and choose smear or stepped motion.

### BTS
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/bts)
- 定义：Behind the scenes cinematography shows the making: C-stands, flags, the set wall, and crew in the same frame as the fiction, so the constructed world leaks. Documentary light (worklamps, mixed Kinos) sits beside the scene's key.
- 叙事功能：The shot admits the apparatus. An actor holds a mark. A boom dips. The apartment has no fourth wall. You came for the scene and got the factory that makes it. That leak can be comic, tender, or cruel. It is not Cinéma Vérité of real life, and not a sit-down Interview unless you plant one on the set. It is documentary rhetoric aimed at a film set. Documentary of a non-film subject will not show stands and flags.
- 怎么拍：Two lighting worlds: the scene's motivated key on the actor, and unstyled worklight on crew and the studio. Include a stand, a flag, a slate, or the unfinished set edge. Camera: observational handheld or a wider locked shot that keeps crew readable. Do not pretty the crew with the movie rim. Prompt crew, stands, and the set edge visible, the fiction leaking, documentary light on a constructed world.
- 何时用：Use it when the making must be visible, not only the make-believe. Do not use it as a vérité street look with no set, and do not hide every stand if you claimed BTS.
- 近似对比：BTS, Cinéma Vérité, Documentary, Interview, Cinéma VéritéStyle would be propaganda., InterviewSomeone is answering a question we did not hear., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  BTS is a set with its crew visible. Cinéma Vérité is real life with a filmmaker. Documentary is evidence rhetoric at large. Interview may appear inside BTS (a director talk) but is not the leak of the set. If there is no apparatus in frame, it is not behind the scenes. Cinéma VéritéStyle would be propaganda. InterviewSomeone is answering a question we did not hear. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：Day for Night (a production as the subject, the set as a factory). Living in Oblivion (independent-set chaos as comedy).；Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Behind-the-scenes look at [Subject], crew, C-stands, and the set edge visible, the fiction leaking, worklight mixed with the scene key. Name a stand or a flag.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Behind-the-scenes look at [Subject], crew, stands, and the set edge visible, the fiction leaking, documentary light on a constructed world.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not hide the apparatus.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Cinéma Vérité or a clean production still: street vérité, or the scene with no crew. The tell is a finished fourth wall and no stands. Fix: show the wall missing, a flag, a person with a boom, and mixed worklight.

### Dreamcore
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/dreamcore)
- 定义：The dreamcore aesthetic is a soft, liminal interior look: empty rooms, pools, and suburban halls lit by childhood practicals gone slightly wrong, with low contrast and unresolved space. Nostalgia is present. Safety is not.
- 叙事功能：A corridor continues too far. A fluorescent is a little green. A window is over-bloomed like a memory. The person may be small or absent. Nothing jumps. The dread is that the room will not resolve into a place you can leave. It is not Weirdcore (low-res digital, captions, early-web jokes that threaten). It is not Altered State (smear, afterimage, unhooked color as perception failure). It is not Magical Realism (a recognizable world with one impossible fact treated as weather). Dreamcore is the memory-room.
- 怎么拍：Wide 24mm to 35mm, eye level, often locked. Soft sources: fluorescent, a cheap tungsten lamp, a blown window. Keep contrast low. Fog the blacks a little. Palette: 1990s suburban pastel or pool cyan, slightly sick. Empty the mid-ground. Prompt liminal rooms, soft dread, childhood lighting gone wrong, a memory that will not resolve.
- 何时用：Use it when nostalgia must lose its safety in an empty interior. Do not use it for JPEG horror, for a miracle in daylight realism, or for a warped trip sequence.
- 近似对比：Dreamcore, Weirdcore, Altered State, Magical Realism, WeirdcoreThe familiar is incorrectly rendered., Altered StateThe mind is the location., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Dreamcore is soft analog liminal space. Weirdcore is degraded digital and captioned. Altered State warps the image physically. Magical Realism keeps ordinary light and one impossible fact. If you add clipart and 240p, you have left dreamcore. WeirdcoreThe familiar is incorrectly rendered. Altered StateThe mind is the location. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：Synecdoche, New York (rooms that replicate and will not end, theater as a memory warehouse). The Backrooms culture (liminal empty interiors as internet folklore).；Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Dreamcore image of [Subject], liminal rooms, soft fluorescent or blown window, childhood lighting gone wrong, low contrast, a memory that will not resolve. Name the empty hall or pool.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Dreamcore image of [Subject], liminal rooms, soft dread, childhood lighting gone wrong, a memory that will not resolve.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not add JPEG captions or psychedelic smear.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Weirdcore or Altered State: chunky artifacts and captions, or trailing edges. The tell is low-res clipart or a trip warp. Fix: keep resolution continuous, soften the key, empty the corridor, and let the light be almost-childhood.

### Dystopian
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/dystopian)
- 定义：Dystopian cinematography makes the civic system the antagonist: used architecture, haze, rank, and signage at a scale that already feels worn. The future is not shiny. It is bureaucratic, polluted, or monumental and cold, often in daylight as well as night.
- 叙事功能：A checkpoint. A tower. A crowd compressed by a long lens, or a handheld walk through trash and concrete. The sky is rarely clean. The person is ranked by clothing, by queue, by a logo on a wall. It is not automatically Tech Noir. Tech noir is wet guilty night and investigation, screens as keys. Dystopia can be a grey afternoon, a refugee camp, an orange industrial fog, with no detective. Bleach Bypass can drain the silver. It is a process, not the whole civic design.
- 怎么拍：Two common modes: dirty handheld 35mm with available mixed light and lens dirt (civic collapse), or monumental wides with haze, fog, and controlled orange or grey (state scale). Keep surfaces used: stains, signage, rank. Avoid heroic rims unless the regime would light itself that way. Prompt civic scale gone cold, haze, signage, and rank, a future that already feels used.
- 何时用：Use it when the system, not a single villain, has to be visible in the streets. Do not use it as generic grey sci-fi, or as neon crime with no civic rank.
- 近似对比：Dystopian, Tech Noir, Bleach Bypass, Blockbuster Gloss, Tech NoirThe future is wet and guilty., Bleach BypassWar, crime, or a world without mercy., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Dystopian is used civic future. Tech Noir is noir crime inside a machine night. Bleach Bypass is a desaturated silver process. Blockbuster Gloss polishes adventure. If the city is wet, neon, and investigative, check whether you actually want tech noir. If the sky is clean and rim-lit, you have left dystopia. Tech NoirThe future is wet and guilty. Bleach BypassWar, crime, or a world without mercy. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：Children of Men (handheld civic dirt, 35mm, long-take streets, a used near-future). Blade Runner 2049 (monumental fog, orange, rank, and scale).；Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Dystopian view of [Subject], civic scale gone cold, haze, signage, and rank, used surfaces, a future that already feels worn. Name the checkpoint, queue, or tower.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Dystopian view of [Subject], civic scale gone cold, haze, signage, and rank, a future that already feels used.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Tech Noir or Blockbuster Gloss: neon rain investigation, or a poster-clean future. The tell is a hard noir cheek with no civic rank, or a rim-lit sky. Fix: dirty the surfaces, add signage and haze, and decide handheld-civic versus monumental-fog.

### Magical Realism
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/magical-realism)
- 定义：Magical realism cinematography treats an extraordinary event as ordinary inside a recognizable world: the same window light, the same 35mm coverage, with one impossible fact staged as if it were weather. The camera does not gawk, add a rim, or warp the lens.
- 叙事功能：A girl sees a monster and the exposure does not change. Snow falls in a kitchen and the practicals stay kitchen practicals. Wonder is not a lighting cue. If you add shafts, dutch angles, and a choir of haze, you have left the contract. It is not Dreamcore (liminal rooms, unresolved memory). It is not Altered State (perception smear). It is not blockbuster spectacle. The world stays real. One fact does not.
- 怎么拍：Motivated naturalistic light: window, overcast, a household bulb. 35mm or 50mm, eye level, coverage as if nothing were impossible. Play the miracle in the same size you would play a kettle. Do not under-light, dutch, or add volumetric spectacle for the impossible beat. Prompt ordinary light, one impossible fact treated as weather.
- 何时用：Use it when a miracle must not become a set-piece. Do not use it for a trip sequence, a liminal corridor, or an effects showcase.
- 近似对比：Magical Realism, Dreamcore, Altered State, Southern Gothic, DreamcoreNostalgia with the safety removed., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps., Neo-NoirNoir after color was invented.
  Magical Realism keeps ordinary light and one impossible fact. Dreamcore empties and softens the room. Altered State warps perception. Southern Gothic can host strange events but its optical problem is heat and decay, not a calmly covered miracle. If the camera gawks, it is spectacle, not this look. DreamcoreNostalgia with the safety removed. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps. Neo-NoirNoir after color was invented.
- 片中实例：The Spirit of the Beehive (honeyed natural light, a child's encounter played as afternoon). Beasts of the Southern Wild (aural and visual wonders inside humid daylight realism).；Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Magical-realist image of [Subject], ordinary window or overcast light, 35mm eye level, one impossible fact treated as weather, no extra rim, no dutch. Name the ordinary room and the single impossibility.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Magical-realist image of [Subject], ordinary light, one impossible fact treated as weather.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not add spectacle shafts.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Dreamcore, Altered State, or gloss: a liminal hall, a smear, or a volumetric miracle. The tell is a lighting change at the impossible beat. Fix: keep the same key, the same lens height, and stage the impossibility as weather.

### Maximalism
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/maximalism)
- 定义：Maximalist cinematography uses density as the point: too much color, too much pattern, ornament in every zone, and lighting that keeps the clutter readable rather than hiding it. Restraint would be a lie, so the frame is packed on purpose.
- 叙事功能：Wallpaper fights the costume. A pastry fights the uniform. Pink fights purple. The eye has no rest unless a centered axis organizes the noise (a hotel lobby) or a smash of hue refuses rest (a dance hall). Speed and scale can join the density, but the optical fact is abundance. It is not Giallo. Giallo stains relatively chic space with a weaponized primary. Maximalism fills the space with pattern for its own sake. Hyper-Saturation is a grade. You can saturate a empty desert and still not be maximalist.
- 怎么拍：Short to moderate lenses (24mm to 40mm) to pack furniture and pattern. Multiple colored practicals. High chroma, high detail, often symmetry or a center line so the density composes. Keep enough stop that wallpaper does not melt into bokeh unless a close-up needs it. Prompt too much color, too much pattern, density as the point.
- 何时用：Use it when a world is ornamental, theatrical, or stuffed, and a sparse frame would deny that world. Do not use it as a loud grade on an empty room, or as giallo threat with one gel.
- 近似对比：Maximalism, Giallo, Hyper-Saturation, Blockbuster Gloss, Arthouse, GialloHorror that is also fashion., Hyper-SaturationFeeling is louder than fact., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Maximalism is packed production design plus chroma. Giallo is fashion-threat primaries. Hyper-Saturation is the grade only. Blockbuster Gloss can be relatively clean and expensive. Arthouse empties. If you can count three competing patterns and they are all in focus, you are in maximalism. GialloHorror that is also fashion. Hyper-SaturationFeeling is louder than fact. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：The Grand Budapest Hotel (centered density, uniforms, pastry, wallpaper as architecture). Moulin Rouge!；(theatrical color, patterned interiors, speed as ornament). Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Maximalist frame of [Subject], too much color, too much pattern, multiple practicals, density as the point, 24mm to 40mm so the clutter stays readable. Name the wallpaper and the costume clash.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Maximalist frame of [Subject], too much color, too much pattern, density as the point.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not empty the room.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Giallo or Hyper-Saturation: one violent gel, or a loud grade on bare walls. The tell is empty negative space and a single hue. Fix: fill every zone with pattern, keep it sharp, and let several colors compete.

### Photography
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/photography)
- 定义：Photographic cinematography treats the movie as a print: a single decisive frame, posed or found light, often Centered Composition or Tableau blocking, with the camera pretending it could hang on a wall. Motion is allowed, but the still is the law.
- 叙事功能：Hold. This is the picture. A candlelit room is arranged like a painting. A river still is exposed for the sky. People occupy the frame as if a shutter, not a scene, were about to close. It is close to Arthouse patience but not the same. Arthouse may be empty, slightly ugly, and long. Photography wants the print: a chosen moment, shaped light, a composition that would survive without time. If the camera hunts, you have left the still.
- 怎么拍：Tripod. One frame. Pose the bodies or wait for a still gesture. Light as a stills photographer would: window, candle, or a single shaped key, not a moving TV-style fill. 35mm to 85mm, sometimes a zoom used as a stills crop (as in Barry Lyndon). Prompt still-photography grammar, a single decisive frame, posed light, the movie pretending to be a print.
- 何时用：Use it when the beat is a picture, not a passage. Do not use it for coverage that must cut, or for empty duration that refuses to compose.
- 近似对比：Photography, Tableau, Centered Composition, Arthouse, Static Locked-Off, TableauHold the arrangement., Centered CompositionControl, ritual, comedy, or fate., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Photography is the print as grammar. Tableau is staged group composition. Centered Composition is a placement rule. Arthouse may refuse the decisive moment. Static Locked-Off is only the locked head. A photographically lit moving shot can still be this look if every frame could hang. A locked empty hold with odd headroom is arthouse first. TableauHold the arrangement. Centered CompositionControl, ritual, comedy, or fate. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：Barry Lyndon (candlelit stills, zoom as a painter's crop). The New World (natural light, frames that behave like exposed plates).；Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Still-photography grammar on [Subject], a single decisive frame, posed or window light, tripod, the movie pretending to be a print. Name the print logic (candle tableau, river still, posed portrait).`
- 示例 Prompt：`Still-photography grammar on [Subject], a single decisive frame, posed light, the movie pretending to be a print.`
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Arthouse emptiness or a moving coverage scene: odd unused air, or a walk-and-talk. The tell is a frame that would not survive as a still, or a camera that hunts. Fix: lock, compose as a print, and shape one light.

### Pixel Art

- 定义：Pixel art builds the image from visible tiles or a low-resolution grid. The world is discrete squares, not continuous grain.
- 叙事功能：The world is tiles. If the beat is actually Video Game, change the setup instead of forcing pixel art.
- 怎么拍：For pixel art: a genre look is light, palette, lens, and blocking together, not the genre name alone. In a prompt it reads like this: Pixel-art treatment of the subject, chunky samples, limited palette, game-sprite cinema. Write a start state, one change, and an end frame the next shot can inherit.
- 何时用：The world is tiles. Do not use pixel art to make a frame look expensive. Prefer Video Game when that cousin's job is the one you actually need.
- 近似对比：Video Game, Animation, Video GameThe world is playable., AnimationThe world is constructed, not captured., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Pixel Art is easy to confuse with Video Game, Animation. Stay on pixel art when the world is tiles. If the beat is Video Game, shoot that instead. Video GameThe world is playable. AnimationThe world is constructed, not captured. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：Pixel Art is easier to picture if you remember "Wreck-It Ralph adjacent", "indie games". Borrow camera, light, and subject relationships, not a copyrighted still.
- Prompt 模板：`Do not replace physics with mood adjectives. Still clause: Pixel-art treatment of the subject, chunky samples, limited palette, game-sprite cinema.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Pixel-art treatment of [Subject], chunky samples, limited palette, game-sprite cinema.`
- Prompt 要点：Lead with who does what. Camera, light, and style follow.
- 常见错误：The usual failure is asking for pixel art and getting Video Game. Pixel Art is easy to confuse with Video Game, Animation. Stay on pixel art when the world is tiles. If the beat is Video Game, shoot that instead.

### Stylistic Suck
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/stylistic-suck)
- 定义：Stylistic suck is deliberate amateur cinematography: hunting zooms, cheap video, and the wrong white balance as a choice of the film's own camera, not necessarily of a character's recovered tape. Polish would be dishonest, so the image is ugly on purpose.
- 叙事功能：Auto-exposure pumps. A zoom overshoots a face. Fluorescent kitchens go green. Highlights blow like 1990s VHS. The film is allowed to look poorly made because that look is the argument: poverty, joke, cruelty, or anti-beauty. It overlaps Found Footage but is not the same. Found footage needs a diegetic operator and a tape story. Stylistic suck can be omniscient and still ugly: no timestamp required. It also overlaps Cinéma Vérité, but vérité hunts in order to witness. Suck hunts in order to fail, as style.
- 怎么拍：Consumer camcorder or VHS: auto gain, hunting zoom, rolling shutter, blown practicals, wrong WB left wrong. Allow bad centering. Do not 'fix' in the grade. If you add a pretty close-up, you have broken the contract. Prompt deliberate amateur look, bad zoom, cheap video, the wrong white balance as a choice.
- 何时用：Use it when polish would be dishonest. Do not use it as accidental incompetence, and do not use it as found footage without an operator story.
- 近似对比：Stylistic Suck, Found Footage, Cinéma Vérité, Documentary, Found FootageThe operator is in danger too., Cinéma VéritéStyle would be propaganda., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Stylistic Suck is the film choosing ugliness. Found Footage is a character's recorder. Cinéma Vérité is available-light witnessing. Documentary may still be respectful and sharp. If there is a timestamp and a diegetic reason the camera exists, you are in found footage. If the ugliness is the film's voice, you are here. Found FootageThe operator is in danger too. Cinéma VéritéStyle would be propaganda. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：The Blair Witch Project (amateur optics; also found footage, so use it as overlap, not as the whole definition). Trash Humpers (VHS, blown highlights, ugliness as the work).；Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Deliberate amateur look on [Subject], hunting zoom, cheap video, wrong white balance as a choice, blown practicals, bad centering. Do not add a timestamp unless there is also a diegetic camera.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Deliberate amateur look on [Subject], bad zoom, cheap video, the wrong white balance as a choice.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not correct the color.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Found Footage: you add a timestamp and an operator without meaning to. The tell is a recovered-tape premise you did not want, or a pretty backup angle. Fix: keep the film's camera ugly and omniscient, or commit fully to a diegetic device if that is the story.

### Video Game
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/video-game)
- 定义：Video game cinematography uses playable camera logic: a follow cam, an isometric view, or an FPS eyeline, with space readable as a level and a HUD implied. Collision, boom height, and pathing constrain the lens the way a game engine would.
- 叙事功能：The world is playable. A character moves and the camera booms behind at a fixed height, or the map is seen at 45 degrees, or we look through a reticle. Collectible space, ledges, and arenas matter. A HUD may sit in the glass. It is not Pixel Art unless the level is also tiled. It is not FPV Drone (a real or simulated racing drone through a physical world). It is not photoreal live action with a fake reticle slapped on. The camera must behave like a game camera.
- 怎么拍：Pick the logic: third-person follow (boom 2 to 3 meters, lag, collision), isometric 45-degree orthographic, or FPS. Keep the path readable. Add a HUD only if the beat is play, not if it is a movie cover of a game. Motion: analog stick ease, not a film dolly's ease. Prompt follow cam or isometric logic, HUD implied, space as a level.
- 何时用：Use it when space must feel playable. Do not use it as a skin on a normal coverage scene, and do not reduce it to chunky pixels unless the game is pixel-art.
- 近似对比：Video Game, Pixel Art, FPV Drone, Animation, FPV DroneImpossible proximity and speed. Not a cinematic crane; a missile with a lens., Pixel ArtThe world is tiles., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Video Game is engine-like camera logic. Pixel Art is sampling. FPV Drone is a physical flying camera through real space. Animation may render a game, or not. If the camera dollies like a film crew and there is no follow, iso, or FPS constraint, it is not this look. FPV DroneImpossible proximity and speed. Not a cinematic crane; a missile with a lens. Pixel ArtThe world is tiles. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：Free Guy (a life inside a game's follow-cam and HUD logic). Scott Pilgrim vs.；the World (fight space, UI, and level logic inside live action). Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Video-game camera on [Subject], follow cam or isometric logic, HUD implied, space as a level, boom height locked, path readable. Name the camera type.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Video-game camera on [Subject], follow cam or isometric logic, HUD implied, space as a level.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not describe a film dolly unless the game would dolly.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Pixel Art or a film Follow Shot shot with a reticle overlay. The tell is continuous film blocking, or tiles you did not want. Fix: lock boom height or isometric angle, make the path a level, and let the camera collide or lag like an engine.

### Weirdcore
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/genre-looks/weirdcore)
- 定义：The weirdcore aesthetic renders the familiar incorrectly: early-web compression, low-res sacred images, off-center crops, and a joke that is also a threat. The file looks like it should not have opened. Light is on-camera flash or a dim analog room, not a designed key.
- 叙事功能：A face is cut by the frame edge. A caption sits in a default font. JPEG blocks crawl. A toy in the dark is both funny and wrong. Resolution is a weapon. The familiar (a bedroom, a mall, a smile) is encoded badly on purpose. It is not Dreamcore. Dreamcore is soft, spatial, analog-liminal. Weirdcore is digital-degraded, captioned, clipart-adjacent. It is not Altered State smear. The warp is compression and crop, not a trip.
- 怎么拍：Crush the resolution. Allow JPEG artifacts, 240p, chromatic cheapness. Crop faces wrong. On-camera flash or underexposed analog dark. Optional captions. Palette: Windows-era interiors, flash skin, crushed blacks. Prompt early-web dread, low-res sacred, a joke that is also a threat.
- 何时用：Use it when the familiar must look incorrectly encoded. Do not use it for a soft memory hall, for a psychedelic warp, or for polished vaporwave marble.
- 近似对比：Weirdcore, Dreamcore, Altered State, Vaporwave, Stylistic Suck, DreamcoreNostalgia with the safety removed., Altered StateThe mind is the location., Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
  Weirdcore is low-res, cropped, captioned threat. Dreamcore is a soft empty room. Altered State smears perception. Vaporwave is pastel, marble, and tape-nostalgia without the joke-threat. Stylistic Suck is amateur video as a film's voice. Weirdcore is specifically early-web incorrectness. DreamcoreNostalgia with the safety removed. Altered StateThe mind is the location. Film NoirCrime, guilt, and streetlamps.
- 片中实例：Skinamarink (dark analog rooms, toys, faces withheld, internet-horror adjacent). Internet horror stills and early-web images supply the native grammar.；Grammar, not frames to copy.
- Prompt 模板：`Weirdcore image of [Subject], early-web dread, low-res sacred, wrong crop, JPEG artifacts, a joke that is also a threat. Name the caption or the chopped face.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Weirdcore image of [Subject], early-web dread, low-res sacred, a joke that is also a threat.`
- Prompt 要点：Do not polish, and do not soften into a liminal pool.
- 常见错误：The usual wrong cousin is Dreamcore or Vaporwave: a soft hall, or a pink-cyan mall. The tell is continuous high-res pastel. Fix: crush the file, crop wrong, add a cheap flash or a caption, and let the joke threaten.

### Agamemnon
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/viral-looks/agamemnon)
- 定义：Agamemnon, the agamemnon look, is a named grade of hard sun, bronze bounce, and a dusk sky the color of a bruise, so a living body reads as antique metal. The name is not a shot: you still lock a height, pick a lens, and place a figure who can hold that weather.
- 叙事功能：Use it on a beat where the person is already doomed and the sky agrees. A rider on a ridge, a man on an empty platform, a coat at a parapet: the camera stays mostly still so metal and dusk can do the sentence. Scale may go statue-large or map-small. Either is legal if the sun is hard and the fill never turns the face into a beauty still. It is the wrong tool when the scene needs charm, flirtation, or a clean key. Pour it on a rom-com and you get a perfume ad with extra dirt, or a tragedy nobody asked for.
- 怎么拍：Lock off, or use a slow push that does not steal the grade. Eye height to slightly low, 35mm to 50mm so faces do not melt. Key is hard sun or a hard HMI from camera-left or behind. Bounce is warm dust, bronze, or iron, not a white card. Shadows stay opaque. No neon, no beauty dish. Then prompt: Agamemnon look on [Subject], bronze, blood-dusk, tragic scale, a king under a bad sky, antique epic as grade. Name the stand, the key side, and what must stay readable.
- 何时用：A myth, a war portrait, or a contemporary face that should feel cursed: the rider pauses on the ridge and the citadel below already looks like a tomb. Do not use it as a default warm LUT on any wide.
- 近似对比：Spaghetti Western, Hard Light, Knight's Diary, Spaghetti WesternMyth in dirt., Hard LightGrit, noon sun, or interrogation., Ink RiotThe image should spill.
  Spaghetti Western shares hard sun and dust, but its moral weather is frontier irony, not antique bronze. Hard Light is the lamp without the metal-and-dusk law. Knight's Diary is the same period hunger written as gold leaf and mud on a page, not as a king under a bad sky. Spaghetti WesternMyth in dirt. Hard LightGrit, noon sun, or interrogation. Ink RiotThe image should spill.
- 片中实例：Troy gives the sun-and-metal grammar. The Northman gives mud, iron, and a face that already lost.；Borrow light and metal, not a copyrighted still.
- Prompt 模板：`Lead with the person and the stand, then the grade. Example: Agamemnon look on [Subject], bronze, blood-dusk, tragic scale, a king under a bad sky, antique epic as grade.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Add hard sun camera-left, opaque shadows, 35mm, eye height, no neon. Do not write mood words in place of the key.`
- 常见错误：The usual cousin is a generic teal-and-gold prestige still, or a Hard Light beauty portrait. The tell is perfume-ad skin and a sky that is only pretty. Fix it: name bronze, bruise dusk, and a figure small or statue-large, then kill the fill.

### Ink Riot
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/viral-looks/ink-riot)
- 定义：Ink riot, the ink riot effect, is liquid calligraphy occupying the air around a still-photographic subject: black and color blooming, dripping, exploding off a brush. The camera still needs a stand and a readable face, because the ink is weather, not a texture pack.
- 叙事功能：The shot is a page that fought back. Hold the person. Let ink do the violence: a bloom past the cheek, a splash that hides a doorway, a black tide that has not yet reached the eyes. Titles, music, and a character whose interior is a mess can survive this. Procedural crime coverage usually cannot, unless you are in the credits. It is the wrong tool when you need geography, eyelines, or a clean insert. If the face drowns, you shot a stock loop of paint, not a scene.
- 怎么拍：Lock off, or use a tiny handheld that does not chase every splash. Eye height, 35mm to 50mm, subject sharp. Key is a real lamp (sodium, window, practical) so the photographic body has a shadow. Describe ink as matter: blooming, dripping, occupying air. One palette, not every hue. Keep eyes clear. Prompt: Ink riot around [Subject], black and color blooming in liquid, calligraphy as explosion, a page that fights.
- 何时用：A title card, a breakdown, a music still where the room should spill. Do not use it on a two-shot that has to cut on dialogue.
- 近似对比：Collage, Mixed Media, Akrill, CollageOne image is not enough; stack them., Mixed MediaNo single medium owns the truth., AgamemnonMake them ancient and doomed.
  Collage is cut paper and edges, dry pieces, not liquid. Mixed Media stacks stocks and techniques. Akrill is thick paint sitting on the world. Ink riot is airborne calligraphy around a face that still photographs. CollageOne image is not enough; stack them. Mixed MediaNo single medium owns the truth. AgamemnonMake them ancient and doomed.
- 片中实例：Zhang Yimou's Hero uses ink-in-water as weather around bodies. Sin City titles treat ink as the world.；The still should look wet. You are borrowing the liquid law, not a frame.
- Prompt 模板：`Hold a readable subject, then the liquid. Ink riot around [Subject], black and color blooming in liquid, calligraphy as explosion, a page that fights.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Ink riot around [Subject], black and color blooming in liquid, calligraphy as explosion, a page that fights.`
- Prompt 要点：The person does not dissolve.
- 常见错误：Models drown the subject or add Comic halftone and oil at once. The tell is no eyes, or every medium in one frame. Fix it: one ink palette, photographic face, lock-off, ink as matter in air.

### Fallen Angel
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/viral-looks/fallen-angel)
- 定义：Fallen angel, the fallen angel look, is holy light after the drop: a shaft of dirty church air, low-key flesh, wrecked wings implied by cloth, shadow, or light. The face is the altar, and costume is optional.
- 叙事功能：The fall already happened. You are photographing the minute after: a nave, a cliff, a rooftop, a person in wrecked pale fabric with the head slightly bowed. The camera stays still enough that the shaft of light can judge. Wings can be a coat, a shadow on stone, or nothing. Literal feathers often cheapen the theology. It is the wrong tool for Halloween, superhero sheen, or a romance that still believes in rescue. If the light is pretty and the wings are stock white, you shot a carnival float.
- 怎么拍：Eye height or slightly low in a nave or on a cliff. 35mm to 50mm. Key is a high dirty window or a hard shaft camera-left, pews or rock falling to black. Low-Key Lighting contrast. Skin like painted wood, not beauty oil. Cloth that can read as ruined wings without a feather store. Prompt: Fallen-angel image of [Subject], wrecked wings implied, church light, a holy fall, beauty after the drop.
- 何时用：Grief, blasphemy, a portrait that should feel judged: the person in the aisle, head bowed, dust in the shaft. Do not use it as a costume still with white wings and a clean key.
- 近似对比：Epiphany, Low-Key Lighting, Silhouette, EpiphanyUnderstanding should be visible., Low-Key LightingMystery, crime, or moral night., AgamemnonMake them ancient and doomed.
  Epiphany is revelation light that arrives as knowledge. Fallen angel is the same sacred air after failure. Low-Key Lighting is the contrast without the theology. Silhouette deletes the face. Here the face stays, half-lit, already fallen. EpiphanyUnderstanding should be visible. Low-Key LightingMystery, crime, or moral night. AgamemnonMake them ancient and doomed.
- 片中实例：Wings of Desire treats angels as watchers in real air and coats. The Prophecy treats the holy as violent and tired.；Light is the theology. You are not copying a still.
- Prompt 模板：`Place the body, the shaft, and the dark. Fallen-angel image of [Subject], wrecked wings implied, church light, a holy fall, beauty after the drop.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Add nave or cliff, high dirty window camera-left, low-key, no superhero sheen, feathers optional and wrecked. Lock the camera.`
- 常见错误：The usual cousin is a stock angel with white wings, or a generic Low-Key Lighting beauty. The tell is carnival feathers and a clean key. Fix it: cut the feathers, keep the shaft, wreck the cloth, hold the face.

### Fairytale Castle
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/viral-looks/fairytale-castle)
- 定义：Fairytale castle, the fairytale castle look, puts storybook stone and impossible turrets around a small figure, with dusk treated as illustration. Place first, person second: the name is a location law, not a camera move.
- 叙事功能：The arrival, the exile, the love story that needs a kingdom: a causeway, window grids, indigo-and-gold hour, one person small enough that the building still speaks. Stone should look drawn and real at once, like a children's plate that grew up. Weather has to exist. A plastic CGI battlement with no hour is a matte, not this look. It is the wrong tool for a tourist establishing shot of a real European site, unless tourists are the joke. If the figure is hero-large, the castle becomes a backdrop and the tale dies.
- 怎么拍：Wide locked camera, slightly low or eye height on the path, 24mm to 35mm. The figure occupies a third or less. Key is dusk: indigo air, gold on stone edges. Ask for illustration-grade stone and photochemical haze, not game-engine brick. Name the path to the door. Prompt: Fairytale-castle world around [Subject], storybook stone, impossible turrets, dusk as illustration.
- 何时用：An arrival at a kingdom, an exile looking back, a love story that needs architecture as fate. Do not use it as a postcard of a real castle with a couple in the foreground.
- 近似对比：Magical Realism, Diorama, Lost in a Book, Magical RealismMiracle without spectacle., DioramaShrink the epic until it fits a shelf., AgamemnonMake them ancient and doomed.
  Magical Realism keeps real air and adds one impossible law. Fairytale castle makes the architecture itself a tale. Diorama is toy scale on a table. Lost in a Book uses a page as the door into that world. Magical RealismMiracle without spectacle. DioramaShrink the epic until it fits a shelf. AgamemnonMake them ancient and doomed.
- 片中实例：The Fall builds kingdoms as illustrated space around a body. Pan's Labyrinth lets stone and dusk obey storybook law.；Borrow the law of space, not a studio's castle.
- Prompt 模板：`Start with the building, then the small person. Fairytale-castle world around [Subject], storybook stone, impossible turrets, dusk as illustration.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Add causeway, window grids, indigo-gold hour, 24mm lock-off, figure small, photochemical air. No plastic battlements.`
- 常见错误：Generic fantasy mattes with no weather, or a tourist wide. The tell is game-engine brick and a hero who fills the frame. Fix it: name the hour, the path, illustration-grade stone, and one small figure.

### Comic
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/viral-looks/comic)
- 定义：Comic, in comic book cinematography, inks a live-action frame: hard edges, halftone in the shadows, limited spots of color, a page that still has a photographed body in it. The camera still has a lens and one sun, and it is not a screenshot of a book.

### Cold Vision
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/viral-looks/cold-vision)
- 定义：Cold vision, the cold vision look, reads the world as temperature: either an arctic photochemical grade with breath and ice, or a thermal false-color overlay with heat edges. Empathy is not in the palette, so pick one sensor and keep it.
- 叙事功能：Hunts, winter war, a stalker POV: faces become warmer than walls if you are in thermal, or paler than snow if you are in climate. The camera can be lock-off, handheld, or a device POV, but the seeing logic cannot change mid-shot. Kindness dies in this grade unless the joke is cruelty. It is the wrong tool for a Christmas romance, a beauty key, or a teal wash that only makes skin pale. If there is no breath, ice, or heat edge, you shot a cool LUT.
- 怎么拍：Choose one: (1) arctic still, 35mm, breath visible, ice in the air, hard winter sun or overcast white, photochemical blues, or (2) thermal/false-color overlay, readable human hotter than the room, device frame optional but no HUD letters. Do not mix Night Vision green unless that is the device. Prompt: Cold vision of [Subject], arctic grade, thermal edges, a world seen as temperature and threat.
- 何时用：A hunt through snow, a stalker watching heat, a winter war still. Do not use it as teal-and-sad on a love scene unless cruelty is the point.
- 近似对比：Thermal, Night Vision, Cool Blue, ThermalSee temperature, not light., Night VisionSomeone is hunting in the dark., Cool BlueCold institutions, night, or alienation.
  Thermal is the device overlay as such. Night Vision is green intensification, a different sensor. Cool Blue is white-balance weather without a seeing-device or ice logic. Cold vision is the named recipe that must pick one of those physics and commit. ThermalSee temperature, not light. Night VisionSomeone is hunting in the dark. Cool BlueCold institutions, night, or alienation.
- 片中实例：The Revenant is winter as climate: breath, ice, unkind daylight. The Thing is isolation in cold rooms and a world read as threat.；Name the device if you want a thermal overlay rather than weather.
- Prompt 模板：`Name the sensor, then the body. Cold vision of [Subject], arctic grade, thermal edges, a world seen as temperature and threat.`
- 示例 Prompt：`Add either breath and ice with a winter key, or false-color heat with a readable face. One logic.`
- Prompt 要点：No night-vision green unless you mean that tube.
- 常见错误：A teal grade with pale skin, or a mash of thermal plus Night Vision. The tell is no breath, no ice, no heat edge. Fix it: pick climate or device, show the physics, hold the face.

### Casual Monster Slayer
- [原文](https://melies.co/cinematic-techniques/viral-looks/casual-monster-slayer)
- 定义：Casual monster slayer is deadpan heroism in ordinary clothes: supermarket wardrobe, impossible creature work, the same naturalistic light on both. The joke is register clash, and the camera should look like coverage of a commute, not a poster.
